paper.title: Proteus: Incremental Memory Activation for Long-Context Sequence Modeling
paper.abstract: The quadratic cost of attention-based sequence models for long contexts has motivated a growing line of research on memory-based models that can compress context into a compact state. However, most existing memory models expose a static memory throughout the entire sequence. Because early tokens face no compression pressure, they occupy too many degrees of freedom and "pollute" the memory state, leaving little capacity for later context and increasing interference between what is stored and what

summary.core_problem: 现有基于固定大小内存的长上下文序列模型（如现代RNN、线性注意力变体）存在内存分配失衡问题：早期token进入空内存时几乎没有压缩压力，会占用过多自由度，后续token只能写入剩余容量，导致严重的覆盖干扰，长上下文下后期信息留存能力差。
summary.importance: 提出了「增量内存激活」的新范式，从内存写入时机而非仅写入规则的角度优化长上下文建模，为长上下文基座模型的架构设计、预训练阶段的长度外推能力增强提供了新思路，且实现无额外参数开销，工程落地成本低。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是增量内存激活范式：将内存的有效容量作为上下文长度的函数逐步扩张——序列早期施加容量瓶颈，强制模型压缩初始上下文而非直接记忆；随序列长度增加逐步解锁未使用的新容量，为新信息提供独立写入空间，减少对已存信息的覆盖。具体实现Proteus是一种逐块门控机制，同时作用于内存的读和写操作，可直接嵌入SWLA、Comba、Titans、Hope-Attention等多种关联内存架构，无需新增参数或显存。该思路还可通过嵌套学习视角扩展到模型参数层面，适配注意力类架构。
summary.experiments: 在语言建模、常识推理、长上下文理解、大海捞针（needle-in-a-haystack）等多类基准上测试，Proteus在标准和长上下文设置下均稳定优于强基线，且上下文长度越长性能增益越显著。适配的架构覆盖多种当前最优的线性内存/深度循环模型，支持不同模型规模。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先关注第1节的问题动机（静态内存失衡的具体机制分析）、第3节的Proteus门控实现细节、第4节的长上下文增益对比图表，可跳过过于理论化的关联内存公式推导部分，预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing fixed-memory long-context sequence models (including modern RNNs and linear attention variants) suffer from unbalanced memory allocation: early tokens enter a nearly empty state with almost no compression pressure, occupying excessive memory degrees of freedom. Later tokens can only be written to residual capacity, leading to severe overwrite interference and poor retention of late-stage information in long-context scenarios.
summary_en.importance: This work proposes the incremental memory activation paradigm, which optimizes long-context modeling from the perspective of memory write timing rather than only write rules. It provides a new direction for long-context base model architecture design and length extrapolation enhancement during pretraining, with zero additional parameter overhead and low engineering deployment cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core of incremental memory activation is to schedule effective memory capacity as a function of context length: a capacity bottleneck is imposed at the early sequence stage to force the model to compress initial context instead of raw memorization; unused fresh capacity is progressively unlocked as context grows, leaving independent write space for new information and reducing overwrite of stored content. The concrete implementation, Proteus, is a block-wise gating mechanism applied to both memory read and write operations. It is a drop-in module for a broad range of associative memory architectures including SWLA, Comba, Titans, and Hope-Attention, requiring no extra parameters or memory. The principle can also be extended to the model parameter level via the Nested Learning lens to adapt to attention-based architectures.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across diverse benchmarks including language modeling, commonsense reasoning, long-context understanding, and needle-in-a-haystack tasks, Proteus consistently outperforms strong baselines under both standard and long-context settings, with gains scaling up as context length increases. The module is validated across multiple state-of-the-art linear-memory/deep recurrent architectures and supports various model scales.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, prioritize the motivation analysis in Section 1 (detailed mechanism of static memory imbalance), implementation details of Proteus gating in Section 3, and long-context gain plots in Section 4. Skip overly theoretical derivations of associative memory formulations if needed; estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得读 §方法和 retention 曲线；“容量逐步开放”是干净的架构 prior，应该在内部长上下文 memory ablation 里复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and retention curves; progressive capacity release is a clean architectural prior worth reproducing in internal long-context memory ablations.

paper.title: SEER: Long-Context Reasoning via Selective Visual-Text Compression
paper.abstract: Long-context reasoning remains computationally expensive for large language models due to the quadratic complexity of attention over text tokens. Visual-text compression offers a promising alternative by rendering text into images and processing them with vision-language models, often reducing token usage. However, existing approaches apply uniform compression regardless of query relevance, potentially sacrificing precision where detailed extraction is required. We present SEER, a framework that

summary.core_problem: 现有基于视觉-文本压缩的长上下文方法对所有文本做统一压缩，在需要精细抽取的查询相关片段上损失精度。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出选择性视觉扫描+按需文本检索的自适应框架，在节省 token 的同时保留抽取精度。
summary.technical_approach: SEER 将长文本渲染为图像，先用 VLM 做视觉扫描定位查询相关区域，再调用工具仅检索对应文本片段做精细推理；通过工具交互轨迹的 SFT 学习自适应工具调用策略。
summary.experiments: 在长上下文 benchmark 上验证，相比统一视觉压缩方法提升抽取精度，同时保持平均 prompt token 节省量；未给出具体模型规模和 baseline 数值。
summary.authors_note: 剑桥大学工程系，Tianlong Chen 为通讯作者之一，团队长期做多模态与高效推理方向。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing visual-text compression for long-context reasoning applies uniform compression regardless of query relevance, sacrificing precision on segments requiring fine-grained extraction.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: an adaptive framework combining visual scanning for relevance localization and on-demand text retrieval for precise reasoning, preserving token savings.
summary_en.technical_approach: SEER renders long text into images, uses a VLM to visually scan and locate query-relevant regions, then invokes a tool to retrieve only the corresponding text segments for fine-grained reasoning. Adaptive tool invocation is learned via SFT on tool-interaction trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on long-context benchmarks, improving extraction precision over uniform visual compression while retaining average prompt-token savings; specific model sizes and baseline numbers not fully provided in the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Department of Engineering, University of Cambridge; Tianlong Chen is a corresponding author, with the group working on multimodal and efficient reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 用视觉压缩绕开文本注意力二次方开销的思路有意思，但属于应用层 trick，对预训练研究员参考有限，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: The idea of bypassing quadratic attention via visual compression is clever, but it is an application-level trick with limited relevance to pretraining research; read the abstract only.

paper.title: BCMT: Blockwise Causal Memory Transformer
paper.abstract: Transformer architectures rely on dense self-attention to model long-range dependencies, but this mechanism exhibits quadratic complexity with respect to sequence length. We introduce BCMT (Blockwise Causal Memory Transformer), an architecture for long-context language modeling that decouples local token interactions from global context propagation. Dense causal self-attention is applied independently within local blocks, while each block produces an adaptive summary aggregated through an expone

summary.core_problem: 降低长上下文语言建模中 dense self-attention 的二次复杂度，同时保留跨块长程信息传播能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是长上下文架构改进。它提出一种不使用显式全局 attention、也不维护 learned memory state 的 blockwise memory 机制，目标是在标准 dense attention 实现兼容性和长程建模效率之间取折中。
summary.technical_approach: BCMT 将序列切分为局部 block，在每个 block 内做 dense causal self-attention；每个 block 产生自适应 summary，经指数因果记忆聚合后再注入 token 表示。这样局部交互保持精细，跨块信息通过并行化的 causal memory 传递，而不是让远距离 token 两两 attention。
summary.experiments: 摘要只说明进行了实验，但未给出模型规模、上下文长度、训练 token 数、baseline 或提升幅度。需要查看正文确认是否在真实 LM 规模、长上下文压力测试和困惑度/下游任务上超过 sliding-window、Transformer-XL、RWKV/SSM 或 recurrent memory baseline。
summary.authors_note: 作者标注为 Independent Researcher。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the quadratic cost of dense self-attention for long-context language modeling while preserving long-range information flow.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a long-context architectural variant. It proposes a blockwise memory mechanism that avoids explicit global attention and learned memory states, trying to balance standard attention compatibility with efficient global context propagation.
summary_en.technical_approach: BCMT splits the sequence into local blocks, applies dense causal self-attention within each block, produces an adaptive summary per block, aggregates summaries through an exponential causal memory, and injects that memory back into token representations. Local token interactions remain dense, while cross-block context is carried through a parallelizable memory path.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that experiments are conducted but does not report parameter scale, context length, training tokens, baselines, or gains. The main thing to verify in the full paper is whether it holds up against sliding-window attention, Transformer-XL-style recurrence, RWKV/SSM, and other memory baselines under realistic LM scaling.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper lists the author as an Independent Researcher.

recommendation.zh: 先看复杂度和 ablation；没有强长程任务与同算力 baseline，这类 memory Transformer 很容易只赢在小实验。
recommendation.en: Check complexity and ablations first; without strong long-range tasks and compute-matched baselines, memory Transformers often only win in toy regimes.

paper.title: KV Cache Compression Through the Lens of Transform Coding
paper.abstract: The key-value (KV) cache stores information from past tokens and is a major memory bottleneck in long-context inference. Existing quantization methods address this bottleneck by representing the KV cache uniformly with lower-precision data types and designing quantization schemes to minimize reconstruction error in the cache itself, without accounting for how that error propagates through attention mechanisms. We prove that, under a white-noise quantization model, the expected attention-aware di

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决长上下文推理中的 KV cache 内存问题：如何在较高压缩率下压缩 KV cache，同时尽量不破坏 attention 输出，而不是只最小化 cache 张量的重构误差。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对长上下文模型的 serving 和评测有参考价值。核心启发是：KV cache 压缩不应只看每个维度的方差或量化误差，还应看这些误差经过 query、attention 和 output projection 后对最终输出的影响。这个视角也有助于理解不同模型架构、GQA 配置和长上下文任务对 cache 噪声的敏感性。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把 KV cache 压缩表述为 transform coding 问题。AATC 先对每层 cache 特征做 whitening-based decorrelation，再在变换域做 bit allocation。与只按重构误差分配 bit 的方法不同，AATC 的分配准则引入 attention-aware 权重，包括 query 相关项 q_c^2 和 output projection 相关项 W_Oc，用来近似量化误差对 attention 输出的影响。实现上保留最前 s=4 个 token 和最近 w=128 个 token 为全精度；recent window 满后，每次量化最旧的 16 个 token。Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 使用 G=2 个 head groups，Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 使用 G=1。变换矩阵用 WikiText-2 校准，rate-distortion 校准使用 256 条长度 2048 的序列，FineWeb 和 OpenR1-Math-220k 各占一半。AATC var-only 去掉 attention-aware 权重，只按量化误差方差分配，可视作 per-layer 版本的 KVTC 重构准则。
summary.experiments: 主实验在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 和 Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct 上比较 KIVI、PALU、KVQuant、AATC var-only 和 AATC。AATC 在 5.82× 压缩率下，18 个评测单元均与 FP16 baseline 在 2σ 统计误差内不可区分。Llama 的 KV cache 从 FP16 的 1.07GB 降到 184MB。Qwen 更难压缩：KIVI 在 LongBench 降到 0.351，RULER 多个长度低于 0.28；AATC 在 Qwen 上保持 LongBench 0.567，对比 FP16 0.574，并在 RULER-32k 达到 0.715，对比 FP16 0.720。Qwen 的 MMLU-Pro math 上 AATC 为 0.710，明显高于 AATC var-only 的 0.674 和 KVQuant 的 0.478。更激进的约 7×、2-bit 设置下，attention-aware 分配的作用更明显：full AATC 在长上下文 RULER 上接近 baseline，而 var-only 随上下文变长明显退化。限制也比较清楚：没有专用 CUDA 实现，只测了两个模型族，理论分析中使用了 token 独立性假设。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 分钟。优先看 Theorem 1 及其对应的 distortion 形式，重点理解为什么 q_c^2 和 W_Oc 会进入 bit allocation。然后看方法部分的 per-layer transform、reverse-waterfilling allocation、full-precision prefix/recent window 设计。实验部分重点看 Table II 和 Figure 1：Table II 展示 5.82× 下的主结果，Figure 1 展示 2-bit 时 attention-aware 分配相对 var-only 的优势。系统落地前还需要看 Appendix E 的实现细节和 CUDA 缺口。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses KV cache memory pressure in long-context inference. The key question is how to compress the cache at high compression ratios while preserving the attention output, rather than merely minimizing reconstruction error on the cached tensors.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-efficiency contribution, but it is relevant to long-context LLM research. The useful idea is that KV cache compression should be output-aware: an error is harmful only to the extent that it propagates through queries, attention, and the output projection. This gives a cleaner way to reason about why some model families and GQA configurations are more sensitive to cache compression than others.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method formulates KV cache compression as transform coding. AATC applies a whitening-based per-layer transform to decorrelate cache features, then performs bit allocation in the transform domain. Unlike variance-only or reconstruction-error criteria, AATC weights distortion by attention-aware terms, including query-related q_c^2 factors and output-projection-related W_Oc factors, derived from an output-error analysis. The implementation keeps the first s=4 tokens and the most recent w=128 tokens in full precision. Once the recent-token window is full, it quantizes the oldest 16 tokens and refills the window. Calibration uses WikiText-2 for the transform, and 256 sequences of length 2048 for rate-distortion calibration, split evenly between FineWeb and OpenR1-Math-220k. The var-only ablation removes the attention-aware terms and allocates bits based only on quantization-error variance, making it a per-layer analogue of a KVTC-style reconstruction criterion.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluation covers Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct, with comparisons to KIVI, PALU, KVQuant, AATC var-only, and full AATC. At 5.82× compression, AATC is statistically indistinguishable from the FP16 baseline within 2 standard errors across all 18 reported cells. For Llama, the KV cache memory drops from 1.07 GB in FP16 to 184 MB. Qwen is much harder to compress: KIVI falls to 0.351 on LongBench and below 0.28 on several RULER settings, while AATC reaches 0.567 on LongBench versus 0.574 for FP16, and 0.715 on RULER-32k versus 0.720 for FP16. On Qwen MMLU-Pro math, AATC scores 0.710, compared with 0.674 for AATC var-only and 0.478 for KVQuant. At the more aggressive 2-bit, roughly 7× setting, the attention-aware allocation becomes more important: full AATC remains close to baseline on long-context RULER, while the var-only variant degrades as context length increases.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 20 minutes. Start with Theorem 1 and the resulting distortion expression, since that is where the output-aware weighting enters the compression objective. Then read the method details on per-layer transforms, reverse-waterfilling allocation, and the full-precision prefix/recent-window policy. For results, Table II gives the main 5.82× comparison, and Figure 1 is the clearest evidence for the benefit of attention-aware allocation under aggressive 2-bit compression. Appendix E is useful if implementation feasibility matters, especially because the current version does not include a dedicated CUDA kernel.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是目标函数，不是压缩技巧本身：把 KV 量化从“重建 cache”改成“重建 attention 行为”，先读理论分解和 bit allocation。
recommendation.en: What matters here is the objective, not the compression trick: it reframes KV quantization from cache reconstruction to attention-behavior reconstruction; read the distortion decomposition and bit-allocation parts first.

paper.title: MemoryLake on MemoryArena: A Matched Study of Agent Memory Backends
paper.abstract: Most agent-memory benchmarks test post-hoc recall, whereas MemoryArena evaluates whether memory supports interdependent, multi-session task completion. We compare MemoryLake, a structured multi-track memory backend, with Mem0, text-embedding-3-small vector RAG, and a long-context control across all five MemoryArena domains. The systems share the same agent framework, requested gpt-5-mini model alias, task samples, and scoring code; the memory integration is the intentionally changed component. B

summary.core_problem: 比较不同 agent memory backend 在多会话、相互依赖任务中的实际支持能力，而不只是测试事后回忆。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent memory 的系统级 matched study。它不是新 benchmark，也不是新通用 agent 架构，但给出一个较干净的对照：固定 agent 框架、模型别名、任务样本和评分代码，只替换 memory backend。
summary.technical_approach: 将 MemoryLake 结构化多轨记忆 backend 与 Mem0、text-embedding-3-small vector RAG、long-context control 在 MemoryArena 的五个领域上比较。作者明确说明该实验不是表示层 ablation，也不是 cost-matched comparison，因为每个 backend 绑定了写入、检索、整合、预算和 prompt assembly 策略。
summary.experiments: 在共享评测集上，MemoryLake 在 mathematics 上达到 9/40 success rate，在 physics 上达到 12/20，在 progressive retrieval 上达到 4/20。travel planning 中所有系统 success rate 为 0；web shopping 仅 long-context control 出现 1/150 的 bundle-level success。整体结果显示这些 memory backend 在复杂多会话任务上仍很弱。

summary_en.core_problem: The study compares agent memory backends on interdependent multi-session task completion rather than post-hoc recall.
summary_en.importance: This is a matched system-level study of agent memory. It is not a new benchmark or a new general agent architecture, but the comparison is relatively controlled: same agent framework, model alias, task samples, and scoring code, with the memory backend as the intended intervention.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemoryLake, a structured multi-track memory backend, is compared against Mem0, text-embedding-3-small vector RAG, and a long-context control on five MemoryArena domains. The authors emphasize that each backend includes write, retrieval, consolidation, budgeting, and prompt-assembly decisions, so the study is not a representation-only ablation or cost-matched test.
summary_en.experiments: On the shared evaluation sets, MemoryLake obtains the highest observed success rates in mathematics at 9/40, physics at 12/20, and progressive retrieval at 4/20. All systems score zero in travel planning, and web shopping has only one bundle-level success from the long-context control at 1/150.

recommendation.zh: 看结果段就够；它提醒 memory backend 差异存在，但近零成功率说明任务难度和系统耦合都很重。
recommendation.en: Read only the results; backend differences show up, but near-zero success rates mean task difficulty and system coupling dominate.

paper.title: Lost in Compaction: Evaluating Side-Constraint Loss under Context Compaction
paper.abstract: When the context window is under pressure, LLM systems compact prior context to continue ongoing tasks. We identify a class of user-issued instructions, Session Constraints (SCs), such as "do not delete any emails until I confirm," that are meant to constrain LLM's behavior for the remainder of a session but are silently dropped during compaction. To quantify this loss, we introduce COMPINT, an evaluation suite that evaluates compactors across three long-context scenarios: multi-turn chat, agent

summary.core_problem: 论文关注长上下文系统里的一个具体失效点：当会话接近上下文上限并触发压缩时，用户在早期给出的会话级约束会被摘要器丢掉。这里的约束不是主任务，也不是长期记忆，而是在当前 session 内持续生效的行为边界，例如“未经确认不要发送邮件”。压缩器通常保留任务目标、当前状态和下一步计划，却容易丢掉这类“如何执行任务”的约束，导致 agent 继续完成任务但违反用户要求。
summary.importance: 这项工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对长上下文模型、agent serving、memory/compaction 机制和 post-train 评测有清晰启发。它把上下文压缩从“信息是否足够恢复任务”推进到“约束是否被完整继承”。这对训练和评测都有意义：如果未来模型在预训练或中训练阶段学习摘要、记忆、状态压缩，训练信号不能只奖励任务连续性，也要显式覆盖用户约束、权限边界和过程要求。论文的主要贡献是评测资产和系统诊断，而不是新模型架构。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先定义 Session Constraints，简称 SC。SC 有三个条件：不是用户主任务的一部分；用于约束当前 session 内模型后续行为；没有跨 session 的长期用途。作者进一步按约束绑定对象划分为五类：Action、Information、Process、Preference、Output。CompInt 评测套件围绕四个正交轴构造样本：SC 内容、表达方式、注入位置/次数、长上下文环境。长上下文环境包括多轮聊天、agent 轨迹和长程研究任务。评测流程是在上下文中注入 SC，触发 compaction，再通过后续 probe 检查压缩后状态是否保留并执行这些约束。方法上的关键点是把“主任务恢复”和“侧约束保真”拆开评估，因此能暴露普通摘要指标看不到的失败。论文还提出一个 SC-aware extractor，与常规 compactor 并行工作：摘要器继续负责任务状态，提取器专门抽取和保留会话约束。这说明作者认为单纯改 compactor prompt 不够稳定，需要把约束通道从任务摘要通道中分离出来。
summary.experiments: CompInt 每个压缩条件下构造 750 个评测实例。论文测试多种 compactor、prompt、上下文长度、压缩率、SC 表达强度、注入位置和重复次数。核心结果是当前 compactors 平均只保留 17% 的注入 SC，很多设置下甚至不如不做 compaction。保留率对系统和数据因素都很敏感：compactor 选择、压缩 prompt、上下文长度、压缩率、SC phrasing、注入位置都会显著影响结果。重复出现和更强显式表述通常有帮助，但不能根治问题。SC-aware extractor 在三个环境上都达到 90% 以上保留率，说明把侧约束作为独立状态管理对象，比让通用摘要器“顺便记住”更可靠。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Side Constraints，重点理解 SC 与 system prompt、主任务、长期记忆的区别。然后看 CompInt 构造部分，尤其是四个评测轴和五类 SC taxonomy，这是论文最可复用的部分。实验部分重点看 retention rate 随 compactor、context length、injection location、framing 变化的表格和图。最后看 SC-aware extractor 的设计和消融，关注它为何需要与 compactor 分离。对做长上下文训练、agent memory、session state 管理的人，这篇的价值主要在 failure taxonomy 和 evaluation protocol。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a concrete failure mode in long-context LLM systems: context compaction often drops user-issued constraints that are meant to govern the rest of the session. These constraints are not the main task and are not durable memory. They specify how the agent should behave, for example, “do not send anything without my confirmation.” A task-oriented compactor may preserve the goal and current working state while silently removing these constraints, so the agent can continue the task but violate the user’s stated boundaries.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an evaluation and systems diagnostic rather than a pretraining method. Its relevance to foundation-model research is still clear. Long-context training, agent memory, summarization-as-state-compression, and post-training evaluations often optimize for task continuity. This work shows that continuity is incomplete if behavioral constraints are not preserved. For future pretraining or mid-training recipes that teach models to summarize, compress, or maintain session state, the training signal should include constraint preservation rather than only reconstruction of the dominant task.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper defines Session Constraints as clauses that are not part of the task, constrain behavior within the current session, and have no intended use beyond that session. It groups them into five categories: Action, Information, Process, Preference, and Output. The CompInt suite varies four axes: constraint content, surface framing, injection condition, and long-context environment. The environments cover multi-turn chat, agentic trajectories, and long-horizon research. The evaluation injects constraints into long contexts, applies a compactor, and then uses probes to test whether the compacted state still carries the constraint. The key design choice is to evaluate constraint integrity separately from task recovery. The proposed mitigation is an SC-aware extractor that runs alongside the ordinary compactor: the compactor maintains task state, while the extractor maintains session constraints as a separate artifact.
summary_en.experiments: CompInt contains 750 evaluation instances per compaction condition. The paper evaluates retention under different compactors, prompts, context lengths, compression rates, constraint phrasings, injection locations, and repetitions. Current compactors retain only 17% of injected session constraints on average, and many settings perform worse than simply continuing without compaction. Retention is highly sensitive to both system-side choices and constraint-side factors. Stronger wording and repeated constraints can help, but they do not remove the failure. The SC-aware extractor achieves over 90% retention across the three evaluated environments, supporting the claim that constraints should be tracked through a dedicated channel rather than left to a generic summary prompt.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take about 25–35 minutes. Read the Introduction and Side Constraints sections first to understand the distinction between task content, system instructions, durable memory, and session-scoped constraints. Then read the CompInt construction, especially the four evaluation axes and the five-way taxonomy. In the experiments, focus on the retention tables and plots that vary compactor, context length, injection location, and framing. The mitigation section is worth reading for the architectural lesson: session constraints are safer when represented separately from the task summary.

recommendation.zh: 读 COMPINT 设置和 17% 保留率结果；这会改变长上下文数据管线里“摘要后仍安全”的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the COMPINT setup and the 17% retention result; it challenges the default assumption that summarized context remains behaviorally safe.

paper.title: Information Abundance Paradox: Long-Context Training Undermines Parametric Knowledge
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly trained and deployed with long contexts that span documents, code repositories, and interaction histories. This scaling reflects the implicit assumption that training on longer contexts will only help the model by exposing it to richer evidence. We challenge this view by studying how the context window shapes a model's mode of learning, shifting it between parametric internalization and contextualization. We propose the Information Abundance Paradox, which

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究长上下文训练是否会改变模型学习知识的方式。核心问题是：当训练上下文中包含大量与预测相关的信息时，模型是否会减少把知识写入参数的压力，转而学习依赖上下文证据。作者把这一现象称为 Information Abundance Paradox，并用 context addiction 作为可观测表现：模型在有相关上下文时表现好，但在上下文缺失或误导时退化。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对长上下文预训练有直接影响。当前常见假设是，上下文窗口变长主要带来更多证据，只要数据足够好，训练就会受益。论文提出相反的风险：长上下文不是中性的供数管道，它会改变 cross-entropy 优化下的最优学习策略。模型可以通过读取上下文降低 loss，而不必把同一信息压缩进权重。对基座训练而言，这意味着长上下文扩展可能提高长文建模能力，却削弱闭卷知识、短上下文泛化或无上下文鲁棒性。Phi-3 和 OLMo 3 中长上下文版本在 few-shot / zero-shot 上落后短上下文版本的现象，被用作这一问题的现实动机。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从两个训练场景验证假设。预训练场景中，作者固定 token budget、数据、模型配置和优化设置，只改变训练上下文窗口长度，用连贯文档跨度作为信息丰富度的代理变量。这样可以把“训练了更多 token”与“上下文更长”区分开。监督微调场景中，作者固定上下文长度，直接控制上下文中任务相关信息的多少，用来隔离相关信息本身的作用。理论部分把语言模型训练看成压缩问题，区分参数知识和上下文知识两条预测通道；当上下文提供足够低复杂度的解时，达到相同风险阈值所需写入权重的任务信息会减少。机制分析进一步从三方面支撑这一点：长上下文提供更低复杂度的训练解；参数更新压力从 FFN 更偏向 attention；推理时模型对上下文 token 的依赖增强。
summary.experiments: 预训练实验在 20M、55M、259M、750M 四个参数规模上进行，固定 token 预算、数据和优化 recipe，改变训练 context window。结果呈现倒 U 型：语言建模、自然语言理解、闭卷多选问答会随上下文变长先提升，到中等长度附近达到较好状态，继续增加上下文后反而下降。这说明问题不是单纯的数据质量或训练量不足。监督微调实验显示，当推理时提供有用上下文，训练中见过丰富任务相关上下文的模型准确率更高；但当上下文缺失或被误导时，鲁棒性下降。机制实验显示，长上下文模型更倾向使用上下文 token，训练更新也更集中到 attention 模块，相对减少了通过 FFN 储存可复用知识的压力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Section 2、Section 3、Section 5。Section 2 给出 Information Abundance Paradox 和 context addiction 的定义，是理解实验设计的关键。Section 3.1 最重要，关注固定 token budget 下不同 context window 的预训练对比，以及四个规模上的倒 U 型曲线。Section 3.2 适合看可控 SFT 实验，因为它把“上下文长度”和“任务相关信息量”拆开。Section 4 的理论模型不必逐行推导，但要看风险阈值与参数内化信息量之间的关系。Section 5 值得细读，尤其是 update pressure 从 FFN 转向 attention、推理时上下文依赖增强的分析；这些结果对设计长上下文训练 mixture、短上下文保持、闭卷能力评估都有参考意义。

summary_en.core_problem: This work asks whether long-context training changes what a model learns to store in its parameters. The core issue is that abundant task-relevant information inside the training context may reduce the pressure to internalize the same information parametrically. The authors call this the Information Abundance Paradox. Its observable form is context addiction: the model performs well when useful context is present, but degrades when the context is absent, incomplete, or misleading.
summary_en.importance: The paper is directly relevant to long-context pretraining. A common assumption is that longer contexts simply expose the model to richer evidence, so better data and longer windows should help. This work argues that the context window also changes the learning strategy induced by next-token cross-entropy. If the model can lower loss by reading evidence from the context, it may store less reusable knowledge in the weights. For foundation-model training, this creates a trade-off: longer contexts can improve contextual prediction while weakening closed-book knowledge, short-context generalization, or robustness without supporting evidence. The paper uses the gap between long-context and short-context variants of Phi-3 and OLMo 3 as motivating evidence that this issue appears in real training recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study tests the hypothesis in both pretraining and supervised fine-tuning. In pretraining, the token budget, data, model configuration, and optimization setup are fixed, while the training context window is varied. Coherent document span length serves as a proxy for the amount of available relevant information. This design separates longer-context learning from simply seeing more tokens. In supervised fine-tuning, the context length is fixed and the amount of task-relevant context is directly controlled, isolating relevance from length. The theoretical account treats language modeling as compression with two predictive channels: information stored in parameters and information supplied in context. When context offers a lower-complexity solution, less task information needs to be encoded in the weights to reach the same risk threshold. The mechanistic analyses then connect this to lower-complexity contextual solutions, a shift in update pressure from feed-forward networks toward attention modules, and stronger reliance on context tokens at inference time.
summary_en.experiments: The pretraining experiments cover four model scales: 20M, 55M, 259M, and 750M parameters. With fixed token budget, data, architecture, and optimization, varying the training context window produces an inverted-U pattern. Language modeling, natural language understanding, and closed-book multiple-choice QA improve up to an intermediate context length and then decline as the context becomes longer. This suggests that the degradation is not just a data-quality issue. The supervised fine-tuning experiments show a complementary pattern: informative context improves accuracy when such context is available at inference, but training with abundant relevant context reduces robustness when the context is missing or misleading. Mechanistic measurements indicate that longer-context training increases reliance on context tokens and shifts more learning pressure toward attention relative to feed-forward networks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read Section 2 first for the definitions of Information Abundance Paradox and context addiction. Section 3.1 is the main pretraining result: focus on the fixed-token-budget comparisons across context windows and the inverted-U curves across the four model scales. Section 3.2 is useful because the SFT setup directly controls task-relevant information and separates relevance from length. Section 4 is worth reading for the risk-threshold argument, but the main takeaway is the reduction in required parametric information when context provides an easier solution. Section 5 is the most useful part for training researchers interested in mechanisms: the analyses of FFN-versus-attention update pressure and inference-time context reliance have direct implications for long-context data mixtures, short-context retention, and closed-book evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你对 long-context pretrain 的 prior：别再默认窗口越长越赚，先看它如何把“会背”换成“会找”，建议优先核查实验控制和中间最优点是否稳。
recommendation.en: This one should update your prior on long-context pretraining: longer context may trade memorization for retrieval, so check whether the intermediate optimum survives clean controls before changing recipe.

paper.title: Disentangling the Expressivity of RoPE
paper.abstract: Two accounts recur in explanations of the success of rotary position embeddings (RoPE). Expressivity studies associate periodic position information with modular predicates, whereas mechanistic and long-context studies emphasize positional anchors and local offsets. We formalize both accounts for fully uniform, finite-precision soft-attention transformers. We find that, if every rotary component is periodic, RoPE transformers recognize exactly the languages definable in past temporal logic with

summary.core_problem: RoPE 为何有效？现有两种解释——周期性带来的模块化谓词表达能力，与位置锚点/局部偏移的机制性偏好——看似矛盾。论文在有限精度、fully uniform soft-attention transformer 框架下把两者区分开。
summary.importance: 对理解主流位置编码方案的实际能力边界有参考价值。结论解释了 RoPE 在长上下文泛化上的局限：常规 RoPE 的旋转相位与 2π 不可公度、永不重复，它实现的是精度依赖的有界固定偏移回看，而非任意长度的模块化构造；这为长上下文外推失败和 fixed-offset attention head 的存在提供了形式化依据。
summary.technical_approach: 区分两种 RoPE 变体。组件周期性 RoPE（RoPE_P）把每个旋转分量的角度取为 2π 的有理数倍，相位有限重复，在有限精度下等价于带模块化谓词的过去时态逻辑 LTL[P, MOD]。常规 RoPE 的频率相位与 2π 不可公度，旋转永不重复，其相对注意力分数只能在精度维持的分数间隔内模拟 k 步回看算子，因此对应有界局部注意力而非全长度模块化刻画。这把 RoPE 与 local attention 和实践中观察到的 fixed-offset head 联系起来。
summary.experiments: 在受控形式语言上训练 transformer。周期性 RoPE 调度在需要模块化谓词的语言上实现长度泛化；常规 RoPE 在所有 base 取值下都无法在 (aa)* 和 (ab)* 上泛化，说明调 base 不能恢复模块化构造。在 LTL[Y] 语言上，常规 RoPE 的平均最长完美长度在七个 base 中六个优于 NoPE，但在 LTL[P] 语言和同时需要 P 与 Y 的语言上每个 base 都弱于 NoPE。结果支持局部性解释，并显示局部偏置可能干扰长距离条件化。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看 §1 引言的两种解释对比、§2.4 对常规 RoPE 非周期性的论证，以及实验部分形式语言上的对比结果。形式逻辑定义（LTL、FO²、自动机等价）可按需跳过。预计 20–30 分钟。对做长上下文和位置编码改进的研究者，值得思考的是：能否设计混合调度，让部分维度承担周期性模块化构造、其余维度承担局部偏移，以兼得两种能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Why does RoPE work? Two accounts recur—periodicity enabling modular-predicate expressivity, versus positional anchors and local-offset biases—and they appear incompatible. The paper disentangles them within a fully uniform, finite-precision soft-attention transformer framework.
summary_en.importance: Useful for understanding the actual capability boundary of the dominant positional encoding scheme. The result explains RoPE's long-context extrapolation failures: conventional RoPE uses phases incommensurate with 2π that never repeat, so it realizes a precision-dependent bounded simulation of fixed-offset look-back rather than an all-length modular construction. This gives a formal account of both extrapolation limits and the fixed-offset heads observed in practice.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two RoPE variants are distinguished. Component-periodic RoPE (RoPE_P) rotates each subspace by rational multiples of 2π, so phases repeat finitely and, under finite precision, the model recognizes exactly the languages definable in past temporal logic with modular predicates, LTL[P, MOD]. Conventional RoPE uses frequencies whose phases are incommensurate with 2π and never repeat; its relative attention scores can simulate k-step look-back only while a precision-dependent score gap is maintained, yielding bounded local attention rather than an all-length modular characterization. This connects RoPE to local attention and to empirically observed fixed-offset heads.
summary_en.experiments: Transformers are trained on controlled formal languages. Periodic RoPE schedules length-generalize on languages requiring modular predicates. No conventional base value generalizes on (aa)* or (ab)*, indicating that changing the base does not recover the modular construction. On an LTL[Y] language, conventional RoPE's mean longest-perfect length beats NoPE at six of seven bases, but underperforms NoPE at every base on an LTL[P] language and on a language requiring both P and Y. The results support the locality account and suggest the local bias can interfere with long-distance conditioning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim §1 for the contrast between the two accounts, §2.4 for the non-periodicity argument for conventional RoPE, and the formal-language experiments. The LTL/FO²/automata formalisms can be skipped as needed. Estimated 20–30 minutes. For researchers working on long-context or positional-encoding improvements, a natural question is whether a hybrid schedule—some dimensions carrying periodic modular constructions, others carrying local offsets—could combine both capabilities.

recommendation.zh: RoPE 的周期性和局部回看被拆开了；只看形式化定义和实验分离，也能校正长上下文外推直觉。
recommendation.en: It cleanly separates RoPE periodicity from local look-back behavior; read the formal setup and controlled separation experiments to recalibrate long-context intuitions.

paper.title: ImpactHO: Importance-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Multi-User Edge LLM Handover
paper.abstract: Edge LLMs must preserve inference continuity when a user hands over between edge nodes, requiring key-value (KV) cache transfer to the target node. However, simultaneous handovers saturate the backhaul, preventing full cache delivery within the mobility-imposed transfer window. Rather than allocating bandwidth as if all cache entries were equally valuable, we order each user's KV cache by importance and transmit only its most informative fraction, turning token-level sparsity into communication

summary.core_problem: 解决边缘 LLM 服务中用户跨边缘节点切换时 KV cache 需要迁移、但多用户同时切换会让回传带宽不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理服务系统优化。它不是预训练方法，但对长上下文服务、KV cache 价值分布、部分 cache 保留后的精度退化建模有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 ImpactHO：先按重要性对每个用户的 KV cache entry 排序，只传输信息量最高的一部分；再把多用户 cache 迁移建模成回传带宽分配问题，以平均准确率最大化为目标。每个用户的 partial-cache accuracy 被拟合成 sigmoid utility，并利用重要性排序带来的前段高收益进行资源分配。
summary.experiments: 实验在 RULER benchmark 上测量不同模型和上下文长度下的部分 KV cache 精度曲线，sigmoid 拟合达到 R²>0.99。摘要称重要性排序让准确率曲线的凹区几乎覆盖整个 cache，使分配器能把用户保持在高边际收益区间；未给出具体 LLM 参数量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses KV-cache transfer during edge-LLM handover, where simultaneous user mobility can exceed the available backhaul bandwidth.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-serving optimization. It does not change pretraining, but it is relevant to long-context serving, KV-cache value distribution, and accuracy degradation under partial cache retention.
summary_en.technical_approach: ImpactHO ranks each user's KV-cache entries by importance and transfers only the most informative fraction. It then formulates multi-user cache transfer as a backhaul allocation problem that maximizes average accuracy. Each user's partial-cache accuracy is modeled as a sigmoid utility curve, exploiting the high-value prefix created by importance ordering.
summary_en.experiments: The paper measures partial-cache accuracy on the RULER benchmark across models and context lengths, fitting the utility curves with R² above 0.99. The abstract claims importance ordering makes the concave region span nearly the whole cache, enabling the allocator to keep users in a high-marginal-gain region. Model sizes are not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看 partial KV accuracy 的 sigmoid 拟合和排序策略；对训练无直接作用，但能补 KV cache 价值分布的直觉。
recommendation.en: Skim the sigmoid fit for partial-KV accuracy and the ranking policy; not a training paper, but useful intuition on KV-cache value distribution.

paper.title: Position Encoding in Transformers: From Absolute and Relative Methods to Rotary Position Embeddings and Long-Context Scaling
paper.abstract: Self-attention models content-dependent interactions between tokens but does not by itself encode token order. Position encoding addresses this limitation by introducing absolute coordinates, relative distances, or position-dependent rotations into Transformer representations and attention scores. This technical survey develops a unified account of sinusoidal and learned absolute position embeddings, Shaw-style relative position representations, Transformer-XL, T5 relative position bias, ALiBi,

summary.core_problem: 系统梳理 Transformer 中位置编码的设计空间，并解释 RoPE 及其长上下文扩展为何有效、代价在哪里。
summary.importance: 这是一篇技术综述，不是新方法论文。价值在于把绝对位置、相对位置、RoPE、ALiBi 以及 Position Interpolation、NTK-aware scaling、YaRN、LongRoPE 等长上下文方案放到同一框架下比较，适合作为预训练和长上下文建模的知识整理材料。
summary.technical_approach: 文章从位置注入位置、对 attention score 的作用方式、与 KV-cache 的兼容性、长度外推能力等维度统一分析多类位置编码；重点推导 RoPE 如何把绝对位置索引转成 Query-Key 内积中的相对相位差，并讨论多种 RoPE scaling/插值方法的频率分配与上下文扩展机制。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，核心是理论推导与方法比较，不像包含新的大规模训练实验。更像对已有方法的归纳、公式化解释和工程属性对比，适合查阅概念差异，不适合把其中结论当作新的实证证据。

summary_en.core_problem: It organizes the design space of positional encoding in Transformers and explains why RoPE and its long-context extensions work, along with their trade-offs.
summary_en.importance: This is a technical survey rather than a new method paper. Its value is in placing absolute, relative, RoPE, ALiBi, and long-context extensions such as Position Interpolation, NTK-aware scaling, YaRN, and LongRoPE under one comparative framework, which is useful background for pretraining and long-context modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper unifies positional methods by where position is injected, how it affects attention scores, KV-cache compatibility, and length extrapolation. It emphasizes a derivation of how RoPE turns absolute indices into relative phase differences in QK inner products, then discusses scaling/interpolation variants through frequency allocation and context extension behavior.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, this appears to be primarily theoretical and comparative rather than a source of new large-scale training evidence. It is better treated as a reference for conceptual distinctions and engineering trade-offs than as fresh empirical proof.

recommendation.zh: 综述写得再全也只是综述；如果你在做长上下文或改 RoPE，拿它当索引表即可，不必通读正文。
recommendation.en: A useful index if you work on long context or RoPE variants, but it is still a survey; use it as a map, not as evidence.

paper.title: Quantum Coordination Advantages in AI State-Tracking Tasks: Semantic Compilation and Latent Memory
paper.abstract: We prove inference-time quantum coordination advantages for specified AI state-tracking tasks. A solver compresses semantic history into a future-accessible boundary state and later answers a query. We count communication $B$, persistent instance-dependent memory $M$, and local work $D$; classical recurrence, caches, tools, and recomputation are allowed and charged. The central result is a boundary-preserving semantic-compilation theorem. It maps a finite one-way, streaming, or adaptive causal t

summary.core_problem: 研究在 AI 状态跟踪任务中，量子边界状态是否能在推理时通信、持久记忆和本地计算之间带来可证明优势。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是理论分析。它试图把经典通信复杂度与量子记忆优势编译到语义 AI 接口中，对长上下文、状态压缩和外部记忆的理论边界有概念参考，但离当前 LLM 训练系统较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 boundary-preserving semantic-compilation theorem，将有限 one-way、streaming 或 adaptive causal task 映射为语义 AI 接口，同时保持事件顺序和过去输入访问方式。资源计费包括通信 B、实例相关持久记忆 M 和本地工作量 D，并允许经典 recurrence、cache、tool 和 recomputation，但都计入成本。
summary.experiments: 这是理论论文，不是实验论文。摘要给出两个应用：matched-entity synopsis QA 继承 hidden-matching 分离，量子侧为 O(log N) qubits，经典边界 bits 下界为 Ω(√N)；continual requirements auditing 继承 Max-kSAT 类型分离。未涉及 LLM 参数规模或训练数据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether quantum boundary states can provide provable inference-time advantages for AI state-tracking tasks under communication, persistent memory, and local-work costs.
summary_en.importance: This is a theoretical contribution. It connects communication-complexity style lower bounds and quantum memory advantages to semantic AI interfaces, offering conceptual input for long-context memory and state compression, but it is far from current LLM training practice.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central result is a boundary-preserving semantic-compilation theorem that maps finite one-way, streaming, or adaptive causal tasks into a semantic AI interface while preserving event order and access to past input. The resource model counts communication B, instance-dependent persistent memory M, and local work D, while allowing classical recurrence, caches, tools, and recomputation if charged.
summary_en.experiments: This is not an empirical paper. The abstract gives two theoretical applications: matched-entity synopsis QA inherits a hidden-matching separation with O(log N) qubits versus Ω(√N) classical boundary bits, and continual requirements auditing inherits a Max-kSAT-style separation. No LLM scale or training data is involved.

recommendation.zh: 理论味很重，量子设定离训练系统远；只扫资源计费定义和 theorem statement，别当 memory recipe。
recommendation.en: Heavy theory with a quantum setup far from training systems; read the cost model and theorem statement, not as a practical memory recipe.

paper.title: Why Does CLAUDE.md Keep Growing? Catastrophic Remembering in Agentic Coding
paper.abstract: Agentic coding READMEs like CLAUDE.md grow without bound in real repositories, stopping only when the repository retires or someone rewrites the file wholesale. We trace this to imperfect recall: appending an instruction is always cheap, but once an instruction's rationale is gone, deleting it without risking a correctness regression costs O(2^|D|) in a prompt of |D| instructions. We name the resulting divergence catastrophic remembering, the inverse of catastrophic forgetting around which conti

summary.core_problem: 编程Agent使用的系统提示文件（如CLAUDE.md、AGENTS.md）在真实仓库维护过程中会无限制增长，冗余指令持续累积导致模型指令遵循能力下降，但删除旧指令的回归风险极高，此前没有研究解释该现象的根因，也无可行的缓解方案。
summary.importance: 提出“灾难性记忆（catastrophic remembering）”概念，与持续学习领域的灾难性遗忘形成对应，指出多作者维护过程中指令设计依据的丢失是导致删除成本指数级上升、提示只增不减的核心原因。该分析对长系统提示维护、Agent记忆管理、迭代式prompt工程有实际参考价值，但属于Agent应用层的现象分析与工程优化，对基座预训练的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 首先建立提示维护的在线约束集估计理论模型，证明当指令写入时的设计溯源信息丢失后，安全删除单条指令需要O(2^|D|)量级的反事实测试，风险最小化的最优维护策略会退化为仅追加模式；通过分析1867个仓库中247694条指令的生命周期，验证指令删除风险随存活时间、参与维护的作者数量上升而下降，排除了指令自然过时、内容脆弱性等竞争性解释；提出prompt comment方案，类比代码注释的设计，在写入每条指令时同步记录其设计理由，供后续维护者参考但不送入模型执行。
summary.experiments: 实证测量显示真实仓库中的提示文件生命周期内平均长度增长226%，平均每次提交净增4.9条指令，76.8%的指令删除发生在整个文件被全量重写的提交中；在基于改造IFEval构建的可控评测环境（已知最优最小指令集）中，给指令补充结果导向的设计理由注释后，51轮维护迭代后提示的冗余尺寸从+211.3%降至+1.4%，15轮迭代后尺寸增长从+60.4%转为-5.8%的缩减，同时真实提示场景下的指令遵循准确率最高提升11.6个百分点（相对提升23.1%）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言与根因分析部分对“灾难性记忆”现象的定义、实证证据，以及prompt comment方案的核心思路，无需深入阅读理论模型推导部分，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Agent-facing coding instruction files (e.g. CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) grow without bound in real-world software repositories, accumulating redundant instructions that degrade model instruction-following performance. However, removing outdated instructions carries prohibitive regression risk, and no prior work has identified the root cause of this phenomenon or proposed a practical mitigation.
summary_en.importance: This work formalizes the concept of "catastrophic remembering", the inverse of catastrophic forgetting in continual learning, showing that lost write-time design rationale for instructions makes safe deletion exponentially costly, leading to append-only maintenance dynamics. The analysis provides practical reference for long system prompt maintenance, agent memory management, and iterative prompt engineering, though it sits at the agent application layer with limited direct implications for base model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: An online constraint set estimation model for prompt maintenance is derived, proving that when write-time instruction provenance (latent design rationale) is lost, safe deletion of a single instruction requires O(2^{|D|}) counterfactual tests, making append-only the optimal risk-minimizing strategy. Lifecycle analysis of 247,694 instructions across 1,867 repositories confirms deletion hazard decays with instruction age and number of contributing maintainers, ruling out competing explanations of natural instruction staleness or content fragility. A prompt comment solution is proposed, analogous to source code comments: design rationale for each instruction is recorded at write time for future maintainers, but is not exposed to the model executor.
summary_en.experiments: Empirical measurement shows real prompt files grow 226% on average over their lifetime, adding a net 4.9 instructions per commit, with 76.8% of instruction deletions occurring in full-file rewrite commits. On a controlled benchmark derived from IFEval with a known minimal optimal instruction set, adding outcome-grounded rationale comments reduces excess prompt size from +211.3% to +1.4% over 51 maintenance steps, and turns +60.4% growth into -5.8% shrinkage over 15 steps, while improving instruction-following accuracy on real-world prompts by up to 11.6 percentage points (23.1% relative gain).
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction and root cause analysis sections for the definition of catastrophic remembering and supporting empirical evidence, as well as the core design of the prompt comment solution. Skip detailed theoretical derivations. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 揭示的“灾难性记忆”现象直接指向基座模型长上下文指令遵循的缺陷，看§2的实证统计部分即可
recommendation.en: The "catastrophic remembering" phenomenon directly reveals flaws in base models' long-context instruction following; read the empirical statistics in Section 2 only

paper.title: Mitigating Context Interference for Reliable and Efficient Search Agents
paper.abstract: Recent research empowers Large Language Models (LLMs) as multi-turn search agents to iteratively retrieve and generate outputs until complex tasks are solved. However, the contexts of multi-turn search agents are lengthy and complex. For example, the retrieved set of documents in each turn would inevitably introduce irrelevant information that distracts LLMs, referring to \textit{context interference}, potentially hindering the reliability and efficiency of search agents. Therefore, we conduct a

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究多轮搜索 Agent 中的 context interference：检索系统通常能召回含有答案的文档，但上下文里混入的无关文档、历史查询和中间推理会干扰模型选取正确证据，导致“召回到了但答不对”。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更偏向 Agent/RAG 训练范式。但它对长上下文使用方式有启发：上下文长度增加不等于有效信息增加，噪声文档会改变模型对内部知识和外部证据的利用方式。对做 post-train、RL search agent、长上下文数据构造的人更有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先把搜索 Agent 的上下文拆成问题、历史搜索 query、历史检索文档、最新检索文档、历史 reasoning 等部分，通过 masking 不同上下文片段来定位干扰源。实验结论是最新一轮检索文档是主要干扰来源，历史 query 和历史文档也有轻微影响。基于这个观察，作者构造了一个 context refinement 数据集，用蒸馏方式把“检索文档”压缩为“对当前搜索 query 最关键的信息”。随后训练一个 context refiner，在 Agent 生成前动态重写检索上下文。最后把 refiner 放入 RL 训练流程，让策略模型在训练时看到的是动态精炼后的上下文，而不是原始检索结果。
summary.experiments: 论文在一组 closed-book QA benchmark 上评估多轮搜索 Agent 的可靠性和效率。关键实验包括：不同上下文片段 masking 的归因实验；多种上下文精炼策略比较；蒸馏式 context refiner 的效果；以及把 context refinement 接入 RL search-agent training pipeline 后与其他训练基线比较。提供内容中没有给出具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、数据规模和提升数字，因此不宜补充数值。可确认的实验结论是：refiner 同时提升答题可靠性和搜索效率；在 RL 训练中使用动态精炼上下文，比仅在推理时做上下文处理更稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看三处：第一，RQ1 的 context masking 设计，它决定了“干扰来自哪里”的可信度；第二，context refinement 数据集如何蒸馏，特别是 teacher 信号来自哪里、是否会引入答案泄漏；第三，RL pipeline 中 refiner 的接入方式，关注训练时和推理时上下文分布是否一致。对基座预训练研究员来说，不必细读具体 QA 结果，值得关注的是长上下文噪声如何影响 search-agent 训练信号。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies context interference in multi-turn search agents. A retriever may return documents that contain the needed evidence, but irrelevant documents, past queries, and intermediate reasoning can distract the model, creating a gap between retrieval recall and answer accuracy.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a core pretraining paper. Its relevance is mainly at the pretrain–posttrain interface: it shows that longer retrieved context can degrade the learning and inference signal for search agents. This matters for RL-trained retrieval agents, long-context training data design, and systems that mix parametric knowledge with external evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors decompose the agent context into the user question, previous search queries, previous retrieved documents, the latest retrieved documents, and reasoning history. They then mask specific context components to identify where interference comes from. Their main finding is that the latest retrieved documents are the dominant source of interference, while earlier queries and documents contribute mildly. Based on this, they build a distilled context-refinement dataset that maps retrieved documents into concise query-relevant evidence. A context refiner is trained on this dataset and inserted before generation. The refiner is also integrated into the reinforcement-learning pipeline, so the search agent is trained with dynamically refined contexts rather than raw retrieval outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates reliability and efficiency on several closed-book QA benchmarks. The main experiments include context-component masking, comparison among refinement strategies, evaluation of the distilled refiner, and RL training with dynamic context refinement. The supplied full text does not include exact model sizes, dataset sizes, benchmark names, or numerical gains, so those numbers should not be inferred. The reported qualitative result is consistent: context refinement improves both answer reliability and search efficiency, and using refinement during RL training is stronger than treating it only as an inference-time wrapper.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on three parts: the masking-based attribution setup for RQ1, the construction of the distilled context-refinement data, and the way the refiner is inserted into the RL training loop. The most useful question to ask while reading is whether the refiner changes the training distribution in a controlled way or simply filters away hard negatives. The detailed QA leaderboard numbers are less important for pretraining researchers than the analysis of noisy long-context supervision.

recommendation.zh: 只看干扰源定位和 refinement ablation；若最新检索文档真是主因，RAG 训练里盲目塞更多证据会更可疑。
recommendation.en: Skim the interference-source ablations and refinement results; if newest retrieved docs dominate the noise, stuffing more evidence into RAG training looks less defensible.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
MoE Key Laboratory of High Confidence Software Technologies

paper.title: MixFormer: Linear Transformer with Mixture of Memory Experts
paper.abstract: State Space Models (SSMs), as a mainstream research direction of linear Transformers, aim to achieve higher efficiency than standard Transformers in long-context modeling. However, existing SSMs suffer from limited input adaptivity and constrained memory capacity, leading to information loss when modeling ultra-long sequences. To address these limitations, we propose MixFormer, a novel linear Transformer that integrates a Mixture-of-Memory-Experts (MoE) mechanism. Specifically, the model maintai

summary.core_problem: 解决 SSM/线性 Transformer 在超长序列中输入自适应不足、记忆容量有限和历史信息稀释的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是长上下文架构改进，方向与 linear attention、SSM 和 memory-augmented Transformer 相关。摘要中的设计有一定可读性，但缺少模型规模、训练 token、强 baseline 和真实 LLM 预训练结果信息，当前更像早期架构提案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MixFormer，引入 Mixture-of-Memory-Experts。模型维护多个差异化 memory states，并通过 Time-Aware Linear Attention 使用可学习指数衰减函数和位置偏置动态更新记忆，从而选择性强化重要历史信息、缓解 memory dilution。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在长序列文本和图像生成任务上验证，目标是提升长程依赖建模。未给出参数规模、训练数据规模、对比模型、速度/显存曲线或具体提升幅度；这些决定其是否对 LLM 预训练有实际意义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets limited input adaptivity, constrained memory capacity, and memory dilution in SSM-like or linear-Transformer long-context models.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an architecture proposal for long-context modeling, related to linear attention, SSMs, and memory-augmented Transformers. The idea is relevant, but the abstract lacks scale, token budget, strong baselines, and full LLM pretraining evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: MixFormer introduces a Mixture-of-Memory-Experts mechanism. It maintains multiple differentiated memory states and uses Time-Aware Linear Attention with learnable exponential decay functions and positional biases to dynamically update memory and reinforce important historical information.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on long-sequence text and image generation tasks. It does not provide model sizes, training data, concrete baselines, speed-memory tradeoffs, or effect sizes, which are essential for judging relevance to LLM pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 作为线性注意力记忆设计备查；先看是否有真实语言预训练和吞吐曲线，没有就不必投入太多时间。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for linear-attention memory design; first check for real LM pretraining and throughput curves before spending time.

paper.title: RippleKV: Cross-Layer KV Cache Allocation via Perturbation Propagation
paper.abstract: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by KV cache memory, yet distributing a limited cache budget across layers remains challenging. Existing methods rely on proxies such as layer depth, attention statistics, or representation change. These proxies do not measure how perturbations at each layer propagate to the output and may therefore cause sensitive layers to be underallocated while tolerant layers are overallocated. To address this issue, we propose RippleKV, which allocates cache across

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文推理中 KV cache 总预算有限时，如何在不同层之间分配缓存的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理内存优化方法。它把层级 KV 分配从启发式代理指标，转向直接测量某层 value cache 扰动对最终预测分布的影响，对长上下文 serving 和 cache compression 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RippleKV：在小校准集上，对每一层的 value cache 独立注入范数自适应扰动，测量输出分布的 KL divergence；把多样本平均后的响应作为层敏感度，再归一化为各层缓存预算 multiplier。方法不是按深度单调分配，也不直接依赖 attention statistic 或 hidden-state change。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型参数量、校准集规模、压缩比例或吞吐/困惑度提升。可确认的实验信号是方法围绕有限 KV cache budget 下的跨层分配，与基于层深、注意力统计、表示变化等代理方法比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to allocate a fixed KV-cache budget across transformer layers during long-context LLM inference.
summary_en.importance: It is an inference-memory optimization contribution. The useful shift is from heuristic layer proxies to a direct estimate of how perturbing a layer’s value cache changes the final predictive distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: RippleKV injects norm-adaptive perturbations into each layer’s value cache independently on a small calibration set, measures the induced output KL divergence, averages the responses into a model-specific sensitivity profile, and converts that profile into layer-wise budget multipliers. The allocation is not assumed to be monotonic with depth.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not specify model sizes, calibration-set size, compression ratios, or latency/quality numbers. The stated comparisons are against allocation rules based on layer depth, attention statistics, and representation-change proxies.

recommendation.zh: 只看扰动校准的定义和层敏感度曲线；若曲线稳定，内部 KV 压缩 ablation 可以复现。
recommendation.en: Read the perturbation calibration and layer-sensitivity plots; if the profiles are stable, this is worth reproducing in internal KV-compression ablations.

paper.title: Locating Failure in Multi-Page Visually Rich Document Understanding: An Empirical Attribution
paper.abstract: Multi-page visually-rich document understanding (MP-VRDU) requires managing evidence that is sparse, spread across pages, and often exceeds a model's context window. Prior work has produced competing, largely untested claims about how these systems should be built. We attribute incorrect answers to three failure modes, representation, selection, and reasoning, and isolate each over a multi-page document understanding dataset by intervening on one while holding the others fixed. We find that visi

summary.core_problem: 定位多页、视觉丰富文档理解系统的错误来源：到底是页面表示、证据选择，还是跨页推理失败。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是经验归因分析。它不提出新的基座模型或预训练方法，但把 MP-VRDU 中常被混在一起讨论的三个瓶颈拆开测量，对 VLM 长文档训练和系统设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把错误归因到 representation、selection、reasoning 三类，并通过干预实验固定其中若干环节、单独改变一个环节来隔离因果影响。例如分别控制文本抽取、页面选择、完整证据供给和提示方式，观察最终回答变化。
summary.experiments: 实验基于一个多页文档理解数据集，评估视觉输入、文本抽取、缺页、干扰页和提示策略对准确率的影响。主要发现包括：视觉信息必要但不能替代文本抽取；缺失相关页面会直接限制准确率；额外干扰页代价较小；即使完整证据已提供，模型仍会在跨页证据整合上失败。摘要未给出模型规模和具体提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks where multi-page visually rich document understanding systems fail: page representation, evidence selection, or cross-page reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is an empirical attribution study rather than a new foundation-model training method. Its value is in separating three failure sources that are often conflated in MP-VRDU systems, which is useful for VLM long-document training and system design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors decompose errors into representation, selection, and reasoning failures, then use intervention-style experiments that hold some components fixed while varying one component at a time. They control text extraction, page selection, full-evidence supply, and prompting behavior to isolate causal effects.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on a multi-page document understanding dataset. The main findings are that vision remains necessary but does not replace text extraction, missing relevant pages upper-bound accuracy, distractor pages are relatively cheap, and reasoners still fail to integrate cross-page evidence even when all evidence is supplied. The abstract does not report model sizes or exact numeric gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看错误归因结果即可；对 native VLM 预训练不直接给 recipe，但会校准文档任务里“加长上下文就够了”的直觉。
recommendation.en: Read the attribution results only; it does not give a VLM pretraining recipe, but it usefully checks the prior that longer context alone solves document QA.

paper.title: Autonomy-of-Heads: Data-Free Sparse Attention from Frozen Query-Key Geometry
paper.abstract: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by quadratic attention computation and growing KV-cache costs. Existing sparse attention and KV-compression methods typically decide which tokens or heads to preserve from runtime attention scores, observation windows, calibration prompts, or learned gates, making head diagnosis input-dependent and costly to deploy. We propose Autonomy-of-Heads (AoH), a data-free method that identifies retrieval and streaming heads from the spectral geometry of query-ke

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决长上下文推理中的 attention head 选择问题：现有稀疏注意力或 KV 压缩方法通常依赖运行时 attention score、校准 prompt、观察窗口或学习 gate，部署成本高，也难以在 prefill 一开始就确定哪些 head 需要全局上下文。论文提出只从冻结权重的 query-key 几何判断 head 的功能。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献偏推理效率，但它对理解长上下文模型的 head specialization 有启发。论文把 attention head 的 retrieval/streaming 分工和权重空间里的谱结构联系起来，而不是只看输入相关的 attention map。这个视角可用于分析长上下文能力如何在预训练中形成，也可能反过来指导 head-level regularization、长上下文继续训练和稀疏 attention 架构设计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Autonomy-of-Heads。对每个 attention head，定义 kernel attention operator：M_h = W_K^{h⊤} W_Q^h。该矩阵刻画 query 与 key 在该 head 中的匹配方向。论文用 M_h 的 effective rank 作为 head 功能指标：低 effective-rank 表示谱集中，少数主方向主导匹配，更像 retrieval head，需要保留全局 KV；高 effective-rank 表示匹配方向分散，更接近 streaming head，可以只保留 sink tokens 和 recent window。为了部署，作者不显式构造 d_model × d_model 的 M_h，而是利用 d_head × d_head 的 proxy 计算非零奇异值。最终策略很简单：低 ER head 用 full attention，高 ER head 用 sink-plus-recent attention。整个过程不需要训练数据、校准样本或额外 gate。
summary.experiments: 论文先给出两个观察。第一，在 Qwen2.5-7B 上，不同 head 的平均 attention distance 在 4K 到 100K context 下结构稳定，且 effective rank 与长距离 attention 行为呈负相关：低 ER head 更倾向远距离检索，高 ER head 更局部。第二，在 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 的 32K passkey retrieval 测试中，把高 ER head 逐步改成 streaming attention 对准确率影响较小；先改低 ER head 会使检索准确率快速下降，说明低 ER head 对远程信息访问更关键。LongBench 实验覆盖三个长上下文 LLM。在 50% sparsity 下，AoH 接近 full attention，并稳定优于 random 和 reversed head selection。效率实验显示，在长上下文下它能降低 prefill/decode latency 和 KV-cache memory；文中 streaming head 使用 128 个 sink tokens 加 256 个 recent tokens，因此在 32K、64K、128K 这类长度下 KV budget 近似等于 full-attention head 的比例。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 分钟。重点看 Observations 部分的两组证据：effective rank 与 average attention distance 的关系，以及 passkey retrieval 中 low-ER-first/high-ER-first 的对照。方法部分关注 M_h = W_K^{⊤}W_Q 的定义、effective rank 的计算，以及 d_head 级别谱计算为什么等价于关注非零奇异值。实验部分看 LongBench 50% sparsity 的主表和 latency/KV memory 曲线即可。需要留意的限制是：AoH 的 head 标签是输入无关的，因此适合稳定 head 分工明显的模型；如果某些模型大量依赖动态 routing 或 layer-wise adaptive behavior，固定分类可能不够细。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether long-context attention heads can be classified without prompts, runtime attention statistics, calibration data, or learned gates. The target problem is sparse long-context inference: deciding which heads must keep global KV access and which heads can be restricted to sink-plus-recent attention from the start of prefill.
summary_en.importance: The work is primarily an inference-efficiency paper, but it is also useful for pretraining analysis. It links retrieval versus streaming behavior to spectral structure in frozen query-key weights, rather than to input-specific attention maps. This gives a weight-space diagnostic for head specialization in long-context LLMs. Such diagnostics can inform how long-range retrieval capabilities emerge during pretraining or continued long-context training, and may be useful when designing head-level sparsity or regularization schemes.
summary_en.technical_approach: Autonomy-of-Heads defines a head-specific kernel attention operator M_h = W_K^{h⊤} W_Q^h. This operator captures the query-key matching directions available to a head. The classifier uses the effective rank of M_h. A low effective rank means the spectrum is concentrated in a few dominant matching directions; these heads are treated as retrieval heads and keep full-context attention. A high effective rank means the spectrum is more diffuse; these heads are treated as streaming heads and keep only a small sink cache plus a recent window. For efficiency, the nonzero singular values are computed through a d_head by d_head proxy rather than by materializing the full d_model by d_model matrix. The resulting sparse policy is training-free, data-free, compatible with GQA-style settings, and simple enough to be applied before any prompt is processed.
summary_en.experiments: The paper first reports two supporting observations. On Qwen2.5-7B, per-head average attention distance remains structurally stable from 4K to 100K context lengths, and lower-effective-rank heads tend to attend farther back in the context. On Llama3.1-8B-Instruct at 32K context length, a passkey retrieval study shows a clear separation: converting high-ER heads to streaming attention has limited impact, while converting low-ER heads first causes retrieval accuracy to collapse quickly. The main LongBench evaluation spans three long-context LLMs. At 50% sparsity, AoH remains close to full attention and outperforms random and reversed head-selection baselines. The efficiency results show reductions in prefill and decode latency as well as KV-cache memory at long sequence lengths. Streaming heads use a small 128-token sink cache and a 256-token recent window, so at 32K and beyond the KV budget is dominated by the fraction of heads kept in full attention.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes around 20 minutes. Start with the observation figures connecting effective rank to average attention distance and passkey retrieval degradation. Then read the method section for the definition of M_h, the effective-rank criterion, and the d_head-dimensional spectral computation. For results, focus on the 50% sparsity LongBench tables and the latency/KV-cache plots. The main limitation to keep in mind is that AoH assigns fixed, input-independent head roles. This is attractive for deployment, but may be less precise for models whose attention functions are highly prompt-dependent or shaped by dynamic routing mechanisms.

recommendation.zh: 只看谱几何定义和 head 分类实验；若稳定成立，应加入内部长上下文压缩诊断工具链。
recommendation.en: Read the spectral-geometry definition and head-classification results; if it holds up, it belongs in an internal long-context compression diagnostic stack.

paper.title: CoinRAG: Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG
paper.abstract: Recent optimization studies on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) have exploited chunk-level KV cache reuse to avoid processing long retrieved contexts for higher efficiency, while significant information redundancy and noise still remain in the coarse-grained chunks. This paper optimizes the Pareto frontier under low prefill latency constraints while maximizing accuracy by proposing CoinRAG (Contextualized Information Nugget KV Cache Reuse for Long-Context RAG). The name metaphorically reflec

summary.core_problem: 降低 long-context RAG 的 prefill latency，同时避免粗粒度 chunk 级 KV cache 复用带来的冗余和噪声。
summary.importance: 这是推理系统与 RAG efficiency 工作，贡献点在 KV cache 复用粒度。对预训练研究员的间接价值在于理解长上下文系统瓶颈，以及 retrieval context 表示是否需要在训练阶段适配更细粒度的复用结构。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoinRAG，把离线计算的 fine-grained information nugget KV cache 作为可组合单元。系统先用两阶段检索从 retrieved chunks 中定位 query-relevant semantic units，再拼接或组装这些 sliced KV representations，形成更紧凑、语义相关性更高的上下文表示。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型、数据集和数值。实验目标是优化低 prefill latency 约束下的 accuracy-latency Pareto frontier，并与 chunk-level KV cache reuse 方案比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce prefill latency in long-context RAG while avoiding the redundancy and noise of coarse chunk-level KV-cache reuse.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems and RAG-efficiency contribution focused on cache granularity. For pretraining researchers, its indirect value is in exposing long-context serving bottlenecks and raising the question of whether retrieval-context representations should be trained for finer-grained reuse.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoinRAG reuses offline-computed fine-grained information-nugget KV caches as composable units. It uses two-stage retrieval to identify query-relevant semantic units inside retrieved chunks, then assembles sliced KV representations into a compact, semantically relevant contextual representation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not include concrete model names, datasets, or numerical results. The evaluation targets the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier under low prefill-latency constraints and compares against chunk-level KV-cache reuse approaches.

recommendation.zh: 只看 cache 粒度和 Pareto 图；若结果干净，它提示 RAG context 可以按 semantic unit 预编码，而不是按 chunk 硬切。
recommendation.en: Read the cache granularity and Pareto plots; if clean, it argues for semantic-unit pre-encoding rather than hard chunking in RAG.

paper.title: K-EXAONE 2.0 Technical Report
paper.abstract: This technical report presents K-EXAONE 2.0, an open-weight multilingual foundation model developed by LG AI Research as a step in our effort toward global frontier-scale foundation models. Rather than training from scratch, we upcycle K-EXAONE and expand its architecture, yielding a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 750B total parameters and approximately 37B activated per token---more than three times the capacity of its predecessor. K-EXAONE 2.0 supports context lengths of up to 256K tokens

summary.core_problem: 报告 K-EXAONE 2.0 如何从已有 K-EXAONE 继续扩展为大规模多语 MoE 基座模型，并通过持续预训练、中期训练和后训练提升实用能力。
summary.importance: 这是一个大模型技术报告，重点在 MoE upcycling、256K 长上下文、多语扩展和完整训练管线。对预训练研究员的价值主要在训练路径选择：不从零训练，而是把已有模型扩容成 750B 总参数、每 token 激活约 37B 的 MoE。
summary.technical_approach: 模型通过 upcycle K-EXAONE 扩展架构，形成 750B total parameters、约 37B activated parameters per token 的 MoE。训练流程结合 continual pre-training、difficulty-focused mid-training 和 post-training，目标覆盖推理、agentic coding、多语能力、安全性，以及韩国社会文化语境下的行为对齐。
summary.experiments: K-EXAONE 2.0 支持最长 256K context，多语覆盖从 6 种扩展到 10 种。报告在九类贴近实际使用的评测上比较，整体优于前代 K-EXAONE，并与开放权重模型保持竞争力；最大增益出现在 agentic coding 等能力上。摘要未披露训练 token 数、数据配比和详细 baseline 列表。
summary.authors_note: 来自 LG AI Research，属于 K-EXAONE 系列开放权重基础模型技术报告。

summary_en.core_problem: The report describes how K-EXAONE 2.0 expands an existing K-EXAONE model into a large multilingual MoE foundation model through continued training and staged capability tuning.
summary_en.importance: This is a large-model technical report. Its main relevance is the training path: instead of training from scratch, LG AI Research upcycles an existing model into a 750B-parameter MoE with about 37B active parameters per token, long context, and broader multilingual coverage.
summary_en.technical_approach: K-EXAONE 2.0 upcycles K-EXAONE and expands it into a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. The pipeline combines continual pre-training, difficulty-focused mid-training, and post-training to improve reasoning, agentic coding, multilingual ability, safety, and Korean sociocultural grounding.
summary_en.experiments: The model supports up to 256K context and expands language coverage from six to ten languages. It is evaluated across nine practical-use categories, improves over K-EXAONE, and remains competitive with open-weight models, with particularly large gains in agentic coding. The abstract does not provide token counts, data mixture details, or full baseline tables.
summary_en.authors_note: The report is from LG AI Research and belongs to the K-EXAONE open-weight foundation-model line.

recommendation.zh: 重点看 upcycling 到 750B MoE 的 recipe 和长上下文段落；若细节足够，应对内部 dense-to-MoE 扩容实验有参考。
recommendation.en: Read the upcycling-to-750B-MoE recipe and long-context sections; if details are concrete, they are useful for internal dense-to-MoE expansion ablations.

paper.title: Relevant but Incomplete: Referential Dangling as a Paradigm-Level Failure Mode in Hard Prompt Compression
paper.abstract: Hard prompt compression reduces long-context inference cost by independently scoring tokens, sentences, or chunks and retaining the highest-scoring units under a budget. We identify a structural failure in this procedure: independent selection can split dependent evidence pairs, retaining one member while deleting the other. When retained text contains an answer but deleted text defines the entity needed to interpret it, we call the result referential dangling. At a compression ratio of 0.30, Be

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作指出硬提示压缩中的一个结构性失效：压缩器独立选择高相关 token、句子或段落时，可能保留答案片段，却删除解释该片段所需的前置实体定义或桥接证据。作者称这种现象为 referential dangling。
summary.importance: 这项结果对长上下文推理和推理侧降本有直接启发。很多 prompt compression 方法优化的是局部相关性或重要性分数，但多跳问答需要的是完整证据链。保留“看起来相关”的片段并不等于保留“可推理”的上下文。对基座研究来说，它提醒长上下文能力评估不能只看召回率或压缩后 token 数，也要检查证据依赖是否闭合。对 serving 和压缩系统来说，它说明压缩目标需要从独立片段打分走向依赖感知选择。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先形式化 extractive hard compressor：给定上下文、问题和 token 预算，压缩器输出源文本片段的子序列。referential dangling 被定义为：压缩结果保留了任务相关句子，但删除了使该句子可解释、可用于回答问题的支持片段。例如保留答案实体和一个地理事实，却删除了把问题主体连接到该地理事实的桥接句。实验先诊断 Beaver 这类基于 embedding 相似度和 chunk 排序的压缩器，再扩展到多种压缩方法。随后做两类修复：一类是 annotation-guided reselection，把遗漏的支持段落插回，并用删除最低分非支持段落抵消预算；另一类是自动 restoration，从被删除文本中生成候选句，训练小型分类器判断这些句子是否是解释已保留文本所需的依赖，再插回高分候选。
summary.experiments: 在 compression ratio 0.30 下，Beaver 在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA 和 MuSiQue 的 bridge examples 上造成 34% 到 54% 的答案路径不完整。人工审计显示 dangling 诊断 precision 为 95%。在共享 HotpotQA bridge 集合上，6 个压缩器都出现该问题，比例为 32% 到 60%。LongBench-v2 Single-Document QA 的 80 个文档全部包含至少一个 dangling reference。修复实验使用 Qwen3-8B 作为下游答题模型：在 dangling examples 上，插回遗漏支持段落并保持预算不变，准确率提升 29 到 34 个百分点，p < 1e-4，并恢复原压缩上下文与完整支持上下文之间至少 88% 的准确率差距。自动 restoration 在 HotpotQA 上将准确率提升 4.7 个百分点，压缩率仅从 0.30 变为 0.31。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中的 Figure 1 和问题定义，理解为什么答案字符串存在仍然可能不可用。然后看 Problem Formulation 中 Sufficiency 的定义，它是这篇工作的核心抽象。实验部分重点看三组数字：Beaver 在三套多跳 QA 上的 dangling 率、6 个压缩器的横向结果、annotation-guided reselection 的准确率恢复幅度。自动 restoration 部分可以快速看方法框架和 HotpotQA 结果，主要价值在于证明依赖修复可以部分自动化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper identifies a structural failure mode in hard prompt compression. Independent token, sentence, or chunk selection can keep a relevant fragment while removing the antecedent, entity definition, or bridge fact needed to interpret it. The authors call this failure referential dangling.
summary_en.importance: The result matters for long-context inference and cost reduction. Many compressors optimize local relevance, perplexity, embedding similarity, attention-derived importance, or learned salience. Multi-hop reasoning instead requires a closed evidence path. A compressed prompt can contain the answer string and still be unusable because the dependency that links the query to that answer has been removed. This is a useful diagnostic for pretraining and inference research around long context: recall of relevant spans is not enough; dependency completeness should be measured.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work formalizes extractive hard compression as selecting a source-ordered subset of the input under a token budget. A dangling case occurs when a task-relevant retained sentence lacks sufficient retained support to be interpreted and used in the evidence chain for the query. The empirical study starts with Beaver, a chunk-ranking compressor using Qwen3-0.6B embeddings, and then checks whether the issue generalizes to other compressors. Two repair strategies are studied. The first is annotation-guided reselection: reinsert the omitted supporting paragraph and remove the lowest-scoring non-supporting paragraphs to keep the token budget fixed. The second is automatic restoration: generate candidate sentences from omitted text and train a compact classifier to rank whether a candidate is needed to interpret retained content, then reinsert top-ranked candidates without using support annotations at inference time.
summary_en.experiments: At a 0.30 compression ratio, Beaver leaves answer paths incomplete in 34% to 54% of bridge examples across HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue. A human audit reports 95% precision for the dangling diagnosis. The issue is not specific to Beaver: on a shared HotpotQA bridge set, all six tested compressors show dangling rates between 32% and 60%. In LongBench-v2 Single-Document QA, all 80 documents contain at least one dangling reference. With Qwen3-8B as the downstream answer model, annotation-guided reselection improves accuracy by 29 to 34 points on dangling examples at the same token budget, with p < 1e-4, and recovers at least 88% of the gap between the original compressed context and a context retaining both annotated supporting paragraphs. The automatic restoration method improves HotpotQA accuracy by 4.7 points while changing the compression ratio only from 0.30 to 0.31.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Start with the motivating example and the formal definition of sufficiency, since that is the main conceptual contribution. Then read the diagnostic results for Beaver and the six-compressor comparison. The most informative ablation is the fixed-budget reselection experiment, because it separates missing dependency structure from mere token-budget shortage. The automatic restoration section is useful as a first step toward dependency-aware compression, but the larger lesson is the evaluation failure of independent relevance scoring.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它把“压缩掉信息”细化成“压缩断了依赖对”；如果你在做 long-context pruning，只看 dangling 定义、干预实验和错误率表就够，足以改内部设计。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it sharpens “compression loses information” into “compression breaks dependency pairs”; if you work on long-context pruning, the dangling definition plus the intervention tables are enough to change your design instincts.
