paper.title: Chimera: Designing and Chinchilla-Scaling Hybrid Visual Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Visual generation increasingly requires high-resolution images, long videos, and multimodal context, making the quadratic cost of full attention prohibitive. We introduce Chimera, a hybrid visual diffusion backbone with a principled scaling recipe. Chimera processes text, image, and video tokens in one raster-ordered stream without positional embeddings. It combines Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) for long-context state tracking with O(N) complexity, interleaved Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) for

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉扩散 backbone 在长上下文、高分辨率、多模态条件下全注意力成本过高，以及异构混合架构缺少可迁移 scaling recipe 的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值有两层：一是提出 KDA+MLA+短卷积+MoE 的混合视觉扩散架构；二是更关键地给出 HeteroP 和 Chinchilla-style compute-optimal scaling，用于异构模块的宽度/深度扩展与激活计算分配。对基座预训练研究员，后者比模型本身更值得看，因为它触及“异构架构如何做 clean scaling”这个普遍难题。
summary.technical_approach: Chimera 把文本、图像、视频 token 放进统一 raster-ordered 序列，不用显式位置编码；用 Kimi Delta Attention 做 O(N) 长程状态跟踪，用间隔插入的 Multi-head Latent Attention 保留全局直接交互，再配合 modality-aware short convolution 建模局部时空结构。容量扩展依赖 sparse MoE。为让这种异构结构可系统扩展，作者提出 HeteroP，按 tensor 的 functional fan-in 与模型深度做模块级超参迁移，并据此拟合 activated model size 下的 compute-optimal law。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明实验覆盖图像、视频和多模态生成场景，并构建了一族经过 HeteroP 调参的模型来拟合 Chinchilla 风格 scaling 曲线。若论文正文给出不同 activated parameter / token budget 下的最优点与外推误差，这部分会比最终生成指标更有参考价值。需要注意：这是视觉扩散模型上的结论，能否迁移到文本或统一 token LM 仍需谨慎。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles two issues in visual diffusion backbones: the prohibitive cost of full attention for long-context, high-resolution, multimodal generation, and the lack of a transferable scaling recipe for heterogeneous hybrid architectures.
summary_en.importance: The paper matters at two levels: it proposes a hybrid visual diffusion architecture, but more importantly it introduces HeteroP plus Chinchilla-style compute-optimal scaling for heterogeneous modules. For foundation-model pretraining researchers, the latter is the more interesting part because it addresses how to scale non-uniform architectures cleanly.
summary_en.technical_approach: Chimera places text, image, and video tokens into one raster-ordered stream without explicit positional embeddings. It combines Kimi Delta Attention for O(N) long-range state tracking, interleaved Multi-head Latent Attention for direct global interaction, modality-aware short convolutions for local spatiotemporal context, and sparse MoE for capacity expansion. HeteroP then transfers hyperparameters module-wise based on functional fan-in and depth, enabling compute-optimal scaling fits over activated model size.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract suggests experiments across image, video, and multimodal generation, with a family of HeteroP-tuned models used to fit Chinchilla-style scaling curves. If the paper reports optimal points and extrapolation quality across activated-parameter and token budgets, that section is more valuable than the final generation metrics. Still, these are visual diffusion results, so transfer to text LMs should be treated cautiously.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的不是视觉生成结果，而是异构架构怎么做 scaling：先读 HeteroP 和 compute-optimal 拟合，若曲线干净，内部 MoE/混合架构实验可直接借鉴。
recommendation.en: The real value is not the visual generation result but how they scale a heterogeneous architecture; read HeteroP and the compute-optimal fits first, and borrow it if the curves are clean.

paper.title: Understanding Is Done Early: A Depth Division of Labor in Large Language Models and Its Use for Unbounded-Context Memory
paper.abstract: Transformer depth is not used uniformly: lower and middle layers build semantic representations, while upper layers increasingly specialize them for prediction. We turn this division of labor into CoMem (Comprehension Memory), which writes each context chunk only through an intermediate layer, retrieves a fixed number of cached residual states, and recomputes the query-conditioned upper layers over the resulting pack. For a fixed retrieval budget, model-side read compute and memory are independe

summary.core_problem: 利用 Transformer 不同深度层的功能分工，构造一种存储上下文长度不影响读时显存和计算的长上下文记忆机制。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是长上下文推理与记忆系统创新，同时带有机制分析价值。它把“中间层负责理解、上层负责预测”的观察转化为可训练、可部署的缓存方案，对 KV-cache 长上下文路线有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CoMem。每个上下文 chunk 只前向到中间层并写入残差状态；检索时取固定数量的缓存残差状态，与当前 query 组成 pack，再重新计算 query-conditioned 的上层网络。这样在固定检索预算下，读时计算和显存不随已存上下文长度增长。主实验冻结 Qwen3-8B base backbone，只训练 rank-32 self-distillation LoRA；另报告无 adapter 版本。
summary.experiments: 使用 continued-trained Qwen3-8B base LM，在无 chat-template 的统一协议下评测。CoMem 在 RULER 达到 97.05，在 LoCoMo 达到 38.27；对比 full-context KV-Direct 的 34.59，差距很大。摘要还称对话记忆优势在 conversation-cluster resampling 和独立 judge 下仍保留，并补充了长上下文与长文档结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper turns depth-wise functional specialization in Transformers into a long-context memory mechanism whose read-time compute and memory do not grow with stored context length.
summary_en.importance: This is a long-context inference and memory-system contribution with a useful mechanistic angle. It converts the observation that middle layers encode semantics while upper layers specialize for prediction into a practical cache design, making it relevant to KV-cache alternatives.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoMem writes each context chunk only up to an intermediate layer and stores residual states. At read time, it retrieves a fixed number of cached states, packs them with the query, and recomputes the query-conditioned upper layers. With a fixed retrieval budget, read compute and memory are independent of the total stored context. The main setup freezes a continued-trained Qwen3-8B base model and trains only a rank-32 self-distillation LoRA; an adapter-free variant is also reported.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses a continued-trained Qwen3-8B base LM under a unified chat-template-free protocol. CoMem reaches 97.05 on RULER and 38.27 on LoCoMo, compared with 34.59 for full-context KV-Direct. The abstract also reports robustness under conversation-cluster resampling, an independent judge, and additional long-context and long-document tests.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图、RULER/LoCoMo 设置和消融；若 setup 干净，应在内部长上下文 cache 实验复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram, RULER/LoCoMo setup, and ablations; if the setup is clean, this deserves an internal long-context cache reproduction.

paper.title: Back from the Future: Key-Value Cache Management by Counter-Causal Surprise
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) cache management through compression and eviction strategies has emerged as an important research direction in recent years. Computational demands of large language models (LLMs) and their multi-modal variants during output generation can be partially alleviated by caching previous key and value calculations needed by subsequent scaled dot-product attention operations. However, this leads to another problem: the size of the resulting KV cache grows linearly with context length and

summary.core_problem: 在有限显存下做自回归生成时，KV cache 随上下文线性增长。现有基于注意力分数的驱逐策略会产生自强化偏差：被保留的 token 持续获得后续注意力，分数累积后更难被驱逐；而只出现一次但对后续回答关键的低频 token 可能被误删。
summary.importance: 提出了一种不依赖训练、不依赖前向注意力权重的 KV cache 驱逐准则，对长上下文推理和多模态生成的显存管理有实际价值。对预训练研究的直接启发在于：它用“未来 token 能否预测当前 token”来度量上下文信息冗余，提供了一种不同于 heavy hitter 注意力统计的上下文可压缩性视角。
summary.technical_approach: 核心量是 counter-causal surprise。在生成过程中复用已计算的 KV，额外做一次带反因果上三角 mask 的前向计算，使每个位置只能注意 cache 中它之后的 token。如果一个旧 token 能被后续 token 很好预测，说明其信息已被后文吸收，surprise 低，可以驱逐；如果难以被后文预测，则保留。该方法天然偏向近期 token，类似滑动窗口但保留原则更明确。完整反因果 pass 的代价为 O(Ln²)，其中 L 是层数、n 是当前 cache 大小；作者进一步提出只在最后一层做反因果 pass 的快速近似，代价降到 O(n²)，在 Qwen2.5-7B、512 token cache 下每次刷新约 7.9ms，相对完整版本加速 7–9 倍。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖长提示和长生成两类任务，测试 prefill 与 decode 阶段，并在两个开源 LLM 系列、不同尺寸上比较。论文展示了注意力-based 方法在部分任务、模型和 cache 大小组合下退化更快的失败案例；counter-causal surprise 在质量上与现有方法持平或更好，同时快速近似保持了较低延迟。具体任务精度数字未在提供的正文中完整给出。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看引言中对注意力自强化偏差的描述，再看方法部分关于反因果 mask 和 surprise 评分的定义。重点比较完整反因果 pass 与最后一层近似的精度-开销权衡。实验部分建议关注 cache 大小变化时的质量曲线和失败案例。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: During autoregressive generation under memory constraints, the KV cache grows linearly with context length. Attention-based eviction methods suffer from a self-reinforcing bias: retained tokens keep receiving attention in later decoding steps, accumulating score and becoming harder to evict, while low-frequency but factually critical tokens may be removed too early.
summary_en.importance: The paper introduces a training-free KV cache eviction criterion that does not rely on forward attention scores. It is practically relevant for long-context and multimodal inference. For pretraining research, its main interest is the notion that a past token is redundant if it can be predicted from later tokens, offering a different measure of context compressibility from heavy-hitter attention statistics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed score is counter-causal surprise. While reusing the already computed KV entries, the method runs an additional forward pass with an upper-triangular counter-causal attention mask, so each position attends only to tokens that come after it in the cache. A token with low surprise is predictable from future context and can be evicted; a token with high surprise carries unique information and should be kept. The rule also naturally favors recent tokens. The full counter-causal pass costs O(Ln²), where L is the number of layers and n is the current cache size. A fast approximation restricts the pass to the last transformer layer, reducing cost to O(n²); on Qwen2.5-7B with a 512-token cache, a refresh takes about 7.9 ms, yielding a 7–9× speedup over the full version.
summary_en.experiments: Benchmarks cover both long-prompt and long-generation settings and evaluate both prefill and decode phases across two families of open-weight LLMs of different sizes. The paper shows cases where attention-based methods degrade faster for certain task, model, and cache-size combinations. Counter-causal surprise is competitive with or better than existing eviction methods, while the last-layer approximation keeps overhead low. Exact task accuracy numbers are not fully included in the provided text.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the self-reinforcing bias of attention-based eviction, then read the method section for the counter-causal mask and surprise definition. Pay special attention to the trade-off between the full counter-causal pass and the last-layer approximation. In the experiments, look at quality versus cache-size curves and the reported failure cases. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: KV缓存驱逐的新视角，用反因果可预测性判断冗余，思路新颖，重点看方法设计和消融实验。
recommendation.en: A novel perspective on KV cache eviction using counter-causal predictability; focus on the method design and ablation studies.

paper.title: Measuring Alignment With Reader Highlights Net of Position and Length
paper.abstract: Context compression discards most of a document before a language model reads it, and is normally evaluated by downstream task accuracy - which makes another model the judge of what mattered. Naturalistic social highlighting offers a non-circular reference: many people independently marking passages on the same page. But the obvious metric, the fraction of crowd-marked sentences a compressor keeps, is confounded twice: crowd marks are front-loaded and crowd-marked sentences are longer, so any me

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作评估长上下文压缩器是否保留了人类读者会标记的句子，同时去掉两个强混杂因素：位置和长度。普通的“保留了多少高亮句子”指标不可靠，因为读者高亮更靠前，且被高亮句子更长；截断策略或偏好长句的简单方法会在未理解内容的情况下得高分。
summary.importance: 对预训练方向的直接贡献有限，但对长上下文 LM 的评测和数据管线有参考意义。很多长上下文系统会在模型读取前丢弃大部分文档，压缩质量通常用下游任务准确率衡量，这会让另一个模型或任务标签间接决定什么重要。社会化高亮提供了一种非模型判官的参照，虽然它只表示“读者选择保留什么”，不等同于客观重要性。更有价值的是方法论提醒：上下文压缩评测很容易被位置、长度和抽样结构污染，必须报告控制变量本身的假阳性率。
summary.technical_approach: 数据来自一个社会化高亮平台，包含 120 篇公共网页文档、78 个域名，每篇至少有 12 个独立读者标记。句子若处于标记次数前 15% 且至少有 2 次标记，则定义为 crowd-marked。作者对每个被标记句子，在同一文档内寻找未标记句子作为对照，要求相对深度差不超过 0.05，文档内长度排名差不超过 0.05。压缩器的效果用被保留的标记句子比例减去匹配邻居被保留比例来衡量，并用按域名聚类的 bootstrap 给区间。为了验证控制是否有效，作者构造 synthetic nulls：在没有真实读者偏好的情况下模拟位置和长度混杂，测量匹配估计器自身的假阳性率。这个校准环节是方法上的重点。
summary.experiments: 原始数据中有 2,101 个 crowd-marked 句子，其中 1,304 个成功匹配，797 个因缺少合适对照被丢弃，丢弃率为 37.9%；120 篇文档中有 15 篇没有贡献匹配对。匹配池很小，中位数只有 2 个对照。高亮句子有明显连续性：54.9% 的标记句子相邻位置也被标记，而等规模随机放置为 25.3%，形成 1,378 个标记 runs，因此句子级精度偏乐观。控制实验显示，只按深度分层会在 synthetic nulls 上产生 20–36% 的假阳性，远高于名义 2.5%。主结果是语言模型压缩器保留 38.4% 的 crowd-marked 句子，而匹配未标记邻居为 19.9%。Luhn 1958 词频启发式也有正信号，约 +0.088，大约达到语言模型效果的一半。prompt framing 会让结果变化约 2 倍，且方向不直观，说明压缩器评测对提示设计敏感。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。重点看 Data 和 Method，尤其是 crowd-marked 标签定义、位置/长度匹配规则、discard rate、domain-clustered bootstrap，以及 synthetic null calibration。实验部分优先看主表、假阳性校准表、Luhn baseline 和 prompt framing 对比。预训练研究员不必细读社会化高亮平台细节，但应关注它对长上下文数据筛选的启发：如果用模型生成摘要或压缩文档作为训练数据，保留信号可能被位置和长度偏置主导。这个工作更像评测方法和数据诊断，不是新的 LM 训练方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether a context compressor preserves sentences that human readers chose to highlight, after removing two major confounds: position and length. A naive highlight-recall metric is misleading because highlighted sentences tend to appear earlier and tend to be longer. A truncation policy or a length-biased selector can therefore look good without capturing reader preference.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a pretraining method, but it is useful for long-context evaluation and data pipelines. Many long-context systems discard most of a document before an LM reads it, and compression quality is often measured by downstream task accuracy. That makes the task setup or another model decide what mattered. Social highlights give a non-model reference for what readers elected to keep, with the important caveat that this is not the same as objective importance. The stronger lesson is methodological: context-compression evaluations can be dominated by surface confounds, and the false-positive rate of the control procedure itself should be measured.
summary_en.technical_approach: The dataset contains 120 public web documents from 78 domains, each highlighted by at least 12 independent readers. A sentence is labeled crowd-marked if it is in the top 15% by mark count and has at least two marks. For each marked sentence, the estimator searches within the same document for unmarked comparator sentences that match relative depth within 0.05 and within-document length rank within 0.05. A compressor is scored by comparing how often it keeps marked sentences versus their matched unmarked neighbors. Intervals are computed with a domain-clustered bootstrap. The paper also calibrates the estimator on synthetic nulls that contain position and length confounds but no true reader-preference effect, which is the key methodological safeguard.
summary_en.experiments: The raw set contains 2,101 crowd-marked sentences. Of these, 1,304 are matched and 797 are discarded because no admissible comparator exists, a 37.9% discard rate. Fifteen of the 120 documents contribute no matched pairs. Comparator pools are small, with a median size of 2. Highlight contiguity is substantial: 54.9% of marked sentences have a marked immediate neighbor, compared with 25.3% under size-matched random placement, yielding 1,378 marked runs. This makes sentence-level precision optimistic. Calibration shows that depth-only stratification produces false positives on 20–36% of synthetic nulls, far above the nominal 2.5%. The main result is that an LM-based compressor keeps 38.4% of crowd-marked sentences versus 19.9% of matched unmarked neighbors. A classical Luhn-style lexical heuristic gives a positive effect of about +0.088, roughly half the LM effect. Prompt framing changes the measured result by about a factor of two, indicating that compressor evaluation is prompt-sensitive.
summary_en.reading_guide: A productive skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Read the Data and Method sections carefully: the label definition, depth/length matching, discard rate, domain-clustered bootstrap, and synthetic-null calibration are the main substance. In the results, focus on the main matched comparison, the false-positive calibration, the Luhn baseline, and the prompt-framing sensitivity. Pretraining researchers can skip most platform-specific details, but the bias analysis is relevant when building document compression or synthetic summarization pipelines for long-context training. The work is best viewed as an evaluation and data-diagnostic contribution, not as a new language-model training method.

recommendation.zh: 点出长上下文/上下文压缩评测的系统性偏差，做相关方向必须看§3的校准方法，避免被虚假SOTA误导。
recommendation.en: Identifies systematic biases in long-context/context compression evaluation; read §3 for the calibration protocol to avoid being misled by spurious SOTA claims.

paper.title: ObjectStream: Latent Objects as Memory Anchors for Streaming Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Streaming video understanding requires models to continuously retain useful visual evidence before future questions are known. Existing approaches primarily manage the growing visual context according to token importance, temporal redundancy, or segment-level relevance, but rarely organize evidence around objects that persist and evolve over time. Thus, in this paper, we introduce ObjectStream, a training-free framework that treats latent objects as memory anchors for streaming video understandi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是流式视频理解里的记忆组织问题：视频不断到来、问题何时提出未知、上下文预算有限，模型需要提前决定“保留什么”和“怎么组织这些保留下来的证据”。作者认为，现有 training-free 方法大多围绕 token 重要性、时间冗余或片段级相关性做压缩，但缺少跨时间稳定的对象级组织，因此在需要追踪对象身份、状态变化和交互关系的问题上不够稳。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接相关性不高，它更接近 Video-LLM 推理时的记忆管理方法，而不是预训练目标、数据或训练 recipe 的创新。不过它有一个可借鉴的点：作者把“对象”当作长期记忆锚点，而不是把历史视觉 token 平铺存储。这种 object-centric memory 视角，对原生视频模型、长上下文多模态模型、甚至视觉 tokenizer 设计都有启发。若关心统一多模态模型在长时序输入上的表示压缩，这篇可以作为思路参考，但不属于必须精读的预训练论文。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是一个 training-free、plug-and-play 的流式记忆框架，直接建立在冻结的 Video-LLM 表示上，不改底层模型。核心由三部分组成。

第一部分是 Latent Object-Anchored Memory。作者不依赖外部 detector 或 segmentation model，而是从冻结模型的 patch-level visual tokens 中诱导出空间上连贯的“latent objects”，再把跨帧相似的对象关联起来，形成持久的 memory anchors。这样做的目的，是把长视频中的历史信息从“按时间堆叠的 token”改成“按对象维护的状态轨迹”。

第二部分是 Object-Conditioned Temporal Residuals。仅保留对象主轨迹还不够，因为很多关键证据是短暂变化，比如物体突然出现、姿态切换、交互发生。作者因此额外保存围绕对象级突变的残差信息，用来补足长期对象记忆对瞬时事件的压缩损失。

第三部分是 Recent Visual Grounding Window。对象历史适合长期追踪，但回答当前问题时还需要最近的原始视觉上下文做 grounding，因此系统保留一个近期窗口，避免过度抽象后丢失即时细节。

整体上，这是一个三层记忆结构：持久对象历史、短时变化残差、最近视觉窗口。和常见的 token pruning、frame selection、segment memory 相比，它的区别不在压得更狠，而在组织方式从 token-centric 变成 object-centric。作者强调 latent objects 完全来自模型内部表征，这一点让方法具备较好的可插拔性。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖在线流式和离线长视频两类场景，底座模型主要展示在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上。在线流式评测中，ObjectStream 相比基线在 OVO-Bench 的 Real-Time Visual Perception 上提升 10.0 分，在 Backward Tracing 上提升 4.9 分，在 StreamingBench 上提升 2.9 分。这个结果说明对象锚点式记忆对“实时感知”和“回溯追踪”都有效，尤其对需要沿时间找对象证据的问题更明显。

离线长视频评测里，作者声称在丢弃 82.5% 视觉 token 的情况下，仍能超过 full-token baseline。这个结果的意义在于：它不是单纯用更多计算换更好效果，而是在强压缩下仍保持甚至提升性能，说明记忆组织方式确实比原始 token 堆叠更有效。

从消融角度看，三部分组件各自对应不同能力：对象锚点负责长期一致性，temporal residuals 负责突发变化，recent window 负责即时 grounding。若只保留其中一部分，性能会掉，说明这不是单一压缩技巧，而是针对不同时间尺度的信息做分工。全文没有把重点放在训练细节，因为方法本身不需要训练；实验价值主要在于展示“冻结模型 + 更好的记忆结构”可以带来稳定收益。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读。先看引言和 Figure 2，把三层记忆结构理解清楚：object anchors、temporal residuals、recent window 分别解决什么问题。然后看方法部分里 latent object 的构造和跨帧关联方式，这是全文最关键的设计。实验部分重点看两类 benchmark：OVO-Bench 的实时感知/回溯追踪，以及离线长视频上的 token efficiency。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主要内容。

如果你主要做预训练，不必深挖全部实现细节；更值得留意的是它背后的表示假设：冻结 Video-LLM 的 patch token 已经隐含了可聚合的对象结构。这一点和 object-centric tokenizer、视频离散化、长时记忆压缩都有潜在联系。若你做 streaming inference 或长视频 VLM，这篇的图表和消融值得仔细看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a memory-organization problem in streaming video understanding. In a streaming setting, frames arrive continuously, future questions are unknown, and memory is bounded. Existing training-free methods mostly decide which tokens, frames, or segments to keep, but they do not organize retained evidence around persistent objects. That becomes a weakness when the question requires tracking object identity, state changes, or interactions over time.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to core pretraining research is limited. This is primarily an inference-time memory framework for Video-LLMs, not a new pretraining objective, data recipe, or scaling result. Still, there is one useful idea for foundation-model researchers: long-horizon visual memory may be better organized around object-like latent units than around raw token history. That object-centric view could matter for future work on native video models, multimodal long-context systems, and visual tokenization. It is a useful skim for representation and memory design, but not a must-read pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ObjectStream is a training-free, plug-and-play memory framework built on frozen Video-LLM representations. It does not modify the backbone model. The method has three components.

The first is Latent Object-Anchored Memory. Instead of storing historical visual tokens as a flat sequence, the method induces spatially coherent latent object candidates directly from patch-level features of the frozen model, links corresponding objects across frames, and maintains their histories under a memory budget. The goal is to convert long video memory from token-centric storage into object-centric trajectories.

The second is Object-Conditioned Temporal Residuals. Persistent object histories alone can miss short-lived but important events, such as abrupt appearance changes or interactions. To address that, the method stores residual evidence around object-level changes, preserving transient information that would otherwise be compressed away.

The third is a Recent Visual Grounding Window. Object histories are useful for long-term tracking, but answering current questions still requires access to recent raw visual context. The grounding window keeps the latest observations so the model can remain visually grounded without relying only on abstracted memory.

So the design is a three-part memory system: persistent object histories, transient change residuals, and recent visual context. Compared with token pruning, frame selection, or segment-level memory, the main difference is not just stronger compression but a different organizing principle. The method is also notable for avoiding external detectors or segmentation models; the object-like units are induced from the model’s own latent space.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover both online streaming and offline long-video understanding, with Qwen2.5-VL-7B as the main backbone. On streaming benchmarks, ObjectStream improves Real-Time Visual Perception on OVO-Bench by 10.0 points, Backward Tracing by 4.9 points, and StreamingBench by 2.9 points. The gains are especially consistent with the paper’s claim that object-anchored memory helps when evidence must be traced over time.

On offline long-video benchmarks, the method reportedly surpasses the full-token baseline while discarding 82.5% of visual tokens. That is the most important efficiency result: performance is maintained or improved under aggressive token reduction, suggesting that better memory organization can outperform brute-force retention of raw visual tokens.

The ablations support the division of labor among the three components. Object anchors handle long-term consistency, temporal residuals preserve abrupt changes, and the recent window supports immediate grounding. Removing any one of them hurts performance, which indicates that the method is not a single compression trick but a multi-timescale memory design. Since the framework is training-free, the experimental contribution is mainly about showing that frozen models can benefit substantially from better memory structure.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction and the main framework figure to understand the three memory components and why each exists. Then read the method section on latent object induction and cross-frame association, since that is the core design choice. In the experiments, focus on the OVO-Bench results for real-time perception and backward tracing, and on the token-efficiency results in offline long-video evaluation. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to extract the main idea.

If your main focus is pretraining, you do not need every implementation detail. The more interesting takeaway is the representation assumption behind the method: frozen Video-LLM patch tokens already contain enough structure to recover object-like units. That connects naturally to object-centric tokenization, video discretization, and long-horizon memory compression.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法图和记忆更新规则；对象锚点比 token saliency 更像可扩展视频记忆，但证据强度要看完整实验。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and memory update rule; object anchors look more scalable than token saliency, but the claim depends on full experiments.

paper.title: Visko Orbis 1.0: A Live Model for Real-Time Interactive Long Video Generation
paper.abstract: We present Visko Orbis 1.0, a Live Model for real-time, interactive long-video generation. Users can change the prompt at any moment during generation, and the update becomes visible in real time. Visko Orbis 1.0 supports long-form text-to-video, image-to-video, and video continuation, with multilingual prompts and prompt switching while generation is in progress. A bounded multi-scale memory preserves subjects, scenes, and style across chunks, sustaining hour-scale rollouts without evident qual

summary.core_problem: 构建可实时交互的长视频生成模型，让用户在生成过程中随时切换 prompt，并立即反映到后续视频里。
summary.importance: 贡献偏系统与生成范式：把 chunk-wise streaming generation、多尺度有界记忆、实时上采样和 serving engine 结合，目标是小时级视频 rollout 的稳定性和交互性。对 LLM 预训练研究的间接价值在于长程生成状态管理和在线条件变更，而非文本基座训练。
summary.technical_approach: Visko Orbis 1.0 使用蒸馏后的 chunk-wise streaming generator 逐块生成视频，并通过 bounded multi-scale memory 维护主体、场景和风格，减少跨 chunk 的漂移。系统还包含 streaming video upscaler 和优化后的 GPU serving engine，支持 text-to-video、image-to-video、video continuation、多语言 prompt 和生成中的 prompt switching。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称可在优化 GPU serving engine 上实现 4K、24 FPS 实时生成，支持小时级 rollout 且无明显质量或颜色漂移；在 long-form Arena 比较中获得最高整体偏好和时间稳定性评分。未给出训练数据、模型参数量、具体硬件配置和对比数值。

summary_en.core_problem: Build a real-time interactive long-video generation model where users can change prompts during generation and see the change reflected immediately.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a system-level video generation design: chunk-wise streaming generation, bounded multi-scale memory, real-time upscaling, and an optimized serving engine for stable hour-scale rollouts. Its relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect, mostly through long-horizon state management and online conditioning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Visko Orbis 1.0 uses a distilled chunk-wise streaming generator and a bounded multi-scale memory to preserve subjects, scenes, and style across chunks. It also includes a streaming video upscaler and optimized GPU serving engine. The system supports text-to-video, image-to-video, video continuation, multilingual prompts, and prompt switching during generation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims real-time 4K video generation at 24 FPS on an optimized GPU serving engine, hour-scale rollouts without obvious quality or color drift, and the highest overall preference and temporal stability ratings in long-form Arena comparisons. It does not provide training data scale, parameter count, hardware details, or numerical margins.

recommendation.zh: 看 bounded memory 和 chunk 接口即可；系统指标很亮，但缺少训练规模与硬件细节，先当产品型信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the bounded-memory and chunk interface design; the system claims are strong, but without scale and hardware details this is mostly a product-style signal.

paper.title: Raven: High-Recall Sequence Modeling with Sparse Memory Routing
paper.abstract: Long-context recall in linear-time sequence models highlights a tradeoff in how they write to memory. State-based linear models, such as state-space models (SSMs) and linear Transformers, write densely, updating the entire state for each newly arrived token, which leads to interference and makes specific past tokens hard to recover. Sliding-window attention (SWA) exhibits the opposite behavior: it writes sparsely by storing explicit token representations, but only within a fixed window, so recal

summary.core_problem: 线性时间序列模型（包括状态空间模型SSM、线性Transformer、滑动窗口注意力SWA）在长上下文记忆上存在根本性的写记忆权衡：SSM类模型每步对全状态做稠密写入，不同token的信息相互干扰，难以精准召回久远的特定token；SWA类模型做稀疏写入，但只保留固定窗口内的显式token表示，一旦内容滑出窗口就会完全丢失。现有线性模型的设计始终停留在这两个极端，缺少介于“稠密写入全局记忆”和“稀疏写入固定窗口”之间的中间方案，导致长距离召回能力薄弱，上下文长度外推性能差。
summary.importance: 该工作将现有线性时序模型的记忆机制统一到“路由写入+选择性衰减”的框架下，明确指出SSM和SWA是该框架上的两个极端端点。提出的Raven结构在保持线性推理复杂度的同时大幅提升长序列召回能力，不需要叠加卷积或SWA辅助层就能实现可靠的长距离记忆，对下一代非Transformer线性架构的长上下文设计有直接参考价值，也明确了全状态稠密更新带来的写入干扰是现有SSM类模型长上下文召回差的核心原因。
summary.technical_approach: 该工作首先提出路由槽记忆（Routing Slot Memories, RSM）的统一框架，将固定大小记忆矩阵的更新拆解为两个独立维度：一是写入路由，决定新内容写入哪些记忆槽；二是槽位衰减，只对被写入的槽位应用遗忘衰减，未被选中的槽位内容完全保留，不被覆盖或衰减。在这一框架下，SSM对应每步全槽位稠密写入+全局逐步衰减的极端，SWA对应确定性轮流写入单一槽位+硬驱逐（未写入槽位保留内容直到被轮转到覆盖）的另一个极端。Raven作为RSM的具体实现：每步通过输入依赖的可学习路由选择少量记忆槽（稀疏路由，既非全槽写入也非固定轮转单个槽位），仅对选中的槽位写入新的内容，并仅对这些槽位应用可学习的衰减；未选中的槽位完全保留原有信息，不做任何更新或衰减。Raven块不需要叠加卷积层或滑动窗口注意力辅助，单一RSM层就能同时实现记忆持久化和精准召回，保持严格的线性时间复杂度。
summary.experiments: 实验对比Mamba-2、Gated DeltaNet（GDN）、Gated Linear Attention（GLA）、SWA等主流线性序列模型：一是Needle-in-a-Haystack测试中，SWA在窗口外的召回率接近0，Raven在超出训练长度16倍的外推设置下仍能实现完美召回；二是标准语言建模任务上，Raven的困惑度与Mamba-2、GDN、GLA等近年提出的线性模型持平或更优；三是召回密集型任务上，无论是独立使用Raven结构还是与注意力机制混合，性能都显著优于SWA和SSM基线，结果在不同模型规模下保持一致；四是消融实验验证了稀疏路由和选择性衰减两个设计的独立贡献：仅保留稀疏路由但对所有槽位应用全局衰减，会损失长期记忆保持能力；仅保留选择性衰减但对所有槽位做稠密写入，则退化为类似GLA的稠密更新模型，召回性能大幅下降。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第3节RSM统一框架的推导部分，尤其是将SSM和SWA都归约到同一更新公式下的内容（对应原论文公式1到公式5的对比）。这部分是整个工作的核心概念贡献，厘清了此前线性模型记忆设计中未被明确讨论的隐含权衡。之后看第4节Raven的路由机制和衰减设计的具体实现，留意路由稀疏度、衰减作用范围的设计选择。实验部分重点关注长度外推下的Needle测试结果和消融实验，理解两个设计维度各自的独立贡献。值得深挖的方向包括：路由稀疏度随模型规模、训练长度的scaling规律，路由决策的可解释性（不同槽位是否对应不同类型的记忆内容），以及RSM框架下更灵活的记忆管理策略（如动态槽位数量、显式记忆擦除）。

summary_en.core_problem: Linear-time sequence models (state space models/SSMs, linear Transformers, sliding-window attention/SWA) face a fundamental write-memory tradeoff for long-context recall: dense-write models like SSMs update their entire state at every step, causing cross-token interference that makes precise retrieval of old, specific tokens difficult; sparse-write models like SWA store explicit token representations but only within a fixed recent window, leading to total information loss once tokens are evicted. Existing linear architectures leave this tradeoff implicit, with no intermediate design point between dense global memory and sparse fixed-window memory, resulting in weak long-range recall and poor length extrapolation.
summary_en.importance: This work unifies the memory mechanisms of existing linear sequence models under a single “routing + selective decay” framework, explicitly identifying SSMs and SWA as two extreme points on the routing spectrum. The proposed Raven architecture delivers substantially improved long-sequence recall while retaining linear time complexity, and achieves reliable long-range retrieval without relying on auxiliary convolution or SWA layers. It provides a concrete design direction for long-context non-Transformer linear architectures, and identifies dense full-state updates as the root cause of poor long-context recall in prior SSM variants.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work first proposes Routing Slot Memories (RSM), a unifying framework that decomposes fixed-size memory updates into two independent dimensions: (1) write routing, which selects a subset of memory slots to write new content to; (2) slot-wise decay, which applies forgetting operators only to slots that receive new writes, leaving unselected slots completely untouched with no overwrites or decay. Under this framework, SSMs correspond to the extreme of dense full-slot writes with global gradual decay, while SWA corresponds to the extreme of deterministic round-robin single-slot writes with hard eviction (unselected slots retain content until overwritten on their rotation). Raven is a concrete RSM instantiation that uses learned, input-dependent sparse routing to select a small subset of slots per step—neither writing to all slots nor rotating deterministically through a single slot. New content is only written to selected slots, and learnable decay is applied exclusively to these updated slots, while unselected slots retain their content indefinitely without any update or decay. The Raven block requires no auxiliary convolution or sliding-window attention layers; a single RSM layer supports both persistent memory and precise recall while maintaining strict linear time complexity.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated against strong linear model baselines including Mamba-2, Gated DeltaNet (GDN), Gated Linear Attention (GLA), and SWA: (1) On Needle-in-a-Haystack benchmarks, SWA achieves near-zero recall for tokens outside its fixed window, while Raven maintains perfect recall even when extrapolating to 16x the training context length; (2) On standard language modeling, Raven matches or outperforms recent linear model variants including Mamba-2, GDN, and GLA in perplexity; (3) On recall-heavy tasks, Raven delivers substantial improvements over SWA and SSM baselines in both standalone and hybrid-with-attention configurations, with consistent results across model scales; (4) Ablations confirm independent contributions of the two core design choices: sparse routing alone with global full-state decay reduces long-term memory retention, while selective decay alone with dense full-slot writes degenerates to GLA-like behavior with significantly degraded recall.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3, which develops the unifying RSM framework, particularly the derivation that maps both SSM and SWA update rules to the same general recurrence (Equations 1 through 5). This conceptual unification is the core insight of the work, making explicit the previously implicit tradeoff in linear model memory design. Next, study the specific routing and decay implementation in Section 4, paying close attention to design choices around routing sparsity and decay scope. In experiments, focus on the length-extrapolation Needle-in-a-Haystack results and ablation studies to isolate the contribution of each design component. Open directions worth exploring include scaling behavior of routing sparsity with model size and training context length, interpretability of routing decisions (whether slots specialize to specific memory types), and more flexible memory management policies under the RSM framework (e.g., dynamic slot counts, explicit memory erasure).

recommendation.zh: 把 SSM 与 SWA 的记忆写入机制做了干净的插值，应立刻在内部长程 recall ablation 中复现，看路由稀疏度的 scaling。
recommendation.en: A clean interpolation between SSM and SWA memory writes; reproduce it in internal long-context recall ablations and watch how routed sparsity scales.

paper.title: Seen, Said, or Forgotten? A Causal Audit of Visual KV Memory Across Dialog Turns
paper.abstract: Stateful multimodal assistants encode an image once but may answer questions about it many turns later. Attention-guided visual-KV eviction assumes that evidence irrelevant now will remain dispensable, although future questions are unknown. We ask when a visual fact is actually safe to forget and introduce the Causal Visual Memory Audit (CVMA), a paired single-prefill framework that tests what later answers lose when a visual region, the whole image, or prior assistant text becomes unavailable.

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究多轮 VLM 中的视觉 KV cache 是否可以安全丢弃。具体问题是：当前轮 attention 低的视觉区域，是否真的对未来问题无用。作者指出，attention-based visual KV eviction 隐含了一个强假设：当前不重要的视觉证据，未来也不重要。但在多轮对话里，未来问题未知，这个假设经常不成立。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对 VLM 记忆机制、长上下文多模态 serving、视觉 token 压缩有启发。它把“视觉信息是否已被模型看到、是否已被说出、是否仍保存在 KV 中”拆开分析。这个拆分很重要，因为多轮 VLM 的性能下降可能来自三种不同机制：视觉证据被错误删除、后续问题其实不依赖视觉、或者视觉事实已经迁移到 assistant text KV。对做 native multimodal LM 或视觉 token 压缩的人，论文的主要价值是提供了更干净的因果审计方法，而不是提出新的压缩策略。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Causal Visual Memory Audit，简称 CVMA。它保持单次 image prefill 的 stateful trajectory，然后在同一个对话轨迹内做 paired intervention。干预对象包括特定视觉区域、整张图像对应的 KV、以及历史 assistant text KV。技术细节上，drop 操作让对应 cache 位置不可读，但保持 cache 长度、位置索引和 RoPE index 不变，从而减少位置分布变化带来的混淆。评价指标是 reference answer 内容 token 的平均 cross-entropy。作者定义了 regional future utility，用删除某个区域后未来轮次 NLL 的上升衡量该区域未来是否有用；定义 all-image dependence，用删除整张图像后的损失衡量该对话是否仍需要视觉证据；还用 random retention 和 marginal-utility retention 控制，区分“attention 代理失效”和“选择问题本身无解”。最后，通过 image-text factorial interventions 分析 assistant 输出文本能否替代已删除的视觉 KV。
summary.experiments: 主实验使用 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct BF16，因果审计还测试 Idefics3-8B-Llama3，附录中有 Qwen 3B scale check。数据包括 VisDial v1.0 validation 的 2,064 个十轮对话，以及 ConvBench 的 547 个三轮长回答对话，其中 546 个可用。完整 policy comparison 用全部样本；regional audit 在排除 72 个早期 pilot/confirmation ID 后，固定随机顺序取前 200 个样本。主要发现是：当前轮 attention 对未来区域效用的排序很差，在 VisDial 上甚至可能比随机更差；但 marginal-utility control 显示仍有选择空间，说明不是任务本身无法选择，而是 attention proxy 不适合预测未来。总体分数下降有时不大，因为很多后续轮次不依赖视觉，甚至可能因删除噪声视觉 KV 而改善。更细的 fact-level 分析显示，assistant text KV 可以替代那些已经被明确说出的视觉事实；没有说出的隐藏视觉事实是否保留，取决于模型和上下文，不稳定，也不一定能支持正确回答。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 CVMA 的 causal estimands 和 intervention 设计，尤其是如何在不改变 cache 几何结构的情况下删除视觉证据。实验部分优先看 attention ranking 与 future regional utility 的对比、all-image dependence 分桶结果、以及 image-text factorial intervention。若关注推理效率或 VLM serving，可以重点读 policy regret 和 retention budget 相关图表；若关注多模态预训练，可以关注视觉事实何时迁移到文本 KV，这对理解跨模态记忆边界更有用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when visual KV entries in a stateful multimodal assistant can be safely forgotten. The concrete question is whether visual regions that receive low attention in the current turn are truly irrelevant for future turns. The paper argues that attention-guided visual KV eviction makes a strong assumption: evidence that is not useful now will remain unnecessary later, even though future user questions are unknown.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for VLM memory analysis, multimodal long-context serving, and visual token compression. Its main contribution is to separate three mechanisms that aggregate scores usually mix together: the model may have seen a fact, the assistant may have verbalized it into text, or the visual KV that carried it may still be available. That distinction matters for native multimodal models because a small average loss after KV eviction can hide failures on visually dependent future turns.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce the Causal Visual Memory Audit, or CVMA. It keeps a single stateful trajectory in which the image is prefetched once, then applies paired interventions within the same dialog. The interventions remove access to a visual region, the entire image span, or prior assistant text KV. The drop operation preserves cache length, positions, and RoPE indices, so the intervention targets availability of evidence rather than sequence geometry. The outcome is the mean cross-entropy on reference answer content tokens. Regional future utility is measured by the loss increase after removing a region over later turns. All-image dependence measures whether the future dialog needs visual KV at all. Random and marginal-utility retention controls test whether attention is a bad proxy or whether selection is intrinsically difficult. Image–text factorial interventions then test when assistant text can replace missing visual evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct in BF16. The causal audit also includes Idefics3-8B-Llama3, with a Qwen 3B scale check in the appendix. The datasets are VisDial v1.0 validation with 2,064 ten-turn dialogs and ConvBench with 547 three-turn long-form dialogs, 546 of which are usable after excluding one degenerate reference. Full policy comparisons use all available dialogs. The regional audit removes 72 earlier pilot or confirmation IDs, shuffles the remaining set with a fixed seed, and freezes the first 200 examples. The main empirical result is that current attention can rank future-useful regions poorly, and on VisDial joint retention can be worse than random. A marginal-utility control shows that useful selection is still possible, so the issue is the proxy rather than the absence of signal. Aggregate degradation can look modest because many later turns do not require vision, and some low-dependence cases benefit from denoising. At the fact level, assistant text KV can substitute for visual KV when the fact has been stated, while unstated visual facts are not reliably recoverable.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the CVMA definitions, the intervention invariants, and the comparison between current attention and future regional utility. The most useful results are the dependence-conditioned analyses, the retention-budget regret plots, and the image–text factorial interventions. For serving and compression work, the key lesson is that low current attention is not enough evidence for irreversible visual KV deletion. For multimodal pretraining research, the useful part is the analysis of when visual facts move into text memory and when they remain dependent on image KV.

recommendation.zh: 做过多模态 KV-cache 压缩的人该看：它直接打脸"按当前注意力分数驱逐"的默认假设，只看 §3 的 CVMA 设计和 Fig 中 random vs attention 对比即可。
recommendation.en: If you work on multimodal KV-cache compression, this directly challenges the default attention-score eviction heuristic; read §3 and the random-vs-attention comparison, skip the rest.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

paper.title: HANDBOOK.md: A Benchmark for Long-Context Agentic Instruction Following
paper.abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly deployed under standing instructions: a system prompt, a policy file, or a skills document is placed in context, and the agent is trusted to let it govern every action that follows. Existing benchmarks rarely test this deployment pattern directly; they measure whether an agent can complete a task, not whether a long, binding policy document actually constrains its behavior over an extended tool-use horizon. We present HANDBOOK.md, a benchmark of 65 agentic

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent基准多测试任务完成能力，未直接评测长约束性文档（如企业手册）在长工具使用周期中对Agent行为的约束效果，不符合真实企业部署场景
summary.importance: Benchmark贡献，首次构建面向企业长手册场景的长上下文Agent指令跟随评测，覆盖多领域、多工具、长SOP约束
summary.technical_approach: 构建65个Agent任务，模拟自包含企业环境（文件工作区+邮件/聊天/日历/issue跟踪/商务服务等工具，通过MCP协议暴露），每个任务由20-124页的专家编写SOP约束，覆盖5个业务领域
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露评测模型与结果，仅提及包含65个任务，覆盖金融、医疗账单、保险、物流、HR5个领域、10个虚构公司
summary.authors_note: 作者包含Edwin Chen（前Google Brain研究员，Surge AI创始人，专注NLP评测与数据质量），所属机构未明确披露

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent benchmarks mostly measure task completion, not whether long binding policy documents reliably constrain agent behavior over extended tool-use horizons, which mismatches real enterprise deployment patterns
summary_en.importance: Benchmark contribution; first long-context agentic instruction-following benchmark modeled on enterprise handbook scenarios, covering multiple domains, tools, and long SOP constraints
summary_en.technical_approach: Includes 65 agent tasks set in self-contained company environments with file workspaces and mock email/chat/calendar/issue-tracking/commerce tools exposed via the Model Context Protocol, governed by expert-written SOPs of 20-124 pages across 5 domains
summary_en.experiments: Full model evaluation results are not disclosed in the truncated abstract; the benchmark covers 5 domains and 10 fictional companies with 65 total tasks
summary_en.authors_note: Includes Edwin Chen (ex-Google Brain, founder of Surge AI, focused on NLP evaluation and data quality); affiliated institutions not explicitly disclosed

recommendation.zh: 企业长手册场景的Agent指令跟随基准，贴近真实部署，作为评测资产备查即可，无需读正文
recommendation.en: Agent instruction-following benchmark with realistic enterprise long-handbook scenarios; keep as evaluation reference, no need to read full text

paper.title: Wonder: Video World Model Done Better
paper.abstract: We present Wonder, a general-purpose video world model for real-time, camera-controllable world exploration. Given an image or a conditional video, Wonder constructs a playable world where users can navigate interactively by moving the camera, discovering unseen regions, and revisiting previously observed areas in real time and over a long-term horizon. Achieving this capability requires a system-level co-design of control method, memory mechanism, and training strategy. We introduce a novel cam

summary.core_problem: 构建可实时交互、可由相机控制、能长期探索和回访的通用视频世界模型。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成/世界模型系统设计。它对 LLM 预训练不是直接方法贡献，但 dense camera conditioning、长程生成记忆和稀疏注意力检索，对未来统一视频-语言世界模型有可借鉴的系统信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Wonder，通过系统级协同设计把控制、记忆和训练策略结合起来。核心包括：用 dense coordinate field 作为相机条件，使模型获得空间对齐的运动和朝向线索；用稀疏 attention 记忆机制在推理时只检索少量相关上下文 token，使实际上下文增长时计算仍可控；同时配套训练策略以支持长期可导航生成。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 或量化提升。它声称支持从单张图像或条件视频生成可交互世界，用户可移动相机、探索未见区域并长期回访已见区域，目标是实时运行。
summary.authors_note: Vishal M. Patel 和 Kalyan Sunkavalli 是视觉生成、图像/视频建模方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to build a real-time, camera-controllable video world model that supports long-horizon exploration and revisiting of generated environments.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal generation and world-modeling system contribution. It is not a direct LLM pretraining method, but its camera conditioning and sparse memory design are relevant to future unified video-language world models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Wonder combines control, memory, and training strategy. It uses a dense coordinate field as camera conditioning to provide spatially aligned motion and orientation cues, and an efficient sparse-attention memory mechanism that retrieves a small set of relevant context tokens at inference time as the generation history grows.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data scale, baselines, or numerical gains. It claims support for image- or video-conditioned playable worlds with interactive camera movement, unseen-region discovery, and long-term revisiting in real time.
summary_en.authors_note: Vishal M. Patel and Kalyan Sunkavalli are recognized researchers in visual generation and image/video modeling.

recommendation.zh: 不必按 LLM 论文读；只看稀疏记忆检索如何约束长程视频生成上下文。
recommendation.en: Do not read it like an LLM paper; inspect only how sparse memory retrieval constrains long-horizon video generation context.

paper.title: A scaling law of contextual persistence in human language
paper.abstract: Human language exhibits lawful structure at the level of words (frequency, vocabulary growth) and word pairs (co-occurrence across distance). Here we show that the arrangement of words in sequence -- a central determinant of meaning -- obeys a comparable law. Using large language models as probabilistic probes, we measured the reduction in target perplexity conferred by prior context at distance d beyond that of the same words scrambled; this difference, the contextual persistence function P(d),

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“语言有长程依赖吗”，而是更细的一层：在固定词汇内容和大致话题信息之后，词序本身对未来词预测的影响，随距离如何衰减。以往 Zipf、Heaps、长程 mutual information 这些统计规律，要么只看词频，要么看词对共现，无法把“同一批词以不同顺序排列”带来的信息单独剥离出来。作者用大语言模型作为概率探针，定义 contextual persistence function, CPF：当逐步揭示更远处的真实上下文时，目标 token 的 surprisal 下降了多少；再减去把同样上下文打乱顺序后的下降量，剩下的就是纯粹由顺序结构贡献的预测增益。核心问题因此被精确定义为：自然语言中，order-specific contextual influence 是否存在稳定的距离律，以及这个律是否跨语言、跨体裁、跨模态成立。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它给“长上下文为什么有用”提供了一个比 perplexity-length curve 更干净的分解：不是单纯更多词更有用，而是有一部分收益明确来自远距离顺序结构，而且这一部分近似按 1/d 衰减。第二，这个结果为语言建模目标提供了新的诊断量。标准 next-token loss 把 lexical content、topic recurrence、order dependence 混在一起；CPF 试图把其中的 arrangement signal 单独量化，这对分析 AR LM 学到了什么、长程依赖是否真实被利用、不同架构是否更擅长保留顺序信息，都有直接启发。第三，它对 scaling law 研究有方法论价值：作者不是再拟合 loss 对 compute 的幂律，而是提出一个“语言本身的统计律”，并用 LLM 作为测量仪器去估计。这种思路对 tokenizer、masked/any-order LM、长上下文架构、memory 机制的比较都可能有用。贡献量级上，它更像一个新的测量框架和经验规律，而不是直接改变训练 recipe 的方法论文。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计的关键在于把“上下文长度效应”和“词序效应”拆开。作者对每个目标位置，构造两种上下文揭示方式：一种是 intact context，即保留原始顺序；另一种是 scrambled baseline，即把已揭示的整段上下文做置换，保留词袋和大致主题线索，但破坏局部与全局顺序。然后用预训练好的 autoregressive transformer 计算目标 span 的条件概率或等价的 token-level surprisal。随着揭示边界向更远处移动，可以得到每一段新增上下文带来的预测收益。两条曲线相减，定义为 order-specific 的边际收益；其对距离 d 的函数就是 CPF，记作 P(d)。

这个定义有几个细节值得注意。第一，作者测的是“增量收益”而不是简单比较 full-context 与 truncated-context，这样可以把不同距离段的贡献局部化。第二，scrambled baseline 不是随机替换词，而是对同一段真实词序列做 permutation，因此控制了词汇集合、词频、主题重复等因素，尽量只让顺序信息消失。第三，作者把 LLM 当作 probe，而不是研究模型本身的内部机制；也就是说，结论针对的是自然语言序列中可被强语言模型读出的统计结构。第四，论文做了多种控制：随机 token 序列、合成语料、部分扰动顺序、跨句分布分析等，用来验证这个幂律不是 tokenizer 或简单 topicality 造成的假象。

与已有工作相比，Shannon guessing / Hilberg conjecture 只研究“上下文越长，预测越准”，没有 order-ablated 对照，因此无法区分是词汇内容还是排列结构在起作用；长程 mutual information 研究的是成对依赖，也不能表达高阶有序配置。这里的创新不在模型，而在测量对象和对照设计：把 sequence arrangement 作为独立统计量来测。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖十个 written 和 spoken corpora，横跨六个 language families。主结果是 CPF 在近两数量级的距离范围内近似满足 P(d) ∝ d^-α，平均 α=1.04，标准差 0.15；拟合优度中位数 r^2=0.96。这个数字很关键，因为作者强调“law”不只看是不是 power law，更看指数是否稳定；这里指数集中在 1 附近，是其主要论据。

控制实验方面，随机打乱 token 的序列和合成控制语料上，这个效应基本消失，说明 CPF 不是 probe 的机械偏好。顺序完整性逐步破坏时，CPF 的幅度也相应下降，支持它确实在测 order-specific signal，而不是词汇重现。作者还分析了影响是否集中在少数远距离 anchor token 或特定句子边界上，结论是该效应广泛分布在前文多个句子中，而不是由极少数提示词驱动。

从论文给出的信息看，重点不是比较不同模型大小，而是比较不同语料与语言类型下的规律稳定性。也就是说，实验的说服力主要来自跨语料复现和对照设计，而不是某个 benchmark 提升多少。对做预训练的人，最有价值的实验不是主图本身，而是那些排除混杂因素的 ablation：scrambled baseline、synthetic controls、partial corruption、sentence-distributed contribution。这些实验共同支撑“1/d 衰减的是顺序信息的持续影响”这一解释。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓定义，再看控制实验。优先看 Introduction 里 CPF 的构造逻辑，弄清楚 intact vs scrambled 到底控制了什么、没控制什么。随后重点看主结果图：不同语料上 P(d) 的 log-log 曲线、指数拟合、跨语言分布。再看控制实验部分，尤其是随机序列、合成语料、顺序完整性扰动、跨句贡献分布，这些决定这个规律是否可信。

阅读时要带着两个问题。第一，scrambling 是否真的只去掉顺序，而没有引入别的分布偏移；例如局部语法破坏后，模型是否会产生额外的 calibration artifact。第二，LLM probe 的能力边界会不会影响测得的指数；如果 probe 本身长程建模不足，CPF 可能是语言规律与模型衰减的卷积。论文把模型当测量仪器，这个假设合理但并非无条件成立。预计 25–35 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读；如果关心 long-context pretrain 或 alternative LM objective，可以再细看方法定义和 discussion。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a more precise question than whether language has long-range dependence. It isolates how much predictive benefit comes from word order itself, after controlling for the presence of the same words and broad topical content, and studies how that benefit decays with distance. Prior regularities such as Zipf, Heaps, or long-range mutual information either ignore order or only capture pairwise co-occurrence. Here the authors define a contextual persistence function (CPF) using LLMs as probabilistic probes: as more distant context is revealed, how much does target surprisal drop with the intact sequence, beyond the drop obtained from the same revealed words in scrambled order? The core problem is therefore to quantify the distance law of order-specific contextual influence in natural language.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is mainly diagnostic rather than algorithmic. First, it gives a cleaner decomposition of why long context helps: some of the gain is not just more lexical evidence, but specifically ordered structure that remains useful far away and decays roughly as 1/d. Second, it introduces a measurement that separates arrangement-sensitive signal from lexical/topic signal, which is relevant for analyzing what autoregressive LMs actually exploit, whether long-context architectures preserve order information, and how alternative objectives might differ. Third, it is methodologically interesting as a scaling-law-style result about language itself rather than about loss versus compute. Using LLMs as measurement instruments to estimate a linguistic law could be useful for comparing tokenizers, memory mechanisms, masked or any-order objectives, and long-context training recipes. The contribution is best read as a new empirical law plus a probing framework, not as a direct training method.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main idea is to disentangle context-length effects from order effects. For each target position, the authors construct two reveal conditions. In the intact condition, the preceding context is revealed in its original order. In the scrambled baseline, the same revealed span is permuted, preserving the word inventory and much of the topical signal while destroying sequential arrangement. A pretrained autoregressive transformer then provides conditional probabilities, or equivalently token-level surprisal, for the target span. By extending the revealed boundary farther back, they measure the incremental predictive gain contributed by each distance range. The difference between intact and scrambled gains defines the order-specific marginal benefit, and its dependence on distance d is the CPF, P(d).

Several design choices matter. They measure incremental gain rather than only comparing full versus truncated context, which localizes contribution by distance. The baseline uses permutations of the true words rather than random replacements, so lexical content and topic recurrence are controlled as much as possible while order is removed. The LLM is treated as a probe of structure in natural language, not as the object of analysis. The paper also includes controls with random-token sequences, synthetic corpora, partial order corruption, and analyses of whether the effect is concentrated in a few anchor tokens or broadly distributed.

Relative to Shannon-style context-length studies or Hilberg-type arguments, the novelty is the counterfactual baseline. Earlier work measured the total value of longer context but could not separate lexical availability from arrangement. Mutual information studies pairwise dependence, not dependence on ordered configurations. The contribution here is therefore a measurement design for sequence arrangement as its own statistical object.
summary_en.experiments:
The study covers ten written and spoken corpora spanning six language families. The headline result is that CPF follows an approximate power law, P(d) ∝ d^-α, over nearly two orders of magnitude in distance, with mean α = 1.04, standard deviation 0.15, and median r^2 = 0.96. The concentration of the exponent near 1 is central to the claim that this is a reproducible law rather than a loose curve fit.

The control experiments are important. The effect largely disappears on scrambled or random-token controls and on synthetic corpora, which argues against the pattern being a trivial artifact of the probe. When sequential integrity is progressively degraded, CPF weakens accordingly, supporting the interpretation that it is measuring order-specific signal rather than simple lexical recurrence. The paper also reports that the contribution is broadly distributed across prior sentences rather than being dominated by a few distant anchor tokens.

The experimental strength is not a model-size sweep or benchmark gains. It comes from replication across corpora and from careful controls that rule out obvious confounds. For a pretraining reader, the most informative parts are the ablations around the scrambled baseline, synthetic controls, partial corruption, and sentence-level contribution distribution.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the definition. The key is to understand exactly what intact versus scrambled controls for, and what it does not. Then read the main result figures showing log-log CPF curves, exponent fits, and the distribution across languages and corpora. After that, spend time on the control sections: random or synthetic sequences, partial order corruption, and analyses of whether the signal is sentence-local or broadly spread.

Two questions are worth keeping in mind. First, does scrambling remove only order, or does it also create a distribution shift that changes model calibration in other ways? Second, how much is the measured exponent a property of language versus a property of the probe model’s own long-range limitations? Treating an LLM as a measuring instrument is reasonable, but it is still an assumption. A useful skim should take around 25–35 minutes; if your interests are long-context pretraining or alternative language modeling objectives, the method definition and discussion deserve a closer read.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不直接教你怎么训模型，但它给了长程依赖一个很干净的统计量；先看 P(d) 定义和 controls，若成立，会影响你对长上下文衰减先验的设定。
recommendation.en: It does not tell you how to train a model, but it gives a clean statistic for long-range dependence; read the P(d) definition and controls first, because if it holds, it should update your prior on context-decay assumptions.

paper.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
paper.abstract: We introduce Kimi K3, a 2.8T parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 104 billion activated parameters, native vision capabilities, and a 1-million-token context window. Kimi K3 is built on Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals, which improve information flow across sequence length and model depth. Together with Stable LatentMoE, which effectively activates 16 of 896 routed experts per token, and refined training and data recipes, these advances yield an approximately 2.5x improvement in o

summary.core_problem: Kimi K3 试图解决的是一个更完整的前沿基座问题：当开源模型已经普遍把重心放到 test-time scaling、RL 和推理链条上时，预训练底座本身仍停留在 1T 左右参数级别，导致后续 RL 和 agentic post-training 的上限被基础容量、长上下文信息流和训练稳定性共同限制。K3 的目标不是单点改进，而是在 2.8T 级别 MoE、1M context、原生多模态和长轨迹 RL 这几个维度同时推进，并且把这些维度做成一个能训练、能对齐、能部署的统一系统。
summary.importance: 这篇技术报告对预训练研究的价值很高，主要因为它给出了一个 3T-class 开源底座如何被真正训练出来的较完整配方。重要性有三层。第一，它不是单纯堆参数，而是把长序列建模、深层信息流、极稀疏 MoE 稳定性、数据与训练 recipe 放在一起，声称相对 Kimi K2 获得约 2.5× 的整体 scaling efficiency 提升，这对大模型 scaling 研究是实打实的信号。第二，它把 pretrain 和 post-train 明确连成闭环：预训练底座为 1M context 的 agentic RL 服务，而 RL 又通过多 effort level、多教师 on-policy distillation 回灌到统一模型。第三，它展示了前沿模型里 architecture、systems、RL infrastructure 已经很难分开看；如果只研究其中一个局部，往往解释不了最终能力和成本曲线。
summary.technical_approach: 技术路线可以拆成四块。第一块是长上下文与深层信息流。Kimi Delta Attention 负责长序列混合，周期性插入 Gated MLA 层保留全局交互；这说明他们没有完全放弃 attention，而是用更便宜的序列混合主干配合稀疏的全局 attention 校正。Attention Residuals 则让每层可以选择性访问所有前层表示，缓解超深网络中的信息衰减与优化困难。第二块是超大规模稀疏 MoE。K3 使用 Stable LatentMoE，把 routed expert 空间扩到 896 个，每个 token 激活 16 个 expert，外加 shared expert。这里的难点不是 MoE 结构本身，而是极高稀疏度下的训练稳定性与负载均衡。报告提到用 normalization、SiTU-GLU 和 Quantile Balancing 来稳定路由与激活分布，目标是既扩大专家容量，又避免 router collapse、负载失衡和训练震荡。第三块是训练与数据 recipe。公开文本里没有把所有数据细节完全展开，但明确把 refined data and training recipes 作为 2.5× scaling efficiency 的组成部分，而不是把收益全部归因于架构。这一点很重要，因为大模型报告常把数据因素弱化。第四块是 post-training 与基础设施协同。RL 覆盖 general、agentic、coding 和多种 reasoning effort level，训练环境包括可验证搜索、专业知识工作、软件工程、kernel optimization、vision-in-the-loop 工具使用、persistent assistant workflow 等。不同领域和 effort 的策略最后通过 multi-teacher on-policy distillation 合并到统一模型。系统侧则分别为 KDA、2.8T MoE 预训练、百万 token agentic RL 和 serving 做了专门设计：如 fused kernels、KDA context parallelism、state-aware prefix caching、MoonEP 的静态 shape 与零拷贝通信、外部 KV 保留、partial rollout、可恢复 microVM sandbox 等。这里最值得注意的是，他们把“能否训练和运行长轨迹 RL”当成模型设计的一部分，而不是后处理问题。
summary.experiments: 从报告给出的关键信息看，模型规模是 2.8T total parameters、104B activated parameters、1M token context，并且是 native vision model。作者声称相对 Kimi K2，整体 scaling efficiency 提升约 2.5×。这个数字不是单一 benchmark 提升，而是综合 architecture、MoE 稳定化、数据和训练 recipe 后，在同等计算下获得更好能力或在同等能力下节省计算。评测覆盖 long-horizon coding、agentic、knowledge、reasoning 和 vision，多数公开对比里 Kimi K3 整体落后于最强闭源系统 Claude Fable 5 与 GPT-5.6 Sol，但稳定领先其余被纳入套件的开源与闭源模型。对预训练研究者更有价值的不是榜单名次，而是几个结构性信号：一，16-of-896 这种极稀疏激活在 104B active 规模上仍可稳定训练；二，1M context 不是只靠推理时外插，而是与架构和 RL 轨迹长度一起设计；三，多 effort RL 与 agentic 训练被视为统一模型能力的一部分，而非单独外挂。若全文中有更细的消融，重点应看 KDA 与 Gated MLA 的配比、AttnRes 对深层训练稳定性的影响、Stable LatentMoE 相比常规 top-k MoE 的负载与 loss 曲线、以及数据 recipe 对 scaling curve 的贡献拆分。
summary.reading_guide: 精读建议按三条线走。第一条线看架构章节和总览图，先搞清 KDA、Gated MLA、AttnRes、Stable LatentMoE 在 block 内如何组合，尤其要看为什么长序列 mixing、全局 attention 和跨层残差要同时存在，而不是只押一个机制。第二条线看训练与系统章节，重点找 2.8T MoE 的稳定性细节：router 设计、负载均衡、激活分布、并行策略、MoonEP 的静态 shape 与通信路径。这部分对真正做大规模预训练最有参考价值。第三条线看 post-training 与 RL infrastructure，关注 1M context 长轨迹是如何被环境、缓存和 rollout 机制支撑起来的，以及 multi-teacher on-policy distillation 如何把多 effort policy 合并。图表上优先看 scaling efficiency 对比、长上下文能力曲线、MoE 负载统计、以及 RL 训练后不同任务簇的收益。若时间有限，先读 Introduction、architecture overview、systems/pretraining sections，再挑 RL consolidation 部分。完整读下来大约需要 1.5 到 2.5 小时，因为它不是单一方法论文，而是一个大系统的技术说明。
summary.authors_note: Moonshot AI / Kimi 团队技术报告。公开署名通常为 Kimi Research 或 Moonshot AI 多作者协作，核心背景是长上下文、MoE、agentic RL 与系统联合设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Kimi K3 addresses a broader frontier problem than a single architectural tweak. Open models have recently advanced quickly in test-time scaling, RL, and reasoning, but many pretraining foundations remain around the 1T-parameter regime. That limits the ceiling of downstream RL and agentic training. K3 aims to push several constraints at once: a 2.8T-class MoE foundation, 1M-token context, native multimodality, and long-horizon RL, while keeping the whole stack trainable and deployable.
summary_en.importance: This report matters because it provides a relatively complete recipe for how an open 3T-class foundation is actually built. Its importance comes in three layers. First, it is not just parameter scaling. The report combines long-sequence modeling, deep information flow, extremely sparse MoE stabilization, and data/training recipe refinements, and attributes an overall ~2.5x scaling-efficiency gain over Kimi K2 to that combination. That is directly relevant to scaling-law and systems-aware pretraining research. Second, it treats pretraining and post-training as one loop: the foundation is designed for 1M-context agentic RL, and RL capabilities are later consolidated back into a unified model through multi-teacher on-policy distillation. Third, it shows that at this scale, architecture, infrastructure, and RL systems cannot be studied in isolation if one wants to understand the final capability-cost tradeoff.
summary_en.technical_approach: The technical design has four major pieces. First is long-context and deep information flow. Kimi Delta Attention serves as the main long-sequence mixing mechanism, while Gated MLA layers are periodically interleaved to preserve global interaction. This suggests they do not fully abandon attention; instead they use a cheaper sequence-mixing backbone plus sparse global correction. Attention Residuals let each layer selectively access representations from all previous layers, which is meant to reduce information decay and optimization difficulty in very deep networks. Second is ultra-large sparse MoE. K3 uses Stable LatentMoE with 896 routed experts and 16 activated experts per token, plus shared experts. The challenge here is not the MoE idea itself but stable optimization and balanced routing under extreme sparsity. The report highlights normalization, SiTU-GLU, and Quantile Balancing as the stabilizers that keep routing and activation distributions under control. Third is the training and data recipe. The public text does not fully expose all data details, but it explicitly includes refined data and training recipes as part of the claimed efficiency gain rather than attributing everything to architecture. That is an important signal. Fourth is post-training and infrastructure co-design. RL spans general reasoning, agentic tasks, coding, and multiple reasoning-effort levels. Training environments include verifiable search, professional knowledge work, software engineering, kernel optimization, multimodal tool use, persistent assistant workflows, and autonomous execution. These specialized policies are later merged through multi-teacher on-policy distillation. On the systems side, the report introduces fused kernels, KDA context parallelism, state-aware prefix caching, MoonEP for perfectly balanced expert execution with static shapes and zero-copy communication, plus external KV retention, partial rollouts, and resumable microVM sandboxes for million-token agentic RL. A notable design choice is that long-horizon RL support is treated as part of the model stack, not as an afterthought.
summary_en.experiments: The key reported scales are 2.8T total parameters, 104B activated parameters, 1M-token context, and native vision capability. The headline claim is an approximately 2.5x improvement in overall scaling efficiency over Kimi K2. This is not a single benchmark delta; it is presented as a combined effect of architecture, MoE stabilization, and refined data/training recipes. Evaluation spans long-horizon coding, agentic tasks, knowledge, reasoning, and vision. In the authors’ benchmark suite, Kimi K3 trails the strongest proprietary systems, Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol, but is reported to be consistently ahead of the other open and proprietary models included there. For pretraining researchers, the more important signals are structural: 16-of-896 sparse activation appears trainable at 104B active scale; 1M context is designed jointly with architecture and RL trajectory length rather than treated as pure inference extrapolation; and multi-effort RL is integrated into the unified model rather than exposed as a separate specialist policy. If the full report contains detailed ablations, the most valuable ones to inspect are the KDA versus Gated MLA mix, the effect of Attention Residuals on optimization at depth, the load and loss behavior of Stable LatentMoE versus standard top-k MoE, and the contribution of data recipe changes to the scaling curve.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read it along three tracks. First, study the architecture overview and block diagrams to understand how KDA, Gated MLA, Attention Residuals, and Stable LatentMoE are composed, and why the design keeps all three forms of information flow: along sequence length, across depth, and across expert width. Second, read the pretraining and systems sections carefully, especially the details around MoE stability, routing balance, parallelism, MoonEP, and communication design. That is where much of the practical value lies for anyone training very large sparse models. Third, read the post-training and RL infrastructure sections to see how million-token trajectories are made feasible and how multi-effort policies are consolidated. Prioritize figures on scaling efficiency, long-context performance, MoE load statistics, and RL gains by task family. If time is limited, start with the introduction, architecture overview, and pretraining/systems sections, then sample the RL consolidation part. A full careful read likely takes 1.5 to 2.5 hours because this is a large-stack technical report rather than a narrow method paper.
summary_en.authors_note: Moonshot AI / Kimi technical report. Public authorship is typically listed under Kimi Research or a large Moonshot AI collaboration, with background spanning long-context modeling, sparse MoE training, agentic RL, and systems co-design.

recommendation.zh: 国内一线 MoE 旗舰的训练与 RL 基建披露，KDA+LatentMoE+百万 token agentic RL 的组合值得对照自家 scaling 表和路由稳定性实验马上复现思路。
recommendation.en: A flagship MoE report from a top Chinese lab; cross-check their KDA + LatentMoE + 1M-token agentic RL stack against your own scaling tables and routing stability ablations right away.

paper.title: PIVOT: Efficient Query-Group Indexing for Token-Level Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Token-level sparse attention, as implemented by DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) in production systems, makes the downstream attention efficient but shifts the bottleneck to the indexer that feeds it. To select the top-k tokens for each query, the indexer must still score every preceding token, incurring a cost of O(L^2) per layer for a sequence of length L. summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 token-level sparse attention 在真实长上下文推理里的一个新瓶颈：主注意力已经从全量 attention 降到只看 top-k token，但用于选出这 top-k 的 indexer 仍然要对每个 query 扫完整个前缀，单层复杂度还是 O(L^2)。论文抓住的不是 token 轴、head 轴或 layer 轴，而是 query 轴上的冗余：相邻 query 往往会选到高度重合的 top-k token，因此没必要为每个 query 各做一次完整前缀扫描。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练方法本身，而在长上下文 serving 与稀疏注意力落地。很多稀疏 attention 方案论文里看起来便宜，真正上线时却被索引阶段拖住，这篇工作把瓶颈拆得很清楚，也给出一个不改模型、不重训、可直接替换的方案。它的价值主要有两点：第一，说明 sparse attention 的效率分析不能只看 downstream attention kernel，还要把 candidate selection 算进去；第二，提出 query-group 共享索引这一条独立于 token/head/layer 压缩的新轴，对后续训练期联合设计也有启发，比如是否可以在预训练中显式鼓励局部 query 的检索一致性，从而让这类近似更稳。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接，也很工程化。PIVOT 的核心是把一组相邻 query 合成一个 proxy query，只做一次 full-prefix traversal，然后把这次扫描得到的高分 token 作为整组共享候选集。之后再分两种变体。PIVOT-Refine 会让组内每个 query 只在这个小候选集上重新打分，再取自己的 top-k；这样把原本每个 query 的 O(L) 扫描改成 O(c)，其中 k < c << L。PIVOT-Reuse 更激进，直接把 proxy query 的 top-k 复用给整组 query，连 per-query refine 都省掉。复杂度上，g 个 query 的索引成本从 O(gL) 变成 Refine 的 O(L + gc) 或 Reuse 的 O(L)。论文成立的经验基础有两个：一是相邻 query 的 top-k overlap 很高；二是 indexer score 沿 key 轴呈长尾分布，所以只要 c 比 k 稍大，通常就能覆盖组内大部分真正需要的 token。实现上它保持 DSA 接口不变，下游 Sparse MLA 完全不用改，因此是 drop-in replacement。prefill 阶段按固定组大小分组；decode 阶段则直接利用 multi-token prediction 同一步产生的 d+1 个 token 作为一组，因此能和 MTP 的加速叠加。方法的关键取舍也很清楚：Refine 更稳，Reuse 更便宜；组越大，摊薄越明显，但候选覆盖风险也会上升。
summary.experiments: 论文在 DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GLM-5.1 上做了 LongBench 与 RULER 评测，结论是 Refine 基本能维持与原始 dense DSA indexer 相当的精度，同时显著降低索引开销。文中给出的代表性结果是：在长上下文场景下，indexer operator 最多可加速 4×，端到端延迟最多降低 1.6×。问题背景里的一个数字也很关键：在 200K context 时，原始 indexer 可占 prefill 延迟约 81%，decode 延迟约 41%，这解释了为什么只优化 attention kernel 不够。实验重点不是绝对任务分数提升，而是 accuracy-latency tradeoff：PIVOT-Refine 在较小候选预算下就能接近基线，说明 query-group 的 top-k union 远小于最坏情况 gk；PIVOT-Reuse 则进一步换取速度，但更依赖 query 相似性。消融的核心变量应包括 group size g、candidate size c、Refine vs Reuse、prefill 与 decode 两阶段差异，以及不同长上下文长度下的收益变化。全文给人的信息是：收益主要来自把重复 prefix scan 摊薄，而不是改写下游稀疏 attention 算子。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 2。Figure 2 基本给出了整篇成立的证据：相邻 query 的 top-k overlap 高，而且组内 top-k 并集增长很慢。然后看方法部分里 proxy query 的构造方式、candidate set 的选取、Refine 与 Reuse 的复杂度对比。实验部分重点看三类结果：一是 indexer latency 与 end-to-end latency 的拆分；二是不同 g、c 下的精度保持情况；三是 prefill 和 decode 是否都稳定受益。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主要内容。如果只想判断是否值得跟进，实现接口兼容性和 MTP 结合方式最值得看，因为这决定了它是不是一个真实可部署的方案。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical bottleneck in token-level sparse attention. Even if the downstream attention only attends to top-k tokens, the indexer still scores every prefix token for every query, so indexing remains O(L^2) per layer. The key observation is that this work does not reduce cost along the token, head, or layer axis; it attacks redundancy along the query axis. Nearby queries often retrieve highly overlapping top-k tokens, so running a full prefix scan for each query is wasteful.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is mainly on long-context inference and sparse-attention deployment rather than pretraining itself. Many sparse-attention designs look efficient on paper but hide a dense retrieval stage that dominates latency in production. This paper is useful because it makes that hidden cost explicit and proposes a training-free replacement. Two takeaways matter. First, sparse-attention efficiency should be evaluated end-to-end, including candidate selection. Second, query-group shared indexing is an orthogonal optimization axis, which may later inform training-time co-design, for example by encouraging local retrieval consistency so that such approximations become more reliable.
summary_en.technical_approach: PIVOT groups nearby queries and replaces multiple full-prefix scans with one shared scan. A group is aggregated into a single proxy query, which traverses the prefix once and selects a shared candidate set of size c. Then there are two variants. PIVOT-Refine rescoring: each query re-scores only the shared candidate set and picks its own top-k. This changes per-query work from O(L) to O(c), where k < c << L. PIVOT-Reuse is cheaper: it directly reuses the proxy top-k for all queries in the group, skipping per-query refinement. For a group of size g, indexing cost drops from O(gL) to O(L + gc) for Refine or O(L) for Reuse. The method relies on two empirical properties shown in the paper: high top-k overlap among nearby queries, and long-tailed indexer scores along the key axis, so a candidate budget only slightly above k is often enough. Importantly, PIVOT preserves the DSA interface and leaves the downstream Sparse MLA operator unchanged, making it a drop-in replacement. In prefill, groups are formed by contiguous query positions; in decode, the d+1 tokens from one multi-token prediction step form a natural group, so PIVOT composes with MTP speedups.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5.1 with LongBench and RULER. The main result is not better task quality but a better accuracy-latency tradeoff. PIVOT-Refine largely matches the dense DSA indexer in accuracy while reducing indexing cost substantially. The headline numbers are up to 4x speedup for the indexer operator and up to 1.6x end-to-end latency reduction at long context. A key motivating number from the paper is that at 200K context, the original indexer can account for about 81% of prefill latency and 41% of decode latency. The important ablations are group size g, candidate size c, Refine versus Reuse, and behavior in prefill versus decode. The evidence suggests that the gain comes from amortizing repeated prefix scans, not from changing the sparse attention kernel itself.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and Figure 2. Those plots carry the central empirical claim: neighboring queries have high top-k overlap, and the union of their top-k sets grows much more slowly than the worst-case gk. Then read the method section for proxy-query construction, candidate selection, and the complexity difference between Refine and Reuse. In experiments, focus on latency breakdowns, quality retention under different g and c, and whether gains hold in both prefill and decode. Around 20 to 30 minutes is enough for a solid skim. If deciding whether it is deployable, pay most attention to interface compatibility and how it leverages MTP during decode.

recommendation.zh: DeepSeek生产级稀疏注意力的索引优化，思路巧妙且训练无关，做长上下文/高效注意力的研究员应重点看其分组共享扫描的设计。
recommendation.en: DeepSeek's production-grade sparse attention index optimization, clever and training-free; researchers on long-context/efficient attention should study its group-shared scan design.

paper.title: Compute Globally, Materialize Locally: The Memory Contract of Sparse Event-KV
paper.abstract: Long-horizon agents increasingly reuse their KV cache as memory: a serving system keeps a subset of cached entries and drops the rest. Eviction and episodic-memory schemes therefore rest on a premise rarely tested directly, that a retained event is still informative once the observations that produced it are gone. We test it by omitting one earlier observation from what is served, across otherwise identical agent histories. Among items sensitive to that observation, the answer overwhelmingly fol

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“KV cache 能不能当记忆”这种泛问题，而是一个更细、更关键的 serving 问题：当系统只保留一小部分历史事件对应的 KV 行、并把真正写入信息的源事件删掉之后，被保留的下游事件 KV 是否仍然携带了由已删除上游观测计算出来的状态。作者把这个现象定义为 semantic materialization。核心难点在于，普通准确率无法区分三种来源：答案是否直接写在保留文本里、模型是否靠先验或排除法猜对、还是 KV 行里真的保留了不可见的上游状态。论文因此设计了 donor-pair 因果对照：两段历史在所有被服务的 token 与位置上完全一致，只改变一个已被删除的源事件中的值，看最终回答是否跟着这个被删值变化。这样测到的就是“被保留 KV 行是否独立承载了已消失输入的计算结果”。
summary.importance: 对长上下文 agent、episodic memory、KV eviction、cache-backed memory 这条线，这篇工作的意义在于把一个常被默认成立的前提单独测了出来：保留下来的 KV 行不只代表它们可见文本，还可能携带来自已删除上下文的隐式状态。于是，很多“删掉源事件后性能不降”的结论并不能说明源事件不重要，只能说明某个下游 KV 块已经把信息写穿过去了。这会直接影响 memory policy 的评估方式、cache eviction 的解释、以及长期 agent 里‘记忆单元’应该如何设计。更进一步，作者还说明这种写入不是纯自然涌现、也不是稳定通道，而是一个可编程但容量有限、checkpoint 相关、表面形式敏感的机制。对做预训练和架构的人，这提示了一个值得认真看的方向：Transformer 预填充阶段会把部分中间计算压进后续 token 表示里，而 serving 时这些表示可能成为一种比文本更强、但也更脆弱的记忆接口。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上最重要的是把“语义写入”从普通上下文利用中剥离出来。作者把 agent 历史表示成事件序列，一次 global prefill 后，每个事件的 KV 都已经被其前文上下文化。随后 serving 只取一个子集，故意删掉真正包含答案的 source event，只保留一个 downstream root event；这个 root event 的文本只引用 source，例如“ M mirrors S ”，但不显式说出值。若此时模型仍能回答 M 的状态，而且答案随 donor pair 中被删 source 的值切换，就说明 root 的 KV 行中已经 materialize 了上游状态。

论文围绕三个维度建立了“memory contract”。第一是 trigger：什么样的表面构造能触发写入。作者做了 16 种构造 bank，发现语义相近并不够，表面形式差异会让 write-through 从接近随机到 0.95 不等，说明 materialization 不是抽象语义层面自动成立，而是强依赖 checkpoint 对特定句式和关系模式的内部编码。第二是 landing：写入后的状态主要落在哪些被保留行里。结果显示 root event 承载主导 donor-aligned 信号，而某些 reference edge 更多像路由器，帮助查询回到 root；同时单个 row 的可读出内容还依赖 co-served 上下文，说明这不是一个完全局部、上下文无关的存储单元。第三是 access：这个通道能承载多大 payload。作者发现它更像紧凑状态通道，而不是通用信息通道：二元状态恢复明显高于随机，但 4-way、8-way 多分类接近机会水平，三位数字 payload 基本读不出来。

另一个关键贡献是“programmable carrier”。作者不满足于被动观察自然 mention，而是构造一种刻意书写、但不直接泄露答案的 carrier event，用来把上游状态写进后续表示。这个 carrier 能把 donor-aligned recovery 从 6% 提到 51%；在固定 query 位置上，只是把这个 carrier 与共享 downstream row 一起服务，就能把读出从 0.00 提到 0.42。这里的含义很直接：如果系统知道某类状态在未来可能需要、但原始操作数会被 eviction，那么可以在写时显式制造一个“承载事件”来提高后续可读性。不过作者也很克制，指出自然文本中的被动 harvesting 并不是可靠接口，真正工程上稳妥的做法仍然是保留显式 textual record 作为 fallback。
summary.experiments:
最关键的结果来自 donor-pair 因果测试。在 Qwen3-8B 上，针对 donor-sensitive items，最终回答对被删除 source value 与其对照值的跟随比达到 99:0，而被服务文本中没有任何 span 明说哪个值正确。这基本排除了“看见答案文本”的解释，也大幅压低了纯猜测解释。

在可编程写入实验里，作者构造 answer-free carrier 后，Qwen3-8B 上 donor-aligned recovery 从 6% 提升到 51%。更细一点，在固定 query position 的设置下，给同一个 downstream row 旁边加上 carrier，读出分数从 0.00 提高到 0.42，说明 materialization 不是只存在于某个单点 token，而是能通过额外承载事件显著改变可服务状态。

触发条件实验用了 16 种 construction bank。作者报告这些构造在表面理解上平均可被模型正确读取到 0.98，但真正 write-through 效果从 chance 到 0.95 波动很大，而且没有任何一种构造在三种近期模型上都稳定属于强写入类。这说明“模型理解了句子”与“模型把状态写进后续 KV”不是一回事。

容量边界实验也很有信息量。二元状态恢复达到 0.934，对比随机基线 0.5 明显更高；但 4-way、8-way payload 基本靠近各自 chance rate，三位数字 payload 则几乎完全缺失。这个结果把现象从“神秘记忆”拉回到更可信的解释：模型能把少量、压缩过的判别状态写进后续表示，但远不是任意信息都能无损搬运。

论文还做了 landing 和 co-serving 相关分析，显示 root event 是主要承载体，而 reference edge 更像访问路径的一部分；同时同一 row 的可读出性依赖与哪些其他 span 一起被服务。这对 cache eviction 很重要，因为它意味着“保留哪一行”不是独立决策，组合也会改变可恢复信息。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓住实验设计，再看边界条件。优先看 Introduction 里 donor-pair 的定义和 Fig.1，这里把问题设定得很清楚：比较对象不是文本 span，而是被独立服务的 KV block。然后看 §3，理解 99:0 这个主结果是怎么排除文本泄露、先验猜测和 decoy elimination 的。作者专门强调 decoy 要独立采样，这一点值得注意，因为很多类似实验会被“排除错误选项”伪装成“记住正确答案”。

接着看 §4 到 §6。§4 讲 trigger，适合快速建立直觉：materialization 对表面形式很敏感，不能把它当成稳定 API。§5 讲 landing 和 co-serving，适合做系统的人看，因为它直接关系到 memory selection policy。§6 讲 access envelope，是判断这个机制工程上能不能用的关键部分。若时间有限，先读这三节的图表和结论段，再回头看方法细节。

最后看 §7 和附录 F。§7 讨论 programmable carrier 与 passive harvesting 的差别，是整篇最接近工程启示的部分。附录 F 讨论“删源事件不掉点”为什么不能证明源事件没用，这对解读很多 memory ablation 很有帮助。预计 30–45 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读；如果你做 KV memory、long-horizon agent 或 cache eviction，建议把 donor-pair 设计和 access boundary 两部分精读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper isolates a serving-time question that is usually assumed but rarely tested directly: if a system keeps only a subset of historical KV blocks and evicts the original source observation, can a retained downstream event still carry state computed from that missing source? The authors call this semantic materialization. The hard part is measurement. Raw accuracy cannot tell whether the model succeeds because the answer is explicitly present in the served text, because it guesses from priors or decoy elimination, or because the retained KV rows genuinely encode hidden upstream state. To separate these cases, the paper uses a donor-pair causal comparison: two histories are byte-identical on all served tokens and positions, and differ only in the value written by an earlier source event that is later omitted from serving. If the final answer tracks that omitted value, the retained downstream KV must be carrying information beyond visible text.
summary_en.importance: This matters for long-horizon agents, episodic memory, and KV-eviction systems because it changes how memory ablations should be interpreted. If dropping a source event does not hurt downstream accuracy, that does not prove the source was unnecessary; it may only mean that some retained downstream KV block had already absorbed the relevant state during prefill. That is a different claim, and a much stronger one than text retrieval can support.
