The paper therefore sharpens the evaluation target for cache-backed memory systems: row selection is not equivalent to text selection. For pretraining and architecture work, the broader implication is that causal prefill can compress some intermediate computation into later token representations, creating a serving interface that is stronger than raw text but also fragile, checkpoint-specific, and capacity-limited.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main methodological contribution is a clean causal probe for hidden state transfer through KV. The history is modeled as a sequence of events. After one global prefill, each event’s KV is contextualized by everything before it. Serving then keeps only a subset of event blocks, deliberately dropping the source event that contains the value of interest while retaining a downstream root event whose text refers to the source but does not restate the value. If the model can still answer the query and the answer flips with the omitted source value across donor pairs, the retained root KV has materialized upstream-derived state.

The paper organizes the phenomenon into a three-part contract: trigger, landing, and access. Trigger asks which surface constructions actually induce write-through. The authors build a 16-construction bank and show that semantic equivalence is not enough: constructions that are all easy to read can differ dramatically in whether they cause state to be written into downstream representations. This means materialization is sensitive to form, not just meaning, and must be calibrated per checkpoint. Landing asks where the donor-aligned signal resides once the source is gone. The dominant signal lands in the root event, while some served reference edges mostly help route the query back to that root. Importantly, what a row yields depends on what other spans are co-served with it, so the retained row is not a context-free storage cell. Access asks how much information this channel can carry. The answer is: only compact state. Binary payloads are recoverable well above chance, but larger discrete payloads collapse toward chance, and multi-digit values are absent.

A particularly useful part is the programmable carrier construction. Instead of passively harvesting naturally occurring mentions, the authors intentionally write an answer-free carrier event designed to commit upstream state into later representations without explicitly naming the value. This substantially improves donor-aligned recovery. The engineering message is concrete: if a system expects some state to be needed after its operands are evicted, it may be possible to write that state forward on purpose. But the paper is careful not to oversell this. Passive natural mentions are not a reliable interface, and explicit textual records remain the robust fallback.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result is the donor-pair test on Qwen3-8B. Among donor-sensitive items, the model’s answer follows the omitted source value at a 99:0 ratio, even though no served span states which value is correct. That is the central evidence that retained KV rows can expose hidden upstream-derived state independently of visible text.

The programmable-carrier experiment is the most actionable systems result. On Qwen3-8B, an intentionally written answer-free carrier raises donor-aligned recovery from 6% to 51%. In a fixed query-position setup, adding the carrier alongside a shared downstream row moves the readout from 0.00 to 0.42. This shows that materialization is not merely an accidental property of one token position; it can be strengthened by writing a better downstream carrier.

The trigger study uses a 16-construction bank. Average read correctness of the constructions is reported at 0.98, but write-through ranges from chance to 0.95, and no construction is consistently strong across all three recent models tested. This is an important negative result: understanding a relation in text does not imply that the model will commit the resulting state into later KV in a way that survives source eviction.

The access-boundary experiments are also informative. Binary state recovers at 0.934 versus a 0.5 chance baseline, but 4-way and 8-way payloads sit near chance, and three-digit payloads are effectively absent. That sharply limits the interpretation of the phenomenon: it is a compact-state channel, not a general-purpose hidden memory bus.

Additional analyses on landing and co-serving show that the root event carries the dominant donor-aligned signal, while reference edges mostly help access it. The recoverability of a row also depends on which other spans are served together, which matters directly for eviction policy design.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the setup, not the claims. Read the introduction and Fig. 1 carefully until the donor-pair comparison is fully clear. The key object is the independently served KV block of a downstream event, not the visible text span itself. Then read Section 3, where the 99:0 result is established and the paper explains how it avoids confounds such as explicit answer leakage, priors, and decoy elimination. The note about independently sampled decoys is worth attention because many memory-style evaluations quietly fail there.

After that, Sections 4 to 6 are the core. Section 4 is about trigger sensitivity and is the fastest way to understand why this is not a stable semantic API. Section 5 is the most relevant part for systems and memory-policy work because it studies where the signal lands and how co-serving changes what can be read out. Section 6 gives the capacity boundary, which is essential if you want to judge whether the mechanism is practically usable.

If time is limited, read the figures and conclusion paragraphs of Sections 3–6 first, then return to the methodological details. Section 7 is the engineering takeaway: programmable carriers versus passive harvesting. Appendix F is worth a quick pass because it explains why “dropping the source causes no loss” is not evidence that the source was unnecessary. A useful skim takes about 30–45 minutes; if you work on KV memory, long-horizon agents, or cache eviction, the donor-pair design and the access-boundary analysis deserve a closer read.

recommendation.zh: 这个结果会改变 KV eviction 的默认心智模型；先看 omission setup，再决定是否内部复现实验。
recommendation.en: This shifts the default mental model for KV eviction; read the omission setup first and consider an internal replication.

paper.title: Eviction as Estimation: A Fixed-Lag Smoothing View of Test-Time Memory, and When Measuring Beats Accumulating
paper.abstract: A language model with a bounded working memory must repeatedly decide which stored items to keep. Every deployed method decides the moment an item arrives, from the past (StreamingLLM, H2O) or from a guess about the future (SnapKV). We recast the choice as an estimation problem on a hidden signal, whether an item will be reused, placing existing methods on one axis, the commit lag $H$: online filters and learned predictors commit at $H=0$, while Belady's offline optimum sits where the whole futu

summary.core_problem: 长上下文/流式推理下，KV-cache 或工作记忆有硬预算时，如何做“保留/驱逐（eviction）”决策：把驱逐视为对“未来是否会复用”的隐藏信号做估计，并提出一个介于在线策略与离线最优（Belady）之间的固定滞后（fixed-lag smoothing）框架，回答‘什么时候测量近未来使用情况比预测更好’。
summary.importance:
对预训练不是直接贡献，但对长上下文推理与服务侧 memory 管理很有方法论价值：
- 提供一个统一坐标轴（commit lag H）把 StreamingLLM/H2O/学习式预测（SnapKV 等）与 Belady 放到同一条线上，便于讨论“信息可得性 vs 决策时机”的本质差异。
- 提出 demonstrated utility 这种“无标注、从模型自身注意力与 next-token 正确性读出”的近未来使用信号，作为把 Belady 思想迁移到神经缓存的桥。
- 结论比较克制：框架成立，但在独立基准上 RMM 只能做到 H2O 水平甚至更差；这对研究者很重要，因为它明确了适用边界：只有当复用是内生的、且在时间上有间隔时，fixed-lag 的‘测量’才可能胜过‘累计注意力/即时预测’。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 估计论视角：把每个缓存项 x 的“潜在效用”u(x)（保留它能降低未来损失的程度）当作隐藏状态；驱逐策略就是对 u(x) 的估计 û(x)。
2) 关键轴：commit lag H。现有方法几乎都在到达时立刻决定（H=0）：
- filtering：只用过去信息（如 recency、累计 attention）。
- prediction：用模型预测未来会不会用到。
Belady 是 H→∞ 的离线最优，需要完整未来请求序列。
3) fixed-lag smoothing：延迟 H 步再决定是否保留/驱逐，让“是否被复用”的证据从不可观测变为可观测（至少部分可观测）。代价是需要一个缓冲区与额外延迟。
4) Belady bridge：在神经注意力里没有显式 request stream，作者定义 demonstrated utility：从模型在近未来 token 预测中实际使用了哪些 KV（注意力分配）以及这些预测是否正确，构造一种无标注的‘被请求’信号。
5) 算法产物：RMM（training-free policy），被描述为 H2O 的严格泛化；并额外训练一个小模型去预测“我们随后将测量的排序”（用于更好地组织 fixed-lag 的测量/决策）。
6) 负结果与边界：当任务是单次长文阅读、复用不呈现清晰的时间分离时，fixed-lag 的测量会退化为累计注意力，策略等价/接近 H2O；在作者设计的 streaming/复用分离场景里机制更成立。
summary.experiments:
论文把证据分成两类：
- 受控实验（为隔离机制而构造）：RMM 能更贴近离线 oracle（Belady 风格），而纯过滤类方法会退化；用于证明 fixed-lag smoothing 在“复用内生且有时间间隔”的设定下确实能利用到额外信息。
- 独立基准（第三方 harness + 其自带 baselines）：RMM 与 H2O 大致同级，未稳定超过；在其目标 streaming 设定下甚至输给 H2O 与 SnapKV。作者把这作为核心结论之一，并在后文解释原因。
- 由于给出的全文片段未包含具体 benchmark 名称、K 值、H 值扫描曲线与精确数值，这里不复述数字；精读时应重点核对 Section 7/8 的曲线与统计设置。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟，信息密度高但结构清楚）：
1) 先读 Section 3 的“eviction as estimation”与 Table 1/Figure 1（如果有）：把 filtering/prediction/smoothing 与 H 轴对齐，这是全文的组织骨架。
2) 精读 Section 4（demonstrated utility）：这是把 Belady 引入神经缓存的关键技术点，决定了信号是否可靠、是否会被注意力噪声污染。
3) 看 Section 5 的 RMM：理解它为何是 H2O 的严格泛化，以及在 H→0 或特定设置下如何退化回 H2O。
4) 直接跳到 Section 8/9：作者对负结果的解释与“什么时候 measuring beats accumulating”的边界图谱，是最有可迁移价值的部分。
5) 如果你做 pretrain/长上下文训练：把 demonstrated utility 当作一种潜在训练信号来思考——是否能在训练阶段塑造更‘可测量的复用’，从而让 fixed-lag 类策略在真实任务上不退化。

summary_en.core_problem: Under a hard working-memory budget (KV cache or recurrent state), how should a model decide what to keep vs evict? The paper reframes eviction as estimating a hidden signal—future reuse—and introduces fixed-lag smoothing as an intermediate regime between online policies (commit immediately) and the offline optimal Belady algorithm (knows the full future).
summary_en.importance:
Not a pretraining contribution per se, but highly relevant to long-context inference and memory management.
- It provides a clean unifying axis (commit lag H) that places recency/attention-accumulation methods (StreamingLLM, H2O), learned predictors (e.g., SnapKV-style), and Belady on one continuum.
- It proposes “demonstrated utility,” a label-free signal extracted from the model’s own attention and next-token correctness, as a way to make Belady-like reasoning feasible in neural caches.
- The paper is unusually explicit about limitations: on independent benchmarks, the resulting policy (RMM) is only H2O-class and can be worse in streaming settings. That boundary—when measurement beats accumulation—is arguably the most useful takeaway for practitioners.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Estimation framing: each cached item x has latent utility u(x), roughly how much keeping it reduces future loss; an eviction policy is an estimator û(x).
2) Commit lag H as the key degree of freedom:
- H=0 covers existing approaches that decide at arrival: filtering (past-only signals like recency or accumulated attention) and prediction (learned guesses about future reuse).
- H→∞ corresponds to Belady’s offline optimum.
3) Fixed-lag smoothing: delay the keep/evict commitment by H steps so near-future evidence of reuse is observed rather than predicted, trading off buffer memory and latency.
4) Belady bridge via demonstrated utility: since neural attention lacks an explicit request stream, the paper defines a proxy “request” signal from which cached items were actually used by attention in correct near-future predictions.
5) Resulting policy: RMM, a training-free eviction rule that strictly generalizes H2O; additionally, a small model is trained to predict an ordering that is then measured/confirmed under the lag.
6) Regime map: when reuse is endogenous and temporally separated, smoothing can help; for common single-shot long-context reading, the measurement collapses to accumulated attention, making RMM effectively H2O-like.
summary_en.experiments:
Evidence is presented in two tiers:
- Controlled tasks designed to isolate the mechanism: RMM tracks an offline oracle more closely, while pure filtering collapses—supporting the fixed-lag idea when reuse is structured and delayed.
- Independent benchmarks run in a third-party harness against that harness’s baselines: RMM is on par with H2O and does not consistently beat it; in the streaming regime it targets, it can lose to H2O and SnapKV.
- The excerpt provided does not include benchmark names, exact K/H sweeps, or numeric deltas; the key is to verify the curves and settings in Sections 7–9.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Read the estimation formulation and the H-axis unification (Section 3 + the main table/figure).
2) Spend time on demonstrated utility (Section 4): it is the technical hinge that determines whether Belady-style signals are meaningful in practice.
3) Review RMM (Section 5) to understand how it generalizes H2O and what it reduces to in limiting cases.
4) Jump to the negative results and regime analysis (Sections 8–9): the “when measuring beats accumulating” boundary is the most transferable insight.
5) If you work on pretraining/long-context training, treat demonstrated utility as a candidate training signal and ask whether training can make reuse more measurable, preventing the smoothing approach from degenerating to H2O on real workloads.

recommendation.zh: 固定滞后平滑这个 framing 值得看，尤其是 RMM=H2O 泛化；应在长上下文 KV eviction ablation 里复现。
recommendation.en: The fixed-lag smoothing framing is worth reading, especially the RMM-as-H2O-generalization result; reproduce it in long-context KV eviction ablations.

paper.title: KAP: Bridging the Knowledge Selection-Runtime Consumption Gap in LLM Systems
paper.abstract: Modern LLM systems increasingly rely on knowledge-selection processes that produce high-value structured priors, such as ranked evidence, graph topology, multimodal alignment, and confidence signals. Yet LLM serving remains fundamentally oblivious to this rich structure: once such signals are serialized into a prompt, the backend observes only a flat token sequence, forcing dense and uniform consumption of the full key-value (KV) state during decoding. We term this architectural mismatch the Kno

summary.core_problem: 现代LLM系统存在上游知识选择与下游服务运行时之间的架构不匹配（被命名为KSRC gap）：上游知识选择流水线（如RAG重排序、GraphRAG的图结构遍历、置信度估计等）会产出丰富的结构化先验，但这些信息在prompt序列化阶段被压缩为扁平的token序列，后端serving系统只能无差别加载全部KV缓存进行解码，导致运行时成本随序列化后的上下文长度线性增长，而非随推理实际需要的知识量增长。随着知识选择能力增强、上下文规模扩大，这一不匹配会愈发严重。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有三点：1. 长上下文预训练的性能收益需要与推理运行时效率协同设计，单纯扩大上下文窗口会被线性增长的解码成本抵消，无法充分释放价值；2. 预训练目标可考虑将结构化知识先验（重要性、图结构、置信度等）直接编码进模型表示，而非完全依赖prompt序列化传递，有望同时提升推理质量与效率；3. 长上下文预训练数据的价值评估应结合运行时知识消费模式，而非仅看原始上下文长度下的性能表现。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Knowledge Access Planning（KAP）范式，采用编译器-执行器的拆分架构，引入统一的中间表示「运行时访问计划」，解耦逻辑prompt语义与物理KV缓存访问。KAP编译器将上游知识选择产出的高维结构化先验（排序结果、图拓扑、多模态对齐信号、置信度等）编译为该中间表示，KAP执行器则根据计划控制后端KV缓存的物理访问，全程无需修改知识选择前端、语言模型本身或逻辑prompt结构。论文还给出了一个具体实例GraphSpec，以GraphRAG为知识选择前端、vLLM为服务后端，将图结构先验编译为访问计划，指导后端选择性消费知识，同时保留全上下文验证能力。
summary.experiments: 本次提供的论文片段未包含完整实验结果。根据文中提及的内容，后续将通过GraphSpec实例验证其服务效率与回答质量的平衡，并在第4节从分析和实证层面支撑一项缩放原则：当知识选择的选择性提升且能保持执行保真度时，LLM服务的物理成本可随上下文长度亚线性缩放。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读可重点关注第1节中KSRC gap的定义与问题背景，以及第2节中KAP范式的核心设计思路。关注系统实现的读者可查看第3节GraphSpec与vLLM的适配细节，关注缩放理论的读者可查看第4节的亚线性缩放原则分析。预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Modern LLM systems face an architectural mismatch termed the Knowledge Selection–Runtime Consumption (KSRC) gap. Upstream knowledge selection pipelines (e.g., RAG reranking, GraphRAG graph traversal, confidence estimation) produce rich structured priors, but these are collapsed into a flat token sequence during prompt serialization. The serving backend only sees a linear token stream and loads the full KV-cache uniformly during decoding, so runtime cost scales with serialized context length rather than the small fraction of context actually needed for reasoning. This mismatch worsens as knowledge selection becomes more sophisticated and context grows longer.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, this work delivers three actionable implications: 1. Long-context pretraining gains require co-design with serving runtime efficiency; simply expanding context window size is offset by linear growth in decoding cost, preventing full realization of performance improvements. 2. Pretraining objectives could be adapted to encode structured knowledge priors (importance, graph structure, confidence) directly into model representations, rather than relying solely on prompt serialization, potentially improving both reasoning quality and inference efficiency. 3. The value of long-context pretraining data should be evaluated alongside runtime knowledge consumption patterns, not just raw context length performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Knowledge Access Planning (KAP), a plan-driven paradigm for runtime knowledge consumption built on a compiler-executor split. A universal intermediate representation called the runtime access plan decouples logical prompt semantics from physical KV-cache access. The KAP compiler translates high-dimensional structured priors from upstream systems (ranked evidence, graph topology, multimodal alignment, confidence scores) into this IR, while the KAP executor interprets the plan to control physical KV access in the serving backend. No changes are required to the knowledge selection frontend, the language model itself, or the logical prompt structure. As a concrete instantiation, GraphSpec implements KAP for GraphRAG frontends and vLLM backends, compiling graph-derived priors into access plans that guide selective KV consumption while retaining full-context verification capability.
summary_en.experiments: The provided paper fragment does not include full experimental results. The work states it will evaluate GraphSpec's serving efficiency and answer quality in Section 5, and provides both analytical and empirical grounding in Section 4 for a scaling principle: when knowledge selection becomes more selective while preserving execution fidelity, the physical cost of LLM serving can scale sublinearly with context length.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim read, focus on Section 1 for the formal definition of the KSRC gap and problem background, and the core KAP paradigm design in Section 2. Readers interested in system implementation can review Section 3 for GraphSpec's vLLM integration details, while those focused on scaling theory can check Section 4 for the sublinear scaling principle analysis. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 想法对长上下文 serving 有用；只看系统抽象和 KV traffic 实测，若无端到端数字就当概念稿。
recommendation.en: Useful for long-context serving design; read the abstraction and KV-traffic measurements, but treat it as conceptual if end-to-end numbers are missing.

paper.title: OmniScope: Modality-Decoupled Token Compression for Omnimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Existing token compression methods for omnimodal large language models typically rely on one modality to determine what to retain in the other. We show that this assumption often breaks down: for the same query, audio and video relevance often peaks at different moments. This cross-modal salience mismatch makes unidirectional guidance prone to discarding answer-critical cues under aggressive compression. We propose OmniScope, a training-free token compression framework that uses the query as a s

summary.core_problem: 现有全模态（音频+视频+文本）大模型的token压缩方法大多采用单向跨模态引导策略，即依靠单模态的显著性信号决定另一模态的token保留规则，但同一查询对应的音频和视频显著性峰值往往出现在不同时间点，这种跨模态显著性不匹配问题会导致高压缩比下关键信息丢失，造成模型性能明显下降。
summary.importance: 指出了此前跨模态压缩方法的核心设计偏差，提出的模态解耦压缩框架无需训练即可直接适配现有开源全模态大模型，不需要重训，对统一多模态模型的部署有实际参考价值；压缩过程保留模态独立性的设计原则也为后续多模态效率优化研究提供了方向参考。
summary.technical_approach: 核心设计为以输入查询作为跨模态共享的语义锚点，但允许音频、视频流独立评估自身token的重要性、独立分配压缩预算，不做显式的跨模态信息引导。视频侧采用Anchor-Delta时空压缩策略：一方面保留全局语义锚点帧，另一方面保留反映时序变化的增量token，平衡全局语义覆盖和时序动态表达；音频侧采用每秒粒度的token合并策略，基于编码器输出的时序嵌入做二分软匹配，在保留时序连续性的同时降低冗余，解决了此前音频压缩粒度过粗的问题。整个框架不需要微调模型。
summary.experiments: 在4个视频理解基准、3B和7B两个模型规模上开展验证，OmniScope在所有测试压缩比下的平均性能均优于基线压缩方法；45%token保留率下精度几乎无损；在25%的激进压缩比下，鲁棒性显著优于所有对比方法，prefill阶段速度最高提升3.53倍，GPU显存占用降低15%以上。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注引言部分对跨模态显著性不匹配现象的观察、以及相关注意力分布的分析，理解单向跨模态引导失效的原因；其次关注模态解耦压缩的设计逻辑，以及音视频两侧压缩策略的核心思路，具体实现细节可略过，预计阅读时间10分钟。
summary.authors_note: MAC-AutoML

summary_en.core_problem: Existing token compression methods for omnimodal (audio+video+text) large language models mostly adopt unidirectional cross-modal guidance, using saliency signals from one modality to determine token retention in the other. However, audio and video saliency peaks for the same query often occur at different timestamps; this cross-modal saliency mismatch leads to loss of critical information at high compression ratios, causing significant performance degradation.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a key design flaw in prior cross-modal compression approaches. The proposed modality-decoupled compression framework is training-free and can be directly applied to existing open omnimodal LLMs without retraining, offering practical reference for deployment of unified multimodal models. The design principle of preserving modality independence in compression also provides guidance for future multimodal efficiency research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core design uses the input query as a shared semantic anchor across modalities, but allows audio and video streams to independently estimate token importance and allocate compression budgets, with no explicit cross-modal guidance. For video tokens, an Anchor-Delta Spatio-Temporal Compression strategy is applied: it retains global semantic anchor frames as well as incremental tokens reflecting temporal changes, balancing global semantic coverage and temporal dynamics. For audio tokens, per-second token merging via bipartite soft matching on post-encoder temporal embeddings reduces redundancy while preserving temporal continuity, addressing the over-coarse granularity of prior audio compression methods. The entire framework requires no model fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on 4 video understanding benchmarks across 3B and 7B model scales, OmniScope achieves better average performance than baseline compression methods across all tested compression ratios. It delivers near-lossless accuracy at 45% token retention. At the more aggressive 25% retention rate, it shows significantly stronger robustness than comparison methods, with up to 3.53× prefilling speedup and over 15% GPU memory reduction.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the observation of cross-modal saliency mismatch and the attention distribution analysis in the introduction, which explains why prior unidirectional cross-modal guidance fails. Then review the design logic of modality-decoupled compression and the core ideas behind the video and audio compression strategies. Implementation details can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 10 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: MAC-AutoML

recommendation.zh: 把“跨模态显著性不同步”讲清楚了，作为长音视频上下文压缩的强基线；只需看失败案例+预算分配策略，别期待训练侧新东西。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the clean failure mode (cross-modal salience mismatch) and a strong training-free compression baseline; focus on the ablations/case studies, not on training-time insights.

paper.title: WaveZip: Wavelet-Driven Space-Time Decoupling for Video Token Condensation
paper.abstract: Existing Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) struggle with long-form video understanding due to the quadratic computational cost of visual tokens. While recent efficient methods attempt to compress tokens via hard pruning or uniform merging, they operate strictly in the spatial feature domain, where robust structural context and discriminative semantic details are inherently entangled. In this work, we propose WaveZip, a joint signal-frequency-domain framework for efficient video inference. Dri

summary.core_problem: 长视频输入LVLM时会产生海量时空视觉token，导致注意力计算复杂度随token数二次增长，推理效率低下。现有token压缩方法直接在空间特征域操作：硬剪枝会破坏空间连贯性，均匀合并会模糊语义显著区域，根源是这类方法在空域无法解耦两类混淆——空间维度上，任务相关的细粒度证据和冗余背景纹理混杂；时间维度上，慢变的语义趋势和采样噪声、视觉抖动、场景突变等高频波动混杂，即频率混淆问题。
summary.importance: 这个工作从频域视角给出了无需训练、即插即用的视频token压缩方案，其按频带分配token预算的思路，对多模态统一预训练中的视觉token冗余处理、视觉tokenizer设计、长视频建模效率优化有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: WaveZip选择离散小波变换（DWT）做时空分解，因为DWT具备局部性、可逆性、多子带分解的特性。时间维度：对帧级查询相关性序列做1D DWT，用帧间视觉变化先验门控高频细节系数，经逆DWT重构校正后的相关性序列，指导自适应的帧级token预算分配。空间维度：对每帧特征图做2D DWT，保留代表结构的低频近似子带，用查询条件的空间显著性对高频细节子带重新加权，重构后的特征按分配的预算下采样，投影为紧凑视觉token。整个流程不需要任务特定训练，可直接集成到现有LVLM中。
summary.experiments: 现有手稿的实验部分内容截断，已公开部分提到在多个长视频理解基准、多款LVLM骨干上开展测试，相比硬剪枝、均匀合并等空域压缩基线，相同压缩率下能保留更多任务相关语义细节，性能损失更小，且无额外训练开销。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时重点看引言部分对现有压缩方法缺陷的频率视角分析，以及方法部分的时空DWT分解逻辑，理解为什么频域解耦能避免空域压缩“要么丢信息要么模糊”的问题。不用深究具体小波基选择的工程细节，核心收获是按信息频率差异化分配token预算的思路。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Long video inputs to LVLMs produce thousands of spatiotemporal visual tokens, leading to quadratic attention complexity and poor inference efficiency. Existing token compression methods operate directly in the spatial feature domain: hard pruning breaks spatial coherence, while uniform merging blurs semantically salient regions. The root issue is frequency conflation: in the spatial dimension, task-relevant fine-grained evidence is mixed with redundant background texture; in the temporal dimension, slow-varying semantic trends are mixed with high-frequency fluctuations from sampling noise, visual jitter, and abrupt scene changes.
summary_en.importance: This work presents a training-free, plug-and-play video token compression framework built on frequency-domain decomposition. Its core design—allocating token budgets based on separated frequency bands—offers useful reference for handling visual token redundancy in unified multimodal pretraining, designing efficient visual tokenizers, and optimizing long-video modeling efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach: WaveZip uses the Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) for spatiotemporal decomposition, chosen for its localized support, invertibility, and multi-band decomposition properties. Temporally, it applies 1D DWT to frame-level query relevance sequences, gates high-frequency detail coefficients with an inter-frame visual change prior, and reconstructs a rectified relevance sequence via inverse DWT to guide adaptive frame-level token budget allocation. Spatially, it applies 2D DWT to per-frame feature maps, retains the low-frequency approximation subband that encodes structural information, and reweights high-frequency detail subbands with query-conditioned spatial saliency. Reconstructed features are downsampled according to allocated budgets and projected to compact visual tokens. The entire pipeline requires no task-specific training and integrates directly with off-the-shelf LVLMs.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental section of the available manuscript is truncated. Publicly described results report tests across multiple long-video understanding benchmarks and LVLM backbones, showing that WaveZip retains more task-relevant semantic details and suffers less performance degradation than spatial-domain baselines (hard pruning, uniform merging) at equivalent compression ratios, with no additional training overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the frequency-domain critique of existing compression methods in the introduction, and the spatiotemporal DWT decomposition logic in the method section, to understand how frequency disentanglement avoids the common tradeoff between information loss and blurring in spatial-domain compression. Engineering details of specific wavelet kernel selection can be skipped. The core transferable idea is allocating token budgets differentially based on information frequency bands. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把“压缩决策放到频域”这条路走得更系统，适合做长视频推理的可解释基线；重点看频带假设是否在不同数据集/模型上稳。
recommendation.en: A more principled frequency-domain take on token compression; skim for whether the wavelet-band assumptions hold across models/datasets before adopting it as a serving baseline.

paper.title: Temporal Context Reinstatement Drives Episodic-Like Order Memory in Long-Context Language Models
paper.abstract: Human episodic memory supports the retrieval of experiences that unfold over extended timescales, yet the computational mechanisms underlying this ability remain debated due to the limited mechanistic accessibility in long-term memory experiments in humans. Long-context LLMs may offer promising ways to reveal plausible computational mechanisms that drive this type of retrieval. Here, we investigate whether and how LLMs capture the core behavioral signatures of episodic memory via a temporal orde

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究长上下文语言模型是否能表现出类似人类情景记忆的时间顺序记忆，并进一步追问模型内部靠什么机制完成这种判断：是显式的时间位置表征，还是仅靠语义、因果和叙事线索推断先后顺序。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在长上下文机制分析，而不是训练 recipe。论文把“长上下文是否真的在用时间结构”这个问题做成了可测、可干预的任务。结果指向一个重要现象：模型在长文本检索时不只是匹配语义片段，还会在检索阶段重建低维时间上下文。这对长上下文预训练、位置编码设计、KV-cache 记忆解释、长程评测设计都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文设计了 Sequence Order Recall Task，给定一部长篇文本中的两个不重叠 50 词片段，要求判断哪个片段在原文中更早出现。作者用完整小说构造人类行为数据，并让长上下文 LLM 在相同任务上评测。关键分析不是停留在行为相似性，而是进入模型内部：先定位隐藏状态中是否存在可线性读出的时间顺序信息，再分析 retrieval 阶段哪些 attention head 会从 KV-cache 中重新激活这种时间码。论文报告一个专门的 attention head 会重建低维 temporal code，并通过因果干预验证它对顺序判断有实际作用。这与“模型只是利用故事语义链推断顺序”的解释不同。
summary.experiments: 主要结果包括三点。第一，模型和人类都表现出 distance effect：两个片段在原文中距离越远，顺序判断越容易。第二，模型内部存在低维时间表征，可用于解释顺序判断表现。第三，某个特化 attention head 在 retrieval 阶段从 KV-cache 中恢复时间信息；对该 head 或相关表征做干预会影响 temporal order judgment。文中还发布 ICMemory-Kit，用于长上下文记忆与机制解释实验。给定材料中没有提供具体模型参数量、上下文长度、样本规模和干预幅度数字，阅读时需要到实验章节核对。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看任务构造和人类数据部分，确认 SORT 是否排除了明显的语义捷径。然后看 temporal code 的定位方法，以及 attention head 的因果验证实验。最值得细读的是模型如何区分“时间上下文恢复”和“语义链推断”，因为这决定了结论对长上下文预训练是否有外推意义。若只关心工程启发，可重点看 attention/KV-cache 分析和 ICMemory-Kit 的接口设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether long-context language models exhibit human-like temporal order memory over extended naturalistic inputs, and what internal mechanism supports this behavior: an explicit temporal position code or inference from semantic and narrative structure.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is mechanistic insight into long-context memory. The work turns a vague question—whether a model actually uses temporal structure—into a controlled task with behavioral comparison and causal probing. The key implication is that long-context retrieval may rely on reinstating a low-dimensional temporal context, not only on matching semantic content. This matters for long-context pretraining, positional representation design, KV-cache analysis, and evaluation of memory over long documents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce the Sequence Order Recall Task. Given two non-overlapping 50-word passages sampled from a long text, the model or human subject must decide which one appeared earlier. They build a human behavioral dataset from memory of a full-length novel and compare it with long-context LLMs. The mechanistic part localizes temporal order information in model activations, then studies how this information is reinstated during retrieval. The paper reports that a specialized attention head retrieves a low-dimensional temporal code from the KV cache and that causal interventions on this mechanism affect order judgments. This distinguishes the proposed mechanism from a pure semantic-chain explanation.
summary_en.experiments: The reported findings are: models show the same distance effect observed in humans, where order judgments become easier as the two queried segments are farther apart in the original text; temporal order information can be localized in internal representations; and a specific attention head reinstates temporal information during retrieval and is causally involved in the task. The paper also releases ICMemory-Kit for long-context memory and interpretability experiments. The provided text does not include exact model sizes, context lengths, dataset sizes, or intervention effect sizes, so those numbers should be checked in the experimental sections.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the task and human dataset design to see how much semantic shortcutting is controlled. Then read the sections on temporal-code localization and attention-head causal intervention. The most important technical point is how the authors separate temporal context reinstatement from semantic inference. For engineering relevance, focus on the KV-cache analysis and the ICMemory-Kit design.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 方法论文，但如果你关心长上下文记忆机制，只看关键 head 干预和一维时间码那几节就够，能帮你判断 retrieval 到底像不像显式状态重建。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if long-context memory matters to you, read the head intervention and 1D temporal-code sections; they sharpen whether retrieval behaves like explicit state reinstatement.

institutions: The University of Texas at Austin

paper.title: SF-AMS: Strategic Forgetting for Structured Memory in LLM Agent
paper.abstract: Managing long-context dependencies remains a primary bottleneck in LLM agents, as redundant and irrelevant information can degrade multi-step reasoning. Strategic Forgetting for Agent Memory Systems (SF-AMS) is proposed as a framework for maintaining compact high-utility memory by modeling the long-term importance of memory units. SF-AMS replaces static retrieval and heuristic decay with a utility-driven survival mechanism that updates memory importance from usage redundancy and temporal signals

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 的长期记忆会积累冗余和无关信息，干扰多步推理和长上下文依赖处理。
summary.importance: 贡献是通用 agent memory 的工程方法：用 utility-driven forgetting 维护紧凑高效记忆。它对预训练没有直接作用，但对外部记忆、长上下文 agent 和 retrieval policy 设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: SF-AMS 用 utility-driven survival mechanism 替代静态检索和启发式衰减；记忆单元的重要性由使用频率、冗余度和时间信号动态更新，并形成层级记忆结构。Composite Importance Scoring 进一步结合语义信号和 entity-level 信号，提高检索稳定性。
summary.experiments: 在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval-s 上，与 LightMem、MemO、A-Mem 等 agent memory baseline 比较。摘要报告在 Qwen2.5-7B 的 multi-hop reasoning 场景中，SF-AMS 相比最强 baseline 提升 +9.65 F1。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-term memory in LLM agents accumulates redundant and irrelevant information, which can hurt multi-step reasoning over long contexts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-memory engineering method based on utility-driven forgetting. It is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to external memory, retrieval policy design, and long-context agent behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: SF-AMS replaces static retrieval and heuristic decay with a utility-driven survival mechanism. Memory-unit importance is updated from usage, redundancy, and temporal signals, inducing a hierarchical memory structure. Composite Importance Scoring combines semantic and entity-level cues for more robust retrieval.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-s against memory baselines including LightMem, MemO, and A-Mem. The abstract reports the largest gain in multi-hop reasoning with Qwen2.5-7B, where SF-AMS improves by 9.65 F1 over the strongest baseline.

recommendation.zh: 看 memory scoring 公式和 LoCoMo 表即可；像 agent memory 的工程整理，未改变长上下文 prior。
recommendation.en: Check the memory-scoring rule and LoCoMo table; this is useful agent-memory engineering, not a shift in long-context priors.

paper.title: Decoupled Attention Fusion: Accelerating RAG with Efficient KV Cache Reuse
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) effectively mitigates hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) but suffers from prohibitive Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) latency in long-context scenarios. Reusing pre-computed document KV caches addresses this but introduces a distribution mismatch, where offline caches lack the inter-document attention patterns required for coherent reasoning. CacheBlend reduces recomputation via selective attention, but suffers severe accuracy degradation at longer con

summary.core_problem: RAG 场景下如何复用离线预计算的文档 KV cache，同时避免独立编码文档带来的 KV cache mismatch。核心矛盾是：全量在线 prefill 准确但慢，直接复用离线 cache 快但缺少文档间注意力，质量会下降。
summary.importance: 这篇论文属于推理效率方向，对长上下文 RAG serving 有直接价值。它不解决预训练目标或模型结构训练问题，但对基座模型部署和长上下文系统设计有启发：RAG 的文档语料通常是静态的，可以把一部分 prefill 计算前移到离线阶段；难点在于如何用很少的在线计算补回跨文档依赖。DAF 的价值在于把这个补偿问题改写成硬件友好的 dense attention，而不是依赖复杂稀疏 mask 或大量条件分支。
summary.technical_approach: DAF 将 prefill 拆成三部分。第一，选择重要 token，并只让这些 token 之间做 self-attention，用一个较小的全局交互场修复跨文档依赖。重要 token 的选择不只看单层 KV 偏移，而是聚合第 2 到第 4 层等多层信号，降低层间方差带来的误选。第二，question-document self-attention 让问题 token attend 到全部文档和问题上下文，其中重要 token 的 KV 已经在前一步更新，因此在线问答阶段使用的是混合 KV cache。第三，state fusion 将重要 token 路径和问题-文档路径的输出融合为最终 hidden states。复杂度从 CacheBlend 近似的 O(r L_d^2 + L_d L_q) 降到 O(r^2 L_d^2 + L_q(L_d + L_q))，其中 r 是重要 token 比例，L_d 是文档 token 总长，L_q 是问题长度。由于 DAF 的两个 attention 子问题都能表示为标准 dense attention，它可以直接使用 Flash-Attention，避免非标准 mask 和 GPU thread divergence。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen2.5-7B，在单张 NVIDIA A100 80GB 上 greedy decoding。对比对象包括 vLLM 全量重算和 CacheBlend，重要 token 比例固定为 r = 0.3。评测覆盖 2WikiMultiHopQA、SAMSum 等 6k–9k token 任务，也包括 RULER、LongBench-V2 等最长约 136k token 的长上下文任务。指标包括 TTFT 和任务准确性指标，如 QA 的 Exact Match、摘要的 Rouge-L，并在表中统一为 Accuracy。结果显示，在 9k token 左右 DAF 与 CacheBlend 接近；到约 130k token 时，DAF 相比 CacheBlend 最高约 2 倍加速，相比 vLLM 全量重算约 5.6 倍加速，同时保持接近或更好的准确性。限制也比较明确：r 需要按任务调节；大规模语料的 KV cache 存储和调度仍然是系统瓶颈。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15–20 分钟。优先看 Methods 中三个模块：important-token self-attention、question-document self-attention、state fusion。复杂度分析值得看，关键是 r L_d^2 到 r^2 L_d^2 的差别，以及为什么 L_q 通常较小。硬件部分重点看它如何保持 Flash-Attention 兼容，这决定了理论复杂度能否转成真实 TTFT 收益。实验部分重点看长上下文长度增加时 DAF 与 CacheBlend 的分化，以及 r = 0.3 的固定设置是否足够支撑不同任务。若关注生产系统，还应重点看限制部分，因为 KV cache 存储可能比 attention 计算更早成为瓶颈。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses KV cache reuse for RAG. Offline document caches can reduce prefill latency, but independently encoded documents miss inter-document attention, causing a representation mismatch and quality loss.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to inference efficiency and long-context RAG serving rather than pretraining itself. Its main lesson is that static retrieval corpora create an opportunity to move part of prefill computation offline, but the online stage must repair the missing cross-document dependencies. DAF is useful because it formulates this repair as standard dense attention operations that can run efficiently on existing Flash-Attention kernels.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decoupled Attention Fusion splits prefill into three components. First, it selects important document tokens and performs self-attention only among this subset, creating a compact interaction path across document boundaries. Unlike CacheBlend-style selection based on a single layer, DAF aggregates signals from multiple early layers, typically layers 2–4, to reduce layer-specific noise. Second, question tokens perform question-document self-attention over the full context, using a hybrid KV cache where important-token states have already been updated. Third, a state fusion step combines the outputs into final hidden states. The complexity changes from roughly O(r L_d^2 + L_d L_q) in CacheBlend to O(r^2 L_d^2 + L_q(L_d + L_q)), where r is the important-token ratio, L_d is total document length, and L_q is question length. The practical design choice is to keep the operations dense and Flash-Attention-compatible, avoiding custom masks and GPU branch divergence.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Qwen2.5-7B on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU with greedy decoding. Baselines include full recomputation with vLLM and CacheBlend, with the important-token fraction fixed at r = 0.3. The evaluation spans shorter RAG tasks such as 2WikiMultiHopQA and SAMSum at around 6k–9k tokens, plus long-context tasks from RULER and LongBench-V2 up to about 136k tokens. Metrics include TTFT and task accuracy measures such as Exact Match and Rouge-L, reported under a unified Accuracy column. Around 9k tokens, DAF and CacheBlend are similar. Around 130k tokens, DAF reaches up to 2x speedup over CacheBlend and 5.6x over full recomputation with vLLM, while maintaining comparable or better accuracy. The main limitations are task-dependent tuning of r and the storage and management cost of large offline KV caches.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–20 minutes. Focus on the method section: important-token self-attention, question-document self-attention, and state fusion. The complexity analysis is the key technical part, especially the reduction from r L_d^2 to r^2 L_d^2 and the assumption that L_q is much smaller than L_d. The hardware compatibility discussion is also worth reading because Flash-Attention support is what makes the wall-clock speedup plausible. In the results, inspect how the gap between DAF and CacheBlend grows with context length. For production RAG systems, read the limitations carefully, since KV cache storage can become the dominant bottleneck even if online attention is accelerated.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和长上下文 ablation；如果数字扎实，DAF 是 RAG cache 预计算里比粗暴拼 KV 更干净的折中。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and long-context ablations; if the numbers hold, DAF is a cleaner compromise than blindly concatenating precomputed KV caches.

paper.title: HiKV: Hierarchical Importance-Aware KV Cache with Hardware Acceleration for LLM Decoding
paper.abstract: With the rapid adoption of long-context large language models (LLMs), the continuously growing KV cache during decoding has become the critical memory bottleneck. To tackle this challenge, we propose HiKV, a novel algorithm-hardware co-design that exploits KV cache redundancy through hierarchical importance awareness. Algorithmically, HiKV compresses the KV cache at two granularities: Stage I evicts unimportant tokens within a fixed budget, and Stage II further loads only the significant element

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM解码阶段KV缓存随序列长度和batch规模线性增长，成为核心内存瓶颈；现有基于重要性的KV压缩仅在token粒度做驱逐，保留token的完整KV向量仍存在元素级冗余，且动态排序的计算开销大，缺乏算法与硬件的协同优化。
summary.importance: 算法-硬件协同设计的思路可延伸到长序列预训练的注意力内存优化场景；两级粒度的冗余消除模式为理解注意力稀疏性结构提供了实证依据，可为预训练中的稀疏注意力设计提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出分层重要性感知的KV缓存压缩与硬件加速协同方案。算法分为两阶段：第一阶段在固定缓存预算内，基于累积注意力得分动态驱逐不重要的token；第二阶段对保留的token，仅加载对注意力计算影响显著的向量元素，实现单粒度方法无法达到的压缩比。硬件上设计专用加速器，核心是可重构重要性排序器，可在第一阶段的堆式重要性维护和第二阶段的并行分块排序两种数据通路间切换，统一两阶段加速需求，仅增加8%的系统级面积开销。
summary.experiments: 在长上下文基准测试中，相比token级最优方法，在精度损失不超过1%的约束下压缩比更优；相比原始基线，解码阶段注意力计算最高获得7.95倍加速，能耗降低90%，在等精度约束下性能优于现有KV缓存优化方案。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点关注第III节的两级压缩算法设计思路和第V节的系统级性能对比，可跳过硬件电路实现细节；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: KV cache grows linearly with sequence length and batch size during long-context LLM decoding, becoming the dominant memory bottleneck. Existing importance-based KV compression only operates at token granularity, leaving element-level redundancy in full KV vectors of retained tokens, and the high overhead of dynamic sorting lacks algorithm-hardware co-optimization.
summary_en.importance: The algorithm-hardware co-design principle can be extended to attention memory optimization in long-sequence pretraining. The two-level redundancy elimination pattern provides empirical evidence for understanding attention sparsity structure, which can inform sparse attention design in pretraining pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: HiKV is a hierarchical importance-aware KV cache compression framework with dedicated hardware acceleration. Algorithmically, it runs two complementary stages: Stage I dynamically evicts unimportant tokens within a fixed cache budget based on accumulated attention scores; Stage II selectively loads only significant vector elements from retained tokens, achieving compression ratios unattainable by single-granularity methods. Architecturally, a custom accelerator with a reconfigurable importance sorter switches between heap-based importance maintenance (Stage I) and parallel chunk-based sorting (Stage II), unifying two-stage acceleration with only 8% system-level area overhead.
summary_en.experiments: On long-context benchmarks, HiKV achieves better compression ratios than leading token-level methods under 1% accuracy loss. Compared to the vanilla baseline, it delivers up to 7.95× speedup and 90% energy reduction in attention computation during decoding, outperforming existing KV cache optimizations under iso-accuracy constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming: focus on Section III for the two-stage compression algorithm design and Section V for system-level performance comparison; skip hardware circuit implementation details. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做长上下文 serving 的可以看；对 pretrain 本身帮助有限，但“token 级+元素级”双层压缩这个归纳值得记，先看方法图和质量退化表再决定是否深读。
recommendation.en: Worth a skim if you care about long-context serving; limited pretrain impact, but the token-level plus element-level compression decomposition is a useful design pattern—check the method figure and quality-retention tables first.

paper.title: Lost in Context: Addressing Context Anxiety in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Conventional wisdom suggests that reasoning models fail when problems exceed their capabilities. However, we find that frontier reasoning models sometimes possess the necessary capabilities to solve problems but fail due to premature self-doubt -- a phenomenon informally known as context anxiety. We provide the first systematic study of context anxiety, demonstrating that it arises, in part, from a model's inability to accurately estimate the tokens required to complete a task. We also show that

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的不是模型“不会做题”，而是模型在长程推理任务里错误地判断自己“做不完”，于是提前放弃、绕路、或者生成更低效的解法。作者把这种现象定义为 context anxiety。更具体地说，核心问题是：当前 reasoning model 对完成任务所需 token 的自我估计存在系统性失准，这种失准会诱发行为层面的退缩，而不是能力层面的失败。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口都有启发。它提醒人们，长上下文与长链推理的瓶颈不一定只来自容量、架构或算力，也可能来自模型对自身生成成本的错误表征。这个问题如果成立，就意味着一部分“推理能力不足”其实是 policy 问题，而不是 capability 问题。对 post-train 更直接：SFT 或 RL 不只是教模型更会推理，也可能在重塑它对资源约束的内隐估计。对 pretrain 的间接启发是，训练目标里几乎没有显式校准“完成任务需要多长输出”的信号，模型学到的是语言续写分布，不是 generation budget awareness。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三步。第一步是检测 context anxiety。作者不是只靠关键词匹配，而是用一个 LLM judge panel 去判定 reasoning trace 中是否存在“任务超出上下文/ token 限制”的语义表达，并据此把样本分成 anxiety-driven failures、capability-driven failures 和 successful attempts。这个划分很关键，因为它把“没做对”拆成了两种不同机制。第二步是测量 token 使用校准。作者让模型在完成回答后，自己估计刚才完成该解答需要多少 token，再用真实 token 数做比值，构造 winsorized token ratio。这个量不是在测 tokenizer 知识，而是在测模型主观感受到的生成成本。若该比值系统性偏大，说明模型倾向于高估完成任务所需篇幅。第三步是干预。作者构造一个蒸馏式 SFT 数据集：从目标模型和更强教师模型中收集成功且不表现 context anxiety 的 reasoning traces，只保留完成任务且无焦虑表达的样本，再对学生模型做轻量监督微调。这里的设计点在于，训练目标不是直接灌答案，而是让模型模仿“能完成长任务且不自我退缩”的推理策略。与常见提升推理的做法相比，这篇工作关注的是行为校准，而不是增加搜索、投票或更长 test-time compute。
summary.experiments: 主实验围绕 Tower of Hanoi 展开，并在 shortest-path grid search 上做了验证。论文报告，出现 context anxiety 的前沿推理模型，其 token 需求估计平均失准约 24%；这种失准与 15% 的准确率下降相关，并且在成功解题时还会带来约 54% 的 token 使用增加，说明焦虑不仅导致放弃，也会让成功样本变得更啰嗦、更低效。作者还指出，这种现象出现在具备长上下文和动态长度适配能力的模型上，不是简单的 context window 太短。干预方面，轻量 SFT 能把 context anxiety 降低 50% 以上，支持“这是可塑的行为策略，而非固定能力上限”的结论。泛读时要注意两个实验细节：一是 anxiety detector 的人工验证和敏感性分析是否足够可靠；二是 token ratio 与准确率、放弃行为之间是相关还是有更强的中介证据。若全文给了回归或 mediation analysis，这部分比 headline 数字更值得看。
summary.reading_guide: 先看 Introduction，把作者要区分的两类失败记住：能力不够，和误以为自己做不完。然后直接看方法部分关于 anxiety detection 和 winsorized token ratio 的定义，这是全文最有新意的地方。实验部分优先看 Tower of Hanoi 的主结果表，再看 shortest-path 的外部验证，以及 SFT 干预前后的变化。预计 25 分钟左右能抓住主线。若想判断这项工作是否扎实，重点检查 Appendix 里的 judge 可靠性、人类标注一致性、以及 token 估计提示词设计，因为这些地方最容易引入测量偏差。另一个值得深挖的点是：SFT 到底是在减少焦虑表达，还是确实改善了资源估计与策略选择，这要看作者是否报告了校准指标和准确率同时改善。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode that is different from lacking reasoning ability. In long-horizon tasks, models sometimes incorrectly conclude that they cannot finish within their token budget, then give up early, hedge, or switch to inefficient solution strategies. The authors call this context anxiety. More precisely, the paper argues that some reasoning failures are driven by systematic misestimation of the tokens required to complete a task, which then triggers behavioral disengagement rather than genuine incapacity.
summary_en.importance: This matters for both pretraining and post-training. It suggests that some apparent limits in long-context reasoning are not purely about model size, architecture, or compute. They may come from a learned policy that misjudges generation cost. If that is true, then part of what looks like a capability ceiling is actually a calibration problem. The post-training implication is immediate: SFT or RL may improve reasoning not only by teaching better search patterns, but also by reshaping the model’s internal estimate of how much effort a task requires. The pretraining implication is indirect but important: standard LM objectives do not explicitly teach budget awareness or accurate self-estimation of completion length.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three parts. First, the paper detects context anxiety from reasoning traces. Instead of simple keyword matching, it uses a panel of LLM judges to classify whether a trace semantically expresses claims like 'this exceeds my context window' or 'I cannot finish within token limits.' This lets the authors separate anxiety-driven failures from capability-driven failures and successful attempts. That distinction is central to the paper. Second, it measures token-use calibration. After producing an answer, the model is asked to estimate how many tokens were required to complete the solution. This estimate is compared with the true token count through a winsorized token ratio. The point is not whether the model knows tokenizer internals; it is whether the model’s perceived generation effort is systematically biased. Third, the paper tests whether the behavior is mutable. It builds a distilled SFT dataset from the target model and stronger teacher models, keeping only successful reasoning traces that do not exhibit context anxiety. The student is then fine-tuned on these traces. The intervention is designed to teach alternative long-horizon reasoning strategies that complete the task without self-abandonment, rather than simply injecting more answers or more test-time compute.
summary_en.experiments: The main task is Tower of Hanoi, with shortest-path grid search used as a second validation setting. The paper reports that frontier reasoning models exhibiting context anxiety overestimate required token usage by about 24%. This miscalibration is associated with a 15% drop in accuracy and, even when the model succeeds, a 54% increase in token usage, indicating that anxiety hurts both success rate and efficiency. The effect appears even in models built for long contexts and adaptive generation length, so it is not reducible to a small context window. On the intervention side, lightweight SFT reduces context anxiety by more than 50%, which supports the claim that the phenomenon is a modifiable behavioral policy rather than a hard capability limit. When reading the full paper, the most important checks are the reliability of the anxiety detector, the human validation of the labels, and whether the relationship between token-ratio miscalibration and failure is merely correlational or supported by stronger mediation-style analysis.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and keep the paper’s main distinction in mind: inability versus mistaken self-limitation. Then go straight to the method section on anxiety detection and the winsorized token ratio, since that is where the paper’s novelty sits. In the experiments, read the main Tower of Hanoi table first, then the shortest-path validation, and finally the before/after results for the SFT intervention. About 25 minutes should be enough for the main thread. For a more careful read, inspect the appendix sections on judge reliability, human agreement, and the prompt used to elicit token estimates, because those are the most likely sources of measurement bias. Another useful question is whether SFT truly improves calibration and strategy choice, or only suppresses explicit anxiety language; the answer depends on whether both calibration metrics and task accuracy improve together.

recommendation.zh: 看实验设计和失败案例即可；若 setup 干净，它会改变“长程失败=能力不足”的默认解释。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and failure cases; if the controls are clean, it weakens the default explanation that long-horizon failure is just lack of capability.

paper.title: Domyn-Small: A European 10B Reasoning Language Model
paper.abstract: We introduce Domyn-Small, a 10-billion-parameter open-weight reasoning language model released under the MIT license. Domyn-Small is the product of an initial pre-training phase on 9 trillion tokens multilingual data, followed by a post-training pipeline for reasoning, instruction following, and context extension. For the latter, we performed a Continued Pre-Training (CPT) phase that doubles the native context window to 32K tokens, followed by SFT with a math-focused annealing run. Finally, the

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“如何从零训练一个更强 10B 模型”，而是一个更现实的问题：给定一个 2024 年训练完成、并非为推理优化而设计的 10B multilingual base model，能否通过一条公开、可复现、成本受控的 continued pretrain + SFT + RL 管线，把它改造成在 7–10B 档位里具备可用推理、长上下文和工具调用能力的 reasoning model。全文围绕这个目标展开，重点在后训练配方如何弥补 base model 代际差距，以及如何在准确率和 token 开销之间取得更好的部署平衡。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要体现在 pretrain ↔ post-train 接口，而不是模型架构本身。它给出的信息有三层。第一，continued pretraining 仍然是小中型模型能力改造的重要杠杆，尤其用于 context extension 和分布再对齐。第二，SFT、math annealing、DPO、GRPO 不是简单堆叠，作者试图把它们组织成一个有阶段性的能力塑形流程。第三，论文明确承认 base model 的年代差异会限制 RL 上限，这一点很重要：后训练可以显著改变行为形态，但不能完全补齐预训练阶段缺失的 reasoning-friendly inductive bias。对做基座的人来说，这篇文章更像一份开放 recipe 和负责任的 case study，而不是新的理论突破。
summary.technical_approach: 技术上是一个五阶段适配流程。底座是 Italia 10B，一个从头训练的 10B dense decoder-only Transformer，约 9T token、50+ 语言，原生上下文 16K。架构上采用 40 层、hidden size 4096、GQA（48 个 query heads，8 个 KV heads）、RoPE、squared ReLU、无 dropout、untied embeddings，属于较标准的中等规模开源 dense 配置。第一阶段是 Continued Pre-Training，把原生上下文从 16,384 扩到 32,768，并在这个边界调整 RoPE base 到 500,000。这里的作用不是单纯拉长位置编码，而是让模型在新的长度分布上重新适应注意力和记忆模式。推理时再用训练外的 YaRN 把上下文扩到 131,072。第二阶段是大规模 SFT，使用 12.3B token instruction mixture，并在进入 RL 前做一个短的 math-focused annealing。这个 annealing 的设计意图很清楚：先把策略分布往可验证推理任务上收紧，再进入高方差的 RL。第三阶段是基于 verifiable rewards 的 GRPO，先在数学上做相对稳定的强化学习启动。第四阶段是 DPO，论文提到采用 Delta Learning Hypothesis，说明作者把 DPO 当作对策略边界和偏好方向的再校正，而不是替代 RL。第五阶段是 multi-environment GRPO，把训练环境扩展到数学、代码、多选 QA、指令跟随和 tool calling 五类任务，目标是避免模型被单一 reward 形态过度塑形。推理时还提供 thinking on/off 双模式，这说明其 chat template 和解码策略是围绕“显式推理 token 是否暴露”做过产品化设计的。
summary.experiments: 实验结论比较克制，也因此更有参考价值。作者把 Domyn-Small 与 Qwen3.5-9B、OLMo-3-7B-Think、Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Nano-8B-v1、Ministral-3-8B-Reasoning-2512 做对比。论文最强调的结果不是绝对准确率领先，而是 accuracy-efficiency balance：在若干 reasoning benchmark 上，Domyn-Small 平均每题生成 token 数约为 Qwen3.5-9B 的三分之一，说明其推理链更短，部署成本更低。准确率方面，它在 instruction-following 和 GPQA-Diamond 上领先 Nemotron-Nano 与 Ministral；在 AIME 2025 上与 Ministral 大致持平；但在 hard-math reasoning 上明显落后于 Qwen3.5-9B 和 OLMo-3-7B-Think。作者把差距归因于两点：RL 阶段在 checkpoint 时尚未完全收敛，以及底座来自 2024 年、早于近一轮 reasoning-oriented pretraining 实践。这个解释是合理的，也提醒读者不要把后训练收益误读为可无限叠加。值得注意的还有上下文能力：原生 32K，YaRN 外推到 128K 级别，说明其长上下文能力主要是“CPT 学到一段，推理时再外推一段”的折中方案，而不是从头按超长上下文训练。
summary.reading_guide: 如果你关心 post-train 如何反哺基座研究，这篇文章值得泛读到中度精读。先看 Introduction 和方法总览，抓住作者为什么不重训 base，而选择在 Italia 10B 上做五阶段适配。然后重点看 3.2 的 context extension：CPT 数据、长度分布、RoPE base 调整轨迹，这部分对做长上下文 continued pretrain 很有参考意义。接着看 4.1 到 4.4，尤其是 math annealing、verifiable reward 的 GRPO、DPO 在中间插入的理由，以及 multi-env GRPO 的环境设计。实验部分重点看 5.2 和 5.3，不只看准确率，也看 mean tokens per problem 这一部署指标。若时间有限，45 分钟可以读完主线；若你在做中小模型后训练配方，建议连附录中的数据配比、奖励设计和超参一起看。
summary.authors_note: iGenius / Domyn 团队，依托 CINECA Leonardo 超算完成训练与评测。论文正文明确提到与 CINECA 合作，并同步开源了 Domyn Swarm 用于 HPC 集群上的数据生成与评测。具体作者名单在给定内容中未完整出现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about training a stronger 10B model from scratch. It tackles a more practical question: given a 2024-vintage multilingual 10B base model that was not pretrained for reasoning, can an open, reproducible, and cost-conscious pipeline of continued pretraining, SFT, and RL turn it into a usable reasoning model with long context and tool-use capability in the 7–10B class? The full paper is centered on that adaptation problem and on the trade-off between accuracy and token cost at deployment time.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research lies mainly at the pretrain-to-posttrain interface rather than in architecture novelty. It conveys three useful lessons. First, continued pretraining remains a strong lever for capability reshaping, especially for context extension and distribution realignment. Second, SFT, math annealing, DPO, and GRPO are treated as staged components with different roles, not as a flat stack of standard post-training tricks. Third, the paper is explicit that an older base model limits the ceiling of RL-based reasoning gains. That is an important reminder: post-training can substantially alter behavior, but it cannot fully replace reasoning-friendly pretraining choices. This makes the work more of an open recipe and an honest case study than a conceptual breakthrough.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system is built as a five-stage adaptation pipeline. The base is Italia 10B, a from-scratch dense decoder-only Transformer trained on about 9T tokens across 50+ languages, with a native 16K context. Architecturally it is fairly standard for its size: 40 layers, hidden size 4096, GQA with 48 query heads and 8 KV heads, RoPE, squared ReLU MLPs, no dropout, and untied embeddings. Stage 1 is continued pretraining to extend the native context from 16,384 to 32,768 tokens, with the RoPE base reset to 500,000 at that boundary. This is not just positional extrapolation; it is meant to let the model adapt its attention behavior under a new length distribution. At inference time, YaRN is then used to stretch the context further to 131,072 tokens. Stage 2 is large-scale SFT on a 12.3B-token instruction mixture, followed by a short math-focused annealing run before RL. That annealing step is important: it narrows the policy toward verifiable reasoning before entering a higher-variance RL phase. Stage 3 applies GRPO with verifiable rewards, initially on math. Stage 4 inserts DPO under what the paper calls the Delta Learning Hypothesis, suggesting DPO is used as a preference-boundary correction step rather than as a replacement for RL. Stage 5 runs multi-environment GRPO over five domains: mathematics, code, multiple-choice QA, instruction following, and tool calling. The intent is to avoid over-specializing the policy to a single reward shape. The model is also exposed in dual inference modes, thinking on and thinking off, indicating that the chat template and decoding interface were designed with explicit reasoning-token control in mind.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section is relatively restrained, which makes it more useful. Domyn-Small is compared against Qwen3.5-9B, OLMo-3-7B-Think, Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Nano-8B-v1, and Ministral-3-8B-Reasoning-2512. The headline result is not absolute accuracy leadership but an accuracy-efficiency balance: on reasoning benchmarks, Domyn-Small reportedly uses about one-third as many output tokens per problem as Qwen3.5-9B on average, which matters directly for serving cost. In accuracy terms, it outperforms Nemotron-Nano and Ministral on instruction following and GPQA-Diamond, is roughly on par with Ministral on AIME 2025, and trails Qwen3.5-9B and OLMo-3-7B-Think by a clear margin on hard math reasoning. The paper attributes that gap to two factors: the RL phase had not fully converged at the checkpoint used for evaluation, and the base model predates the recent wave of reasoning-oriented pretraining practices. That explanation is plausible and also useful, because it prevents over-reading post-training gains as if they were unconstrained. On context length, the setup is also informative: 32K native context after CPT, then 128K-class inference via YaRN. This is a pragmatic compromise rather than full native ultra-long-context pretraining.
summary_en.reading_guide: If you care about how post-training feeds back into foundation-model design, this is worth a medium-depth read. Start with the introduction and pipeline overview to understand why the team chose adaptation over retraining. Then focus on Section 3.2 for context extension: CPT data, length distribution, and the RoPE-base transition are the most relevant parts for continued-pretraining practitioners. After that, read Sections 4.1 to 4.4 carefully, especially the role of math annealing, the design of verifiable-reward GRPO, why DPO is inserted in the middle, and how the multi-environment GRPO setup is constructed. In the results, pay attention not only to benchmark accuracy but also to mean tokens per problem, since that is a deployment-facing metric with real operational consequences. A solid first pass should take about 45 minutes; if you work on small-to-mid-size model adaptation, the appendix-level details on data mixture, rewards, and hyperparameters are worth the extra time.
summary_en.authors_note: iGenius / Domyn team, trained and evaluated with CINECA’s Leonardo supercomputer. The paper explicitly mentions the collaboration with CINECA and the open-sourcing of Domyn Swarm for HPC-based synthetic data generation and evaluation. The full author list is not available in the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 读训练 recipe 表和 RL 阶段即可；不是新范式，但能校准 10B 级开源 reasoning 模型的现实配方。
recommendation.en: Skim the recipe and RL stages; not a new paradigm, but useful calibration for practical 10B-class reasoning-model training.

paper.title: The Devil is in the Spectrum: Mitigating Representation Collapse in LLMs via Topologically Regularized Side-Path
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are fundamentally limited by representation collapse, a bottleneck that severely degrades long-context performance. We identify that existing approaches risk drifting into one of two pathological extremes: homogenization collapse (e.g., attention sinks causing rank deficiency) and isolation collapse (e.g., local attention causing context disconnection). Through spectral analysis of attention dynamics, we derive an intrinsic trade-off between mixing efficiency (spectr

summary.core_problem: 长上下文Transformer的注意力机制存在两类极端表征崩溃——过度混合导致的均质化崩溃（如注意力Sink现象，表征秩极低）与混合不足导致的隔离崩溃（如局部注意力，远距信息断开），标准注意力设计无法在谱层面同时兼顾混合效率与信息容量，难以规避两类病理。
summary.importance: 将此前分散讨论的注意力Sink、秩崩溃、局部注意力信息隔离等现象统一到注意力转移算子的谱分析框架下，推导了谱间隙（混合效率）与有效秩（信息容量）的定量权衡关系，为理解深度Transformer堆叠过程中的信息传播退化提供了统一的分析视角；提出的非侵入式侧路方案工程改动量小，为长上下文架构改进提供了可参考的方向，但目前公开结果缺少大规模从零预训练验证，结论的普适性有待确认。
summary.technical_approach: 首先对注意力的行归一化转移算子做奇异值分解，推导得到有效秩与谱间隙的定量关系：提升谱间隙会天然压缩奇异值尾部能量、降低有效秩，若不显式保留尾部谱分量，模型必然落入两类崩溃之一。基于该权衡提出拓扑正则化侧路（TRSP）：在不改动原有注意力计算的前提下，并行加入一条无参数的Triangular Box分支，通过级联因果盒式滤波、随层指数扩张带宽，构建从近邻耦合到远距捷径的多尺度传播路径；再搭配仅含约50个可学习参数的长上下文门控，根据上下文长度和层深度调节侧路注入强度，引导算子达到谱平衡。
summary.experiments: 在MMLU、HellaSwag等通用能力基准（后训练场景）和RULER、NoLiMa等长上下文外推基准（覆盖持续预训练和后训练场景）上测试，TRSP未造成通用能力明显下降；在8倍训练长度的NoLiMa长上下文外推测试中保持83%准确率，比Differential Transformer、Gated Attention分别高约30和50个百分点；谱测量显示TRSP可同时提升转移算子的谱间隙和有效秩，避免两类崩溃极端。目前公开的正文内容未涉及大规模从零开始预训练的验证结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计阅读时间20分钟。重点关注引言和方法开头的谱分析部分，尤其是两类表征崩溃的统一刻画、谱间隙与有效秩的权衡推导，这是最具参考价值的概念性洞见；TRSP的具体实现和实验部分可快速浏览，注意其缺少大规模预训练验证的局限性，无需深究工程实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context Transformer attention suffers from two extreme forms of representation collapse—homogenization collapse from over-mixing (e.g., attention sinks, extremely low representation rank) and isolation collapse from under-mixing (e.g., local attention, disconnected long-range information flow)—and standard attention designs cannot spectrally balance mixing efficiency and information capacity to avoid both pathologies.
summary_en.importance: This work unifies previously disconnected observations of attention sinks, rank collapse, and local attention information isolation under a single spectral analysis framework for the attention transition operator, and derives a quantitative trade-off between spectral gap (mixing efficiency) and effective rank (information capacity). This unified view provides useful intuition for understanding information propagation degradation in deep Transformer stacks. The proposed non-invasive side-path intervention requires minimal engineering changes and offers a practical direction for long-context architecture improvements, though available results lack large-scale from-scratch pretraining validation, so the generality of conclusions remains unconfirmed.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors perform singular value decomposition on the row-normalized attention transition operator, deriving a quantitative relationship between effective rank and spectral gap: increasing spectral gap naturally suppresses tail energy in the singular value distribution and reduces effective rank, so any mechanism that does not explicitly preserve tail spectral components will fall into one of the two collapse regimes. The proposed Topologically Regularized Side-Path (TRSP) runs parallel to unmodified standard attention computations. It consists of two parts: (1) a parameter-free Triangular Box operator, implemented as cascaded causal box filters with exponentially increasing bandwidth across layers, creating a multi-scale propagation path from local proximal coupling to long-distance shortcuts; (2) a lightweight long-context gate with approximately 50 learnable parameters, which adjusts side-path injection strength based on context length and layer depth to steer the operator toward spectral balance.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations cover general capability benchmarks (MMLU, HellaSwag, tested in post-training scenarios) and long-context extrapolation benchmarks (RULER, NoLiMa, tested in both continued pretraining and post-training scenarios). TRSP introduces no measurable degradation to general capabilities. On NoLiMa tests at 8x the training context length, TRSP retains 83% accuracy, outperforming Differential Transformer and Gated Attention by roughly 30 and 50 percentage points respectively. Spectral measurements confirm TRSP jointly improves spectral gap and effective rank, avoiding both collapse extremes. The publicly available portion of the paper does not report results from large-scale from-scratch pretraining with the proposed method.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in approximately 20 minutes. Focus on the spectral analysis in the introduction and early methodology sections, particularly the unified characterization of the two representation collapse pathologies and the derivation of the spectral gap / effective rank trade-off, which is the most conceptually useful contribution. The concrete TRSP implementation and experiment sections can be scanned quickly, with attention to the limitation that no large-scale from-scratch pretraining results are provided; deep engagement with implementation details is not necessary at this stage.

recommendation.zh: 谱分析视角拆解表征坍缩的两种极端和内在权衡，机制部分值得看；TRSP方案偏工程修补，重点读§3谱分析和Fig.2。
recommendation.en: The spectral decomposition of two collapse modes and their intrinsic trade-off is the valuable part; focus on §3 spectral analysis and Fig. 2, while TRSP itself is more of an engineering patch.

paper.title: Naju: A Native Discrete State-Space Model with Independent Retention and Writing for Long-Sequence Memory
paper.abstract: Long-sequence memory tracking places two opposing demands on a recurrent state: near-lossless retention of stored bindings over long horizons, and active overwriting of stale ones. In our diagnostic suite, the strongest efficient baselines tend to solve only one side well. Continuous-time-parameterized state-space models (SSMs) such as Mamba obtain their discrete recurrence by zero-order-hold discretization of a continuous-time system; we argue that this detour is unnecessary for memory tracking

summary.core_problem: 长序列记忆跟踪对循环状态提出了两个相互矛盾的要求：长程上近乎无损地保留已存储的绑定，同时又能果断覆盖过时的绑定。现有基于连续时间零阶保持（ZOH）离散化的 SSM（如 Mamba）以及带互补门控的变体，在参数化上把保留（retention）和写入（write）耦合在一起，无法在同一步独立控制两者。
summary.importance: 对长上下文序列建模架构有直接启发。论文把一个常被忽略的设计选择——从连续时间系统出发再离散化——重新摆到台面上，指出对离散 token 序列而言，直接参数化离散递推可能更合适。解耦保留/写入门的思路与 LSTM 记忆细胞的直觉相通，但以 selective SSM + associative scan 的形式实现，兼顾线性时间复杂度与硬件友好性，为长记忆 SSM 架构提供了一个干净的替代设计点。
summary.technical_approach: Naju（Native Adaptive Junction Unit）放弃连续时间生成器 A、步长 Δ、矩阵指数和 ZOH 映射，直接在离散域参数化对角 selective SSM 的递推：x_n = f_n ⊙ x_{n-1} + i_n ⊙ (B_n u_n)，其中 f_n = σ(·) 是独立的遗忘门（即离散递推极点），i_n = σ(·) 是独立的输入门，C_n^T x_n 做输入相关的读出。这样 f_n → 1 时可以实现近恒等保留而不压低写入幅度；f_n → 0、i_n → 1 时可以果断覆盖旧状态；两者同时较大时可以在保留旧状态的同时写入新信息。整个递推保持对角、输入相关、与并行扫描兼容，因此保留了 Mamba 类 SSM 的线性时间与高效实现特性。论文还诊断了两类耦合来源：ZOH 下 Δ 同时影响 Ā_n = exp(ΔA) 和离散输入映射，使极点趋近恒等时写入尺度也被压缩；外加互补门时 (1−g_n) 作为亚单位因子进入保留路径，同一 g_n 同时控制写入增强与保留抑制。
summary.experiments: 论文构建了一个长序列记忆跟踪诊断套件，覆盖绑定的长期保留、过时值的覆盖更新等场景，对比了多种强效率基线（Mamba 等）。结果显示现有高效基线往往只在保留或覆盖单侧表现良好，而 Naju 能同时做好两者。具体数值与通用语言建模上的规模性结果在节选内容中未给出，主要证据集中在合成记忆诊断任务上的行为差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看引言和方法部分对两类耦合（ZOH 耦合、互补门耦合）的推导，这是论文最有价值的分析贡献；再看诊断实验中不同模型在保留 vs 覆盖上的行为对比。通用 LM / 多规模 scaling 结果若后续正文有补充，可再回头查阅。值得深挖的点：直接离散参数化在语言建模预训练上是否真的比 ZOH 路线更优，以及独立门引入的额外参数/优化难度在大模型下的表现。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-sequence memory tracking imposes two conflicting demands on a recurrent state: near-lossless retention of stored bindings over long horizons, and decisive overwriting of stale bindings. Existing continuous-time SSMs that rely on zero-order-hold (ZOH) discretization (e.g., Mamba), as well as variants with complementary gating, couple retention and write strength in their parameterization so that the two cannot be controlled independently at the same step.
summary_en.importance: Directly relevant to long-context sequence modeling architectures. The paper reopens an often-overlooked design choice: starting from a continuous-time system and then discretizing. For discrete token sequences, parameterizing the discrete recurrence directly may be the more natural option. Decoupling the retain and write gates echoes the LSTM memory-cell intuition, but implements it as a selective, diagonal, associative-scan-compatible SSM, preserving linear-time complexity and hardware efficiency while offering a clean alternative design point for long-memory SSMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Naju (Native Adaptive Junction Unit) drops the continuous-time generator A, step size Δ, matrix exponential, and ZOH map, and directly parameterizes a diagonal selective SSM recurrence in discrete time: x_n = f_n ⊙ x_{n-1} + i_n ⊙ (B_n u_n), where f_n = σ(·) is an independent forget gate (the discrete recurrent pole), i_n = σ(·) is an independent input gate, and C_n^T x_n performs input-dependent readout. With f_n → 1 the model achieves near-identity retention without shrinking the write magnitude; with f_n → 0 and i_n → 1 it decisively overwrites stale state; with both gates large it preserves old state while writing new information. The recurrence remains diagonal, input-dependent, and parallel-scan compatible, retaining Mamba-style linear-time efficiency. The paper also diagnoses two coupling sources: under ZOH, Δ affects both Ā_n = exp(ΔA) and the discretized input map, so pushing the pole toward identity also compresses the write scale; under an external complementary gate, (1−g_n) acts as a subunit factor on the retention path, so the same g_n strengthens writes while suppressing retention.
summary_en.experiments: The paper introduces a diagnostic suite for long-sequence memory tracking covering long-horizon retention of bindings and overwriting of stale values, comparing against strong efficient baselines including Mamba. Existing efficient baselines tend to solve only one side well, while Naju handles both simultaneously. Concrete numbers at scale on general language modeling are not included in the excerpt; the main evidence is behavioral, on synthetic memory diagnostics.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the introduction and method sections, especially the derivations of the two coupling sources (ZOH coupling and complementary-gate coupling)—this is the paper's most useful analytical contribution. Then look at the diagnostic experiments contrasting retention vs. overwriting behavior across models. If the full paper includes general LM or scaling results, revisit those sections. A natural follow-up question is whether direct discrete parameterization actually outperforms the ZOH route in large-scale LM pretraining, and how the extra gates affect optimization at scale.

recommendation.zh: 直接参数化离散递归、绕开连续SSM离散化的思路值得在内部长上下文架构ablation中复现，重点看 §3 分解式与 §4 稳定性证明。
recommendation.en: The idea of directly parameterizing discrete recurrences (bypassing continuous-SSM discretization) is worth reproducing in internal long-context ablations; focus on §3 factorization and §4 stability proofs.

paper.title: Windowed-MTP: Removing the Full-Context Draft-KV Tax at Million-Token Context
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by having a cheap draft propose tokens that a target verifies in parallel. Frontier models increasingly ship a built-in Multi-Token-Prediction (MTP/NEXTN) draft head under the assumption that the draft is negligibly cheap. At million-token context this breaks: an MTP draft head typically runs full attention over the entire KV cache at every draft step, so its read grows linearly with context and comes to dominate the draft cost -- precis

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是长上下文 speculative decoding 里一个被低估的瓶颈：内置 MTP/NEXTN draft head 在百万 token 上下文下并不“便宜”。虽然 target verify 端越来越多采用 hybrid 或 linear attention 来压低长上下文成本，但很多原生 draft head 仍然对全量 KV cache 做 full attention。结果是 draft 每走一步都要线性读取整段上下文，context 越长、draft 越深，这部分 draft-KV read tax 越重，甚至会把 speculative decoding 的净收益吃掉，在低 acceptance 的难任务上比不做 speculation 还慢。论文的核心问题不是如何提高 acceptance，而是如何去掉这个 full-context draft tax，同时保持 exact speculation 的正确性。
summary.importance: 对 serving 和模型共设计来说，这篇工作很重要，因为它指出了一个现实偏差：很多 speculative decoding 的成本模型默认 draft 近似免费，这在短上下文成立，但在 1M context 已经失真。更关键的是，随着 target 侧转向 hybrid/linear attention，这个失真会更严重，因为 verify 变便宜后，draft 的全上下文 attention 反而暴露成主成本。论文给出的方案很简单，但意义不小：只改 draft 的注意力工作集，不改 verify，因此不碰 exactness；不需要训练、蒸馏或额外参数，属于可以直接落地的系统改造。对预训练研究员的启发在于，内置 draft head 的设计不能只看短上下文吞吐，也要看与 target attention 形态是否匹配；否则 native MTP 在长上下文下会出现架构失配。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 Windowed-MTP。核心思想是把 StreamingLLM 风格的 sliding window + attention sink 只应用在 draft head 上，而 target verify 仍然保留全上下文注意力。这样 draft 每一步只读取 W + sink 个 token 的 KV，而不是整段 S 长度上下文；例如 1M context 下 4K window 只占 0.4%。

为什么这能做到“lossless by construction”？因为 speculative decoding 的接受与否始终由 full-attention target 决定。windowing 只会改变 draft 提出的候选 token，不会改变 target 的验证规则，因此不会改变最终采样分布。论文还专门做了 greedy output diff，验证 windowed draft 与 native full-attention draft 的最终输出没有系统性分歧，超出范围的差异只来自 verifier 既有的 bf16 非确定性。

作者还给了一个逐步 latency model，把一次 speculative iteration 分成 γ 次 draft forward 和一次 verify forward，并分析在不同 acceptance length、draft depth d=γ+1、context length S 下，什么时候 native deep draft 会从加速退化到与 dense baseline 持平，甚至变成负收益。这个模型的意义在于，它不是只报告“快了多少”，而是解释为什么在长上下文、低 acceptance、verify 变便宜时，draft attention 会成为主导项。

机制分析部分也做得比较扎实。作者没有停留在“窗口够小也没掉速”这种经验结论，而是看了 window-size dose-response、每个 draft position 的 conditional acceptance 分解，以及 in-run decision-invariance probe。结论是：windowing 大多数时候并不改变 draft 的 top-1 proposal，保留了与 full-attention draft 相近的 acceptance profile，因此速度收益来自每步成本下降，而不是靠牺牲 acceptance 换吞吐。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖三类架构：至少包括 dense Qwen-122B、hybrid Nemotron，以及另一类不同 attention 家族模型。重点都放在 1M context、batch size 1 的长上下文 decode。

首先，论文量化了 long-context draft-attention tax。在 γ=6、也就是 d=7 的设定下，仅 draft phase 相对 bare verify 就额外增加了 +92% 到 +138% 的每步成本，几乎把一次 decode step 的代价翻倍。这说明“draft 很便宜”的假设在百万上下文下已经不成立。更关键的是，在 hard、low-acceptance workload 上，原生 native draft 会出现净负收益：例如 Qwen-122B code QA 上 d=7 只有 0.80× no-speculation dense baseline，Nemotron hybrid 上是 0.97×；把 draft 加深到 d=9 也救不回来。

Windowed-MTP 的收益比较稳定。在 1M context 下，相对 native MTP，每个 speculative iteration 的 per-step cost 降低约 28%–44%，而且这个收益基本 input-invariant，大小与“draft 成本里有多少是可窗口化 attention”一致。作者还测了 draft KV pool 占总 KV 的比例，在三种模型上约为 7.7%–11%；windowing 之后，除了 W+sink 之外的 draft KV 都变成 dead state，可以回收到一个紧凑 ring buffer，且没有质量或速度副作用。

接受率方面，windowing 对 draft top-1 proposal 的保持率达到 86%–94%，整体 acceptance 曲线与 full-attention draft 在置信区间内接近。残余差异存在，但量级小、符号依赖输入和 draft depth，而且始终被每步成本下降带来的收益覆盖，所以端到端结果没有回退。论文还强调，这种改造在 exactness 上没有妥协，因为 target verify 完全不变。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合精读。先看 Introduction 和 Section 3，抓住作者提出的成本分解：speculative decoding 在长上下文下的问题不只是 acceptance 不够高，而是 draft 自身的 full-context attention 已经成为主要瓶颈。这里的 latency model 值得仔细看，它能帮助判断 native MTP 什么时候会从加速器变成负担。

然后重点读方法部分，尤其是“为什么只窗口化 draft 仍然保持 exactness”。很多人会把这类近似和 lossless 混在一起，这篇文章把边界讲得很清楚：近似发生在 proposal，正确性由 verifier 兜底。接着看 acceptance 机制分析，特别是 window-size sweep、per-position conditional acceptance 和 decision-invariance probe，这几部分解释了为什么 4K 级别窗口已经足够支撑 draft 的局部猜测。

实验上建议重点看 Table 13 一类展示 native draft 变成 net-negative 的结果，以及 1M context 下 28%–44% per-step 降幅的主表。若只想抓主线，读完引言、成本模型、主实验和 exactness 验证，大约 45–60 分钟。若要深挖，值得思考两个延伸问题：一是预训练阶段是否应该显式约束 draft head 的局部性，让它天然适配 windowed inference；二是当 target 进一步转向 linear/hybrid attention 时，draft 与 target 的 attention family 是否也应该共同设计，而不是把 full-attention MTP 直接挂在一个更便宜的 verifier 上。
summary.authors_note: NVIDIA 相关工作。正文里给出了 SGLang patch 和复现实验仓库，作者名单在提供内容中未完整展开。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific but increasingly important bottleneck in long-context speculative decoding: built-in MTP/NEXTN draft heads are not cheap at million-token context. While target models are moving toward hybrid or linear attention to reduce long-context verification cost, many native draft heads still run full attention over the entire KV cache at every draft step. That makes draft cost scale linearly with context, and the deeper the draft chain, the worse the tax. On hard workloads with low acceptance, the native draft can erase the speedup of speculation and even become slower than plain decoding. The paper asks how to remove this full-context draft-KV tax without sacrificing the exactness guarantee of speculative decoding.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong systems paper with direct implications for model-serving co-design. It exposes a mismatch in the standard speculative-decoding cost model: treating the draft as negligible is fine at short context, but wrong at 1M tokens. The mismatch becomes sharper as the verifier gets cheaper through hybrid or linear attention. The proposed fix is simple and deployable: restrict only the draft’s attention working set, keep verification unchanged, and preserve exact decoding by construction. For pretraining-oriented readers, the broader lesson is that native draft-head design should be evaluated jointly with the target’s attention family and long-context operating regime; otherwise an apparently lightweight MTP head can become architecturally misaligned at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Windowed-MTP, applies a StreamingLLM-style sliding window plus attention sink to the draft head only, while leaving the target verifier at full attention. As a result, each draft forward reads only W + sink tokens from KV instead of the full context length S. At 1M context, a 4K window is only 0.4% of the sequence.

The key point is why this remains lossless. In speculative decoding, the target verifier always decides which proposed tokens are accepted. Windowing changes only the draft proposals, not the acceptance rule. Therefore the final output distribution remains identical to standard exact speculation. The paper validates this with greedy output diffs, showing no systematic divergence beyond the verifier’s existing bf16 nondeterminism.

The authors also provide a per-step latency model. One speculative iteration is decomposed into γ draft forwards plus one verify forward, and the model explains when a deeper native draft stops helping: long context increases draft KV reads, low acceptance reduces amortization, and cheaper verify phases expose the draft cost instead of hiding it. This is useful because the paper does not merely report speedups; it explains the regime in which native MTP collapses from accelerator to liability.
