The mechanistic analysis is also stronger than usual. The paper studies window-size dose response, conditional acceptance by draft position, and an in-run decision-invariance probe. The conclusion is that windowing usually preserves the draft’s top-1 proposal and closely tracks the full-attention acceptance profile. The gain therefore comes from reducing per-step draft cost, not from trading away acceptance for throughput.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments span three architecture families, including at least a dense Qwen-122B model, a hybrid Nemotron model, and a third model with a different attention design. The main operating point is 1M context with batch size 1.

First, the paper quantifies the long-context draft-attention tax. At γ=6, i.e. d=7, the draft phase alone adds about +92% to +138% on top of the bare verify cost per decode step, nearly doubling step latency. This directly falsifies the assumption that the draft is negligible at million-token context. More importantly, on hard low-acceptance workloads the shipped native draft can become net-negative: at d=7 it reaches only 0.80× the no-speculation dense baseline on Qwen-122B code QA and 0.97× on the hybrid Nemotron. Increasing draft depth to d=9 does not rescue the situation.

Windowed-MTP then delivers a fairly consistent reduction. At 1M context, it cuts per-speculative-iteration cost by about 28%–44% relative to native MTP, and the gain is largely input-invariant. Its magnitude tracks the fraction of draft cost attributable to windowable attention. The paper also measures that the draft KV pool is about 7.7%–11% of total KV across the three models; after windowing, all but W + sink of that draft KV becomes dead state and can be reclaimed into a compact ring buffer with no quality or speed penalty.

On acceptance behavior, windowing preserves the draft top-1 proposal 86%–94% of the time, and the resulting acceptance profile tracks full-attention draft within confidence intervals across the sweep. Residual differences exist, but they are small, depend on input and draft depth, and are always outweighed by the per-step latency reduction. End-to-end performance therefore never regresses in the reported settings, while exactness is preserved because the verifier is unchanged.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one is worth a careful read. Start with the introduction and the latency decomposition section. The central insight is not simply that acceptance matters, but that full-context draft attention becomes the dominant cost at long context, especially when the verifier has already been optimized with hybrid or linear attention. The latency model is useful because it tells you when native MTP stops being a speedup mechanism.

Then read the method section with attention to the exactness argument. The paper is careful about the distinction between approximating the proposal path and preserving the final decoding distribution through full verification. That boundary is important. After that, spend time on the acceptance analysis: the window-size sweep, per-position conditional acceptance, and decision-invariance probe explain why a relatively small local window is enough for the draft to remain a good proposer.

For experiments, prioritize the tables showing native draft becoming net-negative and the main 1M-context latency reductions. A focused read of the introduction, cost model, main experiments, and exactness validation should take about 45–60 minutes. For deeper follow-up, two questions are especially interesting: whether pretraining should explicitly encourage locality in native draft heads so they are naturally compatible with windowed inference, and whether draft and verifier attention families should be co-designed rather than attaching a full-attention MTP head to an increasingly cheap hybrid/linear verifier.
summary_en.authors_note: Appears to be an NVIDIA-affiliated work. The provided text includes an SGLang patch and reproduction package, but the full author list is not visible in the supplied content.

recommendation.zh: 指出 MTP 在长上下文下的隐性税，是部署前沿模型必踩的坑；training-free 无损修复应立刻在内部长上下文 serving 栈里复现。
recommendation.en: Exposes a hidden tax of MTP at long context that every frontier serving stack will hit; the training-free lossless fix should be reproduced in your long-context serving stack immediately.

paper.title: Dropping the Anchor: Statistical Context Summarization for Distributed Systems via Pulsar Attention
paper.abstract: Inference with large language models (LLMs) on long sequences is computationally expensive due to the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Distributed blockwise methods such as Star Attention reduce this cost by sharding context across hosts, but rely on prepending a static, content-blind copy of the first block to every host. We propose Pulsar Attention, which replaces the static anchor with two lightweight, content-aware components: a small attention-sink prefix that stabilizes softmax, and

summary.core_problem: 长上下文推理中的分布式块式注意力通常依赖静态首块锚点，既内容盲又浪费算力；这篇工作要在不增加 KV cache 的前提下改进跨块摘要与稳定性。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的结构改进。价值不在于提出全新主干架构，而在于指出 blockwise long-context attention 里“固定 anchor”这个设计并不必要，内容感知摘要可以同时带来更低 FLOPs 和更好精度。对做长上下文 serving、分布式注意力和 attention sink 机制的人有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Pulsar Attention，用两个轻量组件替代 Star Attention 的静态 anchor：一是小型 attention-sink prefix，用来稳定 softmax；二是基于 Max-IDF 启发式的紧凑 cross-block summaries，优先选择包含全局稀有 token 的 chunk 作为跨块代表。这样在保持相同 KV cache footprint 的同时，减少 Phase 1 的每 GPU FLOPs。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama-3.1-8B 上，于 RULER 和 BABILong 做最长 128K token 的评测。相对 Star Attention，Phase 1 per-GPU FLOPs 最多下降 3.3×；相对 dense attention 和 Star Attention，在长序列上都有更好结果，摘要称对 dense baseline 的绝对提升最高可达 4.7%。实验聚焦推理阶段，没有训练侧分析。

summary_en.core_problem: Distributed blockwise attention for long-context inference often relies on a static first-block anchor that is content-blind and compute-inefficient; this paper tries to improve cross-block summarization and stability without increasing KV cache.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper with a structural tweak. The value is not a new backbone, but the argument that the fixed anchor in blockwise long-context attention is unnecessary: content-aware summaries can reduce FLOPs while improving accuracy. It is directly relevant to long-context serving, distributed attention, and attention-sink design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pulsar Attention replaces the static anchor in Star Attention with two lightweight components: a small attention-sink prefix to stabilize softmax, and compact cross-block summaries built with a Max-IDF heuristic that selects chunks containing globally rare tokens. This keeps the KV-cache footprint unchanged while reducing per-GPU Phase-1 FLOPs.
summary_en.experiments: Using Llama-3.1-8B on RULER and BABILong up to 128K tokens, the method reports up to 3.3× lower Phase-1 per-GPU FLOPs than Star Attention. It also outperforms both Star Attention and dense attention on long-sequence evaluations, with up to 4.7% absolute gains over the dense baseline. The study is inference-only and does not analyze training-time effects.

recommendation.zh: 不是范式级工作，但它把“首块静态锚点”这个默认设计拆掉了；若你做长上下文 serving，只看方法图和 RULER/BABILong 表就够。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but it usefully challenges the default static-anchor design in blockwise attention; for long-context serving, the method figure and the RULER/BABILong tables are enough.

paper.title: ArbiGraph: Arbitrarily Scalable Verifiable Task Graphs for Evaluating Context Management
paper.abstract: We introduce ARBIGRAPH, a benchmark generator for evaluating whether tool-assisted language agents can retain, update, compose, and discard task-relevant context across extended reasoning workflows. ARBIGRAPH represents each task as a natural-language problem with an executable Python solver, and composes tasks through typed intermediate states, instantiated here as scalar and list values. This design enables controllable task graphs whose length, dependency structure, distractor count, and valu

summary.core_problem: 现有Agent评测难以精确控制任务复杂度与依赖结构，无法系统评估LLM在长推理工作流中的上下文管理能力。
summary.importance: 提出首个可任意扩展、可自动验证的任务图benchmark生成器，可系统评测上下文管理的不同维度，属于评测方法与工具创新。
summary.technical_approach: 将每个任务表示为带可执行Python求解器的自然语言问题，通过类型化中间状态（标量、列表）组合成任务图，可灵活调整任务长度、依赖结构、干扰项数量、值类型，通过执行求解器实现精确自动验证。
summary.experiments: 用数学、GSM应用题、Python追踪三类任务实例化，在四种拓扑结构上评测Qwen3.5-27B工具辅助Agent，发现分支依赖的数学任务上准确率最多下降33.3%，单任务评测无法暴露这类缺陷。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含Gennady Pekhimenko（多伦多大学，ML系统与高效计算方向）、Mark C. Jeffrey（多伦多大学，计算机系统方向）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent benchmarks cannot precisely control task complexity and dependency structure, making it hard to systematically evaluate LLMs' context management abilities in extended reasoning workflows.
summary_en.importance: First arbitrarily scalable, automatically verifiable task graph benchmark generator for systematic evaluation of context management dimensions; represents evaluation methodology and tool innovation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each task is a natural-language problem with an executable Python solver; tasks are composed via typed intermediate states (scalars, lists) into task graphs with adjustable length, dependency structure, distractor count, and value type, enabling exact automatic verification via solver execution.
summary_en.experiments: Instantiated with math, GSM-style word problems, and Python tracing tasks; evaluates Qwen3.5-27B tool-assisted agent across four topologies, finding up to 33.3% accuracy drop on branching dependent math tasks — failures not exposed by single-task benchmarks.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Gennady Pekhimenko (University of Toronto, ML systems and efficient computing) and Mark C. Jeffrey (University of Toronto, computer systems).

recommendation.zh: 可控任务图评测上下文管理能力，设计干净，预训练研究员可参考其评测范式验证模型长上下文依赖能力，重点看§3任务构造。
recommendation.en: Cleanly designed controllable task graph benchmark for context management; pretraining researchers can reference its paradigm to test long-context dependency abilities, focus on §3 task construction.

paper.title: REFACT: Adaptive Fact Restatement for Compact and Faithful Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models increasingly rely on long-form reasoning for complex tasks, yet their reasoning traces may drift away from the supplied context when evidence is sparse, noisy, or in conflict with parametric knowledge. Existing grounding methods either attach citations after generation or encourage evidence retrieval inside the trace, but they often do not ensure that cited content is sufficient for the local inference and final answer. We propose REFACT, an adaptive fact-restatement citati

summary.core_problem: 解决长链式推理在上下文证据稀疏、噪声或与参数知识冲突时，推理轨迹脱离给定证据的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是后训练和 grounded reasoning 方法。它把 citation 从生成后的附属标记改成推理中的中间状态，目标是让每一步局部推理都有足够、可追溯的事实支撑。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 REFACT，自适应判断某个推理步骤是否需要 grounding，以及需要以什么粒度复述源事实。训练采用两阶段 SFT-to-RL pipeline；RL 阶段使用 citation-utility reward，鼓励引用事实格式良好、能追溯到来源，并足以支持答案。
summary.experiments: 在 LongBench、LV-Eval 等长上下文评测上实验。摘要说明 REFACT 对 unsupported inference 和 indiscriminate fact copying 都有抑制作用，但未提供模型规模、训练集规模、baseline 列表和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses drift in long-form reasoning traces when contextual evidence is sparse, noisy, or conflicts with a model’s parametric knowledge.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method for grounded reasoning. It turns citations from post-hoc annotations into answer-supporting intermediate states, aiming to make local inference steps sufficiently grounded in source facts.
summary_en.technical_approach: REFACT adaptively decides when a reasoning step needs grounding and at what granularity source facts should be restated. It uses a two-stage SFT-to-RL pipeline, with a citation-utility reward that encourages cited facts to be well formed, source traceable, and sufficient for the answer.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on LongBench, LV-Eval, and related long-context benchmarks. The abstract reports improvements in reducing unsupported inference and indiscriminate copying, but does not provide model sizes, training data scale, full baselines, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 这是 post-train grounding recipe，不改预训练 prior；若做长上下文 SFT/RL，只读 reward 定义和失败案例。
recommendation.en: This is a post-training grounding recipe, not a pretraining result; if you train long-context SFT/RL models, read the reward design and failure cases.

paper.title: Agentic Context Management: Solving Agent Memory and Cost by Treating Them as Lifecycle and Architecture Problems
paper.abstract: Production AI agents' failures are less often due to an inability to reason well and more often because they cannot manage what is in their reasoning context: conversation histories, large prompts, large tool definitions, and ballooning tool outputs. Agents drown in their own accumulating history while paying a token cost that grows every turn, producing missing recalls within and across conversations. The incumbent response treats this as a storage-and-retrieval problem. We argue that framing i

summary.core_problem: 生产环境 Agent 失败常源于上下文管理（历史累积、工具输出膨胀、token 成本随轮次线性增长），而非推理能力本身。
summary.importance: 提出将 Agent 记忆/上下文视为生命周期与架构问题而非单纯存储检索问题的视角，给出工程化分层框架。
summary.technical_approach: 把上下文管理拆成 decide what to remember / extract & structure / per-type store / consolidate & forget / relevance selection / anticipation / compaction 等阶段，并引入组织级 scope 层级。
summary.experiments: 论文为立场/框架性文章，未给出定量实验与模型对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Production agent failures often stem from context management (accumulating history, bloated tool outputs, per-turn token cost growth) rather than weak reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Reframes agent memory as a lifecycle-and-architecture problem rather than storage-and-retrieval, proposing a layered engineering framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decomposes context management into stages: what to remember, extraction/structuring, typed stores, consolidation/forgetting with provenance, relevance selection, next-need anticipation, and budgeted compaction, plus organizational scope hierarchy.
summary_en.experiments: Position/architecture paper; no quantitative experiments or model comparisons reported.

recommendation.zh: 工程视角的清单式文章，没有实验；做长上下文/Agent serving 的人扫一眼框架即可，预训练侧基本无新信息。
recommendation.en: A checklist-style engineering position piece with no experiments; skim the framework if you build long-context agent serving, otherwise skip for pretrain.

paper.title: Solar Open 2 Technical Report
paper.abstract: We present Solar Open 2, a 250B-A15B Mixture-of-Experts language model built for long-horizon agentic tasks, scaled up from Solar Open 1 (Solar Open 100B). To hold entire agent trajectories in a single context, Solar Open 2 reaches a 1M-token window through a hybrid attention stack that interleaves one softmax layer among every three linear-attention layers, using no positional encoding and a gated delta rule extended to negative eigenvalues. To train at this scale under a fixed compute budget,

summary.core_problem: 在固定计算预算下训练一个面向长程agent任务的250B-A15B MoE语言模型，并把上下文窗口扩到1M token。
summary.importance: 这是一个大模型技术报告，价值主要在三点：长上下文架构、跨架构初始化、以及按token价值做预训练数据筛选和配比。它直接触及预训练研究中的架构-数据-计算预算取舍。
summary.technical_approach: Solar Open 2采用混合注意力栈：每三个线性注意力层插入一个softmax注意力层，不使用位置编码，并把gated delta rule扩展到负特征值场景。训练上从Solar Open 1迁移5.69B共享骨架参数，其余部分继续完整预训练。数据上从20T token池中做质量、稀有度感知筛选和mixture-ratio优化，形成10T token训练混合。
summary.experiments: 模型规模为250B总参数、15B激活参数，目标上下文长度为1M token。摘要称10T高价值混合在相同token预算下优于未说明的对照混合，并以Solar Open 1作为起点；具体benchmark、消融和长上下文稳定性结果需要看正文表格。

summary_en.core_problem: The report describes how to train a 250B-A15B MoE language model for long-horizon agentic workloads with a 1M-token context window under a fixed compute budget.
summary_en.importance: The main value is the combination of long-context architecture, cross-architecture warm start, and value-per-token data curation. These are central pretraining tradeoffs rather than downstream tuning details.
summary_en.technical_approach: Solar Open 2 uses a hybrid attention stack with one softmax attention layer interleaved after every three linear-attention layers, no positional encoding, and a gated delta rule extended to negative eigenvalues. It initializes the 5.69B-parameter shared skeleton from Solar Open 1 and pretrains the remaining parameters. Its data pipeline refines a 20T-token pool into a 10T-token mixture using quality, rarity, and mixture-ratio optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The model is reported as 250B total parameters with 15B active parameters and a 1M-token context length. The abstract claims that the curated 10T-token mixture outperforms alternatives at equal token budget, but detailed benchmark numbers and ablations are not present in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 应看架构和数据消融：1M上下文若能靠3:1线性/softmax混合稳住，值得立刻纳入内部长上下文预训练对照。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture and data ablations: if the 3:1 linear/softmax stack really holds at 1M context, it belongs in internal long-context pretraining comparisons.

paper.title: AdaRoPE: Not All Attention Heads Should Rotate and Scale Equally
paper.abstract: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) is widely adopted in Transformers to encode positional information, yet standard implementations enforce a uniform frequency schedule and scaling across all attention heads. Using simplified retrieval tasks and length generalization scenarios, we show -- both empirically and theoretically -- that heads with different functional roles require distinct frequency ranges and attention scaling factors to operate effectively. Ignoring this structure leads to suboptimal

summary.core_problem: 标准 RoPE 对所有 attention head 使用同一套频率表和缩放规则，可能不适合不同 head 在检索、位置建模和长上下文泛化中的不同功能分工。
summary.importance: 这是一个直接作用于 LLM 架构和长上下文预训练的改动。贡献不在于提出新的训练数据或 recipe，而是把 RoPE 的频率和 attention scaling 从全局固定设计改成 head-wise 可学习设计，挑战了“所有 head 共享同一位置编码谱”的默认做法。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先用简化检索任务和长度泛化场景分析不同 head 对旋转频率范围和 attention 缩放因子的需求差异，再提出 AdaRoPE：为每个 attention head 配置可学习的 rotation frequencies 和 attention scaling factors。它属于对 RoPE 参数化方式的结构性改造，也可用于上下文扩展场景，修正 YaRN 等方法中的统一频率缩放和统一 attention 缩放假设。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖简化检索任务、长度泛化场景，以及采用 AdaRoPE 预训练的 LLM。摘要称 AdaRoPE 稳定优于已有 RoPE 变体，包括 partial RoPE 和 NoPE baseline；在上下文扩展中，统一频率和 attention scaling 的方法表现为次优。给定信息中未提供模型规模、训练 token 数和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard RoPE applies the same frequency schedule and scaling rule to all attention heads, which may mismatch the different functional roles heads play in retrieval, position tracking, and long-context generalization.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is directly relevant to LLM architecture and long-context pretraining. It changes the parameterization of positional encoding from a global fixed spectrum to head-wise learnable frequency and attention scaling, questioning the default assumption that all heads should share the same positional spectrum.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper analyzes simplified retrieval and length-generalization settings to show that heads need different frequency ranges and scaling factors. AdaRoPE then assigns learnable rotation frequencies and attention scaling factors to each attention head. The same idea is also applied to context extension, where it argues against uniform frequency and attention scaling used by methods such as YaRN.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments include synthetic retrieval tasks, length-generalization scenarios, and LLMs pretrained with AdaRoPE. The abstract reports consistent gains over RoPE variants including partial RoPE and NoPE baselines, and finds uniform scaling suboptimal for context extension. Model sizes, token budgets, and exact effect sizes are not available in the provided excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 头级 RoPE 参数化值得在长上下文预训练消融里复现；若收益只来自扩参，结论会打折。
recommendation.en: Head-wise RoPE parameterization is worth reproducing in long-context pretraining ablations; the claim weakens if the gain mostly comes from extra parameters.

paper.title: LISA: Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent advances in long chain-of-thought reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1 have led to increasingly longer inference context lengths under the test-time scaling paradigm. However, the O(n^2) computational complexity of standard self-attention causes inference costs to grow sharply with long sequences, limiting the deployment of long-CoT reasoning in production settings. To address this, we propose LISA (Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention), a plug-and-play attention replacement module that requir

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很现实的问题：推理模型在 test-time scaling 下会生成很长的 CoT，准确率往往随思维链长度上升，但标准 softmax attention 的计算和缓存成本也随上下文迅速变重。已有两类路子都不理想：一类是直接让模型少想、短想，代价是推理能力容易掉；另一类是用纯线性注意力或状态压缩替代全注意力，代价是精确检索能力不足，尤其在数学推理这类强依赖局部关键 token 回看的任务上容易失真。LISA要解决的核心矛盾，就是在不从头预训练、不改模型主体参数和输出格式的前提下，把长上下文推理的每步成本压到近似常数，同时尽量保住甚至提升 reasoning quality。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它不是单纯的 serving 工程优化，而是在推理阶段重新设计 attention 记忆机制：用线性状态承载全局历史，用固定预算的稀疏精确检索保住关键上下文访问。这种“粗记忆 + 精索引”的组合，对长上下文预训练和新型记忆架构都有启发。第二，它证明了 attention 替换模块可以通过较轻量的后训练接入现有模型，而不必重新做大规模预训练，这对已有大模型的架构演化很重要。第三，论文的结果不只是省算力，还出现了质量提升，说明全注意力在长 CoT 场景下未必总是最优；适当的结构偏置可能反而改善长程推理中的噪声累积和注意力扩散。这一点对未来 pretrain 阶段是否要显式引入分层记忆、稀疏检索或 recurrent state，很有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，LISA把原来的 self-attention 替换成并联的两条支路。第一条是 linear attention，用一个递推状态矩阵 S_t 累积历史 K/V 信息，承担全局长程记忆。它的优点是每步更新和读取都不随序列长度增长，时间近似 O(1)，内存也是常数级；缺点是缺少 softmax attention 那种基于内容的精确索引能力。第二条是 Lightning Indexer，对历史 token 做重要性打分，从中动态选出 top-M 个 token，保留一个固定大小的精确 self-attention 视野。这样，模型既能通过线性状态保留“全局背景”，又能对少量关键 token 做高保真回看。

关键不在于简单拼接两种注意力，而在于训练方式。论文采用两阶段训练。第一阶段先只训练 linear attention 分支，用纯 cross-entropy 冷启动，让线性状态先学会承接原模型的基本语言建模与推理分布。作者强调不用一开始就做 teacher KL，是为了避免线性分支过早过拟合教师分布表面形态，学不到自己的稳定记忆表示。第二阶段再引入 indexer 和 top-M 选择，同时加入 KL 蒸馏，稳定重要 token 的选择和整体输出分布。这里的直觉是：索引器一旦参与，离散 top-M 选择会让训练更敏感，KL 可以把替换后模块的行为锚定在原模型附近，减少训练震荡。

从设计取舍看，LISA与纯 sparse attention 不同。纯稀疏方法通常需要预定义窗口、块结构或复杂检索规则，长程遗漏风险较高；LISA用 linear state 兜底全局信息。它也不同于纯 linear attention，后者虽然便宜，但在需要精确定位某一步中间结果、变量定义或约束条件时容易失败；LISA用固定预算的 full attention 弥补这一点。它还不同于需要特殊数据预处理的 state compression 方法，接入路径更接近模块替换 + 轻量训练，工程上更现实。
summary.experiments:
实验主要围绕长上下文数学推理展开，覆盖五个 benchmark。论文给出的核心结论有两个：一是效率，二是质量。效率上，在 16K context 条件下，LISA相对 full self-attention 最多可减少约 50% 的推理成本。这里的收益来自两部分：attention 计算从随长度增长转为固定预算的 sparse retrieval 加常数状态更新，以及 KV/cache 压力显著下降。质量上，作者报告平均准确率比 full attention baseline 还高 5.6%。这点比单纯“几乎不掉点”更值得注意，说明模块替换并没有只是做近似，而可能在长 CoT 下改善了信息利用方式。

从消融逻辑看，论文重点验证了几件事。第一，单独使用 linear attention 不够，尤其在上下文敏感任务上会明显弱于混合方案；这支持了“全局记忆需要配合精确索引”的判断。第二，top-M 的固定大小检索是有效的，M 太小会损伤精确回看，M 增大则质量提升趋缓但成本上升，存在明显的效率-性能拐点。第三，两阶段训练优于一步到位联合训练，说明先让线性状态稳定，再学习索引器，是更容易收敛的路径。第四，KL 在第二阶段有稳定作用，尤其对 indexer 的 token 选择和最终输出分布更有帮助。

摘要里没有完整列出参数规模、训练 token 数和每个 benchmark 的逐项数字；如果按全文阅读，建议重点核对实验章节中的模型底座、替换层范围、训练步数、M 的具体设置、以及不同上下文长度下的 latency/accuracy 曲线。这些细节决定了结果更偏“架构有效”还是“特定 recipe 调得好”。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 和 Method 总览，抓住它要解决的不是一般长上下文建模，而是 long-CoT reasoning 的推理成本问题。然后重点看方法图和 attention 替换公式，理解 linear state 与 top-M 精确检索各自负责什么。真正值得精读的是两阶段训练部分：为什么第一阶段只用 CE，为什么第二阶段再加 KL，这里体现了作者对训练动态的判断。

实验部分优先看三类图表。第一类是不同 context length 下的准确率与成本曲线，判断它是否真的在长序列区间建立了更好的 Pareto。第二类是消融：去掉 indexer、只保留 linear attention、改变 M、改变训练阶段设置。第三类是案例分析，尤其是数学推理中需要回看早期条件、变量赋值、子结论的样例，这能直观看出 LISA为何比纯线性方案稳。

如果时间有限，30-40 分钟可以读完主线；如果要深挖，建议把它和几类工作对照着看：一类是 Kimi Linear、DeltaNet 一类把线性/状态空间记忆重新带回语言模型的工作；一类是各种 sparse/retrieval attention；还有一类是专门压缩 CoT 或缩短推理长度的方法。LISA有意思的地方不在于它比这些方向谁更强，而在于它把“保留长思维链”与“降低每步成本”放在同一个结构里处理。

summary_en.core_problem: LISA targets a concrete bottleneck in reasoning-time scaling: stronger reasoning models tend to generate much longer chains of thought, but standard softmax self-attention makes inference cost grow sharply with sequence length. Existing fixes usually fall into two unsatisfying buckets. One tries to shorten CoT, which often hurts reasoning quality. The other replaces full attention with linear/state-compressed mechanisms, which are cheaper but weak at precise content-based retrieval. LISA addresses the tension directly: keep long-CoT reasoning intact, avoid pretraining from scratch, and replace full attention with a hybrid module whose per-step cost is effectively constant while preserving access to critical past tokens.
summary_en.importance: The contribution matters beyond a serving trick. First, it proposes a memory design for inference-time reasoning: a global recurrent state for cheap long-range memory, plus a fixed-budget exact retrieval path for high-fidelity access. That is relevant to pretraining research because it suggests a viable inductive bias for future long-context LMs, not just an inference patch. Second, the paper shows that attention replacement can be retrofitted onto an existing model with lightweight post-training, instead of requiring a new large-scale pretraining run. That is important for architecture evolution in deployed foundation models. Third, the reported gains are not only computational. LISA also improves reasoning accuracy over the full-attention baseline in long-CoT settings, which suggests that unrestricted full attention may not be the best memory mechanism once sequences become very long and noisy. Structured memory can sometimes help quality, not just efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LISA replaces each standard self-attention block with two parallel components. The first is linear attention, implemented as a recurrent state matrix S_t that accumulates historical key-value interactions. This branch provides cheap global memory: update and read cost do not grow with context length, and memory usage stays constant. Its weakness is well known: linear attention lacks the sharp content-based indexing behavior of softmax attention.

The second branch is the Lightning Indexer. It scores historical tokens by importance and dynamically selects the top-M tokens for exact self-attention. This gives the model a fixed-size high-resolution retrieval set. The overall design is therefore a hybrid memory system: linear attention stores broad long-range context, while the indexer preserves precise access to a small number of critical tokens.

A central part of the paper is the training recipe. The model is trained in two stages. In stage 1, only the linear-attention branch is cold-started with plain cross-entropy. The rationale is to let the recurrent memory learn a stable predictive representation on its own, instead of immediately forcing it to mimic the teacher distribution through distillation. In stage 2, the indexer and top-M selection are introduced, together with a KL term to stabilize token selection and keep the modified model close to the original teacher behavior. This is a sensible choice because discrete top-M routing can make optimization brittle; KL acts as an anchor.

The design differs from pure sparse attention, which usually relies on predefined windows, blocks, or retrieval heuristics and may miss long-range information. LISA uses the linear state as a global fallback. It also differs from pure linear attention, which is efficient but often fails on tasks that require exact recall of earlier variables, constraints, or intermediate results. Finally, unlike some state-compression approaches, it does not require complicated preprocessing or a new output format, making the retrofit path much more practical.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments focus on long-context mathematical reasoning across five benchmarks. The two headline results are efficiency and quality. On efficiency, LISA reduces inference cost by up to about 50% at 16K context relative to the full self-attention baseline. The gain comes from replacing sequence-length-dependent attention computation with a constant-cost recurrent update plus fixed-budget sparse retrieval, while also reducing KV-cache pressure. On quality, the paper reports an average accuracy improvement of 5.6% over the full-attention baseline. That is more interesting than a simple “small degradation” result: the hybrid memory is not merely an approximation, it can be a better inductive bias for long-CoT reasoning.

The ablations support the main design choices. Linear attention alone is insufficient, especially on context-sensitive reasoning tasks, which validates the need for exact token retrieval. The top-M budget shows the expected trade-off: too small M hurts precise recall, while larger M improves quality with diminishing returns and higher cost. The two-stage training strategy outperforms one-shot joint training, indicating that stabilizing the recurrent memory before learning the indexer is important. The KL term in stage 2 further improves stability, especially for token selection behavior and output consistency.

The prompt only includes the main claims, not the full table of model sizes, training tokens, or per-benchmark numbers. When reading the full paper, it is worth checking the base model scale, which layers are replaced, the exact M settings, training duration, and the latency/accuracy curves across context lengths. Those details determine whether the gains are broadly architectural or heavily recipe-dependent.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and method overview. The key is to see that the target is not generic long-context modeling, but long-CoT reasoning under test-time scaling. Then read the architecture figure and the equations for the hybrid attention carefully: understand what the linear state is expected to remember, and what the top-M exact attention is expected to recover.

The most important section to read closely is the two-stage training setup. Why stage 1 uses only cross-entropy, and why stage 2 adds KL after introducing the indexer, tells you a lot about the optimization dynamics of retrofitting new memory modules into pretrained LMs.

In the experiments, prioritize three things. First, the accuracy-versus-cost curves across context lengths: this shows whether LISA really improves the Pareto frontier in the long-sequence regime. Second, the ablations: remove the indexer, keep only linear attention, vary M, and compare one-stage versus two-stage training. Third, inspect qualitative math-reasoning examples where the model must revisit early constraints or intermediate derivations. Those cases make the benefit of exact retrieval much clearer than aggregate metrics alone.

If time is limited, the main line can be read in 30–40 minutes. For deeper study, compare it against three families of work: linear/recurrent memory LMs such as Kimi Linear or Delta-style approaches, sparse/retrieval attention methods, and CoT compression or shortening methods. LISA is interesting because it does not choose between long reasoning and cheap inference; it tries to support both with a single memory design.

recommendation.zh: 只看架构和训练替换细节；若无需从头预训练能稳住长 CoT，值得进内部长上下文推理 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the module and adaptation recipe; if it preserves long-CoT behavior without scratch pretraining, it deserves an internal long-context inference ablation.

paper.title: Spectral-LSH: Sub-Quadratic Prompt Compression via Krylov-Projected Locality-Sensitive Hashing
paper.abstract: Long-prompt inference remains expensive because prefill attention scales quadratically with sequence length. We propose Spectral-LSH, a training-free prompt compression method that operates before the prompt enters the language model. Spectral-LSH approximates the dominant components of an implicit attention-kernel operator using a Krylov subspace method together with random features, avoiding explicit $O(N^2)$ attention-kernel materialization. It then applies SimHash in the resulting attention

summary.core_problem: 长 prompt 推理的 prefill attention 成本随序列长度二次增长，常规压缩方法在高压缩率下容易损失上下文质量。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法。它不改变预训练目标或模型架构，但对长上下文 serving、prefill 成本和 prompt 压缩策略选择有参考意义，尤其是提出了不同压缩率区间的经验分界。
summary.technical_approach: Spectral-LSH 是训练无关的 prompt compression 方法，在输入 LLM 前运行。它用 Krylov subspace method 和 random features 近似隐式 attention-kernel operator 的主成分，避免显式构造 O(N^2) attention kernel；随后在 attention eigenspace 中用 SimHash 聚合相似 token，并用 causal positional assignments 形成 macro-token。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct，在 C4 上评估不同压缩率。摘要报告了压缩率相变：低于 4x 时，局部 token 冗余不足，轻量 chunking 往往有更好的延迟-质量折中；高于 8x 时，spectral path 比 chunking 更能保持质量。摘要未完整给出 16x 下的具体数值。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 SRC、Islamic Azad University 和 Iran University of Science and Technology。给定信息中未显示知名 LLM 系统作者。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-prompt inference is expensive because prefill attention scales quadratically with sequence length, while simple compression methods often lose context quality at high compression ratios.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution. It does not change the pretraining objective or core model architecture, but it is useful for long-context serving, prefill-cost reduction, and deciding when more complex prompt compression is justified.
summary_en.technical_approach: Spectral-LSH is a training-free prompt compression method applied before the prompt enters the LLM. It approximates dominant components of an implicit attention-kernel operator using Krylov subspace methods and random features, avoiding explicit O(N^2) kernel materialization. It then applies SimHash in the attention eigenspace to group similar tokens into macro-tokens with causal positional assignments.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct on C4. It reports a compression-ratio phase transition: below 4x, lightweight chunking often gives the best latency-quality trade-off; above 8x, the spectral path preserves quality better than chunking. The provided excerpt does not include the full quantitative results at 16x.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are SRC, Islamic Azad University, and Iran University of Science and Technology. No widely recognized LLM systems authors are identifiable from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 作为长 prompt 压缩备查即可；只看 4x/8x 相变结论，C4-only setup 不足以支撑强部署判断。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for long-prompt compression; read the 4x/8x phase-transition result, but the C4-only setup is too narrow for strong deployment decisions.

institutions: Iran University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Relay-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Multi-Domain Reasoning Chains
paper.abstract: Introducing Relay-Bench, an unsaturated, holistic, text-only benchmark that measures LLMs' ability to complete an assortment of tasks from distinct domains in a single prompt. The leading model, GPT-5.5 (xHigh), scores 43.3%. The test set entirely consists of composite problems: groups of single-domain subproblems that are strung together into challenges that require reasoning across multiple domains in combination. Many of these problems then have layers of complexity added through prompt encod

summary.core_problem: 构建一个文本形式的复合推理 benchmark，评估 LLM 在单个 prompt 中串联多个领域任务、处理上下文膨胀和编码干扰的能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是评测资产，关注多领域推理链而非单一学科题。它对 post-train 推理数据和 agent/tool-use evaluation 有一定参考，但摘要中的模型命名和单作者设置需要谨慎看待。
summary.technical_approach: Relay-Bench 将多个单领域子问题组合成一个复合问题，每题包含 2 到 13 个子问题；覆盖视觉推理、代码、数学、信息抽取、问题求解、常识和数据分析等任务。部分题目加入 prompt encoding 和 deliberate context bloat，并允许模型使用代码执行、网页搜索和可用工具。
summary.experiments: 摘要称领先模型 GPT-5.5 (xHigh) 得分 43.3%，说明测试集未饱和。未给出题目数量、标注流程、泄漏控制、评分协议、工具调用约束、不同模型榜单或人类基线，因此 benchmark 可信度需要看正文验证。

summary_en.core_problem: Relay-Bench evaluates whether LLMs can solve composite, multi-domain reasoning chains within a single text-only prompt under context bloat and encoding distractions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation asset focused on chained multi-domain reasoning rather than isolated subject tests. It may inform post-training data design and agent/tool-use evaluation, but the model naming and single-author setup warrant caution.
summary_en.technical_approach: The benchmark strings together multiple single-domain subproblems into composite tasks, with 2 to 13 subproblems per item. It covers visual reasoning, coding, math, information extraction, problem solving, general knowledge, and data analysis. Some items add prompt encoding and deliberate context bloat, while models are allowed to use code execution, web search, and available tools.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that the leading model, GPT-5.5 (xHigh), scores 43.3%, suggesting the benchmark is unsaturated. It does not provide item counts, annotation procedures, contamination controls, grading protocols, tool-use constraints, full model rankings, or human baselines.

recommendation.zh: 看任务构造和评分协议就够；43.3% 这种数字先别信，关键是是否有泄漏控制和工具约束。
recommendation.en: Skim the task construction and grading protocol only; treat the 43.3% number as weak until leakage controls and tool constraints are clear.

paper.title: Copy Less, Ground More: Overcoming Repetitive Copying in Long-Context Reasoning via Evidence-Aware Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large language models that generate step-by-step reasoning traces have achieved strong performance on complex tasks, and extending them to long-context settings has emerged as an important frontier. However, we identify a critical failure mode in this regime: \emph{repetitive copying}, where models extensively copy text from the input into their reasoning traces rather than productively solving the problem. We show that this behavior is pervasive across frontier long-context LLMs and intensifies

summary.core_problem: 长上下文“思维链/推理轨迹”模型在推理时出现系统性失败模式：在 reasoning trace 中大量、重复地从输入上下文抄写文本（repetitive copying），既挤占 token 预算又降低正确率。论文进一步追问：抄写到底是坏在“抄写本身”，还是坏在“抄写不分证据与干扰”的不充分 grounding，并尝试用 RL 信号把模型从“泛抄”拉回到“围绕关键证据推理”。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练闭环的启发点在于：长上下文推理的退化不一定是“上下文太长导致能力不够”，而可能是训练信号诱导的行为偏置（把输入当作可直接复述的高概率续写对象）。论文把问题拆成可度量的 copying/grounding 指标，并给出可落地的 reward shaping（在不改架构的情况下）来抑制无差别复制。这类方法对长上下文 mid-train / RL 阶段的目标设计、以及“减少无效思维 token”都有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 GEAR（Grounding Evidence-Aware Reward）：在标准的“最终答案是否正确”的 RL reward 上，叠加两个与文本重叠相关的 shaping 项。
1) Grounding reward：鼓励 reasoning trace 与标注的关键证据 span 发生重叠。实现上用 n-gram overlap（文中用 3-gram/10-gram 的重叠率体系）衡量输出与 evidence span 的匹配程度。
2) Distractor penalty：惩罚 reasoning trace 与“无关干扰上下文”的重叠，抑制 indiscriminate copying。
关键诊断假设是：复制并非必然有害；有害的是对干扰内容也复制，反映模型没有把注意力/生成概率集中到任务相关证据上。

为了把方法从合成任务推广到自然文档，论文还给出一个三阶段自动化数据构造流程，用任意长文档生成带 evidence 标注的 QA：先构造问题与答案，再定位支持答案的证据片段（support spans），并显式区分 distractor 区域，从而让 GEAR 的两项 shaping 都可计算。

训练上使用 GSPO（文中作为 RL 算法/框架）对 Qwen3.5 不同规模模型做 RL，数据量较小（3.2k long-context 样本）但混合了合成与自然文档来源，目标是验证 reward 设计对行为的因果影响，而不是堆数据。
summary.experiments:
诊断实验：
- 覆盖 7 个“thinking”长上下文模型（含闭源 API 与开源权重），在 GSM-Infinite 这类长上下文算术推理任务上，repetitive copying 随 context length 增大而加剧。
- 用 overlap rate 度量复制：3-gram 反映总体复制量，10-gram 更接近“连续抄写”。发现 copying 率与准确率负相关，同时显著拉长 reasoning trace（token 预算被抄写消耗）。
- 进一步把 prompt 切分为 key evidence 与 distractor，发现答对样本更“选择性复制”（更多对 evidence 的重叠、更少对 distractor 的重叠），支持“问题是 insufficient grounding 而非 copying per se”。

方法实验：
- 在 3 个 Qwen3.5 不同规模模型上，用 GEAR+GSPO 在 3.2k 训练样本上训练。
- 在 5 个 held-out benchmark 上，相比仅用 accuracy reward 的标准 RL，平均准确率最高提升到 +4.6（average points），同时降低 repetitive copying 指标并缩短 thinking length。

（注：你提供的全文片段未包含各 benchmark 的逐项分数、模型规模具体参数与每项消融的完整表格；若需要精确到每个数据集/每个尺度的数字，需要补充实验章节与表格内容。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（skim）：
- 先看“Repetitive Copying Issue”这一节的指标定义与分解（overlap rate、3-gram vs 10-gram、evidence vs distractor 的选择性复制），这是全文最有可迁移性的诊断框架。
- 再看 GEAR reward 的两项 shaping 如何与 evidence 标注绑定，以及为何用 n-gram overlap 而不是 attention/attribution（工程上更稳、更可复现）。
- 最后快速扫自动化数据构造三阶段流程：它决定了方法能否从合成任务走向真实长文档。
预计阅读时间：20–30 分钟可抓住主要结论与方法；若要复现/迁移到自家长上下文 RL，需精读 reward 公式、阈值/权重、以及数据构造细节与失败案例。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context “thinking” LLMs often fail by producing reasoning traces that heavily and repetitively copy from the prompt. This wastes the token budget and correlates with lower accuracy. The paper asks whether copying is inherently harmful, or whether the real issue is insufficient grounding—i.e., copying indiscriminately from both relevant evidence and irrelevant distractors—and proposes an RL signal to shift the model toward evidence-focused reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model researchers is the framing: long-context degradation can be a behavior induced by training/inference incentives (high-probability continuation of the prompt) rather than a pure capacity/context-length limitation. The work provides measurable diagnostics (copying/grounding via n-gram overlap) and a practical reward-shaping recipe that improves accuracy while reducing “wasted” reasoning tokens, which is directly relevant to long-context RL/mid-training and token-efficiency of reasoning traces.
summary_en.technical_approach:
GEAR (Grounding Evidence-Aware Reward) augments an accuracy-based RL reward with two overlap-based terms:
- Grounding reward: encourages overlap between the generated reasoning trace and annotated supporting evidence spans.
- Distractor penalty: discourages overlap with irrelevant context, targeting indiscriminate copying.
Copying is treated as acceptable when it is selective and evidence-aligned; the penalty is specifically for copying from distractors.

To make this usable beyond synthetic tasks, the paper introduces an automated three-stage pipeline that builds evidence-annotated long-context QA from arbitrary documents: generate QA, identify support spans, and separate distractor regions so both reward components are computable.

Training is done with GSPO on multiple Qwen3.5 scales, using a small but mixed long-context dataset (3.2k examples) to isolate the effect of reward design rather than data scaling.
summary_en.experiments:
Diagnostics:
- Evaluates 7 frontier “thinking” long-context LLMs (both proprietary and open-weight) on GSM-Infinite-style long-context arithmetic reasoning.
- Defines overlap rate using prompt n-gram matching; reports n=3 (overall copying) and n=10 (clear contiguous transcription). Copying increases with context length, is negatively correlated with accuracy, and inflates reasoning length.
- By splitting prompts into key evidence vs distractors, shows correct solutions exhibit more selective copying (more evidence overlap, less distractor overlap), supporting the grounding hypothesis.

Intervention:
- RL fine-tunes three Qwen3.5 models with GEAR on 3.2k long-context training samples.
- On five held-out benchmarks, improves over accuracy-only RL by up to +4.6 average points, while reducing copying metrics and shortening reasoning traces.

(Exact per-benchmark numbers and full ablations are not present in the provided excerpt; they require the full experimental tables/appendix.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Start with the metric/diagnosis section: overlap-rate definition, 3-gram vs 10-gram rationale, and the evidence-vs-distractor decomposition. This is the most reusable part.
- Then read the GEAR reward formulation and how the two terms are balanced; note why n-gram overlap is chosen (simple, stable, model-agnostic) versus attribution-based signals.
- Finally, scan the automated evidence-annotation pipeline to judge scalability and failure modes.
Time: ~20–30 minutes to capture the core idea; deeper adoption needs careful reading of reward weights, thresholds, and data construction details.

recommendation.zh: 值得 skim 诊断部分；它把长上下文 CoT 失败归因到 grounding reward，不是再堆更长 context。
recommendation.en: Skim the diagnostic section; it frames long-context CoT failure as a grounding-reward issue, not just a need for more context.

paper.title: C$^2$KV: Compressed and Composable KV Cache Reuse for Efficient LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Long-context inference is central to modern large language model (LLM) applications such as retrieval-augmented generation and multi-document reasoning. To mitigate the growing inference cost, recent work has explored key-value (KV) cache reuse to reduce redundant prefill computation. However, existing reuse methods primarily focus on computation savings and overlook a critical bottleneck in long-context LLM serving: the cost of storing and accessing large KV caches. While KV compression appears

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文 LLM serving 中非前缀 KV cache 复用与 KV 压缩难以同时成立的问题，目标是在减少 prefill 计算的同时降低 KV 存储和访问成本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与缓存表示方法创新。长上下文 RAG、多文档推理和会话复用场景里，prefill 计算和 KV cache 内存都会成为瓶颈；已有 KV reuse 多关注省算力，较少处理大规模缓存的存取成本，而直接压缩非前缀 KV 往往损伤精度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 C2KV，将非前缀 KV reuse、KV extraction 和 inference-time concatenation 放在同一个框架里优化。方法学习一个可组合、压缩且位置无关的 KV cache manifold，并引入轻量 sidecar Extractor、可学习 compression tokens 和结构化注意力机制，使抽取出的 KV 表示能在不同上下文位置下复用。
summary.experiments: 给定摘要未提供模型参数量、数据规模、baseline 名称和具体提升幅度。实验重点应是长上下文推理、RAG 或多文档场景下的 prefill latency、KV 内存占用、cache access cost 与任务精度之间的折中；需要看正文确认压缩率、吞吐提升和非前缀复用下的质量退化。
summary.authors_note: Alibaba Group 参与的 LLM inference / serving 方向工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the mismatch between non-prefix KV cache reuse and KV compression in long-context LLM serving, aiming to save both prefill compute and KV storage/access cost.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-systems and cache-representation contribution. In long-context RAG, multi-document reasoning, and reusable-session serving, prefill compute is only part of the cost; storing and reading large KV caches can dominate. Existing reuse methods mostly optimize compute, while naive compression of non-prefix reusable KV often hurts accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: C2KV jointly optimizes KV extraction and inference-time concatenation for non-prefix reuse. It learns a compressed, composable, position-agnostic KV cache manifold, using a lightweight sidecar Extractor, learnable compression tokens, and structured attention so that extracted KV states can be reused across different context positions.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not report model sizes, data scale, baselines, or exact gains. The relevant experiments should be long-context reasoning, RAG, or multi-document serving, measuring prefill latency, KV memory footprint, cache access cost, and accuracy retention under non-prefix reuse; the full paper is needed for compression ratios and quality trade-offs.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Alibaba Group on LLM inference and serving.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和 ablation 即可；如果非前缀 KV 复用要进生产，这篇的“位置无关压缩表示”值得复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if non-prefix KV reuse matters in production, the position-agnostic compressed cache representation is worth reproducing.

paper.title: SALT: Salience-Aware Lexical Trie for Long-Context Compression
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) process increasingly longer prompts, computation and KV-cache memory costs have emerged as major bottlenecks in inference systems. Existing input-level prompt compression methods address this, but rank each sentence by a scalar relevance score, treating the document as an unstructured pool of words and sentences. Under tight budgets, this causes theme collapse, where the dominant theme(s) of a document consumes the budget, discarding less-frequent yet task-relevan

summary.core_problem: 现有输入级 prompt 压缩方法按句子孤立打分分配预算，紧预算下会出现主题坍缩，主导主题占满预算而丢弃低频但任务相关的主题，无法保证主题覆盖度。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出模型无关的抽取式 prompt 压缩框架，解决了长上下文压缩中的主题覆盖缺陷，工程实现轻量可复用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SALT 框架，将每个句子的关键词组织为按句子频率（SF）排序的字典树，用 SF 作为文档主题结构的轻量代理，通过 trie 结构平滑内存分配，避免主导主题垄断预算，结合多锚点检索提升任务相关性。
summary.experiments: 提供的摘要中实验部分被截断，未披露具体测试模型、数据集及量化提升结果，仅说明框架为模型无关，可复用句子频率作为主题结构代理。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing input-level prompt compression methods allocate budget via per-sentence isolated scoring, leading to theme collapse under tight budgets where dominant themes consume all budget and discard less frequent but task-relevant themes.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing a model-agnostic extractive prompt compression framework that fixes theme coverage flaws in long-context compression, with lightweight and reusable engineering implementation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SALT organizes per-sentence keywords into a trie sorted by sentence frequency (SF), a lightweight reusable proxy for document thematic structure; the trie smooths memory allocation to prevent dominant theme monopoly, combined with multi-anchor retrieval to improve relevance.
summary_en.experiments: The experimental section is truncated in the provided abstract; no specific test models, datasets, or quantitative improvements are disclosed, only that the framework is model-agnostic and uses sentence frequency as a thematic proxy.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文prompt压缩的实用改进，解决了现有方法的主题坍缩问题，trie结构设计可参考，重点看§3的SF-trie构造。
recommendation.en: Practical long-context prompt compression improvement fixing theme collapse; refer to §3 for SF-trie construction design.

paper.title: More Than Memory: Task-Conditioned Signed FFN Writes in Long-Context Retrieval
paper.abstract: FFNs are often treated as parametric memories. In long-context retrieval, however, the sharper question is not only what they store, but whether their native residual writes push the current retrieval state toward or away from the correct answer. We test this by scaling the model's own FFN write one layer at a time, without editing weights or injecting external steering vectors.   Across controlled literal and semantic retrieval suites, native FFN response surfaces are signed, layer-specific, an

summary.core_problem: 论文分析长上下文检索中 FFN residual write 到底是在推动模型接近正确答案，还是在压制正确检索状态。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。它把 FFN 从“参数记忆”进一步拆成 task-conditioned signed writes：同一层的 FFN 写入可能对 literal retrieval 和 semantic retrieval 起相反作用，这对长上下文退化、层级干预和模型编辑都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是不改权重、不注入外部 steering vector，而是逐层缩放模型自身 FFN write，观察检索指标随缩放系数变化的 response surface。再用沿 native write 方向的局部方向导数区分 amplifier 和 suppressor。
summary.experiments: 在 controlled literal 和 semantic retrieval suites 上，final FFN 在 7/8 个 model-suite case 中表现为 suppressor；60% 的层会在不同检索模式间切换角色，95% CI 为 [50%, 69%]。方向导数能稳定区分角色：suppressor 在 34/35 个 case 中为负，amplifier 在 18/18 个 case 中为正。LongBench retrieval-QA probe 上，同一诊断还能预测 attenuation damage。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether FFN residual writes in long-context retrieval push the model toward the correct answer or suppress the current retrieval state.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis contribution. It refines the common view of FFNs as parametric memories by showing that native FFN writes are signed, layer-specific, and task-conditioned, which matters for long-context failures and layer-level interventions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study scales the model’s own FFN write one layer at a time, without weight edits or external steering vectors, and measures the retrieval response surface. It then uses the local directional derivative along the native write to separate amplifier and suppressor roles.
summary_en.experiments: On controlled literal and semantic retrieval suites, the final FFN is a suppressor in 7 of 8 model-suite cases, and 60% of layers switch roles between retrieval modes with a 95% CI of [50%, 69%]. The directional derivative is negative for suppressors in 34/35 cases and positive for amplifiers in 18/18 cases. The same diagnostic predicts attenuation damage on a safety-filtered LongBench retrieval-QA probe.

recommendation.zh: 值得读方法和主表：它把“FFN 是记忆”改成“FFN 写入有符号且依任务变号”。
recommendation.en: Read the method and main table: it replaces the simple “FFNs are memories” story with signed, task-conditioned FFN writes.

paper.title: Retain or Consolidate? Budget-Dependent Operator Selection for Language Agent Memory
paper.abstract: Language agents depend on memory across interactions. However, the limited context windows of large language models (LLMs) and their inference costs constrain how much memory can be used at once. Existing systems mainly follow two strategies: memory retention and memory consolidation. Retention keeps raw records and preserves exact details, but relevant evidence may not fit under a tight budget; consolidation compresses and combines records, improving coverage per token but risking the loss of q

summary.core_problem: 在语言 agent 的有限上下文预算下，何时保留原始记忆、何时做记忆压缩，以及该选哪种 consolidation operator。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 agent memory 策略分析与方法设计。对预训练研究员的价值不在 agent 本身，而在它把“压缩带来覆盖收益但会损伤关键细节”这个 trade-off 形式化，和长上下文训练、摘要式记忆、RAG 压缩有相通之处。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 operator 的效用拆成两部分：对 retention 放不下证据的 coverage effect，以及对已能放下原始证据的 signed replacement effect；据此在不同预算压力下选择 Retain、Merge、Abstract 或 Rewrite。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模和提升幅度，但看起来重点是预算变化下的策略切换规律，而不是单一任务上的绝对分数。若实验干净，最值得看的是 operator utility 分解是否能稳定预测最优策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when a language agent should retain raw memory versus consolidate it under limited context budgets, and which consolidation operator should be chosen.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory paper, but it is mildly relevant to pretraining researchers because it formalizes the trade-off between coverage gains from compression and loss of query-critical detail, which echoes long-context training, summarization memory, and compressed retrieval.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method decomposes each operator’s utility into a coverage effect for evidence omitted by retention and a signed replacement effect on evidence that would otherwise fit, then uses this to choose among Retain, Merge, Abstract, and Rewrite under varying budget pressure.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide benchmark names, model sizes, or headline gains. The interesting part is whether the utility decomposition robustly predicts operator choice across budget regimes rather than just improving one task score.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把 memory compression 的收益和伤害拆得比较清楚；若你做长上下文或摘要记忆，只看效用分解和预算切换实验即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly decomposes the gains and harms of memory compression; if you work on long context or summary memory, read the utility decomposition and budget-sweep experiments only.

paper.title: Frontier Language Models Struggle to Copy: Text Can Be Better Viewed in 2D
paper.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) can solve advanced reasoning problems in seconds, we show that even frontier models fail to perform a much simpler operation: exactly copying an input string that lies well within their context windows. We attribute this failure to positional encodings in Transformer architectures, whose inductive bias favors copying through a shortcut based on matching local contexts rather than carefully locating the corresponding input positions. To address this issue, we in

summary.core_problem: 解释并缓解“前沿 LLM 在上下文窗口内仍会失败的精确复制（copy）”现象，尤其是在输入包含大量重复子串时；进一步追问失败是否来自 Transformer 位置编码（尤其 RoPE）的归纳偏置，使模型倾向用“局部上下文匹配的捷径”（类似 induction head）而不是按位置对齐去取回对应 token。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接意义不在于“复制任务本身”，而在于它把一个常被忽略的能力缺口（精确字符串操作/格式搬运）追溯到位置编码的结构性偏置，并给出一个可落地的替代位置表示（2D-RoPE）。这类缺口会外溢到工具调用参数搬运、结构化输出、代码/配置片段重排等场景；如果结论成立，它提示：仅靠扩大模型与数据，某些“看似低级但要求精确对齐”的能力可能被 RoPE 的捷径学习长期拖累，需要在 pretrain 架构归纳偏置层面修补。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 失败机理假设：模型复制不是用绝对索引 i 去取输入第 i 个符号，而更像 induction head：在上下文里找“局部 n-gram 相似”的先前片段，再预测其后继 token。重复子串会制造多解匹配，导致注意力被吸走，从而复制出错。
2) 2D 视角：把“输入行 + 输出行”看成二维网格。若仍用 1D 序列，输出位置 y_k 需要从一个依赖输入长度 n 的偏移处取 x_k；相对位置编码（RoPE）更擅长表达固定偏移检索，因此会诱导模型走捷径。若排成两行，y_k 只需取同一列（或固定列偏移）的 token，结构更简单。
3) 2D-RoPE：以换行符 <\n> 作为行分隔，把文本映射到 (row_id, col_id)。在注意力里对两个轴分别施加 RoPE（借鉴视觉模型对 2D RoPE 的用法），使“跨行同列对齐”成为更强的归纳偏置。
4) 理论与可解释性：给出一层 Transformer + 2D-RoPE 可表示二元复制并实现长度泛化的证明；并进一步论证在只见过长度 ≤L 的训练分布上，某些全局最优解可泛化到多项式长度。配合机制分析，强调 RoPE 下注意力更易被局部重复吸引，而 2D-RoPE 更容易形成干净的列对齐检索。
5) 从合成任务到真实 LM：不仅在 copy 专项训练上验证，还在 DCLM 上做真实语言模型预训练（350M–1.4B），再微调评估复制类任务，检查是否在不牺牲常识推理的前提下改善复制与 OOD/长度泛化。另提出 Auto-2D-RoPE：当自然文档的 2D 结构不总由显式换行给出时，自动推断/构造行分割以获得 2D 坐标（全文此处尚未展开完，但方向明确）。
summary.experiments:
1) 现实模型现象：对 GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.1 Pro、DeepSeek V4 Pro 等做 copy 测试，在“远小于上下文长度”的输入上仍出现显著失败；长度越长准确率越低，常低于 50%。
2) 重复度相关：在 Python List Conversion（含周期波形数据，重复子串多）等设置下，复制准确率与输入重复度负相关。
3) 合成二元复制长度泛化：训练于短序列，测试长序列。文中给出极端泛化倍数：一层 2D-RoPE 模型可做到约 1000× 的长度泛化仍保持完美复制；12 层模型可保持约 100× 的完美复制（这里的“×”是相对训练长度的倍数）。
4) 真实预训练验证：在 DCLM 上预训练 350M–1.4B 的 2D-RoPE LM，微调后在 copy 任务上表现出长度泛化与分布外泛化，同时常识推理任务与 RoPE 大体相当（全文未给出你提供片段中的具体分数表，但实验设计意图是“copy 提升不以通用能力为代价”。）
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“现象→机理→结构→验证”顺序读：
- 先看 Figure 1/2（或对应实验图）：确认复制失败的规模、随长度与重复度的变化趋势。
- 精读第 3 节（作者提到的 expressivity theory + mechanistic interpretability）：这里决定了论文是否真的把问题钉在 RoPE 归纳偏置/induction head 捷径上，而不是数据或解码细节。
- 重点看 2D-RoPE 的定义细节：如何从 token 序列得到 (row,col)，两个轴的 RoPE 如何组合进 QK 旋转，是否引入额外超参/实现复杂度。
- 读合成任务的长度泛化设置：训练长度 L、测试长度范围、是否控制重复模式、是否存在提示模板导致的固定列偏移。
- 再看 DCLM 预训练与微调部分：关注是否需要特殊数据格式（换行密度）、对困惑度/下游基准的影响、以及 Auto-2D-RoPE 在无显式换行时的鲁棒性假设。

summary_en.core_problem: Diagnose and fix a surprising failure mode: frontier LLMs often cannot exactly copy an input string even when it fits well within the context window, especially when the input contains repeated substrings. The paper attributes this to the inductive bias of positional encodings (notably RoPE), which encourages a local-context matching shortcut (induction-head-like) instead of position-aligned retrieval.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is the architectural diagnosis: scaling alone may not resolve certain “precision alignment” behaviors (exact copying, format transduction, parameter/argument transfer for tool use) if the positional encoding biases the model toward ambiguous local matches. 2D-RoPE is a concrete proposal to inject a stronger alignment bias while aiming to keep general LM quality intact, and the work connects mechanistic interpretability claims to a design change that can be tested in real pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Mechanism hypothesis: copying is implemented via induction-head-like pattern matching—find a previous occurrence of a similar local context and emit the following token—so repeated substrings create competing matches and derail exact copying.
2) 2D reframing: represent “input then output” as a 2-row grid. In 1D, producing y_k requires retrieving x_k at an offset that depends on input length n, which is awkward for relative encodings like RoPE. In 2D, y_k can attend to the same column (or a fixed column shift), making the retrieval rule length-invariant.
3) 2D-RoPE: assign each token a (row_id, col_id) using newline as a row separator; apply RoPE along both axes (inspired by 2D RoPE in vision transformers) so column-wise alignment becomes an easy-to-learn attention pattern.
4) Theory + interpretability: prove a 1-layer Transformer with 2D-RoPE can represent binary copy with length generalization; argue certain global minima trained up to length L generalize to polynomially longer sequences. Mechanistic evidence supports that RoPE attention is attracted to locally similar substrings, while 2D-RoPE yields cleaner alignment.
5) Beyond synthetic: pretrain 2D-RoPE LMs (350M–1.4B) on DCLM, then finetune for copy tasks to test whether the benefit survives real LM training without hurting commonsense reasoning. Propose Auto-2D-RoPE to handle documents where 2D structure is not explicitly marked by line breaks.
summary_en.experiments:
1) Frontier-model evaluation: GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, DeepSeek V4 Pro show substantial copy failures on inputs well within context; accuracy degrades with length and can drop below 50%.
2) Repetition sensitivity: copy accuracy is negatively correlated with repetition in the input (e.g., periodic synthetic data in a Python list conversion task).
3) Synthetic binary copy length generalization: 1-layer 2D-RoPE achieves perfect copying with ~1000× length generalization; 12-layer models maintain perfect performance up to ~100×.
4) Real pretraining check: 350M–1.4B 2D-RoPE models pretrained on DCLM, after finetuning, show length and OOD generalization on copy tasks while keeping commonsense reasoning roughly comparable to RoPE (the provided excerpt does not include the full numeric tables).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read in this order:
- Start with the empirical figures showing failure rates vs length and vs repetition; they justify the problem and the induction-head shortcut hypothesis.
- Focus on the expressivity/mechanistic section: it’s the crux of the causal claim linking RoPE to ambiguous local matching.
- Study the exact 2D-RoPE formulation (row/col assignment, how 2D rotations are applied in attention) and what it changes in implementation cost.
- Inspect the synthetic generalization protocol (train length L, test lengths, repetition patterns, prompt templates) to ensure the reported 100×/1000× generalization is not an artifact.
- Finally, check the DCLM pretraining results and the assumptions behind Auto-2D-RoPE (how robust it is when newline structure is weak or noisy).

recommendation.zh: 只看复制实验和 2D-RoPE 构造即可；它会改变对“长上下文=可精确搬运文本”的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the copying setup and 2D-RoPE construction; it weakens the default assumption that long context implies reliable verbatim transport.

paper.title: VarRate: Training-Free Variable-Rate KV Cache Compression for Long-Context LLMs
paper.abstract: The key-value (KV) cache is the main memory bottleneck in long-context large language model (LLM) inference. Two leading training-free families are both structurally limited: token-selection methods (SnapKV, Ada-KV) score importance from an observation window and evict low-scoring tokens, but eviction is irreversible -- so when the importance signal degrades under query-agnostic reuse, accuracy collapses by 11-15 points; uniform low-rank coding keeps every token but spends equal rank everywhere,

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV cache 内存占用过高，以及 token eviction 在长距离查询下不可逆丢信息的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是推理效率方法。它把 KV 压缩从“删 token”转成“给每个 token 分配不同低秩预算”，保留所有 token 的非零信息。对长上下文 serving、预训练侧长上下文评测和压缩鲁棒性有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: VarRate 是训练免费的 KV codec。它根据 query salience 为不同 token 分配可变低秩 rank，而不是直接淘汰低分 token；所有 token 都保留非零 rank。相对于统一低秩压缩，它避免把预算平均浪费在不重要位置；相对于 SnapKV、Ada-KV 等选择式方法，它避免不可逆删除。
summary.experiments: 在 LongBench 上，以相同 20% KV 预算比较训练免费的 token-selection 方法和低秩方法。摘要称 SnapKV、Ada-KV 类方法在 query-agnostic reuse 下会掉 11-15 分，而 VarRate 在相同困难场景下只掉 3.5-5.5 分。摘要未给出完整模型规模和全部任务明细。
summary.authors_note: Iowa State University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses KV-cache memory pressure in long-context LLM inference and the irreversible information loss caused by token eviction.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution. It reframes KV compression from dropping tokens to allocating different low-rank budgets per token, keeping nonzero information for every position. It is relevant to long-context serving and to robustness analysis of compression schemes.
summary_en.technical_approach: VarRate is a training-free KV codec that assigns variable low-rank ranks to tokens according to query salience. It keeps every token at a nonzero rank. Compared with uniform low-rank compression, it avoids wasting equal budget everywhere; compared with SnapKV- or Ada-KV-style token selection, it avoids irreversible eviction.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports LongBench results at a matched 20% KV budget. The abstract states that token-selection methods lose 11–15 points when query-agnostic reuse degrades the importance signal, while VarRate loses only 3.5–5.5 points in the same regime. The abstract does not provide full model sizes or all task-level details.
summary_en.authors_note: Iowa State University.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和 LongBench 失败案例即可；“低秩保留全部 token”比 eviction 更稳，是长上下文压缩的有用 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the method and LongBench failure cases; keeping all tokens at low rank is a useful prior over eviction for long-context compression.

paper.title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
paper.abstract: Recent robot foundation models operate with single-step or short-history visuomotor context. We introduce Test-Time-Training Robot Policies (RoboTTT), a robot model and training recipe that scale visuomotor context to 8K timesteps, three orders of magnitude beyond state-of-the-art policies, without growing inference latency. At this context length, we unlock new robot capabilities: one-shot in-context imitation from human video demonstrations, on-the-fly policy improvement, robustness to perturb

summary.core_problem: 现有机器人基础模型仅使用单步或短历史视觉运动上下文，无法支撑长程任务、上下文模仿等能力，且长上下文扩展会带来推理延迟线性增长。
summary.importance: 首次将机器人策略的视觉运动上下文扩展到8K timestep（较SOTA高3个数量级）且不增加推理延迟，验证了预训练上下文长度scaling对闭环性能的稳定增益，提出了基于快权重的长上下文压缩架构。
summary.technical_approach: 将Test-Time Training（TTT）集成进视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，用训练和推理阶段通过梯度下降更新的快权重作为循环状态，将长时序历史压缩到权重空间，无需增长推理延迟即可支持超长上下文。
summary.experiments: 上下文长度从现有SOTA的数十timestep扩展到8K，实现了人类视频演示的one-shot上下文模仿、在线策略改进、扰动鲁棒性提升，长程多阶段任务性能显著优于基线。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自斯坦福大学、德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校、Google DeepMind等团队，包含机器人基础模型领域多位知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing robot foundation models only use single-step or short-history visuomotor context, failing to support long-horizon tasks and in-context imitation, while long context extension leads to linear increases in inference latency.
summary_en.importance: First scales robot policy visuomotor context to 8K timesteps (3 orders of magnitude higher than SOTA) without increasing inference latency, verifies steady closed-loop performance gains from pretraining context length scaling, and proposes a long context compression architecture based on fast weights.
summary_en.technical_approach: Integrates Test-Time Training (TTT) into Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, using fast weights updated via gradient descent during both training and inference as recurrent state, compressing long temporal history into weight space to support ultra-long context without increased inference latency.
summary_en.experiments: Scales context length from tens of timesteps in prior SOTA to 8K, enabling one-shot in-context imitation from human video, on-the-fly policy improvement, perturbation robustness, and significantly better performance on long-horizon multi-stage tasks than baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are affiliated with Stanford University, University of Texas at Austin, Google DeepMind and other institutions, including several leading researchers in robot foundation models.

recommendation.zh: 重点看快权重压缩长上下文的TTT架构设计，机器人领域专属实验结论可直接略过。
recommendation.en: Focus on the TTT architecture that compresses long context into fast weights; skip robot-domain specific experimental results.

paper.title: Capability from Access Structure, Not Scale: Lower Bounds and Pre-Registered Tests for Hybrid Sequence Models
paper.abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) holds that as models scale, representations of heterogeneous networks converge toward a shared model of reality. We propose its sequel and boundary, the Capability Convergence Hypothesis (CCH): under a fixed per-token inference budget, representational convergence does not entail capability convergence. Capability instead converges toward a class, the access-complete hybrid: any architecture holding both a compressive O(1)-state channel and a scalable

summary.core_problem: 讨论在固定每 token 推理预算下，为什么表征随规模收敛并不自动带来能力收敛，尤其针对混合序列模型的访问结构限制。
summary.importance: 这是偏理论的架构能力边界分析，试图把“能力来自 scale”改写为“能力来自 access structure”。对做长上下文、混合记忆架构、外部检索/压缩通道的人有概念启发，但离可直接落地的 pretrain recipe 还较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Capability Convergence Hypothesis，定义 access-complete hybrid：同时具备压缩的 O(1) 状态通道和可扩展的 verbatim-index 通道。围绕一个无限流 witness task（Newton's-apple problem）给出三类资源墙：Shannon wall、horizon wall、circuit wall，并在显式可分离假设下论证混合结构能跨越三者，能力呈超加性。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看重点是预注册测试与理论下界，而非大规模实证。没有给出与主流 LLM 在真实预训练设置下的系统比较，更多是概念性分离结果。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks why representational convergence with scale does not imply capability convergence under a fixed per-token inference budget, focusing on access-structure limits in hybrid sequence models.
summary_en.importance: This is a theory-leaning architecture paper that tries to replace a 'capability comes from scale' intuition with 'capability comes from access structure.' It is conceptually useful for long-context, hybrid-memory, and retrieval-style modeling, though still far from an actionable pretraining recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes the Capability Convergence Hypothesis and defines an access-complete hybrid: an architecture with both a compressive O(1)-state channel and a scalable verbatim-index channel. Using an infinite-stream witness task (the Newton's-apple problem), it introduces three resource walls—Shannon, horizon, and circuit—and argues, under an explicit separability assumption, that a hybrid can cross all three and yields strictly super-additive capability under composition.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the emphasis is on preregistered tests and lower-bound style arguments rather than large-scale empirical evidence. There is no clear comparison against mainstream LLMs in realistic pretraining regimes.

recommendation.zh: 想做长程记忆或 hybrid LM 可以看它的 framing，但目前更像理论宣言；先读问题设定和三道 wall，别急着接受结论。
recommendation.en: Worth a look if you work on long-memory or hybrid LMs, but it reads more like a theoretical manifesto; read the task setup and the three walls, then stay skeptical.

paper.title: PReM: Learning What to Preserve and When to Refresh for Context Compression
paper.abstract: Efficient long-context inference is not only about reducing memory cost, but also about keeping useful contextual evidence accessible as generation proceeds. However, existing compression-oriented approaches, such as key-value (KV) cache compression and context compression, often either make an early decision about which contextual information to keep or rely on an external compressor. Such designs make it difficult to adapt the compressed context to the evidence needed by later reasoning steps.

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文推理中压缩 KV/cache 或上下文后，后续生成步骤无法按需重新获得关键证据的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是长上下文推理效率和记忆管理方法：把压缩问题从一次性保留哪些 token，改成生成过程中动态决定保留什么、何时刷新。对预训练研究员有价值，因为它触及长上下文模型内部 memory 的训练接口，而不只是 serving 侧裁剪。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PReM（Preserve and Refresh Memory），把长上下文维护为模型内部 layer-wise KV memory。框架包含专门的 memory layer 做 memory-selection 决策，并引入特殊 memory token <m> 在生成过程中触发 refresh。训练上提出 Phase-Separated Refresh Training，使 memory selection 与 memory-conditioned generation 对齐，避免压缩器在早期做不可逆选择。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露模型规模、上下文长度、训练数据或具体 benchmark。实验应围绕长上下文问答/推理中的内存成本与准确率权衡，比较 KV cache compression、context compression 和外部 compressor 等 baseline。摘要强调 PReM 能在生成过程中自适应刷新证据。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles long-context inference where compressed KV caches or compressed contexts lose evidence that later generation steps may need.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a memory-management method for efficient long-context inference. Instead of making a one-shot decision about what to keep, it learns what to preserve and when to refresh during generation. This is relevant to pretraining researchers because it exposes a trainable interface for internal long-context memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: PReM maintains the long context as internal layer-wise KV memory. It uses a dedicated memory layer to make memory-selection decisions and a special memory token <m> to trigger refreshes during generation. Phase-Separated Refresh Training aligns memory selection with memory-conditioned generation, reducing the brittleness of early irreversible compression.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size, context length, training data, or benchmark names. The expected evaluation compares memory cost and task accuracy against KV-cache compression, context compression, and external-compressor baselines, with emphasis on adaptive refresh during reasoning.

recommendation.zh: 重点看 refresh training 和 memory token 触发机制；这比静态 KV 压缩更接近可训练长上下文架构接口。
recommendation.en: Focus on refresh training and the memory-token trigger; this is closer to a trainable long-context interface than static KV compression.

paper.title: Adaptive Filtering of the KV Cache: Diagnosing and Correcting Structural-Role Bias in LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Attention-based KV cache eviction (H2O and its descendants) compresses the memory-constrained state of a long-context model by ranking tokens on accumulated attention mass, treated here as signal energy, and keeping the heaviest. On schema-dense input streams such as nested JSON, this score acts as a non-stationary filter that disproportionately retains noise: a non-content sink role (delimiters or whitespace) carries an order of magnitude more energy than any content role, and structural KEY to

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究长上下文推理中的 KV cache eviction 失效模式：H2O 这类按累计注意力质量保留 token 的方法，在 JSON、XML、markdown tables 等 schema-dense 输入上，会把大量预算分给结构符号和 key，而不是答案所在的 value，导致小预算下准确率崩掉。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏 efficient inference，但对长上下文预训练和评测也有启发。它指出注意力质量不总是信息价值的代理变量，尤其在结构化文本中，delimiter、whitespace、schema key 会形成分布式 attention sink。对做长上下文模型、RAG、tool/agent trace、结构化数据训练的人，这个现象提醒我们：模型可能学会了强结构路由，但推理压缩算法如果只看 attention mass，会系统性保留错误状态。它也说明 KV 压缩 benchmark 不能只用自然语言长文，需要加入 schema-dense 场景。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先把 KV cache eviction 解释为带预算的自适应滤波：H2O 用累计 attention mass 近似“信号能量”，保留 heavy hitters。问题在于 schema-dense 文本中，高能量 token 未必是有用 token。作者给每个 token 标注结构角色，包括 KEY、VALUE、DELIM、HEADER、PROSE、WS，并分析不同角色的 attention mass 与 H2O retention rate。随后做反事实 eviction：从候选集合中禁止保留某一类角色，观察准确率变化，以区分相关性和因果作用。方法层面，作者在 SnapKV 上加入 role-conditional allocator：对噪声角色设上限，对 VALUE 等内容角色给保护下限。SnapKV 本身使用最近窗口内的注意力和 1-D max-pooling，能够压低孤立高质量 sink、提升局部内容簇；role-conditioned allocation 则显式纠正 KEY/VALUE 的保留偏置。作者还尝试用约 15MB 的线性 role probe 替代显式 parser，以降低部署依赖。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 做主要诊断，并在四个模型家族上复现部分结论。数据包括 synthetic_json、synthetic_json_compact、synthetic_xml、wikitable，任务是 leaf-value QA 或表格问答，使用 exact match 评估；预算覆盖 5%、10%、20%、30%、50%、75%、100%，100% 是 full-cache baseline。主要数字很清楚：在 synthetic_json 上，DELIM 的平均每 token attention mass 为 13.64，KEY 为 0.434，VALUE 为 0.336，PROSE 为 0.177，WS 为 0.623；DELIM 相对 VALUE 约 40 倍。H2O 在 JSON 上对 KEY 的保留率相对 VALUE 高出约 1.94/1.79/1.65 倍，对应 5%/10%/20% 预算；wikitable 中 HEADER 在 5% 预算下保留率达到 47%。性能上，full-cache EM 为 88%，H2O 在 5% 预算下掉到 0%。反事实实验显示，禁止 KEY 保留反而最好：在 synthetic_json ctx 8k、n=50 下，No-KEY 在 B=0.5 时 EM 达到 0.82，在 B=0.75 时达到 0.88；而 No-DELIM 和 No-VALUE 在所有 sub-1.0 预算下都为 0%，说明 delimiter 是必要结构支架，value 是答案载体，key 反而是最可牺牲的角色。SnapKV 的窗口注意力在 B=0.5 时关闭了 H2O gap 的 81%，加入 pooling 后在 ctx 16k 关闭 100%。role-conditional allocator 在高预算下可匹配或略高于 full-cache，但这个小幅增益被作者标注为 seed-sensitive。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 35–50 分钟。优先看诊断部分的 Fig. 1 和 Table 1，那里直接展示 attention mass 与 retention bias；再看 counterfactual eviction 的 Table 2，这是区分 KEY、VALUE、DELIM 作用的关键证据。SnapKV 分析和 role-conditional allocator 部分适合关注实现细节，尤其是 windowed mass、max-pooling、role budget cap/floor 如何组合。对预训练研究者，最值得带走的是 benchmark 设计和训练数据视角：结构化文本中的 attention sink 不是 BOS 一个固定槽位，而是格式相关、分布式的 token 群；这种现象会影响长上下文模型的压缩、检索增强和 agent trace 推理。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a failure mode of attention-based KV-cache eviction. Methods such as H2O keep tokens with the largest accumulated attention mass, but on schema-dense contexts such as nested JSON, XML, and markdown tables, this criterion over-keeps structural tokens and schema keys while evicting answer-bearing values.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in efficient inference, but it has clear implications for long-context model evaluation and deployment. The key lesson is that attention mass is not always a reliable proxy for information value. In structured inputs, delimiters, whitespace, and keys can behave as distributed attention sinks. This matters for RAG, tool traces, agent logs, and structured-data reasoning, where cache compression can erase the actual answer even when the model’s full-cache behavior is correct. It also argues for adding schema-dense inputs to KV-compression and long-context benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors frame KV-cache eviction as an adaptive filtering problem under a hard memory budget. H2O treats accumulated attention mass as signal energy and retains heavy hitters. The paper shows that, in structured text, this filter locks onto high-energy but low-content roles. Tokens are labeled by structural role, including KEY, VALUE, DELIM, HEADER, PROSE, and whitespace. The authors measure both attention mass and retention rate by role, then run counterfactual eviction experiments that ban one role from the candidate set to test causal importance. The proposed fix is a role-conditional allocator layered on SnapKV. SnapKV uses a recent-query attention window plus 1-D max pooling over the KV axis; this already suppresses isolated sink tokens and favors content clusters. The role allocator adds explicit caps for noisy roles and floor protection for content roles. A small linear role probe, about 15 MB, is evaluated as a parser substitute for deployment.
summary_en.experiments: The main diagnosis uses Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, with replication across four model families. The datasets include synthetic_json, compact JSON, synthetic XML, and wikitable inputs. Evaluation is exact match over leaf-value or table QA, with cache budgets from 5% to 100%. On synthetic JSON, average per-token attention mass is 13.64 for DELIM, 0.434 for KEY, 0.336 for VALUE, 0.177 for PROSE, and 0.623 for whitespace, so delimiter mass is roughly 40 times value mass. Under H2O, KEY tokens are retained about 1.94x, 1.79x, and 1.65x more often than VALUE tokens at 5%, 10%, and 20% budgets. On wikitable, HEADER retention reaches 47% at a 5% budget. Accuracy drops from 88% full-cache EM to 0% at a 5% H2O budget. Counterfactual eviction is the strongest evidence: banning KEY tokens improves performance, reaching 0.82 EM at B=0.5 and 0.88 at B=0.75 on 8k synthetic JSON, while banning DELIM or VALUE collapses to 0% under all sub-full budgets. Windowed SnapKV alone closes 81% of the H2O gap at B=0.5, and adding max pooling closes the gap at 16k context. The role-conditional allocator matches or slightly exceeds full-cache accuracy at higher budgets, although the authors note that this small gain is seed-sensitive.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 35–50 minutes. Start with the diagnostic figures and tables showing role-level attention mass and H2O retention bias. Then read the counterfactual eviction section, which is the most important part of the evidence. The SnapKV and allocator sections are useful for implementation details, especially the interaction between windowed attention, max pooling, and role-level budget caps or floors. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main takeaway is not the specific allocator, but the structured-text failure mode: the attention sink is distributed across format-dependent tokens, not just a fixed BOS slot, and this should affect how long-context compression benchmarks and structured-data training mixtures are designed.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是大而全的系统论文，但把 attention-score eviction 的一个脏假设掀开了；只看角色偏置诊断和 5% budget 崩盘那组实验就值回时间。
recommendation.en: Not a broad systems paper, but it exposes a dirty assumption behind attention-score eviction; the role-bias diagnosis and the 5%-budget collapse result are worth your time.

paper.title: Precomputing the Future-Offset Average in TriAttention
paper.abstract: TriAttention is a recent method for shrinking the KV cache of long-reasoning LLMs: it scores each cached key by how much attention it is likely to receive and evicts the lowest-scoring ones. Because a key does not know how far away its future queries will sit, the score is averaged over a ladder of 17 possible future distances. We point out that this average is free: the future distance enters the score only through the position-dependent rotation, so the whole 17-fold average collapses--exactly

summary.core_problem: TriAttention长上下文KV缓存剪枝方法在计算键保留分数时，需要对17种可能的未来查询距离做平均，存在无意义的计算冗余
