paper.title: Hierarchical Sparse Attention Done Right: Toward Infinite Context Modeling
paper.abstract: Scaling modern large language models (LLMs) to long contexts is limited by the quadratic computation cost, and poor length extrapolation of dense attention. Chunk-wise sparse attention offers a promising alternative, but all existing methods fall short of full attention because of their inaccurate chunk selection. We propose Hierarchical Landmark Sparse (HiLS) Attention, a chunk-wise sparse attention mechanism that learns chunk selection end-to-end under the language-modeling (LM) loss. HiLS fac

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是长上下文 LLM 中 chunk-wise sparse attention 的核心瓶颈：不是稀疏注意力本身不够省，而是 chunk selection 不够准，并且多数方法的选择过程没有被语言建模损失直接优化。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的价值在于，把 sparse attention 从工程近似推进到可训练的建模组件。已有 chunk-wise sparse attention 通常先用 mean pooling 或固定 summary 给 chunk 打分，再 hard top-K 选择；选完后 summary 和 score 被丢弃，LM loss 很难教会模型如何选对 chunk。HiLS 的关键变化是让 chunk retrieval score 参与 forward attention computation，使选择分数能在 next-token prediction 目标下学习。这个思路对 ultra-long context pretraining 很重要，因为它把长度扩展问题从 RoPE 外推或 cache 工程，转为“可学习的信息路由”问题。更重要的是，论文给出了从 full-attention 模型转成 HiLS-Attention 的继续训练路径，7B 模型只需 50B tokens continual training 就能保留短上下文能力并改善长上下文表现，这对已有基座模型改造有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从 naive Block Sparse Attention 出发。naive BSA 先计算 full attention，再把 token-level attention mass 聚合到每个 chunk，选择 attention mass 最大的 top-K chunk。这个方法不省算力，但它给出了 full attention 诱导出的理想 chunk selection pattern。HiLS 试图在不计算 full attention 的情况下近似这个 pattern。第一步是在每个 chunk 中加入 landmark token，用它产生可训练的 chunk summary key。query 与 summary key 的打分被设计成 full-attention chunk mass 的一阶 Taylor 近似，因此 summary 不只是启发式池化结果，而是有明确对齐目标的 chunk-level surrogate。第二步是 hierarchical factorization：query 先在被检索出的 chunk 之间分配注意力质量，再在每个 chunk 内部对 token 分配注意力，最后按 chunk retrieval score 融合各 chunk 的输出。这样 retrieval score 不再只是 top-K 前的临时排序信号，而是 forward attention 权重的一部分，可以通过 LM loss 端到端训练。与传统 sparse attention 相比，HiLS 的区别不在于简单换一种检索器，而在于把 chunk selection、chunk-level score、token-level attention 放进同一个可微的层级注意力结构。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 345M 到 7B 参数规模，评估包括 perplexity、短上下文 benchmark 和长上下文 benchmark。345M 规模下，HiLS-Attention 的 perplexity 接近 full attention，并在 in-domain RULER 上优于 full attention。一个关键信号是长度外推：模型只用 8K context 预训练，却能外推到 4M context，在 needle-in-a-haystack retrieval 上保持超过 90% accuracy，相当于 512× 长度外推。训练上下文增加到 256K 后，HiLS 的优势更明显；在 variable-tracking 任务上，相比 full attention 最高提升约 50%。7B 规模下，论文展示了从 full-attention model 转为 HiLS-Attention 的路线，只用 50B tokens 做 continual training，就能保持短上下文性能，同时在 LongBench 上显著超过 full-attention baseline，并优于 YaRN-extended base model。实验信息说明，HiLS 不只是降低复杂度，还可能改善长上下文中的精确检索和状态跟踪能力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 中对 chunk selection failure 的分析，以及 Fig. 2 展示的长上下文 retrieval gap。方法部分重点看三处：naive BSA 如何定义 full-attention-induced chunk mass；landmark token 和 summary key 如何对应一阶 Taylor 近似；hierarchical factorization 如何把 chunk score 纳入 forward attention。实验部分优先看 345M 的 8K-to-4M 外推、256K context 下 variable-tracking 的结果，以及 7B continual conversion 的设置。预计精读需要 1.5 到 2 小时。真正值得深挖的是它的训练稳定性和 scale-up 风险：top-K sparse routing 在大模型、多机训练、长序列 packing 下是否会带来负载不均、梯度稀疏或 early training collapse，论文结果给了积极信号，但工程细节仍需仔细检查。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the main weakness of chunk-wise sparse attention for long-context LMs: the model often selects the wrong chunks, and the selection mechanism is usually not optimized directly by the language-modeling loss.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is important for pretraining because it turns sparse long-context attention into a trainable modeling mechanism rather than a fixed approximation to full attention. Existing chunk-wise sparse methods often summarize chunks with mean pooling or other weak summaries, use them to rank chunks, and then discard the scores after hard top-K selection. As a result, the LM objective has limited ability to improve the retrieval process. HiLS changes this by injecting retrieval scores into the forward attention computation. The model can therefore learn which chunks are useful for next-token prediction. The conversion result at 7B scale is also practically relevant: a full-attention model can be converted to HiLS-Attention with 50B tokens of continual training while preserving short-context behavior and improving long-context performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper starts from a naive Block Sparse Attention construction. Naive BSA computes full attention, aggregates token-level attention mass within each chunk, and selects the top-K chunks with the largest mass. This is too expensive to use as an efficient method, but it provides a full-attention-derived target pattern for chunk selection. HiLS approximates this pattern without the full-attention pass. It appends a landmark token to each chunk and uses it to form a trainable chunk summary key. The query-summary scoring function is motivated as a first-order Taylor approximation to the chunk mass induced by full attention. The second component is a hierarchical factorization of attention. A query first allocates mass across retrieved chunks, then computes token-level attention independently within each selected chunk, and finally fuses the chunk-specific outputs using the retrieval scores. The important distinction from prior sparse attention methods is that the chunk score is not merely a pre-selection heuristic. It participates in the actual forward computation and is trained under the LM loss.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover models from 345M to 7B parameters and evaluate perplexity, short-context tasks, and long-context benchmarks. At 345M scale, HiLS-Attention reaches perplexity comparable to full attention and performs better on in-domain RULER. A central result is length extrapolation: after pretraining with only an 8K context length, the model extrapolates to 4M context and keeps over 90% accuracy on needle-in-a-haystack retrieval, corresponding to 512× length extrapolation. With 256K training contexts, the advantage becomes larger. On a variable-tracking task, HiLS improves over full attention by up to 50%. At 7B scale, the paper converts a full-attention model into HiLS-Attention with 50B tokens of continual training. The converted model preserves short-context performance while substantially outperforming full-attention baselines on LongBench and exceeding the YaRN-extended base model.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction carefully for the diagnosis of inaccurate chunk selection, especially the retrieval gap shown in Fig. 2. In the method section, focus on three parts: how naive BSA defines full-attention-induced chunk mass, how landmark-token summaries approximate that mass through a first-order Taylor view, and how the hierarchical attention factorization makes retrieval scores part of the forward pass. In the experiments, prioritize the 8K-to-4M extrapolation result, the 256K-context variable-tracking result, and the 7B continual-conversion setup. A careful read should take about 1.5 to 2 hours. The main follow-up questions are engineering-related: stability during early training, routing imbalance, sparse-gradient behavior, and the interaction with sequence packing and distributed training.

recommendation.zh: 值得读的是“把 chunk 选择变成 LM loss 可训练路由”的实现细节；若真能原生稀疏训到接近全注意力，应立刻复现并测长外推与训练稳定性。
recommendation.en: Read for the concrete trick of making chunk selection differentiable under the LM loss; if native sparse training truly matches dense attention, it’s worth reproducing with clean length-extrapolation and stability checks.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Quantize the Target, Quantize the Drafter: Efficient Inference with Qwen3.5-4B
paper.abstract: This report describes our approach to the Efficient Qwen Competition, where the goal is to enable low-latency serving of Qwen3.5-4B on a resource-constrained NVIDIA A10G GPU. Our system combines a quantized target model with speculative decoding. To recover accuracy, we apply quantization-aware distillation to the target model while retaining the original quantization grid. To speed up decoding, a block-diffusion drafter specialized for the quantized target model is trained using a two-stage pro

summary.core_problem: 在资源受限的单卡 NVIDIA A10G（24GB VRAM）上部署 Qwen3.5-4B 时，需要同时满足低延迟推理与严格的质量阈值约束；现有单独使用量化或推测解码的方案，难以在目标模型精度、草稿模型接受率、端到端延迟三者之间取得平衡，尤其是量化后的目标模型分布偏移会破坏草稿模型的对齐。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于：后训练量化与蒸馏、推测解码草稿模型的训练、目标-草稿的分布对齐是一个联合优化问题，不能割裂处理；两阶段草稿训练（先对齐高精度目标、再适配低精度目标）的思路可迁移到其他“目标模型发生分布偏移后需要重训辅助模块”的场景，例如持续预训练后重训推测解码草稿、重训检索增强的适配器等。
summary.technical_approach: 整体方案由量化目标模型与适配的推测解码系统两部分组成。目标模型侧：从现成的 AWQ INT4 PTQ 检查点出发，使用原始 BF16 模型作为教师，执行固定量化网格的量化感知蒸馏（QAD），通过前向 KL 做逐 token 蒸馏，权重更新后重新舍入回原 AWQ 尺度的 INT4 网格，最终以 W4A16 格式部署。推测解码侧：训练基于 DFlash 的块扩散草稿模型，利用目标模型多层隐藏状态作为条件，单次前向预测多个未来 token；采用两阶段训练，第一阶段用 BF16 目标模型及其生成的数据训练草稿，第二阶段用 QAD 后的量化目标模型及其生成的数据微调，解决量化导致的分布偏移。进一步对草稿模型做 GPTQ INT4 量化，并引入滑动窗口注意力（SWA）降低长上下文下的注意力开销，同时提升草稿接受长度。
summary.experiments: 该方案在 Efficient Qwen 竞赛中排名第 3（共 40+ 队伍）。端到端平均加速比达 6.978×：短输入（64/128 token）从 2582ms 降至 232ms，中等输入（2048/256）从 5441ms 降至 782ms，长输入（8192/256）从 6576ms 降至 2313ms。质量指标均满足阈值：MMLU-Pro 0.659（阈值 ≥0.621）、IFEval 0.845（阈值 ≥0.814）、GPQA-Diamond 0.667（阈值 ≥0.630）。组件消融显示：INT4 QAD 目标模型单独贡献 2.16× 加速；加入两阶段训练的 BF16 草稿后提升至 3.32×；草稿 INT4 量化后提升至 3.55×；草稿加入 SWA 后提升至 3.57×，其中 SWA 对长输入场景的增益最明显（从 2.49× 提升至 2.81×）。训练数据来自 Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2 中随机抽取的 22 万样本，经目标模型再生后打包为 16384 长度序列。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点放在方法部分的两阶段草稿训练设计、QAD 的固定量化网格实现细节，以及表 2 的组件消融，理解每个模块对加速比和质量的边际贡献。图 2 的工作流示意图可快速建立整体认知。竞赛设置与主结果表 1 浏览即可，无需深入。预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Deploying Qwen3.5-4B on a resource-constrained single NVIDIA A10G GPU (24 GB VRAM) requires simultaneously meeting strict low-latency targets and quality thresholds. Standalone quantization or speculative decoding fails to balance target-model accuracy, draft-token acceptance rate, and end-to-end latency — in particular, distribution shift introduced by target-model quantization breaks alignment with a separately trained drafter.
summary_en.importance: The key takeaway for pretraining research is that post-training quantization/distillation, speculative-decoding drafter training, and target-drafter distribution alignment must be treated as a joint optimization problem rather than isolated steps. The two-stage drafter training recipe — first aligning to a high-precision target, then adapting to a low-precision shifted target — generalizes to other settings where auxiliary modules must be retrained after target-model distribution shifts, such as drafter refresh after continual pretraining or adapter adaptation for retrieval-augmented systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system combines a quantized target model with an adapted speculative decoding pipeline. On the target side, an existing AWQ INT4 post-training quantization checkpoint is used as initialization; quantization-aware distillation (QAD) is applied with the original BF16 model as teacher, minimizing per-token forward KL divergence while keeping the AWQ per-group quantization scales frozen. Updated BF16 weights are rounded back to the original INT4 grid at packing time, and the final model is served in W4A16 format. On the speculative decoding side, a lightweight DFlash-style block-diffusion drafter is trained on top of the frozen target, using multi-layer hidden states from the target as conditioning to predict multiple future tokens in one forward pass. A two-stage pipeline is used: Stage 1 trains the drafter from scratch against the BF16 target and its regenerated data; Stage 2 fine-tunes the drafter against the QAD quantized target and its regenerated data to absorb quantization-induced distribution shift. The drafter is further compressed with GPTQ INT4 post-training quantization and equipped with sliding-window attention to reduce long-context compute and improve acceptance length.
summary_en.experiments: The submission ranked 3rd out of 40+ teams in the Efficient Qwen Competition. End-to-end average speedup reaches 6.978× over the unoptimized baseline: short inputs (64/128 tokens) drop from 2582ms to 232ms, medium inputs (2048/256) from 5441ms to 782ms, and long inputs (8192/256) from 6576ms to 2313ms. All quality thresholds are satisfied: MMLU-Pro 0.659 (threshold ≥0.621), IFEval 0.845 (threshold ≥0.814), GPQA-Diamond 0.667 (threshold ≥0.630). Component ablation shows the INT4 QAD target alone delivers 2.16× speedup; adding the two-stage BF16 drafter raises it to 3.32×; INT4 quantization of the drafter brings it to 3.55×; sliding-window attention on the drafter reaches 3.57×, with the largest gains on long-context inputs (from 2.49× to 2.81×). Training data is regenerated by the target model from 220K randomly sampled examples from Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v2, packed into 16,384-token sequences.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim pass, focus on the two-stage drafter training design, the fixed-grid QAD implementation details, and the component ablation table to understand the marginal contribution of each module to speedup and quality. The workflow diagram gives a quick overview of the full pipeline. The competition setup and main results table can be browsed lightly. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 不是会改写你对预训练的 prior，但把“量化 target + 量化 drafter + 两阶段适配”串成可落地 recipe，做 serving 的人该看实验分解。
recommendation.en: It will not change your pretraining priors, but the recipe of quantizing both target and drafter with two-stage adaptation is practical; read the ablations, not the hype.

paper.title: KVpop -- Key-Value Cache Compression with Predictive Online Pruning
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) cache growth is a major bottleneck in autoregressive decoding, as memory and bandwidth scale linearly with context length. Existing KV eviction methods often rely on static heuristics or proxy scores, which poorly track future token utility and cause brittle eviction as relevance shifts. To address this, we introduce KVpop, which learns a fixed-budget KV eviction policy by directly supervising the keep-or-drop decision. The scorer is trained against a novel future-attention target

summary.core_problem: 现有KV缓存压缩方法要么依赖启发式规则无法精准识别长期有用token，要么学习式策略在token插入时就做驱逐决策且监督信号未对齐未来实际效用，导致高压缩率下性能下降明显。
summary.importance: KV缓存驱逐策略的设计可与训练阶段的未来注意力监督信号深度结合，该思路不仅适用于推理优化，还可迁移到Transformer-SSM混合架构等需要动态选择序列记忆的场景；延迟决策到驱逐边界的设计，为平衡短期上下文证据与长期记忆保留提供了可落地的方案，且无需修改基础模型架构。
summary.technical_approach: 作为预训练LLM的稀疏注意力改造方案，每个KV头固定保留少量sink token、最近的保护窗口token，其余旧token竞争固定数量的长期缓存槽位；核心设计包括两点：一是用token离开保护窗口后收到的未来注意力质量作为监督信号，训练时通过转置注意力pass计算目标，无需实例化稠密注意力图，无推理开销；二是支持有状态打分器，将token的打分决策延迟到其即将离开保护窗口的驱逐边界，利用保护窗口内积累的近未来上下文提升判断准确性；训练时采用边界感知的pairwise logistic loss，仅关注决定缓存去留的边界处token排序，推理时每个头的KV缓存大小固定。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-4B上，75%和88%的KV压缩率下分别保留95%和94%的稠密注意力性能；在Qwen3-8B上，同压缩率下分别保留95%和99%的稠密注意力性能，表现优于启发式与现有学习式驱逐基线；学到的驱逐策略可迁移到分布外的代码生成与STEM推理基准，同时实现近乎恒定的内存占用与更快的长序列生成速度。
summary.reading_guide: 先看引言中现有KV驱逐方法的缺陷与Figure1的整体架构示意图，再泛读方法部分的未来注意力目标定义、边界感知损失设计与有状态打分器机制；实验部分重点关注不同压缩率下的性能保留率与跨域迁移结果，附录的实现细节可按需查阅，预计阅读时间25-35分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV cache compression methods rely on either heuristic rules that fail to identify long-term useful tokens or learned policies that make eviction decisions at insertion time with supervision unaligned to future utility, leading to steep performance drops at high compression ratios.
summary_en.importance: The design of KV eviction policies can be tightly coupled with training-time supervision from future attention patterns, a principle that extends beyond inference optimization to memory selection mechanisms in hybrid architectures such as Transformer-SSM models. The delayed-decision framing provides a practical way to balance short-term context evidence and long-term memory retention without modifying the base model architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: A sparse-attention retrofit for pretrained LLMs that enforces a fixed per-head KV budget: each head permanently retains a small set of sink tokens, a protected window of recent tokens, and a fixed-size top-k long-range cache for older tokens. Two core designs distinguish it from prior work: first, supervision uses the future attention mass a token receives after leaving the protected window, computed via a training-only transposed attention pass that avoids materializing dense attention maps, adding no inference overhead; second, stateful scorers delay retention scoring until the token reaches the eviction boundary, leveraging near-future context accumulated during the protected period. Training uses a boundary-aware pairwise logistic loss that only focuses on token ranking decisions that determine cache membership, keeping per-step compute overhead low.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen3-4B, it retains 95% and 94% of dense-attention performance at 75% and 88% KV compression ratios respectively. On Qwen3-8B, it retains 95% and 99% of dense performance under the same compression ratios, outperforming both heuristic and existing learned eviction baselines. The learned policy transfers to out-of-domain code generation and STEM reasoning benchmarks, with near-constant memory usage and faster long-sequence generation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the limitations of prior KV eviction methods in the introduction and the overall pipeline diagram in Figure 1, then skim the method section for the future-attention target definition, boundary-aware loss design, and stateful scorer mechanism. Focus the experiment review on performance retention across compression ratios and out-of-domain transfer results; skip appendix implementation details unless reproducing the method. Estimated reading time: 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读这篇主要不是学 serving，而是看它把“未来注意力”当监督信号这件事；若结果稳，说明很多 KV 启发式其实一直在错估 token utility。
recommendation.en: Read it less for serving tricks and more for the idea of supervising cache eviction with future attention; if the setup holds, many heuristic KV policies have been mismeasuring token utility.

paper.title: Gemma 4 Technical Report
paper.abstract: We introduce Gemma 4, a new generation of open-weight, natively multimodal language models in the Gemma model family. Designed to advance compute efficiency and reasoning, the Gemma 4 model suite features dense and Mixture-of-Experts architectures, ranging from 2.3B to 31B parameters. Alongside improved vision and audio encoders for all model sizes, we propose a unified, encoder-free architecture for our 12B model, which ingests raw audio and image patches. Furthermore, we integrate a thinking m

summary.core_problem: Gemma 4 解决的是开源权重模型在多模态、推理、长上下文和推理效率之间的联合取舍问题。它不是单点模型更新，而是一套面向不同硬件预算的模型族设计：从 2.3B、4.5B、12B、31B dense，到 26B total / 3.8B activated 的 MoE，同时覆盖文本、图像、音频和 thinking mode。核心问题可以概括为：如何在较小到中等参数规模内，把 multimodal pretraining、long-context efficiency、reasoning post-training 和 serving 友好的结构设计放进同一个可发布体系。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响主要有三点。第一，Gemma 4 把 open-weight 模型的设计重心从“文本 LLM + 外接多模态 encoder”推进到更原生的多模态建模，尤其是 12B 的 encoder-free 方案，直接把图像 patch 和 raw audio chunk 投入 LLM embedding space。这个方向对 unified multimodal LM 有参考意义。第二，报告把长上下文能力放在架构层面处理，而不是只依赖外推技巧：local/global attention ratio、p-RoPE、KV cache sharing、global layer 中 keys-as-values 共同减少 KV cache 压力。第三，Gemma 4 明确把 post-training 的 thinking mode、QAT 量化版本、MTP drafter head 一起纳入发布形态，说明 pretrain、posttrain 和 serving 约束已经被联合优化，而不是串行拼接。
summary.technical_approach: 模型主体仍是 decoder-only Transformer，使用 pre-norm 和 post-norm 的 RMSNorm，并加入 QKNorm。模型族包含 dense 和 MoE 两类；E2B 与 E4B 使用 per-layer embeddings，因此有效参数为 2.3B 和 4.5B，但总参数分别约为 5B 和 8B。长上下文部分沿用局部注意力与全局注意力混合：E2B 是 4:1 local-to-global，其余模型是 5:1。全局层使用 p-RoPE，p=0.25；局部层使用普通 RoPE。全局和局部 RoPE frequency 分别设为 1M 与 10k。除 E2B/E4B 外，global attention layer 复用 keys 作为 values，使全局 KV cache 最多减少 37.5%。E2B/E4B 还使用 KV cache sharing，比例为 20/35 与 18/42。多模态部分有两条路线。多数模型使用冻结的 vision/audio encoder：小模型配 150M ViT，大模型配 550M ViT；音频 encoder 为 305M USM-style Conformer，输入为 40ms Mel filterbank chunk，相比 Gemma 3n 的 680M 音频 encoder 减少 55% 参数。12B 模型采用更激进的 encoder-free 设计：图像输入为 48×48×3 RGB patches，经单个大矩阵投影到 LLM embedding space，投影模块约 35M 参数，并加入 2D coordinate-based positional embeddings；音频直接把 16kHz 下 40ms 的 raw audio chunk，即 640 维向量，投影到 LLM embedding space，不再使用 Conformer encoder。训练数据覆盖 web documents、code、images、audio，截止到 2025 年 1 月；tokenizer 沿用 Gemini 系列 SentencePiece，包含 split digits、preserved whitespace、byte-level encoding，词表为 262k。推理侧提供 MTP drafter head 支持 speculative decoding，并发布 QAT 量化模型以降低参数显存和延迟。
summary.experiments: 报告给出的关键量化信息集中在架构和效率侧。模型规模覆盖 2.3B effective、4.5B effective、12B、31B dense，以及 26B total / 3.8B activated MoE。视觉 encoder 有 150M 与 550M 两档；音频 encoder 从 680M 降到 305M，减少 55%。12B encoder-free 视觉投影模块约 35M，相比 550M ViT encoder 显著降低额外模块体量。长上下文中，global layer 的 keys-as-values 与 p-RoPE 组合使 global KV cache footprint 最多减少 37.5%。视觉输入支持可变长宽比，并把最大 token 数限制在 70、140、280、560、1120 等档位。性能上，报告声称 Gemma 4 在 STEM、多模态、长上下文 benchmark，以及 Arena 类人评中达到接近更大开源前沿模型的水平；但给定内容没有列出具体 benchmark 表格数值，因此更可靠的实验解读应聚焦这些工程可复现设计：KV cache 节省、encoder 参数缩减、MTP drafter、QAT，以及 encoder-free 12B 的质量/效率权衡。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读三块。第一是 Model Architecture，尤其是 local/global attention ratio、p-RoPE、keys-as-values、KV cache sharing 的组合方式。这部分对长上下文预训练和 serving 成本最有直接参考价值。第二是 unified encoder-free 12B。重点看它如何用 48×48 图像 patch、2D coordinate embedding 和 raw audio 40ms chunk 替代重型 encoder；这里的关键不是省参数本身，而是多模态输入是否可以更早进入 LM token space。第三是 tokenizer、data filtering、QAT 和 MTP drafter 的发布策略。它们说明一个可用 open-weight 模型族需要同时考虑训练语料、污染控制、推理路径和部署格式。若时间有限，先读架构表、长上下文设计图表、encoder-free 章节和 benchmark 汇总表；再看 appendix 中 vision encoder 可变长宽比算法和各模型配置表。
summary.authors_note: Gemma Team，来自 Google / Google DeepMind 体系。Gemma 4 延续 Gemma、Gemma 2、Gemma 3、Gemma 3n 的 open-weight 路线，技术背景与 Gemini 系列 tokenizer、多模态训练和端侧部署需求密切相关。

summary_en.core_problem: Gemma 4 addresses a combined design problem: how to build open-weight models that handle text, vision, audio, reasoning traces, long contexts, and efficient inference under realistic hardware budgets. The report is not just a model-size update. It describes a full model family, ranging from 2.3B and 4.5B effective dense models to 12B, 31B, and a 26B-total / 3.8B-activated MoE model, with a consistent set of choices for multimodal pretraining, long-context attention, quantization, and speculative decoding.
summary_en.importance: The main pretraining relevance is the move toward more native multimodal language modeling. Most Gemma 4 models still use frozen vision and audio encoders, but the 12B model removes both heavy encoders and directly projects image patches and raw audio chunks into the LLM embedding space. That makes the report useful for researchers thinking about unified multimodal token streams rather than adapter-style multimodal systems. A second contribution is the long-context recipe: local/global attention patterns, p-RoPE, KV-cache sharing, and reusing keys as values in global layers are combined to reduce inference memory pressure. A third point is the product-shaped training interface: thinking mode, quantization-aware training, and an MTP drafter head are treated as part of the released system rather than as afterthoughts.
summary_en.technical_approach: The backbone remains a decoder-only Transformer with RMSNorm in both pre-norm and post-norm positions, plus QKNorm. The family includes dense and MoE variants. E2B and E4B use per-layer embeddings, giving 2.3B and 4.5B effective parameters out of roughly 5B and 8B total parameters. For long contexts, E2B uses a 4:1 local-to-global attention pattern, while the larger models use 5:1. Global layers use p-RoPE with p=0.25, while local layers use standard RoPE. The RoPE frequencies are 1M for global layers and 10k for local layers. Except for E2B and E4B, global layers reuse keys as values, reducing the global KV-cache footprint by up to 37.5%. E2B and E4B additionally use KV-cache sharing ratios of 20/35 and 18/42. The multimodal design has two paths. Most models use frozen encoders: 150M or 550M ViTs for vision, and a 305M USM-style Conformer audio encoder operating on 40 ms Mel-filterbank chunks. The 12B model is trained from scratch with an encoder-free design. It takes 48×48×3 RGB patches, projects them through a roughly 35M-parameter matrix into the LLM embedding space, and adds coordinate-based 2D positional embeddings. For audio, it segments 16 kHz waveforms into 40 ms chunks, producing 640-dimensional vectors that are directly projected into the LLM embedding space. The training data includes web documents, code, images, and audio with a January 2025 cutoff. The tokenizer is a 262k-entry SentencePiece tokenizer with split digits, preserved whitespace, and byte-level encodings. The release also includes quantization-aware trained variants and an autoregressive multi-token prediction drafter head for speculative decoding.
summary_en.experiments: The most concrete quantitative evidence in the provided content is architectural and efficiency-related. The family spans 2.3B effective, 4.5B effective, 12B, 31B dense, and 26B-total / 3.8B-activated MoE models. Vision encoders come in 150M and 550M sizes. The audio encoder is reduced from 680M in the previous design to 305M, a 55% parameter reduction. The encoder-free 12B replaces the 550M vision encoder with a roughly 35M projection module. The global KV-cache footprint is reduced by up to 37.5% through the combination of p-RoPE and key-as-value reuse in global layers. Vision inputs support variable aspect ratios with maximum token budgets of 70, 140, 280, 560, and 1120. The report states gains across STEM, multimodal, long-context benchmarks, and Arena-style human evaluation, but the supplied text does not expose the exact benchmark tables. The safest reading is to treat the efficiency and architectural numbers as the primary reusable evidence, and then inspect the original benchmark tables for quality trade-offs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the architecture section closely. The most useful details are the local/global attention schedule, p-RoPE placement, key-as-value reuse, and KV-cache sharing. These are directly relevant to long-context pretraining and serving cost. Then read the encoder-free 12B section, especially the image patch projection, coordinate embeddings, and direct raw-audio chunk projection. The main question is whether heavy modality encoders are still necessary when the LM is trained from scratch with multimodal inputs. Finally, inspect the tokenizer, filtering, QAT, and MTP drafter sections. They show how the pretraining recipe connects to deployment constraints. If time is limited, prioritize the model configuration tables, long-context design figures, the encoder-free architecture description, and the benchmark summary tables.
summary_en.authors_note: Gemma Team from the Google / Google DeepMind ecosystem. The work continues the Gemma open-weight line and is closely tied to Gemini-family tokenizer choices, multimodal training infrastructure, and deployment-oriented model design.

recommendation.zh: 应优先读架构、数据配比和消融表；12B encoder-free 多模态若细节扎实，会影响下一轮统一模型 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture, data-mixture, and ablation sections first; the 12B encoder-free multimodal setup could change the next unified-model ablation plan if the details are clean.

institutions: opers and researchers everywhere to build upon

paper.title: SelfMem: Self-Optimizing Memory for AI Agents
paper.abstract: While current AI agents support increasingly long context windows, tool use, and skill execution for long-horizon tasks, they still require memory systems to effectively leverage historical experience. Existing memory frameworks typically rely on fixed storage, retrieval, and summarization mechanisms, which can be rigid across different tasks and often require manual tuning. To address this limitation, we propose SelfMem, a self-optimizing memory framework. Inspired by prior work on self-improvi

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程 agent 在超长历史中如何自适应形成、检索和压缩记忆，而不是依赖固定 memory policy 的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 agent memory 框架工作，贡献偏系统方法：把 memory 从手工设计的固定模块，改成可在反馈中自我优化的策略。对预训练本身不直接，但对长上下文使用、经验回放和 test-time adaptation 有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SelfMem。它不给 agent 预设单一记忆格式或固定检索/摘要策略，而是提供 memory tools 与反馈信号，让 agent 在环境中探索、评估并迭代自己的 memory strategy。核心思想更接近 self-improving policy over memory operations，而不是更强的静态 memory retriever。
summary.experiments: 在 BEAM 上评测，覆盖 100K 到 1M token 的对话规模。摘要称其持续优于 retrieval、compression 和 agent-memory baselines。未见更细的模型规模、训练成本和 ablation 信息，因此当前更适合把它当作 agent memory design 的一个系统点子，而不是稳定结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 KAUST 的 PRADA Lab 与 University of Macau。团队近来持续做 agent、memory 与 self-improving framework。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses how long-horizon agents should adaptively form, retrieve, and compress memory over very long histories instead of relying on a fixed memory policy.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory systems paper. Its contribution is to turn memory from a hand-designed static module into a self-optimized strategy. It is not directly about pretraining, but it may inform long-context usage, experience replay, and test-time adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SelfMem does not impose a single memory format or a fixed retrieval/summarization rule. Instead, it provides memory tools and feedback signals so the agent can explore, evaluate, and refine its own memory strategy. The key idea is a self-improving policy over memory operations rather than a stronger static retriever.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on BEAM across conversation scales from 100K to 1M tokens. From the abstract, SelfMem consistently beats retrieval, compression, and agent-memory baselines. The abstract does not expose model sizes, training cost, or detailed ablations, so this is better treated as a systems idea than a settled result.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from PRADA Lab at KAUST and the University of Macau. The group has been active in agent, memory, and self-improving framework work.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心长上下文 agent 的 memory policy，这篇可看；但它更像 test-time 策略学习，不会直接改你的 pretrain prior，先看任务设定和 ablation 是否干净。
recommendation.en: Worth a look if you care about memory policy for long-horizon agents, but this is mostly test-time strategy learning, not something that should move your pretraining prior without cleaner ablations.

PRADA Lab, King Abdullah University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Mixture-of-Parallelisms: Towards Memory-Efficient Training Stack for Mixture-of-Experts Models
paper.abstract: This paper showcases a memory-efficient training stack for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. It is a training paradigm that combines and specializes various existing and novel parallelism techniques at different layers and stages of the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model training pipeline. It leverages these techniques to achieve maximal efficiency given the physical constraints of CPU, CPU memory, GPU HBM memory, and the CPU-GPU, GPU-GPU, and node-node communication bandwidth of the GPU cluster. It

summary.core_problem: 现有万亿参数长上下文MoE模型训练普遍采用全局统一的并行策略，无法匹配注意力、MoE前馈、词表投影、优化器状态等不同组件的差异化瓶颈，导致GPU显存、互联带宽、CPU/主机内存等资源利用率低，无法在有限硬件下支撑百万上下文的万亿参数训练。
summary.importance: 打破了全局统一并行策略的设计惯性，提出按组件瓶颈匹配并行方式的系统设计范式，大幅降低了万亿级MoE预训练与微调的硬件门槛；给出了长上下文MoE训练的内存-带宽瓶颈拆解方法，以及三个无损优化的具体实现，为后续大模型训练系统设计提供了可复用的组件级并行方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出混合并行（MoP）训练栈，放弃全局统一并行计划，为MoE模型的每个组件匹配对应瓶颈的分片策略，且所有并行方式在秩级别保持类数据并行特性（每个设备持有不同token分片和对应权重分片），避免3D并行的秩乘法开销。核心包含三个无损优化：1）基于最小负载专家并行（LLEP）的内存高效专家并行，将路由通信与专家计算重叠，降低MoE激活的瞬时内存占用同时保留LLEP的加速效果；2）数据-张量混合分片的词表投影，无需实例化O(NV)规模的logit张量即可计算精确损失和梯度，且满足类数据并行的秩不变性；3）流水线式优化器更新，通过计算-通信重叠压缩优化器步骤的关键路径耗时。所有优化均为无损，不改变训练语义。
summary.experiments: 在120B、600B、1T参数的MoE模型上分别用2、8、12台8×H200节点训练，与最优调参的FSDP2基线相比，MoP的单GPU吞吐量提升4.7~8.2倍，且模型规模越大优势越明显；FSDP2在上下文长度超过64K~128K时即显存耗尽，而MoP可稳定支持最高1M token的上下文训练，且吞吐量随上下文增长几乎保持平稳，万亿参数规模下每步耗时基本由前向/反向计算主导。
summary.reading_guide: 预计阅读时间20-25分钟。重点关注第3.1-3.2节的组件级瓶颈分析与并行策略匹配逻辑、第3.3-3.5节的三个核心无损优化的具体实现、第4节的不同规模模型与上下文长度下的吞吐量/内存对比图表；训练系统方向研究者可深挖附录中通信重叠的实现细节，预训练配方方向研究者可重点关注硬件资源利用率的拆解部分。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing trillion-parameter long-context MoE training relies on uniform global parallelism strategies that fail to match the distinct bottlenecks of different components (attention, MoE feed-forward, vocabulary projection, optimizer state), resulting in underutilization of GPU HBM, interconnect bandwidth, CPU/host memory, and making million-context trillion-parameter training infeasible on limited hardware budgets.
summary_en.importance: Breaks the conventional design inertia of uniform global parallelism, proposes a component-matched parallelism paradigm that drastically reduces the hardware barrier for trillion-scale MoE pretraining and fine-tuning. It also provides a structured memory-bandwidth bottleneck decomposition for long-context MoE training, along with three lossless optimizations that serve as reusable building blocks for future large model training system design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Mixture-of-Parallelisms (MoP), a training stack that abandons uniform global parallel plans and assigns sharding strategies matched to each MoE component's dominant bottleneck. All composed parallelism methods maintain a data-parallel-like rank invariant (each device holds a distinct token shard and corresponding weight shard), avoiding the rank multiplication overhead of 3D parallelism. Three core lossless optimizations are included: 1) A memory-efficient expert parallelism built on Least-Loaded Expert Parallelism (LLEP) that overlaps routing communication with expert computation to reduce transient MoE activation footprint while preserving LLEP speedups; 2) A sharded data-tensor-parallel vocabulary projection that computes exact loss and gradients without materializing the O(NV) logit tensor, while respecting the data-parallel rank invariant; 3) A pipelined optimizer update scheme that compresses critical path time via computation-communication overlap. All optimizations preserve exact training semantics.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 120B, 600B, and 1T parameter MoE models trained on 2, 8, and 12 8×H200 nodes respectively. Compared to the best-tuned FSDP2 baseline, MoP delivers 4.7–8.2× higher per-GPU throughput, with advantages widening as model scale grows. FSDP2 runs out of memory at context lengths beyond 64K–128K, while MoP stably supports up to 1M token context with nearly flat throughput across context lengths; per-step wall time at trillion-parameter scale is essentially bounded by forward and backward compute.
summary_en.reading_guide: Estimated reading time 20-25 minutes. Focus on Sections 3.1–3.2 for component-level bottleneck analysis and parallelism assignment logic, Sections 3.3–3.5 for implementation details of the three core lossless optimizations, and Section 4's throughput/memory comparison plots across model scales and context lengths. For training system researchers, deep dive into appendix communication overlap implementation details; for pretraining recipe researchers, focus on hardware resource utilization breakdowns.

recommendation.zh: 这是典型“系统细节决定能不能做实验”的 paper；先看并行分解和 optimizer step，若 loss 等价性证据干净，内部长上下文 MoE 栈应立刻对照复现。
recommendation.en: This is the kind of paper where systems detail determines whether the experiment is even feasible; read the parallelism decomposition and optimizer-step design first, then verify whether the loss-equivalence evidence is actually clean.

paper.title: A Hippocampus for Linear Attention: An Exact Memory for What the Recurrent State Forgets
paper.abstract: Linear-attention and state-space language models compress the prefix into a fixed-size recurrent state, yielding O(1) memory at the cost of a lossy exact memory: when many key--value associations compete, earlier facts are overwritten and needle recall degrades. Inspired by Complementary Learning Systems, we give linear attention a hippocampal complement. HOLA (Hippocampal Linear Attention) keeps the usual delta-rule state as a compressive memory and adds a bounded exact KV cache, forming a semi

summary.core_problem: 线性注意力与状态空间类模型将前缀上下文压缩到固定大小的循环状态，虽能实现O(1)内存复杂度与次二次计算开销，但固定状态属于有损记忆，新写入的信息会覆盖旧的键值关联，在多事实关联召回、长上下文针检索、远距离精确拷贝这类需要精确记忆的任务上性能显著弱于标准softmax注意力。
summary.importance: 从互补学习系统的认知机制视角出发，为线性注意力补上了缺失的精确记忆能力，在不损失线性注意力效率优势的前提下达到了与全注意力相当的长程检索表现，为线性注意力/SSM架构的长上下文落地提供了可复用的设计思路，也为半参数化语言模型的记忆系统设计提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: HOLA（海马体线性注意力）实现了半参数化的测试时记忆架构：保留原有delta规则更新的循环状态作为类新皮层的参数化组件，负责建模可线性压缩的通用结构；额外增加一个有固定容量上限的精确KV缓存作为类海马体的非参数组件，负责存储不应被强制压缩进循环状态的单样本关联。缓存写入不需要学习额外的驱逐模块，直接复用delta规则更新时的残差更新幅度β·||e||作为惊喜度评分，保留那些让循环状态产生大幅校正、现有压缩记忆预测不准的token，而非简单滑动窗口保留最近的token。缓存读取时单独在缓存路径增加RMSNorm-γ缩放，解决直接复用原线性注意力归一化Q/K时logit值过小、softmax过于平滑导致退化为有损平均的问题，实现锐利的近argmax精确检索，同时不破坏原delta规则的状态更新稳定性。
summary.experiments: 340M参数规模、15B SlimPajama token上的训练结果显示：HOLA在Wikitext上困惑度达到22.9，低于同骨干的Gated DeltaNet基线（27.32）和全注意力Transformer++基线（26.88）；在RULER长上下文检索基准上，外推到32k序列长度（16倍训练长度2k）时性能保持稳定，显著优于Gated DeltaNet和滑动窗口缓存基线，常识推理任务性能与基线持平。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注3.2-3.4节的半参数记忆框架推导，理解两个核心设计选择的必要性：基于惊喜度的缓存驱逐策略、缓存路径独立的RMSNorm缩放；文中的神经科学类比仅作说明用途，无需过度投入精力。总预计阅读时间25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Linear attention and state space language models compress prefix context into a fixed-size recurrent state to achieve O(1) memory usage and sub-quadratic compute, but this fixed state is an inherently lossy memory: new writes overwrite old key-value associations along shared key directions, leading to poor performance on exact recall tasks such as multi-item association, needle-in-haystack retrieval, and long-range verbatim copying, where full softmax attention remains the gold standard.
summary_en.importance: Drawing on complementary learning systems theory from cognitive neuroscience, this work adds a missing exact recall capability to linear attention, matching full-attention long-range retrieval performance without sacrificing linear attention's efficiency advantages. The semiparametric memory framework provides a reusable design pattern for building efficient, long-context architectures for both linear attention and state space models.
summary_en.technical_approach: HOLA (Hippocampal Linear Attention) implements a semiparametric test-time memory with two complementary components: the standard delta-rule recurrent state, which acts as a parametric compressor for linearly generalizable structure (analogous to neocortical memory); and a bounded-capacity exact KV cache, which acts as a non-parametric episodic store for one-shot associations that cannot be well absorbed into the compressed state (analogous to hippocampal memory). For cache writes, no learned eviction module is required: the model uses the intrinsic surprise signal already computed during delta rule updates -- the magnitude of the committed residual correction to the state β·||e|| -- as the eviction score, retaining tokens that produce large state updates rather than holding only recent tokens as in sliding window approaches. For cache reads, a dedicated RMSNorm-γ scaling is applied exclusively to the cache path to fix the overly uniform softmax issue caused by low-magnitude logits from unit-norm keys, enabling sharp near-argmax exact retrieval without destabilizing the delta rule's recurrent state updates.
summary_en.experiments: Trained at 340M parameter scale on 15B SlimPajama tokens, HOLA achieves a Wikitext perplexity of 22.9, outperforming both the same-backbone Gated DeltaNet baseline (27.32) and a full-attention Transformer++ baseline (26.88). On hard RULER long-context recall benchmarks, HOLA maintains robust performance when extrapolated out to 32k sequence length (16x the 2k training length), while Gated DeltaNet and sliding window cache baselines degrade sharply. Performance on commonsense reasoning tasks remains on par with all baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Sections 3.2 to 3.4, which derive the semiparametric memory framework and justify the two core design choices: surprise-based cache eviction, and decoupled RMSNorm scaling for cache reads. The neuroscience analogies are illustrative rather than technically necessary; prioritize the engineering tradeoff logic for the write and read paths. Total expected reading time: 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 线性注意力记忆增强的优雅方案，无学习参数的缓存写入策略很有启发，重点看§3的缓存读写机制和§4的针检索实验。
recommendation.en: Elegant memory augmentation for linear attention with parameter-free cache writing; focus on §3 cache mechanism and §4 needle-in-haystack results.

paper.title: The risk of KV cache compression
paper.abstract: Transformer inference on long sequences is expensive because softmax attention repeatedly reads from a large KV cache. The prevalent approach to this bottleneck is KV cache compression, which replaces the full cache with a compact summary. Despite its practical importance, the design of such summaries is largely driven by empirical experimentation. On the theoretical side, existing results show that KV cache compression can be impossible in the worst case, but offer little systematic guidance fo

summary.core_problem: KV cache compression常用启发式规则决定保留哪些 token，例如近因性、累计 attention mass 或 attention sink，但缺少一个回答“什么时候能安全压缩、压缩到多小会不可避免地产生误差”的理论框架。该工作研究固定压缩预算下，压缩后的 KV cache 在未来 query 上保留 softmax attention 输出的最小可达风险。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏理论和推理效率，但对长上下文预训练研究也有启发。它把 KV cache 看成模型对过去上下文的可查询记忆，而不是一串可按局部分数删除的 token。结论提示：压缩是否安全取决于未来 query 如何探测这段 cache；如果很多历史 token 对未来 query 是可区分、可单独检索的，小摘要必然丢信息；如果 query 分布只能看到低复杂度结构，则可以大幅压缩。这有助于设计长上下文模型和推理系统时区分“上下文长度”与“可用记忆容量”。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，单个 attention head 的 KV cache 被形式化为 key-value 空间上的概率测度 P。softmax attention 被改写为带 Gaussian kernel 的积分形式，value 输出只依赖于 P 在未来 query 下诱导的加权响应。KV 压缩因此变成稀疏测度近似：用一个更少原子的测度 Q 替代完整 cache，并度量两者在未来 query 分布上的 attention 输出误差。该工作给出 minimax risk 的上下界，用一个数据相关的 intrinsic complexity 描述 cache 在未来 query 下的可压缩性。它还区分了能访问未来 query 分布和不能访问未来 query 分布的算法，证明两者存在风险差距。算法设计原则不是简单 token eviction，而是保留未来 query 实际能区分的 kernel-weighted value 结构。
summary.experiments: 实验部分主要用于验证理论设计原则，而不是追求大规模系统指标。作者在 LongBench 上做 targeted evaluation，将理论原则实例化为一个 KV compression 算法，并和常见压缩启发式进行比较。结果显示，在长上下文任务和压缩预算受限时，该方法能保持较好的任务表现，说明基于 query-cache 交互结构的压缩比单纯按近因性或历史 attention mass 更稳。材料中未给出完整表格数字，因此不宜过度解读绝对性能。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30 分钟。先看 Problem setup，理解为什么 softmax attention 可以写成 context measure 上的 kernel attention；再看 minimax risk 的定义和上下界陈述，重点是 intrinsic complexity 如何刻画“未来 query 能分辨多少历史信息”。算法部分主要看它如何在 causal prefill 和 autoregressive decoding 中近似这些理论条件。实验只需看 LongBench 设置、压缩预算和失败案例，因为理论假设与真实 Transformer 多层多头之间的差距是判断实用性的关键。

summary_en.core_problem: KV cache compression is widely used for long-context inference, but most methods rely on heuristics such as recency, accumulated attention mass, or attention sinks. The paper asks a more basic question: for a fixed compression budget, what is the unavoidable error when replacing a full KV cache with a compact summary that must preserve future softmax attention outputs?
summary_en.importance: The paper is mainly about inference efficiency, but it is relevant to long-context model research because it treats the KV cache as a queryable memory rather than a sequence of tokens with fixed salience. The key implication is that compressibility is not an intrinsic property of a token. It depends on how future queries interact with the cache. If many past items are separately retrievable, small summaries must lose information. If future queries only probe a low-complexity structure, substantial compression is possible. This distinction matters for both serving systems and the design of long-context training regimes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes the KV cache of a single attention head as a probability measure over key-value pairs. Softmax attention is rewritten as a kernel attention map, using a Gaussian-kernel representation after absorbing key-norm factors into the measure. Compression then becomes sparse approximation of this measure: replace the full context measure P with an m-atomic summary Q and measure the discrepancy in attention outputs under a future-query distribution. The main theoretical contribution is a characterization of minimax risk through an intrinsic complexity measure that captures how richly future queries can probe the cache. The results also show a separation between algorithms that know the future-query distribution and those that do not. The resulting design principle is to preserve the query-visible kernel-weighted value structure, not just to evict tokens by local importance scores.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical section instantiates the theory into a concrete KV compression algorithm and evaluates it on LongBench with targeted long-context experiments. The reported behavior is consistent with the theory: compression works better when the retained summary matches the future query-cache interaction, and simple eviction heuristics are less reliable under tight budgets. The experiments should be read as evidence that the theoretical criteria are operational, rather than as a complete systems benchmark. The provided material does not include enough table-level numbers to make precise claims about absolute margins.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30-minute skim is appropriate. Start with the problem setup to understand the measure-theoretic view of attention. Then read the minimax-risk definitions and the upper/lower-bound statements; the important object is the intrinsic complexity measure, not the proof details. The algorithm section is useful for seeing how the theory maps to causal prefill and autoregressive decoding. For the experiments, focus on LongBench settings, compression budgets, and cases where the method fails or degrades, since these reveal the gap between the single-head theory and real multi-layer Transformers.

recommendation.zh: 从最小最大风险角度给出KV压缩的理论边界和设计原则，做长上下文推理优化的话看风险刻画章节即可。
recommendation.en: Minimax risk characterization of KV compression provides theoretical bounds and design principles; read the risk analysis section if working on long-context inference optimization.

paper.title: ReContext: Recursive Evidence Replay as LLM Harness for Long-Context Reasoning
paper.abstract: Understanding and reasoning over long contexts has become a key requirement for deploying large language models (LLMs) in realistic applications. Although recent LLMs support increasingly long context windows, they often fail to use relevant evidence that is already present in the input, revealing a gap between context access and effective context utilization. In this work, we propose Recursive Evidence Replay as LLM Harness for Long-Context Reasoning (RECONTEXT), a training-free inference metho

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM普遍存在上下文利用缺口：回答查询所需的证据存在于输入窗口内，模型生成时却经常忽略，导致幻觉或答错。现有解决方案要么需要侵入式修改模型前向逻辑，要么依赖外部检索或上下文压缩丢失细粒度信息，要么裁剪上下文引发多跳推理失效。
summary.importance: 给出了一种免训练的长上下文推理脚手架方法，不需要修改模型权重、不裁剪输入，仅依靠模型自身的注意力信号递归重放证据即可提升长上下文推理效果。该工作对理解长上下文失效模式（区分注意力访问失败和生成利用失败）有参考价值，也可作为长上下文预训练目标设计的强推理基线。方法属于推理时优化，不涉及训练流程改动。
summary.technical_approach: ReContext是训练无关的多轮推理管线，全程保留完整原始上下文在输入中，也不修改最终解码阶段的注意力logits。流程为固定小轮次的递归证据选择：每轮在包含历史积累证据池的prompt上，取查询附近最后w个（默认8个）提示token，聚合选定注意力头的注意力分数，从原始上下文中选取高相关token片段加入有序证据池，再将证据池拼入prompt进入下一轮选择。由于每轮的注意力计算基于已包含前序证据的模型状态，后续轮次可以逐步发现与已选证据相关的多跳信息。最终生成阶段，模型在同时包含完整原始上下文、递归证据池、查询的prompt上输出答案。方法在联想记忆框架下做了形式化，给出单调性证明：证据重放可以推动隐状态向答案表示的方向靠近。
summary.experiments: 在8个128K长度的长上下文数据集上开展测试，覆盖Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B、Llama3-8B三个模型，平均准确率从原生提示的0.24提升至0.30，相对提升24.6%，在三个主干模型上平均排名最高。实验观测到128K上下文中仅128个token就贡献了查询相关注意力累计值的50%~80%，说明相关证据信号本身是高度稀疏的，问题出在生成阶段没有有效利用这些信号。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言中对长上下文失效的两类划分（访问缺口vs利用缺口）、递归证据选择的流程设计，以及关于注意力集中度的统计结果，预计阅读时间20分钟。不做理论方向研究的读者可以跳过联想记忆证明部分；实验部分重点看轮次数量、证据池大小的消融结果即可。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context LLMs suffer from a context utilization gap: evidence required to answer a query is often present within the input window, but models consistently fail to use it during generation, leading to hallucinations and incorrect answers. Existing mitigations either require invasive changes to model forward passes, rely on external retrieval or context compression that loses fine-grained detail, or prune context in ways that break multi-hop reasoning.
summary_en.importance: A training-free long-context reasoning scaffold is introduced, requiring no weight modifications or context pruning, that improves long-context performance using only the model’s own attention signals for recursive evidence replay. The work provides useful framing for understanding long-context failure modes (distinguishing attention access failures from generation utilization failures), and serves as a strong inference baseline for comparison when designing long-context pretraining objectives. It is an inference-time optimization with no changes to training pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReContext is a training-agnostic multi-round inference pipeline that keeps the full original context in the prompt at all times, and does not modify attention logits during final decoding. The process runs a fixed small number of recursive evidence selection rounds: in each round, attention scores are computed on a prompt that includes the evidence pool accumulated in prior rounds. Scores are aggregated across selected attention heads, from the last w=8 cue tokens near the query. High-relevance token spans from the original context are added to an ordered evidence pool, which is inserted into the prompt for the next round. Because attention is computed from a model state that already contains prior selected evidence, later rounds can surface multi-hop information related to previously found spans. At final generation, the model produces answers from a prompt containing the full original context, the recursive evidence pool, and the query. The method is formalized under an associative memory framework, with a monotonicity proof showing evidence replay shifts hidden states closer to the target answer embedding.
summary_en.experiments: Tests are run across eight 128K-context long-context benchmarks, on Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and Llama3-8B. Mean accuracy improves from 0.24 with vanilla prompting to 0.30 with ReContext, a 24.6% relative gain, and the method achieves the highest average rank across all three backbones. A key observation is that only 128 tokens in a 128K context account for 50–80% of total query-conditioned attention mass, indicating relevant evidence signals are highly sparse — the core failure is utilization of these signals during generation, not lack of access.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the framing of access vs utilization gaps in long-context models, the recursive evidence selection pipeline, and the reported attention concentration statistics; expect around 20 minutes of reading. The associative memory proof section can be skipped by readers not focused on theoretical analysis. When reading results, prioritize ablations for number of selection rounds and evidence pool size.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和长上下文消融即可；它提醒 pretrain 评测别只测窗口长度，要测证据再激活能力。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and long-context ablations; the useful signal is that context-window length is not evidence reactivation.

paper.title: Mapping Text to Multiplex Graph: Prompt Compression as Lévy Walk-Guided Graph Pruning
paper.abstract: Existing prompt compression methods treat text as flat token sequences, failing to capture the distributed nature of important information, which is often spread across multiple locations and connected through both local syntactic dependencies and global semantic relations. Such relational structure is naturally represented as a graph, where tokens or sentences become nodes and their dependencies become edges. To this end, we propose RAGP, which formulates prompt compression as Redundancy-Aware

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想解决长提示压缩时的信息保留问题：现有方法把 prompt 当平坦 token 序列处理，难以保留分散在不同位置、由局部依赖和全局语义共同决定的重要信息。
summary.importance: 它属于推理侧效率工作，而不是基座预训练。启发点在于：如果长上下文压缩要做得更稳，可能需要显式建模跨位置关系，而不是只做 token saliency 排序。对 serving、context pruning、retrieval 前处理有一定参考价值，但对 pretrain 方法论影响有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 RAGP，把 prompt compression 建模为 multiplex graph 上的冗余感知图剪枝。图中同时编码细粒度 attention 依赖和粗粒度语义关系；然后用 Lévy walk 在“局部稠密、全局稀疏”的异构结构中寻找非冗余节点，以兼顾局部探索和远距离跳转。整体是图建模 + 剪枝策略的组合，不是新的语言模型架构。
summary.experiments: 摘要只给出 LongBench 结果：在 4x compression ratio 下，RAGP 平均分数 49.3，并优于若干现有 prompt compression 方法。未在摘要中看到更完整的模型规模、额外延迟、图构建成本、或不同 backbone 上的稳定性信息，因此工程可用性还要看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Joey Tianyi Zhou。其余机构信息在给定材料中不完整。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets information preservation in long-prompt compression: existing methods treat prompts as flat token sequences and struggle to retain information distributed across distant positions and linked by both local dependencies and global semantics.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a foundation pretraining paper. The useful takeaway is that robust long-context compression may require explicit relational modeling instead of pure token saliency ranking. It is relevant to serving, context pruning, and retrieval-side preprocessing, but only indirectly informative for pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, RAGP, formulates prompt compression as redundancy-aware graph pruning on a multiplex graph. The graph jointly captures fine-grained attention-based dependencies and coarse semantic relations. Lévy walks are then used to identify non-redundant nodes in this heterogeneous structure, balancing local exploration with long-range jumps. This is a graph-based pruning strategy, not a new LM architecture.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports results on LongBench: under a 4x compression ratio, RAGP achieves an average score of 49.3 and outperforms existing prompt compression baselines. The abstract does not provide enough detail on model sizes, latency overhead, graph construction cost, or robustness across backbones, so practical value depends on the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Joey Tianyi Zhou. Institution details are incomplete in the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 更像 context pruning 工程招式，不会改变你对 pretrain 的 prior；若你在做长上下文 serving，只看方法图和 LongBench 主表即可。
recommendation.en: This is mostly a context-pruning trick, not something that changes pretraining priors; if you care about long-context serving, the method diagram and the main LongBench table are enough.

paper.title: Multi-Head Recurrent Memory Agents
paper.abstract: Recurrent memory agents extend LLMs to arbitrarily long contexts by iteratively consolidating input into a fixed-size memory window. Despite their scalability, these agents exhibit a well-documented reliability problem: end-to-end performance degrades systematically as context length grows. We diagnose this failure by decomposing performance into two factors--memory capture and memory retention--and quantitatively confirm that retention is the dominant bottleneck. Retention collapses because exi

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 recurrent memory agent 在超长上下文下为什么会失效。核心发现是：主要瓶颈不是模型没有把关键信息写进 memory，而是写进去之后在后续反复更新中被覆盖掉。作者把问题拆成 memory capture 和 memory retention 两个环节，指出 retention 才是随上下文长度增长而快速退化的环节。
summary.importance: 对长上下文和 agent memory 研究有直接启发。它没有改模型、不开长窗口、也不训练新的 memory module，而是从 memory 组织结构入手，说明固定大小文本 memory 的主要风险来自单块 memory 的反复覆盖。这个结论对预训练研究的启发在于：长上下文能力不只由 context window 或位置编码决定，外部 recurrent compression 的结构也会形成明确的信息保留瓶颈。它更偏 inference-time memory architecture，但对设计长程信息压缩任务、评测长上下文 retention failure 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先定义两个指标：Memory Capture Rate 衡量答案信息是否曾经出现在任一中间 memory 状态中；Memory Retention Rate 衡量已经捕获的信息是否能保留到最终 memory。基于这个诊断，提出 Multi-Head Recurrent Memory。传统 recurrent memory 把所有信息维护在一个文本块里，每次 update 都同时读旧 memory 和新 chunk，再生成新的 memory，因此任何更新都可能覆盖早期信息。MHM 把总 memory 划分为多个独立 head，每一步只选择一个 head 更新，其余 head 保持不变。这样未被选中的 head 在当前 step 不承受覆盖风险。具体实现 MHM-LRU 使用 least-recently-updated 规则选择 head，不依赖训练，也不需要额外 token 预算。单头 recurrent memory 可以看成 MHM 的退化情形。
summary.experiments: 实验重点放在极长上下文下的 retention 和最终任务准确率。作者在 RULER-HQA 等长上下文基准上测试 100K 到 1M token 范围。诊断实验显示，代表性方法 MemAgent 的 capture 在不同长度下相对稳定，但 retention 随长度增长明显下降，在 896K token 时低于 30%。MHM-LRU 在同一设置下把 RULER-HQA 896K token 的 memory retention rate 提升到 73.96%。最终准确率也随 retention 改善而更稳定，baseline 随上下文变长明显退化。作者还报告了跨模型家族、模型规模和任务类型的泛化结果，说明收益不是单一 prompt 或单一模型的偶然现象。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 failure characterization 部分，尤其是 capture/retention 的定义和随上下文长度变化的曲线；这是论文最有价值的诊断。然后看 MHM 的 select-then-update 机制和 MHM-LRU 的实现，确认它如何在固定 token budget 下减少覆盖压力。实验部分重点看 RULER-HQA 896K 附近的 retention 数字、不同 context length 的 accuracy 曲线，以及 head 数量或更新策略相关消融。无需细读 neuroscience 类比和较泛的 agent 背景叙述。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why recurrent-memory agents fail as the input context becomes extremely long. Its main diagnosis is that the dominant failure mode is not failing to write the relevant evidence into memory, but failing to keep it through later memory updates.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for long-context and agent-memory research because it isolates an architectural bottleneck in fixed-size textual memory. It shows that recurrent compression can lose information even when the underlying LLM is capable of extracting it. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main takeaway is that long-context behavior depends not only on context-window scaling or positional mechanisms, but also on how external memory is structured and updated.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors decompose memory performance into Memory Capture Rate and Memory Retention Rate. Capture measures whether the gold answer ever appears in an intermediate memory state. Retention measures whether captured information survives until the final memory state. They then propose Multi-Head Recurrent Memory, a training-free framework that splits the memory budget into several independent heads. At each step, only one head is selected and updated, while all other heads remain unchanged. This reduces overwrite pressure compared with a monolithic memory block. The concrete MHM-LRU variant updates the least-recently-used head, gives uniform head utilization, and keeps the same token budget as the single-head baseline.
summary_en.experiments: On long-context benchmarks such as RULER-HQA, the diagnostic study shows that capture stays relatively stable as context length grows, while retention drops sharply. For MemAgent, retention falls below 30% at 896K tokens. MHM-LRU raises the RULER-HQA retention rate at 896K tokens to 73.96%, and the retention gain translates into more stable end-task accuracy across the 100K to 1M token range. The reported results cover multiple model families, scales, and task types, suggesting that the effect is tied to the memory architecture rather than a single model or prompt template.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Focus on the capture/retention decomposition and the plots showing how each metric changes with context length. Then read the MHM formulation and the LRU update rule to understand why unchanged heads are protected from overwrite. In the experiments, prioritize the retention curves, the RULER-HQA 896K result, and any ablations over the number of heads or selection policy.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文 memory agent 常把问题归咎于摘要能力不够，这篇更像是在说“写坏旧记忆”才是主因；先看诊断定义和 ablation，再决定要不要跟。
recommendation.en: Many long-context memory papers blame weak summarization; this one argues the real failure is overwriting retained memory. Read the diagnosis and ablations first before buying the method.

paper.title: MosaicKV: Serving Long-Context LLM with Dynamic Two-D KV Cache Compression
paper.abstract: Long-context LLM services now sustain prompts with hundreds of thousands to millions of tokens, making the key-value (KV) cache a first-order serving cost. Because the cache grows linearly with context length, it can exhaust GPU memory, force smaller batches, and reduce serving throughput. Prior KV cache compression techniques typically target only the sequence dimension or only the channel dimension, which leaves limited headroom as context windows scale. Compressing both dimensions promises hi

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM服务场景中，现有KV缓存压缩方法单独在序列维度或通道维度压缩时压缩率存在上限，直接同时在两个维度做全生命周期压缩会造成严重精度损失；同时高压缩率引入的细粒度稀疏访存和动态管理开销，往往会抵消内存缩减带来的吞吐收益，甚至导致性能低于未压缩基线。
summary.importance: 这是长上下文推理侧KV缓存优化的实用工程工作，对十万到百万级token上下文场景的部署成本控制有直接参考价值；论文对KV元素重要性分布异质性的观察，也为理解长上下文注意力的结构模式提供了线索。
summary.technical_approach: 提出动态二维KV压缩框架MosaicKV。第一，用逐向量的元素选择替代此前所有KV向量共用统一通道掩码的做法，匹配单个KV向量内部重要元素分布不对齐的特性；第二，按KV缓存不同区域的元素分布特征（如数值方差、离群值分布）分区段应用适配的压缩策略，避免全局统一策略造成的精度损失；第三，配套压缩KV缓存管理优化，缓解细粒度稀疏带来的GPU缓存命中率下降问题，将SVD计算、重压缩等重操作移出解码关键路径，消除性能回退。
summary.experiments: 验证结果显示，朴素叠加70%通道压缩与序列压缩会造成82.8%的长上下文任务精度损失；在长上下文检索、多文档问答、代码生成等典型场景下，MosaicKV的精度-压缩率权衡显著优于Quest、ThinK、InfiniGen、ShadowKV等现有压缩方案，可在全生命周期对K、V向量同时应用二维压缩，同时解决了细粒度稀疏访存和动态管理开销导致的解码性能回退问题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计15分钟。重点关注引言中对朴素二维压缩精度损失原因的观察、动态压缩策略的设计逻辑，以及系统优化层面的取舍；CUDA实现细节可直接跳过，除非从事推理系统开发工作。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-context LLM serving, existing KV cache compression methods operating solely on the sequence or channel dimension hit strict compression ratio ceilings. Naive combination of compression on both dimensions across the full decode lifecycle causes severe accuracy degradation. Additionally, fine-grained sparse memory access patterns and runtime management overhead introduced by high-compression schemes often erase throughput gains from reduced memory usage, sometimes leading to worse performance than uncompressed baselines.
summary_en.importance: This is a practical engineering work for KV cache optimization in long-context deployment, with direct applicability to cost control for 100K to 1M token context serving. The observation of heterogeneous importance distributions across KV elements also provides useful insight into the structural patterns of long-context attention.
summary_en.technical_approach: MosaicKV implements a dynamic two-dimensional KV compression framework. First, it replaces the global uniform channel mask used in prior work with per-vector element selection, accounting for misaligned important element distributions across individual KV vectors. Second, it partitions the KV cache into segments based on regional distribution characteristics (e.g., magnitude variance, outlier presence) and applies tailored compression policies to each segment, avoiding accuracy loss from one-size-fits-all strategies. Third, it includes compressed cache management optimizations to mitigate poor GPU cache locality from fine-grained sparsity, and moves expensive operations such as SVD computation and recompression off the critical decode path to eliminate performance regressions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations show that naively combining 70% channel compression with sequence compression causes 82.8% accuracy loss on long-context tasks. Across long-context retrieval, multi-document QA, and code generation tasks, MosaicKV delivers substantially better accuracy-compression tradeoffs than prior methods including Quest, ThinK, InfiniGen, and ShadowKV. It supports full two-dimensional compression on both key and value vectors across the entire decode lifecycle, while eliminating performance regressions caused by sparse memory access and runtime overhead in naive implementations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in approximately 15 minutes. Focus on the introductory observations of accuracy loss causes in naive two-dimensional compression, the design logic of the dynamic compression policy, and system-level tradeoffs. CUDA implementation details can be skipped unless working directly on inference system development.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文KV压缩的系统级创新，重点看§3的动态二维分块策略，对预训练时长上下文注意力稀疏设计有参考价值
recommendation.en: System-level innovation for long-context KV compression; focus on §3 for dynamic 2D partitioning, informs sparse attention design in pretraining

paper.title: HyFL-CLIP: Hyperbolic Fine-Tuning of CLIP for Robust Long-Context Understanding
paper.abstract: CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) has become a de facto paradigm for image-text alignment, but it struggles with long-context descriptions (>77 tokens) due to absolute positional encoding and pretraining on short captions. In long contexts, sentences are often reordered, summarized, or partially omitted. Although prior works extend CLIP with longer positional encodings, they often suffer from degraded image-text alignment under such text perturbations. We attribute this limitation t

summary.core_problem: 解决 CLIP 在超过 77 token 的长文本描述上图文对齐变差、且对句子重排、摘要化和局部省略不稳的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLM 对齐目标和表示几何的改进：作者认为仅扩展位置编码不足以解决长上下文图文匹配，欧氏空间的一对一 contrastive objective 不适合表达全局描述与局部成分之间的层级和蕴含关系。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HyFL-CLIP，在双曲空间中微调 CLIP。方法通过 cross-manifold similarity distillation，把原始欧氏 CLIP 已学到的图文对齐知识蒸馏到双曲流形中，利用双曲几何表达层级结构和文本片段之间的蕴含关系。它更像是对 CLIP fine-tuning objective 和表示空间的改造，而不是从头预训练新 VLM。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据、benchmark 名称或具体数值。实验应围绕长文本图文检索或匹配，并测试句子重排、摘要化、部分省略等文本扰动下的鲁棒性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses CLIP's degraded image-text alignment on descriptions longer than 77 tokens and its fragility to sentence reordering, summarization, and partial omission.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a change in alignment geometry and fine-tuning objective for VLMs. The paper argues that extending positional encodings is insufficient because Euclidean contrastive learning enforces strict one-to-one matching and does not model hierarchy or entailment between global context and local components.
summary_en.technical_approach: HyFL-CLIP fine-tunes CLIP in hyperbolic space. It uses cross-manifold similarity distillation to transfer the established Euclidean CLIP alignment into a hyperbolic manifold, using the geometry to better represent hierarchical and entailment-like relations. This is a fine-tuning and representation-space modification rather than full VLM pretraining.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data, benchmark names, or numerical improvements. The evaluation is expected to focus on long-context image-text matching or retrieval under text perturbations such as reordering, summarization, and omission.

recommendation.zh: 想做长文本 VLM 对齐可扫一眼；核心看双曲蒸馏是否有干净消融，别被几何叙事带跑。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look for long-text VLM alignment; check whether the hyperbolic distillation has clean ablations before buying the geometry story.

paper.title: Logit-Contribution Scoring Identifies Non-Literal Retrieval Heads
paper.abstract: In long-context use, large language models frequently synthesize answers from the meaning of a relevant context span rather than literally copy-pasting them. Identifying which attention heads perform this synthesis matters for interpreting long-context model behavior. Yet existing detectors miss these heads by construction: they reward heads whose attended token matches the generated token, a literal-copy criterion that captures where a head reads but not what it writes through its output-value

summary.core_problem: 如何识别“非字面检索（non-literal retrieval）”的注意力头：在长上下文任务里，模型往往不是把 needle 里的答案 token 直接复制出来，而是读懂相关片段后写出语义上对应但词面不同的答案。现有 retrieval-head 识别方法多基于 attention 是否指向 needle、以及 attended token 是否等于生成 token，因此系统性漏掉这类“读 needle、写别的东西”的头。
summary.importance:
这篇更偏机制分析，但对预训练与长上下文能力的研究有两点实用影响：
1) 给出了一个更贴近“模型真正写入 residual 的信息流”的检索头度量（write-aware），能把长上下文能力拆到更可控的子电路层面；
2) 通过大幅度的 targeted head ablation 展示了：长上下文检索在一些模型家族里确实依赖稀疏头集合，且这种依赖能迁移到下游长文 QA 基准。这类结果常被用来反推训练配方（例如长上下文数据/位置编码/注意力结构）对电路形成的影响。
summary.technical_approach:
LOCOS（Logit-Contribution Scoring）的关键是把“检索头识别”从读位置（attention pattern）转到写贡献（OV circuit 对正确答案 logit 的贡献）。
- 观察：注意力头是 read（QK 决定 α）+ write（OV 决定写入 residual 的方向）。在 non-literal retrieval 中，read 到的 token 与最终生成 token 不一致，attention-based 指标天然失效。
- 评分定义：在单步解码时，对每个 head、每个 source position j，计算该 head 从 j 写出的输出向量 o_{t,j}^{(l,h)} 经过加权后的贡献，并取其在“正确答案 token 的 unembedding 向量 u_{y_t}”方向上的标量投影（可理解为对正确 logit 的边际贡献）。
- 聚合方式：用 spatial contrast，把 needle 区间的 logit contribution 与 off-needle 的 length-normalized contribution 做对比，避免“长上下文里 off-needle 总量更大”带来的偏置。
- 计算成本：每个 probing trial 只需一次 forward pass（不需要逐头 ablate 才能打分），因此可以在多模型、多配置上跑。
- 验证方式：用 ranked ablation 曲线验证“识别到的头是否因果重要”：按 LOCOS 排名从高到低 mean-ablate 头，观察 NoLiMa 等检索任务性能退化速度，并用对照任务（parametric recall、算术）验证特异性。
summary.experiments:
从全文片段可提取的关键数字与设置：
- 模型覆盖：Qwen3（8B/14B/32B）、Gemma-3（12B/27B）、OLMo-3.1（32B），共 6 个配置。
- 主评测：NoLiMa non-literal retrieval benchmark（heldout）。指标用 ROUGE-L，并用“ablate top-k heads”的退化曲线比较不同检索头识别方法。
- 代表性结果（Qwen3-8B）：ablate LOCOS top-50 heads，ROUGE-L 从 0.401 降到 0.000；而最强 attention-based baseline 在同样 ablation 深度下仍有 0.292。
- 特异性对照：在相同 ablation 下，parametric recall 与 arithmetic reasoning 基本保持（说明 LOCOS 排名抓到的是检索相关头，而不是通用能力头）。
- 下游迁移（长上下文 QA）：在 Qwen3-8B 上，ablate top-50 LOCOS heads，MuSiQue accuracy 0.55→0.08，BABILong 0.62→0.20。作者也指出迁移一致性在 Qwen3 家族最强，而在 Gemma-3/OLMo-3.1 上与 attention-based baseline 的相对排名更依赖具体 benchmark。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
1) 先把 LOCOS 的数学定义读清楚：尤其是“对 u_{y_t} 的投影”与“needle vs off-needle 的 spatial contrast/归一化”。这决定它为什么能抓到 non-literal retrieval。
2) 重点看 ablation 曲线图与对照实验：它们是这篇文章的因果证据核心，比单点指标更有说服力。
3) 看跨模型家族的差异讨论：为什么 Qwen3 上迁移更一致、Gemma/OLMo 更不稳定；这部分往往暗示不同预训练/架构下检索电路的稀疏性与可替代性。
4) 如果关心训练启示：把“稀疏检索头集合”与长上下文训练数据、位置编码、注意力正则等因素联系起来思考，但论文本身主要做识别与验证，不直接给训练 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: Identifying attention heads responsible for non-literal retrieval in long-context settings, where the model attends to a relevant span (the needle) but generates an answer that is not a literal copy of any needle token. Existing retrieval-head detectors are largely attention-based and implicitly assume token matching, so they systematically miss heads whose OV circuits write answer-aligned information that is not the attended token itself.
summary_en.importance:
Primarily a mechanistic interpretability contribution, with practical implications for long-context pretraining and debugging:
- It provides a write-aware criterion that better isolates the causal subcircuits behind long-context retrieval.
- The strong targeted-ablation results support the view that long-context retrieval can depend on a relatively sparse set of heads (at least in some model families), which is useful when reasoning about how training choices shape retrieval behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LOCOS (Logit-Contribution Scoring) shifts retrieval-head detection from “where a head reads” (attention patterns) to “what a head writes” (OV-circuit contribution to the correct logit).
- For a given decoding step, for each head and each source position, compute the head’s weighted OV output and take its scalar projection onto the unembedding vector of the correct answer token. This directly measures marginal logit contribution.
- Use spatial contrast: compare contributions from needle positions against length-normalized off-needle contributions within the same step to avoid bias from the much larger off-needle region.
- Efficiency: requires only a single forward pass per probing trial.
- Validation: rank heads by LOCOS and perform mean-ablation of top-k heads; evaluate degradation on non-literal retrieval benchmarks and run control tasks (parametric recall, arithmetic) to test specificity.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full text excerpt:
- Models: Qwen3 (8B/14B/32B), Gemma-3 (12B/27B), OLMo-3.1 (32B), totaling six configurations.
- Benchmark: NoLiMa (non-literal retrieval), evaluated with ROUGE-L under ranked head ablations.
- Qwen3-8B highlight: ablating the top-50 LOCOS heads collapses ROUGE-L from 0.401 to 0.000, while the strongest attention-based baseline still achieves 0.292 at the same ablation depth.
- Specificity controls: parametric recall and arithmetic reasoning remain largely intact under the same ablations.
- Downstream transfer: on Qwen3-8B, ablating top-50 LOCOS heads drops MuSiQue accuracy from 0.55 to 0.08 and BABILong from 0.62 to 0.20. Transfer is reported as most consistent within the Qwen3 family, and more benchmark-dependent for Gemma-3 and OLMo-3.1.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Read the LOCOS definition carefully, especially the projection onto the correct-token unembedding direction and the needle vs off-needle normalization.
2) Spend time on the ablation curves; they are the main causal evidence that the ranking is meaningful.
3) Check the cross-family analysis (Qwen3 vs Gemma-3 vs OLMo-3.1) to understand when retrieval is head-sparse vs more distributed.
4) If your goal is training insights, treat the paper as a diagnostic tool: it does not propose a new pretraining recipe, but it gives a way to measure whether a recipe produces robust non-literal retrieval circuits.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看 §方法和 ablation：它提醒你很多“retrieval head”分析其实只测到 copy，不是写入 logits 的因果头；对长上下文机制判断要改口径。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablation sections: it shows that many so-called retrieval-head analyses are really detecting copy behavior, not the heads causally writing answer evidence into logits.

paper.title: HSAP: A Hierachical Sequence-aware Parallelism for Hybrid-Context Generative Models
paper.abstract: In this paper, we aim to combine the advantages of existing sequence parallelism paradigms and overcomes their drawbacks, the most serious of which is the incapability to correctly compute causal attention on the hybrid-context packed sequences, in a stronger sequence parallelism framework. The practical technique of packing sequences for efficiently pretraining and fine-tuning large language models causes cross-contamination problem in attention computation, which can be effectively solved when

summary.core_problem: 论文解决长上下文训练中的一个系统问题：在 sequence parallelism 下，如何对 packed hybrid-context sequences 做精确 causal attention，避免不同样本或不同片段之间的 attention 污染，同时保持较高并行度。
summary.importance: 这篇工作和预训练系统直接相关。长上下文、多模态序列和变长样本训练都依赖 sequence packing 来减少 padding 浪费；但一旦沿序列维切分到多 GPU，传统 cu_len 式边界处理不再简单可用。HSAP 的价值在于把“packed sequence 的正确性”和“长序列并行效率”放在同一个框架里处理。它对训练 100K 到 500K 级上下文、混合文本/多模态 token、或大量短样本打包的预训练任务有工程参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法包含两层。底层是 SAP，即 sequence-aware parallelism。它把 packed sequence 中每个片段的边界和注意力可见性显式纳入调度，使用类似 JIT 编译的方式为每个 rank 生成操作码，安排不完整 QKV tensor 的 P2P 传输和不规则 attention 计算。这样可以在分布式环境中复现单卡 cu_len attention 的语义，而不是退回 unpacking 或牺牲序列并行。上层是 HSAP，即 hierarchical sequence-aware parallelism。它结合 Ulysses 类 intra-group all-to-all 和 Ring-Attention 类 inter-group P2P 的优点：前者适合组内 attention 并行，后者适合跨组扩展序列长度；SAP 负责处理 packed hybrid-context 带来的不规则边界。论文同时讨论了内存与通信管理，使框架能在超长序列上保持可扩展性。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 HSAP 能把训练序列长度扩展到 512K 以上，并在真实 hybrid-context 数据集上取得更高的 tokens per GPU second。相较不做序列维并行的 packing 或普通 batch training，它减少了 padding 与显存压力；相较已有 sequence parallelism，它能在 packed sequence 上做精确 attention，避免跨片段污染，同时 attention 计算速度更好。摘要和正文引言明确强调了与 DeepSpeed-Ulysses 的 head 数并行度上限、Ring-Attention 的固定拓扑通信开销之间的取舍差异。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 30 分钟；如果做训练系统或长上下文预训练，可精读算法部分。优先看 Preliminaries 中 sequence packing 与 cross-contamination attention 的例子，这决定了问题是否真实存在。随后看 SAP 的调度生成逻辑，重点理解它如何把 packed segment 边界转成 rank-local 操作序列。HSAP 框架部分重点看 intra-group 与 inter-group 如何组合。实验部分看 512K 长度扩展、TGS 指标、与 Ulysses/Ring 类方法的 attention 速度和显存对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses exact causal attention for packed hybrid-context sequences under sequence parallelism, where naïve slicing across the sequence dimension can let unrelated packed segments attend to each other.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to pretraining infrastructure. Sequence packing is a standard way to reduce padding waste in LLM pretraining and fine-tuning, and it becomes even more important for long-context and multimodal token streams. Existing sequence-parallel methods handle long sequences, but they do not naturally preserve packed-sequence boundaries at high parallelism. HSAP is useful because it treats correctness of packed attention and scalability of long-sequence training as one systems problem.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core component is SAP, a sequence-aware parallel attention algorithm. SAP explicitly tracks packed segment boundaries and uses a JIT-style scheduling mechanism to emit operation codes for each distributed rank. These codes organize irregular P2P transfers of partial Q, K, and V tensors and compute only the attention blocks that are valid under causal and segment-boundary constraints. HSAP then builds a hierarchy over existing sequence-parallel paradigms: Ulysses-like intra-group all-to-all communication is used where it is efficient, while Ring-Attention-like inter-group P2P communication extends the sequence dimension across groups. SAP supplies the missing boundary-aware execution layer for hybrid-context packed inputs.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments show sequence lengths beyond 512K and improved tokens per GPU second on real hybrid-context datasets. Compared with vanilla packing or batch training, the method reduces padding and activation-memory pressure. Compared with prior sequence-parallel approaches, it computes exact packed-sequence attention without cross-contamination and reports faster attention execution on packed sequences. The main trade-off discussed in the paper is between Ulysses' head-count-limited parallelism and Ring-Attention's topology-driven communication overhead; HSAP is designed to combine their useful parts while handling irregular packed layouts.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30 minutes if familiar with sequence parallelism; allocate more time for the scheduling algorithm if implementing long-context training. Start with the preliminary section on sequence packing and attention cross-contamination. Then read the SAP algorithm to understand how segment boundaries become rank-local execution schedules. The HSAP section is important for seeing how intra-group and inter-group parallelism are composed. In the experiments, focus on the 512K-length runs, TGS comparisons, attention-kernel timing, and memory-scaling results.

recommendation.zh: 针对 sequence packing 场景下的序列并行优化，解决了跨 document attention 污染问题，对做长文本预训练系统优化的工程师有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Optimizes sequence parallelism for sequence packing scenarios, solving cross-document attention contamination. Valuable for engineers working on long-context pre-training system optimization.

paper.title: Depth-Staggered Fibonacci Spacing for Sparse Attention: Static Schedules Beat Learned Dilation and Extrapolate Where Dense Attention Fails
paper.abstract: We study sparse self-attention in which each query attends to a dense local window plus a set of Fibonacci-spaced offsets, with a per-layer scalar alpha that compresses or expands the spacing. Across 21 language models trained under one matched recipe (60M parameters, 512 hidden, 16 layers, 426M tokens), we compare four ways of setting alpha across depth: fixed, per-layer learned, a static linear stagger, and a coprime (anti-gridding) reassignment of that stagger, together with a reach-matched p

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个很具体但常被凭经验处理的问题：在静态稀疏注意力里，跨层的稀疏间距应该如何安排。作者把每层的远程注意力偏移写成 Fibonacci 序列乘一个层级缩放系数 α，然后比较四种深度调度：全层固定、每层可学习、线性静态 stagger、以及借鉴 dilated conv anti-gridding 思路的 coprime stagger。核心结论很明确：让 α 在训练中自己学，几乎学不动，也没有带来收益；真正有效的是预先手工设定一个随深度变化的静态调度。换句话说，问题不在于“给模型一个可学习的 spacing 自由度”，而在于“是否显式地让不同层承担不同尺度的感受野”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的启发主要有三点。第一，它给稀疏注意力设计里一个常见但证据不足的假设做了负结果澄清：单层 spacing 参数未必会在语言建模训练中自发形成有意义的层次结构。第二，它说明静态结构先验在小到中等规模训练里仍然很有价值，尤其是在参数和训练 token 都受限时，手工设计的 depth schedule 可能比“让模型自己学”更稳。第三，它把长度外推问题和相对位置分布偏移联系得比较清楚：稀疏模式在 4× 训练长度下比 dense baseline 更稳，不只是因为更省算力，而是因为它避免了 dense+RoPE 在超长长度上遇到的大量训练外相对位置。这一点对长上下文预训练和 attention pattern 设计都有参考意义。不过量级上要克制看待：实验规模只有约 60M 参数、426M tokens，结论更像是结构归纳偏置的受控证据，而不是可直接外推到大模型生产配方的定论。
summary.technical_approach:
方法本身很简洁。每个 query 看到两部分 key：一段局部 dense window，以及一组按 Fibonacci 间距取样的远程位置。Fibonacci 的好处是近处更密、远处近似几何变稀，比 power-of-2 更平滑。为了让 α 可学习，作者没有用硬 mask，而是对非整数偏移位置做线性插值 gather，这样 α 即使落在整数附近也有梯度。α 被约束在 [0.5, 1.5]，因为基础 Fibonacci 序列在 α=1 时已经基本覆盖 1024 长度上下文，额外自由度主要是压缩或轻微扩张感受野。
