By adding an independently addressed erase operation, it aims to make delta-rule recurrence behave more like an explicit memory system (separate delete vs write primitives) without reverting to KV-cache. The contribution is a structural update-rule extension (more than a minor gating tweak), though its practical impact depends on whether gains persist at larger scales and longer contexts.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Built on channel-wise gated delta / DPLR-style recurrence (diagonal per-channel decay plus low-rank delta updates), the baseline delta rule treats the memory matrix S_t as an associative map and performs a corrective update so that the readout at the current key k_t, i.e., S^T k_t, moves toward v_t.

Erase-then-Delta Attention (EDA) decouples where to erase from where to write:
1) Erase step: select an independent erase address and apply a targeted suppression along a learned erase direction, explicitly cleaning stale content at that address.
2) Delta step: perform the standard delta-style corrective write at the current write key k_t, preserving the desirable “correct-what’s-stored” behavior.

Conceptually, EDA separates three signals: (i) address-agnostic diagonal/channel decay, (ii) independently addressed erasure, and (iii) write-coupled delta correction. The authors report that the learned erase and write addressing becomes nearly orthogonal, suggesting the erase path is not merely stronger forgetting but a distinct conditional cleanup mechanism.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided full-text excerpt does not include the main tables or numeric results, so model sizes, token counts, and exact improvements cannot be stated reliably. From the introduction, evaluation includes: (i) LM pretraining where EDA improves over a DPLR-style gated-delta baseline and compares against other update-rule variants, (ii) long-context evaluation, and (iii) memory-state probes showing near-orthogonal separation between erase and write addressing.

When reading, verify with ablations that isolate the benefit of independent erasure (vs stronger decay, extra parameters, or additional gating capacity).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim with focus on:
1) The exact EDA update equations: how the erase address is parameterized, how the erase direction is applied to S_t, and whether compute/memory remains O(1) state.
2) Core ablations: erase tied vs untied to write; removing erase; replacing erase with stronger diagonal decay; sharing vs separating heads/parameters.
3) Mechanistic plots: cosine similarity/correlation between erase and write addresses across layers/heads, supporting the “orthogonal roles” claim.

Time budget: ~30–45 minutes for method + main results + key ablations; longer if you want to assess long-context settings and training stability details.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看方法和主表：它不是又一个线性注意力小修小补，而是在 memory update rule 上加了“独立擦除”自由度；先查收益是否来自更干净的记忆管理，而不是额外参数或训练技巧。
recommendation.en: Read the method and main tables: this is not just another linear-attention tweak, but a real change to the memory update rule via independent erase; the key question is whether gains come from cleaner memory management rather than extra capacity or training tricks.

paper.title: PersistentKV: Page-Aware Decode Scheduling for Long-Context LLM Serving on Commodity GPUs
paper.abstract: Autoregressive large language model (LLM) serving is increasingly limited by key-value (KV) cache movement rather than dense matrix multiplication. Modern paged-attention systems reduce KV-cache fragmentation and mature kernels such as FlashInfer provide highly optimized native-paged decode attention. However, the best single-kernel implementation is not always the best serving schedule: low-active long-context decode can under-utilize commodity GPUs, while mixed sequence lengths introduce a ten

summary.core_problem: 在长上下文 LLM 推理的 decode 阶段，由于算术强度低，性能瓶颈往往在于 KV-cache 的访存和调度。现有的单一最优 kernel（如 FlashInfer）在面对低并发、长上下文或混合序列长度的 serving 场景时，可能无法充分利用 GPU 资源。
summary.importance: 深入探讨了长上下文 decode 阶段的调度策略，指出不存在“一招鲜”的 attention kernel。通过提出 PersistentKV 并与 FlashInfer 进行对比，强调了在 LLM serving 系统中，应根据请求状态动态选择 kernel 调度策略，而非强制使用单一方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 PersistentKV，一个针对 GQA (Grouped-Query Attention) 的原生块表 (block-table) decode attention 引擎。其核心设计包括：1) 按 KV-head 组映射任务，在分组的 query head 间复用 K,V tile；2) 采用原生 paged cache 布局，避免 KV 重排开销；3) 引入行级序列长度调度和紧凑工作队列 (workqueue)，使任务划分和预取严格遵循实际请求长度，减少 padding 浪费。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama 风格的 GQA 配置下，将 PersistentKV 与 FlashInfer 在相同的页表分布、上下文长度和数值精度下进行了直接对比。结果表明，PersistentKV 在低并发和中等并发的长上下文场景下具有优势，而 FlashInfer 在小 batch 场景下表现更好（因为 PersistentKV 的 split-merge 开销占主导）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Methodology 部分关于 PersistentKV 的任务映射（按 KV-head group 和 sequence split）以及紧凑工作队列的设计。实验部分需注意其在不同并发度和上下文长度下与 FlashInfer 的性能交叉点，这直接支撑了其“自适应调度”的核心主张。

summary_en.core_problem: During the decode phase of long-context LLM inference, low arithmetic intensity makes KV-cache memory traffic and scheduling the primary bottlenecks. A single highly-optimized kernel (like FlashInfer) may under-utilize GPUs in serving scenarios with low-active, long-context requests or mixed sequence lengths.
summary_en.importance: Provides a deep dive into decode scheduling for long-context LLMs, demonstrating that no single attention kernel is optimal across all regimes. By introducing PersistentKV and comparing it with FlashInfer, the paper advocates for an adaptive serving policy that chooses the kernel schedule based on request state rather than forcing a one-size-fits-all approach.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces PersistentKV, a native block-table decode attention engine tailored for Grouped-Query Attention (GQA). Key features include: 1) Mapping work by KV-head group to reuse K,V tiles across grouped query heads; 2) Operating directly on native paged cache layouts to avoid repacking overhead; 3) Implementing row-local sequence-length scheduling and a compact workqueue to align split boundaries and prefetches with true request lengths, minimizing padding waste.
summary_en.experiments: Compared PersistentKV directly against FlashInfer using a Llama-style GQA configuration under identical page-table distributions, context lengths, and numerical tolerances. Results indicate PersistentKV excels in low- and moderate-active long-context regimes, whereas FlashInfer remains superior for small active batches where PersistentKV's split-merge overhead dominates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Methodology section detailing PersistentKV's work mapping (by KV-head group and sequence split) and the compact workqueue design. In the experiments, pay attention to the performance crossover points between PersistentKV and FlashInfer across different batch sizes and context lengths, which justify the proposed adaptive scheduling policy.

recommendation.zh: 只看调度设计和混合长度实验即可；它不改变模型训练，但能提醒长上下文效率瓶颈已从 kernel 转到 page-level scheduling。
recommendation.en: Read the scheduler and mixed-length experiments; it does not change training, but it shows long-context serving bottlenecks moving from kernels to page-level scheduling.

paper.title: ProtoKV: Streaming Video Understanding under Delayed Query with Summary-State Memory
paper.abstract: Streaming video understanding (SVU) must answer queries that arrive asynchronously while visual tokens stream continuously under strict GPU-memory and query-time latency budgets. A key challenge is delayed query: decisive cues may appear briefly, yet many subsequent updates occur before the query arrives, increasing the risk that those cues are evicted or diluted under bounded memory. We propose ProtoKV, a constant-footprint SVU memory that represents far history as a fixed-capacity summary stat

summary.core_problem: 解决流式视频理解中查询延迟到达时，关键早期视觉证据在有限显存下被 KV 缓存淘汰或稀释的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是长时序多模态推理的记忆结构和推理效率改进。它不是 LLM 预训练论文，但对长上下文压缩、KV 记忆抽象和延迟查询场景有可迁移的工程启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ProtoKV：保留近端窗口的精确 KV cache，把远端历史压缩为固定容量的语义-空间 prototype bank，并维护 residual statistics。查询时将这些 prototype 通过受限数量的 pseudo-token 暴露给标准 attention，因此可以较低改动接入现有模型。
summary.experiments: 在流式视频理解 benchmark 的长延迟设置下，与 token-retention 类基线在相同内存预算和相近查询时延下比较，最高提升 12.5 个准确率点。摘要未披露具体模型参数量和训练数据规模。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets streaming video understanding where a query arrives late and decisive early cues may have already been evicted from a bounded memory.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an efficient memory abstraction for long-horizon multimodal inference. It is not an LLM pretraining paper, but it has useful parallels to long-context compression and KV-cache summarization.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProtoKV keeps an exact KV cache for the recent window and compresses older history into a fixed-capacity semantic-spatial prototype bank with residual statistics. At query time, prototypes are exposed as bounded pseudo-tokens that remain compatible with standard attention.
summary_en.experiments: On streaming video understanding benchmarks in long-delay regimes, ProtoKV reports up to a 12.5-point accuracy gain over token-retention baselines under matched memory budgets and comparable query-time cost. The abstract does not provide model size or training data details.

recommendation.zh: 只看 delayed-query setup 和 prototype pseudo-token 接口；和 LLM 长上下文压缩有类比，但视频结论不能直接外推。
recommendation.en: Read the delayed-query setup and pseudo-token interface only; it is a useful analogy for LLM context compression, not direct evidence.

paper.title: ATMA: Length-Invariant Language Modeling via Polar Attention and Gated-Delta Compression Memory
paper.abstract: Modern large language models based on softmax scaled-dot-product attention are constrained by their training sequence length: as the key-value sequence grows, softmax probability mass can dilute across a wider distribution, inducing activation shift and long-context performance collapse. Moreover, long-context language modeling faces a structural tension: a sliding-window attention core maintains a bounded local representation and low perplexity but is blind to long-range dependencies, while ful

summary.core_problem: ATMA 处理的是长上下文长度外推中的两个耦合问题：softmax attention 在键数量增大后会出现概率质量稀释，导致激活分布偏离训练长度；而滑窗注意力虽然局部困惑度稳定，却丢失窗口外检索能力。作者试图用一种有界的全局读出机制，加上可压缩的长期记忆，同时保住局部语言建模和远距离精确召回。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构与训练动态层面。它不是简单扩大窗口或换位置编码，而是把长上下文失败归因到 attention 输出的尺度和分布漂移，并将“匹配内容”和“匹配数量”显式解耦。这一思路值得关注，因为长上下文预训练常见的问题不是只缺少全局信息，而是全局信息进入 residual stream 的方式会改变模型在训练长度内学到的激活统计。不过实验规模仍偏小，370M、1B tokens 的结论更适合作为架构假设和消融证据，不能直接外推到多十亿参数和万亿 token 训练。
summary.technical_approach: ATMA 是 16 层 decoder-only 模型，采用 3:1 的混合序列混合比例：12 层 LFM2 gated convolution 负责稳定的局部建模，4 层 Polar Attention 提供稀疏插入的全局读出。每个 block 使用 pre-norm，MLP 是 4 倍扩展的 squared-ReLU。核心是三通道 attention 输出。第一是 content channel：对匹配到的 value-sum 做单位球投影，只保留方向，减少上下文长度变化带来的幅度漂移。第二是 count channel：用 participation ratio，也就是 inverse Simpson index，估计有多少 key 参与了匹配，再经过饱和单调映射得到有界计数信号。这样“匹配到了什么”和“匹配了多少”不再混在 softmax 归一化输出里。第三是 memory channel：引入 per-head recurrent associative memory，使用类似 Titans 的 gated-delta update，把长文档趋势压缩成有损记忆。Polar Attention 负责精确全局读出，memory 负责长期语义和困惑度趋势。作者还加入 extreme-value-corrected null floor，用学习到的随机匹配上界校准 logits，避免极长序列中的背景噪声淹没有效匹配。
summary.experiments: 实验包括 100-run factorial ablation。模型规模为 370M，在 1B token FineWeb-Edu 上训练，并在 2K 到 64K 上评估，最长达到训练长度的 32 倍。主要结论是 Polar Attention 和 gated-delta memory 必须组合使用：无 memory 的 Polar Attention 在长距离检索上仍会退化；softmax 加同样 memory 在极长长度下仍有困惑度和激活漂移问题。ATMA 在 2K 到 64K 的 induction needle-in-a-haystack 检索中保持 90% 以上，同时 clean-document perplexity 随上下文变长单调改善。系统实现方面，作者提供 PyTorch reference、FP16/FP8 training harness 和 paged inference engine，并实现 FlashAttention 风格 Triton kernel 来流式计算 participation ratio；gated-delta 训练 recurrence 通过 custom ops 避免 dynamo graph break。报告中称 recurrent memory 分支在 NVIDIA L4 上带来约 4.5 个百分点 MFU 下降。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 45 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 softmax dilution 和滑窗/全局注意力取舍的定义，再看 Methodology 里三通道 Polar Attention 的公式和 gated-delta memory 的接口。实验部分优先看 100-run factorial ablation、2K→64K 长度外推曲线、needle 检索和 clean perplexity 的联合结果。值得深挖的是 participation ratio 是否稳定、null floor 如何估计、content 单位化会不会损失强度信息，以及这些设计在更大 batch、更深模型和真实长文预训练中是否仍然稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: ATMA targets a specific failure mode in long-context language modeling: softmax attention changes its output statistics as the number of keys grows, while sliding-window attention avoids this shift only by giving up recall beyond the window. The goal is to keep local language modeling stable and still support precise retrieval at lengths far beyond training.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining research is architectural rather than data-related. The work treats long-context collapse as an activation-distribution problem, not only as a positional-encoding or context-size problem. Its main idea is to separate content from count in the attention readout, then add a recurrent compressed memory for long-range document state. The evidence is still small-scale: 370M parameters and 1B training tokens are enough for controlled ablations, but not enough to establish behavior at frontier-scale training.
summary_en.technical_approach: ATMA is a 16-layer decoder-only model with a 3:1 hybrid mixing schedule: 12 LFM2 gated convolution layers and 4 Polar Attention layers. The blocks use pre-normalization and a 4x squared-ReLU MLP. Polar Attention replaces the usual softmax readout with three additive streams. The content stream normalizes the matched value sum onto the unit sphere, preserving direction while removing length-dependent magnitude. The count stream estimates how many items participated in the match using the participation ratio, or inverse Simpson index, then bounds it through a saturating monotone map. This explicitly decouples what was matched from how much was matched. The memory stream is a per-head recurrent associative memory with a gated-delta update, inspired by Titans. The recurrent path carries a lossy long-term gist, while Polar Attention provides bounded full-context retrieval. An extreme-value-corrected learned null floor is used to calibrate logits against the expected maximum score from random background matches.
summary_en.experiments: The main study is a 100-run factorial ablation with 370M-parameter models trained on 1B FineWeb-Edu tokens. Models are evaluated from 2K to 64K context length, up to 32 times the training length. The reported pattern is clear: Polar Attention without memory still loses retrieval at long range, and softmax paired with the same memory still collapses at extreme lengths. The full ATMA configuration keeps induction needle-in-a-haystack retrieval above 90% across the 2K-to-64K sweep, while clean-document perplexity improves as more context is available. On the systems side, the implementation includes a PyTorch reference, an FP16/FP8 training harness, a paged inference engine, and a FlashAttention-style Triton kernel for streaming participation-ratio computation. The recurrent memory branch is reported to cost about 4.5 percentage points of MFU on NVIDIA L4 GPUs.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30- to 45-minute skim is enough. Read the motivation around softmax dilution and the window-versus-retrieval trade-off first. Then focus on the Polar Attention equations, especially the content normalization, participation-ratio count channel, and null-floor calibration. In the experiments, prioritize the factorial ablations and the 2K-to-64K curves for retrieval and perplexity. The main questions to carry forward are whether the count statistic remains stable at larger scale, whether unit-normalized content loses useful magnitude information, and whether the memory branch interacts cleanly with deeper pretrained models.

recommendation.zh: 这是在正面挑战 softmax attention 长度外推 prior；先看方法图和长上下文曲线，若 baseline 只打滑窗而没打 Hyena/RWKV/linear attention，就当弱信号。
recommendation.en: This directly challenges the softmax-attention prior on length extrapolation; read the method figure and long-context curves first, and treat it as weak evidence if the baselines stop at sliding-window attention.

paper.title: Lifelong In-Context Learning with Transformers Requires Parametric Forms of Attention
paper.abstract: Lifelong continual learning remains an obstacle on the path to human-like intelligence. Modern transformers show sparks of intelligence with in-context learning. The quadratic nature of attention, however, prohibits transformers from performing this process on arbitrarily long sequences. In this work, we argue that extending in-context learning to lifelong settings is a practical solution for continual learning in AI agents. In particular, we argue that \emph{parametric forms of attention} are n

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章讨论的是一个比“长上下文”更强的问题：如果希望 Transformer 在固定硬件预算下，对无限长的 token 流持续学习，也就是把 in-context learning 扩展到 lifelong setting，那么传统 softmax attention 是否在机制上就不够用。作者的回答是肯定的。因为 softmax attention 依赖不断增长的 KV cache，本质更像非参数回归：它能在上下文里检索和插值，但不能把长期经验压缩成有界、可更新的参数化记忆。因此，真正的 lifelong in-context learning 需要 parametric forms of attention，让模型在测试时把过去的 key-value 关系在线拟合进有限状态，而不是无限保留原始样本。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不是新 recipe，而是提出了一个值得认真对待的架构判断：如果未来 agent 要在部署期从海量交互中继续学习，仅靠更长上下文和更大的 KV cache 不够，注意力机制本身需要从“检索历史”转向“在线学习历史”。这和当前基座模型研究有两层关系。第一，它把 linear attention、SSM、fast-weight memory、test-time training 这些常被分散讨论的方向，统一到 attention-as-test-time-regression 的框架里，给出了为什么它们可能对 continual pretrain / deployment-time adaptation 有意义。第二，它明确指出 softmax attention 的瓶颈不是只有 O(n^2) 计算，而是表示形式：缓存原始样本意味着记忆容量随上下文线性增长，无法在固定预算下形成可泛化的长期知识。对做长上下文、在线学习、continual pretrain、agent memory 的研究员，这篇文章更像一份问题重述和研究议程。
summary.technical_approach:
这不是一篇提出新模型并做大规模实验的论文，更接近立场论文加统一视角。技术主线有三步。

第一步，把 attention 解释成 test-time regression。对每个 head，历史 token 经过投影得到 key 和 value，当前 query 要做的是根据过去的 key-value 对，预测与 query 对应的 value。作者强调，这里 attention 不只是“加权平均”，而是在测试时临时构造了一个自监督回归问题：key 是输入视角，value 是标签视角，query 是待预测点。

第二步，区分 nonparametric 与 parametric attention。
- softmax attention 被解释为 Nadaraya-Watson kernel regression 的一种形式。它通过相似度核对历史 value 做局部平均，因此需要保留全部或大量 KV 样本。优点是精确回忆局部上下文，缺点是推理成本和记忆占用随序列增长。
- sparse attention 只能部分缓解成本，但本质仍是保留一部分原始样本、丢弃另一部分。它解决的是“选哪些 token 留下”，不是“如何把经验合并成统计量”。
- parametric attention 则试图用有限维参数或状态，在线学习 key→value 的映射。过去经验不再以原始样本形式存储，而是通过更新规则写入有界记忆。作者把 linear attention、state-space models、fast-weight memories、以及某些 test-time training 方法都放进这个大类。

第三步，提出 lifelong in-context learning 的研究要求。作者认为，真正适合长期流式学习的机制应满足：
1) evictionless merging：不是简单淘汰旧 token，而是把经验合并进状态；
2) bounded memory under fixed hardware：状态维度固定，不随上下文无限增长；
3) online update rule：每到一个新 token，都能低成本更新对 key→value 关系的估计；
4) generalization beyond recall：不仅记住具体观测，还能形成任务相关的充分统计量或规律。

文中对 test-time training 的态度尤其明确。作者认为，在线梯度更新型的 parametric attention 可能是最有前景的一类，因为它允许模型在推理时真正“学”一个映射，而不是只做核回归式检索。但它也带来三个未解决问题：更新效率、容量上限、以及训练目标设计。也就是说，文章不是简单鼓吹线性注意力，而是在给出一个更宽的设计空间：凡是能把上下文转成有界参数化记忆的机制，都值得从 lifelong ICL 角度重新审视。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，这篇文章的重点不在新实验，而在概念统一与问题设定。当前可见部分主要是理论阐释和方法分类，没有像标准实证论文那样给出大规模参数量、数据规模、benchmark 提升幅度等结果。阅读时要预期它更像 perspective / position paper，而不是“提出一个新 attention 并在语言建模上提升 x%”。

即便如此，文中的实验性价值仍体现在它对已有方法的结构化比较：softmax attention 对应非参数回归，KV cache 随上下文增长；稀疏方法只能做选择性保留；parametric 方法通过有限状态做经验合并，更适合固定预算下的长期学习。若正文后半部分有案例或小规模验证，重点应看作者是否用合成长序列任务、持续事实学习、任务切换或流式回忆设置，去展示“回忆 token”与“学习映射”之间的差别。当前材料里还没有足够数字支持更细的结果总结。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合带着问题读，而不是找结论数字。建议先看 Introduction，抓住作者真正要反对的对象：不是 Transformer 本身，而是依赖无界 KV cache 的 softmax attention 范式。然后重点读“Attention as Test-Time Regression”这一节，这是全文的概念支点。要看清楚作者为什么把 softmax attention 归为非参数回归，以及为什么这会在 lifelong setting 下失效。

接着看作者如何组织 parametric attention 家族：linear attention、SSM、fast weights、test-time training 各自对应什么样的在线学习器，哪些只是压缩缓存，哪些真的在更新映射。若后文有 open problems 或 future directions，那部分也值得看，因为文章的价值主要在研究议程而不是单点技巧。

预计 30-45 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。若你在做长上下文、online adaptation、agent memory 或 continual pretrain，建议把文中的“evictionless merging”“bounded representation”“test-time regression”三个关键词记下来，再回头对照自己关心的架构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a stronger question than ordinary long-context modeling: if we want transformers to keep learning from an unbounded token stream under fixed hardware, can standard softmax attention support lifelong in-context learning at all? The answer argued here is no. Softmax attention behaves like a nonparametric regressor backed by an ever-growing KV cache. It can retrieve and interpolate over past examples, but it cannot compress long-run experience into a bounded, updateable memory. Lifelong in-context learning therefore requires parametric forms of attention that learn a key-to-value map online and store experience in finite state rather than raw examples.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining recipe, but it is a useful architectural thesis for people thinking about continual pretraining, deployment-time adaptation, and long-horizon agents. The paper’s main value is conceptual unification. It places linear attention, state-space models, fast-weight memories, and test-time training under a common lens: attention as test-time regression. That framing makes a sharper claim than the usual efficiency story. The bottleneck of softmax attention is not only quadratic compute; it is also representational. A cache of raw examples scales with context length and does not naturally become generalized knowledge under a fixed memory budget. For researchers working on long context, online learning, or agent memory, this is a useful reframing of the problem.
summary_en.technical_approach:
This is closer to a position paper than a new-model paper. The technical contribution is a structured viewpoint built in three steps.

First, attention is cast as test-time regression. For each head, past tokens produce keys and values, and the current query asks for the value associated with a new key-like point. In that view, attention is not merely weighted averaging. It constructs a self-supervised regression problem at inference time: keys are inputs, values are labels, and the query is the test point.

Second, the paper separates nonparametric from parametric attention.
- Softmax attention is interpreted as a form of Nadaraya-Watson kernel regression. It estimates the key-to-value map by local averaging over stored examples, which requires retaining the KV cache.
- Sparse attention may cap cost by evicting tokens, but it still operates by keeping some raw examples and discarding others. It addresses selection, not experience merging.
- Parametric attention instead maintains a finite-dimensional regressor or state that is updated online. Experience is absorbed into bounded memory through an update rule rather than stored as an ever-growing example set. The paper groups linear attention, state-space models, fast-weight memories, and some test-time training methods into this family.

Third, it proposes design requirements for lifelong in-context learning: evictionless merging of experience, bounded memory under fixed hardware, efficient online updates, and generalization beyond token recall. The paper is especially positive about online gradient-based mechanisms, i.e. test-time training, because they allow the model to actually learn a key-to-value map during inference rather than only perform kernel-style retrieval. At the same time, it highlights three unresolved issues: update efficiency, memory capacity, and objective design.

So the paper is not arguing for one specific mechanism. It is arguing that any architecture intended for lifelong in-context learning must move from cache-based nonparametric memory toward bounded parametric memory.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full text, the paper appears to be primarily conceptual rather than empirical. The visible sections focus on formalization and taxonomy, not on a new architecture with large-scale language-model experiments. There are no concrete parameter counts, training-token budgets, or benchmark gains in the available content, so it should not be read as a standard empirical paper claiming a measurable improvement on language modeling.

The experimental value, if any, lies in the structural comparison it sets up: softmax attention as nonparametric regression with growing memory, sparse methods as selective retention, and parametric methods as bounded online learners that merge experience. If later sections include toy tasks or synthetic lifelong-learning setups, the key thing to inspect would be whether they demonstrate a real difference between recalling tokens and learning transferable mappings over a stream. Based on the currently visible content, there is not enough numerical evidence to summarize beyond that.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as a research agenda paper, not as a result-driven methods paper. Start with the introduction and identify the actual target of criticism: not transformers in general, but the softmax-attention-plus-unbounded-KV-cache paradigm. Then read the 'Attention as Test-Time Regression' section carefully. That is the conceptual core. The important question is why softmax attention should be viewed as nonparametric regression, and why that representation fails under lifelong constraints.

Next, inspect how the paper organizes the family of parametric mechanisms: linear attention, SSMs, fast weights, and test-time training. The useful distinction is between methods that merely compress or prune memory and methods that truly update a bounded predictor. If the later sections contain open problems or future directions, those are worth reading closely because the paper’s main contribution is the problem decomposition rather than a single technique.

A productive skim should take 30–45 minutes. If you work on long context, online adaptation, agent memory, or continual pretraining, keep three phrases in mind while reading: evictionless merging, bounded representation, and test-time regression.

recommendation.zh: 统一了线性注意力/SSM/快速权重等路线的底层共性，可作为长上下文架构选型参考，无大模型实证，不用深读。
recommendation.en: Unifies linear attention, SSMs and fast weights under a common framing, useful as context for long-context architecture decisions but lacks large-scale LLM evidence, no need to read in depth.

paper.title: Dustin: Draft-Augmented Sparse Verification for Efficient Long-Context Generation with Speculative Decoding
paper.abstract: While speculative decoding improves inference throughput for multi-batch long-context Large Language Models (LLMs), its efficiency is often limited by a verification bottleneck where Key-Value (KV) cache loading dominates latency. Existing compression methods fail in this regime: static eviction incurs accuracy loss due to saliency shift, while dynamic selection introduces prohibitive computational overhead during the verification path. We propose Dustin, a sparse verification framework designed

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文 speculative decoding 在真实大模型推理里最卡的一段：verification 阶段的 KV cache 读取。问题不在于 speculative decoding 没有减少算力，而在于长上下文、多 batch 下，验证阶段仍要反复搬运大体量 KV，内存带宽成为主瓶颈。已有 KV 压缩方法要么做静态淘汰，容易因为 saliency shift 丢掉后续会变重要的 token；要么做动态选择，但每步重算重要性本身就太贵，放在 verification 路径上得不偿失。作者要解决的是：能不能在 speculative verification 这个特殊场景下，用足够便宜的方式找出未来几个验证步真正关键的 KV token，从而在不明显伤害生成质量的前提下，把 verification 的带宽成本压下去。
summary.importance: 它主要属于推理效率，而不是预训练方法，但对基座研究仍有两点实际价值。第一，长上下文模型的训练与部署越来越一体化，很多 pretrain 研究最后都要落到 32k、64k 甚至更长上下文的 serving 约束上；这篇工作把“verification 不是算力瓶颈，而是 KV 读带宽瓶颈”讲得很具体。第二，它说明在多步验证场景里，token 重要性不是单靠 target model 的历史注意力就能稳定预测的，因为未来几个 token 的 saliency 会漂移；引入 draft model 的 lookahead 信号后，才能更接近 verification 真正需要的 token 子集。这种“用便宜模型预测昂贵模型未来注意力”的思路，对训练期做稀疏注意力近似、课程式上下文裁剪也有启发。
summary.technical_approach: Dustin 的核心是一个面向 speculative verification 的稀疏 KV 选择框架。作者先把问题形式化成在验证窗口 [i, i+w-1] 上选择固定预算 k 个 KV 位置，使保留下来的注意力质量尽量接近全量注意力。为此定义了 ARR，衡量被选 token 覆盖了多少原始注意力质量，并在附录里说明 ARR 与输出 logit 的 KL divergence 强负相关，因此可作为稀疏前向 fidelity 的代理指标。方法上有两个关键设计。第一是 hybrid token selection：不用单一来源估计 token 重要性，而是融合 target model 的 historical attention 与 draft model 的 lookahead attention。前者便宜且反映已发生的依赖，后者能看到 verification 窗口内未来 token 的潜在关注点，适合应对 saliency shift。第二是 sparse estimation：为了避免动态选择本身过慢，作者不在所有层和头上完整物化注意力，而是搜索一个最小但足够有效的 attention head 子集，只在这些头上做重要性估计。这样做的逻辑很清楚：verification 路径里任何额外计算都必须比“直接跑全 KV”更便宜，否则压缩没有意义。文中还把 Dustin 与几类基线区分开来：静态 eviction 方法因为永久丢上下文，在多步验证里容易失真；基于完整 attention 重打分的方法精度高但开销过大；Quest 这类 page-level 近似虽然避免精确 QK^T，但估分仍有不小成本，且不如作者的稀疏估计快。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Llama3 与 Qwen2.5 系列，评测集包括 LongBench 和 PG-19。分析部分主要用 Qwen2.5-32B 作为 target model、Qwen2.5-0.5B 作为 draft model，并在 LongReward 数据上研究时间维度和层间行为，数据平均上下文长度约 13.5k。系统结果里，作者报告在 Qwen2.5-72B、32k context、batch size 16 的设定下，self-attention 计算可加速 27.85×，最终 decoding phase 达到最高 9.17× 提速，同时保持很小的精度损失。引言里还有一个很关键的系统观察：在 32k 输入长度、batch 16 时，verification 最多占到总解码延迟的 87.5%，这解释了为什么优化 verification 比继续抠 draft 端更有收益。方法验证上，作者先证明只看历史注意力不够，因为 verification 一次要处理未来 w 个 token，过去的 saliency 不能稳定外推；只看 draft lookahead 也不够，因为小模型对重要 token 的判断有偏差。混合策略在 ARR 上更接近 oracle，且 ARR 与 logit KL 的相关性支持它作为代理指标。文中还提到一个负结果：如果用朴素方式在所有头和层上重算注意力重要性，超过 4k token 后，额外开销会比直接做全缓存 self-attention 还大，这个结论对任何想在 verification 路径上做“精细动态选择”的方法都很关键。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议按“问题诊断—指标—系统设计—端到端结果”的顺序看。先看 Introduction，抓住 verification 在长上下文 speculative decoding 里的带宽瓶颈，以及静态/动态 KV 压缩各自为什么不合适。然后看 Observation 部分，尤其是作者如何比较 historical attention 和 lookahead attention 的局限，这一段决定了 hybrid 设计是否站得住。接着看 ARR 的定义和它与 logit KL 的关系，理解作者为什么用 ARR 做快速分析。最后看主结果表，重点关注 32k、batch 16、72B 这类最接近真实部署压力的设定。若只花 20 分钟，读引言、ARR 定义、hybrid policy、head subset search、主结果表和 5.4.1 的开销分析即可。若想判断能否迁移到自己的系统，值得细看不同 KV budget、不同 verification window、不同模型家族下的精度-速度折中。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the real bottleneck of long-context speculative decoding: verification-time KV cache loading. In large-batch, long-context generation, speculative decoding reduces some compute, but verification still has to read massive KV caches, so memory bandwidth dominates latency. Existing KV compression methods are a poor fit here. Static eviction loses accuracy because token saliency shifts over time, while dynamic selection often costs too much because importance has to be recomputed on the verification path. The paper asks whether one can cheaply identify the small subset of KV tokens that matter for a multi-step verification window, so that verification becomes sparse without noticeably hurting generation quality.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is still relevant to foundation-model work for two reasons. First, long-context pretraining and long-context serving are increasingly coupled in practice; once models are trained for 32k or longer contexts, deployment is constrained by KV bandwidth rather than pure FLOPs. The paper makes that bottleneck concrete. Second, it shows that token importance in speculative verification cannot be predicted well from target-model history alone because saliency drifts across future steps. Bringing in lookahead signals from the draft model is therefore not just a heuristic but a way to better match the actual verification objective. That idea may transfer to training-time sparse attention approximations or context-selection schemes where a cheap model predicts what the expensive model will need next.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dustin is a sparse verification framework specialized for speculative decoding. The problem is formulated as selecting a fixed budget of k KV positions for a verification window [i, i+w-1], with the goal of preserving as much of the original attention mass as possible. To evaluate selection quality, the paper defines Attention Recovery Rate (ARR), which measures how much attention mass is retained by the selected KV subset. The appendix further shows that ARR is strongly negatively correlated with output-logit KL divergence, making it a useful proxy for sparse-forward fidelity. The method has two main components. The first is a hybrid token-selection policy that combines historical attention from the target model with lookahead attention from the draft model. Historical attention is cheap and reflects established dependencies, while draft lookahead provides information about future tokens inside the verification block and helps handle saliency shift. The second is a sparse estimation scheme designed to keep the selector itself cheap. Instead of materializing attention importance across all heads and layers, Dustin searches for a minimal subset of attention heads that is sufficient for accurate importance estimation. This is a crucial systems choice: any dynamic selector on the verification path must be cheaper than simply running dense attention over the full KV cache, otherwise compression is pointless. The paper also positions Dustin against several baselines. Static eviction permanently discards context and therefore struggles under saliency shift. Full dynamic rescoring is accurate but too expensive. Page-level approximations such as Quest avoid exact QK^T but still incur non-trivial scoring overhead and remain slower than Dustin’s sparse estimator in the authors’ analysis.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover the Llama3 and Qwen2.5 families on LongBench and PG-19. The analysis sections mainly use Qwen2.5-32B as the target model and Qwen2.5-0.5B as the draft model, with LongReward as the analysis dataset, whose average context length is about 13.5k tokens. The headline system result is up to 27.85x acceleration for self-attention computation and up to 9.17x decoding-phase speedup on Qwen2.5-72B at 32k context length and batch size 16, with only minimal accuracy loss. One of the most informative observations appears early: at 32k input length and batch size 16, verification can account for as much as 87.5% of total decoding latency. That explains why optimizing verification matters more than squeezing a bit more speed from the draft side. On the method side, the paper shows that historical attention alone is insufficient because speculative verification processes a future block of w tokens, so past saliency does not extrapolate reliably. Draft lookahead alone is also insufficient because the smaller model is imperfect at predicting which tokens the target model will care about. The hybrid policy gets closer to the oracle in ARR, and the ARR-to-logit-KL relationship supports ARR as a meaningful proxy. Another practically important result is negative: a naive dynamic selector that recomputes importance from all heads and layers becomes slower than full-cache self-attention beyond 4k tokens. That finding is broadly relevant for any method that tries to do fine-grained dynamic KV selection during verification.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good skim order is: bottleneck diagnosis, metric, system design, then end-to-end results. Start with the introduction to understand why verification, not drafting, dominates latency in long-context speculative decoding, and why both static and standard dynamic KV compression are mismatched to this regime. Then read the observation section comparing historical attention and draft lookahead; this is the empirical basis for the hybrid policy. Next, read the ARR definition and the evidence connecting ARR to logit KL, since ARR is the paper’s main analysis tool. Finally, inspect the main result tables, especially the 32k, batch-16, 72B settings that are closest to realistic deployment pressure. If time is limited to about 20 minutes, focus on the introduction, ARR, the hybrid policy, the head-subset search, the main throughput tables, and the overhead analysis in the section discussing naive dynamic scoring. If evaluating transferability to another serving stack, pay extra attention to the trade-offs across KV budgets, verification window sizes, and model families.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文 serving 的人值得看；它不是改模型而是改验证路径，读 latency breakdown 和 token/head 选择开销， headline speedup 先别全信。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about long-context serving: it attacks the verification path rather than the model, but check the latency breakdown and selector overhead before trusting the headline speedup.

paper.title: Agentic evolution of physically constrained foundation models
paper.abstract: Artificial intelligence increasingly drives automated scientific discovery, yet contemporary generalist agents lack physical grounding, frequently hallucinating hardware-incompatible designs. Here, we present a physically grounded, multi-agent discovery engine that autonomously architects hardware-compliant computing systems. Anchored by an Evolutionary Knowledge Graph structuring past scientific innovations, the framework extracts an "algorithmic Chain-of-Thought" to transform blind stochastic

summary.core_problem: 用 LLM 多智能体自动发现硬件约束下的模型压缩算法，解决通用智能体在物理系统设计中容易产生硬件不可实现方案、而传统自动搜索又依赖人工限定搜索空间的问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身贡献有限，但对“LLM 辅助算法发现”这一方向有参考价值。其核心意义不在提出新的训练范式，而在于展示如何把历史算法知识组织成可演化记忆，让智能体在强物理约束下搜索量化/压缩策略，从而逼近甚至超过人工启发式方法。对关注模型压缩、部署优化、自动科研的研究者有借鉴意义，但不属于基座预训练核心问题。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了一个分层多智能体发现框架。基础是 Evolutionary Knowledge Graph（EKG），从 164 个主流 LLM 压缩方法中抽取算法结构、适用场景、硬件约束和演化关系，形成机器可读的“算法记忆”。上层是多智能体协作：负责提出假设、改写历史算法路径、构造算法 CoT、再由 AI peer review 做可行性筛选，最后结合硬件反馈闭环迭代。与常见“让 LLM 直接写新算法”的做法不同，这里显式建模已有方法的演化轨迹，把随机搜索改成基于图谱路径的定向变异；同时引入带宽敏感的 Sensitivity Profile，把硬件约束变成直接反馈信号，而不是事后验证。最终系统自动演化出两种方法：面向长上下文 dense 模型的离群值感知量化 Q-Enhance，以及面向 MoE 的专家级精度分配加低秩误差补偿方法 MoE-Salient-AQ。
summary.experiments: 报告结果集中在模型压缩部署场景。Q-Enhance 针对长上下文推理中的离群值导致的精度崩塌问题，可支撑到 128k token 序列长度；MoE-Salient-AQ 在 sub-3-bit 量化区间报告比人工设计基线高 3.7%。更大规模部署实验中，235B 模型可压缩到双 A100 服务器上运行，显存需求从 438GB 降到 108GB，硬件需求降低约 75%，精度损失 0.64%；8B 模型可部署到单张消费级 GPU。论文没有提供预训练 loss、通用能力 scaling、数据效率等基座训练层面的证据，结果主要针对压缩后的推理部署表现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看框架图和 EKG 的组织方式，理解它如何把“算法演化历史”变成可搜索结构。压缩方法细节可以快速浏览，关键判断是：这里的贡献本质是自动化算法设计流程，而不是提出一个改变预训练范式的新方法。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若关注 AI for Science / 自动算法发现，可重点读多智能体评审和硬件反馈闭环部分；若只关心 LLM 预训练，可直接跳读结果与方法定位。

summary_en.core_problem: Automating the discovery of hardware-aware model compression algorithms with LLM-based multi-agent systems, addressing the failure mode where generalist agents propose physically infeasible designs while classical search methods remain confined to manually specified spaces.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a core pretraining contribution, but it is relevant as a case study in LLM-assisted algorithm discovery. Its main value is in showing how prior algorithmic knowledge can be structured into an evolvable memory so that agents can search under strict hardware constraints and match or exceed hand-designed heuristics. It is of interest to researchers working on compression, deployment, and automated research workflows, rather than on foundation model pretraining itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system is built around a layered multi-agent framework. Its backbone is an Evolutionary Knowledge Graph (EKG) constructed from 164 mainstream LLM compression methods, encoding algorithmic structure, applicability, hardware constraints, and historical relations as machine-readable memory. On top of this, multiple agents perform hypothesis generation, mutation of prior algorithmic trajectories, algorithmic chain-of-thought construction, and AI peer review for feasibility filtering. Rather than asking an LLM to invent algorithms from scratch, the framework explicitly models evolutionary paths over prior methods, converting blind stochastic search into directed structural mutation. A bandwidth-sensitive Sensitivity Profile provides direct hardware feedback instead of deferred validation. The discovered algorithms are Q-Enhance, an outlier-aware quantization scheme for long-context dense models, and MoE-Salient-AQ, which assigns precision at expert granularity and uses adaptive low-rank error compensation for MoE quantization.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results are in compression and deployment. Q-Enhance targets accuracy collapse from long-context outliers and is evaluated up to 128k tokens. MoE-Salient-AQ is reported to outperform human-designed baselines by 3.7% in the sub-3-bit regime. In large-scale deployment tests, a 235B model is compressed onto dual A100 servers, reducing memory requirements from 438 GB to 108 GB, a roughly 75% hardware reduction, with 0.64% accuracy degradation. An 8B model is deployable on a single consumer GPU. No evidence is provided on pretraining loss, scaling behavior, or data efficiency; the empirical claims are limited to post-training compression and inference deployment.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the framework figure and the design of the EKG to understand how historical algorithmic knowledge is turned into a searchable structure. The specific compression methods can be read quickly. The main takeaway is an automated algorithm-design pipeline, not a new pretraining paradigm. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes. Readers interested in AI for science or automated discovery should pay attention to the multi-agent review and hardware feedback loop; readers focused strictly on pretraining can skip most implementation details and only check the problem setup and headline results.

recommendation.zh: 自动进化搜出的MoE亚3比特量化策略有工程参考价值，无范式创新，仅看量化方案和部署实验结果即可
recommendation.en: The auto-evolved sub-3-bit MoE quantization schemes have practical engineering value, no paradigm novelty; only read the quantization method and deployment results.

paper.title: Harmonic: Hierarchical State Space Models for Efficient Long-Context Language Modeling
paper.abstract: We present Harmonic, a hierarchical state space model (SSM) for language modeling. The architecture stacks three recurrent levels at progressively slower timescales; each level receives the prediction error of the level below as input, rather than its raw hidden state. On enwiki8 with equal token budgets, Harmonic outperforms a comparable Transformer (28M params) by +1.4% at 1K tokens, +6.7% at 8K tokens, and +11.4% at 32K tokens (bpt, lower is better). It also outperforms Mamba at every tested

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文语言建模中 Transformer 和现有 SSM 在记忆长度、显存占用与长度泛化上的不足。
summary.importance: 这是架构层面的建模尝试，不是简单替换注意力算子。它把分层时间尺度递归和预测误差传递结合起来，目标是同时改善长程依赖建模和训练可扩展性，对“后注意力时代”的长上下文 LM 设计有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Harmonic，一种分层状态空间模型。模型包含三个递归层级，对应不同时间尺度；上层不直接接收下层隐藏状态，而是接收下层的 prediction error。这个设计更像分层残差预测/误差校正机制，试图让慢时钟层专注于更长程、低频的信息。作者还将 HarmonicBlock 直接替换 TinyLlama 1.1B 中全部 attention 层，构造 Hallamonic，用来测试在更大规模下是否能摆脱 RoPE 的长度限制。
summary.experiments: 在 enwiki8 上，等 token budget 下，相比 28M Transformer，Harmonic 在 1K/8K/32K 上 bpt 分别改善 1.4%/6.7%/11.4%；相对 Mamba 也有 0.7-1.8% 优势。64K 时，Mamba 和 Transformer 在 80GB H100 上无法训练，Harmonic 仍可训练并达到 6.169 bpt。WikiText-103 上也复现了对 Transformer 的优势，1K-32K 区间提升 1.7%-7.2%。在 1.1B 规模，把 TinyLlama 的 attention 全替换后，在 Lambada 等两个 clean benchmark 上 1K-8K 长度范围 loss 更稳定。当前证据主要是中小规模语言建模和一个 attention-free 替换实验，离大规模预训练结论还有距离。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the weakness of Transformers and existing SSMs in long-context language modeling, especially memory usage, context scaling, and length generalization.
summary_en.importance: This is an architectural proposal rather than a minor efficiency tweak. By combining hierarchical timescales with prediction-error passing, it offers a concrete alternative for long-context LM design and is relevant to anyone thinking beyond standard attention.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Harmonic, a hierarchical state space model with three recurrent levels operating at progressively slower timescales. Instead of feeding raw hidden states upward, each level passes prediction errors to the next level. This creates a hierarchical error-correction mechanism intended to separate short-range and long-range dynamics. The authors also replace all attention layers in TinyLlama 1.1B with HarmonicBlock, forming Hallamonic, to test whether the architecture can avoid RoPE-style context limits at larger scale.
summary_en.experiments: On enwiki8 under matched token budgets, Harmonic beats a 28M Transformer by 1.4%, 6.7%, and 11.4% in bpt at 1K, 8K, and 32K respectively, and outperforms Mamba by 0.7-1.8% across tested lengths. At 64K, both Mamba and Transformer run out of memory on an 80GB H100, while Harmonic still trains and reaches 6.169 bpt. The gains replicate on WikiText-103, with a 1.7%-7.2% gap over Transformer from 1K to 32K. At 1.1B scale, replacing TinyLlama attention with HarmonicBlock yields more stable loss across 1K-8K on two clean benchmarks. Evidence is promising but still far from a full large-scale pretraining validation.

recommendation.zh: 这篇该当作“长上下文无注意力替代”的弱强信号来看：机制有新意，结果也干净，但规模还不够，重点读误差传递设计和 64K 训练可行性，别急着改 prior。
recommendation.en: Treat this as a serious but still early signal for attention-free long-context LM: the error-passing idea is novel and the 64K result is clean, but scale is not yet enough to rewrite priors.

paper.title: CompressKV: Semantic-Retrieval-Guided KV-Cache Compression for Resource-Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly constrained by the memory footprint and decoding cost of key-value (KV) caches, limiting sustainable deployment on resource-constrained hardware. Existing KV cache eviction methods typically apply heuristic token scoring over all heads in GQA-based LLMs. These methods ignore the different functionalities of attention heads, leading to the eviction of critical tokens and thus degrading the performance of LLMs. To address this issue

summary.core_problem: 现有基于注意力分数的 KV cache 驱逐方法在 GQA 架构上对所有 head 做均等聚合，忽视了 head 功能异质性，导致偏向保留 prompt 首尾的 Streaming Heads 主导打分，中间语义关键 token 被误驱逐；同时各层 KV 预算要么固定均分，要么依赖在线统计，泛化性和开销都不理想。
summary.importance: 属于推理效率方向的增量工作，主要价值在于再次明确指出 GQA 下 head 异质性对 KV 压缩策略的影响，并给出一个基于离线层误差分配预算的实用方案。对 pretrain 研究的直接启发有限，但对理解 attention head 分工、长上下文推理时的信息保留机制有一定参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CompressKV，分三步：(1) 离线识别 Semantic Retrieval Heads（SRHs），即能同时关注 prompt 首尾 token 及其周边语义上下文的 head，而不是只盯住首尾的 Streaming Heads；(2) 在每层内仅用 SRHs 的注意力分数来选择重要 token，并在该层的所有 head 间共享同一套保留 token 索引，避免 Streaming Heads 主导驱逐决策；(3) 离线计算每层在压缩前后 attention block 输出差的 Frobenius 范数，以此估计该层对压缩误差的敏感度，按比例分配各层 KV 预算，不引入在线开销。
summary.experiments: 在 LongBench 和 Needle-in-a-Haystack 上评测多个 GQA LLM。LongBench 上以 19% KV 预算保留超过 99% 的全 cache 性能，3% 预算下保留约 97% 的 QA 准确率；NIAH 上以 0.7% KV 存储达到 90% 的基线检索准确率。实验验证了 SRH 选择和离线层自适应分配两个组件各自有效。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看方法部分对 Streaming Heads 与 Semantic Retrieval Heads 的区分、以及基于 Frobenius 范数做离线层预算分配的思路。图 1 关于 head 异质性导致误驱逐的示意比较直观。预计阅读时间 15–20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing attention-score-based KV cache eviction methods for GQA models aggregate scores uniformly across heads, ignoring functional heterogeneity across attention heads. As a result, Streaming Heads that focus primarily on the beginning and end of the prompt dominate eviction decisions, causing semantically important mid-context tokens to be discarded. Existing layer budget allocation is either fixed across layers or relies on online statistics with limited generalization and non-trivial overhead.
summary_en.importance: This is an incremental inference-efficiency paper. Its main value is in making the head-heterogeneity problem in GQA-based KV compression explicit and providing a practical, offline layer-budget allocation scheme. Its direct implications for pretraining are limited, but it offers useful observations on attention head specialization and information retention in long-context inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: CompressKV consists of three steps: (1) offline identification of Semantic Retrieval Heads (SRHs), i.e., heads that retrieve important mid-prompt tokens and attend to their semantic context, as opposed to Streaming Heads that mostly attend to initial and final tokens; (2) important-token selection based only on SRH attention scores within each layer, with a single set of preserved token indices shared across all heads in that layer, so that eviction is no longer dominated by Streaming Heads; (3) offline error-aware layer budget allocation, where the Frobenius norm of the attention-block output difference between full and compressed cache is used to estimate per-layer compression sensitivity, and budgets are allocated proportionally without online overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LongBench and Needle-in-a-Haystack across multiple GQA LLMs. On LongBench, CompressKV retains over 99% of full-cache performance with 19% KV budget and about 97% QA accuracy with 3% budget. On NIAH, it reaches 90% of baseline retrieval accuracy with only 0.7% KV storage. Ablations support the contribution of both SRH-based token selection and offline layer-adaptive allocation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper. Focus on the distinction between Streaming Heads and Semantic Retrieval Heads, and on the offline Frobenius-based layer budget allocation idea. Figure 1 gives a clear illustration of how head heterogeneity causes incorrect eviction. Estimated reading time: 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 SRH 识别和 layer budget ablation；若只在少数长文任务上有效，不要过度外推到训练期 head 分工。
recommendation.en: Read the SRH identification and layer-budget ablations; if gains are task-narrow, do not overread them as training-time head specialization.

paper.title: Forget Without Compromise: Nexus Sampling for Streaming KV-Cache Eviction Under Fixed Budgets
paper.abstract: Long-context and agentic LLM workloads push the KV cache past any fixed memory budget, forcing the inference stack to permanently evict tokens at every step of a continuous-inference stream. Existing methods all share the same template, a per-step direct-attention score followed by deterministic top-$K$ selection, which converts a single below-cutoff step into an irreversible verdict and permanently erases any subtly important token that direct attention cannot single out from noise. To address

summary.core_problem: 论文处理的是长上下文连续推理中的 KV-cache 淘汰问题：当缓存超过固定显存预算时，系统必须永久丢弃一部分 token，而现有方法多用当前注意力分数做确定性 top-K，容易把一次低分误判成永久不重要。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身不是核心贡献，但对长上下文模型的 serving 和 agent 式持续交互有参考价值。它把 KV-cache eviction 明确建模成流式固定预算问题，而不是一次性的稀疏读取问题。这个区分有意义，因为训练阶段看到的是完整上下文，推理阶段的缓存删减会改变模型可访问的信息结构，进而影响长上下文能力的真实落地。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Nexus Sampling，是一个无需训练的 KV-cache 淘汰策略。它有两步。第一步是 Nexus scoring：不只看当前 query 对历史 token 的直接注意力，而是在注意力图上做短步迭代传播，用来提高“桥接 token”的权重。这类 token 单次直接注意力可能不高，但连接了一组相互关联的上下文片段，删掉后会破坏局部信息结构。第二步是 weighted reservoir sampling：用带权蓄水池采样替代确定性 top-K，使 token 的保留概率与权重相关，而不是一次低于阈值就被永久淘汰。论文的核心差异在于把选择机制从 hard cutoff 改成概率式保留，并把打分从局部直接注意力扩展到包含间接连接信息的权重。
summary.experiments: 关键结果集中在固定缓存密度下的长上下文性能。论文报告在 20% cache density 时，Nexus Sampling 在 LongBench 上与 dense attention 的差距约在 1 分以内；在 retrieval-heavy 的长上下文任务上优于基于确定性 top-K 的淘汰基线。内存方面，相比 dense FlashAttention-2，每个序列的 cache memory 可降低到约 1/10。理论分析给出的直觉是：蓄水池采样下 token 的长期存活由多步 inclusion probability 的乘积决定，而确定性 top-K 会在第一次低于 cutoff 时直接归零，因此更容易产生边缘 token 的单调流失。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 对 sparse attention 与 cache eviction 的区分，以及“monotone marginal erosion”的问题定义。方法部分重点看 Nexus scoring 的迭代传播公式和 weighted reservoir selection 的具体实现。Appendix A 的理论对比值得扫一遍，主要看 product-over-steps 与 first-below-cutoff 的差异。实验部分优先看 LongBench、retrieval-heavy tasks、不同 cache density 下的曲线；如果关注部署，还要看它与 FlashAttention-2 dense cache 的显存对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets KV-cache eviction under a fixed memory budget for long-context and continuous inference. Existing methods usually score tokens by current attention and keep the deterministic top-K, which can turn a transiently low score into irreversible deletion.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly on inference-time memory management rather than pretraining. It is still relevant for foundation-model researchers because long-context capability is only useful if the serving stack preserves the right information under memory pressure. The paper makes a useful distinction: sparse attention is a read policy over a full cache, while eviction is a streaming decision problem where deletions are permanent.
summary_en.technical_approach: Nexus Sampling combines two mechanisms. Nexus scoring augments direct attention with a short iterative walk over the attention structure, raising the weight of bridge tokens that connect clusters of mutually related context tokens but may not receive high direct attention from any single query. Weighted reservoir sampling then replaces deterministic top-K. Tokens are retained with probability proportional to the Nexus weight, so marginal but repeatedly useful tokens are less likely to be lost after one unlucky step. The main design choice is to fix both the scoring myopia and the hard-cutoff selection rule.
summary_en.experiments: At 20% cache density, the method is reported to stay within roughly one point of dense attention on LongBench. It outperforms top-K eviction baselines on retrieval-heavy long-context tasks. The paper also reports up to a 10x reduction in per-sequence cache memory compared with dense FlashAttention-2. The theoretical analysis frames the difference clearly: reservoir survival depends on a product of per-step inclusion probabilities, while deterministic top-K survival drops to zero once a token falls below the cutoff.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the distinction between sparse attention and irreversible eviction, and for the monotone marginal erosion failure mode. In the method section, focus on the iterative Nexus score and the weighted reservoir selection rule. Appendix A is useful for the survival-probability argument. For practical relevance, look at the LongBench results, retrieval-heavy tasks, cache-density curves, and memory comparisons against dense FlashAttention-2.

recommendation.zh: 概率化KV驱逐思路扎实，80%驱逐率下精度损失<1%，看方法和实验即可，可在推理栈AB测试
recommendation.en: Solid probabilistic KV eviction idea with <1% accuracy loss at 80% eviction, read method and experiments, ready for inference stack AB testing

paper.title: AGORA: An Archive-Grounded Benchmark for Agentic Workplace Document Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that reason over documents rather than answer from parametric knowledge. We study archive-grounded reasoning: locating sparse evidence across a large, messy collection of workplace files, reconciling inconsistent terminology, units, and time conventions, and computing an answer. Existing benchmarks address only parts of this setting and none jointly stresses archive-groundedness, agentic exploration, and cross-domain coverage. We introduc

summary.core_problem: 如何评测“面向企业档案库的 agentic 文档推理”能力：在远超上下文窗口的、杂乱且异构的真实工作文档集合中，模型需要主动探索文件结构、定位稀疏证据、对齐术语/单位/时间口径并完成可验证的数值计算；同时评测要避免依赖模型参数记忆或开放网络检索，且要可复现、可确定性打分。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限（更偏评测/agent harness），但对“长上下文之外的检索-阅读-计算闭环”提出了更贴近企业落地的压力测试：1）把难点从单文档阅读理解转到“证据稀疏 + 异构格式 + 口径冲突 + 需要计算”；2）用固定封闭语料避免 web 漂移，强调可复现；3）用数值唯一答案避免 LLM-as-judge。对做预训练的人，启发主要在数据与能力缺口：模型在跨格式表格/报告/杂项文件上的鲁棒性、单位与时间规范化、以及在检索受限条件下的证据选择策略，可能需要在 mid-train 或合成数据阶段专门补齐。
summary.technical_approach:
核心是 benchmark 设计与构建流水线，而不是新训练方法。Agora 将任务形式化为：给定一个固定集合C（单个领域档案库），agent 只能通过工具在该集合内探索与读取，最终输出唯一可核验的数值答案。设计要点：
1）Archive-grounded：每题必须仅靠集合内证据可解，禁止开放网；集合冻结以保证复现。
2）规模强制探索：每个集合远超上下文窗口（总计372M tokens、9664文档），排除“全量塞上下文”或“粗暴扫描”。
3）异构与跨域：8个领域集合，强调文件格式、表结构、术语与报告口径差异。
4）确定性评测：每题唯一数值答案，避免主观打分。
构建流水线（按文中描述的关键环节）：用 agentic pipeline 做跨文档 multi-hop 问题合成；对可能泄漏答案的表述做 obfuscation（降低模型凭记忆/表面匹配直接命中）；做难度过滤（确保需要多步检索/对齐/计算）；再做人类核验。评测时用一个极简 agent harness（mini-swe-agent），只暴露 bash 工具，尽量固定“脚手架差异”，把差异归因到模型的推理/证据选择/工具使用能力。
summary.experiments:
规模与设置：362个问题；8个领域集合；9664真实文档；总计约372M tokens；每题答案为可验证数值。
主要结果：评测8个模型（包含闭源与开源权重），最强模型总体准确率59.4%，仍未达到作者设定的60%“基本可用”阈值附近；并且存在显著的跨领域波动，聚合排名与分领域排名不一致，说明弱点往往是“模型×领域”的交互而非单一难度。
从预训练视角可读出的信号：即便前沿模型在封闭档案库的证据定位与口径对齐上仍频繁失败，提示能力瓶颈不只是上下文长度，而是跨格式信息抽取、规范化与计算链路的稳定性（文中强调单位/时间/术语不一致带来的错误）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约20–30分钟）：
1）Introduction + Table 1：看作者如何把“archive-grounded + agentic exploration + cross-domain”与现有基准区分开。
2）The Agora Benchmark 章节的 desiderata：这是任务定义与可复现性约束的核心。
3）构建流水线部分：重点看 obfuscation、difficulty filtering、人类核验如何降低泄漏与投机。
4）结果图表：先看总体59.4%上限，再看分领域差异与leaderboard翻转，理解它想测的到底是什么。
精读价值点：如果在做检索增强预训练或 mid-train 数据合成，可以把它的失败模式当作数据生成的目标分布（异构表格、单位换算、时间口径、跨文件对账）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate archive-grounded, agentic workplace document reasoning: given a huge, messy, heterogeneous enterprise-style file collection far beyond any context window, an agent must actively explore the archive, locate sparse evidence, reconcile inconsistent terminology/units/time conventions, and compute a verifiable numeric answer—while keeping the evaluation reproducible and not reliant on open-web access or subjective judging.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an evaluation asset rather than a pretraining method, but it creates a realistic stress test for the retrieval–reading–normalization–calculation loop under tight context constraints. For pretraining researchers, the main value is diagnostic: it exposes capability gaps that are not solved by longer context alone—robust extraction across file formats, unit/time normalization, evidence selection under scarcity, and multi-step numeric reconciliation. It can inform mid-training curricula, synthetic data generation targets, and what “document reasoning” should mean beyond single-document QA.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Agora is a benchmark plus a construction/evaluation pipeline. Task formulation: each question is paired with a fixed, closed collection C; the agent can only use tools to navigate/read within C and must output a single, uniquely verifiable numeric answer.
Key design choices:
1) Archive-groundedness via frozen collections (no web), ensuring reproducibility and preventing drift.
2) Scale that forces deliberate exploration: collections are far larger than context windows (372M tokens total), ruling out brute-force stuffing.
3) Cross-domain, heterogeneous corpora: 8 domain collections with diverse formats and conventions.
4) Deterministic scoring: numeric answers avoid LLM-as-judge.
Dataset construction (as described): an agentic pipeline gathers authentic documents, synthesizes cross-document multi-hop questions, applies leakage-preventing obfuscation, filters for difficulty (to require real search/verification/computation), and uses human verification.
Evaluation harness: a minimal agent interface (mini-swe-agent) exposing only a bash tool, aiming to control for scaffolding differences and attribute variance to model reasoning, evidence selection, and tool use.
summary_en.experiments:
Scale/setup: 362 questions; 8 domain collections; 9,664 real documents; ~372M tokens; each question has a unique numeric ground truth.
Main finding: across 8 evaluated models (mix of proprietary and open-weight), the best reaches 59.4% accuracy—still below a ~60% “barely acceptable” threshold suggested by the authors. Performance varies strongly by domain, and per-domain leaderboards can differ from the aggregate ranking, indicating domain–model interaction effects rather than a single uniform difficulty.
Pretraining-relevant signal: frequent failures stem from evidence sparsity, inconsistent units/time conventions, and cross-file reconciliation—capabilities that likely require targeted data/recipes beyond generic web-text pretraining.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
1) Introduction + the comparison table: understand what they claim existing benchmarks miss.
2) The desiderata in “The Agora Benchmark”: this is the crisp task definition and reproducibility constraints.
3) Dataset construction details: focus on obfuscation, difficulty filtering, and human verification (how they reduce leakage and shortcutting).
4) Results: start from the 59.4% ceiling, then inspect domain-wise breakdowns and ranking flips.
If you work on retrieval-aware pretraining or mid-training, treat the failure modes as a target distribution for synthetic tasks (heterogeneous tables, unit conversion, time normalization, cross-document reconciliation).

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心长上下文是否真的替代检索，这篇值得看；先看任务构造和错误分布，分数本身次要。
recommendation.en: Read this if you care whether long context can really replace retrieval; focus on task construction and failure modes rather than the leaderboard.

paper.title: AVOC: Enhancing Hour-Level Audio-Video Understanding in Omni-Modal LLMs via Retrieval-Inspired Token Compression
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models have achieved remarkable progress in short-form audio-video understanding, yet long-form audio-video comprehension remains challenged by limited context windows and severe information redundancy. To address these bottlenecks, we propose AVOC, a framework for long-form audio-video understanding in Omni-modal Large Language Models. AVOC introduces a learnable token compression module between the modality encoders and the LLM backbone. We reframe multimodal token co

summary.core_problem: 解决 omni-modal LLM 在小时级长音视频理解中，模态 token 过长、冗余过高、上下文窗口不够用的问题。
summary.importance: 这是多模态长上下文方向的工程方法工作。对基座预训练研究员的启发主要在于：它把多模态 token 压缩明确建模成 query-conditioned retrieval 问题，而不是单纯做均匀下采样或固定池化，这对统一模态建模和视觉/音频 tokenizer 设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 AVOC，在模态编码器与 LLM backbone 之间加入可学习 token compression 模块。核心思路是把压缩视为 top-K 检索：在固定上下文预算下，从大量音视频 token 中选出最支持当前问题回答的子集。方法借鉴信息检索中的 relevance、importance、diversity 三个准则，并将三者组合成统一的压缩管线。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明目标场景是长时音视频理解，尤其是小时级输入，但未给出具体 backbone、参数规模、训练数据和 benchmark 名称。实验主线应是与常见 token 压缩或采样策略比较，在固定 context budget 下提升问答或理解性能。由于摘要缺少数字，当前只能判断其贡献更偏方法设计而非规模突破。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles hour-level audio-video understanding in omni-modal LLMs, where multimodal token streams are too long and too redundant for the available context budget.
summary_en.importance: This is an engineering-heavy multimodal long-context paper. Its main value for foundation-model researchers is the reframing of multimodal token compression as query-conditioned retrieval rather than uniform downsampling or fixed pooling, which is relevant to unified modeling and tokenizer design.
summary_en.technical_approach: AVOC inserts a learnable token compression module between modality encoders and the LLM backbone. Compression is cast as a top-K retrieval problem: under a fixed context budget, select the subset of audio-video tokens most useful for answering the query. The design is inspired by three classical IR criteria—relevance, importance, and diversity—and integrates them into one compression pipeline.
summary_en.experiments: The target setting is long-form, hour-level audio-video understanding, but the abstract does not provide the backbone, model size, training data, or benchmark names. The likely experimental story is improved QA/understanding under fixed context budgets versus standard token compression or sampling baselines. Based on the abstract, this looks more like a method paper than a scale report.

recommendation.zh: 长音视频理解的实用招数，和文本 pretrain 关系不深；如果你关心 unified token budget，只看它把压缩写成 relevance/importance/diversity 检索这件事，别花太多时间在任务分数上。
recommendation.en: A practical long audio-video trick with limited direct impact on text pretraining; if unified token budgeting matters to you, just take the relevance/importance/diversity retrieval formulation and skip the task-score details.

paper.title: Randomized YaRN Improves Length Generalization for Long-Context Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are typically pretrained on short sequences and then extended to work on longer sequences with additional training. However, such LLMs still struggle to further generalize to very long sequences. We propose Randomized YaRN, a training method that improves length generalization by combining YaRN-based positional extrapolation with randomized positional encoding and a length curriculum. During training on short context data, tokens are assigned YaRN positional encoding

summary.core_problem: 现有长上下文扩展方法存在两类共性缺陷：基于长文本继续预训练/微调的方案本质是将部分长序列拉入训练分布，没有赋予模型真正的长度外推能力；YaRN这类RoPE位置编码修改方案在简单检索任务（如针在草堆测试）上表现良好，但在训练分布外的长上下文推理任务上效果不稳定，无法支撑16K以上长度的鲁棒推理。
summary.importance: 提供了一个极低训练成本的长上下文推理扩展方案，无需大规模长文本训练数据，仅用<8K的短上下文数据即可实现到128K的长度泛化，解决了以往位置外推方法在推理任务上失效的痛点，对算力有限的团队适配长上下文模型有很高实用价值；同时明确区分了“训练中见过长序列”和“具备真正长度外推能力”的差异，为长上下文预训练的目标设计提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三个核心组件组合而成：1）以YaRN位置编码作为RoPE模型的外推基础，保留其分维度NTK插值、长上下文注意力温度缩放的设计，不引入额外可学习参数；2）训练时采用随机位置采样：对于长度为L的短序列，从远大于L的位置范围中无放回采样一组递增的位置索引，将对应位置的YaRN编码分配给序列中的token，让模型在短文本训练阶段即可接触到分布外的位置表示，同时保留token的相对顺序不变；3）加入长度课程机制：训练过程中逐步增大位置采样的最大长度，避免训练初期直接暴露过大位置导致的不稳定。训练仅需对模型所有线性层施加LoRA，无需全参数微调。
summary.experiments: 模型完全基于<8K的短上下文数据训练，在BABILong、多轮共指消解（MRCR）两个高难度长上下文推理基准上测试，16K到128K长度区间的表现显著优于两类基线：一是仅在推理时启用的YaRN外推，二是普通LoRA长文本微调；效果在Llama、Qwen等不同基座模型上保持一致。消融实验验证三个组件均为必要：移除随机位置采样会导致外推能力大幅下降，移除长度课程会造成128K长度下性能崩塌，将YaRN替换为标准RoPE后随机采样的效果也会明显变差。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注方法章节的位置采样流程与长度课程设计，以及消融实验中各组件的贡献对比。值得深挖的方向包括：不同位置采样分布（均匀分布或其他分布）对不同类型任务的影响、该方法与长文本继续预训练的组合效果、位置插值方法与随机位置训练的兼容性边界。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-context extension methods have two common limitations: Continual pretraining or finetuning on long corpora only brings partial long sequences into the training distribution, without delivering genuine length extrapolation capability; RoPE modification methods like YaRN perform well on simple retrieval tasks such as Needle-in-a-Haystack, but show inconsistent performance on long-context reasoning tasks beyond the training distribution, failing to support robust reasoning at lengths above 16K.
summary_en.importance: This work provides a low-compute recipe for long-context reasoning extension, which achieves length generalization up to 128K using only <8K short-context training data. It resolves the longstanding failure of prior position extrapolation methods on reasoning tasks, and is practically valuable for teams with limited compute budgets adapting models for long-context use cases. It also draws a clear distinction between 'seeing long sequences during training' and 'acquiring true length extrapolation capability', which informs the design of long-context pretraining objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method combines three core components: 1) YaRN as the base positional encoding for RoPE models, retaining its dimension-wise NTK interpolation and length-dependent attention temperature scaling, with no additional learnable parameters introduced; 2) Randomized position sampling during training: for each short sequence of length L, a sorted set of position indices is sampled without replacement from a range far larger than L, and corresponding YaRN encodings are assigned to tokens. This exposes the model to out-of-distribution positional representations on short-sequence inputs while preserving correct token relative order; 3) A length curriculum that gradually increases the maximum sampling range over training epochs, avoiding instability caused by over-exposure to extremely large positions early in training. Only LoRA tuning on all linear layers is required, with no need for full-parameter finetuning.
summary_en.experiments: Models are trained exclusively on <8K short-context data. Tested on two challenging long-context reasoning benchmarks, BABILong and Multi-Round Coreference Resolution (MRCR), Randomized YaRN significantly outperforms two baselines across the 16K to 128K length range: inference-time only YaRN extrapolation, and vanilla LoRA long-context finetuning. Performance is consistent across different base model families including Llama and Qwen. Ablation studies confirm all three components are necessary: removing randomized position sampling leads to substantial drops in extrapolation performance, removing the length curriculum causes performance collapse at 128K, and replacing YaRN with standard RoPE under the same randomized sampling scheme also delivers notably worse results.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the position sampling procedure and length curriculum design in the method section, as well as the ablation results for individual component contributions. Directions worth further exploration include: how different position sampling distributions (uniform vs. alternatives) affect performance across task types, how the method combines with long-sequence continual pretraining, and the compatibility boundary between position interpolation methods and randomized position training.

recommendation.zh: 一种简单有效的长上下文扩展训练策略，通过随机化位置编码打破了短文本训练的局限，建议在长文本微调/持续预训练中尝试复现。
recommendation.en: A simple and effective long-context extension training strategy that breaks the limitations of short-text training via randomized positional encoding; recommended for reproduction in long-context fine-tuning/continual pretraining.

paper.title: Grouped Query Experts: Mixture-of-Experts on GQA Self-Attention
paper.abstract: Self-attention is central to Transformer performance and is often the most expensive part of the Transformer at long context lengths because its pairwise token interactions scale quadratically with sequence length. Standard dense attention also applies the same set of attention heads to every token regardless of token difficulty or information content. This uniform activation can waste compute, especially as sequences grow longer and attention cost increases rapidly. We propose Grouped Query Exp

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是长上下文 Transformer 中注意力计算的条件化问题：GQA 已经降低了 KV-cache 的内存和带宽成本，但仍然对每个 token 激活所有 query heads。作者希望把 MoE 的条件计算从 MLP 挪到注意力块里，让不同 token 只使用一部分 query-head experts，同时保持 GQA 的 KV 路径不变。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构和训练动态，而不是单纯推理加速。GQE 给出了一种较干净的 attention-side sparsity 设计：KV 仍然 dense，避免破坏 GQA 的缓存结构；只在 query-head 侧做 routing，减少长上下文下随序列长度增长的注意力计算。它的价值在于把“head 是否应该对所有 token 全量激活”这个问题具体化，并指出 sparse attention-head routing 需要可学习的 router 信号和稳定的 always-on head，否则容易退化。贡献量级目前偏探索性，实验规模为 250M 参数、30B tokens，还不足以说明大规模预训练时的 scaling 行为。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是在每个 GQA group 内放置多个 query-head experts。设总 query expert 数为 N，KV group 数为 G，则每组有 M=N/G 个 query experts；同组 experts 共享同一个 KV head，KV projection 和 KV cache 与普通 GQA 保持一致。每个 token、每个 group 都由 router 对该组 M 个 experts 打分，先做组内 softmax，再选 top-k。被选中的 expert 输出以 hard-concat 的形式进入后续投影，不做加权平均。为了解决 hard top-k 对 router 的梯度信号弱的问题，作者额外加入一个由 selected probabilities 重新归一化得到的 weighted-sum slot，让语言建模 loss 可以通过这个槽回传到 router。另有一个 always-on shared attention head，为所有 token 固定计算，用来稳定训练和兜底。以 16 query heads / 8 KV heads、k=1 为例，每个 token 选择 8 个 routed query experts，再加 1 个 shared head；weighted-sum slot 不额外计算新的 attention head，而是复用 selected expert outputs。最终输出投影 W_O 的输入槽数从 dense GQA 的 16 个 head slots 变为 10 个 slots，因此比较并非完全参数匹配，这是阅读时需要注意的实验边界。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的主要设置是 250M 参数模型，在固定 30B token 预算上训练。主实验中 GQE 在每个 token 上只激活一半 routed query-head experts；若把 shared head 算入实际 attention 计算，则相当于计算 9/16 个 query-attention heads。作者报告该设置在下游准确率上可以匹配全激活 GQA baseline，同时减少 self-attention 计算，并在长上下文场景中体现出速度收益。消融结论中较关键的一点是：仅做 hard routing 不够，router 需要 weighted-sum slot 提供可微学习信号；always-on shared head 对稳定性也重要。由于提供内容中没有完整表格和具体 benchmark 数字，不能判断不同上下文长度、不同模型规模和不同 k 值下的收益曲线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读方法部分和实验消融，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看三处：第一，GQE 如何嵌入 GQA group，尤其是 KV dense、query sparse 的边界；第二，hard-concat、weighted-sum slot、shared head 三者的分工，这决定了 router 是否能学到有效分配；第三，实验比较是否控制了参数量、FLOPs、KV-cache 和 W_O 形状。需要带着一个问题读：减少 query-side attention 是否真的成为长上下文瓶颈的有效切入点，还是收益主要来自小模型、小规模设置下的结构压缩。若要复现实验，应优先检查 routing 负载均衡、expert 使用分布、loss spike、以及不同 sequence length 下的吞吐曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies conditional computation inside the attention block. GQA already reduces KV-cache cost by sharing keys and values across query groups, but it still evaluates all query heads for every token. The proposed question is whether token-dependent routing can be applied to query heads, so that each token uses only a subset of attention-head experts while preserving the standard GQA KV path.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is architectural. GQE is a concrete attention-side sparsity design rather than an MLP MoE variant. It keeps KV heads dense and unchanged, which preserves the memory and serving advantages of GQA, and sparsifies only the query-head computation. This makes it a useful probe of whether all heads need to be uniformly active for all tokens. The result is still exploratory: the reported scale is 250M parameters and 30B training tokens, so it does not yet establish large-scale pretraining behavior or scaling trends.
summary_en.technical_approach: Within each GQA group, query heads are treated as experts. With N total query experts and G KV groups, each group contains M=N/G experts that attend to the same shared KV head. For each token and each group, a router scores the M experts, applies a group-wise softmax, and selects top-k experts. The selected expert outputs are concatenated as normal hard-routed head slots, not averaged. Because hard top-k gives a weak gradient path to the router, the method adds a router-supervised weighted-sum slot, computed by renormalizing the probabilities of selected experts and summing their outputs. It also adds an always-on shared attention head to stabilize training. In the 16-query-head / 8-KV-head setting with k=1, each token computes 8 routed query experts plus one shared head; the weighted-sum slot reuses selected outputs and does not add another attention computation. The final output projection receives 10 slots rather than the 16 slots of the dense baseline, so the comparison is not strictly parameter-matched in W_O.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiment trains 250M-parameter models for 30B tokens. In the primary configuration, GQE activates half of the routed query-head experts per token; including the always-on shared head, it computes 9 of 16 query-attention heads. The paper reports downstream accuracy comparable to the fully active GQA baseline while reducing self-attention compute, with measured speedups becoming more relevant for longer contexts. The ablations emphasized in the provided text are important: sparse query-head routing only matches the dense baseline when the router receives a useful differentiable learning signal through the weighted-sum slot, and the always-on shared head helps stabilize the layer. The provided content does not include full benchmark tables, so exact per-task gains and length-dependent throughput numbers cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim pass of 20–30 minutes is enough. Focus on the method section that defines routing inside GQA groups, the role of the weighted-sum slot, and the always-on shared head. Then check the experimental setup for parameter accounting, especially the resized output projection. The key technical question is whether query-side sparsity is a robust long-context efficiency lever or whether the observed gains depend on the small-scale setting and projection-size differences. For deeper follow-up, inspect expert utilization, router entropy, training loss stability, and throughput as a function of sequence length.

recommendation.zh: 将 MoE 引入 Attention Query 头的有趣尝试，在长文本场景下有降低计算量的潜力，值得关注其在更大规模模型上的表现。
recommendation.en: An interesting attempt to introduce MoE into Attention Query heads, showing potential for reducing computation in long-context scenarios; worth watching for its performance at larger scales.

paper.title: SpotAttention: Plug-In Block-Sparse Routing for Pretrained Long-Context Transformers
paper.abstract: Long contexts have become standard in pretrained LLMs, yet they remain expensive to run: prefill compute grows quadratically with sequence length, and every decode step re-reads a key-value cache that grows linearly with it. Sparse attention cuts these costs by attending only to a relevant subset of past tokens, but selecting that subset is itself expensive. We present SpotAttention, a lightweight selector that attaches to a frozen pretrained transformer and learns by KL distillation to estimate

summary.core_problem: 现有预训练长上下文LLM的稀疏注意力方案存在选择器计算开销高、无法即插即用适配已训练完成的主模型的问题。
summary.importance: 验证了无需修改预训练主模型结构、仅通过外挂轻量选择器加KL蒸馏即可实现高效稀疏注意力，为长上下文模型的推理优化提供了与预训练解耦的可行路径，也揭示了不同层注意力预算存在不对称性这一训练动态特征。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 设计即插即用的块级稀疏选择器，挂载在已冻结的预训练Transformer每一层全注意力层上，仅通过KL散度蒸馏匹配原模型的头平均注意力分布，无需重新训练主模型；2. 选择器采用块级Q-K评分（按查询块×键块而非逐token计算），可直接通过张量核矩阵乘实现，降低选择开销；3. 提出双top-p规则，直接从选择器输出的校准注意力分布中为每个查询、每层动态分配注意力预算，同时预留sink和近邻块避免被核采样过滤，无需额外剪枝阶段；4. 支持对选择器的K缓存做INT4/FP4量化进一步降低内存开销。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3（稠密注意力，4B-32B）和Qwen3.5（混合线性/全注意力，4B-9B）共7个backbone上完成选择器训练，其中5个完成完整验证；128K上下文解码场景下，Qwen3-8B的吞吐量是FlashAttention的3.9倍、是Twilight的1.8倍；选择器K缓存量化到INT4/FP4可缩小3.5倍体积且保持BF16级精度；在最长128K上下文下性能与稠密注意力持平；观测到不同层的注意力预算存在显著不对称性，静态top-K规则无法匹配该特征。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3节方法部分的双top-p规则设计、第4节的长上下文吞吐量与精度对比实验，附录中的选择器结构与训练策略消融实验；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing sparse attention solutions for pretrained long-context LLMs face two core bottlenecks: high computation overhead of the token selector, and lack of plug-and-play compatibility with fully trained backbone models.
summary_en.importance: Validates that efficient sparse attention can be achieved without modifying pretrained backbone architecture, via a lightweight add-on selector trained with KL distillation. This provides a pretraining-decoupled path for long-context inference optimization, and reveals notable inter-layer attention budget asymmetry as a previously underdiscussed training dynamic.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. A plug-in block-wise sparse selector is attached to each frozen full-attention layer of a pretrained Transformer, trained only via KL divergence to match the backbone's head-averaged attention distribution, with no retraining of the main model. 2. Block-wise Q-K scoring (per query-block × key-block tile instead of per-token) runs as a single tensor-core matrix multiplication, cutting selector overhead sharply. 3. A dual top-p rule directly allocates per-query, per-layer attention budgets from the selector's calibrated output distribution, with reserved sink and recency blocks to avoid exclusion by nucleus sampling and no separate pruning stage. 4. INT4/FP4 quantization of the selector's K-cache is supported for further memory reduction.
summary_en.experiments: Selector training completed on 7 backbones across two architecture families: Qwen3 (dense attention, 4B–32B) and Qwen3.5 (hybrid linear/full attention, 4B–9B), with full validation on 5 of them. For Qwen3-8B at 128K context decode, throughput reaches 3.9× FlashAttention and 1.8× Twilight. Quantizing the selector's K-cache to INT4/FP4 reduces its size by 3.5× while retaining BF16-level accuracy. Performance matches dense attention at contexts up to 128K; significant inter-layer attention budget asymmetry is observed, which static top-K rules cannot match.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (dual top-p rule design in the method pipeline), Section 4 (long-context throughput and accuracy comparison experiments), and ablation studies on selector structure and training strategy in the appendix; estimated reading time 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 §方法和长外推实验；若 128K 上真能稳住精度，内部长上下文服务应复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and length-extrapolation experiments; if 128K accuracy holds, this deserves an internal serving reproduction.

paper.title: DynamicMem: A Long-Horizon Memory Benchmark in Real-World Settings
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly act as personal assistants that must remember a user's profile over months: who they are (attributes), what they routinely do (habits), and what they prefer (preferences), and keep it updated as jobs, routines, and tastes drift. Existing benchmarks evaluate this "memory" ability through short, simplified interactions, missing three core properties of real behavior: the profile is heterogeneous, with attributes, habits, and preferences evolving on different timelines; chan

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“模型能不能从长上下文里找信息”这么简单，而是更接近真实个人助理场景的长期用户建模问题：用户画像由属性、习惯、偏好三类状态组成，它们变化速度不同，变化往往由季节、人生事件、环境切换等外部因素驱动，而且证据分散在跨应用、跨月份的大量细碎行为里。现有 memory benchmark 多半把历史压成短对话或独立事件列表，缺少跨 app 的因果连续性，也缺少随时间推移的覆盖式评测，因此很难判断一个 memory system 到底是检索失败、更新失败，还是只会记静态事实。
