summary.technical_approach: 提出 Dynamic Linear Attention。核心包括 Information-Aware Dynamic State Merging，根据 token-level information variation 动态决定状态边界，在语义变化处保留高分辨率表示，在稳定区域更激进地压缩；同时引入容量受限的记忆机制，避免状态数量无界增长。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型参数量、训练 token 数、baseline 列表和具体指标提升。可确认其评估对象是长上下文场景下的多状态 linear attention，与固定合并策略方法比较。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The Ohio State University、University of Michigan 和 ByteDance Seed。ByteDance Seed 近年持续投入大模型架构、长上下文和高效训练研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses error accumulation in multi-state linear attention caused by fixed state-merging policies that irreversibly blur important tokens over long contexts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an architecture-level method for long-context modeling. It targets a central pretraining tradeoff: sub-quadratic attention is attractive, but memory compression can destroy high-resolution representations at semantic transitions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dynamic Linear Attention introduces information-aware dynamic state merging, where state boundaries are chosen from token-level information variation. It preserves fine-grained memory near semantic changes and compresses stable regions more aggressively, with a capacity-bounded memory design to control state growth.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not give parameter counts, training tokens, baselines, or numeric gains. The intended comparison is against fixed-merging multi-state linear attention methods in long-context settings.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Ohio State University, University of Michigan, and ByteDance Seed. ByteDance Seed has active work on LLM architecture, long context, and efficient training.

recommendation.zh: 只看动态合并准则和长程误差曲线；若实验干净，应进 internal long-context attention ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the dynamic merging rule and long-range error curves; if the setup is clean, it belongs in internal long-context attention ablations.

paper.title: Continual LLM Upcycling: A Predictor-Gated Bank-Wise Sparsity Training Recipe for Dense-to-Sparse LLMs
paper.abstract: We study dense-to-sparse continual training as a way to construct channel-sparse large language models from dense checkpoints. Starting from a Qwen2.5-8B dense backbone, we continue training at 32K context and introduce a predictor-gated sparse SwiGLU FFN in the 32K stage. For each token and layer, we use a low-rank predictor to produce FFN-channel routing logits. We then apply a bank-wise top-k rule to retain 16 channels in every 64-channel bank, yielding 4x sparsity in the FFN intermediate act

summary.core_problem: 论文研究如何把一个 dense LLM 通过继续训练转换成 FFN channel 级稀疏模型，同时让稀疏 mask 在 FFN 主计算之前可用，从而有机会跳过 gate、up 和 down projection 中的无效通道计算。
summary.importance: 对预训练和继续预训练的启发在于，它把稀疏化从 post-hoc 压缩改成训练路径的一部分。许多 activation sparsity 方法需要先算出 FFN 激活再决定哪些通道重要，这对实际加速帮助有限，因为主要矩阵乘已经发生。这里的 predictor-gated 设计提前预测通道路由，更接近硬件可执行的条件计算。论文也给出两个有用的训练教训：channel-level routing 不能直接套用 MoE 的负载均衡经验；短上下文 benchmark 可能看不出长上下文稀疏路由的失败。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是在 SwiGLU FFN 前加入一个每层、逐 token 的低秩 predictor。对于隐藏状态 x，predictor 输出 FFN intermediate channel 的路由 logits，然后按固定 bank 做 top-k。具体配置中，模型 hidden size 为 4096，FFN intermediate dimension 为 14336。作者把 intermediate channels 分成 224 个 bank，每个 bank 64 个 channel，只保留 16 个，因此每个 token 每层激活 3584 个 intermediate channels，对 FFN 中间宽度形成 4 倍稀疏。predictor 是两层低秩模块，隐藏维度 448，并带有 bank-level affine calibration。前向使用 hard top-k 稀疏执行，反向用 soft surrogate gradient 让离散 mask 可训练。训练流程是 dense-to-sparse continual upcycling：基于 Qwen2.5-8B 规模 dense backbone，在长上下文阶段继续训练，并在 32K context 训练后期引入稀疏 FFN。
summary.experiments: 实验比较了三类模型：dense companion run、作者的 predictor-gated 4x sparse FFN 模型，以及基于 dense activation magnitude 的朴素 Dense-4x 稀疏基线。结果显示，predictor-gated 稀疏模型在一组通用 benchmark 上比 Dense-4x 更接近 dense baseline，说明路由器需要进入语言建模训练路径，而不是只作为训练后的剪枝规则。论文也强调稀疏 upcycling 不是无损的。作者观察到 MoE 风格的 balance bias 不容易迁移到 bank-wise channel routing。长上下文评测中，RULER-CWE 暴露出 12K 到 16K 附近的明显性能 cliff；通过 dense fallback 干预，作者把相当一部分问题定位到单层以及最后的 question-answer suffix。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 Methodology 中 predictor、bank-wise top-k 和 surrogate gradient 的定义，确认 mask 是否真的能在主 FFN 计算前产生。然后看训练 recipe，尤其是稀疏化插入 32K 继续训练阶段的时机。实验部分重点看 dense baseline、Dense-4x 和 predictor-gated sparse 的对比，以及 RULER-CWE 的长上下文失败分析。若关注系统落地，还需要检查论文是否提供专用 kernel 或硬件假设；没有相应 kernel 时，4x activation sparsity 不一定直接转化为端到端速度提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies dense-to-sparse continual upcycling for LLMs. The goal is to convert a dense model into a channel-sparse FFN model while producing the sparse mask before the main FFN computation, so inactive gate, up, and down channels can in principle be skipped.
summary_en.importance: The useful idea for pretraining and continual pretraining is to move sparsity into the language-modeling path rather than treating it as a post-training compression heuristic. Many activation-sparsity methods identify important channels only after dense FFN activations have already been computed, which limits actual acceleration. A predictor-gated router gives the mask early enough to be hardware-facing. The paper also reports two practical lessons: MoE-style balancing does not transfer cleanly to bank-wise channel routing, and broad short-context benchmarks can miss long-context failures introduced by sparse routing.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method adds a per-layer, token-wise low-rank predictor before the SwiGLU FFN. Given the hidden state, the predictor outputs routing logits over FFN intermediate channels. Channels are partitioned into fixed banks, and a top-k rule is applied within each bank. In the reported 8B-scale configuration, the hidden size is 4096 and the FFN intermediate dimension is 14336. The intermediate dimension is split into 224 banks of 64 channels, and 16 channels are retained per bank. This leaves 3584 active intermediate channels per token per layer, giving 4x sparsity in the FFN intermediate width. The predictor is a two-layer low-rank module with hidden size 448 and bank-level affine calibration. Forward execution uses a hard top-k sparse path, while training uses a soft surrogate gradient through the top-k boundary. The recipe starts from a Qwen2.5-8B-scale dense backbone, continues training at long context, and introduces the sparse FFN late in the 32K-context stage.
summary_en.experiments: The paper compares a dense companion run, the proposed predictor-gated 4x sparse FFN model, and a naive Dense-4x baseline based on dense activation magnitude. The predictor-gated model stays closer to the dense baseline than Dense-4x across a broad benchmark suite, supporting the claim that the router should be trained as part of the LM objective. The authors also emphasize that sparse upcycling is not lossless. A MoE-style balance bias is not directly effective for bank-wise channel routing. On long-context evaluation, RULER-CWE reveals a sharp failure around the 12K to 16K range that is mostly invisible in shorter-context evaluations. A dense fallback intervention partially localizes the issue to a single layer and the final question-answer suffix.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus first on the methodology defining the predictor, bank-wise top-k rule, and surrogate gradient, since the central question is whether the mask is available before the expensive FFN computation. Then read the training recipe to understand when sparsity is inserted during the 32K continual-training stage. In the experiments, prioritize the comparison against the dense companion and Dense-4x baseline, plus the RULER-CWE failure analysis. For systems relevance, check whether the paper provides specialized kernels or only an architecture-level sparsity pattern; without kernel support, 4x intermediate activation sparsity may not translate into end-to-end speedup.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是“持续训练把 dense 改造成主路径稀疏”这个 recipe，而不是稀疏率本身；重点读长上下文失效分析，可能直接影响你做 mid-train upcycling 的实验设计。
recommendation.en: What matters here is the recipe for turning a dense checkpoint into a main-path sparse model via continual training, not the sparsity number itself; read it for the long-context failure analysis if you do mid-train upcycling.

paper.title: Parallel Causal Associative Fields: Gated Sparse Memory for Long-Context Language Modeling
paper.abstract: Transformers achieve strong language modeling performance by providing direct token-to-token communication paths, but causal self-attention scales quadratically with context length. Recurrent and state-space models reduce this cost, yet compress history into sequentially updated fixed-size states. This paper studies a third primitive: a parallel content-addressed memory over causal successor records. The proposed Parallel Causal Associative Field (PCAF) writes local records from a context window

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：在长上下文语言建模里，如何保留类似 attention 的“按内容直接访问过去局部事件”的能力，同时避免全量 causal self-attention 的二次复杂度，也不把整段历史压进一个固定维状态里。作者把问题拆成两部分：一是如何找到可能相关的过去记录，二是如何把这些记录转成当前 token 的预测。PCAF 的出发点是把这两件事从标准 attention 里拆开，不再对所有历史 token 做稠密打分，而是先用离散或语义路由找到一个很小的候选集合，再只在这些候选上做连续打分和概率混合。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要有两层。第一，它提出的不是单纯的 attention 加速技巧，而是一种不同的序列建模原语：把“记忆寻址”和“值解析”分离，用稀疏联想记忆替代稠密 token-to-token 通信。这一点和常见的 sparse attention、linear attention、SSM 都不一样。第二，它把 neural cache / retrieval 的思路内生到单窗口自回归预训练里，而不是依赖外部检索库。这对长上下文 pretrain 很有启发，因为很多长程依赖并不一定需要全局 dense mixing，更像是对少量前文事件的命中式召回。量级上看，这篇工作更像是一个值得跟踪的新建模方向，而不是已经定型的主流替代方案；它的价值在于提出了清晰的设计分解，并给出 matched-scale 的全 AR 训练证据。
summary.technical_approach:
PCAF 由两条并行路径组成。第一条是 local parametric path，本质上是一个局部因果语言模型，负责学习可泛化的语法和语义规律；从引言和方法描述看，它承担短程组合与兜底预测。第二条是 associative memory path：模型把上下文窗口中的局部 predecessor→successor 记录写入一个按 route 组织的记忆表。对当前位置，先根据当前上下文构造 query，并通过 route 找到少量 bucket / 候选记录；再在这些候选上做 key-query 相似度计算，形成一个稀疏 cache distribution，最后把候选记录对应的 successor token 概率聚合起来。

关键设计有三个。其一，写入的不是原始 token embedding，而是“因果后继记录”，也就是某段上下文后面实际出现过什么 token。这样检索结果天然可以直接转成 next-token 分布，接近 neural cache 的形式。其二，路由分成两类：精确上下文哈希路由和 learned semantic routing。前者命中精度高、实现简单，但受表面形式限制；后者允许隐藏状态相近的上下文互相召回，用语义相似替代字面完全匹配。其三，最终输出不是硬切换，而是 parametric LM 分布与 cache 分布的 learned gate mixture。这个 gate 让模型在“检索可靠时偏向记忆、检索不可靠时回退到参数化泛化”之间自适应权衡。

和标准 attention 相比，PCAF 不对所有历史 token 做值读取；和 SSM / RNN 相比，它不要求把全部历史压缩进单一状态；和外部 retrieval LM 相比，它不依赖额外语料库或 ANN 索引，而是在单个上下文窗口内构造并读取联想记忆。作者强调 bounded top-K retrieval，这意味着计算量由候选数而不是前缀长度主导，是它区别于 dense attention 的核心。
summary.experiments:
论文的主实验是在全自回归预训练设定下进行，而不是只做合成任务或 next-token 诊断。数据集是 WikiText-103 和 PG-19。主模型规模约 303M 参数，并与 matched dense Transformer 和 local attention baseline 对比。作者报告 PCAF 在这两个数据集上都取得更低 perplexity，同时在 TPU v4-32 pod 上有更高的 tokens/s。这个结果说明它不是单纯用更多工程技巧换吞吐，而是在相近规模下同时拿到质量和效率收益。

此外还有约 41M 参数的多随机种子实验，用来隔离几个关键因素：路由方式、cache 容量、以及 mixture gate 的作用。引言已经给出这些是作者重点分析的变量。按方法逻辑，预期结论应包括：1）没有 gate 时，cache 容易在低置信检索下污染预测；2）exact hash routing 在重复模式强、表面形式稳定的场景更有效；3）semantic routing 能缓解 exact match 的脆弱性，但也会引入更高的误召回风险；4）cache 容量和 top-K 存在收益递减。文中还给了 RTX 3060 profiling，说明作者不仅看理论复杂度，也检查了实际硬件效率，这对判断这类新原语是否有工程落地空间很重要。

可惜给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，因此没法逐项复述具体 PPL 和吞吐值；但可以确认的硬指标是：主模型约 303M，控制实验约 41M，训练语料包括 WikiText-103 与 PG-19，硬件包括 TPU v4-32 和 RTX 3060，评价重点是 perplexity 与处理速度。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三件事。第一，看方法图和 memory write/read 的正式定义，确认“记录”到底由哪些字段组成，route、key、value 分别是什么，cache probability 如何从候选记录聚合成词表分布。第二，看 gate 的参数化方式和训练方式。这里决定了模型是在做简单插值，还是能根据上下文动态判断检索可靠性。第三，看实验里 exact hash routing 与 semantic routing 的对比，因为这部分最能说明作者提出的“寻址与解析分离”是否真的带来新的能力，而不是换一种 cache 实现。

建议重点看 Introduction、Method 中关于 write/read pipeline 的小节，以及实验中的 ablation tables。若时间有限，先看主结果表、routing ablation、gate ablation、capacity/top-K ablation，再看硬件 profiling。预计 30–45 分钟可以建立整体判断；如果要深挖，值得进一步检查它的 memory 构造是否会带来训练/推理不一致、bucket 冲突如何处理、以及这种设计在更大规模语料和更长上下文下是否仍稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific gap in long-context language modeling: how to preserve direct, content-based access to relevant past events without paying the quadratic cost of causal self-attention, and without collapsing the entire prefix into a single recurrent state. The authors separate two functions that are entangled in standard attention: locating potentially useful past records, and resolving them into a next-token prediction. PCAF replaces dense all-prefix scoring with a two-stage mechanism: bounded routing to a small candidate set, followed by continuous scoring only within that set.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining research is not just efficiency. The more important point is that it proposes a different sequence-modeling primitive. Sparse attention still defines a restricted communication graph; linear attention approximates dense attention; state-space models compress history into a fixed-dimensional evolving state. PCAF instead treats long-range modeling as sparse associative recall over causal records, mixed with a local parametric LM. That makes it relevant to long-context pretraining, neural cache ideas, and retrieval-style modeling inside a single training window. The contribution is best read as a credible architectural direction with matched-scale autoregressive evidence, rather than a settled replacement for Transformers.
summary_en.technical_approach:
PCAF has two parallel paths. The first is a local parametric causal LM that handles short-range composition and generalization. The second is an associative memory path that stores local causal successor records extracted from the context window. At inference for a position t, the model forms a query from the current context, uses a route to retrieve a bounded set of candidate records from hash buckets or learned semantic partitions, scores only those candidates with a key-query similarity, and converts the retrieved records into a sparse cache distribution over successor tokens.

Three design choices matter. First, the memory stores successor records rather than generic hidden states. This means retrieval directly produces evidence about what token followed a similar context before, making the memory path behave like an internal neural cache. Second, routing comes in two forms: exact context-hash routing and learned semantic routing. Exact routing is precise and cheap but brittle to surface-form mismatch; semantic routing allows hidden-state-near contexts to retrieve one another. Third, the final prediction is a learned mixture between the parametric LM distribution and the cache distribution. The gate lets the model rely on retrieval when the memory hit is informative, and fall back to the parametric path when retrieval is noisy or absent.

Relative to standard attention, PCAF does not compare against every previous token. Relative to recurrent or SSM-style models, it does not force all history through a single compressed state. Relative to external retrieval LMs, it keeps memory construction and access inside the current context window, with bounded top-K retrieval as the main complexity control.
summary_en.experiments:
The main evaluation is full autoregressive pretraining rather than synthetic recall tasks. The reported datasets are WikiText-103 and PG-19. The main model is about 303M parameters, compared against matched dense Transformer and local-attention baselines. The paper reports lower perplexity for PCAF on both datasets, together with higher token throughput on a TPU v4-32 pod. That combination is important: the method is not presented as a pure systems tradeoff, but as a modeling change that improves quality at similar scale while also reducing effective compute.

The paper also includes smaller 41M-parameter multi-seed studies to isolate the effects of routing, cache capacity, and the learned gate. From the setup, these ablations are the right ones to inspect: whether the gate is necessary to prevent harmful retrieval, how exact routing compares with semantic routing, and how much benefit remains once top-K and memory capacity are varied. There is also RTX 3060 profiling, which is useful because many long-context alternatives look attractive in asymptotic terms but fail to translate into practical throughput.

The full numeric tables are not available in the provided excerpt, so I cannot safely restate exact perplexity or throughput values. The confirmed experimental anchors are: ~303M main models, ~41M controlled models, WikiText-103 and PG-19 for AR pretraining, and hardware measurements on TPU v4-32 and RTX 3060.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three things. First, inspect the formal write/read definition in the method section: what exactly is stored in each record, what the route/key/value are, and how candidate records are aggregated into a vocabulary distribution. Second, check how the gate is parameterized and trained, because that determines whether the model can estimate retrieval reliability rather than just interpolate with a fixed coefficient. Third, read the routing ablations carefully. The exact-hash versus semantic-routing comparison is where the paper either justifies the new primitive or collapses into a cache implementation detail.

A practical reading order is: introduction, the method subsection defining the associative memory pipeline, the main perplexity/throughput table, then the routing/gate/capacity ablations, and finally the hardware profiling. Around 30–45 minutes should be enough for a solid skim. If reading more deeply, pay attention to bucket collisions, train–test consistency of memory construction, and whether the gains are likely to survive at larger scales and much longer contexts.

recommendation.zh: 只看记忆写入/检索设计和gate消融；小数据小模型不改prior，但可作为attention替代原语备查。
recommendation.en: Read the write/retrieve design and gate ablations; the scale is too small to change priors, but it is a useful attention-alternative primitive.

paper.title: Blurry Window Attention
paper.abstract: The Softmax Attention operation in Transformer language models has a quadratic complexity in the sequence length and a growing state size in the form of KV cache, which becomes a bottleneck in long context scenarios. To overcome this limitation, alternative architectures with linear complexity and finite state size have been introduced, such as State-Space Models (SSMs), Linear Attention (LA), and Attention with Bounded-memory Control (ABC). Though linear models achieve similar language perplexi

summary.core_problem: 长上下文语言模型需要降低注意力的二次复杂度和不断增长的 KV cache，但现有线性模型在需要精确召回的任务上常弱于 softmax attention；BLA 试图在有限状态预算下保留一部分可检索的历史信息。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的启发点在于把 SWA 的“时间窗口”改写成一个频域压缩状态。它不是常见的 linear attention 外积记忆，也不是简单丢弃窗口外 token，而是用有限 Fourier mode 保存一段历史的模糊重建。对预训练研究的意义主要在架构方向：如果这类有限状态 attention 能在真实 LM 训练中保持困惑度和召回能力，就可能成为长上下文模型中介于 SWA、SSM、linear attention 之间的组件。当前证据仍偏早期，主要来自合成召回任务，还不能说明大规模语言预训练中的稳定收益。
summary.technical_approach: BLA 的核心做法是维护 key 和 value 的分离状态，而不是像 linear attention 那样存储 key-value 外积。写入时，新的 key 和 value 会分别乘到一组 Fourier 基上并累积，相当于在有限频率集合中保存历史序列的低频表示。读取时，通过 Dirichlet kernel 或类似插值方式从频域状态中重建一个“模糊”的时间域 KV 窗口，然后用当前 query 对这些重建的 key/value 做 softmax attention。这样做保留了 softmax attention 的匹配形式，但把存储从精确 KV 序列改成固定大小的频域摘要。与 SWA 相比，它不只记最近 w 个精确 token，而是用同等或更小状态覆盖更长历史；与 ABC/GSA 相比，它的写入机制更接近对窗口的频域泛化；与 SSM 相比，它仍显式构造可被 query 检索的 key/value 结构。
summary.experiments: 给出的实验重点是 recall-intensive synthetic tasks。作者报告 BLA 相比 SWA 有约 8× 的状态效率优势，即在相近召回表现下需要更小状态。MQAR 上，BLA 接近一些流行线性模型；RegBench 上，BLA 的表现接近 full attention，而 Gated Linear Attention 和 Gated DeltaNet 在该设定下明显不足。小状态预算下，BLA 优于 SWA。需要注意的是，提供的正文没有显示大规模 LM 预训练、真实长文档困惑度、下游长上下文 QA 或推理 benchmark 的完整结果，因此实验结论更适合作为架构可行性信号，而不是完整训练 recipe 依据。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分中频域状态的写入、插值重建和读取公式，确认它的复杂度、状态大小和是否支持高效并行训练。实验部分重点看 MQAR、RegBench 的状态预算曲线，而不是只看单点指标。值得深挖的问题有三个：频率数量和窗口周期如何选；模糊重建对精确 key matching 的破坏有多大；在多层 LM 中是否需要和局部 SWA 或少量 full attention 混合使用。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context LMs need to reduce quadratic attention cost and the growing KV cache, but existing finite-state or linear-time alternatives often lose on exact recall. BLA targets this gap by storing a compressed, query-addressable history.
summary_en.importance: The useful idea is a frequency-domain version of a sliding KV window. Instead of dropping old tokens as in SWA or storing key-value outer products as in linear attention, BLA keeps a fixed-size spectral summary from which a blurred KV history can be reconstructed. For pretraining research, this is an architecture probe for long-context models: it may offer a middle ground between local attention, SSM-style memory, and softmax retrieval. The current evidence is still preliminary because the reported results are mainly on synthetic recall benchmarks rather than large-scale LM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: BLA maintains separate key and value states. Incoming keys and values are independently accumulated against a finite set of Fourier modes, similar in spirit to diagonal SSM representations such as S4D. At read time, the model interpolates these spectral states back into a lossy time-domain KV window using Dirichlet-kernel-style reconstruction, then applies standard softmax attention from the current query to the reconstructed keys and values. This preserves the softmax matching operation while replacing the exact KV buffer with a fixed-size compressed state. Compared with SWA, it trades exact recent memory for a longer blurred history. Compared with ABC or GSA, the write mechanism is a frequency-window generalization rather than a learned slot update. Compared with SSMs, it still exposes key/value-like objects to the query.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation focuses on recall-heavy synthetic tasks. The authors report about 8× better state efficiency than SWA. On MQAR, BLA approaches popular linear models. On RegBench, it reaches performance close to full attention, while GLA and Gated DeltaNet lag in the reported setting. Under small state budgets, BLA outperforms SWA. The provided content does not show large-scale language-model pretraining, real long-document perplexity, or downstream long-context QA results, so the experiments should be read as an architectural feasibility check rather than a complete recipe for replacing attention in LLMs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the equations for spectral writing, time-domain interpolation, and query-time softmax reading. Then check the state-size and complexity analysis. In the experiments, read the MQAR and RegBench curves as a function of memory budget rather than isolated scores. The main questions to keep in mind are how the number of Fourier modes is chosen, how much exact retrieval is lost during interpolation, and whether BLA needs to be mixed with local or occasional full attention layers in real LMs.

recommendation.zh: ABC 家族的一个新变体，核心看点是用 Dirichlet 核在频域做插值重建 KV；对做长上下文推理/有界记忆注意力的人值得看 §3 的推导。
recommendation.en: A new ABC-family variant; the key idea is frequency-domain KV reconstruction via Dirichlet-kernel interpolation. Worth reading §3 if you work on bounded-memory attention for long-context inference.

paper.title: Express Language Modeling
paper.abstract: We introduce a new tool, Express, for converting a non-causal attention approximation into a causal approximation with matching approximation guarantees. When combined with the state-of-the-art Thinformer approximation, Express improves upon the best known causal attention guarantees, delivering $\log^{3/2}(n)/s$ approximation error with only $O(s)$ memory and $O(s^2 \log^2(n))$ compression overhead for a sequence of length $n$. We pair these developments with an efficient I/O-aware Triton imple

summary.core_problem: 解决非因果 attention 近似难以直接用于自回归语言模型的问题，并把理论保证转化为长上下文预填充、KV cache 压缩和长文本解码中的实际加速。
summary.importance: 这是高效长上下文语言建模和推理系统工作，贡献类型是算法转换工具加工程实现。对预训练研究员有用的点在于：它把 attention 近似的理论误差、显存占用和 I/O-aware kernel 放到同一个语言建模 pipeline 中评估，而不是只报告单个算子的速度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Express，将非因果 attention approximation 转换为因果 approximation，并保持相匹配的近似保证。与 Thinformer 结合后，给出长度 n、压缩参数 s 下的因果 attention 误差界：log^{3/2}(n)/s，同时只需 O(s) memory 和 O(s^2 log^2(n)) compression overhead。论文还实现了 I/O-aware Triton kernel，并把方法用于四个瓶颈：long-context prefill、KV cache compression、memory-constrained decoding 和 compute-constrained decoding。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 Express 的 Triton 实现在若干语言建模 pipeline 场景中相对 FlashAttention 2 有明显加速，并覆盖长上下文预填充、KV cache 压缩和两类长文本受限解码设置。摘要未给出具体模型参数量、上下文长度、数据集和精确加速倍数。
summary.authors_note: Lester Mackey 是知名机器学习研究者，长期做可扩展统计学习、核方法、压缩和高效算法相关工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the gap between non-causal attention approximations and causal autoregressive language modeling, then applies the resulting approximation to long-context prefill, KV-cache compression, and long-form decoding.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficient long-context language modeling and inference-systems contribution: an algorithmic conversion tool paired with a practical implementation. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is that it connects approximation error, memory, and I/O-aware kernels inside the LM pipeline rather than benchmarking an isolated operator.
summary_en.technical_approach: Express converts a non-causal attention approximation into a causal approximation with matching guarantees. Combined with Thinformer, it gives a causal attention error bound of log^{3/2}(n)/s for sequence length n and compression size s, using O(s) memory and O(s^2 log^2(n)) compression overhead. The paper also provides an I/O-aware Triton implementation and applies it to four bottlenecks: long-context prefill, KV-cache compression, memory-constrained decoding, and compute-constrained decoding.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports substantial speedups over FlashAttention 2 across several language-modeling pipeline settings, including long-context prefill, KV-cache compression, and two long-form decoding regimes. It does not provide the concrete model sizes, context lengths, datasets, or exact speedup factors in the excerpt.
summary_en.authors_note: Lester Mackey is a well-known machine learning researcher with substantial work on scalable statistical learning, kernel methods, compression, and efficient algorithms.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 theorem 和 Triton 实验表；它不改 LM 目标，但可能改变长上下文 prefill 与 KV 压缩的默认实现选择。
recommendation.en: Read the theorem and Triton tables; it does not change the LM objective, but it may change default choices for long-context prefill and KV compression.

paper.title: Kwai Keye-VL-2.0 Technical Report
paper.abstract: We introduce Kwai Keye-VL-2.0-30B-A3B, an open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) multimodal foundation model designed to advance long-video understanding and agentic intelligence. To address the challenges of ultra-long contexts, information redundancy, and prohibitive computational costs inherent in hour-level videos, Keye-VL-2.0 is the first to adapt DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) to GQA-based multimodal architectures, enabling lossless 256K context processing while capturing critical frames an

summary.core_problem: 论文从短视频理解扩展到长视频理解和 Agent 能力时遇到两个核心瓶颈：(1) 小时级视频的 256K 超长上下文导致 KV cache 爆炸式增长和计算墙，现有模型被迫通过大幅帧采样牺牲时间连续性；(2) 多模态对齐与工具使用能力的联合训练会引发灾难性遗忘，导致基础 STEM / 数学 / 语言推理能力退化。
summary.importance: 这是首个将 DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) 适配到 GQA 多模态架构的工作，证明稀疏注意力可以无损处理 256K 视频上下文；提出的 Cross-Modal MOPD 蒸馏方案有效解决了多模态与基础推理能力的模态冲突。对长视频 VLM 预训练和多模态 MoE 具有参考价值。30B MoE 仅 3B 激活参数，部署效率高，是开源社区有竞争力的长视频 VLM 方案。
summary.technical_approach: 模型为 30B 参数 MoE 多模态基座（仅 3B 激活参数），基于 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking LLM + Keye-VL-1.5 ViT。核心创新两点：(1) Multimodal DSA：将 DeepSeek V3 的稀疏注意力扩展到视觉领域，与 GQA 兼容，结合全局 MQA 索引和分组 GQA 聚合，通过压缩和稀疏化视频特征聚合约束 KV cache 线性增长，实现 256K 无损上下文；(2) Cross-Modal MOPD（Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation）：采用多教师模型在策略滚动中对不同模态和任务的学生生成轨迹提供逐 token 稠密反馈，隔离任务特有知识再蒸馏回统一 MoE 骨干，避免端到端联合优化的不稳定性。后续进一步用 Context-RL 和 Video-RL（带桶优势缩放）稳定长序列决策树并减少视觉幻觉。训练基础设施包括可扩展视频 I/O、异构 ViT-LM 并行、定制 DSA 内核。
summary.experiments: 在 TimeLens benchmark（ActivityNet、QVHighlights、Charades）的细粒度时间定位上取得顶级成绩，在多个时间定位设置上显著超过 Gemini-3-Flash；在 Video-MME-v2 和 LongVideoBench 等超长上下文评测上表现出非线性能力提升，证明处理大量时序信息的鲁棒性。同时在 Code / Tool Use / Web Search 等原生 Agent 能力上大幅提升，而基础推理基线保持完好。
summary.reading_guide: 精读 Introduction 中关于 DSA 适配到视觉模态的动机分析（为什么标准注意力在长视频中失效）和 MOPD 解决灾难性遗忘的思路；Architecture 章节的 GQA-compatible DSA 设计细节（全局 MQA 索引 + 分组 GQA 聚合）是核心创新；Training 和 Post-training 章节的 MOPD 动态路由机制和 Context-RL / Video-RL 的桶优势缩放值得关注；图 1 的整体性能对比。大约 30-45 分钟精读技术核心。
summary.authors_note: 快手 Kuaishou Keye-VL 团队（Kwai），继 Keye-VL 和 Keye-VL-1.5 之后的迭代工作。

summary_en.core_problem: Two core bottlenecks emerge when scaling from short-video to long-video understanding and agentic capabilities: (1) 256K extreme context from hour-long videos causes catastrophic KV cache expansion and computational walls, forcing existing models to sacrifice temporal continuity via aggressive frame subsampling; (2) joint training of multimodal alignment and tool-use capabilities induces catastrophic forgetting, degrading foundational STEM, mathematical, and linguistic reasoning.
summary_en.importance: First work to adapt DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) to GQA-based multimodal architectures, demonstrating that sparse attention enables lossless 256K video context processing. The proposed Cross-Modal MOPD effectively resolves the modality conflict between multimodal skills and base reasoning. Valuable reference for long-video VLM pretraining and multimodal MoE design. With 30B total params and only 3B active, it offers strong deployment efficiency and is a competitive open-source long-video VLM.
summary_en.technical_approach: 30B-parameter MoE multimodal foundation (3B active), built on Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking LLM + Keye-VL-1.5 ViT. Two core innovations: (1) Multimodal DSA: extends DeepSeek V3 sparse attention to the visual domain, GQA-compatible, combining global MQA-based indexing with grouped GQA aggregation; compresses and sparsifies video feature aggregation to bound linear KV cache growth, enabling lossless 256K context. (2) Cross-Modal MOPD (Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation): uses specialized teacher models to provide dense token-level feedback on student-generated trajectories across modalities and tasks during on-policy rollouts; isolates task-specific expertise then distills it back into the unified MoE backbone, avoiding instability of end-to-end co-optimization. Post-training further applies Context-RL and Video-RL with bucket advantage scaling to stabilize long-sequence decision trees and reduce visual hallucinations. Infrastructure includes scalable video I/O, heterogeneous ViT-LM parallelism, and custom DSA kernels.
summary_en.experiments: Top-tier results on TimeLens benchmarks (ActivityNet, QVHighlights, Charades) for fine-grained temporal localization, substantially outperforming Gemini-3-Flash on several temporal grounding settings. Non-linear capability scale-up on Video-MME-v2 and LongVideoBench, demonstrating robustness for extensive temporal information. Simultaneously achieves large gains on native agent capabilities (Code, Tool Use, Web Search) while preserving general-purpose reasoning baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the Introduction for the motivation on why standard attention fails in long video and how MOPD addresses catastrophic forgetting. The Architecture section on GQA-compatible DSA design (global MQA indexing + grouped GQA aggregation) is the core innovation. Pay close attention to the MOPD dynamic routing mechanism and bucket advantage scaling in Context-RL / Video-RL under the Training and Post-training sections. Study Figure 1 for the overall performance landscape. Estimated 30-45 min for a deep technical read.
summary_en.authors_note: Kuaishou Keye-VL team (Kwai). Iterative work following Keye-VL and Keye-VL-1.5.

recommendation.zh: DSA 稀疏注意力适配到 GQA 多模态 + 256K 长视频 + MOPD 对齐这一组合值得立刻跟进，重点看 DSA kernel 与多教师 on-policy 蒸馏如何缓解遗忘。
recommendation.en: The combination of DSA sparse attention on GQA multimodal, 256K long-video support, and MOPD alignment is worth immediate follow-up—focus on the DSA kernel details and how multi-teacher on-policy distillation mitigates forgetting.

paper.title: Less Context, More Accuracy: A Bi-Temporal Memory Engine for LLM Agents Where a Lean Retrieved Context Beats the Full History
paper.abstract: Long-term memory is the missing layer for LLM agents: across sessions they forget, and the common workaround -- replaying the whole history into the prompt -- is expensive, slow, and, as distractors accumulate, less accurate. Most memory systems win on cost or latency but still lose to the full-context baseline on accuracy, and benchmark numbers are reported on inconsistent, non-reproducible harnesses, so one system appears at wildly different scores across sources. We present Engram, an open-so

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM Agent 跨会话记忆中，全量历史上下文昂贵、缓慢且容易被累积干扰项降低准确率的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 记忆系统设计：主张经过检索和时态约束的精简上下文可以超过 full-history baseline，但与基座预训练方法关联较弱。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Engram，一个开源双过程记忆引擎。快速写路径无 LLM 调用地追加无损 episode；异步路径抽取原子三元组事实，构建 bi-temporal knowledge graph，并通过失效而非删除来处理矛盾，保留 provenance 和 supersession chain；读路径融合 dense、lexical、graph、recency/salience 信号，并支持 point-in-time 检索。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调其精简检索上下文可击败全历史上下文，并指出现有 memory benchmark harness 不一致；未给出具体数据集、模型、baseline 数值和提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Independent Researcher。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles long-term memory for LLM agents, where replaying full history is costly, slow, and increasingly harmed by distractors.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent memory-system design: it argues that a temporally constrained retrieved context can outperform the full-history baseline, though the connection to base-model pretraining is weak.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes Engram, an open-source dual-process memory engine. A fast write path appends lossless episodes without an LLM call; an asynchronous path extracts atomic subject-predicate-object facts, builds a bi-temporal knowledge graph, and handles contradictions by invalidating rather than deleting facts while preserving provenance and supersession chains; the read path fuses dense, lexical, graph, and recency/salience signals with point-in-time retrieval.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims that lean retrieved context can beat full history and notes inconsistent memory benchmark harnesses, but it does not provide concrete datasets, model configurations, baseline numbers, or gain sizes.
summary_en.authors_note: Independent Researcher.

recommendation.zh: 看系统图和 full-history 对比即可；若评测干净，它支持“长上下文不是记忆上限”的工程 prior。
recommendation.en: Skim the system diagram and full-history comparison; if the evaluation is clean, it supports the engineering prior that long context is not the ceiling for memory.

paper.title: Q-Delta: Beyond Key-Value Associative State Evolution
paper.abstract: Linear attention reformulates sequence modeling as recurrent state evolution, enabling efficient linear-time inference. Under the key-value associative paradigm, existing approaches restrict the role of the query to the readout operation, decoupling it from state evolution. We show that query-conditioned state readout induces a structured value prediction over accumulated memory that complements key-based retrieval. Based on this insight, we propose Q-Delta, a query-aware delta rule that integra

summary.core_problem: 解决线性注意力/状态空间式序列模型中，query 只参与读出而不参与状态演化，导致记忆更新表达力受限的问题。
summary.importance: 这是序列建模架构层的改进，贡献点在于修正 key-value associative state evolution 的设计假设，并给出稳定性分析与高效实现；对替代 Transformer 注意力的长期路线有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Q-Delta，把 query-conditioned state readout 引入 delta-rule 状态更新，用混合 key-query prediction error 共同驱动状态演化。方法上既保留 delta-rule 的线性时间效率，又让 query 参与纠错式更新；同时给出稳定性保证、chunkwise parallel 形式和 Triton 实现。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明在语言建模和长上下文检索任务上，相比强基线取得稳定优化、较高吞吐和一致提升，但未在摘要中披露参数量、训练 token 数和具体提升幅度。若正文实验干净，这类结果对线性 attention 替代路线是有效信号。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses a limitation in linear-attention/state-evolution sequence models where the query only participates in readout, not in state evolution, restricting memory-update expressivity.
summary_en.importance: This is an architectural contribution for sequence modeling. It revisits the key-value associative assumption, adds stability analysis, and provides an efficient implementation—useful if you track alternatives to standard Transformer attention.
summary_en.technical_approach: Q-Delta introduces a query-aware delta rule: query-conditioned readout is used to form mixed key-query prediction errors that drive state evolution. The design keeps delta-rule efficiency while allowing query-dependent corrective updates, and it comes with stability guarantees, chunkwise parallelization, and a Triton kernel.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims stable optimization, competitive throughput, and consistent gains over strong baselines on language modeling and long-context retrieval, but does not expose parameter counts, token budgets, or exact margins. If the full setup is clean, this is a meaningful signal for linear-attention alternatives.

recommendation.zh: 线性 attention 里少见的有机制增量：它动的是 state update 而不是读出花活。先看稳定性推导和长上下文表，若 setup 干净，值得进内部替代注意力 ablation。
recommendation.en: A rare linear-attention paper that changes the state update rather than just decorating the readout; read the stability section and long-context tables first, and replicate if the setup is clean.

paper.title: FlashMemory-DeepSeek-V4: Lightning Index Ultra-Long Context via Lookahead Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Conventional LLMs keep the full KV cache loaded during decoding, causing a severe GPU memory bottleneck for ultra-long context serving. In this report, we propose Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA), a novel inference paradigm powered by a Neural Memory Indexer built upon the DeepSeek-V4 architecture. Rather than passively attending to all historical tokens, LSA proactively predicts future context demands and preserves only the query-critical KV chunks in the GPU memory. Crucially, we instantiate t

summary.core_problem: 传统LLM解码时需加载全部KV cache，超长上下文推理时GPU内存瓶颈严重。
summary.importance: 范式级创新：提出Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA)，由Neural Memory Indexer主动预测未来上下文需求，仅保留关键KV chunk在GPU内存中。
summary.technical_approach: LSA采用backbone-free解耦训练策略：将indexer建模为标准dual-encoder架构，独立于LLM backbone单独训练（用标准检索训练框架，无需加载大模型。在DeepSeek-V4架构上实例化。
summary.experiments: 在主要长上下文评测套件上验证了效率显著提升（未见完整数据（abstract被截断）。声称显著提升serving效率并同时作为attention denoiser。
summary.authors_note: DeepSeek团队。这是继DeepSeek-V4架构的FlashMemory技术报告。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional LLMs keep the full KV cache loaded during decoding, causing severe GPU memory bottlenecks for ultra-long context serving.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm-level innovation: Lookahead Sparse Attention (LSA) proactively predicts future context demands and retains only query-critical KV chunks in GPU memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: LSA uses a backbone-free decoupled training strategy: the indexer is formulated as a standard dual-encoder architecture, trained independently using standard retrieval frameworks without loading the massive backbone model. Instantiated on DeepSeek-V4.
summary_en.experiments: Significant improvements on major long-context evaluation suites (results truncated). Claims both serving efficiency and acts as attention denoiser.
summary_en.authors_note: DeepSeek team; this is the FlashMemory technical report for DeepSeek-V4.

recommendation.zh: 改变我对长上下文推理的认知——用独立dual-encoder indexer预测未来KV需求，backbone-free训练策略极具工程启发性，应立刻在内部ablation中复现核心思路。
recommendation.en: Changes my view on long-context inference: a standalone dual-encoder indexer predicting future KV needs with backbone-free training is highly engineerable; should reproduce core idea in internal ablations immediately.

paper.title: How Much Dense Attention is Necessary? Oracle-Guided Sparse Prefill for Full/GQA Layers in Hybrid Long-Context Models
paper.abstract: Long-context prefill remains expensive because full/GQA layers still score the historical sequence, even in hybrid models with local, sparse, linear, or recurrent components. We study how much dense attention is needed to preserve task-level behavior under explicit support granularity and top-k budgets.   We introduce an attention-mass top-k oracle for existing GQA checkpoints: for each layer and query position, it computes dense attention, selects head-averaged token support, and recomputes att

summary.core_problem: 在长上下文混合模型中，全注意力层或 GQA 层仍需对历史序列进行评分，导致 prefill 阶段计算成本高昂。本文探究了在显式支持粒度和 top-k 预算下，保留任务级行为究竟需要多少密集注意力。
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于注意力质量的 top-k oracle 方法，用于诊断和分离稀疏预算的可行性与索引器误差及运行时实现效应，为长上下文 prefill 的稀疏化提供了理论上限和诊断工具。
summary.technical_approach: 引入了一个 attention-mass top-k oracle，针对现有 GQA 检查点，计算密集注意力，选择 head-averaged token support，并仅在该 support 上重新计算注意力。基于该 oracle 的指导，通过 KL 蒸馏训练了一个 head-collapsed 辅助索引器。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen 系列模型的检索密集型评估中，最长的 per-query oracle 行与密集注意力的差距在 1 分以内；Qwen3.5-9B 在 RULER 风格的 4K 到 100K 扫描中，差距在 0.48 分以内。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context prefill remains expensive because full/GQA layers still score the historical sequence. This paper investigates how much dense attention is necessary to preserve task-level behavior under explicit support granularity and top-k budgets.
summary_en.importance: Introduces an attention-mass top-k oracle to diagnose and separate sparse-budget feasibility from indexer error and runtime realization effects, providing a theoretical upper bound and diagnostic tool for sparsifying long-context prefill.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces an attention-mass top-k oracle for existing GQA checkpoints that computes dense attention, selects head-averaged token support, and recomputes attention only on that support. Guided by this oracle, a head-collapsed auxiliary indexer is derived and trained via KL distillation.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen-family retrieval-heavy evaluations, the longest per-query oracle rows stay within 1 point of dense attention. A Qwen3.5-9B RULER-style sweep from 4K to 100K stays within 0.48 points.

recommendation.zh: 用 oracle 测出了长上下文 prefill 稀疏化的理论上限，证明了极度稀疏的注意力足以维持检索性能，对设计高效长文本架构很有启发。
recommendation.en: Establishes the theoretical upper bound for sparsifying long-context prefill using an oracle, proving that extremely sparse attention suffices for retrieval tasks; highly insightful for designing efficient long-context architectures.

paper.title: From Rigid to Dynamic: Entropy-Guided Adaptive Inference for Long-Context LLMs
paper.abstract: Existing sparse attention and KV cache compression methods for long-context LLM inference typically apply fixed sparsity patterns or uniform budgets across all attention heads, overlooking the substantial variation in attention behavior among heads and contexts. We observe two distinct entropy patterns among attention heads: Rigid Heads, whose entropy stays near zero across input segments, and Dynamic Heads, whose entropy fluctuates significantly. Crucially, the distribution of these types is co

summary.core_problem: 长上下文 LLM 推理中，固定稀疏注意力模式和统一 KV cache 预算没有利用不同 attention head、不同上下文片段之间的行为差异。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理效率方法创新。它把注意力熵作为在线信号，用来区分更稳定的 head 和更依赖上下文的 head，对长上下文 prefill 与 decode 阶段分别做自适应计算分配和 KV 保留。这类工作不直接改预训练，但会影响长上下文训练目标与推理时真实瓶颈的判断。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EntropyInfer，一个 training-free 框架。prefill 阶段按 head 和 segment 粒度计算 attention entropy，把低熵、行为稳定的 Rigid Heads 与熵波动明显的 Dynamic Heads 区分开，并动态分配计算预算。decode 阶段提出 latent KV cache compression，不只依赖 prefill token 的重要性，还利用已生成输出 token 来识别更关键的 cache entries。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 Llama、Qwen 和 openPangu 系列模型上做了实验，覆盖长上下文推理场景。具体数据集、上下文长度、压缩率、延迟收益和精度损失未在摘要中给出，需要看正文表格确认。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context LLM inference often uses fixed sparse attention patterns or uniform KV-cache budgets, ignoring large head-level and context-dependent variation in attention behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution. It uses attention entropy as an online signal to allocate compute and cache budget per head and segment. It does not change pretraining directly, but it gives useful evidence about which long-context attention behaviors actually matter at serving time.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes EntropyInfer, a training-free framework. During prefilling, it measures attention entropy at the head and segment level, separating low-entropy Rigid Heads from high-variance Dynamic Heads and allocating compute adaptively. During decoding, it introduces latent KV-cache compression that uses generated output tokens, not only prefill tokens, to decide which cache entries to retain.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on Llama, Qwen, and openPangu model families in long-context settings. The exact datasets, context lengths, compression ratios, latency gains, and accuracy tradeoffs are not visible from the abstract and need to be checked in the main tables.

recommendation.zh: 只看熵分组和 decode cache 部分；若 Table 里精度-压缩曲线干净，可作为长上下文 serving ablation 候选。
recommendation.en: Read the entropy grouping and decode-cache sections; if the accuracy-compression curves are clean, this is worth reproducing as a long-context serving ablation.

paper.title: STAR-KV: Low-Rank KV Cache Compression via Soft Thresholding for Adaptive Rank Control
paper.abstract: Low-rank projection has emerged as a promising approach for compressing the KV cache by exploiting hidden-dimension redundancy. However, prior methods rely on fixed or heuristic rank selection and struggle to achieve aggressive compression with minimal accuracy degradation. We propose STAR-KV, an adaptive low-rank KV cache compression framework with fine-grained rank control. STAR-KV encompasses 1) a differentiable thresholding mechanism that enables optimal rank selection at both attention-head

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文推理中 KV cache 占用过大，而现有低秩压缩方法 rank 选择僵硬、压缩激进时精度掉得快的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的工程方法创新。它不直接改变预训练范式，但对长上下文 serving、训练后评测和 RL 长 rollout 的系统成本都有现实影响，尤其是把低秩压缩、量化和自适应 rank 控制放到一个统一框架里。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 STAR-KV：用可微 soft-thresholding 在 attention head 和 block 两个粒度上自适应选 rank；对 K/V 采用不同的低秩分解策略，利用两者敏感性差异；再叠加 low-rank-aware mixed-precision quantization，根据统计特性做近无损低比特量化。实现上配了 Triton GPU kernel，说明作者关心的不只是离线压缩率，而是实际吞吐。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的结果是在多个 LLM 和 benchmark 上，单独做 KV 压缩可达 75% 压缩率，结合量化后总体 KV cache reduction 最高到 20x，同时尽量维持精度。具体模型规模、基线和退化幅度摘要未完整给出，但对比对象显然是固定 rank 或启发式 rank 的低秩 KV 方法，以及常规量化方案。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the KV-cache memory bottleneck in long-context inference, where prior low-rank methods rely on fixed or heuristic rank choices and degrade quickly under aggressive compression.
summary_en.importance: This is an engineering contribution in inference efficiency rather than pretraining proper, but it matters for long-context serving, post-training evaluation, and RL rollouts because it combines adaptive low-rank compression and quantization in one deployable stack.
summary_en.technical_approach: STAR-KV introduces differentiable soft-thresholding for adaptive rank selection at both head and block granularity, uses different low-rank factorizations for keys and values based on their sensitivity, and adds low-rank-aware mixed-precision quantization driven by data statistics. The Triton kernel implementation suggests the work is aimed at real throughput, not just offline compression ratios.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, STAR-KV reaches up to 75% KV compression across multiple LLMs and benchmarks, and up to 20x total KV reduction when combined with quantization, while keeping accuracy degradation small. The likely baselines are fixed-rank or heuristic-rank low-rank KV methods plus standard quantization schemes, though the abstract does not expose the full setup.

recommendation.zh: 这是典型值得看实现细节的系统论文，不改 pretrain prior，但若你关心长上下文或 RL rollout 成本，只看自适应 rank 设计和 kernel 结果就够了。
recommendation.en: A solid systems paper to mine for implementation ideas; it does not change pretraining priors, but if long-context serving or RL rollout cost matters, read the adaptive-rank design and kernel results.

paper.title: Still: Amortized KV Cache Compaction in a Single Forward Pass
paper.abstract: The KV cache is the memory bottleneck of long-horizon language model deployment. Practically, a deployable compactor must be lightweight enough to call during inference, expressive enough to preserve context under constraint, and reusable across a trajectory. Existing compaction methods satisfy only part of this requirement: selection methods are lightweight but subset-bound, while synthesis methods are expressive but rely on per-context optimization. Here we introduce Still, a small per-layer P

summary.core_problem: 如何在长上下文 LLM 推理中，通过单次前向传播实现轻量且高压缩率的 KV Cache 压缩？
summary.importance: 提出了一种摊销的 KV Cache 压缩方法，在保持高压缩率的同时，避免了现有方法中选择性压缩的子集限制和合成性压缩的逐上下文优化开销。
summary.technical_approach: 引入 Still，一个针对冻结基础模型训练的小型逐层 Perceiver。它在单次前向传播中生成紧凑的 Key 和 Value，实现摊销的 KV Cache 压缩。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen 和 Gemma 模型上，Still 在 8x 到 200x 的压缩率和 8k 到 128k 的上下文长度下，实现了速度和质量的良好平衡。在长上下文 RULER 网格上，超过最强基线 8-22 分。在 HELMET 上的自由形式摘要任务中也保持了大部分全上下文增益。

summary_en.core_problem: How to achieve lightweight and high-compression KV Cache compaction in a single forward pass for long-context LLM inference?
summary_en.importance: Proposes an amortized KV Cache compaction method that maintains high compression rates while avoiding the subset limitations of selective compression and the per-context optimization overhead of synthetic compression in existing methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Still, a small per-layer Perceiver trained against a frozen base model. It generates compact Keys and Values in a single forward pass, enabling amortized KV Cache compaction.
summary_en.experiments: On Qwen and Gemma models, Still achieves a favorable speed-quality balance across compression ratios from 8x to 200x and context lengths from 8k to 128k. It outperforms the strongest baseline by 8-22 points on the long-context RULER grid and preserves most full-context gains on free-form summarization in HELMET.

recommendation.zh: 用 Perceiver 做 KV Cache 的单次前向压缩，思路干净，值得关注其在极高压缩率（200x）下的表现和训练代价。
recommendation.en: Using a Perceiver for single-forward KV Cache compaction is a clean approach; worth checking its performance at extreme compression ratios (200x) and the training cost.

paper.title: SWE-Marathon: Can Agents Autonomously Complete Ultra-Long-Horizon Software Work?
paper.abstract: AI agents are increasingly expected to complete long-horizon workflows that require sustained progress over hours, millions of tokens, and complex environments. Yet current agent benchmarks largely evaluate short-form tasks, such as single pull requests, small tickets, or 5-10 minute exercises, limiting our ability to measure agents' capabilities in planning, long-context understanding, and memory use. We introduce SWE-Marathon, a benchmark of 20 long-horizon tasks spanning software engineering

summary.core_problem: 如何评测coding agents在“超长时程、数千万token、持续数小时”的软件工程任务中的自主完成能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是benchmark与评测协议：把SWE评测从“单PR/短ticket”推到长时程，直接暴露长上下文、记忆、验证与终止策略的系统性短板；对训练/后训练如何对齐长链路行为也有反向约束。
summary.technical_approach: SWE-Marathon：20个长时程任务，每个任务提供可执行环境、人写参考解、分层验证套件；通过记录真实agent尝试日志，统计token消耗、成功率与失败模式（自验证差、误判不可行、过早终止等）。
summary.experiments: 基准规模：20 tasks；日志平均总token约27.2M/attempt（远超常见SWE-bench类）；当前前沿coding agents完成率<30%；并给出失败原因分布与现象性观察（摘要级信息，具体模型/设置需看正文）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to evaluate coding agents on ultra-long-horizon software work that spans hours and tens of millions of tokens.
summary_en.importance: Benchmark/evaluation contribution: pushes SWE evaluation beyond short PR/ticket tasks, surfacing systematic weaknesses in long-context use, memory, self-verification, and termination policies—useful constraints for post-training and agent design.
summary_en.technical_approach: SWE-Marathon: 20 long-horizon tasks, each with an executable environment, a human-written reference solution, and a multi-layer verification suite; analyzes logged agent attempts to characterize token usage, success rates, and failure modes.
summary_en.experiments: 20 tasks; average logged attempts consume ~27.2M tokens; frontier coding agents solve <30% of tasks; reported failure patterns include weak self-verification, self-declared infeasibility, and premature termination (model/config details require the paper).

recommendation.zh: 把“长链路=长上下文”这件事测得更狠：重点看验证套件设计和失败归因，能直接指导你做长时程agent的训练信号与终止策略。
recommendation.en: A harsher, more realistic long-horizon SWE eval—focus on the verification suite and failure taxonomy; it directly informs training signals and termination policies for long-running agents.

paper.title: Towards Tight Bounds for Streaming Attention
paper.abstract: The attention mechanism is a cornerstone of modern transformer architectures. However, its expressive power comes at the cost of quadratic runtime and linear space usage. In particular, the classical transformer architecture explicitly stores all previously seen input elements (tokens) in order to generate the next one. The problem of implementing a transformer in limited space, known as KV cache compression, has received much interest over the past few years, spurring the development of powerfu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是 streaming attention 的空间复杂度边界，也就是：在不能保存完整 KV cache 的条件下，注意力到底能被压缩到什么程度，同时还能近似原始 softmax attention。它关心的不是提出一个工程启发式，而是把 KV cache 压缩问题形式化成一个近似问题，并尽量把上界和下界收紧。更具体地说，作者试图回答此前理论工作留下的空白：不同温度区间、不同误差要求下，attention 近似所需的内存规模是否已经接近最优，哪些地方还能改进，哪些地方已经有不可突破的下界。
summary.importance: 对基座模型研究员，这篇论文的价值在于提供了一个更硬的理论参照系。现在大量 KV cache 压缩方法是经验性的，效果依赖数据分布、层别、头别和启发式选择，很难知道自己离最优还有多远。这篇工作把问题转成 softmax kernel density estimation 与 coreset 的形式，给出更紧的 upper/lower bounds，帮助判断 streaming / cache compression 这条路在理论上能走到哪里。它不直接改进预训练，但对长上下文建模、推理内存预算、训练时是否值得为 streaming 友好结构付出建模代价，都有间接意义。量级上，这是偏理论基础设施的工作，适合把它当作“能力边界说明书”，而不是可直接落地的算法 recipe。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分三层。第一层是问题重写。作者把 attention 近似与 softmax KDE 联系起来，因为 attention 权重本质上是 query 对 key 的指数核归一化。这样一来，KV cache 压缩就能借用 coreset、核近似、通信复杂度等工具来分析。

第二层是分 regime 处理。目录里可以看出作者明确区分了 high temperature regime 和 low temperature regime。直观上，温度高时，softmax 更平滑，核函数更接近低阶多项式可逼近对象，因此更容易压缩；温度低时，softmax 更尖锐，局部几何和极端点更重要，压缩难度会上升。论文分别在这两个区间给出上界和下界，而不是用一个粗糙结论覆盖全部情况。

第三层是上界构造与下界证明。上界部分，作者使用了多项式逼近、Hermite 多项式、KDE coreset，以及 merge-and-reduce 风格的 streaming 化过程。尤其在低温区，目录显示作者先把数据分成 pseudo-random 和 low-radius 两部分，再做 recenter / rescale，随后分别构造 coreset，最后把离线压缩算法转成 streaming 版本。这说明作者不是直接对原问题硬做统一逼近，而是先按几何性质拆分实例，再针对不同子结构设计压缩策略。

下界部分则借助信息论和通信复杂度工具，说明某些内存需求不是分析松弛造成的，而是问题本身决定的。最后一章再把 softmax KDE 的结果映射回 attention，得到对 streaming attention 的正式结论。

和已有工作的区别在于，这篇论文不是首次提出 streaming attention 的理论框架，而是沿着 Haris et al. 与 Kochetkova et al. 的路线，把未闭合的 gap 往前推进。它的重点是 tighter bounds，而不是新模型或新系统。
summary.experiments:
这是一篇理论论文，没有传统意义上的模型训练实验或 benchmark。结果主要以定理形式给出，核心产出是不同 regime 下的 upper bound 与 lower bound，以及它们之间的 gap 是否缩小。目录显示主要定理包括 Theorem 2.1 和 Theorem 2.2，分别对应高温和低温情形；第 7 章把这些结果从 softmax KDE 转换到 attention setting。若从“实验”角度理解，最重要的是看作者最终给出的空间复杂度依赖关系：它如何随误差 ε、维度 d、温度参数或半径参数 r 变化，以及上界和下界是否只差对数因子或低阶项。

由于你提供的全文片段主要是目录，没有定理正文和具体复杂度表达式，我不能可靠地写出精确公式。但可以明确判断：论文的贡献点在于把不同温度区间分别处理，并通过更细的几何分解与 coreset 构造，把 streaming attention 的理论边界收紧。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时不要从证明细节开始。先看 Introduction 和 Our results，确认作者到底收紧了哪些量、解决了哪些前作遗留问题。接着直接跳到 Technical Overview，重点理解 high temperature 与 low temperature 两个 regime 为什么需要不同工具。

如果你做系统或推理优化，最值得看的是第 7 章“From Softmax KDE to Attention”，因为这里才是和 KV cache compression 直接相关的结论。若你更关心理论方法，可以看第 6 章上界部分，尤其是 pseudo-random / low-radius 划分、recenter & rescale、以及如何从离线压缩转成 streaming。下界部分则适合确认哪些工程目标在理论上可能过于乐观。

预计阅读时间 25 到 40 分钟可抓住主结论；若要跟完整证明，时间会明显更长。阅读时建议把前作 Haris et al. 和 Kochetkova et al. 放在旁边，对照看 gap 是如何被缩小的。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the memory complexity of streaming attention: how much of the KV cache can be compressed while still approximating full softmax attention within a target error. The goal is not to propose another heuristic cache policy, but to tighten the theoretical upper and lower bounds for the approximation problem. More concretely, it addresses gaps left by recent theory papers on streaming attention and asks, across different temperature regimes and error levels, what memory is sufficient and what memory is information-theoretically necessary.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model researchers, the value is as a sharper reference point for KV-cache compression. Much of the current work in this area is heuristic and highly dependent on data, layer, head, and implementation choices. Without theory, it is hard to know whether a method is close to optimal or far from it. By recasting attention approximation through softmax kernel density estimation and coreset constructions, this paper gives tighter bounds that clarify the achievable frontier of streaming attention. It does not change pretraining directly, but it matters for long-context modeling, inference-memory budgeting, and for judging whether architecture changes aimed at streamability are worth their cost.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical route has three main pieces. First, the paper reformulates attention approximation in terms of softmax KDE. This is natural because attention weights are normalized exponential kernels between queries and keys. Once written this way, the problem can be attacked using tools from coresets, polynomial approximation, high-dimensional geometry, and communication complexity.

Second, the analysis is split by regime. The table of contents makes clear that the authors treat a high-temperature regime and a low-temperature regime separately. Intuitively, when temperature is high, softmax is smoother and more amenable to low-degree approximation; when temperature is low, the kernel becomes sharper, local geometry matters more, and compression becomes harder. The paper therefore avoids a single coarse statement and instead derives regime-specific upper and lower bounds.

Third, the upper and lower bounds use different toolchains. On the upper-bound side, the paper employs multivariate polynomial methods, Hermite polynomials, KDE coresets, and a merge-and-reduce style conversion from offline compression to streaming compression. In the low-temperature regime, the contents indicate a more delicate pipeline: partition the dataset into pseudo-random and low-radius components, recenter and rescale them, build coresets for each part, then turn the offline compressor into a streaming algorithm. This suggests that the main technical novelty lies in decomposing the geometry of the instance before compressing it.

On the lower-bound side, the paper uses information-theoretic and communication-complexity arguments to show that some memory requirements are inherent rather than artifacts of loose analysis. The final section transfers the softmax-KDE results back to attention, yielding formal bounds for streaming attention itself.

Relative to prior work by Haris et al. and Kochetkova et al., the contribution here is not a new framework but a tighter characterization of the same problem.
summary_en.experiments:
This is a theory paper, so there are no standard model-training experiments or benchmark tables. The main outputs are theorems: upper and lower bounds in different regimes, and the extent to which the gap between them is reduced. From the structure, Theorem 2.1 and Theorem 2.2 appear to correspond to the high-temperature and low-temperature settings, and Section 7 translates the softmax-KDE statements into attention guarantees.

If one reads the theorems as the equivalent of empirical results, the key quantities to inspect are the memory complexity as a function of approximation error epsilon, ambient dimension, and the temperature or radius parameter r, together with whether upper and lower bounds match up to logarithmic or lower-order factors. The provided excerpt contains the table of contents rather than the theorem statements, so it would be unsafe to invent exact formulas. What is clear is that the paper sharpens the theory by treating the two regimes separately and by using a finer geometric decomposition in the upper-bound construction.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Do not start from the proofs. Begin with the introduction and the statement of results to identify exactly which gaps from earlier work are being closed. Then read the technical overview, focusing on why the high-temperature and low-temperature regimes require different arguments.

If your interest is systems or inference optimization, Section 7, “From Softmax KDE to Attention,” is the most relevant part because it contains the translation back to KV-cache compression. If you care more about the theory itself, the upper-bound construction in Section 6 is likely the most informative, especially the partition into pseudo-random and low-radius components, the recenter-and-rescale step, and the offline-to-streaming conversion. The lower bounds are useful for understanding which engineering goals may simply be too optimistic.

A skim should take about 25–40 minutes. A full proof read will take much longer. It is helpful to keep the earlier papers by Haris et al. and Kochetkova et al. nearby and compare exactly where the new bounds become tighter.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 KV-cache 压缩，这篇该读；不是因为它能立刻提速，而是它在收紧可达边界，能帮你判断现有 heuristic 到底是没调好，还是问题本身就难。
recommendation.en: If you work on KV-cache compression, read this—not for immediate speedups, but because tighter bounds tell you whether current heuristics are under-engineered or fundamentally up against the wall.

paper.title: EASE-TTT: Evidence-Aligned Selective Test-Time Training for Long-Context Question Answering
paper.abstract: Long-context question answering (QA) remains challenging for smaller language models even when answer-bearing evidence is already present in the input. Existing within-context retrieval methods localize and expose candidate evidence chunks for the question, but they stop at input-level evidence exposure rather than adapting the query-side attention parameters that control how the model allocates attention over full-context positions. In contrast, lightweight test-time adaptation methods, such as

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文问答里，小模型即使已看到证据也无法把注意力稳定落到证据位置上的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一类测试时自适应方法，贡献不在预训练本身，而在于把检索到的证据转成显式注意力监督，试图弥补现有 qTTT 只做泛化自监督、却不解决证据定位的缺口。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EASE-TTT：先做 within-context retrieval 选出候选证据块，再把这些证据块对应 token 位置转成 soft attention supervision target，在完整长上下文上进行 selective test-time training。方法不替换原始上下文，而是用证据对 query-side attention 参数做轻量适配，使模型在当前样本上重新分配注意力。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整模型规模、数据集和具体增益数字。可确认的实验设定是长上下文 QA、对比对象包括 within-context retrieval 和 query-only test-time training（qTTT）等轻量测试时适配方法，重点评估证据对齐后的问答效果与长上下文利用能力。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 UIUC、Harvard University、Florida State University。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets long-context QA where smaller LMs fail to place attention on answer-bearing evidence even when that evidence is already present in the context.
summary_en.importance: This is a test-time adaptation paper rather than a pretraining one. Its value lies in turning retrieved evidence into explicit attention supervision, addressing a gap in qTTT-style methods that optimize generic self-supervised objectives without resolving evidence localization.
summary_en.technical_approach: EASE-TTT first performs within-context retrieval to select candidate evidence chunks, then converts their token positions into a soft attention supervision target. It runs selective test-time training over the full context, adapting query-side attention parameters so the model reallocates attention toward evidence-relevant positions without replacing the original context.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full details on model sizes, datasets, or exact gains. What is clear is that the evaluation is on long-context QA, with comparisons against within-context retrieval and lightweight test-time adaptation baselines such as qTTT, focusing on answer accuracy and evidence utilization.
summary_en.authors_note: The affiliations include the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Harvard University, and Florida State University.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深，但把“证据定位”显式写进测试时优化目标这点还算干净；只看方法定义和主表，别投入太多时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the idea of injecting explicit evidence alignment into test-time adaptation is reasonably clean; read the method and main table only.

paper.title: MemDreamer: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning for Long Video Understanding via Hierarchical Graph Memory and Agentic Retrieval Mechanism
paper.abstract: Current Vision-Language Models struggle with hours-long videos because processing full-length visual sequences induces prohibitive token explosion and attention dilution. To overcome this, we introduce MemDreamer to decouple perception and reasoning, shifting long-video understanding into an agentic exploration process. As a plug-and-play framework, it incrementally streams videos to construct a Hierarchical Graph Memory, a top-down three-tier architecture for semantic abstraction, anchored by a

summary.core_problem: 解决长视频理解中全量视觉 token 输入导致的 token 爆炸、注意力稀释和推理上下文不可承受的问题。
summary.importance: 这是长视频 VLM 的 agentic memory/retrieval 框架，贡献在系统组织与推理流程，而不是多模态预训练本身。对做长上下文、多阶段感知-推理解耦、外部记忆设计的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MemDreamer，将感知与推理解耦。系统以流式方式处理视频，构建三层 Hierarchical Graph Memory，并以基础图记录时空与因果关系。推理阶段，模型通过带工具的 agentic retrieval 在图层级中导航、搜索节点、遍历逻辑边，采用 Observation-Reason-Action 循环只取回与当前问题相关的局部证据。
summary.experiments: 在四个主流长视频基准上取得摘要声称的最好结果，并把与人类专家的差距缩小到 3.7 分。推理时只需完整上下文摄入的约 2%，同时保持性能。摘要未给出 backbone 规模、视频时长分布、具体 benchmark 名称和各项绝对分数。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自蚂蚁集团、浙江大学、中南大学。Chunhua Shen 与 Jingdong Chen 在视觉与多模态方向有较高知名度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles long-video understanding where feeding full visual sequences causes token explosion, attention dilution, and impractical reasoning context sizes.
summary_en.importance: This is an agentic memory-and-retrieval framework for long-video VLMs. Its contribution is in system organization and inference flow rather than multimodal pretraining. It is relevant if you care about long-context handling, perception-reasoning decoupling, or external memory design.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemDreamer decouples perception from reasoning. It streams videos to build a three-level Hierarchical Graph Memory, with a foundational graph encoding spatiotemporal and causal relations. At inference time, the reasoning model performs tool-augmented agentic retrieval over the hierarchy, searching nodes and traversing logical edges in an Observation-Reason-Action loop to fetch only question-relevant evidence.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports best results on four mainstream long-video benchmarks and claims to narrow the gap to human experts to 3.7 points. It uses only about 2% of the full-context ingestion at reasoning time while maintaining performance. The abstract does not specify backbone sizes, benchmark names, or absolute scores.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Ant Group, Zhejiang University, and Central South University. Chunhua Shen and Jingdong Chen are well-known researchers in vision and multimodal learning.

recommendation.zh: 这是长视频 agent 系统设计，不是预训练论文；若你在做 memory-augmented reasoning，可看它如何把感知压成图，再用检索替代全上下文注意力。
recommendation.en: This is a long-video agent system, not a pretraining paper; read it only if you care about compressing perception into graph memory and replacing full-context attention with retrieval.

paper.title: LANTERN: Layered Archival and Temporal Episodic Retrieval Network for Long-Context LLM Conversations
paper.abstract: Large language models discard critical details when conversation history is compacted to fit within finite context windows. We present LANTERN (Layered Archival aNd Temporal Episodic Retrieval Network), a lightweight memory layer that proactively archives every conversation turn and restores relevant details after compaction via hybrid retrieval -- requiring zero LLM calls and adding fewer than 25ms of latency per turn. On 94 real multi-turn conversations (1,894 ground-truth facts, human-validat

summary.core_problem: 长对话在上下文压缩后会丢失事实，现有依赖 LLM 的记忆提取与检索方案成本高且恢复率不稳定，作者想用更轻量的外部记忆层解决这个问题。
summary.importance: 这是长上下文/记忆系统方向的工程型工作。它对预训练本身帮助有限，但对部署侧的 conversation memory 设计有参考价值，尤其是把“记忆恢复”从额外 LLM 调用中剥离出来。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LANTERN：对每轮对话做分层归档，并在上下文压缩后通过时间性 episodic retrieval 与混合检索恢复相关事实。系统强调零额外 LLM 调用、低延迟，并提供一个 reranker 版本提升召回。核心不是训练新模型，而是外部记忆与检索管线设计。
summary.experiments: 在 94 个真实多轮对话、1894 条人工验证事实上，LANTERN-Rerank 的事实恢复率为 78.3%，高于作者复现的 MemGPT 风格 LLM 驱动提取+多查询检索基线 72.4%，且延迟低于 25ms/turn。即使不加 reranker，基础版也能匹配或超过该基线。实验说明外部检索式记忆在成本/效果上有竞争力，但数据规模不大，且主要是系统比较而非通用能力分析。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Cisco Systems。工作偏产品系统与长对话记忆工程。

summary_en.core_problem: When long conversations are compacted to fit context limits, models lose factual details; existing LLM-driven memory extraction and retrieval pipelines are costly and unstable, so the paper proposes a lighter external memory layer.
summary_en.importance: This is an engineering-oriented long-context memory paper. It is only indirectly relevant to pretraining, but it is useful for deployment-side conversation memory design, especially because it removes extra LLM calls from the memory-recovery loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces LANTERN, which archives every conversation turn in layered form and restores relevant details after compaction via temporal episodic retrieval and hybrid retrieval. It emphasizes zero additional LLM calls, low latency, and an optional reranker for better recovery. The contribution is a memory/retrieval pipeline rather than a new trained model.
summary_en.experiments: On 94 real multi-turn conversations with 1,894 human-validated facts, LANTERN-Rerank recovers 78.3% of facts lost to compaction, outperforming a reimplemented MemGPT-style LLM-driven extraction plus multi-query search baseline at 72.4%, while adding under 25 ms latency per turn. Even the base version matches or exceeds that baseline. The results suggest external retrieval-based memory can be competitive on cost/effectiveness, though the dataset is small and the paper is more about systems comparison than general capability analysis.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is from Cisco Systems. The work is mainly about product/system design for long-conversation memory.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做长对话产品可看；对 pretrain 研究员只需记住一点：很多“长记忆”问题先别急着改模型，外部归档+检索常常更便宜也更稳。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing if you build long-conversation systems; for pretraining researchers, the main lesson is that many 'memory' failures are cheaper and more robustly handled by external archival plus retrieval than by changing the model.

paper.title: RedKnot: Efficient Long-Context LLM Serving with Head-Aware KV Reuse and SegPagedAttention
paper.abstract: As the input length of large language model (LLM) serving continues to grow, the KV cache has become a dominant bottleneck in AI infrastructure. It limits GPU memory capacity, serving concurrency, cache reuse, and distributed scalability. Several important problems, including position-independent KV cache, prefix KV cache compression, hot/cold KV cache separation, and distributed KV cache management, all depend on how the KV cache is represented and managed. However, existing serving systems lar

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM服务中KV缓存是核心瓶颈，现有系统采用统一的token级KV管理和稠密布局，与实际工作负载中注意力头级的稀疏性结构不匹配，导致位置无关KV缓存复用率低、短上下文下占比过半的FFN开销无法被注意力侧优化覆盖、稀疏KV掩码触发FlashAttention慢路径，实际收益远低于理论预期。
summary.importance: 其观测到的真实服务负载下的头级稀疏性规律，为预训练阶段的注意力架构设计、冗余头裁剪提供了实证依据，存储、计算、负载粒度三者对齐的协同优化思路，也为预训练阶段的推理友好性设计提供了明确方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出RedKnot服务系统，包含三个协同设计的机制：1）头级分类稀疏化：离线将每个（层，头）对分为全局头（12-15%，复用时重新预填充）和局部头（85-88%，滑动窗口内直接复用），运行时通过边质量信号自适应升级局部头，避免token级补丁的级联陈旧问题；2）SegPagedAttention：替换稠密布局为每个（层，头）独立的分页KV存储，配合融合变长注意力内核，物理上只保留每个头需要的token，全程走FlashAttention快路径，消除掩码带来的4.9-7.6倍内核开销；3）稀疏FFN：只计算注意力得分最高的top-k个token的FFN，覆盖2-8K短上下文场景下占比57-62%的FFN开销，三个机制的收益可叠加。
summary.experiments: 基于SGLang实现，在8卡H800服务器上测试Mistral-7B、Qwen3-32B、Llama-3.3-70B三个模型，上下文长度覆盖8K到128K，共6个QA数据集；相比稠密基线，首token延迟提升1.6-3.54倍，单GPU并发会话数提升4.7-7.8倍，预填充FLOPs减少67-79.5%，端到端精度不低于稠密基线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看第3节对现有系统三个结构不匹配问题的分析，再看第4节的三个核心机制设计，重点关注头级稀疏性的实证统计数据，预计阅读时间20-25分钟；若关注预训练的推理友好性设计，可重点查看头分类的统计规律部分。

summary_en.core_problem: KV cache is the dominant bottleneck in long-context LLM serving. Existing systems use unified token-level KV management and dense layouts, which mismatch the per-head sparsity structure of real workloads. This mismatch leads to low reuse rate of position-independent KV cache, unaddressed FFN overhead that accounts for over half of short-context latency, and 4.9-7.6x kernel penalty from sparse attention masks that disable the FlashAttention fast path, resulting in far lower real-world gains than theoretical predictions.
summary_en.importance: The observed per-head sparsity patterns from real serving workloads provide empirical evidence for attention architecture design and redundant head pruning during pretraining. The co-design principle of aligning storage, computation, and workload granularity also offers clear direction for inference-friendly design in pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: RedKnot is a serving system built on SGLang with three co-designed mechanisms: 1) Head-class sparsification: offline classification of each (layer, head) pair into global heads (12-15%, re-prefilled on reuse) and local heads (85-88%, reused directly within a sliding window), with adaptive runtime promotion of local heads via edge-mass signal to avoid cascading staleness of token-level patches. 2) SegPagedAttention: replaces dense KV layout with per-(layer, head) paged KV store and fused varlen attention kernel, physically retaining only tokens required by each head to stay on the FlashAttention fast path and eliminate mask-induced kernel penalty. 3) Sparse FFN: computes FFN only for top-k tokens with highest attention scores to address the 57-62% FFN overhead in 2-8K short-context workloads that no attention-side optimization can cover. Gains from the three mechanisms are multiplicative.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on an 8x NVIDIA H800 server across Mistral-7B, Qwen3-32B, Llama-3.3-70B, 6 QA datasets, and context lengths from 8K to 128K. Compared to dense baselines, RedKnot delivers 1.6-3.54x time-to-first-token speedup, 4.7-7.8x higher concurrent sessions per GPU, 67-79.5% reduction in prefill FLOPs, while matching or exceeding end-to-end accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, first read section 3 on the three structural mismatches of existing serving systems, then review the three core mechanisms in section 4, with focus on empirical statistics of per-head sparsity. Estimated reading time is 20-25 minutes. If focused on inference-friendly pretraining design, refer to the statistics of head classification.

recommendation.zh: 打破了 KV Cache 同质化管理的 prior，提出 Head-Aware 的细粒度管理（SegPagedAttention），对长文本推理系统的内存优化非常有启发，建议系统/推理优化方向的研究员阅读。
recommendation.en: Breaks the prior of homogeneous KV Cache management, proposing Head-Aware fine-grained management (SegPagedAttention); highly inspiring for memory optimization in long-context inference systems. Recommended for system/inference optimization researchers.

paper.title: When Good Enough Is Optimal: Multiplication-Only Matrix Inversion Approximation for Quantized Gated DeltaNet
paper.abstract: Matrix inversion in chunk-wise parallel linear attention is a major bottleneck for long-context modeling, particularly on NPUs, where forward-substitution-based methods exhibit limited parallelism and poor hardware utilization. We propose a fast, Matrix Multiplication (MatMul)-based algorithm tailored for strictly lower-triangular matrices arising in chunk-wise linear attention. Motivated by the rapid growth of Neumann-series terms and the diagonal concentration of the inverse matrix, we employ

summary.core_problem: 如何加速长上下文分块线性注意力（chunk-wise linear attention）中，特别是 NPU 上的矩阵求逆瓶颈？
summary.importance: 工程突破。针对线性注意力在长上下文场景下的计算瓶颈，提出了一种纯矩阵乘法（MatMul）的求逆近似算法，显著提升了硬件利用率和并行度。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一种基于 MatMul 的算法，专门针对分块线性注意力中产生的严格下三角矩阵。利用截断诺伊曼级数（truncated Neumann expansion）结合结构化掩码和并行残差校正来消除顺序依赖。进一步扩展到低比特 INT 量化，通过缓解重复矩阵幂运算引起的动态范围扩展，并根据块大小自适应调整近似阶数和残差步数。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3.5 系列模型上，实现了高达 5 倍的 kernel 级别加速，并减少了 20% 的计算量。

summary_en.core_problem: How to accelerate the matrix inversion bottleneck in chunk-wise linear attention for long-context modeling, particularly on NPUs?
summary_en.importance: Engineering breakthrough. Proposes a multiplication-only (MatMul) matrix inversion approximation algorithm to address the computational bottleneck of linear attention in long-context scenarios, significantly improving hardware utilization and parallelism.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a MatMul-based algorithm tailored for strictly lower-triangular matrices in chunk-wise linear attention. Employs a truncated Neumann expansion with structural masking and parallel residual correction to eliminate sequential dependencies. Extends the method to low-bit INT quantization by mitigating dynamic range expansion from repeated matrix power operations, and adapts approximation order and residual steps to chunk size.
summary_en.experiments: Demonstrates up to 5x kernel-level speedup and a 20% reduction in computational cost on Qwen3.5-family models.

recommendation.zh: 针对线性注意力长上下文推理的底层算子优化，对预训练研究员来说作为 literature 备查即可，不读正文。
recommendation.en: Low-level operator optimization for linear attention in long-context inference; keep as literature reference, skip the main text.

paper.title: Dense Contexts Are Hard Contexts: Lexical Density Limits Effective Context in LLMs
paper.abstract: Input length and the position of relevant information are widely cited as the primary causes of degraded LLM long-context performance. Here, we study lexical density -- the rate at which a context introduces distinct information -- as a third, largely overlooked factor that systematically reduces the effective context window of LLMs. We quantify the impact of lexical density on open-weight LLMs (9B-685B) using three "find-the-needle" style benchmarks with identical length (~12k tokens) and contr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论长上下文失效的一个被低估因素：在相同 token 长度、相同 needle 位置下，context 的信息密度不同，模型可用上下文长度会明显不同。论文把这个因素定义为 lexical density，即上下文引入不同词项或不同信息的速度。
summary.importance: 对预训练和长上下文评测的启发在于，标称 context window 不能只按长度衡量。许多长上下文 benchmark 的 haystack 很稀疏，模型可以靠冗余文本跳读，因此会高估真实场景能力。agent 配置、工具输出、代码、表格化规则、检索拼接材料往往更密集，这类输入会更早触发检索失败。对基座训练而言，这提示长上下文数据配比和评测集需要显式控制每 token 信息量，而不是只扩长度或调位置。
summary.technical_approach: 论文用 MATTR，即 Moving-Average Type-Token Ratio，度量局部窗口内不同 token 类型的比例。MATTR 越高，文本重复越少，局部信息越密。实验设计采用 find-the-needle 风格，但固定总长度约 12k tokens、固定结构和 needle 放置策略，只改变 haystack 的 lexical density。三个主要 benchmark 分别是 MK-NIAH，MATTR 约 0.58；Scene-Rules，MATTR 约 0.75；WordChecker，MATTR 为 1.0，接近每个 token 都引入新词项。为了排除任务类型差异，论文还做了 within-benchmark intervention：在同一个任务、同一长度、同一位置下人工降低或提高密度，观察性能变化。这个设计比单纯比较不同长上下文任务更干净，因为它把长度、位置、任务格式这些常见混杂因素固定住。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 8 个开源权重模型，参数规模从 9B 到 685B。核心结果很直接：模型在稀疏 MK-NIAH 上接近满分，但在更高密度的 Scene-Rules 和 WordChecker 中，检索性能会在 4k 到 6k tokens 后明显下滑，部分设置低于 60% retrieval score。这个失效点远早于只按长度预测的失效区间。论文还观察到 position effect 会被密度放大：needle 在中间位置的弱点在 dense context 中更早暴露。密度干预实验进一步显示，在任务、长度、位置不变时，降低 lexical density 可以恢复性能，说明问题不只是任务更难或位置更差。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 length、position、density 三个轴的拆分；Figure 1 展示不同密度下的性能坍缩，是论文最核心的证据；benchmark 构造部分需要看清 Scene-Rules 和 WordChecker 如何控制密度；within-benchmark intervention 部分最值得细看，因为它决定了 density 是否只是任务差异的替代解释。对预训练研究者，更有价值的问题是后续如何把 lexical density 纳入长上下文数据采样、curriculum 和 eval harness，而不是只把它当成一个新 benchmark 指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper isolates lexical density as a missing variable in long-context failures. At the same sequence length and with the relevant evidence placed at the same position, contexts that introduce more distinct information per token are substantially harder for LLMs to use.
summary_en.importance: The main value is diagnostic.
