It argues against both uniform FP4 attention and overly aggressive sparsity. A better trade-off is to spend a small FP16 budget on the interactions most sensitive to softmax perturbations while keeping the rest in FP4.
summary_en.technical_approach: ThriftAttention is a training-free selective mixed-precision attention method. The paper starts with a first-order perturbation analysis of softmax attention. The contribution of a quantized score error is governed by the score error itself, the attention probability, and the deviation of the value vector from the final output. The attention-probability term makes errors on high-score tokens much more consequential. In implementation, Q, K, and V are quantized with the NVFP4 microscaling format on Blackwell GPUs: E2M1 FP4 values with E4M3 FP8 scales. Q and K/V are partitioned into blocks. For each query block and key block, the method computes an importance score using the dot product between their token-wise block means. The top-k key blocks for each query block are computed in FP16, while all remaining blocks are computed in FP4. The two precision paths are merged with online softmax. Unlike sparse attention, low-scoring blocks are not dropped; they are computed at lower precision, which avoids unrecoverable omission error.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers LongBench-v1, HELMET, RULER, and PG-19 across Llama, Qwen, and Ministral model families. With only a 5% FP16 block budget, ThriftAttention recovers 89.1% of the performance gap between uniform FP4 and FP16 attention on average. At 10% and 25% FP16 budgets, the recovery increases to 91.8% and 92.4%. In end-to-end generation, the method reduces long-context inference latency by up to about 2x. Sequence-length analysis shows that the advantage grows with context length, where uniform FP4 attention degrades most. Visualizations show that FP16-vs-FP4 attention probability differences are concentrated in a small number of blocks, often near the diagonal and around non-initial attention sinks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. The key section is the first-order error analysis in the method part, especially the role of the attention-probability term in concentrating output-relevant error. The implementation details on NVFP4 quantization, block scoring, top-k selection, and online softmax merging are also worth reading. In the experiments, focus on the quality recovery versus FP16 block budget and the sequence-length scaling results. For serving pipelines connected to pretraining or post-training, the main question to examine is how the method behaves on tasks that depend on a few critical tokens, such as needle retrieval, long-range copying, and repository-level code understanding.

recommendation.zh: 值得看误差归因而不是 kernel 细节；若 Fig/Table 证明少量 block 主导退化，应进长上下文量化 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read it for the error attribution, not the kernel; if the tables show few blocks dominate degradation, add this to long-context quantization ablations.

paper.title: A Universal Cliff and a Design Fingerprint: Cross-Section Defect Detection Under LLM Orchestration
paper.abstract: Production language-model systems answer a request by partitioning it across an invisible orchestration of worker agents that recompose one integrated report. We ask what this does to a class of defect no single worker can see: a contradiction in the relation between two distant sections of a document. Holding the documents, defects, mechanism, scoring, and seed fixed, we vary only the model -- ten systems across five generations from one developer and five providers from distinct alignment para

summary.core_problem: 研究生产级 LLM 系统在多 worker orchestration 下是否会丧失发现长文档跨章节矛盾的能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是系统行为分析：把同一类跨章节缺陷检测任务放在单 agent 与 orchestration 两种执行机制下比较，提出“orchestration 会造成检测能力断崖”的现象。对 agent 架构和长文档处理有警示意义，但摘要信息不足，结论需要谨慎看。
summary.technical_approach: 论文固定文档、缺陷、生成机制、评分方式和随机种子，只改变模型或系统；比较十个来自同一开发者五代系统的模型，以及五个来自不同 provider、不同 alignment 范式的系统。使用 signal-detection decomposition 分解掉落后模型的行为差异。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称所有能在单 agent 条件下发现跨章节缺陷的模型，在 orchestration 条件下检测能力下降三分之二以上；该下降不被模型规模或 extended reasoning 消除。在六个仍高于随机的模型中，不同开发者谱系表现出不同的信号检测行为。摘要未给出具体模型名称、样本数、置信区间和任务构造细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者机构标注为 Research Institute of Criminal Psychiatry、Sex Offender Medical Center、Kyoto University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether production LLM systems lose the ability to detect contradictions between distant document sections when the request is handled through multi-worker orchestration.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a behavioral analysis of agentic orchestration: with the task, defects, scoring, and seed held fixed, it compares single-agent and orchestrated execution and reports a large detection cliff. This is relevant to agent architecture and long-document reliability, but the abstract does not provide enough detail to treat the conclusion as settled.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study fixes documents, injected defects, mechanism, scoring, and seed, while varying only the model or provider. It tests ten systems across five generations from one developer and five providers with different alignment paradigms, then applies signal-detection decomposition to analyze model behavior after the performance drop.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims that every model able to detect cross-section defects as a single agent loses that ability under orchestration, with detection falling by at least two thirds across all tested paradigms. The drop is reported not to be closed by scale or extended reasoning. The abstract does not provide model names, dataset size, confidence intervals, or detailed task construction.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed affiliations include Research Institute of Criminal Psychiatry, Sex Offender Medical Center, and Kyoto University.

recommendation.zh: 结论很强但 setup 需验；只看任务构造和误差分解，别把“universal cliff”当稳定规律引用。
recommendation.en: The claim is strong but the setup needs scrutiny; read only the task construction and error decomposition, not the “universal cliff” as a settled law.

paper.title: Gated DeltaNet-2: Decoupling Erase and Write in Linear Attention
paper.abstract: Linear attention replaces the unbounded cache of softmax attention with a fixed-size recurrent state, reducing sequence mixing to linear time and decoding to constant memory. The hard part is not just what to forget, but how to edit this compressed memory without scrambling existing associations. Delta-rule models subtract the current read before writing a new value, and Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) sharpens forgetting with channel-wise decay. But the active edit still uses a single scalar gate to

summary.core_problem: 线性注意力用固定大小 recurrent state 替代 softmax attention 的无界 KV cache，但压缩记忆的擦除与写入容易互相干扰；论文要解决 DeltaNet/KDA 中 erase 和 write 被同一个门控耦合的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 LLM 架构与序列建模机制改进。它瞄准 linear attention 的核心瓶颈：不是简单降低复杂度，而是在固定容量状态中稳定编辑关联记忆。若实验成立，这类改动会影响长上下文、高吞吐解码和 softmax attention 替代路线的设计。
summary.technical_approach: Gated DeltaNet-2 继承 Gated DeltaNet 的 delta-rule 更新和 Kimi Delta Attention 的 adaptive forgetting、channel-wise decay，但把原先单一标量门控拆成两个 channel-wise 门：key 侧 erase gate b_t 控制旧内容擦除，value 侧 write gate w_t 控制新内容写入。两个门退化为相同标量时可回到 KDA 类设定，因此方法是对既有 DeltaNet/KDA 的结构性泛化。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出参数规模、训练 token 数、语言建模 perplexity、长上下文 benchmark 或吞吐/显存指标。可确认的实验主张是 Gated DeltaNet-2 针对 DeltaNet 与 KDA 共享的 scalar tie limitation 做消融，关键应看 erase/write 解耦相对单门控和 KDA 的收益。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a memory-editing problem in linear attention: fixed-size recurrent states reduce memory cost, but DeltaNet/KDA-style updates tie erasing old key-side content and writing new value-side content through a single gate.
summary_en.importance: This is an architecture contribution for language modeling and sequence modeling. It targets the central weakness of linear attention: not just reducing complexity, but editing compressed associative memory without corrupting existing bindings. If the empirical results hold, it matters for long-context and high-throughput alternatives to softmax attention.
summary_en.technical_approach: Gated DeltaNet-2 generalizes Gated DeltaNet and Kimi Delta Attention. It keeps adaptive forgetting and channel-wise decay, but splits the single scalar edit gate into two channel-wise gates: an erase gate b_t on the key side and a write gate w_t on the value side. When the two gates collapse to the same scalar behavior, the update reduces toward the KDA-style formulation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report parameter counts, token budgets, language-modeling perplexity, long-context benchmarks, or throughput and memory numbers. The key empirical question is the ablation of decoupled erase/write gates against single-gate DeltaNet and KDA variants.

recommendation.zh: 优先看消融表；erase/write 解耦是干净的架构假设，若小模型到长上下文都稳，应进内部复现。
recommendation.en: Prioritize the ablations; erase/write decoupling is a clean architectural hypothesis, and if it holds across scale and context length it deserves internal replication.

paper.title: WorldKV: Efficient World Memory with World Retrieval and Compression
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video diffusion models have enabled real-time, action-conditioned world generation. However, sustaining a persistent world, where revisiting a previously seen viewpoint yields consistent content, remains an open problem. Full KV-cache attention preserves this consistency but breaks real-time constraints: memory footprint and attention cost grow linearly with rollout length. Sliding window inference restores throughput but discards long-term consistency. We propose WorldKV, a train

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是自回归视频扩散 world model 的长期一致性与实时推理之间的冲突。完整 KV-cache attention 能在重访场景时保持内容一致，但显存和 attention 计算随 rollout 长度线性增长；滑动窗口能保持速度，却会丢掉早期场景记忆，导致重访时漂移或生成新内容。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不属于传统 LLM 预训练方法，但对自回归多模态生成模型和长期上下文推理有参考价值。它的关键观察是：KV cache 不只是加速缓存，也可以作为模型已有的隐式世界记忆。与训练外部 memory module 或显式 3D 表示相比，WorldKV 选择直接管理模型自身的 KV cache，因此更接近 serving-time memory policy。对 LLM 研究的启发在于，长上下文能力不一定只靠扩大上下文窗口，也可以通过检索、压缩、重插入已有 KV 来获得更低成本的历史访问。
summary.technical_approach: WorldKV 是 training-free 框架，由 World Retrieval 和 World Compression 两部分组成。World Retrieval 把滑动窗口中被驱逐的 KV-cache chunk 存到 GPU/CPU memory，在模型重访相关场景时再选择性取回，并直接插回原生 attention window，不需要重编码，也不改模型结构。检索策略是模块化的，可以使用 camera/action correspondence，也可以使用 attention-based retrieval。World Compression 针对相邻帧 KV 高度冗余的问题，用 Key-Key similarity 识别并裁剪重复 token，把每个 chunk 大约压到一半大小。这样在同样 memory budget 下能保留约 2 倍历史，同时避免完整历史 attention 的线性开销。
summary.experiments: 论文在两个不同规模的自回归视频 world model 上评估：Matrix-Game-2.0 和 LingBot-World-Fast。一个重要实验现象是，即使 Matrix-Game-2.0 训练时只用 6-frame sliding window，推理时放开完整 KV-cache 仍能利用过去 cache 重建曾经看过的视角，说明这种记忆并不完全依赖长序列训练。成本方面，论文指出每帧会产生约 880 到 1,560 个 token，一分钟 rollout 会累积到数十万 token；LingBot-World-Fast 使用完整历史时，FPS 从 8.87 降到 3.61。World Compression 能把 chunk 约减半，World Retrieval 则在不读取完整历史的情况下提升 revisit fidelity。论文称 training-free KV 管理在重访一致性上可匹配或超过 full KV-cache attention 和 memory-trained baselines，同时保持实时推理。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 的 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，理解“KV cache 已经携带世界记忆”和“完整历史 attention 不可承受”这两个前提。方法部分重点看 World Retrieval 如何定义 chunk、如何根据相机/动作或 attention 取回历史 KV，以及 World Compression 的 Key-Key similarity pruning。实验部分关注 Matrix-Game-2.0 的短上下文训练但长记忆可用这一点，这比具体应用演示更有方法价值。Appendix C 如果有时间可以看，用来判断 retrieval 策略是否可迁移到其他自回归多模态模型。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the tension between long-term consistency and real-time inference in autoregressive video diffusion world models. Full-history KV-cache attention can preserve scene consistency during revisits, but memory and attention cost grow with rollout length. Sliding-window inference keeps the system fast, but evicts the very caches needed to recover previously seen views.
summary_en.importance: The work is most relevant as an inference-time memory management study for autoregressive multimodal generation. Its central observation is that KV cache is not only a compute buffer; it can act as an implicit world memory already available inside the model. Instead of training an external memory module, adding cross-attention, or reconstructing an explicit 3D scene, the method manages and reuses the model’s own KV cache. For LLM researchers, the useful analogy is long-context access under a bounded budget: selective retrieval and compression of past KV can be an alternative to simply increasing the active context window.
summary_en.technical_approach: WorldKV is a training-free framework with two components. World Retrieval stores evicted KV-cache chunks in GPU or CPU memory and retrieves scene-relevant chunks when the camera or action trajectory indicates a revisit. The retrieved caches are inserted back into the native attention window, without re-encoding and without architectural changes. The retrieval interface is modular and can use camera/action correspondence or attention-based selection. World Compression reduces redundancy across adjacent video frames by pruning tokens according to Key-Key similarity. Since neighboring frames produce near-duplicate KV entries, compressing each chunk to roughly half size allows about twice as much history to be retained under the same memory budget.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on Matrix-Game-2.0 and LingBot-World-Fast. A notable finding is that Matrix-Game-2.0, although trained with only a 6-frame sliding window, can still use full past KV caches at inference time to reconstruct previously visited viewpoints. This supports the claim that the memory effect is not limited to models trained on minute-long sequences. The cost motivation is concrete: each frame produces around 880 to 1,560 tokens, so a one-minute rollout can accumulate hundreds of thousands of tokens. On LingBot-World-Fast, full-history attention reduces FPS from 8.87 to 3.61 over a one-minute rollout. WorldKV uses retrieval to avoid attending to the full history and compression to roughly halve chunk size. The reported results show revisit fidelity comparable to or better than full KV-cache attention and memory-trained baselines while maintaining real-time inference.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20 to 30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Start with Figure 1 and Figure 2 in the introduction: they establish the two core claims, namely that KV carries usable scene memory and that full-history attention is too expensive. Then read the method sections on World Retrieval and World Compression. The most transferable details are chunk construction, camera/action-based retrieval, attention-based retrieval, and Key-Key similarity pruning. The Matrix-Game-2.0 result is worth noting because it separates inference-time cache reuse from long-sequence training. Appendix C is useful if the goal is to judge whether the retrieval policy could be adapted to other autoregressive multimodal models.

recommendation.zh: 长上下文 KV 记忆的思路值得借鉴；重点看 retrieval key 的定义和压缩误差，别被视频场景绑住。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for long-context KV memory design; focus on the retrieval key and compression error, not the video-specific framing.

paper.title: LT2: Linear-Time Looped Transformers
paper.abstract: Looped Transformers (LT) have emerged as a powerful architecture by iterating their layers multiple times before decoding the final token. However, pairing them with full attention retains quadratic complexity, making them computationally expensive and slow. We introduce LT2 (Linear-Time Looped Transformers), a family of looped architectures that replace quadratic softmax attention with subquadratic, linear-time attention. We study two variants: LT2-linear with linear attention and LT2-sparse wi

summary.core_problem: Looped Transformer 用权重共享把“深度”换成多轮 latent computation，但每一轮仍要做全注意力。这样参数量省下来了，训练 FLOPs、长上下文推理延迟和 KV-cache 却随 loop 次数继续放大。LT2 解决的是这个不匹配：如何让 looped computation 继续保留多轮推理收益，同时把 token mixing 从二次复杂度换成线性或稀疏复杂度。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构和训练成本之间的重新分解。常规深层 Transformer 是用更多独立参数买计算深度，Looped Transformer 是用重复计算买有效深度；LT2 进一步把注意力瓶颈降下来，使“多轮计算”更接近可扩展的训练和推理单元。它的贡献不是提出一个新的预训练目标，而是给 looped/latent reasoning 类架构补上效率短板。对长上下文、小参数强推理、以及从已有全注意力 looped 模型迁移到高效模型，都有直接参考价值。限制也清楚：结果主要说明线性/稀疏 token mixer 在 looped 设置下有协同效应，但更大规模预训练、不同数据配比和更长上下文下的稳定性还需要继续验证。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接：保留 Looped Transformer 的权重共享框架，把每个共享 block 中的 full MHA 替换为线性注意力或稀疏注意力。论文研究了 LT2-linear 和 LT2-sparse 两类。LT2-linear 使用线性注意力类 mixer，通过 recurrent state 在 loop 间被反复更新；loop 不只是重复同一个近似注意力，而是在多轮中细化记忆状态。LT2-sparse 使用稀疏注意力类 mixer，单轮只能看局部或稀疏邻域，但多轮循环会逐步扩大有效感受野。这个点是论文的核心：looping 对 full attention 主要是增加计算深度，对 linear/sparse attention 还会改变可访问上下文的动态。论文还加入零初始化的逐通道门控，使替换 token mixer 时训练更平滑。混合版本 LT2-hybrid 更实用：一种是 GDN + DSA，完全不使用二次复杂度注意力；另一种是 Full + GDN，用少量全注意力层保留全局建模能力，其余用线性 mixer 提供吞吐收益。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了标准零样本评测、语言建模、recall、state-tracking 和效率测试。LT2-hybrid 的 GDN + DSA 版本在不使用 full attention 的情况下，平均 zero-shot 达到 59.3%，与标准 full-attention Looped Transformer 持平；在 8k context、batch size 8 的 decode 设置下，吞吐约 125 tokens/s，而标准 looped transformer 为 22 tokens/s，约 5.7 倍提升。Full + GDN 版本进一步把平均 zero-shot 从 59.3% 提到 61.4%，提升 2.1 点，同时仍保持约 5 倍 decode 吞吐提升。论文还做了从已有 Ouro looped transformer 到 LT2 的转换实验：用约 1B tokens 的 continued training，把 Ouro 转成 Ouro-Hybrid-1.4B，基本保留 full-attention teacher 的质量，同时继承线性时间推理效率。这个实验对工程落地很关键，因为它说明不一定需要从头训练 LT2。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Figure 2，确认 full-attention looped transformer 的 FLOPs 和 KV-cache 问题。再读第 2 节，重点看 LT2-linear、LT2-sparse 的定义，以及论文如何解释“looping turns compute into context”。Appendix B.1 可以选择性读，主要用于理解线性注意力的 memory refinement 和稀疏注意力的 receptive field expansion。实验部分优先看 hybrid 相关表格和 8k decode throughput，对预训练研究员更有用的是 Full + GDN 与 GDN + DSA 的取舍：前者质量更好，后者更纯粹地去掉二次注意力。最后看 Ouro distillation/continued training 实验，它比从头训练结果更接近真实模型改造场景。

summary_en.core_problem: Looped Transformers reuse a small set of layers for multiple iterations, turning repeated computation into effective depth. The problem is that each iteration still runs full self-attention, so the attention cost and KV-cache footprint grow poorly with sequence length and with the number of loops. LT2 addresses this mismatch: it tries to keep the benefits of looped latent computation while replacing quadratic token mixing with linear or sparse alternatives.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant as an architecture and training-efficiency study rather than a new pretraining objective. It makes looped computation more plausible for long-context and parameter-efficient language models by attacking the attention bottleneck directly. The useful idea is that looping is not just depth reuse: with linear attention it repeatedly refines a recurrent memory state, and with sparse attention it expands the effective receptive field over iterations. The main caveat is scale. The reported results are encouraging, but the behavior at larger model sizes, longer pretraining runs, and more diverse data mixtures is still an open question.
summary_en.technical_approach: LT2 keeps the standard Looped Transformer structure: a set of shared blocks is applied for T iterations before prediction. The change is inside the token mixer. LT2-linear replaces full MHA with a linear-attention primitive, so the recurrent attention state can be updated and refined across loop iterations. LT2-sparse replaces full attention with sparse attention, where repeated application gradually expands the reachable context. The paper also studies hybrid designs. The GDN + DSA hybrid combines linear and sparse attention without any quadratic full-attention layer. The Full + GDN hybrid keeps a small amount of full attention and uses linear attention for the rest, trading a little quadratic cost for better quality. A zero-initialized per-channel learned gate is used to make the replacement more stable.
summary_en.experiments: The main results cover zero-shot evaluation, language modeling, recall, state tracking, and inference efficiency. The GDN + DSA LT2-hybrid matches the standard full-attention Looped Transformer at 59.3% average zero-shot accuracy while reaching about 125 tokens/s at 8k context and batch size 8, compared with 22 tokens/s for the standard looped model, roughly a 5.7x decode-throughput gain. The Full + GDN hybrid improves the average zero-shot score from 59.3% to 61.4%, a 2.1-point gain, while still giving around a 5x throughput improvement in the same setting. The paper also converts a pretrained Ouro looped model into an LT2-style hybrid model with about 1B tokens of continued training. The resulting Ouro-Hybrid-1.4B largely retains the full-attention teacher quality while gaining the LT2 efficiency profile.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Start with Figure 2 to understand why full-attention looping becomes expensive. Then read Section 2 for the LT2 formulation and the distinction between the linear and sparse variants. The key mechanism is the interaction between looping and the token mixer, not the replacement of attention alone. Appendix B.1 is worth checking if the theoretical explanation of memory refinement and receptive-field growth matters for your work. In the experiments, focus on the hybrid models and the 8k decode-throughput table. The Ouro conversion experiment is especially practical because it tests whether an existing looped full-attention model can be adapted without retraining from scratch.

recommendation.zh: 值得读方法和 LM 表：它检验 loop 是否能弥补 linear/sparse attention 的短板，可作为长上下文架构 ablation 候选。
recommendation.en: Read the method and LM tables: it tests whether looping can offset linear/sparse attention weaknesses, making it a plausible long-context architecture ablation.

paper.title: Runtime-Certified Bounded-Error Quantized Attention
paper.abstract: KV cache quantization reduces the memory cost of long-context LLM inference, but introduces approximation error that is typically validated only empirically. Existing systems rely on average-case robustness, with no mechanism to detect or recover from failures at runtime. We present a tiered KV cache architecture that enables runtime-certified attention: INT8 keys and INT4 values are stored in GPU memory, while FP16 originals are retained in system RAM for deterministic fallback. A two-term erro

summary.core_problem: KV cache 量化是长上下文推理的关键优化，但现有方案仅依赖经验验证（ perplexity 平均指标），无法在逐解码步骤粒度上检测或恢复量化误差，存在静默失败风险（即对某些 prompt/attention 模式产生大的 step-wise 偏差）。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在推理可靠性维度。该工作将 KV cache 量化从「固定近似」重新定义为「运行时可验证计算」，提供了一种 principled 的误差界框架，而非纯经验调参。对需要确定性服务质量的生产部署有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心创新有三点：(1) 分层存储架构：GPU VRAM 存放 INT8 key + INT4 value 的量化缓存，系统内存（pinned RAM）保留 FP16 原始数据用于确定性 fallback，FP16 数据不丢弃；(2) 两项误差分解：独立界定 key 量化导致的 attention 分布畸变和 value 量化导致的重建误差，两个界都可以在运行时用量化 scale、query 范数、value 范围等已跟踪量计算；(3) 自适应精度选择 + 四级 fallback 梯子：根据 attention mass 分布决定哪些 block 需要 FP16 key，同时用 ranking-consistency 检查检测 INT8 评分噪声何时扭曲 attention 分布，触发 per-head fallback 到 dense attention。
summary.experiments: 论文以 LLaMA 3.1-8B 为目标模型架构（32层，GQA 8 KV heads，head dim 128），在 128K 上下文下 FP16 KV cache 约 17GB。提出的 INT8 key + INT4 value 缓存占 FP16 的约 56%（含元数据）。文中包含形式化误差界推导（第 4 节）和 arithmetic-path gap 分析（第 9.10 节），但未报告完整的端到端性能/精度对比实验数据（从提供的全文来看）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看第 1 节（问题定义和核心思想概述）和第 3 节（分层存储架构 + fallback 机制），第 4 节的误差分解可根据兴趣选读。预计阅读时间 20-30 分钟。对预训练研究员来说，主要价值在于其 runtime verification 的框架思路，而非具体量化参数。
summary.authors_note: 机构作者信息未在提供的全文中标注。

summary_en.core_problem: KV cache quantization is a critical optimization for long-context inference, but existing schemes rely solely on empirical validation (average perplexity metrics) and cannot detect or recover from quantization errors at the per-decode-step granularity, risking silent failures—large step-wise deviations on certain prompts/attention patterns.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretrain research is in the inference reliability dimension. This work reframes KV cache quantization from a 'fixed approximation' to 'runtime-verifiable computation', providing a principled error-bound framework rather than purely empirical tuning. It offers reference value for production deployments requiring deterministic service quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three core innovations: (1) Tiered storage architecture: GPU VRAM holds INT8 key + INT4 value quantized cache, while FP16 originals are retained in pinned system RAM for deterministic fallback—FP16 data is never discarded; (2) Two-term error decomposition: independently bounds attention distribution distortion from key quantization and reconstruction error from value compression, both computable at runtime from already-tracked quantities (quantization scales, query norms, value ranges); (3) Adaptive precision selection + four-rung fallback ladder: determines which blocks need FP16 keys based on attention mass distribution, and uses a ranking-consistency check to detect when INT8 scoring noise distorts the attention distribution, triggering per-head fallback to dense attention.
summary_en.experiments: The target architecture is LLaMA 3.1-8B (32 layers, GQA 8 KV heads, head dim 128), with FP16 KV cache ~17GB at 128K context. The proposed INT8 key + INT4 value cache occupies ~56% of FP16 (including metadata). The paper includes formal error bound derivations (Section 4) and arithmetic-path gap analysis (Section 9.10), but complete end-to-end performance/accuracy comparison experiment data is not reported in the provided full text.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim guidance: focus on Section 1 (problem definition and core idea overview) and Section 3 (tiered storage architecture + fallback mechanism). Section 4 error decomposition is optional based on interest. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes. For pretrain researchers, the main value is the runtime verification framework, not the specific quantization parameters.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not specified in the provided full text.

recommendation.zh: 运行时认证量化的思路有新意，误差分解和回退机制设计对长上下文推理系统有参考价值，关注 §3 的误差界推导。
recommendation.en: Runtime-certified quantization is a novel direction; the error decomposition and fallback mechanism is useful for long-context inference systems. Focus on the bound derivation in §3.

paper.title: Fast and Stable Triangular Inversion for Delta-Rule Linear Transformers
paper.abstract: Linear attention has emerged as a cornerstone for efficient long-context architectures, as evidenced by its integration into state-of-the-art open-source models including Qwen3.5/3.6, Kimi Linear, and RWKV-7. Models that incorporate linear attention layers with the so-called Delta-Rule involve the inversion of triangular matrices as a core sub-routine. This operation often forms a performance bottleneck, and, due to its high-sensitivity to numerical errors, it can significantly deteriorate end-t

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 Delta-Rule Linear Transformer 中一个很具体但影响很大的系统数值问题：chunk-wise 并行计算时，需要反复求解或求逆单位对角下三角矩阵；这个子程序既可能成为运行时瓶颈，也可能因为低精度数值误差破坏模型输出。
summary.importance: 它对基座模型研究的价值在于长上下文架构的可训练、可评测和可部署。DeltaNet、Gated DeltaNet、RWKV-7、Kimi Linear、Qwen3.5/3.6 一类线性注意力或混合线性注意力模型，都依赖类似的 chunk 内三角运算。论文显示，不稳定的求逆实现可以把 Qwen3.6 的 MMLU 从 75.6% 拉到 0.2%，说明 kernel 级数值误差不是纯工程细节，而会直接改变模型能力评估。对做长上下文预训练的人，这类问题会影响 loss spike、长序列稳定性、不同精度 recipe 的可复现性。
summary.technical_approach: 论文系统分析 direct 和 iterative 两类三角求逆算法，目标是同时满足两点：大量使用矩阵乘法以利用 GPU/加速器 matrix cores；在 float32、float16、bfloat16 下保持可控误差。被求逆的矩阵来自 Delta-Rule Linear Transformer 的 chunk 内重写，通常是大小 C×C 的单位对角下三角矩阵，C 常取 16、32、64、128；非对角结构由 key 相关函数 phi 和严格下三角 mask 决定。作者不是简单套用通用 triangular inverse，而是利用这些矩阵的单位对角、严格下三角和 chunk 尺寸较小等结构。一个有意思的点是，单独使用时非常不稳定的 MCH 方法，可以作为 MXR 这类更稳定快速算法的内部子程序，从而在性能和稳定性之间取得更好的平衡。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的关键现象很明确：在现有实现中，三角求逆部分最高可占单层设备运行时间约 40%；不稳定低精度实现会导致端到端准确率崩坏，示例中 Qwen3.6 的 MMLU 从 75.6% 降到 0.2%。作者在 float32、float16、bfloat16 三种精度下测试多种算法的误差和稳定性，并报告 MXR 等方法相对基线最高达到 4.3× 加速，同时保持稳定输出。实验重点不是模型指标提升，而是证明数值实现会在长上下文线性注意力中成为能力保持的前置条件。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。先看 Figure 1，理解问题规模：运行时占比和不稳定实现对 MMLU 的破坏。再看 Table 1，确认不同 Delta-Rule / Gated DeltaNet 变体中的 phi 形式。Table 2 是方法总览，适合快速比较各算法的计算结构和稳定性。若要落地到训练或推理系统，需要细读稳定性分析、低精度实验和 MXR 的实现细节，尤其关注哪些矩阵乘可以安全放到低精度，哪些步骤需要更谨慎的累积或校正。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but consequential numerical kernel in Delta-Rule Linear Transformers: chunk-wise parallel formulations require repeated inversion or solution of unit-diagonal lower-triangular systems. This operation can dominate runtime and, if implemented with unstable low-precision algorithms, can corrupt model outputs.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to foundation-model research is practical and direct for long-context architectures. DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, RWKV-7, Kimi Linear, and Qwen3.5/3.6-style linear attention models rely on related chunk-level triangular operations. The paper shows that an unstable inversion method can reduce Qwen3.6 MMLU accuracy from 75.6% to 0.2%. That makes the kernel a modeling and evaluation issue, not only an implementation detail. For long-context pretraining, such numerical behavior can affect loss spikes, stability under mixed precision, and reproducibility of training recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper analyzes both direct and iterative triangular inversion algorithms, with two constraints in mind: the algorithms should be rich in matrix products to use accelerator matrix cores, and they must remain numerically reliable in float32, float16, and bfloat16. The matrices arise from chunked Delta-Rule linear attention and are typically C by C unit-diagonal lower-triangular matrices, with C in {16, 32, 64, 128}. Their strictly lower-triangular structure is determined by key-dependent functions and causal masking. Rather than applying generic triangular inversion blindly, the analysis exploits the unit diagonal, strict triangularity, and small chunk sizes. A notable design point is that an unstable method such as MCH can still be useful as a subroutine inside a faster and stable method such as MXR.
summary_en.experiments: The reported measurements show that triangular inversion can take up to about 40% of a layer’s device runtime in existing implementations. The numerical stability effect is large: an unstable implementation drops Qwen3.6 MMLU accuracy from 75.6% to 0.2%. The paper evaluates multiple algorithms under float32, float16, and bfloat16, measuring both error behavior and runtime. The best reported approach reaches up to 4.3x speedup over the relevant baseline while preserving stable outputs. The main result is not a higher model score, but evidence that stable triangular inversion is a prerequisite for reliable linear-attention models.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes around 30–45 minutes. Start with Figure 1 to see the runtime bottleneck and the end-to-end accuracy failure caused by unstable inversion. Then read Table 1 to understand which phi functions occur in different Delta-Rule variants. Table 2 gives the algorithm landscape and is the fastest way to compare computational structure and stability. For implementation work, read the stability analysis, the mixed-precision experiments, and the MXR details, especially which matrix products can safely use low precision and which steps need more careful accumulation or correction.

recommendation.zh: 线性Transformer长上下文架构核心算子优化，做长上下文或推理效率的研究员可重点看数值稳定性分析部分
recommendation.en: Core operator optimization for linear Transformer long-context architectures, researchers working on long context or inference efficiency can focus on the numerical stability analysis section

paper.title: Full Attention Strikes Back: Transferring Full Attention into Sparse within Hundred Training Steps
paper.abstract: Long-context inference in large language models is bottlenecked by the quadratic cost of full attention. Existing efficient alternatives often rely either on native sparse training or on heuristic token eviction, creating an undesirable trade-off among efficiency, training cost, and accuracy. In this work, we show that full-attention LLMs are already intrinsically sparse and can be transformed into highly sparse models with only minimal adaptation. Our approach is built on three observations: (1

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决长上下文推理中的 full attention 成本问题。核心问题不是重新训练一个原生 sparse attention 模型，而是问：已经用 full attention 训练好的 LLM，能否通过很小的改造和少量继续训练，转成高稀疏推理模型，同时尽量保持原能力。
summary.importance: 这篇对预训练研究有间接但清楚的启发。它支持一个实用判断：full-attention 预训练仍然有竞争力，因为模型训练后已经形成可利用的 head-level 和 token-level 稀疏结构。相比从头训练稀疏架构，RTPurbo 更像是 post-pretrain 的结构压缩和推理适配。对基座训练的含义是，训练阶段可以先保留表达能力更稳的 full attention，再在部署前用低成本蒸馏和稀疏化提取推理效率。这会影响长上下文模型在训练目标、架构选择和 serving 成本之间的取舍。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名为 RTPurbo。设计基于三个观察。第一，attention head 功能不均匀，只有少量 retrieval heads 真正需要远程上下文，多数 head 主要处理局部信息。因此方法只为 retrieval heads 保留完整或更长程的 KV 访问，对 local heads 丢弃远程 token。第二，远程检索主要依赖低维子空间。论文从 RoPE 的频率结构解释这一点：高频 rotary 分量随相对距离快速变化，长距离下更容易干扰语义检索；低频分量变化平滑，更适合保持远程相关性。因此 RTPurbo 用低维 projector/indexer 做 token selection，文中强调 16 维即可获得较高 recall。第三，固定 Top-k token budget 不适合所有 query，因为不同 query 的注意力分布尖锐程度不同。RTPurbo 使用 Top-p 式自适应选择，让 token 数随 attention mass 分布变化。最后，它用 self-distillation 对齐稀疏模型和原 full-attention 模型的输出，只需几百步、约 1M label tokens，避免大规模重新训练。
summary.experiments: 关键结果包括：16 维低维检索器可达到超过 90% 的 recall；少量自蒸馏即可恢复稀疏化后的性能；配合定制 sparse kernels，prefill 最高加速 9.36×，decoding 最高加速 2.01×。论文还报告 Top-p selector 在推理和长上下文任务上优于静态 Top-k，说明自适应 token budget 对保留能力很关键。整体实验支持一个结论：full-attention 模型内部已经存在显著稀疏性，稀疏化主要需要识别和对齐，而不一定需要从头训练稀疏模型。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–45 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 minimal surgery 的问题定义，以及 Insight Behind RTPurbo 部分对 retrieval heads、RoPE 低频子空间和自适应 sparsity 的解释。实验部分优先看四类结果：retrieval head 选择是否稳定、16 维 indexer 的 recall、Top-p 与 Top-k 的对照、自蒸馏步数和性能恢复曲线。对做预训练的人，最值得深挖的是 full-attention 训练后自然形成的稀疏结构，以及这种结构是否能反过来指导长上下文预训练 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the cost of full attention in long-context inference. The key question is whether a full-attention LLM can be converted into a highly sparse inference model with minimal modification and only a small amount of adaptation, instead of training a sparse-attention model from scratch.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to pretraining strategy through the training–serving interface. It suggests that full-attention pretraining remains a practical choice because trained models already contain exploitable sparsity at both the head and token levels. RTPurbo turns this latent structure into an inference-time sparse model through lightweight continuation and distillation. This changes the trade-off: one can keep the more reliable full-attention objective during pretraining, then extract efficiency before deployment, rather than committing to native sparse attention throughout training.
summary_en.technical_approach: RTPurbo is built around three observations. First, attention heads are functionally heterogeneous. Only a small subset acts as retrieval heads that need remote context; many other heads mostly use local information. RTPurbo therefore preserves long-range KV access for retrieval heads and removes remote tokens for local heads. Second, long-range retrieval can be approximated in a low-dimensional subspace. The paper links this to RoPE: high-frequency rotary components vary rapidly with relative distance and can hurt long-range matching, while low-frequency components change smoothly and better preserve retrieval signals. RTPurbo uses a compact low-dimensional projector or indexer for token selection, with 16 dimensions highlighted in the results. Third, a fixed Top-k budget is too rigid because different queries have different attention concentration. The method uses a Top-p-style adaptive selector. A short self-distillation stage then aligns the sparse model with the original full-attention model, requiring only a few hundred steps and about 1M label tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results show that the 16-dimensional indexer achieves over 90% recall for relevant tokens. Self-distillation recovers sparse-model performance with a very small amount of training. With custom sparse kernels, RTPurbo reaches up to 9.36× prefill speedup and 2.01× decoding speedup. The ablations indicate that Top-p adaptive selection works better than static Top-k on reasoning and long-context tasks, supporting the claim that query-dependent token budgets are important. The experiments collectively show that much of the needed sparsity is already present in full-attention models.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the problem framing in the Introduction, especially the idea of minimal surgery on a full-attention model. Then read the RTPurbo insight section for retrieval-head specialization, the RoPE low-frequency argument, and adaptive sparsity. In the experiments, focus on four points: retrieval-head identification, 16-dimensional indexer recall, Top-p versus Top-k ablations, and the self-distillation recovery curve. For pretraining researchers, the most useful angle is whether the sparsity that emerges after full-attention training can inform future long-context training recipes.

recommendation.zh: 读 §attention-head ablation 和延迟表；若百步迁移成立，native sparse pretraining 的必要性要重新估。
recommendation.en: Read the attention-head ablations and latency table; if the hundred-step transfer holds, the need for native sparse pretraining should be re-estimated.

paper.title: Flash PD-SSM: Memory-Optimized Structured Sparse State-Space Models
paper.abstract: State-space models (SSMs) face a fundamental trade-off between efficiency and expressivity that is mainly dictated by the structure of the model's transition matrix. Unstructured transition matrices enable maximal expressivity, as measured by their ability to model finite-state automaton (FSA) transitions, but come at a prohibitively high compute and memory cost. In contrast, most structured transition matrix forms are highly efficient both in runtime and memory consumption, but suffer from limi

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是结构化稀疏 SSM 的可用性问题。PD-SSM 这类模型在有限状态自动机追踪能力上接近非结构化转移矩阵，但原始实现需要为每个 token 生成输入相关的稀疏转移矩阵，内存开销达到 O(LN^2)，实际速度比 Mamba2 慢很多。Flash PD-SSM 的目标是在保留状态追踪表达力的同时，把训练和推理开销降到接近主流高效 SSM 的水平。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构层。近期混合架构越来越多地用 SSM 层替代部分 attention 层，瓶颈不只是线性复杂度，还包括 SSM 转移矩阵是否能表示复杂状态机。Flash PD-SSM 提供了一个较清楚的取舍：不退回到纯对角矩阵，也不接受非结构化矩阵的成本，而是用结构化稀疏矩阵加硬件友好实现争取表达力和吞吐的平衡。它还给出一个有用信号：单一 SSM 形式未必最合适，Flash PD-SSM 与 DeltaNet 的混合在语言建模上优于纯 Flash PD-SSM 和纯 DeltaNet。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是重做 PD-SSM 中输入相关结构化稀疏矩阵的选择与生成机制。原 PD-SSM 的并行 recurrence 计算虽然是线性的，但矩阵生成阶段需要 O(LN^2) 内存，抵消了结构化稀疏的优势。Flash PD-SSM 把这一部分降到 O(LN)，同时保持原先关于状态追踪能力的理论保证。工程上，作者实现了定制 Triton/CUDA kernel，用于结构化线性 recurrence，避免通用稀疏算子的调度和内存访问损耗。语言模型部分还构造了 Delta-PD，即 Flash PD-SSM 与 DeltaNet 层的混合模型，用 MAD mechanistic capability 的结果辅助决定混合方式，而不是只做单层替换。
summary.experiments: 效率实验显示，在序列长度 5120 下，Flash PD-SSM 训练速度比 DeltaNet 快 18%，比 Mamba2 快 4%，显存比二者都低 12% 以上。合成状态追踪任务上，Flash PD-SSM 平均长度泛化准确率为 96.3%，高于 Mamba2 的 58.9%、Mamba3 的 90.7%、Gated DeltaProduct 的 80.7%。MAD mechanistic capability 测试中，Flash PD-SSM 为 69.2%，接近 Mamba 的 69.3%。自然语言状态追踪方面，作者扩展 Box 数据集到最多 26 次状态转换，在等设置下，Flash PD-SSM 的分布外长度泛化准确率最高比 Mamba2 高 10%。语言建模实验使用 FineWeb100B 进行完整预训练，Delta-PD 的平均准确率为 42.3%，高于纯 Flash PD-SSM 的 38.5% 和纯 DeltaNet 的 41.3%；吞吐为 253k tokens/s，而纯 DeltaNet 为 168k tokens/s，约为 1.5 倍。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 45 分钟。优先看方法部分中矩阵选择机制如何把 O(LN^2) 降到 O(LN)，这是论文的核心。然后看 Section 4.1 的吞吐和显存曲线，判断 kernel 优化带来的实际收益是否足以支撑大规模预训练。状态追踪实验值得看任务设置和长度外推结果，因为它直接对应 SSM 是否能稳定维护离散状态。语言建模部分重点看 Delta-PD 的层混合设计和 FineWeb100B 结果，不必过度关注时间序列任务，除非关心长序列非文本建模。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical bottleneck in structured sparse SSMs. PD-SSM has strong finite-state tracking expressivity, close to unstructured transition matrices, but its input-dependent sparse transition generation requires O(LN^2) memory. This makes the original design much slower than production-oriented SSMs such as Mamba2. Flash PD-SSM aims to keep the expressivity benefit while making the layer competitive in throughput and memory.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to pretraining architecture design, especially for hybrid Transformer-SSM models. It makes a useful point: the cost of an SSM layer is not only the asymptotic recurrence, but also how the transition matrix is parameterized, generated, and mapped to hardware. The paper also suggests that hybridizing different efficient sequence layers can be better than choosing a single SSM family. The Delta-PD results indicate that Flash PD-SSM may be more useful as one component in a mixed architecture than as a full replacement for all sequence layers.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key change is a new selection mechanism for the structured sparse transition matrices used by PD-SSM. The original PD-SSM recurrence can be evaluated with linear-complexity structured sparse matrix multiplication, but generating the input-dependent matrices costs O(LN^2) memory. Flash PD-SSM reduces this generation cost to O(LN) while retaining the theoretical state-tracking guarantees. The algorithmic change is paired with custom Triton/CUDA kernels for the structured linear recurrence, avoiding the overheads of generic sparse operations. For language modeling, the paper also introduces Delta-PD, a hybrid of Flash PD-SSM and DeltaNet layers, motivated by mechanistic capability tests rather than by a blind layer swap.
summary_en.experiments: At sequence length 5120, Flash PD-SSM trains 18% faster than DeltaNet and 4% faster than Mamba2, with more than 12% lower memory usage than both. On synthetic state-tracking tasks, it reaches 96.3% average length-generalization accuracy, compared with 58.9% for Mamba2, 90.7% for Mamba3, and 80.7% for Gated DeltaProduct. On the MAD mechanistic capability benchmark, it scores 69.2%, close to Mamba at 69.3%. On an extended Box natural-language state-tracking dataset with up to 26 state transitions, it improves out-of-distribution length generalization over Mamba2 by up to 10% in matched settings. In language modeling, the authors pretrain on FineWeb100B. Delta-PD reaches 42.3% average accuracy, above pure Flash PD-SSM at 38.5% and pure DeltaNet at 41.3%, while improving throughput from 168k tokens/s for DeltaNet to 253k tokens/s.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30 to 45 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Focus first on the matrix selection mechanism and the O(LN^2) to O(LN) memory reduction. Then inspect the throughput and memory results in Section 4.1, since the paper depends heavily on the hardware realization. The state-tracking experiments are worth reading because they test a capability that diagonal SSMs often struggle with. For LLM architecture work, the most relevant part is the Delta-PD language modeling setup and its FineWeb100B results. The time-series experiments are less central unless long non-text sequences are a direct concern.

recommendation.zh: 看表达力证明和真实 LM 表；若只赢合成 FSA 就当架构备查，若大规模困惑度也赢才值得复现。
recommendation.en: Check the expressivity proof and real LM tables; if it only wins synthetic FSA tasks, keep it as architecture background, not a pretrain recipe.

paper.title: OScaR: The Occam's Razor for Extreme KV Cache Quantization in LLMs and Beyond
paper.abstract: The rapid advancement toward long-context reasoning and multi-modal intelligence has made the memory footprint of the Key-Value (KV) cache a dominant memory bottleneck for efficient deployment. While the established per-channel quantization effectively accommodates intrinsic channel-wise outliers in Key tensors, its efficacy diminishes under extreme compression. In this work, we revisit the inherent limitations of the per-channel quantization paradigm from both empirical and theoretical perspect

summary.core_problem: 论文讨论极低比特 KV cache 量化中的一个具体瓶颈：per-channel Key 量化在 INT2 这类强压缩下失效，不只是因为 channel outlier，而是因为不同 token 的 Key/Value 范数差异过大。作者把这个现象定义为 Token Norm Imbalance，简称 TNI。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏推理效率，不是预训练方法论文。对基座研究的启发在于：长上下文和多模态模型的部署瓶颈会反过来约束模型设计，尤其是 KV cache 的统计分布。论文把 KV 量化误差从 channel outlier 重新定位到 token-wise norm imbalance，有助于理解为什么一些训练后量化方法在短上下文或中等比特下有效，但在极低比特、长上下文、多模态输入下不稳。
summary.technical_approach: OScaR 是一个 training-free 的 KV cache 量化框架，目标是在不引入复杂辅助模块的情况下改善极低比特量化。方法有两个核心步骤。第一步是 Canalized Rotation，用 Hadamard transform 先旋转 Key/Value 表示，避免后续 token scaling 把局部大值放大成新的 outlier，作者称为 Scaling-Induced Outlier Artifacts。第二步是 Omni-Token Scaling，对序列维度做归一化，缓解不同 token 范数差异带来的共享量化参数失配。它不是放弃 per-channel 量化，而是在 per-channel 框架前后加入轻量的 token 归一化和旋转，使量化尺度同时适配 channel outlier 和 token norm imbalance。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在 text-only、multi-modal、omni-modal LLM 上评测，并在 INT2 KV cache 量化下保持接近无损的性能。全文片段中没有给出完整表格数字，但作者强调 OScaR 相比依赖额外参数、在线校正或复杂补偿机制的方法，有更低计算开销，并配套实现了 CUDA kernel。关键实验应包括：TNI 与量化误差的相关性分析、per-channel 量化在极低比特下的退化、Canalized Rotation 与 Omni-Token Scaling 的消融，以及不同模态模型上的吞吐和显存对比。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 TNI 的实证分析和理论推导，再看 OScaR 的两个组件消融。系统实现部分适合做 serving 或长上下文推理的人细读。对预训练研究员来说，重点不是具体 CUDA 优化，而是 KV cache 中 token-wise norm 分布是否可以在训练阶段被正则化或通过架构设计改善。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in extreme low-bit KV-cache quantization. Per-channel Key quantization works reasonably well when channel-wise outliers dominate, but degrades under INT2-level compression because tokens can have highly imbalanced norms. The authors name this property Token Norm Imbalance, or TNI.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-efficiency paper, not a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is that long-context and multimodal deployment constraints expose representation statistics that are often ignored during training. The main useful idea is the shift from viewing Key quantization only through channel outliers to analyzing token-wise norm imbalance, which may explain why some post-training quantization methods fail in long-context or multimodal settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: OScaR is a training-free KV-cache quantization method. It keeps the per-channel quantization paradigm but adds two lightweight operations. First, Canalized Rotation applies a Hadamard transform to reduce scaling-induced outlier artifacts before token scaling. Second, Omni-Token Scaling normalizes sequence-level token norms so that shared quantization parameters are less affected by TNI. The design avoids extra learned parameters and heavy online correction mechanisms, aiming for a simpler path to INT2 KV quantization.
summary_en.experiments: The provided text reports evaluations across text-only, multimodal, and omni-modal LLMs, with near-lossless behavior under INT2 KV-cache quantization. Exact tables are not available in the supplied content. The important experimental axes are likely the empirical link between TNI and quantization error, degradation of vanilla per-channel quantization at extreme bit widths, ablations of rotation and token scaling, and comparisons of memory, latency, and throughput with more complex KV-quantization baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the TNI analysis, the error-amplification argument, and the ablation of Canalized Rotation versus Omni-Token Scaling. The CUDA and kernel sections are most relevant for serving work. For pretraining researchers, the interesting question is whether token-norm imbalance can be shaped during training rather than repaired only at inference time.

recommendation.zh: 只看 TNI 分析和极低比特消融；若结论成立，KV 量化瓶颈不应再只盯 channel outlier。
recommendation.en: Read the TNI analysis and low-bit ablations; if the result holds, KV quantization should not be framed only around channel outliers.

paper.title: Efficient Long-Context Modeling in Diffusion Language Models via Block Approximate Sparse Attention
paper.abstract: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) enable globally coherent, bidirectional, and controllable text generation, offering advantages over traditional autoregressive LLMs, while scaling to ultra-long sequences remains costly. Many existing block-sparse attention methods select blocks by fixed sampling patterns over the high-resolution attention space, such as tail regions or anti-diagonal stripes. Such prior-driven sampling can miss salient tokens and introduce instability under distribution shifts. I

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 diffusion language model 在超长上下文下的注意力开销问题：如何在不重新训练、不依赖固定位置先验的情况下，为 DLM 构造稳定的 block-sparse attention。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在两个方面。第一，DLM/Masked Diffusion LM 要走向长上下文，不能只复用自回归模型里依赖局部窗口、尾部 token 或对角线模式的稀疏策略，因为 DLM 的双向去噪过程会改变注意力分布。第二，论文把 block-sparse attention 的误差来源具体化到 block 内 QK 范数差异和协方差近似，这比单纯设计一个稀疏 pattern 更有分析价值。它更偏 efficient long-context modeling，不是新的预训练目标，但对训练和推理阶段的 DLM 扩展都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 BA-Att。核心做法是先在下采样后的 block 空间里评估 block 重要性，再决定稀疏注意力，而不是先在高分辨率 attention map 上按固定模式采样、再做 block 聚合。这样可以减少对位置先验的依赖。论文还引入一个 oracle attention map，用 post-downsampling 的结果定义理想稀疏选择，并分析 pre-downsampling 与 oracle 之间的近似误差。误差分析指出，block 内 QK pair 的范数范围越大，attention 越分散，block 级近似越困难。为此作者加入 norm-sorting：按 token 范数重排，使高激活 token 更容易聚集，复杂度为 O(LD)。另外加入 covariance compensation，用 QK 方差的对角组合近似完整协方差项，把原本可能需要 O(LD^2) 的修正降到 O(LD)。和 SeerAttention 这类带学习门控的方法相比，BA-Att 不需要额外训练；和 StreamingLLM、MInference、XAttention 这类固定或启发式稀疏模式相比，它在下采样空间内做覆盖式搜索，更少依赖某一种注意力形状假设。
summary.experiments: 论文报告在 128K 序列长度下，相比 FlashAttention 最高达到 6.95 倍加速。在不同 DLM 上集成后，约 50% sparsity 时可以接近 full attention 的效果。作者还把方法用于视频生成场景，报告在保留生成质量的同时降低注意力计算。消融的主要信息是：只做 block 级近似会受 block 内范数差异影响；norm-sorting 能缓解高激活 token 分散的问题；covariance compensation 进一步修正下采样近似误差。需要注意，给出的材料没有完整列出具体模型规模、数据规模、评测集和每项指标表格，因此实验数字只能以论文摘要和引言中披露的信息为准。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。优先看方法部分中 pre-downsampling 与 post-downsampling 的定义、oracle attention map 的构造，以及误差上界如何引出 norm-sorting 和 covariance compensation。实验部分重点看三类结果：128K 长度下的速度曲线，50% sparsity 附近与 full attention 的质量差距，以及 norm-sorting / covariance compensation 的消融。对做 DLM 长上下文训练的人，最值得深挖的是它是否会改变训练时的 attention 统计，以及 token 重排与 RoPE、双向 denoising timestep 之间是否存在额外交互。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the attention cost of diffusion language models under ultra-long contexts: how to build a training-free block-sparse attention scheme that remains robust without relying on fixed positional priors.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is in long-context scaling for DLMs and masked diffusion LMs. Sparse patterns inherited from autoregressive models often assume locality, tail-heavy attention, or diagonal structures. Those assumptions are less reliable for bidirectional denoising, where attention can be more distributed and timestep-dependent. The paper is not a new language modeling objective, but it gives a useful efficiency mechanism and a concrete error analysis for block-level approximation in DLM-style models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, BA-Att, evaluates block quality directly in a downsampled block space before selecting sparse attention blocks. This differs from methods that sample fixed regions in the high-resolution attention map and then aggregate them. The paper defines an oracle attention map induced by post-downsampling computation and studies the approximation gap between the pre-downsampled scheme and this oracle. The analysis shows that large intra-block norm ranges in QK pairs make attention more dispersed and degrade block approximation. BA-Att therefore adds a lightweight norm-sorting module with O(LD) complexity to cluster high-activation tokens. It also adds a covariance-compensated correction, approximating the full covariance term with diagonal combinations of QK variances, reducing the correction cost from O(LD^2) to O(LD). Compared with learned gating methods, it requires no extra training. Compared with fixed sparse patterns such as tail, vertical-slash, or anti-diagonal heuristics, it searches over the downsampled space more directly.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports up to 6.95x speedup over FlashAttention at 128K sequence length. When integrated into multiple DLMs, the method is reported to match full-attention quality at roughly 50% sparsity. It is also evaluated in video generation, where the reported results suggest a better quality-efficiency trade-off than prior sparse attention baselines. The most informative ablations are the ones isolating block approximation, norm-sorting, and covariance compensation. The provided material does not include the full experimental tables, model sizes, datasets, or per-metric numbers, so the quantitative summary should be read with that limitation.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–45 minute skim is enough. Focus on the definitions of pre-downsampling versus post-downsampling, the oracle attention map, and the derivation that links approximation error to intra-block QK norm variation. Then check the ablations for norm-sorting and covariance compensation. For researchers working on long-context DLM pretraining, the open questions are whether token norm sorting changes training-time attention statistics, how it interacts with RoPE, and whether the approximation remains stable across denoising timesteps.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和误差分析即可；DLM 长上下文的关键不是复用 AR 稀疏先验，而是重新定义哪些 block 在去噪时重要。
recommendation.en: Read the method and error analysis; the useful signal is that long-context DLMs need saliency-driven sparsity rather than reused AR positional priors.

paper.title: KVBuffer: IO-aware Serving for Linear Attention
paper.abstract: Linear attention has recently gained significant attention for long-context inference due to its constant decoding cost with respect to context length. However, existing serving systems typically serve linear attention by recurrently computing and updating a large linear attention state in every decoding step. Since the state is much larger than the per-token key and value, recurrent decoding incurs substantial memory access and becomes inefficient for serving linear attention. In this paper, we

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是线性注意力模型 serving 中的 IO 瓶颈。线性注意力解码算力随上下文长度近似常数，但现有系统通常每步都读写一个 d×d 的线性注意力状态。这个状态远大于单 token 的 KV，例如 Qwen3-Next 的 Gated DeltaNet 层约 2MB。结果是长上下文收益被显存带宽和状态更新的串行性吃掉， speculative decoding 和短上下文场景尤其明显。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是核心论文，但对线性注意力和混合架构能否落到真实推理系统有直接参考价值。Qwen3-Next、MiniMax 等模型已经采用 softmax attention 与 linear attention 交错的结构，训练侧看到的理论复杂度优势，只有在 serving 侧把状态 IO 处理好才会转化为吞吐优势。这篇论文的启发在于：线性注意力的系统瓶颈不只是算子 FLOPs，而是状态表示形式和更新粒度。
summary.technical_approach: KVBuffer 的做法是缓存连续生成 token 的 key/value，不在每个 decoding step 立即更新线性注意力状态，而是等 buffer 满后批量并行 flush。这样会增加一部分 KV 读写，但减少了更昂贵的线性状态读写。论文给出一个 IO trade-off 分析：在隐藏维度为 d 时，chunkwise decoding 的平均内存访问在 buffer size 约为 2√d 时较优。对 speculative decoding，它不再为每个 draft token 递推生成临时线性状态，而是先缓存 draft token 的 KV，并行完成验证，只用 accepted tokens 更新主状态。对短上下文，如果 token 数不超过 d，则直接保留全部 KV 并从 KV 计算输出，完全避免创建 d×d 状态。
summary.experiments: 实现基于 SGLang，目标模型是带 Gated DeltaNet 的 Qwen3-Next。核心结果包括：普通解码中，KVBuffer 最高降低 linear attention decoding latency 45.17%；speculative decoding 中，随着 draft token 数增加，KVBuffer 降低 verification latency，并提高可同时服务的最大 request 数，端到端 serving throughput 最高提升 1.46×；短上下文实验显示，KV-only decoding 比 recurrent decoding 和 chunkwise decoding 都更高效。这些结果说明线性注意力 serving 需要按 context length、draft length 和状态大小动态选择计算形式。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 2.2 对 recurrent serving 的瓶颈拆解，3.2 的 IO 模型和 2√d buffer size 推导，以及 speculative decoding 部分。实验部分重点看 Qwen3-Next 上 latency、throughput、max served requests 随 draft token 数变化的图表。对做预训练架构的人，最有用的是理解 linear attention state 的系统代价，这会反过来影响是否采用更大的 state、更多 linear 层，或 softmax/linear 的交错比例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an IO bottleneck in serving linear-attention LLMs. Linear attention has constant decoding compute with respect to context length, but current serving systems usually read and write a large d×d recurrent state at every decoding step. This state can be orders of magnitude larger than per-token KV; for example, a Qwen3-Next Gated DeltaNet layer has a state of about 2MB. The issue becomes worse for speculative decoding and for short-context requests.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-systems paper, not a pretraining-method paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research is that the practical value of linear or hybrid attention architectures depends on serving-time state management. The paper shows that the bottleneck is often not arithmetic cost, but memory traffic caused by how the linear-attention state is represented and updated.
summary_en.technical_approach: KVBuffer stores recent keys and values and updates the linear-attention state in chunks instead of recurrently at every token. The extra KV traffic is offset by fewer reads and writes of the much larger state. The paper derives an IO trade-off and argues that a buffer size around 2√d minimizes average memory access per decoding step for hidden dimension d. For speculative decoding, KVBuffer avoids materializing temporary recurrent states for each draft token; it verifies draft tokens in parallel using buffered KV and updates the main state only with accepted tokens. For short contexts with at most d tokens, it uses KV-only decoding and never creates the d×d state.
summary_en.experiments: The implementation is in SGLang for Qwen3-Next with Gated DeltaNet layers. KVBuffer reduces linear-attention decoding latency by up to 45.17%. In speculative decoding, it lowers verification latency, allows more concurrent requests as the number of draft tokens grows, and improves end-to-end serving throughput by up to 1.46×. The short-context results show that KV-only decoding can be faster than both recurrent and chunkwise decoding.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough; budget 20 to 30 minutes. Read Section 2.2 for the recurrent-state bottleneck, Section 3.2 for the IO model and the 2√d buffer-size argument, and the speculative-decoding design. In the experiments, focus on latency, throughput, and maximum served-request curves. For architecture researchers, the useful lesson is that linear-attention state size should be treated as a serving constraint, not only a modeling detail.

recommendation.zh: 线性注意力如果是内部路线，建议看方法图和 IO 分析；它提醒不要只拿 O(1) 解码复杂度做架构判断。
recommendation.en: If linear attention is on your roadmap, read the method diagram and IO analysis; O(1) decoding is not a sufficient serving argument.

paper.title: GoLongRL: Capability-Oriented Long Context Reinforcement Learning with Multitask Alignment
paper.abstract: We present GoLongRL, a fully open-source, capability-oriented post-training recipe for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Existing long-context RL methods often treat data construction as a matter of designing increasingly complex retrieval paths, leading to homogeneous task coverage and reward formulations that inadequately reflect practical long-context requirements. Our work offers two contributions. (1) Capability-oriented data construction with full open rel

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决长上下文 RLVR 中两个具体问题：训练数据过度集中在人工设计的复杂检索路径，导致能力覆盖单一；不同任务使用 EM、F1、NDCG、ROUGE-L 等异质奖励，直接用标准 GRPO 时会带来奖励尺度和难度偏差。
summary.importance: 它的价值在于把长上下文后训练从“构造更复杂的 needle/retrieval 任务”转向“按能力组织数据和奖励”。这对预训练研究也有参考意义：长上下文能力不只来自 context window 扩展或中训练，后训练数据的任务覆盖、奖励形式和优势估计方式会显著影响模型是否真正利用长上下文。尤其是 23K 规模的数据能让 30B-A3B 模型接近更大 thinking 模型的长上下文表现，说明数据结构和奖励多样性可能比单纯扩大 RL 数据量更关键。
summary.technical_approach: GoLongRL 包含两部分。第一是 capability-oriented RLVR dataset，共 23K 样本，覆盖 9 类长上下文任务。约 14K 样本来自已有开源长上下文语料的筛选和改造，约 9K 样本由真实源文档合成，来源包括书籍、学术论文和多轮对话。每类任务保留自然评价指标作为奖励，而不是统一压成一个二值正确性信号。第二是 TMN-Reweight。它用 task-level mean normalization 对齐不同任务的奖励尺度，避免 per-prompt normalization 抹掉样本难度信息；再用基于平滑 pass rate 的 difficulty-adaptive weighting，提高有信息量的困难正样本权重，降低过易样本的重复梯度贡献。这个设计针对的是多任务长上下文 RL 中的 advantage estimation，而不是改动模型架构。
summary.experiments: 在相同 vanilla GRPO 设置下，使用 GoLongRL 数据训练 Qwen3-4B-Thinking，长上下文平均分从 53.0 提升到 62.2；加入 TMN-Reweight 后进一步到 63.0。Qwen3-30B-A3B 从 60.1 提升到 69.8，并优于使用 QwenLong-L1.5 数据训练的对应设置。图中 GoLongRL-30B-A3B 在 DocMath、LongBench-V2、Frames、MRCR、CorpusQA、LBV1-QA 上分别为 65.3、55.1、74.5、81.6、73.6、68.7，平均 69.8。论文还报告通用能力没有明显损失，MMLU-Pro、AIME24/25、GPQA 等评测保持或改善，并在 agentic memory、long-term dialogue memory 等未训练场景有迁移。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。先看任务 taxonomy 和数据构造流程，重点确认 9 类任务是否覆盖真实长上下文使用：多文档 QA、摘要、排序、聚合、结构化推理等能力比单一检索链更有意义。然后看 TMN-Reweight 的公式，尤其是它如何替代 prompt-level 标准化，以及 difficulty weight 如何由 pass rate 得到。实验部分优先看同模型、同 GRPO 设置下与 QwenLong-L1.5 数据的对比，这能隔离数据本身的贡献。消融表比总榜更重要，因为它说明收益来自能力覆盖、奖励多样性，还是优化重加权。
summary.authors_note: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences；作者姓名在给定内容中未显示。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two bottlenecks in long-context RLVR. First, many existing datasets overemphasize synthetic retrieval paths, which narrows capability coverage. Second, heterogeneous rewards such as EM, F1, NDCG, and ROUGE-L interact poorly with standard GRPO, creating reward-scale mismatch and biased advantage estimates across tasks with different difficulty levels.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a post-training recipe, but it has clear implications for foundation-model training. Long-context capability is not only a matter of extending the context window during pretraining or mid-training. Models also need post-training signals that cover the ways long contexts are actually used: aggregation, ranking, summarization, structured reasoning, and multi-document analysis. The results suggest that task coverage and reward diversity can be a primary bottleneck in long-context RL, even at modest data scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: GoLongRL combines a capability-oriented RLVR dataset with a multitask optimization adjustment. The dataset contains 23K samples across 9 long-context task types. Around 14K samples are curated from open long-context corpora, while around 9K synthetic samples are generated from real source documents, including books, academic papers, and multi-turn dialogues. Each task keeps its natural metric as the reward instead of being forced into a single binary format. The optimization method, TMN-Reweight, has two components. Task-level mean normalization aligns reward scales across tasks while preserving prompt-level difficulty information. Difficulty-adaptive reweighting uses a smoothed pass rate to emphasize informative hard positives and reduce redundant gradients from easy prompts. The method keeps the model architecture unchanged and targets the advantage-estimation problem in heterogeneous long-context RL.
summary_en.experiments: Under the same vanilla GRPO setup, training on the GoLongRL dataset improves Qwen3-4B-Thinking from 53.0 to 62.2 average on long-context benchmarks. TMN-Reweight further raises the 4B average to 63.0. For Qwen3-30B-A3B, the average improves from 60.1 to 69.8. The 30B GoLongRL model reports 65.3 on DocMath, 55.1 on LongBench-V2, 74.5 on Frames, 81.6 on MRCR, 73.6 on CorpusQA, and 68.7 on LBV1-QA, with a 69.8 average. It also outperforms the corresponding QwenLong-L1.5 GRPO setting. General capabilities are reported as preserved or improved on evaluations such as MMLU-Pro, AIME24/25, and GPQA, with transfer to agentic memory and long-term dialogue memory benchmarks not used in training.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the task taxonomy and data pipeline, because the main claim depends on whether the 9 task types reflect real long-context usage rather than another retrieval-heavy mixture. Then read the TMN-Reweight formulation carefully: how task-level normalization differs from prompt-level normalization, and how pass-rate-based difficulty weights affect gradient allocation. In the experiments, prioritize controlled comparisons under the same base model and GRPO setup, especially against QwenLong-L1.5 data. The ablation tables are more informative than the aggregate benchmark figure because they identify whether the gains come from data coverage, reward diversity, or the reweighting algorithm.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; author names are not shown in the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 long-context 能力到底是算法学出来的还是数据喂出来的，这篇值得看；先看同一 GRPO 下仅换数据的 ablation，那里信息密度最高。
recommendation.en: Read this if you care whether long-context gains come from RL algorithms or simply from better task/reward design; the highest-signal part is the fixed-GRPO, data-only ablation.

paper.title: PEEK: Context Map as an Orientation Cache for Long-Context LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over long and recurring external contexts, like document corpora and code repositories. Across invocations, existing approaches preserve either the agent's trajectory, passive access to raw material, or task-level strategies. None of them preserves what we argue is most needed for repeated same-context workloads: reusable orientation knowledge (e.g., what the context contains, how it is organized, and which entities, constants, and schemas h

summary.core_problem: PEEK 解决的是长上下文 Agent 在反复访问同一外部语料、代码库或文档集合时缺少“上下文方位感”的问题。现有方法保留聊天轨迹、压缩历史、检索原文或积累任务策略，但很少维护一个关于外部上下文本身的、可复用的小型结构化记忆。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不是预训练方法，但对长上下文和 Agent 训练有方法论意义。它把长期记忆从“保存更多历史”转向“保存可迁移的上下文地图”：语料里有什么、结构如何、哪些 schema、常量、实体和证据位置反复有用。对基座研究的启发在于，长上下文能力不只取决于窗口长度，也取决于模型能否形成稳定的外部环境索引。未来如果要训练长期工作流模型，这类 orientation knowledge 可以成为数据构造、过程监督和评测目标。
summary.technical_approach: PEEK 在 system prompt 中维护一个固定 token 预算的 context map。这个 map 不是 KV-cache，也不是聊天摘要，而是面向外部上下文的语义索引。系统包含三个模块：Distiller 从 Agent 执行轨迹中抽取可复用的上下文知识；Cartographer 把抽取结果转成结构化编辑，更新 map；Evictor 在固定预算下按优先级淘汰低价值内容。论文强调抽取与编辑要分离，否则容易把一次性任务事实、对话噪声和重复内容写入 map。相比 RAG，PEEK 不只是被动取回片段；相比 prompt learning，它维护的不是通用任务策略，而是某个固定外部上下文的方位知识。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两类长上下文任务：reasoning and aggregation，以及 context learning。PEEK 在 OOLONG 上相对各类 baseline 提升 6.3–34.0%；在 CL-bench 上 solving rate 提升 6.0–14.0%，rubric accuracy 提升 7.8–12.1%。相对强 prompt-learning baseline，PEEK 在 OOLONG 上提升 10.7%，在 CL-bench 上 solving rate / rubric accuracy 分别提升 6.0% / 9.9%。效率上，PEEK 在 OOLONG 比该 prompt-learning baseline 少 93–145 次迭代；成本上，OOLONG 低 1.7–5.8 倍，CL-bench 低约 1.4 倍。泛化实验显示，收益可迁移到 GPT-5.5、Qwen3-Coder-Next-FP8，以及不同 Agent backbone OpenAI Codex。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。先看 Figure 2，理解它如何区分 Agent/Task State 与 External Context State，以及 active/passive context management。再看方法部分的 Distiller、Cartographer、Evictor，重点关注 context map 的写入规则和 eviction 规则。Section 4.5 的消融值得看，因为它说明为什么不能直接把执行轨迹摘要写进 map。实验部分优先看 OOLONG 和 CL-bench 的质量、迭代次数、成本三组指标，而不只看最终 accuracy。

summary_en.core_problem: PEEK addresses a recurring-context problem in long-context LLM agents. When an agent repeatedly works over the same document collection, repository, or corpus, existing systems preserve chat history, retrieve raw material, compact transcripts, or learn task-level prompts. They usually do not maintain reusable orientation knowledge about the external context itself.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to long-context model research and agent training. The key idea is to preserve a compact context map rather than more conversation history. The map records what the external context contains, how it is organized, and which entities, schemas, constants, or evidence locations have been useful. For foundation-model work, the implication is clear: long-context performance is not only about context length or retrieval quality. Models and agents also need stable, reusable indexes over their working environment. This can inform future data construction, process supervision, and evaluations for persistent workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: PEEK maintains a fixed-budget context map inside the system prompt. The map is not a KV-cache and not a transcript summary. It is a curated semantic index over a recurring external context. The system has three modules. The Distiller extracts transferable contextual knowledge from execution trajectories. The Cartographer converts extracted knowledge into structured map edits. The Evictor enforces the token budget through priority-based eviction. The separation between extraction and editing is important, because direct updates from trajectories tend to leak task-specific facts, duplicate entries, and noisy observations into the map. Compared with RAG, PEEK actively maintains orientation knowledge rather than only retrieving passages. Compared with prompt learning, it stores context-specific knowledge rather than task procedures.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates PEEK on reasoning-and-aggregation tasks and context-learning tasks. On OOLONG, PEEK improves over baselines by 6.3–34.0%. On CL-bench, it improves solving rate by 6.0–14.0% and rubric accuracy by 7.8–12.1%. Against a strong prompt-learning baseline, PEEK gains 10.7% on OOLONG and 6.0% / 9.9% on CL-bench solving rate / rubric accuracy. It is also more efficient: on OOLONG it uses 93–145 fewer iterations than that prompt-learning baseline, and costs 1.7–5.8x less; on CL-bench it costs about 1.4x less. The gains transfer across models, including GPT-5.5 and Qwen3-Coder-Next-FP8, and across agent backbones such as OpenAI Codex.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is appropriate. Start with Figure 2 to understand the distinction between Agent/Task State and External Context State, and between active and passive context management. Then read the method description of the Distiller, Cartographer, and Evictor, with special attention to how map updates and evictions are controlled. Section 4.5 is useful because it explains why simply summarizing trajectories into the map is not enough. In the experiments, focus on the three-way tradeoff among quality, number of iterations, and cost, rather than only the final task score.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统设计和 ablation：orientation cache 是比轨迹记忆更干净的变量，可借鉴到长上下文数据构造。
recommendation.en: Skim the design and ablations: orientation caching is a cleaner variable than trajectory memory and may inform long-context data construction.

paper.title: Context Memorization for Efficient Long Context Generation
paper.abstract: Modern large language model (LLM) applications increasingly rely on long conditioning prefixes to control model behavior at inference time. While prefix-augmented inference is effective, it incurs two structural limitations: i) the prefix's influence fades as generation proceeds, and ii) attention computation over the prefix scales linearly with its length. Existing approaches either keep the prefix in attention while compressing it, or internalize it into model parameters through gradient-based

summary.core_problem: 解决长前缀条件生成中两个问题：前缀影响随生成变弱，以及每步都对长前缀做 attention 带来的线性开销。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是推理系统与长上下文效率方法。它尝试把固定 prefix 从在线 attention 中移出，用训练免费记忆替代完整前缀重算，对 prompt-heavy 应用和长上下文 serving 有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 attention-state memory：预先计算 prefix 与 query token 之间的 attention states，并存入轻量 lookup memory。推理时模型不再完整 attending over prefix，而是检索这些预计算状态来保留前缀控制信号。方法不需要梯度训练，也比把 prefix 内化进参数更容易更新。
summary.experiments: 在 ManyICLBench 上使用 LLaMA-3.1-8B 评估；摘要报告在 1K 到 8K memory budget 下，相比常规 in-context learning 提升准确率，同时降低 prefix attention latency。具体延迟和准确率幅度需看正文表格。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets two issues in long-prefix generation: prefix influence fades over time, and attention over the prefix scales linearly with prefix length.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency and long-context systems contribution. It tries to move fixed prefixes out of online attention through a training-free memory, which is relevant for prompt-heavy applications and serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, attention-state memory, precomputes attention states between prefix and query tokens and stores them in a lightweight lookup memory. At inference time, the model retrieves these states instead of attending over the full prefix. It avoids gradient-based parameter updates and supports easier prefix changes.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use LLaMA-3.1-8B on ManyICLBench. The abstract reports better accuracy than standard in-context learning under 1K–8K memory budgets while reducing attention latency over the prefix.

recommendation.zh: 读 §方法和延迟表即可；若结果稳，prefix-as-memory 比继续压 KV 更像可落地 serving trick。
recommendation.en: Read the method and latency table; if the numbers hold, prefix-as-memory is a more deployable serving trick than yet another KV compression variant.
