Existing long-context RL methods often treat data construction as a matter of designing increasingly complex retrieval paths, leading to homogeneous task coverage and reward formulations that inadequately reflect practical long-context requirements. Our work offers two contributions. (1) Capability-oriented data construction with full open rel

summary.core_problem: 解决长上下文 RLVR 训练中过度依赖检索路径设计、任务覆盖单一、奖励定义与真实长上下文能力脱节的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练数据与训练 recipe 工作，价值不在新 RL 算法，而在把长上下文能力拆成可操作的能力 taxonomy，并公开 23K 样本、构造流程和训练代码。对预训练研究员的意义在于：它提供了一个更干净的长上下文能力分解视角，可反过来检验预训练阶段到底缺了哪些能力。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 capability-oriented 的 RLVR 数据构造，而不是继续堆复杂 retrieval path。作者按长上下文能力分类组织 9 类任务，并为每类任务配自然评测指标；数据由两部分组成：从开源语料筛选的真实样本，以及基于书籍、论文、多轮对话等真实长文档生成的合成 QA。训练上使用 vanilla GRPO，强调在相同 RL 设置下，仅替换数据即可带来收益，并通过 multitask alignment 让不同长上下文能力共同训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要可确认的数据规模为 23K RLVR 样本，覆盖 9 类长上下文任务；实验主张是在相同 vanilla GRPO 设置下，仅靠该数据集就能优于现有长上下文 RL 方法。摘要未给出模型参数量、训练 token 或具体提升幅度，因此当前更应把它看作数据配方与任务设计信号，而不是已被充分定量验证的范式结论。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets a mismatch in long-context RLVR: existing methods over-index on retrieval-path engineering, cover a narrow task set, and use rewards that poorly reflect real long-context capabilities.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training data/recipe paper rather than a new RL algorithm. Its value lies in turning long-context ability into an explicit capability taxonomy, with a fully open 23K-sample dataset, construction pipeline, and code. For pretraining researchers, the useful part is the cleaner decomposition of what long-context competence actually consists of.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key idea is capability-oriented RLVR data construction instead of increasingly complex retrieval-path design. The dataset spans 9 task types aligned with a taxonomy of long-context capabilities, each paired with a natural evaluation metric. Data comes from curated open-source samples plus synthetic QA built from real long documents such as books, papers, and multi-turn dialogues. Training uses vanilla GRPO, with multitask alignment across capability types.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the dataset contains 23K RLVR samples over 9 long-context task types. The main empirical claim is that under the same vanilla GRPO setup, swapping in this dataset alone outperforms prior long-context RL approaches. The abstract does not expose model size, training budget, or exact gains, so the current signal is stronger on data design than on fully quantified scaling conclusions.

recommendation.zh: 可读，但重点只在数据 taxonomy 和任务配比；如果你关心 long-context 能力到底该怎么拆，这篇比又一个花哨 RL 算法更有用，先看数据构造部分。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for the capability taxonomy and task mix, not for the RL algorithm; if you care how long-context ability should be decomposed, read the data construction sections first.

paper.title: PEEK: Context Map as an Orientation Cache for Long-Context LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over long and recurring external contexts, like document corpora and code repositories. Across invocations, existing approaches preserve either the agent's trajectory, passive access to raw material, or task-level strategies. None of them preserves what we argue is most needed for repeated same-context workloads: reusable orientation knowledge (e.g., what the context contains, how it is organized, and which entities, constants, and schemas h

summary.core_problem: 长上下文 agent 在反复访问同一外部语料或代码库时，如何保留对上下文结构与有用实体的“定向知识”，而不只是保存历史轨迹或原始文档。
summary.importance: 这是长上下文 agent 的缓存设计问题。贡献点在于提出 orientation cache / context map 这一中间表示，介于原始上下文和任务轨迹之间。对预训练本身不直接，但对长期记忆、外部上下文压缩和 recurrent workload 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PEEK，把可复用的 orientation knowledge 压成一个小而常数大小的 context map，放入后续 prompt。系统包含 Distiller、Cartographer、Prioritizer 三个模块：从推理时信号中抽取可迁移知识，转成结构化编辑，再按缓存策略维护。目标是让 agent 在重复面对同一上下文时更快定位内容、组织结构、关键实体、常用 schema 等。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark 数字，但任务场景包括长文档语料和代码仓库上的 repeated same-context workloads。比较对象应包括保留轨迹、直接访问原始上下文、任务级策略缓存等方案。论文核心评估点大概率是提示长度固定下的任务成功率、检索效率或多轮调用性能。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Omar Khattab 与 Samuel Madden，分别与检索增强、系统和数据库方向有代表性工作；这类组合通常偏系统化 agent 设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how long-context agents can preserve reusable orientation knowledge about a recurring external context, rather than only storing trajectories or raw documents.
summary_en.importance: This is a cache-design paper for long-context agents. Its main contribution is the notion of an orientation cache or context map, an intermediate representation between raw context and task trajectories. It is not directly about pretraining, but it is relevant to memory, context compression, and repeated-workload settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: PEEK stores reusable orientation knowledge as a small constant-sized context map inserted into future prompts. The system has three modules: a Distiller that extracts transferable knowledge from inference-time signals, a Cartographer that turns it into structured edits, and a Prioritizer that maintains the cache under a policy. The goal is to help the agent quickly recover what the context contains, how it is organized, and which entities or schemas matter.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete numbers, but the target workloads involve recurring long-context settings such as document corpora and code repositories. Likely baselines include trajectory memory, passive access to raw context, and task-level strategy retention. The main metrics are likely task success under fixed prompt budget, retrieval efficiency, or repeated-invocation performance.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include Omar Khattab and Samuel Madden, known for work in retrieval-augmented systems and data systems, which fits a systems-oriented agent design paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“缓存上下文结构而不是缓存 token”这个抽象挺干净；看系统图和 cache policy 即可，别指望它回答长上下文建模本身。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the abstraction is clean: cache context structure rather than tokens; read the system design and cache policy, not for answers about long-context modeling itself.

paper.title: Towards Generalization of Block Attention via Automatic Segmentation and Block Distillation
paper.abstract: Block attention, which processes the input as separate blocks that cannot attend to one another, offers significant potential to improve KV cache reuse in long-context scenarios such as Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). However, its broader application is hindered by two key challenges: the difficulty of segmenting input text into meaningful, self-contained blocks, and the inefficiency of existing block fine-tuning methods that risk degrading performance. To address these, we first construct

summary.core_problem: 解决 block attention 难以泛化到真实长上下文输入的问题：块边界难自动确定，直接微调又低效且容易损伤模型能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是长上下文推理效率方法和训练框架：把 block attention 从依赖人工分块或任务特定分块，推进到自动语义分割加教师蒸馏的通用流程，目标是提升 RAG 等场景的 KV cache 复用。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SemanticSeg，包含 3 万多个样本、16 类文本、长度 2k 到 32k，覆盖书籍、代码、网页和对话；用该数据训练轻量 segmenter 自动切分语义自洽块，并提出 block distillation，用冻结的 full-attention teacher 指导 block-attention student，避免昂贵且不稳定的 block fine-tuning。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出数据规模和覆盖范围，但未完整展示模型参数、baseline 和具体提升；核心实验应围绕自动分块质量、block distillation 相比 block fine-tuning 的效率与性能保持，以及长上下文 KV cache 复用收益。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 The Chinese University of Hong Kong、City University of Hong Kong、Tencent、Singapore Management University、Renmin University of China 等；包含 Tencent 参与，方向与长上下文推理和 RAG 缓存复用相关。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the poor generalization of block attention in realistic long-context inputs, where block boundaries are hard to choose automatically and direct fine-tuning is inefficient and performance-damaging.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a long-context inference-efficiency method and training framework. It moves block attention from manual or task-specific segmentation toward automatic semantic segmentation plus teacher distillation, targeting KV-cache reuse in RAG-like workloads.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces SemanticSeg, a dataset with over 30K examples across 16 categories and 2K–32K token lengths, covering books, code, web text, and conversations. A lightweight segmenter predicts semantically self-contained blocks, while block distillation uses a frozen full-attention teacher to train a block-attention student instead of relying on costly block fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports the dataset scale and coverage but not detailed model sizes, baselines, or numerical gains. The key experiments should test segmentation quality, efficiency and capability retention versus block fine-tuning, and KV-cache reuse benefits in long-context settings.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include The Chinese University of Hong Kong, City University of Hong Kong, Tencent, Singapore Management University, and Renmin University of China. Tencent is involved, and the work targets long-context inference and RAG cache reuse.

recommendation.zh: 只看分块数据构造和 distillation ablation；若性能不掉，这会改变 block attention 只能做工程特例的判断。
recommendation.en: Read the segmentation dataset and distillation ablations; if capability holds, it weakens the prior that block attention is only a narrow engineering trick.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: RoPE Distinguishes Neither Positions Nor Tokens in Long Contexts, Provably
paper.abstract: We identify intrinsic limitations of Rotary Positional Embeddings (RoPE) in Transformer-based long-context language models. Our theoretical analysis abstracts away from the specific content of the context and depends only on its length. We prove that as context length increases, RoPE-based attention becomes unpredictable and loses two properties that are central to its effectiveness. First, it loses its locality bias: RoPE is no more likely to favor nearer positions than substantially farther on

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是“RoPE 在工程上还能不能再调一调”，而是一个更根的问题：当上下文变长时，RoPE 作为位置机制，是否还稳定地提供了 Transformer 需要的两类信息——位置区分能力和 token 区分能力。全文给出的结论很明确：在单头注意力的抽象分析下，随着上下文长度增加，RoPE 诱导的注意力分数会变得高度不稳定，原本依赖其成立的 locality bias 与相对位置一致性都会退化。具体表现为四类失败：position inversion（更远位置反而比更近位置得分更高）、position aliasing（不同位置给出相同分数）、token inversion（两个 key token 的相对排序随位置翻转）、token aliasing（不同 token 在某些位置上不可区分）。作者强调，这些现象不依赖具体语义内容，而是由 RoPE 的旋转结构和长程相位行为内生导致的。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响主要有三层。第一，它给长上下文失效提供了机制层解释。很多长上下文模型在“标称 128K、实际几千到几万就开始掉”的现象，过去常被归因于训练数据、指令调优、检索策略或评测设置；这篇工作指出，至少有一部分问题来自位置编码本身，而不是后续工程补丁。第二，它重新定义了“上下文扩展”的边界：如果底层位置机制在统计上已经接近随机猜测，那么继续靠插值、base 调参、长度外推去拉长窗口，收益会越来越受限。第三，它对预训练设计有直接含义。RoPE 之所以被广泛采用，是因为它兼顾相对位置信号、实现简单、训练稳定；但这篇工作说明，这种优势可能只在中短上下文区间成立。对下一代长上下文预训练，位置机制本身可能需要被重新设计，而不是只在数据配比和 length annealing 上做文章。贡献类型更偏“理论诊断 + 机制证伪 + 经验验证”，不是提出替代方案，但量级不小，因为它挑战的是当前主流 LLM 的默认位置编码假设。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上最关键的地方，是作者把 RoPE 下的未归一化 attention score 写成与相对位置相关的振荡和式，并进一步在适当假设下把它近似为高斯随机变量来分析。这样做的好处是，问题从“某个具体 query-key 内容下的个案行为”转成“随上下文长度增长的统计规律”。在位置区分部分，作者分析同一 key token 放在不同位置时，score 差值的分布如何随距离和上下文长度变化。结论是：随着长度增大，RoPE 的相位叠加会让“近的更高”这件事不再稳定，position inversion 的概率趋近 0.5；也就是说，RoPE 不再系统性偏好近邻。position aliasing 则来自不同位置的旋转相位在高维上可能产生相同投影结果，导致分数碰撞。这个现象不是简单的周期重复，而是在多频率组合下依然大量存在。

在 token 区分部分，作者固定 query 和位置，比较两个不同 key token 的得分差。由于 RoPE 旋转会把 token 内容与位置相位耦合，原本在某个位置上更相关的 token，移到另一个位置后可能被另一个 token 反超，形成 token inversion；其概率同样趋近 0.5。token aliasing 则说明在某些位置上，不同 token 经 RoPE 作用后对 attention score 的贡献会重合，模型对 token 身份的判别被位置机制部分抹平。

一个很有价值的分析点是对 RoPE base 的讨论。很多工程实践会通过改 base、NTK-aware scaling、YaRN 一类方法来延长上下文。作者的理论指出，base 不是单调更优的旋钮，而是在两类失败之间做权衡：增大 base 可以减缓 token relevance 的不一致，但会削弱位置可分性；减小 base 则相反。这意味着常见长度扩展方法更像是在移动失效边界，而不是消除失效机制。正文主要聚焦单头情形，附录讨论了多头多层下为何这些问题不会自然消失：多头可能平均掉部分噪声，但只要底层位置相位结构仍在，失真不会被根治。
summary.experiments:
实验分两部分。第一部分是对理论现象的直接验证。作者在 Llama 3.1-8B 上检查 position/token inversion 与 aliasing，发现理论预测在真实模型里确实出现，而且出现得比很多人直觉上更早。文中给出的一个醒目数字是：仅在 8K 上下文范围内，就发现约 75K 对位置存在 position aliasing，而且这些别名对并不局限于相邻位置；同时大约有 150 个位置出现 token aliasing。这个结果说明问题不是极端长上下文才出现，而是在远低于标称上限时就已经普遍存在。

第二部分是端到端任务验证。作者测试了 6 个流行模型，规模从 7B 到 100B 以上，任务很简单：给定一个列表，要求返回第 k 个位置的值。这个任务刻意弱化语义理解，直接考察位置区分能力。结果是，当列表中只有 4 个不同值时，所有模型在大约 4K token 长度上就已经接近随机猜测水平。这个设计很重要，因为值域只有 4，随机基线就是 25%；如果模型连这种低熵位置检索都做不好，就很难把问题归咎于知识缺失或复杂推理。作者还比较了不同长度扩展设置，发现常见 RoPE 调整并没有从根本上修复失败模式，只是改变了失效出现的方式和区间。

从预训练视角看，实验最值得注意的不是某个 benchmark 分数，而是“失效出现得很早”。理论上讨论的是渐近行为，但经验上 4K~8K 这个区间就已经能看到明显退化，这意味着问题与训练分布外长度并不完全等价，甚至在很多模型的常用工作区间内就会影响学习和利用长程依赖。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 和“Demystifying RoPE”部分，抓住作者对 attention 两个基本目标的拆分：position identification 与 token identification。这个拆分很重要，因为很多长上下文讨论只盯着位置外推，却忽略了位置机制也会反过来扰动 token relevance。

精读重点在第 3、4 节。第 3 节看 position inversion 和 position aliasing 的定义、定理条件以及概率如何随长度变化；这里要特别注意作者不是证明“某些例子会失败”，而是在证明“失败概率趋向随机”。第 4 节看 token inversion / aliasing，这部分更容易被低估，但对语言建模更关键，因为 attention 排序不稳定会直接影响信息路由。

实验部分优先看 Llama 3.1-8B 的机制验证图和简单 list retrieval 任务。前者帮助把理论对象和真实模型对上，后者则说明这些机制缺陷会外显成可测的功能失败。附录里多头多层讨论也值得看，尤其如果关心“单头理论是否过强简化”。

深挖时可以带着三个问题读：一，RoPE 的失效是由频率设计、相位累积还是 score 聚合方式主导；二，base 调整为何只能 trade-off 而不能同时保住位置与 token 区分；三，如果要替代 RoPE，新的位置机制需要保留哪些优点，避免哪些长程振荡问题。读完后再回头看 ALiBi、线性偏置、状态空间或显式记忆类方法，会更容易形成判断。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a structural question rather than an engineering one: as context length grows, does RoPE still provide the two signals attention needs—reliable position discrimination and stable token relevance? The answer developed through the full paper is no. Under a single-head abstraction, RoPE-induced attention scores become statistically unstable with longer contexts, and the properties that made RoPE attractive start to break down. The paper formalizes four failure modes: position inversion, where a farther position can score higher than a nearer one; position aliasing, where different positions become indistinguishable in score; token inversion, where the ranking between two key tokens flips across positions; and token aliasing, where different tokens become indistinguishable at some positions. A central point is that these failures are not tied to specific semantic content. They arise from the rotary positional mechanism itself.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, the contribution matters in three ways. First, it gives a mechanistic explanation for long-context brittleness. Many failures of supposedly long-context LLMs have been attributed to data, instruction tuning, retrieval setup, or evaluation artifacts. This paper argues that part of the problem is upstream: the positional mechanism itself degrades. Second, it reframes context extension. If the underlying position signal is already approaching random behavior statistically, then interpolation tricks, base retuning, and extrapolation heuristics can only go so far. Third, it has direct implications for future pretraining design. RoPE became dominant because it is simple, efficient, and works well in standard training regimes. The paper suggests that these advantages may be local to moderate lengths, not robust to truly long contexts. The contribution is mainly a theory-backed diagnosis with empirical confirmation, not a replacement method, but it challenges a default assumption used by most current LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical core is the treatment of the unnormalized RoPE attention score as a position-dependent oscillatory sum, which is then analyzed as an approximately Gaussian random variable under mild assumptions. This move is important because it shifts the discussion from anecdotal query-key examples to length-dependent statistical behavior. For position discrimination, the paper studies how the score difference changes when the same key token is placed at different positions. As context length increases, phase interactions induced by RoPE make the preference for nearer positions unreliable; the probability of position inversion approaches 0.5. In other words, RoPE loses its locality bias in a probabilistic sense. Position aliasing comes from collisions in the rotated representation: different positions can produce the same attention score for a fixed query-key pair. The paper argues that this is not just a trivial periodicity artifact but a broader consequence of multi-frequency phase composition.

For token discrimination, the analysis fixes the query and position, then compares two different key tokens. Because RoPE couples token content with positional phase, a token that scores higher at one position can score lower at another, yielding token inversion. Its probability also tends to 0.5 with longer contexts. Token aliasing further shows that at some positions, different key tokens can become indistinguishable in their score contribution.

A particularly useful part of the paper is the discussion of the RoPE base hyperparameter. In practice, many long-context extensions rely on changing the base or applying scaling variants. The theory here says the base is not a monotonic improvement knob. Increasing it helps preserve consistency of token relevance but weakens positional separability; decreasing it does the opposite. So common length-extension methods shift the failure frontier rather than remove the underlying mechanism. The main text focuses on single-head attention, while the appendix discusses why multi-head and multi-layer stacks do not automatically eliminate the issue. Averaging across heads may smooth some effects, but the positional distortion remains rooted in the same rotary phase structure.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section has two layers. The first directly validates the theoretical phenomena. On Llama 3.1-8B, the paper measures position/token inversion and aliasing, and finds that the predicted failures appear in a real model, and much earlier than one might expect. One striking number is that within only an 8K context window, the authors identify about 75K pairs of positions exhibiting position aliasing, and these are not restricted to nearby positions. They also report around 150 positions showing token aliasing in the same range. This matters because it shows the issue is not confined to extreme context lengths.

The second layer is an end-to-end functional test. The authors evaluate six popular models ranging from 7B to over 100B on a simple list retrieval task: given a list, return the value at the k-th position. The task is intentionally low-level and minimizes semantic confounds, so it probes positional discrimination directly. With only four distinct values in the list, all tested models fall to near-random performance at around 4K tokens. Since the random baseline is 25%, this is a strong result: the models fail even on low-entropy positional lookup, where knowledge and reasoning are not the bottleneck. The paper also checks common RoPE length-extension settings and finds that they do not fundamentally remove the failure modes; they only alter where and how the degradation appears.

From a pretraining perspective, the most important empirical message is how early the degradation shows up. The theory is asymptotic, but the practical failures emerge already in the 4K–8K regime, which is within the operational range of many models and not merely an out-of-distribution extreme.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the section that decomposes what attention needs from positional encoding. The split between position identification and token identification is the conceptual anchor of the paper. Many long-context discussions focus only on extrapolating positions, while this paper shows that the same mechanism also destabilizes token relevance.

Read Sections 3 and 4 carefully. Section 3 defines position inversion and position aliasing, states the assumptions, and shows how the failure probability evolves with context length. The key point is not that failures exist, but that the probability approaches random guessing. Section 4 does the same for token inversion and token aliasing. This part is easy to underrate, but it is highly relevant for language modeling because unstable token ranking directly affects information routing in attention.

In the experiments, prioritize the mechanistic validation on Llama 3.1-8B and the simple list retrieval task. The former ties the theory to a real model; the latter shows that the mechanism surfaces as an observable capability failure. The appendix on multi-head and multi-layer settings is also worth reading if you want to judge how much the single-head abstraction limits the claims.

Three questions are useful while reading: what exactly drives the failure—frequency design, phase accumulation, or score aggregation; why base scaling only trades off token consistency against positional separability; and what a replacement positional mechanism would need to preserve from RoPE while avoiding long-range oscillatory collapse.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接动摇“RoPE 靠调参还能继续撑长上下文”的 prior；建议立刻对照内部长上下文实验复现其失效条件，重点看定理假设和 base 无效结论。
recommendation.en: This directly challenges the prior that RoPE can keep stretching with enough tuning; replicate its failure regime against your internal long-context setup, especially the theorem assumptions and the 'base does not fix it' claim.

paper.title: EndPrompt: Efficient Long-Context Extension via Terminal Anchoring
paper.abstract: Extending the context window of large language models typically requires training on sequences at the target length, incurring quadratic memory and computational costs that make long-context adaptation expensive and difficult to reproduce. We propose EndPrompt, a method that achieves effective context extension using only short training sequences. The core insight is that exposing a model to long-range relative positional distances does not require constructing full-length inputs: we preserve th

summary.core_problem: 如何在不进行“目标长度全序列训练”（64K 级别）的情况下，把 RoPE 架构的 LLaMA 系模型从 8K 稳定扩展到 64K：既要让模型见到足够大的相对位置距离，又要避免长序列训练的二次方算力/显存成本与长文本数据获取难题。
summary.importance:
贡献点很明确：把长上下文适配从“必须喂长序列”改成“用稀疏但结构化的位置监督就够”。EndPrompt 用短物理序列模拟长相对距离，训练成本接近短上下文继续训练，但在 RULER/LongBench 上达到或超过多种长上下文适配基线（含全长微调）。对预训练研究的价值在于：
- 给出一种可复现、低成本的 long-context mid-train 配方，适合做大规模 ablation（tokenizer/数据配比/优化器/冷却阶段）而不被 64K 训练成本卡住。
- 从 RoPE 角度解释“为什么稀疏距离监督能泛化到未见距离”，把经验技巧和位置编码的频率/平滑性联系起来，便于推导更一般的构造方式（不局限于 terminal prompt）。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是两段式构造（two-segment construction）：
- Segment A：保留原始短上下文（连续文本，不切 chunk），使用正常的低位置索引（例如从 0 开始）。
- Segment B：在序列末尾追加一个很短的 terminal prompt（end prompt），但把它的 position indices 直接“锚定”到接近目标最大长度的位置（例如接近 64K）。

这样在一个很短的物理序列里，同时出现：
- A 内部的局部相对距离（训练不被破坏，next-token 信号干净）。
- A 与 B 之间的超长相对距离（让注意力机制在训练时真正经历 8K→64K 的距离尺度）。

为什么要“末端锚定”而不是把中间某段抬到高位置？论文的动机是让 B 充当稳定的 terminal anchor：末端提示天然与“序列结束附近的结构”一致，且不需要打断原文语义连续性；相比 chunk/拼接式模拟长上下文（会破坏语义连贯与语言建模目标），EndPrompt 保留了 A 的完整语言建模分布。

理论解释围绕 RoPE：注意力分数可视为相对距离上的正弦分量叠加；位置插值（position interpolation）等方法等价于降低有效频率，使得注意力分数随距离变化更平滑，从而对未见的中间距离产生平滑归纳偏置。再叠加一个关键事实：Transformer 并不会为每个距离学习独立参数，Q/K 投影共享，因此“局部监督 + 少量长距离监督”会共同约束同一组参数，减少未见距离处的不稳定行为。

从工程角度看，这是一种“位置索引重映射 + 极短附加 token”的训练数据变换，不改注意力结构，不引入稀疏/滑窗等推理时结构变化，属于低侵入式适配。
summary.experiments:
任务与设置：在 LLaMA-family 上把上下文从 8K 扩到 64K，使用短序列训练（不需要 64K 物理长度）。

关键结果（论文在引言给出汇总数值）：
- RULER 平均分：EndPrompt 76.03；对比 LCEG 72.24、LongLoRA 72.95、全长 fine-tuning 69.23。
- LongBench：EndPrompt 平均分最高，并在 QA、摘要、few-shot、代码补全等子任务上表现稳定。

消融方向（引言提到）：end-prompt 具体文本形式、base model 选择、扩展长度、训练 token 数量。核心结论是对 prompt 文本不敏感，更像是“结构位置”在起作用，而不是记住某个固定字符串。

希望全文里重点核对的实验细节：训练 token 预算与 batch/seq 配置、是否结合 position interpolation、对不同长度（如 32K/64K/更长）的外推曲线、以及对困惑度/短上下文能力的回归情况（是否有短上下文退化）。你提供的全文片段未包含这些表格细节，但从引言描述看作者做了较完整的 ablation。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议（优先级从高到低）：
- 方法章节里两段式 position index 分配的具体实现：如何在不改变物理序列长度的情况下设置 position ids；训练时 attention mask 是否有特殊处理；是否要求 RoPE/实现细节（如 rope scaling）。
- 理论分析部分：RoPE 注意力分数的“频率/曲率/平滑性”解释，以及 position interpolation 如何与 EndPrompt 互补或替代。这里决定了方法能否推广到别的相对位置编码或别的构造方式。
- 实验部分先看 RULER/LongBench 的总体表，再看消融：
  1）没有 end prompt 只做 position id 跳变是否有效；
  2）end prompt 长度/内容变化；
  3）训练 token 预算缩放曲线（数据效率）；
  4）短上下文回归与长上下文稳定性（尤其是 needle-in-a-haystack 类指标）。
- 复现时建议先在 8K→32K 做 sanity check，再上 64K；重点监控训练 loss spike 与长距离 attention 的数值稳定性（RoPE 外推常见坑）。

summary_en.core_problem: Extend RoPE-based LLaMA-family models from 8K to 64K context without doing full-length (64K) training, which is expensive due to quadratic attention cost and the need for long-form data.
summary_en.importance: EndPrompt reframes long-context adaptation as designing sparse but informative positional supervision rather than feeding full-length sequences. It achieves competitive or better RULER/LongBench results while training only on short physical sequences, making long-context mid-training far cheaper and easier to reproduce. For pretraining work, this is mainly valuable as a low-cost recipe to study long-context scaling/ablation without being bottlenecked by 64K training, and as a RoPE-grounded explanation of why sparse distance exposure can generalize to unseen distances.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method constructs a two-segment training example:
- Segment A: keep the original short context intact (no chunking), with normal low position indices.
- Segment B: append a short terminal prompt, but assign its position indices near the target maximum length (e.g., near 64K).

This creates, within a short sequence, both (i) local relative distances inside A (preserving clean next-token supervision) and (ii) very long relative distances between A and B (forcing the model to experience long-range RoPE distances during training).

The “terminal anchoring” choice is deliberate: placing the anchor at the end avoids breaking semantic continuity (unlike chunk-based simulated long-context training) and provides a stable structural cue that is less about memorizing specific tokens and more about the positional configuration.

Their analysis leverages RoPE: attention scores can be viewed as sums of sinusoidal components over relative distances; position interpolation effectively reduces frequencies, inducing smoothness over unobserved distances. Since Q/K projections are shared across distances (no per-distance parameters), combining dense local supervision with sparse long-distance supervision constrains the same parameter space and reduces instability in unseen distance regions.
summary_en.experiments:
Setup: extend LLaMA-family models from 8K to 64K using only short-sequence training.

Key numbers reported in the introduction:
- RULER average: EndPrompt 76.03 vs LCEG 72.24, LongLoRA 72.95, and full-length fine-tuning 69.23.
- LongBench: best average score overall, with strong performance across QA, summarization, few-shot, and code completion.

Ablations mentioned: end-prompt formulation, base model choice, extension length, and training-token budget. A notable claim is robustness to the exact prompt text, suggesting the structural terminal anchor matters more than memorized strings.

The excerpt provided does not include the full experimental tables (training budget details, scaling curves, short-context regression metrics), so those should be verified in the main experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Deep-read priorities:
- Implementation details of position-id reassignment: how they set position ids for the terminal segment without increasing physical sequence length; any special attention masking; interaction with RoPE scaling / position interpolation.
- The RoPE-based analysis: the smoothness/frequency argument is the main rationale for why sparse supervision can generalize.
- Experiments: start from the main RULER/LongBench tables, then scrutinize ablations on (i) removing the end prompt, (ii) varying prompt length/content, (iii) training-token budget scaling (data efficiency), and (iv) short-context regression.
- For reproduction, validate 8K→32K first, then 64K; monitor training stability (loss spikes) and long-distance numerical issues common in RoPE extrapolation.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现一个小规模 ablation；若 terminal anchoring 真能替代长序列训练，会改变长上下文继续训练预算分配。
recommendation.en: Run a small internal ablation soon; if terminal anchoring substitutes for long-sequence training, it changes the budget split for long-context continuation.

paper.title: Self-Pruned Key-Value Attention: Learning When to Write by Predicting Future Utility
paper.abstract: Under modern test-time compute and agentic paradigms, language models process ever-longer sequences. Efficient text generation with transformer architectures is increasingly constrained by the Key-Value cache memory footprint and bandwidth. To address this limitation, we introduce Self-Pruned Key-Value Attention (SP-KV), a mechanism designed to predict future KV utility in order to reduce the size of the long-term KV cache. This strategy operates at a fine granularity: a lightweight utility pred

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长上下文解码里的一个老问题：KV cache 的瓶颈已经越来越像内存带宽问题，而不是算力问题。现有方法大多只在“读”的时候做稀疏化，或者在预填充后做事后驱逐；前者省 FLOPs 但不省显存，后者容易出现训练-推理失配，因为模型表征并没有为被裁剪的缓存而适配。作者要解决的是：能不能在写入 KV cache 的时候就学会“哪些 token 值得进入长期记忆”，并且只用标准 next-token 训练信号完成联合学习，而不依赖额外监督或冻结模型后的校准。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有两层。第一层是工程层面：它把 KV 压缩从事后启发式，推进到可训练的架构设计，目标不是单纯做推理 trick，而是让模型在持续预训练阶段就适配稀疏写入机制。这一点和只做 read sparsity、eviction policy 的工作不同。第二层是研究层面：作者把 learned utility 当成一种“头部长期依赖需求”的探针，用它反过来指导 global/local hybrid attention 的布局设计。这使得 SP-KV 不只是一个推理优化模块，也是在回答哪些 head 真正在承担长期记忆、哪些 head 只需要局部上下文。对做长上下文预训练、混合注意力架构、训练后期 continual pretrain 的人，这个角度是有启发的。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心很直接：对每一层、每个 key head、每个 token 位置，用一个很轻量的两层 MLP 从该层 hidden state 预测一个 utility 分数 u∈(0,1)。推理时，最近的 w 个 token 永远可见，形成 local sliding window；窗口之外的旧 token 只有在 utility 超过阈值 τ 时，才会被写入 persistent/global KV cache，并在后续全局注意力中可见。也就是说，它不是 query-aware 的读时检索，而是 token-wise、head-wise 的写时筛选。

训练时不能直接做硬阈值，因为会断梯度。作者采用 soft gating：把 log u 加到 attention mask bias 上。这样 u=1 时等价于不加偏置，u→0 时等价于把该位置屏蔽掉。模型和 utility predictor 端到端联合训练，训练目标仍然只是 next-token prediction。文中强调通常从 full-attention checkpoint 做 continual pretraining，而不是从零开始，这样更稳定，也更符合实际部署路径。

和已有方法相比，差异有三点。其一，H2O、KVZap 这类方法是在已有 cache 上做驱逐，SP-KV 是在写入时决定是否进入长期记忆，因而同时减少 cache 容量和后续读取流量。其二，QUEST、DeepSeek Sparse Attention 这类方法只做读稀疏，完整 cache 仍在内存里；SP-KV 直接减少持久缓存本身。其三，SP-KV 的 utility predictor 与主模型共同训练，避免了 frozen backbone + 小数据校准带来的分布偏移。

论文还有一个延伸用法：先在参考模型上训练 SP-KV，统计各 head 的平均 utility，再把 utility 高的 head 保留为 global，其他 head 改成 local，从而构造更合理的 hybrid transformer。这个思路比手工做 interleaved global/local layout 更数据驱动。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，作者做了几类关键实验。第一类是不同模型规模、不同序列分布下的 KV 压缩与质量权衡，结论是可以在较高 cache reduction 下保持验证损失和下游评测几乎不变。摘要和引言没有给出完整数字表，但论文主张的重点是“高压缩、低退化”，而且这种效果不是只在单一长度分布上成立。第二类是与 post-hoc eviction 方法的比较，作者强调压缩越激进、输入分布偏移越大，事后方法退化越明显，而联合训练的 SP-KV 更稳。第三类是迁移到 hybrid local-global attention 的实验：用 learned utility 选择 global heads，在相同 KV 预算下优于标准 interleaved layout。这个结果很关键，因为它说明 utility predictor 学到的不只是一个压缩策略，还包含了关于 head 功能分工的结构信息。

从方法细节可推断，实验里应重点报告：local window 默认 128；utility predictor 是 2-layer MLP；训练方式通常是从 pretrained full-attention checkpoint 做 continual pretraining；评估同时看 validation loss、下游任务和解码速度/显存占用。若精读全文，建议重点核对不同阈值 τ 下的 cache 保留率、per-head utility 分布、以及在长尾长上下文样本上的退化曲线，这些比单点平均指标更能说明方法边界。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇更适合泛读，但有几个位置值得认真看。先看 Introduction，作者把 write sparsity 和 read sparsity、post-hoc eviction 的区别讲得比较清楚。然后看方法部分里 soft gating 的公式：为什么用 log utility 加到 attention bias，而不是直接乘 attention score，这关系到训练稳定性和与 mask 语义的一致性。再看实验里三类图表：一是 cache reduction 对 loss/accuracy 的曲线，二是和 H2O、KVZap 之类方法的对比，三是 per-head utility 排名与 hybrid layout 设计结果。如果时间有限，抓住“联合训练的 sparse write 是否真的优于事后裁剪”以及“utility 是否真能作为 head 全局性的可靠指标”这两个问题即可，预计 25-35 分钟能完成一轮有效阅读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a growing inference bottleneck in long-context autoregressive decoding: KV cache cost is increasingly dominated by memory footprint and bandwidth rather than raw compute. Existing approaches usually sparsify reads or evict entries after prefill. Read sparsity reduces FLOPs but keeps the full cache in memory; post-hoc eviction often suffers from train-test mismatch because the model was never trained to operate under aggressive cache pruning. The paper asks a sharper question: can the model learn, during training, which tokens are worth writing into persistent long-term memory in the first place, using only the standard next-token objective?
summary_en.importance: Its value is not just as an inference optimization trick. The main contribution is to turn KV compression into a trainable architectural choice that can be integrated into continual pretraining from a dense checkpoint. That matters for long-context foundation models, where memory behavior should ideally be co-adapted with representations rather than patched afterward. A second contribution is more structural: the learned utility scores expose which heads actually need global memory and which mostly operate locally. That makes SP-KV useful as a probe for designing better local-global hybrid attention layouts under a fixed KV budget.
summary_en.technical_approach:
For each layer, each key head, and each token position, a lightweight two-layer MLP predicts a utility score u in (0,1) from the hidden state. During inference, the most recent w tokens are always accessible through a causal local window. Older tokens are available to global attention only if their predicted utility exceeds a threshold τ, meaning only those key-value pairs are written into the persistent cache. This is write-time sparsification, not query-aware retrieval at read time.

Hard thresholding would block gradients, so training uses a soft relaxation: instead of binary gating, the model adds log u to the attention mask bias. When u=1, the bias is zero; when u approaches 0, the position is effectively masked out. The language model and the utility predictor are trained jointly end-to-end with the ordinary next-token loss, typically via continual pretraining from a pretrained full-attention checkpoint rather than training from scratch.

Relative to prior work, the distinctions are clear. Methods such as H2O or KVZap prune or evict cache entries after they have already been written; SP-KV decides whether to write them into long-term memory at all. Query-aware sparse attention methods reduce reads but still retain the full cache in memory; SP-KV reduces the persistent cache itself. And unlike frozen-model pruning policies calibrated on auxiliary data, SP-KV co-trains the pruning mechanism with the backbone, reducing distribution mismatch under stronger compression.

The paper also uses the learned utility as an architectural signal. After training SP-KV on a reference model, heads with high average utility are kept global while the rest are converted to local heads, yielding hybrid transformers that outperform standard interleaved layouts at the same KV budget.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full text, the experimental story has three main parts. First, across model scales and sequence distributions, SP-KV achieves substantial KV-cache reduction with negligible degradation in validation loss and downstream evaluations. The excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, but the claimed operating regime is clearly 'high compression, low quality loss.' Second, the paper compares against post-hoc eviction methods and argues that the gap widens as compression becomes more aggressive and as the input distribution shifts, which is exactly where train-test mismatch hurts frozen pruning schemes. Third, the utility scores transfer beyond dense attention: selecting global heads based on learned average utility yields stronger local-global hybrids than standard interleaved designs under the same cache budget.

The details worth checking in the full paper are the retention curves versus threshold τ, the default local window size of 128, the behavior across different context-length distributions, and the per-head utility histograms. Those analyses matter more than a single average metric because they show whether the method is robust or only tuned to a narrow operating point.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, but several sections deserve focused attention. Start with the introduction to understand the distinction between write sparsity, read sparsity, and post-hoc eviction. Then read the method section carefully around the soft-gating formulation: adding log-utility to the attention bias is a small design choice with important implications for differentiability and mask semantics. In the experiments, prioritize three things: the compression-quality tradeoff curves, the comparison against eviction baselines, and the head-utility analysis used to build hybrid attention layouts. If reading time is limited, the key questions are whether jointly trained sparse writes truly outperform post-hoc pruning, and whether utility is a stable enough signal to guide architectural head allocation. A useful first pass should take about 25-35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Meta提出的动态KV剪枝方案训练成本低，适配现有模型，做推理优化的团队可参考§3的联合训练方法做内部验证。
recommendation.en: This dynamic KV pruning method from Meta has low training cost and is compatible with existing checkpoints, refer to §3 for joint training details if working on inference efficiency.

paper.title: Hidden State Poisoning Attacks against Mamba-based Language Models
paper.abstract: State space models (SSMs) like Mamba offer efficient alternatives to Transformer-based language models, with linear time complexity. Yet, their adversarial robustness remains critically unexplored. This paper studies the phenomenon whereby specific short input phrases induce a partial amnesia effect in such models, by irreversibly overwriting information in their hidden states, referred to as a Hidden State Poisoning Attack (HiSPA). Our benchmark RoBench-25 allows evaluating a model's informatio

summary.core_problem: 该工作指出 Mamba / Mamba-2 这类 SSM 语言模型存在一种架构相关的长上下文脆弱性：短触发串可以把 recurrent hidden state 中已有信息部分覆盖，导致模型在后续查询时无法恢复前文信息。这个攻击被称为 Hidden State Poisoning Attack，核心不是让模型被提示词说服，而是让模型的状态更新机制遗忘早先内容。
summary.importance: 这对基座模型研究的影响主要在架构安全和长上下文建模。SSM 的吸引力来自线性复杂度和更低推理成本，但它不像 Transformer 那样可以在后续 token 重新 attention 到所有前文 token。若中间状态被少量 token 强烈收缩或覆盖，前文信息可能不可逆丢失。这个结果提醒两点：第一，评估长上下文模型不能只看平均检索能力，还要看对 adversarial filler / trigger 的鲁棒性；第二，混合架构中即使有 attention 层，SSM block 的状态污染仍可能传导到整体行为，尤其会放大 prompt injection。
summary.technical_approach: 技术核心是把 Mamba 的选择性状态更新看成可被输入 token 控制的递推系统。Mamba 的状态转移包含由输入决定的参数，其中 Δ 被约束为正，A 通常为对角结构，B 由模型学习且不受同样约束。作者分析了这样一种触发条件：若一小段 token 使状态转移因子进入统一收缩区间，前文携带状态会随触发长度几何衰减；同时，触发 token 的输入项会在 hidden state 中形成占主导的新增分量。这样，触发串不需要包含显式恶意指令，也能覆盖早先信息。方法包含零样本黑盒触发 Z-HiSPA 和白盒优化触发 M-HiSPA。评测结构把 prompt 分为三段：前面的 informative text 含目标信息；中间插入 trigger；后面是 distractive text；最后询问前文目标信息。这个设计能把普通长上下文遗忘与触发导致的状态污染区分开。作者还把该机制连接到 prompt injection：先用 HiSPA 类前缀破坏上下文记忆，再放入注入指令，会提高混合 SSM–Transformer 模型的攻击成功率。
summary.experiments: 作者构建了 RoBench-25，用于测试长上下文信息检索在触发攻击下的鲁棒性。实验显示，Z-HiSPA 对 Mamba 系列模型造成明显退化，而纯 Transformer 不出现同类崩溃，说明问题与 recurrent SSM 状态有关，不只是一般提示干扰。更强的 M-HiSPA 可以让 Jamba-1.7-Mini 这类 52B 混合 SSM–Transformer 模型在 RoBench-25 的部分触发下严重失效，说明 attention 层不能自动隔离 SSM 状态污染。机制分析部分发现，Mamba 中一段较窄 block 区间的 activation norm 与失败几乎完全相关，这给检测和缓解留下了可操作入口。扩展实验还讨论了 Mamba-2，并在 Nemotron-3-Nano 等含 Mamba-2 block 的混合模型上验证了类似风险。Prompt Injection 实验显示，HiSPA 前缀会提升 Jamba-1.7-Mini 的注入成功率，说明隐藏状态污染会削弱模型对前文约束的保持能力。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。优先看 §3 的 HiSPA 定义和理论推导，重点理解为什么短 trigger 会让旧 hidden state 几何衰减，以及输入项如何占据状态。然后看 §4 的 RoBench-25 设计和 Mamba、Transformer、Jamba 的对比结果，尤其要关注是否控制了 distractive text、触发长度和模型规模。§5 的机制分析值得细看，activation norm 与失败的对应关系可能启发训练期正则、状态监控、触发过滤或 hybrid block 设计。§6 的 prompt injection 扩展也有价值，因为它把架构级遗忘和实际安全风险连接起来。若时间有限，先读 §3.1–§3.3、§4.2–§4.3、§5 的关键图表，再看附录中 Mamba-2 的推广。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper identifies an architecture-specific long-context vulnerability in Mamba and Mamba-2 language models. A short trigger sequence can partially overwrite the recurrent hidden state, making earlier information unrecoverable at query time. The attack is named Hidden State Poisoning Attack, and its mechanism is state corruption rather than ordinary instruction following.
summary_en.importance: The result matters for foundation-model architecture research. SSM-based LMs are attractive because they offer linear-time training and inference, but they do not retain a direct attention path to all previous tokens. If a few tokens push the recurrence into a strongly contractive and input-dominated regime, previously stored information can be lost. This changes how long-context SSMs should be evaluated: average retrieval accuracy is not enough; robustness to adversarial triggers and fillers needs to be measured. The finding also affects hybrid designs, because attention layers do not necessarily prevent corrupted SSM states from influencing the final behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis treats the Mamba block as an input-controlled recurrent system. The transition factors depend on token-conditioned parameters; Δ is constrained to be positive for stability, A is diagonal, and learned input terms can dominate the update. The attack searches for short token sequences that make the carried-over state contract while injecting a large new contribution. Under a uniform contraction condition, the old state decays geometrically with trigger length, while the trigger-induced input term becomes dominant. The paper studies a zero-shot black-box variant, Z-HiSPA, and an optimized white-box variant, M-HiSPA. The evaluation prompt separates informative text, trigger, distractive text, and final query, which isolates trigger-induced state poisoning from ordinary long-context distraction. The paper further connects this mechanism to prompt injection: a HiSPA-like prefix can weaken memory of earlier constraints and make later malicious instructions more effective.
summary_en.experiments: The authors introduce RoBench-25 for testing information retrieval under hidden-state poisoning. Z-HiSPA causes severe degradation in Mamba-based models, while pure Transformers do not show the same collapse pattern, supporting the claim that the failure is tied to recurrent SSM state updates. Optimized M-HiSPA triggers can also break Jamba-1.7-Mini, a 52B hybrid SSM–Transformer model, on some RoBench-25 settings. This indicates that adding attention layers does not automatically protect the model from poisoned SSM states. A mechanistic study finds a narrow band of Mamba blocks whose activation norms correlate almost perfectly with failure, suggesting possible detection or mitigation hooks. The paper also extends the argument to Mamba-2 and evaluates related risks in hybrid models such as Nemotron-3-Nano. In prompt-injection experiments, HiSPA-like prefixes increase the attack success rate on Jamba-1.7-Mini.
summary_en.reading_guide: This deserves a close read for anyone considering SSM or hybrid SSM–attention architectures. Start with Section 3 to understand the recurrence-level mechanism, especially the contraction of prior state and dominance of the trigger input. Then read Section 4 for the RoBench-25 setup and the comparisons between Mamba, Transformers, and Jamba. Section 5 is important because the activation-norm analysis points to practical monitoring and mitigation strategies. Section 6 is useful for deployment-facing readers, since it links hidden-state corruption to prompt-injection success. If time is limited, focus on Sections 3.1–3.3, 4.2–4.3, the main plots in Section 5, and the appendix material on Mamba-2.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看攻击构造和 RoBench-25；若结论站得住，SSM 长上下文路线需要把“状态可擦写性”当成架构风险而非普通鲁棒性问题。
recommendation.en: Read the attack construction and RoBench-25; if it holds, SSM long-context work must treat state overwrite as an architectural risk, not generic robustness noise.

paper.title: OSDN: Improving Delta Rule with Provable Online Preconditioning in Linear Attention
paper.abstract: Linear attention and state-space models offer constant-memory alternatives to softmax attention, but often struggle with in-context associative recall. The Delta Rule mitigates this by writing each token via one step of online gradient descent. However, its step size relies on a single scalar gate that ignores the feature-wise curvature of the inner objective. We propose Online Scaled DeltaNet (OSDN), which augments the scalar gate with a diagonal preconditioner updated online via hypergradient

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题是：DeltaNet 类线性注意力用单个标量 gate 写入记忆，无法按 key 维度适配曲率和频率差异，导致关联召回能力受限。
summary.importance: 这篇属于长上下文架构和高效序列建模方向，对预训练有直接参考价值。它没有把线性注意力的弱点简单归因于容量不足，而是把 Delta Rule 写入过程解释成在线回归中的一步梯度下降，由此指出标量学习率是结构性限制。这个视角有用，因为它把 recurrent memory update、优化器预条件和硬件友好实现连在一起。对想用 linear attention 或 state-space 替代 softmax attention 的预训练实验来说，OSDN 提供了一个低改动路径：增强 associative recall，同时尽量不破坏 chunkwise parallel pipeline，也不引入高维二阶状态。
summary.technical_approach: OSDN 在 Delta Rule 的标量 gate 外，再加入一个按 key 维度变化的对角预条件器 D_t = diag(d_t)。Delta Rule 可看作对每个 token 的回归损失 1/2 ||S k_t - v_t||^2 做一步在线梯度下降；OSDN 的改动相当于对这个梯度做右预条件。关键等价关系是：右预条件可以代数化为 write-side key 的逐维缩放，即 \tilde{k}_t = d_t ⊙ k_t。因此实现上只需要在写入侧把 K 替换成 \tilde{K}，原有 DeltaNet 的 chunkwise WY 并行流程仍可保留。d_t 的更新来自 OSGM 风格的 hypergradient feedback，并且只依赖 key 序列和标量 gates，不依赖高维记忆 S_t、value 或残差，所以整条预条件器轨迹可以用 O(K) 状态的仿射扫描提前计算。为处理非平稳上下文，作者加入 Adaptive Preconditioner Forgetting，对 d_t 使用 token-wise、head-wise retention gate；这个遗忘只作用在预条件器上，不衰减主记忆状态 S_t。理论部分给出两个保证：一个是在 population limit 下相对 right-Newton comparator 的超几何收敛，另一个是面向实现中 residual-ratio surrogate 的 token-local contraction bound。
summary.experiments: 实验规模覆盖 340M 参数 / 10B tokens，以及 1.3B 参数 / 100B tokens。340M 设置下，vanilla OSDN 相对 DeltaNet 在 JRT 风格 in-context recall 上提升 32%，重复 prompt 的 residual-ratio 几何均值从 0.537 降到 0.433。OSDN-APF 的召回提升为 17%，但在长上下文 perplexity 上更稳定。扩大到 1.3B 和 100B tokens 后，residual-ratio 从 DeltaNet 的 0.432 降到 0.265，下降 39%。同时，perplexity、commonsense 和 LongBench 平均表现与 DeltaNet 大致持平。这组结果说明收益主要出现在机制预期的关联召回和写入残差收缩上，而不是靠牺牲通用语言建模指标换取某个合成任务提升。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。优先看 Section 4：右预条件与 write-key scaling 的等价关系是核心，决定了方法是否能保留 DeltaNet 的高效实现。然后看 Section 4.4 的 APF，重点理解为什么只遗忘预条件器 d_t，而不是遗忘主 memory state S_t。理论部分看 Theorem 5.1 和 5.2 的结论、假设和对应诊断指标即可，不必深追完整证明。实验部分重点看 Section 6 和 Appendix K 中的 JRT recall、residual-ratio、长上下文 perplexity，以及 340M/10B 到 1.3B/100B 的扩展结果。若要复现实验，最需要确认的是 chunkwise scan 中 K 到 \tilde{K} 的替换位置，以及 APF gate 的参数化方式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific weakness in DeltaNet-style linear attention: memory writes are controlled by a scalar gate, so the update cannot adapt to feature-wise curvature and frequency differences in the key space.
summary_en.importance: This is relevant to pretraining architecture work because it targets one of the main failure modes of linear attention and recurrent state models: weaker in-context associative recall. The paper’s useful move is to reinterpret the Delta Rule as one step of online gradient descent on a token-level regression objective. Under that view, the scalar write gate is analogous to plain SGD with a single learning rate, while associative memory would benefit from diagonal preconditioning. The proposed change is small enough to preserve the DeltaNet chunkwise parallel path, which matters for any realistic long-context pretraining experiment.
summary_en.technical_approach: OSDN adds a diagonal preconditioner D_t = diag(d_t) on top of the usual scalar gate in the Delta Rule. Since the Delta update corresponds to gradient descent on 1/2 ||S k_t - v_t||^2, the new method right-preconditions the gradient. The key algebraic result is that this right-preconditioning is exactly equivalent to scaling the write-side key feature by feature: \tilde{k}_t = d_t ⊙ k_t. As a result, the implementation can keep the existing chunkwise WY pipeline and only replace the storage-side K with \tilde{K}. The preconditioner d_t is updated online using OSGM-style hypergradient feedback. Its update depends only on keys and scalar gates, not on the high-dimensional memory state, values, or residuals, so the full d_t trajectory can be computed as an O(K)-state affine scan before the write pass. The APF variant adds learned token-wise and head-wise forgetting for the preconditioner only, which helps under non-stationary contexts without decaying the main memory state. The theory gives a population-limit super-geometric rate against a right-Newton comparator and a token-local contraction bound for the residual-ratio surrogate used in diagnostics.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare against DeltaNet at matched compute. At 340M parameters and 10B training tokens, vanilla OSDN improves JRT-style in-context recall by 32% and reduces the geometric mean residual ratio on repeated prompts from 0.537 to 0.433. OSDN-APF keeps a 17% recall gain and is more stable on long-context perplexity. At 1.3B parameters and 100B tokens, the residual ratio drops from 0.432 to 0.265, a 39% reduction. Perplexity, commonsense evaluation, and LongBench averages remain roughly at parity with DeltaNet. The gains therefore line up with the proposed mechanism: better associative write correction and residual contraction, without an obvious loss in broad language modeling metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 30–45 minutes. Read Section 4 first, especially the equivalence between right-preconditioning and write-key scaling; this is the main implementation insight. Then read Section 4.4 on APF to see why the method forgets the preconditioner rather than the memory state. For the theory, focus on the assumptions and statements of Theorems 5.1 and 5.2 rather than the full derivations. In the experiments, prioritize Section 6 and Appendix K: JRT recall, residual-ratio diagnostics, long-context perplexity, and the 340M/10B to 1.3B/100B scaling comparison. For implementation, the important details are where K is replaced by \tilde{K} in the chunkwise scan and how the APF gate is parameterized.

recommendation.zh: 如果你还在跟踪 linear attention 替代路线，这篇值得看：不是又一个 kernel trick，而是把 online second-order 信息塞进 DeltaNet 且没破坏并行实现，先读方法和理论，再看 LM 实验是否站得住。
recommendation.en: If you still track linear-attention alternatives, this is worth a read: not another kernel trick, but a way to inject online second-order structure into DeltaNet without breaking the parallel pipeline; read the method/theory first, then check whether the LM evidence is actually clean.

institutions: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Pyramid Forcing: Head-Aware Pyramid KV Cache Policy for High-Quality Long Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video generation enables streaming and open-ended long video synthesis, but still suffers from long-term degradation caused by accumulated errors. Existing KVCache strategies usually apply unified historical-frame retention, implicitly assuming homogeneous historical dependencies across attention heads. We revisit historical-frame attention and reveal three distinct head types: Anchor Heads require broad long-range context, Wave Heads exhibit periodic temporal dependencies, and Ve

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是自回归视频生成中的长程退化问题：生成时间变长后，外观漂移、运动变弱、身份模糊会逐步积累。作者指出，问题不只是历史信息太多或太少，而是现有 KV cache 策略把所有 attention head 当成同一种历史依赖模式处理，导致该保留的长程锚点、周期性运动信息和局部连续性被混在一起压缩。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练的直接相关性不强，因为工作对象是自回归视频扩散生成，不是语言模型预训练。但它对长上下文建模和推理期记忆压缩有启发：不同 attention head 对历史 token 的使用方式可能高度异质，统一的滑窗、sink token 或重要性采样策略会损失结构化依赖。对研究长上下文 LM、KV cache 压缩、流式生成和多模态 AR 生成的人，可以把它看作一个 head-aware cache policy 的案例。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Pyramid Forcing，核心是先识别 head 类型，再给不同 head 分配不同的历史帧缓存策略。作者把历史依赖模式分成三类：Anchor Heads 需要宽范围长程上下文，用来稳定外观和身份；Wave Heads 对历史帧呈周期性注意力波动，更像是在跟踪运动节律；Veil Heads 对近期历史注意力较弱，但对初始帧敏感，过多历史反而会遮蔽它们对第一帧的关注。分类阶段采用小规模 calibration set，结合 sign-rate statistics 和频域周期性来做 offline head classification。策略阶段，Anchor Heads 使用 strided retention 覆盖长历史，Wave Heads 使用 period-aligned sampling 保留周期相关帧，Veil Heads 使用 compact local merging 控制历史干扰并保留局部连续性。由于不同 head 的 cache 长度不同，作者还实现了 ragged-cache attention，以支持 head-level heterogeneous KV cache，而不是把所有 head padding 到同一长度。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Self Forcing 和 Causal Forcing 两个自回归视频生成 backbone 上评估，使用 VBench-Long，覆盖 30 秒和 60 秒长视频生成。关键数字是：在 Self Forcing 的 60 秒生成上，总分从 77.87 提升到 81.21。动态程度指标提升更明显，在 Causal Forcing 上最高提升 29.36 分，说明该策略主要缓解了长视频中运动衰减的问题。作者还强调方法同时改善 motion dynamics、visual fidelity 和 semantic consistency，但全文片段中没有给出完整消融表；最值得确认的是三类 head 分类是否稳定、每类 cache policy 的独立贡献，以及 ragged-cache attention 的额外开销。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。建议重点看 Introduction 中对三类 head 的观察，以及方法部分的 Offline Tri-Pattern Head Classification、Pyramid KVCache Policies 和 Heterogeneous KVCache Computation Optimization。图 1 和图 2 是理解问题设定的入口：前者展示长程退化，后者对比统一 cache 与 head-aware cache。实验部分重点看 30 秒、60 秒 VBench-Long 结果和动态程度指标。若关注 LLM 长上下文，可跳过视频生成细节，重点抽取两个问题：head specialization 如何测量，以及异构 cache 如何在工程上避免 padding 浪费。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets long-horizon degradation in autoregressive video generation. As generation proceeds, appearance drifts, motion weakens, and object identity becomes less stable. The main claim is that existing KV-cache policies treat all attention heads as if they had the same temporal dependency pattern, while heads actually use historical frames in different ways.
summary_en.importance: The work is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is useful for long-context modeling and inference-time memory compression. It gives a concrete example where keeping or dropping history uniformly across heads is too coarse. For long-context language models, streaming multimodal models, and autoregressive world models, the useful lesson is that cache compression may need to respect head-level specialization rather than only token-level recency or global importance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pyramid Forcing first classifies attention heads offline and then assigns head-specific cache policies. The paper identifies three patterns. Anchor Heads attend broadly to long-range history and help preserve global anchors such as identity and appearance. Wave Heads show periodic temporal preferences and are suited to motion-related dependencies. Veil Heads are sensitive to initial frames but can be distracted by excessive historical context. The classification uses a small calibration set, sign-rate statistics, and frequency-domain periodicity. The cache policies are then matched to these behaviors: strided retention for Anchor Heads, period-aligned sampling for Wave Heads, and compact local merging for Veil Heads. Because different heads keep different numbers of cached frames, the paper introduces ragged-cache attention to support heterogeneous cache lengths without forcing a single padded layout.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Self Forcing and Causal Forcing backbones on VBench-Long for 30-second and 60-second video generation. On Self Forcing at 60 seconds, the total score improves from 77.87 to 81.21. The largest reported gain is on dynamic degree, with an improvement of up to 29.36 points on Causal Forcing. These results suggest that the method mainly helps with motion persistence and long-term consistency. The most important missing checks to look for in the full experimental section are the stability of the head taxonomy, per-policy ablations, and the overhead of ragged-cache attention.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim reading should take about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the analysis of Anchor, Wave, and Veil Heads, then read the sections on offline head classification, head-specific cache policies, and heterogeneous cache computation. Figures 1 and 2 are the quickest way to understand the motivation. For readers working on LLM long context, the video-generation details are less important than two transferable questions: how to measure head-level temporal behavior, and how to implement variable cache lengths efficiently.

recommendation.zh: 读 head 分类和 ragged-cache 实现；它把“所有头同一缓存窗口”这个默认设定拆开了，值得对长上下文 LLM 做同类探针。
recommendation.en: Read the head taxonomy and ragged-cache implementation; it breaks the default uniform-cache-window assumption and is worth probing in long-context LLMs.

paper.title: Attention Once Is All You Need: Efficient Streaming Inference with Stateful Transformers
paper.abstract: Conventional transformer inference engines are request-driven, paying an O(n) prefill cost on every query. In streaming workloads, where data arrives continuously and queries probe an ever-growing context, this cost is prohibitive. We introduce a data-driven computational model centred on stateful sessions: a persistent KV cache advanced incrementally as new data arrives, so prefill is moved off the critical path and query latency becomes O(|q|), independent of accumulated context size. Building

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM推理框架（vLLM、SGLang、TensorRT-LLM等）基于请求驱动的KV缓存优化，在流式工作负载（数据持续到达、查询偶发）下完全失效——每次数据更新改变前缀，缓存命中率趋近于零，导致查询延迟随上下文长度线性增长。论文提出以数据为中心的有状态推理架构，将预计算从关键路径移除。
summary.importance: 对实时分析、金融交易、传感器数据监控等流式LLM应用有直接工程价值。架构思路也对长上下文推理系统有启发：数据与查询的分离处理是一种未被充分利用的并行性来源。此外，Flash Queries机制利用GPU空闲周期预计算，为提高生产推理集群的GPU利用率（通常仅10-45%）提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 核心架构是有状态会话（stateful sessions）：一个持久化的KV缓存在多次会话间存活，数据到达时异步增量更新。通过解耦数据平面和查询平面，数据摄入驱动预计算（而非查询驱动），查询仅需处理自身的查询令牌，复杂度降为O(|q|)，与累积上下文大小无关。在此基础上提出两个机制：(1) Flash Queries：在每次数据更新后利用GPU空闲时间预计算已注册问题的答案，将查询延迟从~43ms推向接近零；(2) 无锁流水线实现数据异步摄入。整个系统不改变模型权重或核函数实现。
summary.experiments: 核心实验结果：(1) 查询延迟从标准路径的~43ms通过Flash Queries降至接近零；(2) 查询复杂度独立于累积上下文大小，仅取决于查询本身长度；(3) 相同GPU在相同工作负载下，有状态设计比无状态请求循环完成更多分析工作量，且无需改动模型权重或核实现。具体数值未在提供的片段中完整给出。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点关注第1章引言中的问题定义（流式vs请求驱动工作负载的本质区别）、第2-3章架构设计（数据平面/查询平面解耦、有状态KV缓存）以及Flash Queries机制。阅读时间约25分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构和作者信息未在提供的全文片段中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) optimize for request-driven KV-cache hit rates, which fail under streaming workloads where data arrives continuously and each query sees a unique accumulated context. Cache hit rates approach zero, causing query latency to scale linearly with context length. The paper proposes a data-centric stateful inference architecture that moves precomputation off the critical path.
summary_en.importance: Direct engineering value for streaming LLM applications including real-time analytics, financial trading, and sensor monitoring. The architecture also informs long-context reasoning systems: separating data and query processing is an under-exploited source of parallelism. The Flash Queries mechanism, which harnesses idle GPU cycles for pre-computation, addresses the well-known problem of low GPU utilization (typically 10-45%) in production inference clusters.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core construct is stateful sessions: a persistent KV cache that survives across sessions and is incrementally updated as data arrives. By decoupling the data plane from the query plane, data ingestion drives precomputation (not queries), and queries process only their own tokens against pre-computed state, achieving O(|q|) complexity independent of accumulated context size. Two mechanisms build on this: (1) Flash Queries pre-compute answers to registered questions during GPU idle time after each data update, pushing latency from ~43ms toward zero; (2) Lock-free pipelines enable asynchronous data ingestion. No changes to model weights or kernel implementations are required.
summary_en.experiments: Key results: (1) Query latency reduced from ~43ms (standard path) to near-zero via Flash Queries; (2) Query complexity independent of accumulated context size, scaling only with query length; (3) The same GPU performs more analytical work per unit power under stateful design vs. stateless request loops, with no model or kernel changes. Full numerical results not available in the provided excerpt.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read. Focus on Section 1 for problem framing (streaming vs request-driven workload distinction), Sections 2-3 for architecture design (data/query plane decoupling, stateful KV cache), and the Flash Queries mechanism. Estimated reading time: 25 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not available in the provided text excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统模型和调度实验：它把KV从请求缓存变成会话状态，适合检验长上下文产品里的prefill浪费。
recommendation.en: Read the execution model and scheduler results: it reframes KV as session state rather than request cache, useful for auditing prefill waste in streaming long-context products.

paper.title: Training Long-Context Vision-Language Models Effectively with Generalization Beyond 128K Context
paper.abstract: Long-context modeling is becoming a core capability of modern large vision-language models (LVLMs), enabling sustained context management across long-document understanding, video analysis, and multi-turn tool use in agentic workflows. Yet practical training recipes remain insufficiently explored, particularly for designing and balancing long-context data mixtures. In this work, we present a systematic study of long-context continued pre-training for LVLMs, extending a 7B model from 32K to 128K

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究 LVLM 长上下文继续预训练的实际配方：如何把一个 32K 上下文的 7B 视觉语言模型扩展到 128K，并让能力泛化到 256K / 512K，而不是只在目标长度附近记住位置模式。重点问题不是 RoPE 缩放本身，而是长文档数据应该怎么合成、任务怎么选、长度分布怎么配、是否需要混入短上下文数据。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值很直接：它把 long-context LVLM 的瓶颈从“位置编码能不能外推”转向“长上下文训练信号是否教会模型检索关键信息”。论文给出几条可操作的结论。长文档 VQA 明显优于 OCR transcription；均衡长度分布优于只堆 128K 附近的 target-length 数据；retrieval-heavy 的任务混合更有效，但需要少量 reasoning 数据保持任务多样性；纯 long-document VQA 基本保留短上下文能力，因此不一定像 LLM LongPT 那样强依赖短数据混合。这些结论对多模态长上下文预训练、文档智能模型、长视频模型和 agentic workflow 的上下文管理都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 实验基座是 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，原始上下文为 32K。论文用 Dynamic-NTK 启发式把 mRoPE base frequency 从 1×10^6 调到 4×10^6，最大序列长度设为 131,072 tokens，全局 batch 为 4M tokens，每个 LongPT run 使用固定 5B token 预算。数据侧先构建超过 150 万个 PDF 文档的池子，覆盖论文、书籍、技术手册，以及工程、医学、社会科学、生物等领域。训练时选择 32 到 50 页的文档，并渲染成页面图像；在 Qwen2.5-VL 的 2×2 pixel unshuffle 设置下，这些文档形成约 32K 到 128K 的多模态序列。为避免评测污染，使用 PDF 内容的 SHA-256 hash 做过滤。任务侧构造五类长文档任务，归为两组：long-document VQA 和 OCR transcription。主要发现是，VQA 格式比纯 OCR 更适合 LongPT，因为它同时提供 instruction-formatted supervision、跨页检索、信息抽取、数值推理和复杂版面理解信号。最终配方训练得到 MMProLong，并在 Qwen3-VL 上进一步验证可迁移性。
summary.experiments: 核心训练规模是 7B 基座、5B token LongPT、128K 最大训练长度、4M token 全局 batch。主要结果是，MMProLong 在 64K 和 128K 的长文档 VQA 上提升 7.1%；在没有额外训练或适配的情况下，仍能在 256K 和 512K 上保持强性能，并相对基线超过 20%。能力还迁移到更广的多模态长上下文任务，包括网页 needle-in-a-haystack 的 MM-NIAH、长上下文压缩 VTCBench，以及长视频理解 benchmark。消融给出三点关键实验洞察：第一，balanced length distribution 比集中在 128K 附近的 target-length-focused 数据更好，说明模型需要学习不同长度和位置上的关键信息检索，而不是只适配一个窗口长度。第二，长上下文训练的主要瓶颈仍是 key-information retrieval，因此 retrieval-heavy mixture 优于偏 OCR 或偏复杂 reasoning 的配方。第三，纯 long-document VQA 对短上下文能力损伤很小，这与部分 LLM 长上下文继续预训练经验不同，原因可能是 VQA 数据本身保持了指令格式和任务多样性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读数据构造和消融部分。优先看 long-document VQA 与 OCR transcription 的对比，因为它决定了长上下文多模态训练信号应当是“问答式任务监督”还是“逐字转录监督”。然后看长度分布实验，重点关注 balanced distribution 为什么能带来 256K / 512K 外推。再看 task mixture 消融，尤其是 retrieval-heavy 与 reasoning 数据比例的取舍。实验设置中的 mRoPE base frequency、5B token budget、4M token batch、PDF 页面数选择也值得记录，这些是复现实验配方的关键超参。预计精读需要 1 到 1.5 小时；如果只泛读，20 到 30 分钟看 Introduction、Experimental Setup、Data Curation 和三组 ablation 结论即可。
summary.authors_note: 输入材料未给出完整作者与机构信息。工作基于 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 Qwen3-VL 做实验验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the practical recipe for long-context continued pretraining of large vision-language models. The target is to extend a 7B LVLM from 32K to 128K context and obtain generalization to 256K and 512K without additional adaptation. The central question is not only how to scale positional encoding, but how to design long-document data, task formats, length distributions, and short-context mixing.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is useful for pretraining because it reframes long-context LVLM training as a data-mixture problem. The main bottleneck is key-information retrieval over long multimodal sequences, not simple OCR coverage. The paper provides several actionable findings: long-document VQA is much more effective than OCR transcription; balanced sequence-length distributions outperform data concentrated near the 128K target length; retrieval-heavy mixtures work best when paired with a modest amount of reasoning data; and pure long-document VQA largely preserves short-context performance, reducing the need for explicit short-context mixing. These findings are relevant to document-native LVLMs, long-video models, and agent workflows that rely on sustained multimodal context.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses Qwen2.5-VL-7B as the base model and extends its context window from 32K to 128K. Following a Dynamic-NTK heuristic, the mRoPE base frequency is increased from 1×10^6 to 4×10^6. Each LongPT run uses a fixed 5B-token budget, a maximum sequence length of 131,072 tokens, and a global batch size of 4M tokens. On the data side, the authors build a pool of more than 1.5 million PDF documents spanning papers, books, technical manuals, and domains such as engineering, medicine, social sciences, and biology. Documents with 32 to 50 pages are selected and rendered into page images. With the 2×2 pixel unshuffle in the Qwen2.5-VL backbone, these documents produce multimodal sequences from roughly 32K to 128K tokens. Potential evaluation contamination is filtered using SHA-256 hashes of PDF content. Five long-document training tasks are synthesized and grouped into long-document VQA and OCR transcription. The final recipe emphasizes VQA-style supervision because it provides instruction formatting, information extraction, cross-page retrieval, numerical reasoning, and layout understanding signals. The resulting model is named MMProLong, and the recipe is also validated on Qwen3-VL.
summary_en.experiments: The main training setup uses a 7B base model, 5B tokens of continued pretraining, 128K maximum training length, and a 4M-token global batch. MMProLong improves long-document VQA performance by 7.1% at 64K and 128K. Without additional training or adaptation, it maintains strong performance at 256K and 512K and exceeds baselines by more than 20%. The gains transfer to broader multimodal long-context tasks, including webpage-based needle-in-a-haystack on MM-NIAH, long-context compression on VTCBench, and long-video understanding benchmarks. The ablations are the most informative part. Balanced length distributions outperform target-length-focused data, indicating that the model should learn retrieval across many lengths and positions instead of specializing to the training-window boundary. Retrieval-heavy task mixtures are preferred because key-information retrieval remains the dominant weakness. A small amount of reasoning data helps preserve task diversity. Pure long-document VQA has limited negative impact on short-context capability, likely because the data remains instruction-formatted and diverse.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus first on the data curation and ablation sections. The most important comparison is long-document VQA versus OCR transcription, because it determines what kind of supervision actually improves long-context LVLMs. Then read the sequence-length distribution experiments, especially the evidence that balanced lengths support 256K and 512K extrapolation. The task-mixture ablations are also important, particularly the trade-off between retrieval-heavy data and reasoning data. The experimental setup details are worth recording: mRoPE base frequency scaling, 5B-token budget, 4M-token global batch, 131K maximum sequence length, and the 32-to-50-page PDF selection rule. A careful read should take about 60 to 90 minutes; a quick technical skim can focus on the introduction, experimental setup, data curation, and three main ablation findings.
summary_en.authors_note: The provided material does not include the full author or institution list. The experiments are built around Qwen2.5-VL-7B and are further validated on Qwen3-VL.

recommendation.zh: 字节和港科大关于 VLM 长上下文训练的扎实实证工作，明确指出了 VQA 数据优于 OCR 以及长度分布平衡的重要性，对做多模态长文本的同学极具参考价值。
recommendation.en: Solid empirical work from ByteDance and HKUST on VLM long-context training, clearly pointing out the superiority of VQA data over OCR and the importance of balanced length distribution. Highly valuable for researchers working on multimodal long context.

paper.title: When Attention Closes: How LLMs Lose the Thread in Multi-Turn Interaction
paper.abstract: Large language models can follow complex instructions in a single turn, yet over long multi-turn interactions they often lose the thread of instructions, persona, and rules. This degradation has been measured behaviorally but not mechanistically explained. We propose a channel-transition account: goal-defining tokens become less accessible through attention, while goal-related information may persist in residual representations. We introduce the Goal Accessibility Ratio (GAR), measuring attentio

summary.core_problem: 解释多轮对话中模型为何会逐步“丢掉系统提示里的目标/规则/人设”，并给出可预测、可诊断的机制指标。论文提出一个两通道解释：目标信息一开始主要通过注意力通道从系统提示 token 直接可达；随着轮次增长，注意力对这些 token 的可达性下降并进入“关闭”区间，之后行为更多依赖残差流里先前写入的内部表征是否还保留了目标状态。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对训练动态与架构选择有直接启发：1）把“长对话失忆/失规”从纯行为现象变成可测的内部量（GAR），便于做架构对比与回归测试；2）揭示不同架构在残差通道保留目标信息的深度位置差异很大（层 2 到层 27），这会影响你如何做中期训练（mid-train）或对齐训练来强化长程遵循；3）对长上下文训练的一个现实提醒：仅靠扩大窗口不等于目标 token 可达，位置衰减与注意力分配会产生“可达性阈值”。
summary.technical_approach:
提出“channel-transition account”。把目标条件化信息的跨轮传播分为两条路径：
- Attention channel：生成时对系统提示中“目标定义 token 集合”的注意力质量。
- Residual channel：早期层在残差流中写入并在后续位置/轮次中保留的目标相关表征。

三个工具：
1）GAR（Goal Accessibility Ratio）：统计生成 token 对目标 token 的注意力质量（跨层跨头平均）。它不是通用质量分数，而是架构相关的诊断量。
2）Sliding-window ablation：用滑动窗口裁剪上下文，因果地“关闭”对系统提示的直接注意力通道，并观察行为何时崩。
3）Residual-stream probes：在线性可分性层面探测残差流中是否仍可解码出“本回合是否能回忆/遵循目标”的结果变量，用 AUC 衡量；并用输入 embedding 探针作对照，证明信号不是来自浅层词面。

作者把“注意力关闭点”与窗口大小建立了近线性的剂量-反应关系，从而能参数化预测多轮失败发生的轮次。
summary.experiments:
覆盖四个开源架构（Mistral、Qwen、LLaMA、Mixtral）：
- GAR 在所有架构上随轮次单调下降（每个架构 Mann-Kendall p < 1e-7）。
- 通过 sliding-window ablation，关闭点与窗口大小呈线性剂量-反应关系（R^2 > 0.999），说明这是一个强可预测的几何/位置信号，而非偶然行为波动。
- 残差流线性探针可以高精度预测每个 episode 的回忆/遵循结果，AUC 最高到 0.99；对 input embedding 的探针接近随机，支持“残差通道确实携带目标状态”。
- 目标信息在网络中变得线性可解码的层深因架构差异很大：最浅到第 2 层，最深到第 27 层。
- 架构差异的行为侧表现：Mistral 在关闭后仍保留较多目标条件化行为且随目标复杂度呈渐变退化；LLaMA/Qwen 更像对复杂度不敏感的整体失败；Mixtral 出现中层深度附近的“相变式”可解码性跃迁。

这些结果更像机制诊断而非刷榜；它的价值在于给长对话遵循问题提供了可复现实验范式与可量化指标。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
1）先看 Figure 1 的两通道示意与 GAR 定义，理解作者把问题拆成“注意力可达性”与“残差保留”。
2）看 GAR 随轮次下降的主图，以及不同架构的对比图，抓住“关闭点”概念。
3）看 sliding-window ablation 的线性剂量-反应结果（R^2>0.999 那张图/表），这是最强的因果证据。
4）看 residual probe 的 AUC 结果与“可解码层深”分析，理解为什么不同架构关闭后的失败形态不同。
5）如果你做长上下文/多轮对齐训练，建议把 GAR 当成回归指标：在 mid-train 或 cooldown 后测 GAR 曲线是否右移、残差可解码层是否前移。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains why LLMs gradually lose adherence to system-prompt goals (instructions/persona/rules) over long multi-turn interactions, and proposes a mechanistic, predictive diagnostic. It argues for a two-channel transition: early on, goal tokens are directly accessible via attention; as turns progress, attention to those goal-defining tokens decays and eventually enters a “closure” regime, after which behavior depends on whether goal state has been preserved indirectly in residual-stream representations.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for architecture/optimization-facing researchers because it turns a messy behavioral failure into measurable internal quantities. GAR can serve as a regression metric for long-dialogue instruction-following. The finding that goal information becomes linearly decodable at very different depths across architectures (layer ~2 to ~27) suggests that “what survives after attention closure” is an architectural property—relevant when designing mid-training or alignment interventions for long-context and multi-turn settings.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed channel-transition account decomposes goal-conditioned state propagation into:
- An attention channel: direct attention mass from generated tokens to goal-defining tokens in the system prompt.
- A residual channel: goal-related information written into and carried by the residual stream.

Three instruments:
1) Goal Accessibility Ratio (GAR): average attention mass from generated tokens to the goal-token set, aggregated across heads/layers.
2) Sliding-window ablations: causally close the attention channel by truncating context windows and observing when compliance collapses.
3) Linear residual-stream probes: test whether per-episode compliance/recall outcomes are decodable from residual activations (AUC), with input-embedding probes as a control.

A key claim is that the turn at which attention “closes” is parametrically predictable from window size (a near-perfect linear dose-response).
summary_en.experiments:
Across four open-weight architectures (Mistral, Qwen, LLaMA, Mixtral):
- GAR declines monotonically with turn count for every architecture (Mann–Kendall p < 1e-7).
- Sliding-window ablations show a linear dose-response between window size and the crossover/closure turn (R^2 > 0.999), supporting a strong causal link.
- Residual-stream probes predict per-episode recall/compliance with AUC up to 0.99, while input-embedding probes are near chance—evidence that goal state persists in residual representations even when attention access fades.
- The layer at which goal information becomes linearly decodable varies widely by architecture (as early as layer 2, as late as layer 27).
- Post-closure behavioral differences: Mistral degrades more gracefully with goal complexity; LLaMA/Qwen fail more uniformly; Mixtral shows a sharp mid-depth “phase-transition-like” rise in decodability.

Overall, the contribution is a reproducible diagnostic framework rather than a performance benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~30–45 minutes):
1) Start with the two-channel schematic and the GAR definition.
2) Look at the main GAR-vs-turn plots and identify the closure regime per architecture.
3) Read the sliding-window ablation section and the linear dose-response result (R^2 > 0.999); this is the strongest causal evidence.
4) Review the residual-probe AUC results and the “decodable depth” analysis to understand architecture-specific failure modes.
5) If you work on long-context or multi-turn alignment, consider GAR as a regression metric to track whether mid-training/cooldown shifts the closure point or changes residual retention.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 GAR、残差 probe 和因果干预；它提醒长对话失控不等于信息消失，而是读出通道坏了。
recommendation.en: Skim GAR, residual probes, and causal interventions; the useful prior shift is that multi-turn failure can be a broken readout channel, not erased information.

paper.title: A Unified Framework for Critical Scaling of Inverse Temperature in Self-Attention
paper.abstract: Length-dependent logit rescaling is widely used to stabilize long-context self-attention, but existing analyses and methods suggest conflicting inverse-temperature laws for the context length $n$, ranging from $(\log n)^{1/2}$ to $\log n$ and $(\log n)^2$. We provide a general theory showing that the desirable scale is determined by the gap-counting function $N_n$ of each attention row. Counting how many competitors lie within each gap from the maximum, we define an upper-tail accumulation scale

summary.core_problem: 长上下文自注意力的逆温度缩放缺乏统一理论，现有工作提出的(log n)指数从1/2到2不等，仅针对特定假设场景推导结论，缺乏从实际注意力分数本身计算临界缩放的通用方法，无法适配不同模型和场景的最优温度设置。
summary.importance: 统一了此前分散的长上下文温度缩放理论，为长上下文Transformer训练和推理阶段的温度校准提供了可直接落地的诊断方法，对预训练长上下文模型的注意力稳定性优化有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出基于间隙计数的确定性框架，定义上尾累积尺度Λn：对每个注意力行，统计距离最高分的每个分数间隔内的竞争者数量，通过该计数曲线的指数增长率得到行级临界逆温度尺度。理论证明该尺度是softmax从弥散到集中的相变临界点：低于该尺度，顶部分量无法有效区分；高于该尺度，注意力熵会发生崩溃。该框架将此前所有缩放律统一为不同计数函数对应的特例，可直接从实际注意力分数计算最优缩放指数。
summary.experiments: 多数据集的指数扫频实验显示，最优逆温度缩放指数ξβ并不固定为1：PG-19和Proof-Pile-2数据集上推理阶段最优ξβ在2到2.5之间，SlimPajama和OpenWebText数据集上训练阶段学到的ξβ小于1，所有实验结果均与理论推导的上尾累积尺度计算结果一致。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读Table1的现有方法总结、Figure1的指数扫频结果、第4节的核心定理与定义，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: There is no unified theory for inverse temperature scaling in long-context self-attention. Existing works propose (log n) exponents ranging from 1/2 to 2, derived only for specific hypothetical scenarios, and lack a general method to calculate critical scaling directly from actual attention scores, making it impossible to adapt optimal temperature settings to different models and scenarios.
summary_en.importance: It unifies previously scattered long-context temperature scaling theories, provides an implementable diagnostic method for temperature calibration during training and inference of long-context Transformers, and has direct reference value for optimizing attention stability in long-context model pre-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a deterministic gap-counting framework, and defines the upper-tail accumulation scale Λn: for each attention row, count the number of competitors within each score gap from the maximum score, and obtain the row-level critical inverse temperature scale through the exponential growth rate of this counting curve. Theoretical proof shows this scale is the phase transition point of softmax from diffuse to concentrated: below this scale, top components cannot be effectively distinguished; above this scale, attention entropy collapses. This framework unifies all prior scaling laws as special cases corresponding to different counting functions, and the optimal scaling exponent can be calculated directly from actual attention scores.
summary_en.experiments: Exponent sweep experiments on multiple datasets show the optimal inverse temperature scaling exponent ξβ is not fixed at 1: the inference optimal ξβ is between 2 and 2.5 on PG-19 and Proof-Pile-2, and the learned ξβ during training is less than 1 on SlimPajama and OpenWebText. All experimental results are consistent with values calculated from the theoretical upper-tail accumulation scale.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the summary of existing methods in Table 1, exponent sweep results in Figure 1, and core theorems and definitions in Section 4. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看理论主定理和诊断部分；它把“该用哪个 log n 缩放”改成看 score tail，而不是背固定律。
recommendation.en: Read the main theorem and diagnostic section; it replaces fixed log-n rules with a tail-dependent criterion over attention scores.

paper.title: HEBATRON: A Hebrew-Specialized Open-Weight Mixture-of-Experts Language Model
paper.abstract: We present Hebatron, a Hebrew-specialized open-weight large language model built on the NVIDIA Nemotron-3 sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture. Training employs a three-phase easy-to-hard curriculum with continuous anti-forgetting anchoring, followed by supervised fine-tuning on 2 million bilingual Hebrew--English samples. The curriculum ordering alone yields a 3-point aggregate benchmark gain over the reversed configuration. Hebatron achieves a Hebrew reasoning average of 73.8\%, outperformin

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是低资源、形态复杂语言在大模型时代的本地化预训练问题。更具体地说，作者关注三个互相耦合的难点：一是希伯来语在通用多语模型中的表示不足，尤其是词形变化、附着成分、无元音拼写带来的 tokenizer 和建模困难；二是继续预训练时容易牺牲原有英语与通用推理能力，出现灾难性遗忘；三是在算力受限条件下，如何用稀疏 MoE 底座做高效本地化，而不是从头训练一个专用模型。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有两层。第一，这是一篇比较典型的 continued pretraining / localization 案例，重点不在新架构，而在数据配比、课程顺序、抗遗忘锚点这些训练设计。对于做多语种、领域化、持续预训练的人，这类工作比单纯报 benchmark 更有参考意义。第二，它给出一个明确结论：在语言本地化场景里，数据顺序不是边角细节，easy-to-hard curriculum 本身就能带来可测的整体收益，而且如果同时保留一部分原始基座训练分布作为 anchor，可以在提升目标语言能力的同时尽量守住英语和推理能力。贡献量级上属于扎实的工程型配方总结，不是范式级方法创新。
summary.technical_approach:
模型建立在 NVIDIA Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-Base-BF16 之上，这是一个总参数约 30B、单次前向激活约 3B 参数的稀疏 MoE 模型。作者选择这个底座有两个原因：一是 MoE 让本地化训练和推理更省；二是 Nemotron 的原始预训练数据分布公开，便于从中抽取高质量英语/推理数据作为 anti-forgetting anchor。

训练分三阶段，采用 easy-to-hard curriculum。虽然全文截取里没有完整列出每阶段的精确配比，但从引言能看出其设计逻辑：先用结构更规整、语言现象更稳定的希伯来语来源，如文学、法律、正式文本，帮助模型建立词法和句法基础；再逐步引入更开放、更噪声、更依赖世界知识和推理的网络与混合语料。这个顺序不是装饰性的，而是论文明确拿正序和逆序做了对比。

另一个关键设计是 continuous anti-forgetting anchoring。作者不是在本地化完成后再补英语，而是在继续预训练过程中持续混入一部分 foundation model 原始训练信号，尤其是高质量英语 reasoning 数据，作为稳定器。这样做的目的很直接：避免模型在希伯来语强化过程中把原有英语能力和通用推理能力洗掉。这个思路和常见的 domain-adaptive pretraining 相比，更强调“保留基座能力”而不是只追求目标域增益。
