summary.technical_approach: 将原来计算 λ 的线性投影替换为轻量两层 MLP（softplus 激活），为每个 token、每个层级生成独立的自适应记忆衰减系数。选择 softplus 而非 softmax 的原因是：softmax 强制层级间竞争，当某些层级活跃时会人为抑制其他层级；而 softplus 允许各层级独立缩放。该修改增加不到 0.007% 的参数量，精确保持 O(T log T) 训练复杂度和 O(log T) 解码存储。
summary.experiments: 在三个任务上验证：(1) 多查询关联回忆（multi-query associative recall）；(2) 选择性复制（selective copying）；(3) WikiText-103 语言建模。在所有任务上一致优于基线，最大收益出现在高记忆负载和长序列场景——此时原始参数化方法性能退化甚至崩溃。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看 §1（引言）中对原 Log-Linear Attention 局限性的分析和 OpenReview 讨论引用，以及 §3（方法）中 MLP 设计和 softplus vs softmax 的讨论。实验部分 §4 验证结果清晰。预计阅读时间 15-20 分钟。适合关注长序列建模和高效架构的研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Log-Linear Attention organizes memory across a Fenwick tree hierarchy, achieving O(T log T) training complexity and O(log T) decoding memory. However, its memory decay parameter λ is computed via a linear projection of input, making it near-fixed and content-independent, assigning uniform weights across all hierarchy levels regardless of input content. The original paper's authors explicitly identified this as an open limitation.
summary_en.importance: Has practical engineering value for long-sequence modeling paradigms. Linearized attention is an important long-sequence alternative to Transformers, and enhancing content adaptivity while preserving linear complexity is an ongoing direction. This work demonstrates that a tiny modification (replacing linear projection with a two-layer MLP) yields consistent improvements, with implications for similar architectures like state-space models and linear Transformers.
summary_en.technical_approach: Replaces the original linear projection for computing λ with a lightweight two-layer MLP using softplus activation, producing independent adaptive memory decay coefficients for each token and each hierarchy level. Softplus is chosen over softmax because softmax forces inter-level competition, artificially suppressing some levels when others are active; softplus enables independent per-level scaling. The modification adds <0.007% parameters while preserving O(T log T) training complexity and O(log T) decoding memory exactly.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on three tasks: (1) multi-query associative recall; (2) selective copying; (3) WikiText-103 language modeling. Consistent improvements over the baseline across all tasks, with largest gains at high memory loads and long sequences — scenarios where the original parameterization degrades or collapses.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §1 (Introduction) for the analysis of original Log-Linear Attention limitations and OpenReview discussion citations, and §3 (Method) for MLP design and softplus vs softmax discussion. Experiments in §4 present clear validation results. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes. Suitable for researchers interested in long-sequence modeling and efficient architectures.

recommendation.zh: 看 softplus 的 per-level decay 设计即可；像是干净的小架构改动，是否有用取决于长程 recall 曲线。
recommendation.en: Focus on the softplus per-level decay design; it is a clean small architecture change whose value depends on the long-range recall curves.

paper.title: CSR: Infinite-Horizon Real-Time Policies with Massive Cached State Representations
paper.abstract: Deploying massive large language models (LLMs) as continuous cognitive engines for robotics is bottlenecked by the time-to-first-token (TTFT) latency required to process extensive state histories. Existing solutions like RAG or sliding windows compromise global context or incur prohibitive re-computation costs. We formalize the optimal task structure for minimizing latency and theoretically prove that prefix stability, incremental extensibility, and asynchronous state reconciliation are necessar

summary.core_problem: 大型 LLM 作为机器人连续认知引擎时，处理大量状态历史的 TTFT（time-to-first-token）延迟成为瓶颈。标准 KV-cache 只适合追加式序列，而机器人状态需要动态更新和旧数据驱逐，会导致缓存失效和全量重计算。
summary.importance: 对 LLM serving 系统设计有实际参考价值，特别是 KV-cache 复用策略和异步状态更新机制。理论上刻画的「前缀稳定性」和「增量可扩展性」两个必要条件，对长上下文连续推理系统设计有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 理论上证明了两个必要条件：前缀稳定性（历史上下文不可变以保持缓存有效）和增量可扩展性（新信息只能追加）。提出 Cached State Representation (CSR) 框架实现这些条件以最大化 KV-cache 复用。Asynchronous State Reconciliation (ASR) 算法将状态驱逐与主推理循环解耦，利用并行硬件预计算新状态的 KV-cache，消除延迟尖峰。
summary.experiments: 235B 参数模型在 120K token 上下文上实现 26 倍延迟降低（14.67s → 0.56s）。在 30B-235B 不同模型规模验证，实现 ≥2Hz 的高频响应。真实世界部署中无延迟尖峰，embodied AI 任务召回率 0.836（对比 RAG 的 0.459）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 Section 1（Introduction）和 Section 3（Cached State Representation）了解核心设计思路。实验部分看关键数字即可。对预训练研究者的参考价值在于理解长上下文 KV-cache 的工程约束，这可能影响未来长上下文模型的架构设计决策。预计阅读时间 15-20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When large LLMs serve as continuous cognitive engines for robotics, TTFT (time-to-first-token) latency for processing extensive state histories becomes a bottleneck. Standard KV caching only works well for append-only sequences, but robotic state requires dynamic updates and obsolete data eviction, which invalidate the cache and force full recomputation.
summary_en.importance: Practical reference for LLM serving system design, especially KV-cache reuse strategies and asynchronous state update mechanisms. The theoretically characterized necessary conditions (prefix stability and incremental extensibility) inform long-context continuous reasoning system design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Theoretically proves two necessary conditions: prefix stability (historical context must be immutable to preserve cache validity) and incremental extensibility (new information must be strictly appended). The Cached State Representation (CSR) framework implements these conditions for optimal KV-cache reuse. The Asynchronous State Reconciliation (ASR) algorithm decouples state eviction from the primary inference loop, using parallel hardware to precompute KV-cache for new states and eliminating latency spikes.
summary_en.experiments: 235B parameter model achieves 26× latency reduction (14.67s → 0.56s) on 120K token contexts. Validated across 30B–235B model sizes, achieving ≥2Hz high-frequency responsiveness. Bounded, spike-free operation in real-world deployments; embodied AI task recall 0.836 (vs. 0.459 for RAG).
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 1 (Introduction) and Section 3 (Cached State Representation) for core design ideas. Just check the key numbers in experiments. For pretraining researchers, the reference value lies in understanding engineering constraints of long-context KV caching, which may inform future architectural design decisions for long-context models. Estimated reading time: 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 关注长上下文推理和 KV-cache 管理的系统工作，其关于前缀稳定性和异步状态管理的理论分析对优化 LLM Serving 延迟有启发，可扫读方法部分。
recommendation.en: A systems paper focusing on long-context inference and KV-cache management; its theoretical analysis on prefix stability and asynchronous state management offers insights for optimizing LLM serving latency. Skim the methods section.

institutions: Graduate School of Informatics, Nagoya University, Aichi

paper.title: The Memory Curse: How Expanded Recall Erodes Cooperative Intent in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Context window expansion is often treated as a straightforward capability upgrade for LLMs, but we find it systematically fails in multi-agent social dilemmas. Across 7 LLMs and 4 games over 500 rounds, expanding accessible history degrades cooperation in 18 of 28 model--game settings, a pattern we term the memory curse. We isolate the underlying mechanism through three analyses. First, lexical analysis of 378,000 reasoning traces associates this breakdown with eroding forward-looking intent rat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究一个具体但容易被忽略的问题：在长程多智能体博弈中，给 LLM agent 更多可见历史，是否一定会提升合作与长期收益。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不大，但对长上下文建模和 agent 记忆机制有启发。结果提示，扩大 context window 不是单调能力提升。模型在长历史下可能更依赖逐条历史记录，变得防御、报复、短视，而不是形成更稳定的长期策略。这对基座模型的长上下文训练、记忆压缩、trajectory 数据构造都有参考意义：训练目标不能只奖励“记住更多”，还需要让模型学会抽象、遗忘、宽恕和面向未来的规划。
summary.technical_approach: 实验把同一模型实例化为多个 agent，在四类重复社会困境中交互：囚徒困境、旅行者困境、公共品博弈、信任博弈。每局扩展到 500 轮，远长于常见的 10 轮左右设定。核心变量是可见历史长度，作者扫描 9 个 history-length 设置，并要求模型输出 chain-of-thought 式推理和最终行动。机制分析分三层。第一，用 378,000 条推理轨迹做词汇和行为分析，区分“更偏执”与“更缺少前瞻性”两种解释。第二，用 memory sanitization 保持 prompt 长度不变，但替换可见历史内容，用来排除单纯长 prompt 或位置效应。第三，用 LoRA 在 Mistral-7B 上只训练 forward-looking reasoning traces，把它作为认知探针，观察是否能缓解长历史下的合作衰减。这个设计比单纯比较不同 context length 更干净，因为它把被动记忆长度、推理风格、prompt 长度和模型能力分开考察。
summary.experiments: 主实验覆盖 7 个模型、4 个博弈、9 个历史长度、3 个随机种子，每次交互 500 轮。模型包括 Gemma-3-12B、GPT-OSS-20B、GPT-OSS-120B、Llama-3.3-70B、Llama-4-Scout-17B、Mistral-7B、Qwen2.5-Coder-32B。结果显示，在 28 个 model-game 组合中，有 18 个组合随着可见历史扩展出现合作下降，即作者称为 memory curse 的现象。并非所有模型都会失败：一些能力更强或与游戏结构更匹配的组合能维持合作，说明问题不是 context length 本身，而是模型如何使用历史。词汇分析把合作崩塌更多关联到 forward-looking intent 的下降，而不是单纯 paranoia 上升。LoRA 干预在 Mistral-7B 上明显缓解长历史下的合作衰减，并能零样本迁移到未训练过的博弈；作者还检查了 GSM8K、TriviaQA、HumanEval、MBPP，声称没有明显损害通用能力。具体收益幅度需要看正文结果表和各游戏曲线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 分钟。重点看实验设置中 history length 的定义、500 轮重复博弈的 prompt、以及结果部分的合作率随历史长度变化曲线。机制部分值得看 memory sanitization 和 forward-looking LoRA 两个消融，它们决定了结论是否只是 prompt 长度伪影。附录中的游戏定义和 prompt 也值得快速检查，因为社会困境实验对提示词很敏感。对预训练研究者来说，不必深究博弈论细节，更应关注长上下文模型是否需要训练“选择性记忆”和“面向未来的压缩表示”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether giving LLM agents longer access to interaction history reliably improves cooperation in long-horizon multi-agent social dilemmas.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a core pretraining method, but it is relevant to long-context modeling and agent memory design. The main lesson is that a larger context window is not automatically a better memory system. Dense verbatim recall can make agents more history-following, defensive, and less forgiving, especially when they fail to abstract long-run incentives. For foundation-model research, this points to a gap between memorizing more tokens and using history in a compressed, forward-looking way.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study instantiates multiple agents from the same LLM and lets them play 500-round repeated social dilemmas: Prisoner’s Dilemma, Traveler’s Dilemma, Public Goods Game, and Trust Game. The main intervention is the visible history length, swept over nine settings. Agents are prompted to reason step by step and then output a final action. The analysis separates several possible mechanisms. Lexical analysis over reasoning traces tests whether cooperation decay comes from paranoia or from reduced forward-looking intent. Memory sanitization keeps prompt length fixed while replacing visible history content, which helps control for raw length effects. A targeted LoRA intervention on Mistral-7B is trained only on forward-looking reasoning traces and used as a cognitive probe: if cooperation recovers under long memory, the forward-looking hypothesis becomes more plausible.
summary_en.experiments: The main sweep covers 7 models, 4 games, 9 history-length settings, and 3 seeds, with 500 rounds per interaction. The evaluated models include Gemma-3-12B, GPT-OSS-20B, GPT-OSS-120B, Llama-3.3-70B, Llama-4-Scout-17B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen2.5-Coder-32B. Across 28 model-game combinations, 18 show cooperation degradation as accessible history expands. The paper reports more than 378,000 reasoning traces. The effect is not universal: some model-game pairs maintain cooperation, which suggests that memory length interacts with model capability, game structure, and reasoning style. The forward-looking LoRA reduces cooperation decay for Mistral-7B at extended history lengths, transfers to unseen games, and is reported not to harm GSM8K, TriviaQA, HumanEval, or MBPP performance in the authors’ checks.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25 minutes. Read the experimental setup carefully, especially how history length is defined and how the 500-round repeated games are prompted. Then focus on the cooperation-versus-history curves, the memory sanitization ablation, and the LoRA intervention. The appendix prompts matter because social-dilemma behavior is highly prompt-sensitive. For pretraining researchers, the most useful angle is not the game-theoretic result itself, but the evidence that long-context models may need training signals for selective memory, abstraction, and future-oriented planning.

recommendation.zh: 只看机制实验和 memory sanitization：它提醒长上下文不是单调增益，agent 评测不能只看任务分数。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanism experiments and memory sanitization: the useful lesson is that longer context is not a monotone gain for agents.

paper.title: MDN: Parallelizing Stepwise Momentum for Delta Linear Attention
paper.abstract: Linear Attention (LA) offers a promising paradigm for scaling large language models (LLMs) to long sequences by avoiding the quadratic complexity of self-attention. Recent LA models such as Mamba2 and GDN interpret linear recurrences as closed-form online stochastic gradient descent (SGD), but naive SGD updates suffer from rapid information decay and suboptimal convergence in optimization. While momentum-based optimizers provide a natural remedy, they pose challenges in simultaneously achieving

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 Delta Linear Attention 中“逐步动量更新难以并行化”的问题。线性注意力把序列建模写成递归状态更新，训练时需要 chunkwise 并行，推理时需要严格因果递推。已有 Delta Rule / GDN / KDA 类方法可以解释为对隐式目标做在线 SGD，但 SGD 只用当前梯度，历史信息衰减快，长上下文检索容易掉细节。动量可以缓解这个问题，但标准 stepwise momentum 是强序列依赖，直接使用会破坏大规模预训练的吞吐。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在建模范式和可训练性之间搭了一座桥。它不是简单给线性注意力加一个门控，而是把 LA 的递归更新重新解释为带动量的在线优化过程，并给出可并行训练的精确计算形式。对预训练研究的意义在于：如果线性注意力要成为长上下文基座模型的稳定替代或混合组件，仅有 O(L) 复杂度不够，还要解决历史信息保留、训练吞吐、推理一致性三件事。MDN 针对这三点同时设计，量级上属于线性注意力方向的结构性改进，而不是只调 kernel 或局部超参。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Momentum DeltaNet。论文先把 Delta Linear Attention 的状态更新看成在线最小二乘类目标的 SGD 闭式更新，再引入 stepwise momentum。动量项维护一个辅助状态，用过去梯度平滑当前更新，使状态变化不只由当前 token 决定。难点在于这种更新通常形如二阶递归，不能像普通 Delta Rule 那样直接做前缀乘积并行。

论文的关键技术是 chunkwise parallel algorithm。它从几何重排的角度拆解递归系数，把逐步动量中的耦合项重写成可在 chunk 内并行计算、chunk 间递推传递的形式。文中给出的等价系数包括 \(\widetilde{\alpha}_t=\alpha_t+\mu_t\beta_t/\beta_{t-1}\)、\(\widetilde{\beta}_t=\beta_t\eta_t\)、\(\widetilde{\gamma}_t=\alpha_{t-1}\mu_t\beta_t/\beta_{t-1}\)。训练时使用重排后的 chunkwise 并行形式，推理时仍使用 stepwise momentum 递推，因此避免了 blockwise momentum 常见的训练—推理不一致。

另一个重要点是动力系统分析。论文把动量递归写成二阶系统，指出动量会引入复特征值。复特征值可以带来振荡式记忆和更丰富的历史混合，但也可能造成不稳定。因此 MDN 不是无约束地学习所有门控，而是基于稳定性分析设计受限 gating，使状态演化保持在可控范围内。这一点区别于只经验性加入 momentum 或 decay 的线性 RNN 变体。
summary.experiments:
给定内容中明确披露的实验规模是 400M 和 1.3B 参数。论文报告 MDN 在这两个规模上相对强线性模型基线有一致收益，基线包括 KDA、Mamba2 一类具有高效 chunkwise 实现的模型。Triton 实现的训练效率被描述为与 KDA、Mamba2 等竞争性线性模型相当，说明并行化没有把动量收益换成不可接受的训练成本。

实验重点应包括三类结果。第一是语言建模或通用评测上的总体收益，用来验证动量更新不是只改善某个构造任务。第二是长上下文检索和细粒度历史保留任务，因为论文动机明确指向 LA 的 retrieval limitation。第三是消融实验：stepwise momentum 对比 blockwise momentum，受限 gating 对比无约束 gating，chunk size 对吞吐和效果的影响，以及是否保持训练—推理一致性。给定材料没有提供具体分数、吞吐数值和表号，因此不应把收益幅度写成确定数字。
summary.reading_guide:
建议精读三处。第一，Delta Rule / LA 与在线 SGD 对应关系的推导，这决定了“为什么动量是自然修改”，而不是随意加一个递归状态。第二，chunkwise parallel algorithm 的推导，特别是系数重排和 chunk 内/跨 chunk 状态传递。这是论文最有技术含量的部分，也最影响能否复现。第三，二阶动力系统和 gating 约束，这部分解释了模型为什么可能更稳，也能帮助判断它在更大规模预训练中是否有风险。

实验部分建议重点看 400M 到 1.3B 的 scaling 趋势，而不只看单点指标。如果 MDN 的增益随规模保持，说明它更可能是建模改进；如果只在小模型有效，则可能主要来自优化正则化。还应看效率表，尤其是 tokens/s、显存、chunk size、kernel 实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific bottleneck in Delta Linear Attention: stepwise momentum is attractive for memory retention and optimization quality, but it is hard to parallelize for large-scale training. Existing Delta-rule linear attention can be viewed as closed-form online SGD on a latent objective. This view also exposes a weakness: plain SGD relies on the current gradient and tends to forget fine-grained historical information quickly. Momentum can help, but a naive step-by-step momentum recurrence is sequential and does not fit high-throughput pretraining.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is relevant to long-context pretraining because it connects three constraints that usually conflict: better historical retention, efficient chunkwise training, and exact causal recurrent decoding. The work is more than a kernel optimization. It changes the recurrence rule of Delta Linear Attention while preserving a trainable parallel form. For researchers studying linear attention as a replacement or hybrid component for Transformer blocks, MDN offers a concrete route to move beyond SGD-like state updates without giving up pretraining efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The proposed model is Momentum DeltaNet. The paper starts from the interpretation of Delta Linear Attention as an online optimization process and replaces the plain SGD-style update with a stepwise momentum rule. Momentum introduces an auxiliary state that accumulates past gradient information, which can smooth updates and preserve longer-range signals.

The main technical device is a chunkwise parallel algorithm for this stepwise momentum recurrence. Instead of using blockwise momentum, which weakens within-block causality and creates a training-inference mismatch, the paper algebraically reorders the update coefficients so that the same causal stepwise rule can be evaluated in parallel within chunks. The derived equivalent coefficients include terms such as \(\widetilde{\alpha}_t=\alpha_t+\mu_t\beta_t/\beta_{t-1}\), \(\widetilde{\beta}_t=\beta_t\eta_t\), and \(\widetilde{\gamma}_t=\alpha_{t-1}\mu_t\beta_t/\beta_{t-1}\). Training uses the parallel chunk form, while recurrent decoding keeps the original stepwise update.

The paper also analyzes the momentum recurrence as a second-order dynamical system. Momentum changes the spectrum of the recurrence and can introduce complex eigenvalues. This gives the model richer temporal dynamics, but it also creates stability concerns. MDN therefore uses constrained gating mechanisms rather than unconstrained gates. This design is motivated by the dynamics, not only by empirical tuning.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided content explicitly states experiments at 400M and 1.3B parameter scales. MDN is reported to give consistent improvements over strong linear-attention baselines, including models in the KDA and Mamba2 family, while a Triton implementation reaches training efficiency comparable to those competitive linear models.

The key experiments to inspect are likely the general language-modeling evaluations, long-context retrieval tests, and ablations over the momentum rule, gating constraints, and chunkwise implementation. The most important comparison is stepwise momentum versus blockwise momentum, because that tests whether preserving strict temporal causality matters in practice. The supplied material does not include exact benchmark scores, throughput numbers, or ablation tables, so the magnitude of the gains should be checked directly in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read the derivation of the Delta-rule-as-online-SGD view first, because it explains why momentum is the right modification. Then focus on the chunkwise parallel algorithm and the coefficient reordering; this is the core implementation idea. The dynamical-system section is also worth careful reading, especially the eigenvalue discussion and the resulting gating constraints.

For experiments, focus on whether the gains hold from 400M to 1.3B, not only on a single benchmark. Also check the efficiency tables for tokens per second, memory use, chunk size, and Triton kernel details. These details determine whether the method is plausible for larger pretraining runs.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你怎么看“线性递推=在线优化器”这条线；先读动力系统分析和稳定门控设计，若实验扎实，值得在内部长序列 pretrain 上复现。
recommendation.en: This can change how seriously you take the 'linear recurrence as online optimizer' view; read the dynamical-systems analysis and stable gating first, and if the setup is solid, it is worth reproducing for long-context pretraining.

paper.title: UniPrefill: Universal Long-Context Prefill Acceleration via Block-wise Dynamic Sparsification
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) continue to advance rapidly, they are becoming increasingly capable while simultaneously demanding ever-longer context lengths. To improve the inference efficiency of long-context processing, several novel low-complexity hybrid architectures have recently been proposed, effectively alleviating the computational burden of long-context inference. However, existing research on long-context prefill acceleration remains predominantly focused on sparse attention mechani

summary.core_problem: 在长上下文推理的 prefill 阶段，现有加速方法主要绑定“全注意力层的稀疏化”，对新一代 hybrid 架构（线性/滑窗 + 少量全注意力）收益显著下降，且难以融入 vLLM 这类连续批处理（continuous batching）调度；论文要解决的是：如何做一种对架构更通用、并且可生产落地的 prefill 加速。
summary.importance: 偏推理系统与 serving 工程贡献，不直接改变预训练范式，但对“长上下文模型在真实高并发服务下的 TTFT 成本结构”给出一个可操作的加速路径：通过把稀疏决策从“只省 attention FLOPs”扩展到“连带省后续层的 GEMM FLOPs”，让 hybrid 架构也能吃到收益。对做长上下文预训练的人，价值主要在于理解部署侧瓶颈与架构选择（full-attn 层比例、block 设计）如何影响端到端成本。
summary.technical_approach: UniPrefill 的关键设计是“在全注意力层做 token 重要性估计，然后把 token-drop 的稀疏性向后传播到一个 block 的后续层”。具体做法：在每个 full-attention 层用轻量的 block-wise scoring 评估 token 重要性，选择性丢弃冗余 token；一旦 token 被丢弃，它在该 block 后续层（不仅是 attention 子层，也包括 MLP/GEMM 计算）都不再参与计算，从而同时减少 attention FLOPs 与 GEMM FLOPs。与只对 attention 做稀疏化的方法相比，这种“级联式 token-drop”在 hybrid 架构里更有效，因为 full-attn 层虽少，但一次决策能影响后续多层的计算量。系统侧，作者把 UniPrefill 实现为 continuous batching operator，并扩展 vLLM scheduler 支持在 token-drop 语义下的 prefill-decode co-processing 与 tensor parallel，使其能在请求动态进出 batch 的场景工作，而不是停留在单请求/静态 batch 的研究原型。
summary.experiments: 在 RULER 长上下文基准上评测多种架构，结论是“几乎无显著精度损失”前提下，TTFT 最多提升到 2.1×；并且加速收益随并发请求数提升而更明显（更贴近生产高吞吐场景）。论文在引言中对比了稀疏 attention 方法在 hybrid 架构中受限于 full-attn 层占比、边际收益变小的现象，实验部分主要验证 UniPrefill 在不同架构下的稳定收益与可并发扩展性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看 Introduction 里对 hybrid 架构下“只加速 full-attn 不够”的成本拆解动机；再看方法部分关于“token importance 在 full-attn 层估计、并向后传播到 block 后续层”的机制描述，理解它为何能同时省 attention 与 GEMM；最后看系统实现与 vLLM scheduler 改动，确认它如何支持 continuous batching 与 prefill-decode co-processing。预计 30–45 分钟可抓住主要思路，若要复现/落地再细读实现细节与调度策略。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-context prefill acceleration largely targets sparsifying full attention, which delivers strong gains only when most layers are full-attention. On modern hybrid stacks (linear/sliding-window layers plus a few full-attention layers), the marginal benefit collapses, and many methods do not integrate cleanly with continuous batching in production engines like vLLM. The paper addresses how to build an architecture-agnostic, production-friendly prefill accelerator.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference/serving contribution rather than a pretraining one. Its relevance to foundation-model researchers is in clarifying the real TTFT cost structure for long-context deployments and showing a mechanism that remains effective on hybrid architectures by reducing not only attention FLOPs but also downstream GEMM compute. This can inform architectural choices (e.g., placement/ratio of full-attention layers, block design) under serving constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniPrefill makes token-dropping decisions at full-attention layers using a lightweight block-wise importance score, then propagates that sparsity to all subsequent layers within a block. Once a token is dropped, it is excluded from later computation, so the savings extend beyond the attention sublayer to MLP/GEMM as well. This differs from attention-only sparsification: even if full-attention layers are sparse in a hybrid model, each decision amortizes across many following layers. On the systems side, UniPrefill is implemented as a continuous-batching operator and requires scheduler extensions in vLLM to support prefill-decode co-processing and tensor parallel under the token-drop regime.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on the RULER long-context benchmark across multiple architectures. The reported outcome is up to 2.1× TTFT speedup with negligible accuracy degradation, and the speedup improves with higher request concurrency (aligning with production scenarios where prefill dominates).
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction for the argument why attention-only acceleration underperforms on hybrids. Then read the method section to understand the “drop at full-attn, cascade through the block” mechanism and why it reduces both attention and GEMM. Finally, check the vLLM integration/scheduler changes to see how continuous batching is supported. ~30–45 minutes for the main idea; deeper reading only if you plan to implement it.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统设计和端到端表格即可；若它真兼容 hybrid attention 和 continuous batching，长上下文架构评估要加这一项。
recommendation.en: Skim the system design and end-to-end tables; if it really supports hybrid attention plus continuous batching, long-context architecture evals need this axis.

paper.title: Shallow Prefill, Deep Decoding: Efficient Long-Context Inference via Layer-Asymmetric KV Visibility
paper.abstract: Long-context inference in decoder-only language models is costly because long prompts are processed during Prefill, cached at every layer, and repeatedly attended to during autoregressive Decode. We introduce \emph{Shallow Prefill, dEEp Decode} (SPEED), a phase-asymmetric KV-visibility policy that materializes non-anchor prompt-token KV states only in lower layers while keeping Decode-phase tokens full-depth. Unlike previous approaches that make upper-layer prompt KV states cheaper to store or c

summary.core_problem: 解码器-only大模型的长上下文推理成本高，Prefill阶段生成的全层KV缓存占用大量内存，且Decode阶段每层都要读取全量Prefill KV，导致首token延迟、单token生成延迟和KV内存占用随上下文长度和模型深度快速上升；现有方法仅压缩或近似上层Prefill KV，未从根本上消除上层对Prefill KV的依赖。
summary.importance: 提出了阶段不对称的KV可见性范式，打破了Prefill和Decode token必须经过相同层数并缓存全层KV的常规设计，对长上下文推理优化、推理系统架构设计有明确的工程参考价值，也为预训练阶段的层间分工设计提供了新的观察视角。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SPEED策略，在L层Transformer中，非锚点Prefill token仅经过前K层处理并缓存KV，Decode token仍经过全部L层并生成全层KV；仅保留BoS token作为锚点缓存全层KV，用于稳定长上下文生成。该策略仅修改KV可见性规则，不改动模型权重、训练目标或位置编码。
summary.experiments: 基于Llama-3.1-8B Base做受控指令微调实验，K=24（即仅用75%层数处理Prefill）加BoS锚点的SPEED-24+BoS，在OLMES风格基准上平均得分51.2，与全层微调基线的51.4接近；128K上下文下，首token延迟降低33%，单token生成延迟降低22%，KV内存占用减少25%。基于现成Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct做1 epoch LoRA适配后，中等K值的SPEED在文档QA和长上下文检索任务上仍与全层LoRA性能相当。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第2节的SPEED机制设计和第3节的受控实验结果，附录的层间诊断方法可快速浏览，总阅读时间约25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context inference for decoder-only large language models incurs high cost: full-layer KV states generated during the Prefill phase occupy large memory footprint, and each Decode step reads full Prefill KV across all layers, causing time-to-first-token (TTFT), time-per-output-token (TPOT), and KV memory usage to scale sharply with context length and model depth. Existing methods only compress or approximate upper-layer Prefill KV, rather than eliminating upper layers' dependency on Prefill KV entirely.
summary_en.importance: It proposes a phase-asymmetric KV visibility paradigm, breaking the conventional assumption that Prefill and Decode tokens must go through the same number of layers and retain full-layer KV. The method provides practical engineering reference for long-context inference optimization and inference system design, and offers new insights into inter-layer labor division during pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The SPEED policy works as follows: in an L-layer transformer, non-anchor Prefill tokens are only processed and cached through the first K layers (K < L), while Decode-phase tokens still traverse all L layers and generate full-depth KV caches. Only the BoS token is retained as an anchor with full-layer KV cache to stabilize long-context generation. This policy only modifies KV visibility rules, without changing model weights, training objectives, or positional encoding.
summary_en.experiments: Controlled instruction tuning experiments on Llama-3.1-8B Base show that SPEED-24+BoS (K=24, using 75% of layers for Prefill, with BoS anchoring) achieves 51.2 average score on OLMES-style benchmarks, close to the full-depth fine-tuning baseline of 51.4. For 128K context, it reduces TTFT by 33%, TPOT by 22%, and active KV memory by 25%. When applied via 1-epoch LoRA adaptation on off-the-shelf Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, SPEED with moderate K cutoff remains competitive with full-depth LoRA on document-grounded QA and long-context retrieval tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for SPEED mechanism design and Section 3 for controlled experiment results. The layer-wise diagnostic method in the appendix can be skimmed. Total reading time is around 25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看，因为它不是花哨压缩而是直接问“高层到底需不需要看完整 prompt”；先读方法图和 75% layer 那组表，若复现稳，可反哺训练时层功能设计。
recommendation.en: Worth reading because it asks the cleaner question—do upper layers really need full prompt visibility? Read the method figure and the 75%-layer table first; if it reproduces, it should feed back into training-time layer design.

paper.title: Training Transformers for KV Cache Compressibility
paper.abstract: Long-context language modeling is increasingly constrained by the Key-Value (KV) cache, whose memory and decode-time access costs scale linearly with the prefix length. This bottleneck has motivated a range of context-compression methods, from token-level summarization to recent optimization-based KV compression methods. These post-hoc methods operate on the KV cache of a fixed pretrained model, so their effectiveness is fundamentally limited by how well the model's internal representations can

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题很直接：KV cache 压缩的上限不只取决于压缩算法，也取决于模型在训练中学出了什么样的内部表示。作者关心的是，能不能通过继续预训练，让 Transformer 自身变得更“可压缩”，从而让后续任何 post-hoc KV compression 方法都更有效。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发在于，它把长上下文推理中的 KV cache 问题从纯推理优化，往训练目标和表示学习上推了一步。很多现有方法默认模型固定，只在推理时做裁剪、摘要或优化式压缩；这篇工作指出，表示是否冗余、是否把关键信息组织成可压缩形式，本身是可训练的。这对 continued pretraining、长上下文适配和 serving-aware pretraining 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先形式化了 KV-compressibility，把它定义为：是否存在一个压缩策略，能把长前缀的 KV cache 映射到更短 cache，同时近似保持 next-token 分布。理论部分说明，同一个 sequence-to-vector function 可以有高度可压缩的 Transformer 实现，也可以有几乎不可压缩的实现，因此可压缩性是 learned representation 的属性，不是输入序列天然决定的。基于这个观点，作者提出 KV-CAT。做法是在 continued pretraining 中引入训练时 KV sparsification：随机或按策略屏蔽一部分 KV 槽位，让模型在信息瓶颈下前向。损失由两部分组成，一部分是 self-distillation，让稀疏 KV 前向去匹配原始 dense 前向的输出分布；另一部分保留标准 next-token prediction，在未屏蔽前向上维持原模型能力。这样训练的目标不是直接替代现有压缩算法，而是让模型学出更适合被这些算法压缩的表示。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Qwen2.5 系列模型，评测三类指标：前缀压缩后的 suffix perplexity、从压缩前缀中做 retrieval 的准确率，以及 LongBench v2 上的压缩长上下文问答。结果显示，经过 KV-CAT 的模型在不同压缩预算、模型规模和后续压缩方法下，都有更好的 quality-budget tradeoff。文中给出的代表性数字包括：suffix perplexity retention 最多提升 3.21 倍，优化式压缩的求解时间最多加速 5 倍，retrieval accuracy 提升最高 68%，LongBench v2 长上下文 QA 提升最高 39%。这些结果说明训练出的表示更规整后，不只是压缩误差更小，连后续优化过程也更容易。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看引言和问题形式化，抓住作者的核心判断：KV 压缩不是纯后处理问题。然后看理论部分里的构造性例子，尤其是同一计算目标可以有可压缩和不可压缩两种实现，这一段能帮助理解为什么要改训练而不是只改压缩器。实验部分重点看三张结果：perplexity-retention 曲线、retrieval、LongBench v2。若时间有限，30 分钟内读完方法总览、主结果和一页消融就够。若要继续深挖，可以看训练时 sparsification 策略、蒸馏目标细节，以及不同 post-hoc compression 方法在 KV-CAT checkpoint 上的收益差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether KV-cache compressibility should be treated as a property to train for, rather than something to recover only at inference time. Existing KV compression methods operate on a fixed pretrained model, so their ceiling is limited by how compressible that model’s internal representations already are. The core problem is therefore: can we continue training a transformer so that its KV cache becomes easier to compress without sacrificing its standard dense-cache behavior?
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is conceptual. It reframes long-context efficiency from a purely inference-side problem into a representation-learning problem. That matters because many current approaches assume the model is fixed and only optimize the compressor. This paper argues that the model itself can be made more compression-friendly through continued pretraining. For foundation-model work, that is relevant to long-context adaptation, serving-aware pretraining, and the broader idea that deployment constraints should feed back into training objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper first formalizes KV-compressibility as the existence of a compression policy that maps a long KV cache to a shorter one while preserving the next-token distribution up to small error. The theoretical section shows that compressibility is not determined by the task or the input sequence alone: nearly any sequence-to-vector function can be implemented by transformers whose caches are either highly compressible or fundamentally hard to compress. This motivates making compressibility an explicit training target.

The proposed method, KV-CAT, is a continued pretraining procedure. During training, the model is exposed to a KV sparsification policy that masks out a constant fraction of KV slots, creating an information bottleneck. The objective combines two losses: a self-distillation loss that makes the masked model match the dense model’s output distribution, and a standard next-token prediction loss on the unmasked forward pass to preserve the original model’s dense-cache quality. The goal is not to replace post-hoc compression algorithms, but to reshape the learned representations so that those algorithms work better afterward.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on Qwen2.5 models and evaluate three settings: suffix perplexity under compressed prefixes, retrieval accuracy from compressed prefixes, and compressed long-context QA on LongBench v2. The main result is consistent improvement in the quality–budget tradeoff across compression budgets, model sizes, and downstream compression methods. The paper reports up to 3.21× better suffix perplexity retention, up to 5× faster optimization time for compression, up to 68% higher retrieval accuracy, and up to 39% gains on long-context QA. The optimization-time result is especially interesting because it suggests that better-trained representations are not only more compressible in principle, but also easier for optimization-based compressors to fit in practice.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, read the introduction, the formal problem setup, and the main experimental figures. The key idea to retain is that KV compressibility is a learned property of the representation, not just a property of the context. If you have a bit more time, look at the theoretical constructions showing that the same computation can admit both compressible and non-compressible transformer implementations. Then read the KV-CAT training recipe and the main result tables on perplexity retention, retrieval, and LongBench v2. A 25–30 minute pass is enough to capture the main idea and empirical takeaway.

recommendation.zh: 只看第3节理论证明和第4节正则设计，可参考在长上下文预训练中加入类似约束降低推理成本
recommendation.en: Only read Section 3 for theoretical proof and Section 4 for regularization design, referenceable for adding similar constraints in long-context pretraining to reduce inference cost

paper.title: The Structural Origin of Attention Sink: Variance Discrepancy, Super Neurons, and Dimension Disparity
paper.abstract: Despite the prevalence of the attention sink phenomenon in Large Language Models (LLMs), where initial tokens disproportionately monopolize attention scores, its structural origins remain elusive. This work provides a \textit{mechanistic explanation} for this phenomenon. First, we trace its root to the value aggregation process inherent in self-attention, which induces a systematic variance discrepancy. We further demonstrate that this discrepancy is drastically amplified by the activation of su

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解释 decoder-only Transformer 中 attention sink 为什么稳定出现在初始 token 上。问题不是简单描述“第一个 token 被过度关注”，而是追踪这个现象从自注意力值聚合、FFN 放大、残差传播到 QK 打分偏置的结构性因果链。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于，它把 attention sink 从经验现象推进到可干预的架构问题。attention sink 会影响长上下文、KV cache 压缩、activation outlier、表示塌缩和训练稳定性。论文指出 sink 不是规模增大后的不可避免结果，而是由 value aggregation 的方差差异触发，并可通过归一化或 attention 形式调整缓解。这个结论对 base model 架构设计和预训练稳定性有直接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者的机制链条是：在 causal mask 下，第一个 token 只能 attend to itself，不经历多 token value averaging；后续 token 会聚合越来越长的上下文，表示方差被平均效应压低。于是初始 token 成为高方差 outlier。这个 outlier 经过 attention output projection 后被保留，并在 FFN 中激活 super neurons。SwiGLU FFN 的 channel-sparse down-projection 进一步造成某些维度上的 representation disparity。残差连接和 normalization 不能完全消除这种差异，差异最终进入 query-key dot product，使其他位置把初始 token 当作结构锚点。为了验证因果关系，作者做了两类干预：改变 attention mask 来隔离聚合效应；人为放大任意 token 的表示方差。两者都能把 sink 诱导到指定位置。方法层面的改动包括用 Sigmoid attention 替代 Softmax attention，以及引入 head-wise RMSNorm 来稳定每个 attention head 的 value aggregation 输出。
summary.experiments: 主要分析对象是 Llama-2-7B，并在 WikiText-2 上追踪跨层 attention pattern 与 hidden-state norm。作者观察到初始 token 的 attention weight 在早期层较低，但在约第 2 层附近突然上升；同一层附近，初始 token 表示的 l2 norm 也同步出现异常增大。这一同步性支持“表示方差异常触发 sink”的路径。控制实验显示，修改 mask 或提高任意位置的方差，可以在任意 token 上制造 attention sink，说明初始 token 不是语义特殊，而是统计结构特殊。预训练实验中，Sigmoid attention 因为不受 Softmax sum-to-one 约束，明显减轻了初始 token 的高方差异常；head-wise RMSNorm 也抑制了 sink，并带来更快的预训练收敛。材料中没有给出完整预训练规模、token 数和 loss 曲线数值，阅读时需要核对 Figure 2、Figure 3 以及附录中的跨模型验证。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25 到 40 分钟。先看 Section 3 对 variance discrepancy 的定义，以及 Figure 3 中 attention weight spike 和 first-token l2 norm spike 的同步关系。然后看两个控制干预，它们是论文因果论证的关键：如果任意位置被赋予类似初始 token 的方差特征也会变成 sink，机制解释就比位置编码或 Softmax 残余概率假设更有说服力。最后看 Sigmoid attention 与 head-wise RMSNorm 的预训练实验，重点关注它们是否只降低 sink，还是同时改善 loss 收敛。附录中的其他模型验证适合快速扫一遍，用来判断结论是否只依赖 Llama-2-7B。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper explains why attention sinks in decoder-only Transformers consistently attach to the initial token. Rather than treating the first token as a semantic attractor, it traces a structural causal chain from value aggregation, to FFN amplification, to residual propagation, and finally to biased query-key scores.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for pretraining research because attention sinks are tied to long-context behavior, KV-cache compression, activation outliers, representation collapse, and training stability. The paper argues that sinks are not an unavoidable consequence of scale. They arise from variance discrepancy in value aggregation and can be reduced by targeted architectural changes. This makes the phenomenon relevant to base-model architecture design, not only to interpretability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed mechanism starts with causal self-attention. The initial token attends only to itself, while later tokens aggregate values from an expanding context. This averaging reduces the variance of later token representations, leaving the first token as a high-variance outlier. The attention output projection preserves this outlier, and the FFN then amplifies it through super-neuron activations. In SwiGLU FFNs, channel-sparse down-projections create a dimension disparity in the token representation. Residual connections and normalization layers propagate rather than fully remove this disparity. The distorted representation then dominates query-key dot products, making the first token a structural anchor. The causal claim is tested with two interventions: modifying attention masks to isolate aggregation effects, and increasing the variance of arbitrary token representations. Both can induce attention sinks at chosen positions. The paper also evaluates two remedies: replacing Softmax attention with Sigmoid attention, and adding head-wise RMSNorm to stabilize value-aggregation outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The main analysis is conducted on Llama-2-7B using WikiText-2. The authors track attention patterns and hidden-state norms across layers. They observe that attention to the initial token remains low in the earliest layers, then rises sharply around layer 2. At the same depth, the l2 norm of the first-token representation also spikes, supporting the proposed trigger from representation outliers to attention sinks. Controlled interventions show that arbitrary positions can become sinks when they are given the same variance property, indicating that the effect is structural rather than semantic. In pretraining experiments, Sigmoid attention reduces the sink because it removes the Softmax sum-to-one constraint that helps create the high-variance first-token outlier. Head-wise RMSNorm also suppresses sinks and improves convergence speed. The provided content does not include full pretraining scale, token counts, or exact loss numbers, so the relevant figures and appendices should be checked for quantitative details.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim takes about 25 to 40 minutes. Start with the definition of variance discrepancy and the layer-wise evidence in Figure 3, especially the alignment between the attention spike and the first-token norm spike. Then read the two intervention experiments, since they carry most of the causal argument. If a non-initial token can be made into a sink by manipulating variance, the explanation is stronger than hypotheses based only on position or Softmax residual mass. Finally, read the Sigmoid-attention and head-wise-RMSNorm pretraining results to see whether the interventions merely suppress the sink or also improve optimization. The appendix with additional models is useful for judging how specific the effect is to Llama-2-7B.

recommendation.zh: 只看机制链和干预实验即可；若证据干净，会改变把 attention sink 当纯训练偶然性的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the causal chain and intervention experiments; if the setup is clean, it weakens the prior that attention sinks are just a training artifact.

paper.title: Don't Lose Focus: Activation Steering via Key-Orthogonal Projections
paper.abstract: Activation steering controls LLM behaviour towards target behaviour by intervening in internal representations, yet it often degrades reasoning and retrieval performance. We argue that a primary cause of this trade-off is attention rerouting: steering vectors alter query-key matching, shifting attention away from contextually important tokens toward less informative ones. To address this, we propose Steering via Key-Orthogonal Projections (SKOP), a steering method that constrains harmful attenti

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 activation steering 里一个很具体但长期没有被拆开的矛盾：想把模型往目标行为上推，比如更愿意拒答有害请求、或更偏向某种行为风格，通常会伤到原本的推理和检索能力。作者把问题定位到 attention rerouting——当你在 query 空间加 steering vector 时，改变的不只是某个抽象语义方向，还会直接改写 query-key 相对打分，导致注意力从真正关键的 token 上移开，转而分散到一批信息价值更低的 tail tokens。论文的核心不是再做一个经验上更稳的 steering trick，而是给出一个可分析的机制解释，并据此设计只抑制“有害 rerouting”而不过度压制 steering 效果的方法。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在于它是 post-hoc 控制方法，而在于它把“表示干预为什么会伤 utility”这件事讲清楚了。很多人把 activation steering 看成线性语义编辑，但这篇文章说明，在 transformer 里，哪怕只改 query，也会通过 attention logits 的相对变化放大成检索路径和推理路径的偏移。这个观察对预训练研究有两层启发。第一，内部表示的可控性不能只看线性可分性，还要看它是否会破坏模型已经学到的 attention routing 结构。第二，若以后要把 steering、test-time control、甚至训练期的 representation regularization 做得更稳，重点可能不是“完全不改注意力”，而是“只保护少数真正承载能力的 focus tokens”。从贡献量级看，它更像一个机制层面的增量但扎实的工作，不是范式替换；不过对理解 attention-space intervention 的副作用很有帮助。
summary.technical_approach:
方法建立在 query-space steering 的闭式分析上。作者先把 query steering 写成对某些层、某些头的 query 向量加上固定方向 r_q。这样 attention logit 的变化可以拆成一个与 key 直接内积的附加项，因此 rerouting 的来源可以被单独刻画。接着作者观察到，若强行要求 attention 完全不变，相当于把 steering 向量投影到某种 null space 里，虽然能保 utility，但 steering efficacy 也几乎被一起抹掉。这说明“完全保持 attention invariant”约束太强。

SKOP 的做法更细：它不追求全局 attention 不变，而是只保护 focus set。具体地，作者先在 utility 任务上找出每个 head 原本高注意力的 token 集合，视为 focus tokens；低注意力的一批 token 视为 tail tokens。然后利用这些 token 的 key 表示差分，构造出那些最容易把注意力从 focus 推向 tail 的方向子空间。对原始 steering vector，只去掉它在这部分子空间上的分量，保留其余分量。名字里的 Key-Orthogonal Projections，指的就是 steering 向量相对于由 key 差分张成的“有害方向”做正交投影。

还有两个实现点值得注意。第一，作者不是对所有头统一修正，而是识别 risk heads，只在最容易发生 harmful rerouting 的头上应用 SKOP，这样减少对 steering 强度的无谓削弱。第二，focus/tail 的定义来自 utility 数据上的 head-level attention 统计，而不是人工规则，因此方法本身是数据驱动的。和已有 residual-space null-space steering、或直接 query steering 相比，区别在于它把约束对象从“表示本身”换成“由 key 几何诱发的注意力迁移方向”，约束更弱，也更贴近 utility 退化的实际机制。
summary.experiments:
从引言和正文可见，实验覆盖了多个 steering benchmark，并特别强调 reasoning、retrieval 和 long-context retrieval 这几类最容易被误伤的能力。核心结果有三点。第一，SKOP 在 steering efficacy 基本保持的前提下，把 utility degradation 降低了 5–7 倍，这是全文最关键的数字。第二，作者用 top-set attention mass preservation 之类指标展示：普通 query steering 会明显把注意力从少量关键 token 挪走，而 SKOP 能显著保住这些 token 上的注意力质量。第三，在长上下文检索场景里，SKOP 仍然有效，作者将其表述为首个稳健的 long-context activation steering 展示，这一点比一般短上下文行为控制更有意思，因为长上下文下 attention rerouting 的代价更高。

消融方面，文中至少有两类关键对比。其一是与 exact attention invariance 或 null-space style 约束比较：后者 utility 保得住，但 steering 几乎失效，说明约束过强。其二是 selective head correction 的价值：只修 risk heads 比全头修正更能维持 steering-utility trade-off。若精读，建议留意不同层、不同头的 rerouting 强弱分布，以及 focus/tail 划分阈值对结果的敏感性；这些细节决定方法是否真有普适性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三处。第一，看 Sec. 3 对 query steering 如何进入 attention logits 的推导，这是全文最有信息量的部分，决定了后面为什么能做 key-orthogonal correction。第二，看 Fig. 1 和 Fig. 2，尤其是 attention 从 focus tokens 流失、以及 exact invariance 会压掉 steering efficacy 的证据。第三，看方法部分里 risk heads 的选择和 projection 的构造方式，确认它到底是在做局部几何修正，还是只是另一个经验正则。

如果时间有限，优先顺序可以是：机制分析图表 → SKOP 算法定义 → 主结果表 → 长上下文实验。预计 30–45 分钟能把主要思想读明白。更值得深挖的点有两个：一是 focus tokens 是否稳定、是否会随任务和上下文变化；二是这种 key-difference 子空间是否能迁移到训练期，变成一种更一般的 attention-preserving regularizer。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific failure mode in activation steering: stronger steering often improves the target behavior but degrades unrelated capabilities such as reasoning and retrieval. The authors argue that the main cause is attention rerouting. When a steering vector is added in query space, it does not merely shift a semantic feature; it changes relative query-key scores and therefore changes which tokens receive attention. In practice, attention moves away from a small set of high-value focus tokens toward a broader set of low-value tail tokens. The paper’s central contribution is to isolate this mechanism analytically and design a correction that suppresses harmful rerouting without nullifying steering itself.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is mostly mechanistic. Activation steering is often discussed as if latent directions can be edited independently of the model’s computational pathways. This work shows that in transformers, even a clean query-space intervention can perturb routing in a way that directly harms utility. That matters beyond steering. It suggests that controllability of internal representations should not be judged only by linear separability, but also by whether the intervention preserves the attention structure that supports retrieval and reasoning. For pretraining-oriented readers, the broader lesson is that many representation-level controls may fail because they disturb a small set of critical tokens rather than because they globally distort the residual stream. The contribution is not a new pretraining paradigm, but it is a solid mechanism paper with practical implications for test-time control and possibly for training-time regularization.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method starts from a closed-form analysis of query-space steering. A steering vector is added to selected query representations, and the resulting change in attention logits can be written explicitly as an additive term involving keys. This makes the source of rerouting analyzable. The authors then show that enforcing exact attention invariance, for example through null-space style constraints adapted from residual steering, is too strong: it preserves utility but largely destroys steering efficacy.

SKOP takes a weaker and more targeted route. Instead of preserving the full attention pattern, it preserves attention on a small focus set. For each head, the method identifies tokens that receive high attention on utility tasks as focus tokens, and weakly attended tokens as tail tokens. It then uses differences between their key representations to characterize directions that are likely to shift attention from focus to tail. The original steering vector is projected to remove only components aligned with these harmful key-difference directions. The remaining components are kept, so steering can still act through other channels.

Two implementation choices matter. First, the correction is applied only to risk heads, namely heads that are most prone to harmful rerouting, rather than uniformly across all heads. Second, the focus/tail partition is data-driven, derived from attention statistics on utility data rather than hand-crafted rules. Compared with prior residual-space null-space constraints or plain query steering, the key difference is that SKOP constrains the geometry of attention migration induced by keys, not the entire intervention space. That makes the constraint weaker and better aligned with the actual failure mode.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover multiple steering benchmarks and emphasize reasoning, retrieval, and long-context retrieval, where utility loss is especially visible. The headline result is that SKOP reduces utility degradation by 5–7x while retaining strong steering efficacy. That is the main quantitative takeaway. The paper also introduces attention-based diagnostics, such as preservation of attention mass on top tokens, showing that standard query steering pulls attention away from a small set of critical tokens, whereas SKOP largely preserves them. A further result is that the method remains effective in long-context retrieval, which the authors present as the first robust demonstration of long-context activation steering.

The most informative ablations compare SKOP against exact attention-invariance or null-space style constraints. Those baselines preserve utility but suppress steering too aggressively, confirming that full invariance is the wrong objective. Another useful ablation studies selective correction: fixing only risk heads yields a better steering-utility trade-off than correcting all heads indiscriminately. When reading, it is worth checking how rerouting varies by layer and head, and how sensitive the method is to the definition of focus versus tail tokens.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick but useful read, focus on three parts. First, read the derivation showing how query-space steering enters attention logits; that is the conceptual backbone of the paper. Second, inspect the early figures that visualize attention moving away from focus tokens and the failure of exact invariance constraints. Third, read the method section carefully enough to understand how risk heads are selected and how the projection space is constructed from key differences.

A practical reading order is: mechanism analysis and figures, then the SKOP algorithm, then the main result tables, and finally the long-context experiments. Around 30–45 minutes should be enough to extract the main idea. The deeper questions are whether focus tokens are stable across tasks and contexts, and whether the same key-difference geometry could be turned into a training-time regularizer rather than only an inference-time fix.

recommendation.zh: 机制判断比方法本身更值钱：只看 attention rerouting 这个解释和长上下文结果即可；若你做 steering/representation editing，值得顺手复现。
recommendation.en: The mechanism matters more than the method: read it for the attention-rerouting explanation and the long-context results; if you work on steering or representation editing, it is worth a quick reproduction.

paper.title: Short Data, Long Context: Distilling Positional Knowledge in Transformers
paper.abstract: Extending the context window of language models typically requires expensive long-context pre-training, posing significant challenges for both training efficiency and data collection. In this paper, we present evidence that long-context retrieval capabilities can be transferred to student models through logit-based knowledge distillation, even when training exclusively on packed short-context samples within a long-context window. We provide comprehensive insights through the lens of Rotary Posit

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究一个很具体的长上下文问题：学生模型能否只用短上下文数据，通过知识蒸馏学到长距离位置感知能力。这里的长上下文能力被限定为检索型能力，例如 Needle-in-a-Haystack 和 RULER，而不是更宽泛的长程推理。核心问题不是如何收集长文档数据，也不是如何降低长序列注意力成本，而是蒸馏目标里是否已经携带了足够的位置结构，能让学生模型外推到训练长度之外。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值在于，它把长上下文扩展拆成了一个更可控的问题：位置知识是否可以从 teacher 的输出分布中被蒸馏出来。如果结论成立，长上下文训练不一定完全依赖真实长序列语料，也不一定需要在早期预训练中承担完整的长序列显存成本。这对小模型、端侧模型、后期 context extension 都有直接意义。贡献类型偏机制分析和训练配方验证，重点在 RoPE、KD objective、短上下文数据三者的耦合，而不是提出一个全新的注意力结构。
summary.technical_approach: 方法围绕 RoPE 和 logit-based knowledge distillation 展开。RoPE 只作用在 attention 的 query/key 上，通过旋转角度把位置信息注入注意力打分。作者的假设是：teacher 在前向传播中受到 RoPE 位置扰动影响，这些扰动会继续传到 hidden states 和最终 logits；学生在匹配 teacher logits 时，虽然只看到短上下文样本，也会被迫学习这种位置相关的输出变化。这个观点和常见的长上下文扩展不同。常见做法直接拉长训练序列，或者调整 RoPE base θ 后用长数据继续训练；这里关注的是，短数据上的蒸馏信号是否足够传递位置结构。技术上，作者显式考察 RoPE base θ 的缩放策略、短上下文本地位置能否迁移到更长长度、RoPE 对 query/key 的扰动是否在 teacher 前向中形成可学习信号，以及学生参数更新是否呈现与位置编码相关的模式。teacher 使用 Llama-4 Scout，采用 iRoPE，即 RoPE 层和 NoPE 层交错；student 是 1B 参数级别模型，并在每层使用 RoPE。这一点很有意思，因为 teacher 和 student 的位置编码结构并不完全一致，蒸馏是否有效可以反映位置知识是否以更抽象的函数形式存在于输出分布里。
summary.experiments: 可见实验设置包含两个阶段。第一阶段是短上下文预训练：student 从随机初始化开始，训练 128,000 steps，共 100B tokens，序列长度为 2,048。student 配置为 30 层、20 个 attention heads、4 个 KV heads、hidden size 1,280、FFN hidden dim 6,144、vocab size 202,048。teacher 是 Llama-4 Scout，48 层、40 个 attention heads、8 个 KV heads、hidden size 5,120、FFN hidden dim 16,384、vocab size 202,048。蒸馏采用 logit-based KD。评测目标是检索型长上下文 benchmark，包括 Needle-in-a-Haystack 和 RULER。提供的内容没有给出完整实验表、性能数字、RoPE θ 消融结果、不同数据长度对比、是否使用 packing 的详细配置，也没有给出参数更新分析图。因此不能确认最终提升幅度。需要特别注意的是，这项工作把 long-context ability 明确定义为长距离检索和 attention 定位能力，实验结论不应直接外推到复杂长文档推理。
summary.reading_guide: 精读时先看问题定义和 Figure 1。它限定了工作边界：RoPE、KD objective、short-context data 三者如何组合。然后看 RoPE background 和 Figure 2，重点理解 θ 放大为什么会延缓角度 wrap，从而减少远距离位置混淆。方法部分需要重点看四组问题：RoPE θ 在 KD 中如何设定；短上下文 token 的局部位置变化如何变成长上下文外推信号；teacher 的 RoPE 扰动如何从 query/key 传播到 logits；student 的哪些参数更新和位置知识相关。实验部分应优先检查 NIAH/RULER 随 context length 的曲线，而不只看平均分；还要看是否比较了普通 LM loss、KD loss、不同 θ、不同 teacher positional scheme、不同短序列长度，以及是否存在训练后短上下文能力退化。最值得深挖的是 teacher/student 位置编码不一致的情况下，logit KD 是否仍能迁移位置知识；这会影响后续做 long-context distillation、context annealing、端侧模型蒸馏时的训练设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but important long-context question: can a student transformer acquire long-range positional awareness from short-context data through knowledge distillation alone. Long-context ability is defined as retrieval and attention over long sequences, measured by tasks such as Needle-in-a-Haystack and RULER. The target is not broad long-document reasoning. The central issue is whether the teacher's output distribution contains enough positional structure for the student to extrapolate beyond the sequence lengths seen during training.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining is the separation of long-context extension into a positional knowledge transfer problem. If the claim holds, long-context capability does not always require large amounts of curated long documents or full long-sequence training from the beginning. This matters for small and on-device models, where quadratic attention cost and distribution shifts across training stages are serious constraints. The contribution is primarily mechanistic and recipe-oriented: it examines how RoPE, the distillation objective, and short-context data interact, rather than proposing a new attention architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: The approach is built around RoPE and logit-based knowledge distillation. RoPE injects position through rotations applied to attention queries and keys. The authors hypothesize that these position-dependent perturbations propagate through the teacher forward pass and appear in the final logits. When the student matches those logits, it receives an implicit positional training signal even if the sequences are short and even if packed samples do not attend to one another. This differs from standard long-context extension recipes that rely on training directly on long sequences after changing the RoPE base. The paper investigates four linked questions: how to scale the RoPE base θ under KD; whether local positional information from short contexts can support long-context learning; whether RoPE perturbations in the teacher meaningfully propagate to the output distribution; and whether student parameter updates show patterns aligned with positional information. The setup uses Llama-4 Scout as the teacher, which has an iRoPE design with interleaved RoPE and NoPE layers, while the 1B student uses RoPE in every layer. This mismatch is useful: successful transfer would suggest that the positional signal is not merely copied layer by layer, but expressed through the teacher's output function.
summary_en.experiments: The visible setup includes a progressive context-extension training pipeline. Stage 1 trains the randomly initialized student for 128,000 steps on 100B tokens with a 2,048-token context window. The student has 30 layers, 20 attention heads, 4 KV heads, model dimension 1,280, FFN hidden dimension 6,144, and a vocabulary size of 202,048. The teacher, Llama-4 Scout, has 48 layers, 40 attention heads, 8 KV heads, model dimension 5,120, FFN hidden dimension 16,384, and the same vocabulary size. Distillation is logit-based. Evaluation is framed around retrieval-oriented long-context benchmarks such as Needle-in-a-Haystack and RULER. The provided content does not include the final result tables, RoPE θ ablations, sequence-length curves, packing details, or parameter-update visualizations. For that reason, the size of the reported gain cannot be verified from the available text. A key caveat is that the claimed capability should be interpreted as positional retrieval competence, not general long-context reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the problem framing and Figure 1 first, because they define the three interacting factors: RoPE, KD objective, and short-context data. Then read the RoPE background and Figure 2 carefully; the important point is how increasing θ slows angular rotation and reduces position aliasing at longer lengths. In the method and experiment sections, focus on four checks: the RoPE θ choice under distillation, the evidence that short-range positions transfer to longer ranges, the analysis showing propagation from query/key perturbations to logits, and the parameter-update patterns in the student. In the results, prioritize Needle-in-a-Haystack and RULER curves as a function of context length rather than only aggregate scores. Also check comparisons against plain LM training, KD with different θ values, different teacher positional schemes, and different short-context lengths. The most useful detail to inspect is whether positional knowledge transfers despite the teacher using iRoPE and the student using RoPE in all layers, since that directly informs practical long-context distillation recipes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会动摇“长上下文必须靠长数据喂出来”的默认前提；先看受控重复序列实验和 RoPE 分阶段缩放，若你做 context extension，值得立刻加进内部 ablation。
recommendation.en: This weakens the default prior that long-context ability must be trained on long data; read the repeated-token control setup and phase-wise RoPE scaling first, then add it to your internal context-extension ablations.

paper.abstract: 大模型知识分享 清华大学 关注 斯坦福团队：解决「上下文永远不够长」难题 现实世界的文档问答非常具有挑战性，分析师必须整合多个文档和同一文档的不同部分的内容。 然而，随着文档集合不断扩增，任何固定的 LLM 上下文窗口都可能被超出。常见的折中是把文档切成片段（chunk），再从 chunk 级输出中拼出答案，但这引入了一个聚合瓶颈：当 chunk 数量增加，系统仍然要在越来越大的提取证据集合上做合并和推理。 在这项工作中，斯坦福大学团队提出了 SLIDERS，通过结构化推理对长文档集合进行问答。SLIDERS 把关键信息抽取到一个关系型数据库中，使系统能借助 SQL 在持久化的结构化状态上进行可扩展推理，而不必反复拼接长文本。 为让局部抽取出的表示在全局上保持一致，SLIDERS 设计了一个数据协调（reconciliation）阶段，利用来源、抽取依据和元数据来检测并修复重复、不一致、不完整的记录。 在 3 个现有的长上下文基准测试中，SLIDERS 的表现均超过了其他基线模型，平均比 GPT-4.1 高 6.6 分，尽管这 3 个基准测试的文档量都在对比 LLM 的上下文窗口容量之

summary.core_problem: 文章讨论长文档集合问答里“上下文再长也不够”的问题，重点不是继续堆上下文窗口，而是如何把跨文档推理转成可扩展的结构化状态操作。
summary.key_insights: SLIDERS 的关键判断是：长上下文瓶颈不只在检索，还在后续证据聚合。它先把局部文本抽取成关系型数据库中的结构化记录，再用 SQL 在持久化状态上做推理，并加入 reconciliation 阶段处理重复、冲突和缺失信息。按文中描述，这种做法在超长 token 规模下比直接依赖大上下文 LLM 更稳，也说明部分长程推理问题更像状态构建与一致性维护，而不只是一次性上下文压入模型。
summary.limits: 这更像面向文档 QA 的系统设计，而不是基座模型方法。文章没有展开抽取误差如何传播、数据库 schema 的人工成分有多重、以及对开放域任务的泛化边界，因此结论更适合理解 agentic long-context 系统，而不是直接指导预训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The article looks at document QA settings where no fixed context window is enough, and asks how to scale reasoning over many documents without repeatedly stuffing more text into the model.
summary_en.key_insights: The useful idea in SLIDERS is that the real bottleneck is evidence aggregation, not just retrieval. It extracts local facts into a relational database, reasons over persistent structured state with SQL, and adds a reconciliation stage to resolve duplicates and inconsistencies. That framing is interesting because it treats long-context reasoning as state construction and consistency management rather than pure context expansion.
summary_en.limits: This is primarily a system approach for document QA, not a base-model training contribution. The note does not discuss extraction errors, schema dependence, or how robust the method is outside the evaluated benchmarks, so its value is more conceptual than directly actionable for pretraining.

paper.title: Jordan-RoPE: Non-Semisimple Relative Positional Encoding via Complex Jordan Blocks
paper.abstract: Relative positional encodings determine which functions of query-key lag can enter the primitive attention logit. RoPE supplies a rotary phase, while ALiBi supplies an additive distance bias. Motivated by group-theoretic views of linear translation-invariant positional encodings, we study a non-semisimple case in which a complex rotary eigenvalue and a nilpotent response live in the same defective Jordan block. The resulting relative operator generates oscillatory-polynomial features such as $e^

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 RoPE 的一个较窄但清楚的扩展问题：如果相对位置编码的生成元不是可对角化的，而是把复数旋转特征值和 nilpotent 响应放进同一个二阶 Jordan block，注意力 logit 能直接获得哪些新的相对距离基函数。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在长上下文位置编码的函数空间设计。RoPE 提供相位项，ALiBi 提供距离偏置，很多长度外推方法是在频率缩放、插值或衰减上改造 RoPE。Jordan-RoPE 的贡献不在大模型实证，而在说明一种新的 primitive logit basis：d·exp(iωd)，也就是距离调制的旋转相位。这个特征不是把距离通道和相位通道简单并列，而是在同一个非半单表示里耦合出来。对研究位置编码的人，它提供了一个可分析的构造，用来讨论 attention 在预 softmax 层面到底能表达哪些关于 lag 的函数。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从线性、平移不变、连续的一参数矩阵作用出发。普通 RoPE 对应可对角化的复旋转生成元；ALiBi 或 shear 类方法可看作实特征值下的 defective 情形。论文选择最小的复 Jordan block，把旋转 eigenvalue 和 nilpotent 链放在同一个 block 中。矩阵指数展开后，除了 exp(iωd) 这样的旋转项，还会出现 d·exp(iωd) 这样的 tangent mode。实现上，Exact Jordan-RoPE 需要注意 query 和 key 的作用不是简单同向旋转，因为 block 非正交。为了恢复纯相对 attention score，论文使用 contragredient query action。它还区分了三类实现：Exact Jordan-RoPE 保持一参数群结构；bounded shear 限制 shear 的幅度，保留局部 Jordan 响应但破坏严格群律；Scaled-exact 在保持一参数结构的同时引入受控 damping，缓解非正交块带来的数值放大。
summary.experiments: 实验主要用于验证表示能力，而不是给出通用语言建模收益。论文测试了固定 kernel probe、结构化序列 probe、一个 synthetic LM teacher kernel K(d)=(d/L)cos(ωd)，以及小规模 WikiText-103 byte-level language model。关键观察是：当任务的真实相对位置依赖包含距离调制相位项时，Stabilized Jordan-RoPE 比标准 RoPE 和 direct-sum baseline 更容易外推。direct-sum baseline 指把相位和距离放在独立通道中，而不是在同一个 Jordan block 中耦合。自然语言实验被定位为边界测试，不能解读为已经证明该方法适合大规模 LLM 预训练。提供内容中没有给出参数量、训练 token 数或 WikiText 的具体困惑度数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看位置编码的代数推导、Exact Jordan-RoPE 的 real block implementation、contragredient query action，以及 Exact、bounded shear、Scaled-exact 三者的差异。实验部分优先看 synthetic teacher kernel 和 extrapolation 设置，因为这里最能检验 d·exp(iωd) 这个 primitive basis 是否真的被模型利用。WikiText-103 部分只适合作为稳定性和负面边界的参考，不宜当作主要结论。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but useful extension of RoPE: what relative-position features become available when the positional generator is non-diagonalizable, with a complex rotary eigenvalue and a nilpotent response placed in the same order-two Jordan block.
summary_en.importance: The main value is for long-context positional encoding design. Standard RoPE gives a phase basis, while ALiBi gives an additive distance bias. Many RoPE variants change frequency scaling, interpolation, or damping. Jordan-RoPE instead changes the primitive functions available to the pre-softmax attention logit. It directly exposes d·exp(iωd), a distance-modulated phase feature. This is different from putting distance and phase in separate channels, because the coupling is supplied by the positional representation itself. The contribution is structural rather than an empirical claim about large-scale pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The construction uses the view that linear, translation-invariant, continuous positional encodings form one-parameter matrix actions. RoPE corresponds to a diagonalizable complex rotation. Defective generators introduce polynomial factors through Jordan blocks. The paper focuses on the minimal complex defective case: an order-two complex Jordan block. Its matrix exponential contains both the rotary phase exp(iωd) and the tangent feature d·exp(iωd). Because the block is non-orthogonal, the usual symmetric query/key action does not directly yield a pure relative score. The exact version therefore uses a contragredient action on queries. The paper separates three variants: Exact Jordan-RoPE, which preserves the one-parameter representation; bounded shear, which stabilizes the local response but breaks the group law; and scaled-exact, which keeps the one-parameter structure while adding controlled damping.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are designed as representation probes. They include fixed kernel probes, structured sequence probes, a synthetic language-modeling task with teacher kernel K(d)=(d/L)cos(ωd), and a small WikiText-103 byte-level language model. The main result is that when the target kernel contains a distance-modulated phase term, stabilized Jordan-RoPE extrapolates better than standard RoPE and direct-sum baselines that keep distance and phase separate. The natural-language experiment is presented as a boundary test, not as evidence for broad pretraining gains. The provided content does not include exact parameter counts, token counts, or WikiText perplexity numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the algebraic derivation, the real block implementation, the contragredient query action, and the distinction between exact, bounded-shear, and scaled-exact variants. The synthetic teacher-kernel experiment is the most diagnostic part, because it directly tests whether d·exp(iωd) is useful as a primitive attention-logit feature. Treat the WikiText-103 result as a stability and boundary check rather than the central evidence.

recommendation.zh: 理论味重但值得扫公式；没有 LM 实验前别改主线，先在小模型长上下文 ablation 里试。
recommendation.en: Formula-heavy but worth skimming; without LM experiments, do not touch the mainline—try it first in small long-context ablations.

paper.title: The Impossibility Triangle of Long-Context Modeling
paper.abstract: We identify and prove a fundamental trade-off governing long-sequence models: no model can simultaneously achieve (i) per-step computation independent of sequence length (Efficiency), (ii) state size independent of sequence length (Compactness), and (iii) the ability to recall a number of historical facts proportional to sequence length (Recall). We formalize this trade-off within an Online Sequence Processor abstraction that unifies Transformers, state space models, linear recurrent networks, a

summary.core_problem: 给长上下文建模一个统一的不可能性结论：是否存在一种序列模型，能同时做到每步计算不随长度增长、状态大小不随长度增长、且可召回与序列长度成比例的历史事实。
summary.importance: 这是理论约束类工作，不直接给新架构，但它试图为 Transformer、SSM、线性 RNN 及混合模型提供统一上界。对基座研究员重要之处在于，它把很多“长上下文架构 trade-off”从经验现象提升为结构性限制，能帮助判断哪些路线只是工程折中，哪些目标本身就不可兼得。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 Online Sequence Processor 抽象，把不同长序列架构统一到同一框架下。然后用 Data Processing Inequality 和 Fano's Inequality 证明：若模型同时满足 Efficiency（每步计算与长度无关）和 Compactness（状态大小与长度无关），则其可召回的 key-value 对数量至多是 O(poly(d)/log V)，无法随序列长度线性增长。进一步把 2026 年 3 月前的 52 个架构映射到这个三角形中，说明每类方法至多满足三者中的两项。
summary.experiments: 这篇主要是理论与架构归类，不是常规训练实验。摘要给出的核心结果是一个上界定理和 52 个架构的分类图谱，覆盖 Transformer、state space model、linear recurrent network 及其混合体。没有参数量、训练 token 或 benchmark 提升，因为重点不是经验 SOTA，而是约束边界。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自长沙理工大学数学与统计学院，偏理论分析。若证明严谨，这类工作对长上下文建模路线选择有长期参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether any long-context sequence model can simultaneously achieve length-independent per-step compute, length-independent state size, and recall capacity that scales linearly with sequence length.
summary_en.importance: This is a theory-constrained paper rather than a new architecture. Its importance is that it tries to turn many empirical long-context trade-offs into a structural impossibility statement, giving foundation-model researchers a cleaner lens for judging which architecture directions are merely engineering compromises and which goals are fundamentally incompatible.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author introduces an Online Sequence Processor abstraction that unifies Transformers, state-space models, linear recurrent networks, and hybrids. Using the Data Processing Inequality and Fano's Inequality, the paper proves that any model satisfying both Efficiency (length-independent per-step compute) and Compactness (length-independent state size) can recall at most O(poly(d)/log V) key-value pairs, rather than a number growing linearly with sequence length. It then maps 52 architectures published before March 2026 into this triangle, arguing that each achieves at most two of the three properties.
summary_en.experiments: This is primarily a theoretical and taxonomy paper, not a standard training study. The main deliverables are the upper-bound theorem and a classification of 52 architectures spanning Transformers, SSMs, linear recurrent networks, and hybrids. There are no model sizes, training tokens, or benchmark gains because the point is not empirical SOTA but a boundary on what is achievable.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is from the School of Mathematics and Statistics at Changsha University of Science and Technology. This is a theory-oriented analysis; if the proof holds up, it has long-term value for choosing long-context modeling directions.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接约束你对长上下文架构的 prior：若证明站得住，很多“线性时间+常数状态+强召回”的叙事可以少投资源，先读定理和 52 模型归类表。
recommendation.en: This can change your prior on long-context architectures: if the proof is sound, many 'linear-time + constant-state + strong recall' stories are dead on arrival; read the theorem and the 52-model taxonomy first.

institutions: Changsha University of Science and Technology

paper.title: How Long Does Infinite Width Last? Signal Propagation in Long-Range Linear Recurrences
paper.abstract: We study signal propagation in linear recurrent models at finite width. While existing signal propagation theory relies predominantly on the infinite-width limit, it remains unclear for how long that approximation remains accurate when recurrent depth $t$ grows jointly with width $n$. This question is especially relevant for modern recurrent sequence models, whose natural operating regime involves long input sequences, i.e., large $t$. We derive exact finite-width formulas for the hidden state s

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是：在线性递归模型里，经典的无限宽度信号传播理论到底能在多长序列长度上保持准确。已有理论大多假设宽度 n 趋于无穷，此时隐藏态能量会按均值场规律传播；但对现代长序列递归模型，时间步 t 往往和宽度一起变大，有限宽度误差会不断累积。论文聚焦一个更尖锐的问题：对随机初始化的线性 recurrence，有限宽度偏离会在什么 depth-width 联合尺度上从可忽略变成主导，并给出精确而不是粗糙下界的刻画。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究，它不是直接给出新模型或新训练法，而是补上了长程递归建模里一个很基础的稳定性问题。价值主要有三层。第一，它说明 recurrent/SSM/LRU 这类长上下文架构不能简单沿用 feedforward 的“深度到宽度同阶才失效”直觉；在线性 recurrence 中，临界尺度更早，达到 t≈√n 就开始从无限宽近似过渡。第二，它把“同一权重矩阵被反复使用会强化主谱方向”这一直觉做成了可计算的有限宽度公式，这对理解长程训练初期的爆炸/偏置来源很有帮助。第三，它给架构和初始化设计一个明确约束：如果希望随机初始化下的信号传播仍接近 mean-field，序列长度与状态维度不能随意配，至少在线性骨架上要尊重 √n 级别的边界。这对分析 SSM、LRU、复数递归核以及更一般的共享参数长链模型都有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，论文选了两个最干净的对象：无输入的线性 RNN，以及带输入注入的 linear recurrent unit。隐藏态在每一步都由同一个复高斯随机矩阵 W 作用，矩阵元素独立采样，方差为 1/n。作者关心的量不是单条轨迹，而是归一化后的期望平方范数，也就是 signal energy。核心技术贡献有两部分。

第一部分是精确有限宽度公式。不同于无限宽分析只跟踪均值场递推，这里直接利用复高斯矩阵的谱与矩结构，推导出任意有限 n、任意时间步 t 下隐藏态能量的闭式或准闭式表达。这样做的关键好处是，有限宽度修正项不再只是 big-O 级别，而能看见它如何随 t 和 n 共同增长。

第二部分是 joint scaling regime 的划分。论文给出三个区间：当 t=o(√n) 时，有限宽度修正整体消失，无限宽近似有效；当 t 与 √n 同阶时，进入临界窗口，有限宽度效应不再可忽略，但仍处于可描述的 crossover；当 t≫√n 时，主导谱方向被重复乘法放大，signal energy 明显偏离无限宽预测并出现爆炸趋势。这个结论和 feedforward 网络里常见的临界深度 L~n 很不一样，原因就在于 recurrence 重复使用同一随机矩阵，而不是每层重新采样独立矩阵。

论文还讨论了为什么采用复数权重。一个原因是现代 LRU/SSM 常用复特征值表示振荡动力学；另一个原因是复高斯 ensemble 在解析上更干净，能得到 sharp 结果。作者同时给出实高斯情形偏离无限宽预测的一个充分条件，说明现象并非纯粹依赖复数设定。若从建模角度看，这篇工作的真正创新不在模型，而在把“共享矩阵导致更快积累有限宽度误差”从经验判断推进到精确尺度律。
summary.experiments:
这篇论文的实验更像理论验证，而不是大规模 benchmark。关键结果围绕理论公式与不同 scaling regime 的数值吻合展开。核心观察包括：

1. 在 t=o(√n) 区间，有限宽度下测得的 hidden-state energy 与无限宽预测几乎重合，误差随 n 增大而收缩。
2. 在 t≈c√n 的临界区间，曲线开始系统性偏离 mean-field 预测，但偏离方式与理论给出的 crossover 公式一致，而不是突然失稳。
3. 在 t≫√n 时，能量增长明显快于无限宽理论，出现由少数谱方向主导的爆炸行为；这比先前工作只证明“足够大时会爆”更细，因为这里能定位失效发生的尺度。
4. 对 LRU 与简单线性 RNN，两类模型都表现出相同的临界规律，说明关键因素是共享线性递归核，而不是是否有输入注入。
5. 论文还比较了复高斯与实高斯设定，表明实值情形也会出现偏离，只是理论 sharpness 主要建立在复数情形上。

从你给出的全文片段里，没有看到完整实验表格中的具体 n、t 网格和误差数值，因此不适合编造精确百分点。但可以确定，实验的重点不是“性能提升多少”，而是“理论曲线是否准确描述有限宽度能量在不同 t/√n 区间的行为”。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不需要逐行推导。建议先看 Introduction，把它和 feedforward 临界深度 L~n 的已知结论对照起来，抓住这篇文章真正回答的问题：为什么 recurrent 的临界尺度提前到 √n。然后重点看给出精确 finite-width signal energy 公式的主定理，以及划分 subcritical / critical / supercritical 三个 regime 的命题或图。若时间有限，优先看展示 t/√n 重标度后曲线如何对齐的图，这通常最能说明结论是否 sharp。

如果想深一点，值得看两处。第一，推导里到底是哪一步把“重复使用同一矩阵”转成了谱方向强化，这关系到结论能否迁移到更一般的共享参数模型。第二，LRU 与无输入线性 RNN 的公式差别，能帮助判断外部输入在多大程度上只改变常数项，而不改变临界尺度。预计阅读时间 30 到 45 分钟；若要跟完整证明，时间会长很多。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise question about linear recurrent models: for how long does infinite-width signal propagation remain accurate when sequence length grows together with hidden width? Existing theory mostly lives in the n→∞ regime, where mean-field recursions describe hidden-state energy cleanly. That is not enough for modern long-context recurrent models, because finite-width errors can accumulate over many recurrent steps. The paper targets the sharp breakdown scale of the infinite-width approximation in randomly initialized linear recurrences, and aims to replace earlier coarse lower bounds with exact finite-width characterizations.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining recipe, but it matters for the foundations of long-range sequence modeling. The main contribution is conceptual and quantitative. First, it shows that recurrent models should not inherit the feedforward intuition that finite-width effects become qualitatively important only when depth is on the order of width. For linear recurrences, the critical scale is much earlier: around t≈√n. Second, it turns the common intuition—reusing the same weight matrix repeatedly amplifies dominant spectral directions—into explicit finite-width formulas. That is useful for understanding instability and bias at initialization in LRUs, SSM-like recurrences, and other shared-kernel sequence models. Third, it gives a concrete design constraint: if one wants initialization-time signal propagation to remain close to mean-field predictions, sequence length and state dimension cannot be chosen independently. Even in the clean linear setting, the safe regime is bounded by a √n law rather than an n law.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The analysis focuses on two minimal settings: a linear RNN without sequential inputs, and a linear recurrent unit with input injection. In both cases, the same random complex matrix W is applied at every recurrent step, with i.i.d. proper complex Gaussian entries of variance 1/n. The quantity of interest is the normalized expected squared hidden-state norm, called the signal energy.

The first technical contribution is an exact finite-width treatment. Instead of relying on infinite-width mean-field recursions, the paper derives exact finite-n formulas for hidden-state energies at arbitrary time t. The complex Gaussian ensemble makes the analysis tractable and sharp. This is important because the finite-width correction is not left as an asymptotic remainder; one can see explicitly how it scales jointly with t and n.

The second contribution is the identification of depth-width scaling regimes. The paper establishes a subcritical regime t=o(√n), where the infinite-width approximation remains valid; a critical regime t=Θ(√n), where finite-width effects become order-one and a crossover appears; and a supercritical regime t≫√n, where repeated application of the same matrix amplifies dominant spectral directions and the signal energy departs strongly from the infinite-width prediction, eventually exhibiting explosion. This differs sharply from feedforward networks, where the known critical depth is typically L=Θ(n). The reason is structural: feedforward layers use fresh random matrices, while recurrence reuses the same one.

The paper also explains why complex weights are a natural choice. They match modern recurrent architectures that use complex eigenvalues to model oscillatory dynamics, and they allow cleaner analysis. At the same time, the authors provide a sufficient condition showing that real Gaussian recurrences also deviate from infinite-width predictions, so the phenomenon is not merely an artifact of the complex setting.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical section is mainly a validation of the theory rather than a performance benchmark. The key findings are:

1. In the subcritical regime t=o(√n), measured hidden-state energies closely track the infinite-width prediction, and the discrepancy shrinks with width.
2. Around the critical window t≈c√n, the curves begin to deviate systematically from mean-field behavior, but the deviation follows the predicted crossover rather than appearing as an abrupt failure.
3. In the supercritical regime t≫√n, the energy grows much faster than the infinite-width theory predicts, consistent with amplification along a few dominant spectral directions.
4. The same qualitative scaling law appears in both the simple linear RNN and the LRU-style recurrence, suggesting that the shared recurrent kernel—not the presence or absence of input injection—is the main driver.
5. The paper also discusses the real-valued Gaussian case, indicating that the breakdown of infinite-width predictions persists beyond the complex ensemble, even though the sharpest results are proved in the complex setting.

The provided full-content excerpt does not include the complete tables or figure captions with exact numerical grids for n and t, so it would be unsafe to invent precise values. The experimental point is not downstream accuracy, but agreement between finite-width theory and observed signal-energy trajectories across the t/√n regimes.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper unless you are actively working on recurrent initialization theory. Start with the introduction and compare its question to the known feedforward result that critical depth scales like width. The main thing to retain is why recurrence changes the scaling from n to √n. Then go straight to the main theorem giving the exact finite-width signal-energy formula, and the result that separates subcritical, critical, and supercritical regimes. If there is a figure that rescales time by √n and aligns the curves, that is likely the fastest way to see the sharpness of the claim.

If you want to read more carefully, focus on two points. First, identify the step in the derivation where repeated reuse of the same random matrix becomes spectral reinforcement; that is the mechanism most likely to transfer to broader shared-parameter models. Second, compare the formulas for the input-free linear RNN and the LRU, to see whether inputs only change constants or can alter the scaling law. A practical reading time is about 30–45 minutes without following every proof.

recommendation.zh: 只看定理和 regime 图；它不会直接改 pretrain 配方，但会约束你对长程 recurrent 架构初始化理论的信任范围。
recommendation.en: Read the theorems and regime diagram; it will not change a pretraining recipe directly, but it narrows when initialization theory for long recurrent models should be trusted.
