paper.title: LongSeeker: Elastic Context Orchestration for Long-Horizon Search Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon search agents must manage a rapidly growing working context as they reason, call tools, and observe information. Naively accumulating all intermediate content can overwhelm the agent, increasing costs and the risk of errors. We propose that effective context management should be adaptive: parts of the agent's trajectory are maintained at different levels of detail depending on their current relevance to the task. To operationalize this principle, we introduce Context-ReAct, a genera

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是长时程 search agent 的上下文失控问题：ReAct 式 agent 在多轮搜索、工具调用和观察累积后，工作上下文会越来越长，里面既有关键证据，也有失败分支、重复信息和已经过时的推理。现有做法通常是截断、定期总结或重启，但这些方法要么不区分信息重要性，要么破坏推理连续性，要么在反复摘要中引入误差。作者要解决的是：agent 能不能在推理过程中主动决定何时、何处、以何种保真度改写自己的上下文，而不是被动接受 append-only 历史。
summary.importance: 它对预训练的直接贡献有限，更接近 agent memory / long-context orchestration，但仍有两个值得基座研究员关注的点。第一，它把“上下文管理”从外部 heuristic 变成了模型内部可学习动作，这和未来长上下文模型的训练目标设计有关：模型不只是消费上下文，也可能需要学习重写、压缩和回滚上下文。第二，它提出的多分辨率上下文表示，对长序列建模有启发。当前很多 long-context 方案仍默认历史是只追加、等精度保存的；这篇工作则假设不同历史片段应以不同 fidelity 存在，这个假设对 memory-augmented LM、agentic continual context、甚至训练时的 trajectory packing 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
核心范式叫 Context-ReAct。它在标准 ReAct 循环上加了一层显式的 meta-action：每一步不是只生成 reasoning trace 和 tool call，而是联合生成 reasoning、context meta-operations 和下一步工具调用。meta-operations 会在新 observation 加入前先作用于已有上下文，因此 agent 可以主动重塑工作记忆。

作者定义了五个原子操作：
1. Skip：上下文不变。
2. Compress：把一段连续历史替换成抽象摘要。
3. Snippet：从某一步中保留精确子串，适合数字、实体名、引用、代码等不能被抽象改写的证据。
4. Delete：删除已无残余价值的步骤。
5. Rollback：放弃一条失败分支，把上下文回退到更早状态，同时记录回退原因和可迁移信息。

这个设计的关键不是“多几个操作”，而是把上下文表示从单一文本序列改成多分辨率工作记忆。作者还给出 expressive completeness 的论证：理论上 Compress 足以模拟其他操作，但专门设计 Snippet、Delete、Rollback 是为了降低生成成本和摘要失真风险。这个论证有点像 instruction set 设计：最小完备集不一定是最好用的工程接口。

实例化系统 LongSeeker 基于 Qwen3-30B-A3B，并在 10k 合成搜索轨迹上微调。训练重点在于数据合成：需要构造包含 context edit 行为的轨迹，而不是普通 ReAct 轨迹。也就是说，模型学的不是单纯“怎么搜”，而是“什么时候该保留原文、什么时候该压缩、什么时候该回滚”。
summary.experiments:
LongSeeker 在四个 benchmark 上评测：BrowseComp、BrowseComp-ZH、xbench 和 GAIA。摘要中给出的主结果是 BrowseComp 61.5%，BrowseComp-ZH 62.5%，显著高于 Tongyi DeepResearch 的 43.2% / 46.7%，也高于 AgentFold 的 36.2% / 47.3%。这些数字说明收益主要出现在长时程、多轮搜索场景，而不是普通短链路 QA。

从全文应重点看三类实验。第一，和 sliding window、periodic summarization、restart 类方法的对比，验证 elastic context orchestration 是否真的优于固定策略。第二，各原子操作的消融，尤其是 Snippet 和 Rollback：前者对应高保真证据保留，后者对应搜索分支管理，二者通常比单纯 Compress 更能解释性能来源。第三，context 长度、token 成本、成功率之间的关系。如果论文给出了 trajectory-level 统计，值得看 agent 是否在更短上下文下保持或提升正确率，而不是靠更长推理链换分数。

训练规模方面，10k 合成轨迹不算大，因此结果更多反映范式设计是否有效，而不是大规模数据堆出来的收益。需要留意的是，合成数据的 teacher 和规则会不会把某种特定搜索风格固化进模型；如果泛化实验不足，这会影响方法外推性。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点不在 benchmark 排名，而在上下文操作接口的设计。

优先看方法部分前半，弄清楚 Context-ReAct 相比标准 ReAct 多了什么状态转移能力，五个操作分别解决什么失败模式。尤其要看 Snippet 和 Rollback 的定义，因为这两个操作最能体现作者不是在做普通摘要压缩。

然后看数据合成与训练部分。关键问题是：这些 meta-operations 的监督信号从哪里来，轨迹是如何构造的，模型如何学会在正确时机编辑上下文。若这一部分比较弱，方法就容易退化成 prompt 规则。

最后看主结果和消融。重点观察：性能提升是否伴随 token 成本下降；不同 benchmark 上哪类操作最常被触发；失败案例是否来自错误压缩、错误删除，还是搜索策略本身。

预计 20–30 分钟可以读完主线。若只挑图表，优先看范式示意图、操作消融表、以及上下文长度/成本统计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses context blow-up in long-horizon search agents. In standard ReAct-style systems, reasoning traces, tool calls, and observations are appended step by step, so the working context grows monotonically. Over time it mixes critical evidence with stale reasoning, failed branches, and redundant content. Existing fixes such as truncation, periodic summarization, or restart policies are all partial: they either ignore importance, break reasoning continuity, or accumulate abstraction errors. The central question here is whether the agent can actively reshape its own context during reasoning, instead of passively inheriting an append-only history.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but it is still useful for foundation-model researchers for two reasons. First, it turns context management into a learned action space rather than an external heuristic. That is relevant to future long-context training objectives, where a model may need to learn not only to consume context but also to rewrite, compress, and roll back it. Second, the paper proposes a multi-resolution view of context: different parts of history should survive at different fidelities depending on current utility. That assumption is interesting for memory-augmented LMs, continual agent context, and any training setup where long trajectories are treated as uniform text even though their informational value is highly non-uniform.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main paradigm is Context-ReAct, which augments the standard ReAct loop with explicit context meta-actions. At each step, the agent jointly generates its reasoning trace, a set of context-edit operations, and the next tool call in one autoregressive pass. The meta-operations are applied before the next observation is appended, so the agent actively curates its working memory online.

The operation vocabulary has five atomic actions. Skip leaves the context unchanged. Compress replaces a contiguous span of prior steps with an abstractive summary. Snippet preserves an exact substring from a previous step, which is useful for numbers, entity names, quotations, or code where abstraction is risky. Delete removes a step that no longer carries value. Rollback abandons an unproductive branch by reverting to an earlier state while retaining the reason for backtracking and any transferable insight.

The key idea is not merely adding more actions. It is changing the representation of context from a uniform text log into a multi-resolution working memory. The paper also argues expressive completeness: in principle, Compress can simulate the other operations, but specialized operators reduce generation cost and fidelity loss. That is a sensible engineering choice, similar to designing a practical instruction set rather than relying on a theoretically minimal one.

The instantiated system, LongSeeker, is fine-tuned from Qwen3-30B-A3B on 10k synthesized search trajectories. The important training detail is that the data must teach not only how to search, but when to preserve exact evidence, when to summarize, and when to roll back.
summary_en.experiments:
LongSeeker is evaluated on BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, xbench, and GAIA. The headline numbers in the paper are 61.5% on BrowseComp and 62.5% on BrowseComp-ZH, compared with 43.2% and 46.7% for Tongyi DeepResearch, and 36.2% and 47.3% for AgentFold. These gains suggest that elastic context control matters most in long-horizon, tool-augmented search rather than in short QA settings.

The most informative experiments are likely threefold. First, comparisons against sliding-window, periodic summarization, and restart-style baselines, to test whether adaptive context editing really beats fixed policies. Second, ablations over the five operations, especially Snippet and Rollback. Those two are the clearest indicators that the method is doing more than generic summarization. Third, analyses of context length, token cost, and success rate. If the paper reports trajectory-level statistics, the important question is whether the agent maintains or improves accuracy while operating on a shorter and cleaner context.

The training scale is modest at 10k synthesized trajectories, so the result is more about the usefulness of the paradigm than about data scale. One caveat to watch is whether the synthesis pipeline bakes in a particular search style from the teacher, which could limit generalization if the evaluation distribution shifts.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is best read as a context-interface paper rather than a benchmark paper. Start with the method section and understand exactly what Context-ReAct adds over standard ReAct. The most important part is the semantics of the five operations and the failure modes they are meant to address. Snippet and Rollback deserve special attention because they are the strongest departures from ordinary summarization.

Then read the data synthesis and training pipeline. The key question is where supervision for the meta-operations comes from and how the trajectories are constructed. If that part is weak, the whole method risks collapsing into a prompt-level heuristic.

Finally, inspect the main results and ablations with an efficiency lens: whether gains come with lower token cost, which operations are used most often, and whether failures are caused by bad compression, bad deletion, or poor search policy.

A 20–30 minute skim is enough for the main ideas. If reading selectively, prioritize the paradigm figure, the operation ablation table, and any statistics on context length or token usage.

recommendation.zh: 读操作空间和 ablation 即可；如果 Compress 完备性和实测收益都站得住，可借来设计长轨迹 SFT/RL 数据格式。
recommendation.en: Read the action space and ablations; if the Compress completeness claim and empirical gains hold, this is a useful template for long-trajectory SFT/RL data formats.

paper.title: LCM: Lossless Context Management
paper.abstract: We introduce Lossless Context Management (LCM), a deterministic architecture for LLM memory that outperforms Claude Code on long-context tasks. When benchmarked using Opus 4.6, our LCM-augmented coding agent, Volt, achieves higher scores than Claude Code on the OOLONG long-context eval, including at every context length between 32K and 1M tokens.   LCM may be considered both a vindication and extension of the recursive paradigm pioneered by Recursive Language Models (RLMs). Our results demonstra

summary.core_problem: 在超长会话/多日 agent 任务里，LLM 的有效上下文远小于标称窗口，且会出现“context rot”（未到上限性能先崩）。论文要解决的是：在不依赖模型随机生成“记忆管理脚本”的前提下，提供一种可工程化、可复现、可回溯（lossless）的上下文管理架构，让长程任务在 32K–1M token 范围内稳定工作。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献（不改训练目标/数据/优化），但对“长上下文能力如何在系统层落地”给了一个清晰的、可对照 RLM 的设计点：把递归式上下文操作从“模型写程序”改成“引擎提供确定性原语”。对做长上下文预训练/长程 agent 评测的人，价值在于：1）把长上下文失败拆成“表示/检索/结构保持”问题，而不只是窗口长度；2）提供一种更接近生产约束的 baseline（确定性、事务化存储、可审计回放），便于把训练侧改进（更好的摘要、结构化记忆 token、检索策略学习）接到系统侧。
summary.technical_approach:
LCM 采用双态记忆：Immutable Store 与 Active Context。Immutable Store 持久化保存会话中每条 user/assistant/tool 消息的原文，永不修改，作为唯一真源；Active Context 是每轮实际送入 LLM 的上下文，由“最近原文消息 + 旧消息的 Summary Nodes”混合组成。
核心数据结构是一个高分叉的摘要 DAG：旧消息被 LLM 总结成摘要节点（类似物化视图/缓存），摘要节点在持久化存储中以事务方式写入并维护外键/索引，形成可多分辨率遍历的层级结构。所谓“lossless”不是指摘要无损，而是指任何摘要节点都保留指向原文的可达路径，系统提供 lcm_grep / lcm_expand 等工具做定向回溯。
与 RLM 的差异是控制权：RLM 让模型用符号递归/脚本自己写循环来管理上下文（高表达力但高随机性、易退化、且对短对话有额外开销）；LCM 把常见控制流收敛为少量确定性原语，由引擎执行，减少 rollout 方差与“短上下文惩罚”。与纯 grep 的差异是支持开放式回顾（不仅靠已知子串）；与 embedding-RAG 的差异是保留对话结构与决策演化脉络，而不是返回去上下文化的片段。论文也提到可叠加 embedding 索引，但其实现与评测主要依赖“层级摘要遍历 + 原文正则检索”。
summary.experiments: 论文宣称在 OOLONG long-context eval 上，用 Opus 4.6 驱动的 LCM 增强 coding agent（Volt）在 32K 到 1M 的各个上下文长度都超过 Claude Code，并强调这反驳了“递归上下文管理只是 Claude Code 的同类系统”的说法。给出的全文片段未包含关键表格/具体分数、方差、统计显著性、以及对摘要质量/expand 策略/压缩比的消融，因此无法在此复述具体数值与误差条。就方法验证而言，最需要看的应是：不同长度下的曲线、失败案例（何时需要 expand、何时 grep 失效）、以及与滑窗/纯摘要/RAG 的对照。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
1）先看 Introduction 里对 RLM 的定位与“structured control flow”类比，理解它为何把不确定性从模型侧移到引擎侧。
2）重点看“Lossless Context Management Architecture”对双态记忆、摘要 DAG、事务化存储与 lcm_expand 限制（只允许子任务展开、主循环只看摘要）的设计取舍。
3）如果要判断是否值得复现，优先找：OOLONG 评测设置、与 Claude Code 的对齐方式（工具权限、文件系统访问、提示模板）、以及压缩/展开触发策略的细节与消融。预计 20–30 分钟可抓住系统设计要点；要评估可信度需要把实验部分与附录实现细节一起读。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs hit an effective-context bottleneck in long-horizon agent sessions: performance degrades well before the nominal window (“context rot”), and even 1M-token windows are insufficient for multi-day tool-heavy workflows. The paper targets a practical alternative to model-written recursive memory scripts: a deterministic, auditable, lossless-by-retrievability context management architecture that keeps long-context performance stable from 32K to 1M tokens.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method contribution (no new objective/data/optimizer), but it is a strong systems-side baseline for long-context research. It reframes long-context failure as a structure-and-retrieval problem rather than just window size, and it offers a production-friendly counterpoint to Recursive Language Models (RLMs): move control flow from stochastic model code to engine-managed deterministic primitives. For pretraining researchers, the main value is as an interface target: better summarization training, structured memory representations, or learned retrieval policies can be plugged into a deterministic memory substrate and evaluated more cleanly.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LCM uses a dual-state memory design:
- Immutable Store: append-only, verbatim persistence of every user/assistant/tool message; the single source of truth.
- Active Context: the prompt actually sent to the LLM each turn, composed of recent raw messages plus Summary Nodes for older history.
Older content is compacted into Summary Nodes produced by LLM summarization, but “lossless” means every summary retains pointers to the underlying raw messages, which remain reachable via tools like lcm_grep and lcm_expand. The memory is organized as a high-fanout DAG stored in a transactional, indexed persistent database (PostgreSQL in the reference implementation), enabling multi-resolution traversal of session history.
Key design choice vs RLM: RLM grants the model full autonomy to write recursive scripts (high expressivity, high variance, brittle in production, plus overhead on short queries). LCM constrains memory operations into a small set of deterministic, engine-executed primitives—analogous to structured programming replacing GOTO—trading theoretical expressivity for reliability and reproducibility. It also argues why flat-file grep is insufficient for open-ended recall and why embedding-RAG can lose conversational structure; the DAG summaries aim to preserve decision provenance while still allowing targeted drill-down to ground truth.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports that an LCM-augmented coding agent (Volt) using Opus 4.6 outperforms Claude Code on the OOLONG long-context evaluation at every tested context length from 32K to 1M tokens. In the provided full-text excerpt, the exact scores, variance, and ablations (compression ratio, expand policy, summary quality) are not visible, so specific numeric deltas cannot be reliably quoted here. The credibility hinges on the missing details: evaluation protocol parity with Claude Code (tools/filesystem), length-wise curves, and failure-case analysis around when expand/grep succeeds or fails.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim path:
1) Introduction for the motivation and the explicit positioning against RLM (engine-managed determinism vs model-written recursion).
2) The architecture section for the dual-state memory, DAG summaries, transactional persistence, and the constraint that expansion happens only in sub-tasks.
3) If deciding whether to adopt it, focus on the OOLONG setup, tool-access parity with Claude Code, and any ablations on summarization/expansion triggers. ~20–30 minutes to understand the design; deeper time needed to validate experimental rigor and implementation details in appendices.

recommendation.zh: 一种系统级的长上下文管理方案（摘要树+指针），虽然不是模型层面的长上下文创新，但其工程设计对构建长上下文 Agent 系统有参考价值，可略读其架构设计。
recommendation.en: A system-level long-context management scheme (summary tree + pointers); while not a model-level innovation, its engineering design is valuable for building long-context Agent systems. Skim the architecture design.

paper.title: Storage Is Not Memory: A Retrieval-Centered Architecture for Agent Recall
paper.abstract: Extraction at ingestion is the wrong primitive for agent memory: content discarded before the query is known cannot be recovered at retrieval time. We propose True Memory, a six-layer architecture that shifts the center of the system from a storage schema to a multi-stage retrieval pipeline operating over events preserved verbatim. The full system runs as a single SQLite file on commodity CPU with no external database, vector index, graph store, or GPU. On LoCoMo (1,540 questions across 10 multi

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程 Agent 记忆中“入库时先抽取、检索时再回答”会丢失信息的问题，主张把原始事件完整保留，把系统重心放到检索流水线而不是存储 schema。
summary.importance: 这是 Agent memory 架构工作，不是基座预训练论文，但对“记忆应在写入时压缩还是在读取时推理”这个设计点给了较干净的工程论证。贡献类型主要是系统设计、评测和消融，而不是新的学习范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 True Memory 六层架构：保留 verbatim events，不依赖向量库、图数据库或外部检索系统，而是在单个 SQLite 文件上做多阶段检索与重排。核心主张是 ingestion 阶段不要过早抽取和压缩，避免 query 未知时的信息不可逆丢失；真正的“记忆”发生在 retrieval pipeline 中，而不是预定义存储结构中。
summary.experiments: 在 LoCoMo 上，True Memory Pro 在匹配的 gpt-4.1-mini answer model 下达到 93.0% 准确率，高于 Mem0 的 61.4%、Supermemory 的 65.4%、约 71% 的 Zep，接近 EverMemOS 的 94.5%。在 LongMemEval 上达到 87.8%，在 100 万 token 规模的 BEAM-1M 上达到 76.6%，高于已发表的 Hindsight 73.9%。还做了 56 组消融，说明性能并非来自单一 heuristic。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Sauron Labs。论文更像一篇面向 Agent memory 系统设计的强工程论文，关注点是检索架构与评测，而不是 LLM 预训练本身。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the failure mode of agent memory systems that extract and compress information at ingestion time, arguing that information discarded before the query is known cannot be recovered later.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory systems paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining paper, but it gives a fairly clean argument about a real design choice: whether memory should be compressed on write or reasoned over on read. The contribution is mainly architectural, evaluative, and empirical.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes True Memory, a six-layer retrieval-centered architecture that stores events verbatim and shifts the intelligence into a multi-stage retrieval pipeline. It runs in a single SQLite file on CPU, without an external vector DB, graph store, or GPU. The key idea is to avoid irreversible extraction at ingestion and defer structure induction to retrieval time.
summary_en.experiments: On LoCoMo, True Memory Pro reaches 93.0% accuracy with a matched gpt-4.1-mini answer model, outperforming Mem0 (61.4%), Supermemory (65.4%), and Zep (~71%), and approaching EverMemOS (94.5%). It also reports 87.8% on LongMemEval and 76.6% on BEAM-1M, above the prior published Hindsight result of 73.9%. A 56-setting ablation suggests the gains are not from a single heuristic.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Sauron Labs. The work is best read as a strong agent-memory systems paper focused on retrieval architecture and evaluation, not as a pretraining contribution.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练关系不深，但它把“写时抽取”这条常见 memory prior 打得很具体；只看架构图和 ablation，别把 benchmark 胜负直接外推到通用 Agent。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly attacks the common write-time extraction prior in agent memory; read the architecture and ablations, not the leaderboard as a universal agent claim.

paper.title: eOptShrinkQ: Near-Lossless KV Cache Compression Through Optimal Spectral Denoising and Quantization
paper.abstract: We show that the key-value (KV) cache in transformer attention heads admits a natural decomposition into a low-rank \emph{shared context} component and a full-rank \emph{per-token} residual, well described by the spiked random matrix model. This observation leads to eOptShrinkQ, a two-stage compression pipeline: optimal singular value shrinkage (eOptShrink) automatically extracts the shared structure, and the residual -- which satisfies the \emph{thin shell property} with delocalized coordinates

summary.core_problem: 长上下文 LLM 推理中 KV Cache 占用大量显存。现有的逐向量量化方法（如 TurboQuant）忽略了 KV Cache 中连续 token 之间共享的低秩结构，导致量化后存在内积偏差，影响模型性能。
summary.importance: 提出了一种结合谱降噪和量化的 KV Cache 压缩新范式。通过分离共享上下文和独立残差，不仅提高了量化精度，还消除了对异常值处理和内积偏差校正的依赖，为长上下文推理的显存优化提供了更优雅的解决方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 eOptShrinkQ，一个两阶段压缩流水线。首先，基于随机矩阵理论中的尖峰矩阵模型（spiked matrix model），利用最优奇异值收缩（eOptShrink）自动提取连续 KV 向量块中的低秩共享结构（信号）。然后，对剩余的全秩残差（噪声）进行量化。由于残差去除了结构化信息，更符合标量量化假设的各向同性，因此可以直接使用 TurboQuant 进行量化，无需额外的偏差校正。
summary.experiments: 在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 模型和 LongBench 数据集上的初步结果表明，eOptShrinkQ 在 3.5 bit 压缩率下能匹配全精度性能。相比于直接使用 TurboQuant，eOptShrinkQ 通过谱降噪恢复了各向同性，避免了 QJL 校正带来的额外 1 bit 开销。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Introduction 中关于 KV Cache 尖峰矩阵模型的建模思路，理解为什么连续 token 的 KV 向量可以分解为低秩信号和全秩残差。这部分理论分析是本文的核心创新。

summary_en.core_problem: KV Cache consumes significant GPU memory during long-context LLM inference. Existing per-vector quantization methods (like TurboQuant) ignore the shared low-rank structure among consecutive tokens in the KV Cache, leading to inner product bias after quantization and degrading model performance.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel KV Cache compression paradigm combining spectral denoising and quantization. By separating the shared context from the independent residual, it not only improves quantization accuracy but also eliminates the need for outlier handling and inner product bias correction, offering a more elegant solution for memory optimization in long-context inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces eOptShrinkQ, a two-stage compression pipeline. First, based on the spiked matrix model from random matrix theory, it uses optimal singular value shrinkage (eOptShrink) to automatically extract the low-rank shared structure (signal) from blocks of consecutive KV vectors. Then, the remaining full-rank residual (noise) is quantized. Because the residual is stripped of structured information and better satisfies the isotropy assumption of scalar quantization, it can be directly quantized using TurboQuant without additional bias correction.
summary_en.experiments: Preliminary results on the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model and the LongBench dataset show that eOptShrinkQ matches full-precision performance at a 3.5-bit compression rate. Compared to using TurboQuant directly, eOptShrinkQ restores isotropy through spectral denoising, avoiding the extra 1-bit overhead of QJL correction.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the modeling approach of the spiked matrix model for KV Cache in the Introduction. Understand why consecutive token KV vectors can be decomposed into a low-rank signal and a full-rank residual. This theoretical analysis is the core innovation of the paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但它把 KV cache 压缩从 heuristic 拉回到结构假设；先看是否真有跨层稳定低秩，再决定要不要信后面的理论包装。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it usefully reframes KV compression around structural assumptions rather than heuristics; first check whether the low-rank/shared-context story actually holds across layers before buying the theory.

paper.title: AdapShot: Adaptive Many-Shot In-Context Learning with Semantic-Aware KV Cache Reuse
paper.abstract: Many-Shot In-Context Learning (ICL) has emerged as a promising paradigm, leveraging extensive examples to unlock the reasoning potential of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, existing methods typically rely on a predetermined, fixed number of shots. This static approach often fails to adapt to the varying difficulty of different queries, leading to either insufficient context or interference from noise. Furthermore, the prohibitive computational and memory costs of long contexts severely lim

summary.core_problem: 解决 many-shot ICL 中固定 shot 数无法适配样本难度，以及长上下文预填充带来的计算和显存成本问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是推理效率和上下文选择方法，重点在动态选择示例数量与 KV cache 复用。它不属于预训练方法，但对长上下文推理成本和 ICL 工程有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AdapShot。先用 probe-based evaluation，根据输出熵估计当前 query 需要多少 shots；再通过 semantic-aware KV cache reuse 复用 probing 和正式推理阶段的前缀计算，减少重复 prefill。方法还试图处理复用 KV 时的位置不匹配问题。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模、上下文长度、速度提升、显存节省或准确率变化。主要声明是动态 shot 数可减少不足上下文或噪声干扰，KV cache 复用降低 many-shot 推理成本。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Electronic Science and Technology of China。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two issues in many-shot ICL: fixed shot counts do not adapt to query difficulty, and long-context prefilling is expensive in compute and memory.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-efficiency and context-selection method centered on adaptive shot counts and KV-cache reuse. It is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to long-context inference cost and ICL engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdapShot uses a probe-based evaluation mechanism where output entropy estimates the optimal number of shots for a given query. It then applies semantic-aware KV-cache reuse to avoid redundant prefill computation across probing and final inference, with additional handling for positional mismatch during reuse.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide benchmarks, model sizes, context lengths, speedups, memory savings, or accuracy numbers. The main claim is that adaptive shot selection reduces under-contexting or noise interference, while KV-cache reuse reduces many-shot inference cost.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China.

recommendation.zh: 工程上合理但像组合优化；先看 KV 复用的位置处理和熵阈值消融即可。
recommendation.en: Engineering-plausible but mostly a composition; check the positional handling for KV reuse and the entropy-threshold ablation.

institutions: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Counting as a minimal probe of language model reliability
paper.abstract: Large language models perform strongly on benchmarks in mathematical reasoning, coding and document analysis, suggesting a broad ability to follow instructions. However, it remains unclear whether such success reflects general logical competence, repeated application of learned procedures, or pattern matching that mimics rule execution. We investigate this question by introducing Stable Counting Capacity, an assay in which models count repeated symbols until failure. The assay removes knowledge

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要回答一个很窄但重要的问题：LLM 在没有知识、语义线索、格式约束和任务模板帮助时，能把一个简单规则稳定执行多久。作者选择“数一串完全相同的符号并输出数量”作为最小探针，用 Stable Counting Capacity, SCC，测量模型在状态跟踪失效前能处理的最大长度。核心不是证明模型不会数数，而是用计数作为可控实验，定位模型执行程序性规则的可靠边界。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在评测信号，而不是新模型结构。SCC 把“长上下文能力”和“跨长序列维护规则定义状态的能力”分开了。许多长上下文模型可以读入很长 prompt，但在远低于上下文窗口的位置失去稳定计数能力，这说明 context length benchmark 不能直接代表状态维护能力。这个结果对基座训练有直接启发：只靠 next-token 预测和自然语料中的隐式程序模式，模型可能学到有限范围内的 procedure mimicry，但未必获得开放长度上的算法泛化。它也提醒预训练评测需要加入无限可采样、无知识依赖、可定位失败边界的 mechanical assays，而不能只依赖知识型 benchmark 的平均准确率。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计刻意去掉常见混杂因素。输入是一段同质 item 序列，模型只需输出一个整数。评测数的是 item，不是 tokenizer 切出来的 token，因此避免把 tokenizer 粒度误当作模型能力。主评测不使用 JSON 或复杂 schema，减少 parser 和格式跟随能力对结果的影响。作者用 adaptive randomized ladder scheme 逐步增加序列长度，并在接近失败边界时重复采样，定义模型稳定失败前的长度为 Counting Capacity, CC。这个设计和固定题集不同：样本可以无限生成，规则极简单，正确答案精确，训练集泄漏和世界知识影响都被压到很低。与 ARC-AGI 这类机械 benchmark 相比，SCC 更像一个单变量压力测试，牺牲任务多样性，换取对状态维护边界的清晰测量。
summary.experiments: 关键观察是模型不是逐渐产生小误差，而是在 CC 附近从稳定区突然进入结构性失败区。以 claude-sonnet-4-6 的一次代表性运行看，稳定区内输出几乎沿着真实长度的对角线前进；越过边界后，模型常跳到 500、1000、2000 等显著整数，而不是给出接近真实值的局部偏差。作者把不同模型的预测按各自 CC 归一化后叠加，稳定区仍集中在对角线附近，边界后误差大且不可预测。错误输出还会聚集在有限的一组偏好整数上，尤其是 10 或 100 的倍数。这更像有限内部状态在边界处崩溃，而不是连续近似器的平滑误差增长。实验还显示所有被测 LLM 都有可测的 CC，新模型往往更高，但长上下文系统的 CC 通常远小于标称 context window。这个差异是最有信息量的实验结果：能接受长输入，不等于能在长输入上稳定维护一个由规则定义的变量。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 中 mechanical benchmark 和 knowledge-based benchmark 的区分，以及 SCC 为什么要避免 tokenizer、JSON schema 和语义 landmark。随后重点看 Fig. 1 的 CC 分布和长上下文对比，它给出这项评测的主结论。Fig. 2 更值得细读：稳定区、突然塌缩、归一化后跨模型形态一致、错误集中到偏好整数，这些现象支撑“有限状态式 procedure mimicry”的解释。Supplementary Note 3 的 adaptive randomized ladder scheme 也需要看，那里决定 CC 是否是稳健指标，而不是某个长度上的偶然失败。若从预训练角度深挖，重点不是计数任务本身，而是它如何暴露 next-token LM 在长期状态维护、算法外推、隐式 scratchpad 缺失上的限制。

summary_en.core_problem: The work asks a narrow but diagnostic question: how long can a language model execute a simple rule when knowledge, semantics, formatting cues, and external memory aids are removed. It uses homogeneous sequence counting as a minimal probe and defines Stable Counting Capacity, SCC, as the point where the model can no longer reliably return the exact number of repeated items. The target is not counting as a user task. Counting is used as a controlled assay for procedural state maintenance.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly an evaluation instrument for foundation-model research. SCC separates long-context ingestion from reliable state tracking over a long input. A model may accept a long context while failing to carry a single rule-defined variable far below its advertised window. This matters for pretraining because standard next-token training on natural data may teach bounded procedure imitation without yielding length-general algorithmic behavior. The result also argues for mechanical assays that are infinitely sampleable, knowledge-free, exact, and able to expose a failure boundary, rather than relying only on average accuracy over knowledge-heavy benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: The assay is deliberately stripped down. The model receives a sequence of identical items and must output one integer. The measured unit is the item, not the tokenizer token, which reduces tokenizer-specific confounds. The main setup avoids JSON and other output schemas, so parsing and format following are not part of the measurement. Sequence length is increased with an adaptive randomized ladder scheme, with repeated trials near the failure region, and the resulting boundary is reported as Counting Capacity. Compared with fixed mechanical benchmarks such as ARC-style tests, SCC is less broad but more controlled: the rule is elementary, instances can be generated without limit, and the measured variable is a clear procedural boundary.
summary_en.experiments: The central empirical pattern is abrupt failure rather than gradual degradation. In a representative run for claude-sonnet-4-6, predictions follow the diagonal in the stable region and then break near the CC boundary. After failure, outputs often jump to salient values such as 500, 1000, or 2000 instead of small local errors around the true count. When predictions from different models are normalized by each model’s CC and overlaid, the same structure appears: tight diagonal behavior before the boundary, followed by large and unpredictable errors after it. Incorrect outputs cluster around a restricted set of preferred integers, especially multiples of 10 or 100. This pattern is more consistent with the collapse of a finite internal state than with a smooth continuous approximation. The evaluated models all have measurable counting capacities. Newer models often support larger capacities, but long-context models still lose stable counting far below their nominal context windows.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction for the distinction between knowledge-based benchmarks and mechanical assays, and for the design choices that remove tokenizer, schema, and semantic confounds. Fig. 1 is the main entry point for the capacity distribution and the long-context comparison. Fig. 2 is the key mechanistic evidence: stable diagonal behavior, sudden collapse, cross-model normalization, and preferred erroneous integers. Supplementary Note 3 is important because the adaptive ladder procedure determines whether CC is a stable boundary rather than a noisy single-point measurement. For pretraining researchers, the useful question is not whether models can count, but what SCC reveals about next-token models, long-range state maintenance, and length extrapolation of learned procedures.

recommendation.zh: 应读：它把“长上下文=长程可靠计算”这个 prior 切开了，复现成本低，适合放进内部 eval。
recommendation.en: Read it: it separates long context from reliable long-horizon computation, and the assay is cheap enough to add to internal evals.

paper.title: Retrieval and Multi-Hop Reasoning in 1M-Token Context Windows: Evaluating LLMs on Classical Chinese Text
paper.abstract: We evaluate the long-context retrieval and reasoning capabilities of five frontier large language models with advertised 1M-token context windows on a classical Chinese corpus. Two complementary studies are reported. Test 1 measures single-needle retrieval at 1M tokens of input, with three biographical needles planted at three depths and pairs of real (training-prior-consistent) and altered (training-prior-contradicting) variants to separate genuine in-context retrieval from reliance on memorise

summary.core_problem: 评估标称 1M token 上下文窗口的前沿 LLM，是否能在文言文长语料中完成可靠检索和多跳关系推理，并区分真正的上下文读取与训练语料记忆。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发主要在长上下文评测设计，而不是模型训练方法。它把长上下文能力拆成两个层次：单点事实定位和多跳链式遍历。前者更接近 needle-in-a-haystack，后者更接近真实 RAG 或 Graph RAG 场景。文言文语料带来三个有用压力源：tokenizer 对字符的切分效率差异、经典文本在预训练中的泄漏、单位 token 信息密度高。这些因素会影响对长上下文能力的判断，也提醒预训练研究者不能只用英文或现代中文 NIAH 来估计 1M context 的有效容量。
summary.technical_approach: 方法设计有两个关键点。第一，使用《宋元学案》作为长上下文语料，并按每个模型自己的 tokenizer 标定上下文长度，而不是用同一字符数喂给所有模型。文中报告不同模型在该语料上的 token/character 比例约有 35% 差异，这会直接改变有效上下文负载。第二，构造 real / altered 成对 needle。real needle 与历史事实一致，altered needle 刻意与训练先验冲突，用来检查模型是在读上下文，还是调用参数记忆。单点检索测试在 1M tier 中进行，3 个 needle、3 个插入深度、2 种事实变体，共 18 个 cell。多跳测试使用虚构主体名，进一步消除训练泄漏，要求模型在 256K、512K、1M 三个上下文 tier 中做三跳链式关系遍历。与常规 NIAH 相比，它更关注长上下文中的关系跟踪和抗先验能力。
summary.experiments: 实验设置覆盖 5 个官方 API 前沿模型，均为标称 1M token context。语料来自 Chinese Text Project 的《宋元学案》数字版本，总计约 142 万汉字，使用其中不包含 needle 主体个人学案的 97 卷作为 haystack。haystack 按各模型 tokenizer 填充到约 99% 可用输入上限；多跳测试另设 256K 和 512K tier。提供内容中没有完整结果表和数值曲线，无法可靠复原各模型准确率、不同深度衰减模式或三跳任务上的具体失败点。能确认的实验洞察是：作者把参数记忆、tokenizer 差异、上下文深度和多跳推理分离控制，这比单纯报告 1M NIAH 命中率更能暴露长上下文能力的边界。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Methods 中 tokenizer calibration、per-model haystack construction、real/altered needle 设计和 fictional multi-hop chain 设计。若能获得完整结果，优先看三类图表：不同模型 token/character 比例表，1M 单点检索在 25%/50%/75% 深度的 real 与 altered 对比，256K/512K/1M 三跳任务准确率曲线。对预训练研究最有用的不是具体哪个 API 模型表现更好，而是评测如何避免把训练记忆误判为长上下文读取能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The work tests whether frontier LLMs with advertised 1M-token context windows can reliably retrieve facts and perform multi-hop relation traversal in Classical Chinese, while separating in-context retrieval from memorized training priors.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining research is evaluation design for long-context models. The task separates single-fact lookup from multi-hop chain traversal, which matters because the latter is closer to the workload that motivates RAG and graph-based retrieval. Classical Chinese is a useful stress test: tokenizer efficiency varies substantially across vendors, many source texts may have appeared in pretraining data, and each character carries high semantic density. These factors make standard English NIAH-style results an incomplete proxy for effective 1M-context capacity.
summary_en.technical_approach: The evaluation uses Song-Yuan Xue’an as the long-context corpus and constructs model-specific haystacks after calibrating each tokenizer. This avoids a common confound: the same character sequence can occupy meaningfully different token budgets across models. The reported tokenizer spread is about 35% in tokens per character. The first test plants biographical facts as paired real and altered needles. The altered variants intentionally contradict historical facts, so a model must follow the prompt context rather than rely on parametric memory. The 1M-token test uses 3 needles, 3 insertion depths, and 2 variants, giving 18 cells per model. The second test uses fictional names and a three-hop chain traversal task at 256K, 512K, and 1M tokens, removing training leakage and testing reference following rather than single-span lookup.
summary_en.experiments: The setup covers five frontier models accessed through official APIs. The corpus contains roughly 1.42 million Classical Chinese characters, with 97 volumes used as the haystack after excluding volumes directly associated with needle subjects. Haystacks are sized per model to approximately 99% of each usable input limit, with additional 256K and 512K tiers for the multi-hop test. The provided content does not include the full result tables or accuracy curves, so model-wise accuracy, depth sensitivity, and exact decay patterns cannot be reconstructed safely. The reliable takeaway from the available text is the controlled separation of tokenizer effects, parametric leakage, insertion depth, and multi-hop reasoning difficulty.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the tokenizer calibration, per-model haystack construction, real-versus-altered needle protocol, and fictional multi-hop chain design. If the complete results are available, read the tokenizer efficiency table, the 1M single-needle real/altered comparison at 25%, 50%, and 75% depths, and the 256K/512K/1M multi-hop accuracy curves. The most transferable part is the benchmark construction, not the ranking of particular API models.

recommendation.zh: 只看测试构造和多跳衰减图；它提醒长上下文预训练别被 needle-in-haystack 的 100% 误导。
recommendation.en: Read the test construction and decay plots; it is a useful warning against over-trusting 100% needle-in-haystack scores.

paper.title: EditPropBench: Measuring Factual Edit Propagation in Scientific Manuscripts
paper.abstract: Local factual edits in scientific manuscripts often create non-local revision obligations. If a dataset changes from 215 to 80 documents, claims such as 'medium-scale' or 'a few hundred items' may also become stale, even though they do not repeat the edited number. We introduce EditPropBench, a benchmark for measuring whether LLM editors propagate factual edits through dependent manuscript claims. Each item contains an ML/NLP-style synthetic manuscript, a targeted edit, and a controlled fact gra

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是：当用户对长文档做局部事实编辑时，模型能否识别并传播到文中所有依赖该事实的非局部表述，而不是只改显式提到的那一句。
summary.importance: 主要贡献是 benchmark。它把文档编辑中的“事实传播”问题做成了可控评测集，并提供句级依赖监督和专门指标。对做 agent/editing 系统的人有用，但对基座预训练的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 EditPropBench。每个样本包含一篇合成的 ML/NLP 风格 scientific manuscript、一个目标编辑，以及一个受控 fact graph，用句级标签标出直接编辑目标、必须联动更新的下游句子和应保持不变的无关句子。评测包含三种编辑协议、对抗性 metric probe、stress-test 变体，以及核心指标 Edit-Ripple Adherence (ERA)。
summary.experiments: 在最难的 implicit/free-form 子集上，5 个 LLM 编辑系统的 ERA 范围为 0.148–0.705；最强系统仍漏掉约 30% 必须级联更新的内容。摘要没有给出模型名单和更细 baseline，但结果足以说明当前长文档编辑系统在依赖传播上并不稳。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLM editors can propagate a local factual edit through all dependent claims in a long scientific manuscript, rather than only patching the explicitly edited sentence.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark. It turns factual edit propagation into a controlled evaluation problem with sentence-level dependency supervision and a dedicated metric. Useful for editing agents, but only indirectly relevant to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce EditPropBench. Each example contains a synthetic ML/NLP-style manuscript, a targeted edit, and a controlled fact graph with sentence-level labels for direct targets, required downstream updates, and protected unrelated text. The benchmark includes three editing protocols, adversarial metric probes, stress-test variants, and a central metric called Edit-Ripple Adherence (ERA).
summary_en.experiments: On the hardest implicit/free-form stratum, five LLM editing systems span ERA 0.148–0.705, and even the strongest system misses roughly 30% of required cascade updates. The abstract does not list all systems or detailed baselines, but the result is enough to show that current long-document editing remains brittle.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做文档编辑 agent，可记住这个 benchmark；否则知道“局部改动不会自动全局一致”这件事就够了，不必细读正文。
recommendation.en: Keep this benchmark in mind if you work on document-editing agents; otherwise the main takeaway is simply that local edits do not reliably induce global consistency.

paper.title: Caracal: Causal Architecture via Spectral Mixing
paper.abstract: The scalability of Large Language Models to long sequences is hindered by the quadratic cost of attention and the limitations of positional encodings. To address these, we introduce Caracal, a novel architecture that replaces attention with a parameter-efficient, $\mathcal{O}(L \log L)$ Multi-Head Fourier (MHF) module. Our contributions are threefold: (1) We leverage the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) for sequence mixing, inherently addressing both bottlenecks mentioned above. (2) We apply a frequ

summary.core_problem: Transformer注意力机制存在序列长度相关的二次计算复杂度瓶颈，外嵌位置编码导致长度外推能力受限；此前Fourier类高效架构无法实现自回归生成必需的因果约束，而Mamba等SSM类架构依赖硬件定制内核，可移植性差。
summary.importance: 提供了一种硬件无关、复杂度为O(L log L)的长序列建模架构备选，验证了频域因果掩码的可行性，为无需显式位置编码的自回归模型设计提供了新路径。
summary.technical_approach: 以标准Decoder-only Transformer为基底，用多头傅里叶（MHF）模块替换全局自注意力，仅保留少量滑动窗口注意力层捕捉局部依赖；通过频域非对称补全和截断实现因果约束，FFT天然包含位置信息，因此可移除显式位置编码；MHF模块前增加小核深度因果卷积注入局部归纳偏置，整体适配现有Transformer生态的成熟组件。
summary.experiments: 在多个序列建模基准上性能与Transformer、SSM基线相当，计算复杂度介于O(L)的SSM和O(L²)的Transformer之间，无需定制CUDA内核即可跨硬件平台运行。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Methodology部分的频域因果掩码实现逻辑、MHF模块设计，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Transformer attention suffers from quadratic computational complexity along sequence length, and external positional encodings limit length extrapolation performance. Previous Fourier-based efficient architectures cannot support causal constraint required for autoregressive generation, while SSM architectures such as Mamba rely on hardware-specific custom kernels with poor portability.
summary_en.importance: Provides a hardware-agnostic, O(L log L) alternative for long-sequence modeling, verifies the feasibility of frequency-domain causal masking, and offers a new path for autoregressive model design without explicit positional encodings.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on standard decoder-only Transformer, replaces global self-attention with Multi-Head Fourier (MHF) modules, and retains only a small number of sliding-window attention layers to capture local dependencies. Causal constraint is implemented via asymmetric padding and truncation in the frequency domain, and explicit positional encodings are removed as FFT inherently captures positional information. A small-kernel depthwise causal convolution is added before the MHF module to inject local inductive bias, and the overall design is compatible with mature components of the existing Transformer ecosystem.
summary_en.experiments: Performance matches Transformer and SSM baselines on multiple sequence modeling benchmarks, with complexity between O(L) SSMs and O(L²) Transformers, and runs across hardware platforms without custom CUDA kernels.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the implementation of frequency-domain causal masking and MHF module design in the Methodology section, estimated reading time 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 值得读因果频域 masking 的构造；实验规模若不大，先把它当长上下文架构候选而非替代 attention 的结论。
recommendation.en: Read the causal spectral-masking construction; unless scale is convincing, treat it as an architecture candidate, not an attention replacement.

paper.title: Characterizing the Expressivity of Local Attention in Transformers
paper.abstract: The transformer is the most popular neural architecture for language modeling. The cornerstone of the transformer is its global attention mechanism, which lets the model aggregate information from all preceding tokens before generating the next token. One common variant of attention is called local attention, which restricts each token to aggregating information from a bounded window of predecessors, reducing the quadratic cost of global attention to linear. Although this restriction is usually

summary.core_problem: 解释一个经验现象：在计算预算相近时，限制注意力范围的 local attention 有时不但不降质，反而提升语言建模效果。论文要回答的是：从可表达性（recognizer expressivity）的角度，local attention 到底改变了 Transformer 能识别/实现的计算结构是什么，为什么“加限制”会变强。
summary.importance: 对预训练/架构研究的价值在于给出一个可操作的结构性解释：local attention 不是单纯的效率近似，而是在固定精度（fixed-precision）设定下引入了新的“时间逻辑算子”，使得模型可识别的正则语言类严格变大；同时纯 local 又会退化为只依赖固定后缀的更弱类别。结论直接支持一种工程上常见但缺少理论支撑的设计：global+local 的混合注意力可能在质量上优于纯 global 或纯 local，并且“窗口=1”是一个值得优先尝试的强基线。这类结论对长上下文架构、稀疏注意力设计、以及在不改训练数据的情况下提升困惑度/泛化的结构改动都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach:
全文路线是“形式语言/时间逻辑刻画 + 实证验证”。
1）理论框架：沿用并扩展 Li & Cotterell (2025) 的结果，把 fixed-precision 的 Transformer LM 与线性时序逻辑（LTL）的某个片段对应起来。已有结论是：global attention 对应某个带单一 past operator 的 LTL 片段。
2）核心理论贡献：证明加入 local attention 等价于在逻辑上增加一种新的时间算子，从而能识别严格更大的正则语言家族，特别是 locally testable languages（与 n-gram/局部模式强相关的一类经典语言）。直觉上，local attention 提供了对“局部邻接结构”的直接可计算性，而 global attention 在 fixed-precision 下对某些局部可测试性质反而不够表达。
3）互补性而非替代：进一步证明如果只有 local attention，则每个位置的计算只依赖固定长度后缀，表达性塌缩到 definite languages（更弱）。因此最强的是 hybrid：同时有 global 与 local。
4）位置编码讨论：比较 SiPE 与 RoPE，结论是位置编码本身不能弥补缺少 local attention 带来的表达性缺口。
这套论证把“为什么局部窗口能提升质量”从经验归因（正则化/归纳偏置）推进到可分离的表达性结论：local 提供了 global 缺失的一类可识别结构，而 global 提供了 local 做不到的长程依赖。
summary.experiments:
实验分两块：
1）形式语言识别 + 长度外推：比较三类模型（纯 global、纯 local、global+local hybrid），结果与理论一致：hybrid 能识别严格更多语言，并且对更长序列的泛化更稳。并且在 local-attention 家族里，window size=1 一直是最强选择（无论纯 local 还是 hybrid）。
2）自然语言困惑度：在 WikiText-2 上，window=1 的 hybrid attention 在不同位置编码（SiPE/RoPE）下都取得最低 perplexity。
（注：给定片段未包含具体 perplexity 数值、模型规模、训练步数等表格；精读应定位实验章节的表格，确认“预算相同”的控制方式、窗口大小扫描范围、以及长度外推的评测协议。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟，偏理论）：
1）先读 Introduction：把三条主结论记下来——local 增强表达性、纯 local 会塌缩、hybrid 最强且 window=1 最优。
2）精读理论部分开头对 LTL 片段的定义与“新增算子”的直观解释（通常是全文最有信息密度的地方）。目标不是跟完所有证明，而是搞清楚：新增算子对应哪类可测试性质，为什么 global-only 在 fixed-precision 下做不到。
3）再看实验：重点看语言识别的长度外推设置与 window size 消融；最后扫 WikiText-2 的 perplexity 对比，确认结论是否稳健跨位置编码。
如果你在做架构改动：把它当作“为什么要保留一条极窄的局部注意力分支”的理论背书，并据此设计 hybrid 的实现细节与 ablation。

summary_en.core_problem: Explain why local attention—despite being a restriction—can improve Transformer language modeling quality under comparable compute, by characterizing how different attention patterns change the model’s formal recognizer expressivity.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining and architecture work, the paper reframes local attention as more than an efficiency approximation: under fixed-precision assumptions, adding local attention introduces an additional temporal-logic operator, strictly expanding the class of regular languages the model can recognize. At the same time, purely local attention collapses expressivity to suffix-dependent (definite) languages. This yields a concrete design implication: global+local hybrid attention can be strictly more capable than either extreme, and a window size of 1 is a strong default. This is directly relevant to sparse/long-context attention designs where quality often hinges on the inductive bias of the attention pattern.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper combines a formal-language/logic characterization with empirical validation.
- Starting point: prior work (Li & Cotterell, 2025) links fixed-precision Transformer LMs with global attention to a specific fragment of linear temporal logic (LTL) with a single past operator.
- Main theoretical step: prove that adding local attention corresponds to adding a new temporal operator, enabling recognition of a strictly larger family of regular languages, notably locally testable languages (closely related to n-gram-like local pattern properties).
- Complementarity result: show that using only local attention makes the computation depend on a fixed-length suffix, reducing expressivity to definite languages; hence local is not a drop-in replacement for global.
- Positional encoding check: evaluate sinusoidal (SiPE) and rotary (RoPE) encodings and argue they do not compensate for the absence of local attention.
The conceptual takeaway is a sharper mechanism than generic “regularization”: local attention adds a missing kind of local-testability computation, while global attention supplies long-range capabilities that local-only cannot provide.
summary_en.experiments:
Two empirical tracks:
1) Formal language recognition with length generalization: compare (i) global-only, (ii) local-only, and (iii) hybrid attention. Results match the theory: hybrids recognize more languages and generalize more reliably to longer sequences. Across local variants, window size = 1 is consistently best, both for local-only and hybrid models.
2) Natural language modeling: on WikiText-2, hybrid attention with window size 1 achieves the lowest perplexity across positional encodings.
(The excerpt provided does not include the exact PPL numbers, model sizes, or training-budget controls; those should be verified in the experiment tables, especially how “constant compute” is enforced and how window-size sweeps are configured.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes, theory-leaning):
- Introduction for the three headline claims (local expands expressivity; local-only collapses; hybrid + window=1 is best).
- The LTL section for the definitions and the intuition of the “new operator” induced by local attention; you don’t need every proof detail, but you should understand what property class (locally testable) is gained.
- Experiments for (a) length-generalization protocol and window-size ablations, then (b) WikiText-2 perplexity comparison across SiPE/RoPE.
If you’re iterating on attention patterns, treat this as justification for keeping a very narrow local branch in a hybrid design and ablate window=1 early.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改一点对 attention 设计的 prior：local 不是单纯效率折中。读证明主结论和构造例子即可，别期待它直接告诉你工程最优窗口大小。
recommendation.en: This slightly updates the prior that local attention is merely an efficiency trade-off. Read the main theorem and constructive examples, but do not expect direct guidance on engineering-optimal window sizes.

paper.title: Predictive Multi-Tier Memory Management for KV Cache in Large-Scale GPU Inference
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) cache memory management is the primary bottleneck limiting throughput and cost-efficiency in large-scale GPU inference serving. Current systems suffer from three compounding inefficiencies: (1) the absence of unified KV cache sizing across all attention architectures--particularly multi-head latent attention (MLA), which is unsupported in general-purpose frameworks, resulting in up to 57x memory over-provisioning; (2) confinement of KV cache to a single memory tier (GPU HBM) despi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是大规模 LLM 推理里一个越来越硬的系统瓶颈：KV cache 不是简单地“不够大”，而是同时存在三层错配。第一，现有框架对不同 attention 变体的 KV 大小建模不统一，尤其对 MLA 这类压缩 KV 表示的结构缺少原生支持，导致显著的显存预算错误和批大小浪费。第二，主流 serving 系统几乎把 KV cache 视为只能放在 GPU HBM 里的对象，没有把 CPU DRAM、CXL、NVMe、RDMA、并行文件系统这些层级纳入统一管理。第三，缓存淘汰仍以 LRU 这类被动策略为主，没有利用请求复用、系统 prompt 重复、agent workflow 模板化、RoPE 顺序局部性这些可预测结构，因此频繁把后续还会用到的状态驱逐掉，再付出重算代价。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身没有直接方法贡献，属于推理系统论文，但对基座研究仍有两点现实意义。第一，attention 结构设计不能只看训练时 FLOPs 和质量，也要看 serving 时 KV 形态是否能被系统正确建模和利用。文中把 MHA/GQA/MQA/MLA 放进同一套 sizing 逻辑，提醒人们像 MLA 这样的结构，真正收益只有在 serving 栈跟上后才会兑现。第二，长上下文和 agent 场景正在把“模型参数”瓶颈转成“状态管理”瓶颈。对做长上下文预训练、KV 压缩、latent attention、memory-aware architecture 的研究者，这篇文章提供了一个较完整的系统侧约束图景：如果未来模型继续扩大上下文，单靠更省 KV 的架构不够，还需要预测式分层缓存和更细粒度的 eviction/prefetch 机制配套。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由四部分组成。1）统一的架构感知 KV sizing。作者先把 MHA、GQA、MQA、MLA 的每 token 每层 KV 占用公式统一起来。关键点在 MLA：它不是传统 K/V head 数乘 head dim 的形式，而是 latent 维度加上单独保留的 RoPE 分量，因此若沿用 MHA 公式会严重高估。文中以 DeepSeek-V3 风格 MLA 为例，指出通用框架若按 MHA 预算，可能出现 57 倍级别的过度预留。2）六层内存层级管理。系统把 GPU HBM、CPU DRAM、CXL memory、NVMe+GDS、RDMA fabric、并行文件系统纳入统一层级，并按带宽和延迟特征做放置。这里不是简单 offload，而是把 KV block 视为可迁移对象，根据访问预测和时延预算决定驻留层级。3）Bayesian reuse prediction。作者把 KV block 的复用建模成 Beta 共轭先验下的命中概率估计，并按 16 种 (block-type, transition-type) 组合维护统计量。这样做的原因是不同块类型和状态转移的复用模式差异很大，例如 system prompt block、tool-call block、continuation block 的未来访问概率并不相同。相比纯 LRU，这种方法试图在驱逐前先判断“以后还会不会回来”。4）head-granular eviction 与 RoPE-aware prefetch。驱逐不是整块一刀切，而是跟踪 attention head 级别的重要性，用 EMA 分数估计哪些 head 的缓存更值得保留；同时利用 RoPE 带来的顺序局部性做预取，减少下一步访问 miss。这个设计的含义是：即便 token/block 粒度相同，不同 head 对后续生成的贡献也不一样，细粒度管理可以进一步压缩 miss 率。
summary.experiments: 文中给出的结果以分析投影和系统级评估为主，而不是完整开源实现上的端到端大规模线上实验。几个核心数字值得记住。第一，统一 sizing 后，在同样硬件上可得到最高 7.4 倍的 batch size 提升；这主要来自对 MLA 等结构不再按 MHA 方式错误预留。第二，六层内存体系把单节点有效 KV 容量从约 40GB 扩展到 38TB 以上，目标是在不破坏延迟 SLO 的前提下承接超长上下文和高并发。第三，Bayesian reuse prediction 在作者设定的访问模式下达到 70%–84% 的 cache hit rate，并带来 1.4–2.1 倍的 projected TTFT 改善。第四，head-granular eviction + RoPE-aware prefetch 相比 LRU 进一步降低约 25% miss rate。第五，在 64-GPU H100 集群的分析配置上，系统投影吞吐达到 4150 tokens/s/GPU，成本约 0.43 美元每百万 token；相对文中最强延迟优化基线 TensorRT-LLM，吞吐约 2.0 倍且成本低 30%；相对 FlexGen，吞吐约 6.4 倍，TTFT P99 低 11 倍。需要注意的是，这些数字多为 analytical projections，不应等同于严格可复现的线上实测。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看三处。第一，看引言和背景里对不同 attention 架构 KV 公式的统一推导，尤其 MLA 的 sizing 方式。这部分对做 latent attention、KV compression、长上下文架构的人最有用。第二，看方法部分关于六层 memory hierarchy 和 Bayesian reuse prediction 的设计，理解作者为什么不用单纯的 LRU+offload，而要把“未来复用概率”显式建模。第三，看实验部分时要区分“实测结果”和“分析投影”，不要把 projected throughput 当成已经充分验证的部署结论。预计 20–30 分钟能抓住主要信息；如果只关心预训练研究接口，读 sizing 公式、MLA 讨论和系统约束假设就够了。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a serving-side bottleneck that has become central in large-scale LLM inference: KV cache management is not merely a capacity issue, but a three-way mismatch. First, existing frameworks do not provide unified KV sizing across attention variants, especially for MLA-style compressed KV representations, which leads to severe over-allocation and reduced batch size. Second, most serving stacks effectively treat KV cache as an HBM-only object, leaving CPU DRAM, CXL memory, NVMe, RDMA, and parallel filesystems outside a coherent placement policy. Third, eviction remains largely reactive, typically LRU-like, despite the fact that many reuse patterns are predictable: repeated system prompts, recurring tool-call traces, and sequential locality induced by RoPE.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it matters for foundation-model research in two practical ways. First, attention architecture choices should not be evaluated only by training-time quality and FLOPs; their serving-time KV representation must also be modeled correctly by the runtime stack. The paper makes this explicit by putting MHA, GQA, MQA, and MLA under one sizing framework. Second, long-context and agentic workloads are turning the bottleneck from parameter storage into state management. For researchers working on long-context pretraining, KV compression, latent attention, or memory-aware architectures, the paper is useful because it shows what system support is required for architectural gains to materialize in deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The system has four main components. 1) Architecture-aware KV sizing. The paper derives unified per-token, per-layer KV memory formulas for MHA, GQA, MQA, and MLA. The key point is MLA: its cache footprint is determined by latent-state dimensions plus a separately stored RoPE component, not by the standard KV-head-count times head-dimension formula. Using an MHA-equivalent budget for MLA can therefore massively overestimate memory. 2) A six-tier memory hierarchy. KV blocks can reside across GPU HBM, CPU DRAM, CXL-attached memory, NVMe with GPUDirect Storage, RDMA fabric, and parallel filesystems. This is not simple offloading; placement is tied to latency and bandwidth characteristics, with KV blocks treated as migratable objects. 3) Bayesian reuse prediction. Reuse is modeled with Beta-conjugate priors over 16 (block-type, transition-type) pairs. The motivation is that different block classes have different future-access probabilities, so eviction should depend on predicted reuse rather than recency alone. 4) Head-granular eviction and RoPE-aware prefetch. Instead of evicting whole blocks uniformly, the system tracks per-head importance with EMA-style scores and uses RoPE-induced sequential locality to prefetch likely-needed content. The broader idea is that cache value is heterogeneous even within the same token/block granularity.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is largely analytical and system-level rather than a fully demonstrated production deployment. The main reported numbers are: up to 7.4x higher batch size from correct architecture-aware sizing; effective KV capacity expansion from roughly 40 GB to more than 38 TB per node through the six-tier hierarchy; 70%–84% cache hit rates from Bayesian reuse prediction, with projected 1.4x–2.1x TTFT reduction; and about 25% lower miss rate from head-granular eviction plus RoPE-aware prefetch relative to LRU. On an analytically modeled 64-GPU H100 cluster, the system projects 4,150 tokens/s/GPU at $0.43 per million tokens, about 2.0x the throughput of the best latency-optimized baseline in the paper (TensorRT-LLM) at 30% lower cost, and 6.4x the throughput of FlexGen with 11x lower TTFT P99. These are projections, not all end-to-end measured deployment results, so they should be read with that distinction in mind.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Focus on three parts. First, read the unified KV sizing discussion, especially the MLA case; that is the most relevant section for architecture and long-context researchers. Second, inspect the memory-hierarchy design and the Bayesian reuse predictor to understand why the authors move beyond LRU plus naive offload. Third, when reading the results, separate measured behavior from analytical projections. About 20–30 minutes is enough to extract the main ideas. If your interest is mainly pretraining-facing, the sizing formulas, MLA treatment, and system assumptions are the parts worth keeping.

recommendation.zh: 只看 sizing 公式和 MLA 部分；六级 cache 方案可能工程假设偏重，先当 serving 设计草案读。
recommendation.en: Read the sizing model and the MLA section; treat the six-tier cache hierarchy as a serving design sketch until the workload evidence is clear.

paper.title: When Hidden States Drift: Can KV Caches Rescue Long-Range Speculative Decoding?
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference, but SOTA hidden-state-based drafters suffer from long-range decay: draft accuracy degrades as the speculative step increases. Existing work attributes this decay to train-inference mismatch and proposes test-time training (TTT) as a remedy, yet we observe that long-range decay persists even in TTT-trained drafters. We revisit long-range decay from the perspective of context information preservation. In hidden-state reuse, we argue the target hidden

summary.core_problem: 解释并缓解 hidden-state-based speculative decoding 在长 speculative step 下 draft accuracy 衰减的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的机制性工作，来自阿里 Qwen 应用团队。关键价值不只是加速，而是重新解释 long-range speculative decoding 的失败原因：问题可能不是单纯的 train-inference mismatch，而是 hidden state 本身作为上下文压缩表示会丢掉后续 draft step 需要的信息。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从上下文信息保留角度重审 speculative decoding。它认为复用 target hidden state 等价于使用一个带偏置的上下文压缩：该 hidden state 是按当前位置 query 聚合历史 token 得到的，适合当前位置 next-token prediction，但会压制对后续 speculative step 重要的信息。相比之下，target model 的 KV cache 保留 token-wise key/value 表示，是更显式的上下文载体。基于这一分析，论文转向利用 KV cache 来支撑长程 draft，而不是只依赖单个 hidden state。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明已有 hidden-state-based drafter 在 speculative step 增大时 draft accuracy 会下降，并且即使用 test-time training 训练过的 drafter，long-range decay 仍然存在。具体模型规模、数据集、吞吐提升、acceptance rate 或速度提升幅度未在提供的摘要中给出。
summary.authors_note: 论文来自 Alibaba Qwen Applications Business Group，并包含 University of Science and Technology of China、Zhejiang University 等机构作者；Qwen 团队在开源大模型、长上下文和推理系统方向有持续工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why hidden-state-based speculative decoding loses draft accuracy as the speculative horizon grows, and whether KV caches can mitigate that long-range decay.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper with a useful mechanistic angle from Alibaba's Qwen ecosystem. The main contribution is not just acceleration: it reframes long-range speculative failure as an information-preservation problem rather than merely a train-inference mismatch.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper analyzes hidden-state reuse as biased context compression. A target hidden state aggregates prior tokens according to the current-position query, making it suitable for immediate next-token prediction but potentially suppressing information needed by later speculative steps. In contrast, the target model's KV cache retains token-wise key/value representations and acts as a more explicit context store. The proposed direction is to use KV-cache information for longer-range drafting rather than relying only on a single hidden vector.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that hidden-state-based drafters suffer draft-accuracy decay as the speculative step increases, and that the decay persists even for drafters trained with test-time training. The supplied abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, acceptance-rate numbers, or end-to-end speedup figures.
summary_en.authors_note: The work involves Alibaba's Qwen Applications Business Group, along with authors from the University of Science and Technology of China and Zhejiang University. The Qwen ecosystem has substantial prior work on open LLMs, long context, and inference systems.

recommendation.zh: 值得看机制分析部分；它把 speculative decay 从训练错配改写成上下文压缩问题，可能影响 drafter 设计。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanism section: it recasts speculative decay as context-compression failure, which can change how drafters are designed.

paper.title: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction via a Unified Information-Theoretic Objective
paper.abstract: Key-value (KV) caching is essential for large language model inference, yet its memory overhead poses a critical bottleneck for long-context generation. Existing eviction policies predominantly rely on empirical heuristics, lacking a rigorous theoretical foundation. This work rethinks KV cache eviction through the lens of the Information Bottleneck principle. Under a linear-Gaussian surrogate of attention, we derive a closed-form mutual information objective that characterizes the effective info

summary.core_problem: 长上下文推理时 KV cache 线性增长带来显存瓶颈。现有 eviction 多是经验启发式（按注意力分数、按多样性等），缺少统一目标与可解释的“为什么这样删”。论文要解决的是：能否给 KV eviction 一个信息论目标，并据此导出低开销、效果稳定的删缓存策略。
summary.importance: 属于推理系统/效率方向而非预训练，但对基座研究仍有两点价值：1）把一堆看似不同的 eviction 规则统一到同一个互信息/容量最大化目标下，提供了更可解释的分析框架，便于做机制分析与设计新策略；2）若做长上下文 continual pretrain 或长序列评测，推理阶段的 cache 策略会显著影响可用上下文与有效信息保留，进而影响对“模型是否真的学会长程依赖”的判断。整体建议泛读，重点看其统一目标与 CapKV 的可实现近似。
summary.technical_approach:
核心是用 Information Bottleneck 视角重述 eviction：在一个线性-高斯的注意力替身模型下，把 KV cache 看成一组线性通信信道；在固定预算B下选择子集C，使“未来查询（latent future queries）与传输后的表示”之间的互信息最大，即最大化保留子集的有效信息容量。
- 建模：用线性高斯抽象把 attention 的聚合写成可分析的线性传输过程。作者强调这是 tractable abstraction，不是对真实 Transformer 的精确刻画。
- 统一解释：注意力模式驱动的删法（按历史 attention 低的 token 删）与结构/几何多样性驱动的删法，都可视为在近似同一个容量最大化目标，只是近似方式不同。
- CapKV：提出显式优化容量的 eviction。做法是构造简化的 capacity matrix，并用统计杠杆分数（statistical leverage scores）对 token 重要性打分，采用贪心选择保留高杠杆 token，作为对最优互信息目标的确定性近似。相比纯 attention-score 规则，CapKV 试图更直接刻画“这个 token 的表示子空间对未来查询有多大信息承载能力”。
summary.experiments: 作者在多种模型架构与长上下文基准上做了对比，结论是 CapKV 在“生成保真度 vs 显存节省”的 trade-off 上优于先前方法，并声称其容量指标与下游性能有较强相关性。由于你提供的全文片段未包含具体表格数字（压缩率、困惑度/准确率下降幅度、不同预算B下曲线等），这里无法可靠复述精确数值；精读时建议直接对照主结果表与不同 eviction ratio 的曲线，确认其优势是否在多个预算区间都稳定，以及开销（额外矩阵/分数计算）是否可接受。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看引言与 Figure 1：作者如何把不同 eviction 家族统一到“互信息/容量最大化”的黄色目标块，以及 CapKV 对应的紫色近似目标。
- 方法部分重点抓两件事：线性-高斯 surrogate 下互信息的闭式形式长什么样；CapKV 的 leverage score 从哪个矩阵来、计算复杂度如何、是否需要跨层/跨头聚合。
- 实验部分优先看：不同 cache budget/压缩率下的性能曲线、以及与 attention-score 类方法的对照。
预计阅读时间：30–45 分钟可理解框架；若要落地实现，需要额外时间核对其工程细节与开销。

summary_en.core_problem: KV cache grows linearly with context length and becomes the dominant memory bottleneck in long-context decoding. Existing eviction policies are largely heuristic (attention-score based or diversity/geometry based). The paper asks whether KV eviction can be formulated under a single information-theoretic objective and turned into a practical, low-overhead policy.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference-efficiency paper rather than pretraining. Still useful for foundation-model researchers because (1) it provides a unifying, interpretable objective—mutual-information / capacity maximization—that explains many seemingly different eviction heuristics; (2) for long-context evaluation or continual pretraining setups, eviction policies can confound conclusions about long-range capability by changing what information is effectively retained during decoding. Recommended as a skim focused on the objective and the CapKV approximation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The key move is an Information Bottleneck framing under a linear-Gaussian surrogate of attention:
- Abstraction: treat attention as a linear transmission process and the KV cache entries as a set of linear communication channels.
- Objective: given a cache budget B, select a subset of channels that maximizes the mutual information between (latent) future queries and the transmitted representations—equivalently, maximize an information-capacity metric of the retained subset.
- Unification: attention-pattern eviction and structure/diversity-based eviction are interpreted as different approximations to the same global capacity objective.
- CapKV: a capacity-aware eviction rule that greedily keeps tokens with the highest statistical leverage scores computed from a simplified capacity matrix, yielding a deterministic approximation to the MI-maximization target rather than an empirical scoring heuristic.
summary_en.experiments: Reported experiments across multiple model architectures and long-context benchmarks show CapKV achieves a better fidelity–memory trade-off than prior methods, and the derived capacity metric correlates with downstream performance. The provided content snippet does not include the main tables/figures with exact numbers (e.g., retention ratios, perplexity/accuracy deltas, curves over budgets), so the precise margins cannot be quoted reliably here; the main results table and budget-sweep plots are the places to verify robustness and overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Read the intro and Figure 1 to see how the paper maps diverse eviction heuristics onto a single MI/capacity objective.
- In methodology, focus on (a) the closed-form MI/capacity expression under the linear-Gaussian surrogate, and (b) how CapKV’s leverage scores are derived and what the computational overhead is.
- In experiments, prioritize performance-vs-budget curves and comparisons against attention-score baselines.
Time: ~30–45 minutes for the conceptual framework; more if you intend to implement and need engineering details.

recommendation.zh: 只看推导和实验主表；若 log-det 代理在多模型上稳，这会改变 KV eviction 还停留在启发式调参的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Read the derivation and main tables; if the log-det proxy holds across models, it moves KV eviction beyond heuristic tuning.

paper.title: AMMA: A Multi-Chiplet Memory-Centric Architecture for Low-Latency 1M Context Attention Serving
paper.abstract: All current LLM serving systems place the GPU at the center, from production-level attention-FFN disaggregation to NVIDIA's Rubin GPU-LPU heterogeneous platform. Even academic PIM/PNM proposals still treat the GPU as the central hub for cross-device communication. Yet the GPU's compute-rich architecture is fundamentally mismatched with the memory-bound nature of decode-phase attention, inflating serving latency while wasting power and die area on idle compute units. The problem is compounded as

summary.core_problem: 现有以GPU为中心的LLM推理架构与长上下文解码阶段注意力的内存绑定特性严重不匹配，GPU上大量计算单元闲置，功耗和芯片面积浪费严重，1M token级上下文下注意力延迟成为主要用户感知瓶颈。
summary.importance: 提出了完全脱离GPU中心的近存计算架构设计思路，为长上下文LLM推理专用硬件设计提供了新范式，也为后续推理系统的软硬件协同设计提供了方向参考。
summary.technical_approach: 采用多芯粒内存中心架构，用16个集成PNM（近存计算）加速单元的HBM4立方体替换GPU的计算裸片，每个PNM单元支持数据加载、GEMM/GEMV计算、die-to-die直接通信，无需经过主机GPU即可实现HBM立方体之间的直接交互；针对内存绑定的注意力负载设计专用微架构，采用拓扑感知的并行策略减少跨立方体长距离通信，简化集体通信流程降低开销，通过设计空间探索平衡单立方体计算吞吐量和 inter-die 链路带宽参数。
summary.experiments: 量化分析显示NVIDIA Rubin GPU的计算资源比FP8 GQA注意力需求高25倍，运行注意力负载时仅4%的计算峰值被利用；AMMA方案可将单芯片封装的聚合HBM带宽提升1倍，针对1M token上下文注意力负载优化，可大幅降低解码阶段延迟和功耗。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第一章的GPU架构与注意力负载不匹配的量化分析、第二章的核心架构设计部分，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Current GPU-centric LLM serving architectures are fundamentally mismatched with the memory-bound nature of decode-phase attention for long context workloads. Large amounts of GPU compute units are left idle, causing significant power and die area waste, and attention latency becomes the dominant user-facing bottleneck for 1M-token context lengths.
summary_en.importance: The work proposes a completely GPU-agnostic processing-near-memory architecture paradigm for long-context attention acceleration, providing a new direction for dedicated LLM inference hardware design and future software-hardware co-optimization of inference systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: AMMA adopts a multi-chiplet memory-centric architecture, replacing GPU compute dies with 16 HBM4 cubes integrated with dedicated PNM (processing-near-memory) accelerators. Each PNM unit supports data loading, GEMM/GEMV computation, and direct die-to-die communication, enabling cross-HBM communication without a host GPU. The design includes a dedicated microarchitecture for memory-bound attention workloads, a topology-aware parallelism strategy to reduce long-range data movement, simplified collective communication flows, and design-space exploration to balance per-cube compute throughput and inter-die link bandwidth.
summary_en.experiments: Quantitative analysis shows NVIDIA Rubin GPU has 25x compute surplus for FP8 GQA attention, with only 4% of peak compute throughput utilized for attention workloads. AMMA doubles the aggregated HBM bandwidth per package, optimized for 1M-token context attention workloads to significantly reduce decode latency and power consumption.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1 for the quantitative analysis of GPU-architecture mismatch, and Section 2 for the core architecture design. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看架构和评估假设即可；它不会改变预训练方法，但会约束你对 1M context 模型可服务性的判断。
recommendation.en: Read the architecture and evaluation assumptions; it will not change pretraining recipes, but it should calibrate your priors on whether 1M-context models are actually serviceable.
